job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking an Account Executive to join its growing AccuWeather for Business sales team. AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally. The challenge is to develop new sales through your stellar efforts with new and existing markets, products, and verticals. This position is focused on building the vertical instead of handling a specific region. If you are a metric driven Account Executive who thrives on the responsibility of driving strategic B2B field sales from pipeline development through customer acquisition, then it’s time to apply to this exciting opportunity to join a best in class, growing Sales team!

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

•    Drive strategic B2B field sales from pipeline development and lead cultivation through customer acquisition
•    Develop a solid lead generation strategy that allows for customer retention and referrals
•    Close new business while shortening historical sales cycles
•    Lead and manage multiple accounts and be the single point of contact and expert resource to our customers and foster long term, successful relationships
•    Promote AccuWeather’s industry leading Enterprise Solutions within your vertical and drive engagement at an executive level within target markets segments
•    Develop deep relationships within all your accounts to provide 360-degree coverage from end user through executive
•    Collaborate with members of the AES team to expand our current accounts by introducing the benefits of our new products and services to current customers
•    Maintain effective pipeline management to achieve accuracy in forecasting and quota attainment
•    Work in conjunction with Marketing, Sales Support, Account Management and other internal partners to ensure both campaign delivery objectives and proper competitive positioning for AccuWeather
•    Manage, organize, and update relevant data using applicable sales database applications (Microsoft Dynamic CRM)
•    Follow up on all leads generated by advertising, trade shows, mailings, web sites, other media and both internal/external lead generation sources.
•    Up to 20-30% travel is required at times. 
•    Other duties as assigned as necessary

QUALIFICATIONS 

•    Bachelor’s degree in a related field or the equivalent in education and experience
•    5+ years of experience with Enterprise, large corporate sales environments
•    Expertise in multiple verticals such as Manufacturing, Logistics, Transportation, Healthcare, Insurance or FinTech
•    Demonstrated ability to build customer relationships
•    Proven and demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed quota
•    Excellent client relations and negotiating skills
•    Solid presentation skills (both verbal and written) and the ability to clearly articulate ideas at all levels of the organization
•    Demonstrated ability to simultaneously work on multiple projects and adhere to tight timelines and deadlines
•    Must work well in a team-oriented and collaborative environment 
•    Ability to provide clear and concise justification on how decisions make positive impacts on attaining AccuWeather business objectives
•    Must be willing to travel, including overnight trips, for an average of 20-30 percent of the time
•    While we are considering remote candidates, in the United States, AccuWeather is only able to hire team members in the following states due to taxation purposes: CA, CO, CT, DE, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, MD, MN, MO, NE, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI and WY.

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER
 
AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. 

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Client Systems Specialist
job.description:
The Client Systems Specialist’s primary responsibility is to provide responsive customer service, technical support, and troubleshooting for approximately 100 AccuWeather TV customers. This role supports the department’s 24/7 customer service coverage, helping customers maintain reliable operation of their AccuWeather software, hardware, and data services. The position requires proactive customer communication, advanced troubleshooting, and coordination with internal teams to resolve issues promptly. Occasional travel is required for product demonstrations, system installations, customer training, and trade shows. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Serve as a primary technical support resource for AccuWeather TV customers, providing timely, professional assistance by phone, email, and remote support.
• Participate in the department’s 24/7 support coverage and assigned on-call schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Monitor customer support calls, emails, and requests; prioritize issues based on urgency, impact on customer operations, and departmental guidelines.
• Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, system configuration, and data issues, with particular attention to problems affecting on-air operations.
• Take ownership of assigned support issues from initial response through resolution, keeping customers informed of progress and next steps.
• Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions to support consistent service and knowledge sharing.
• Escalate complex or unresolved issues to management and developers, providing clear details to support timely resolution.
• Communicate with sales and account management teams about ongoing customer issues, support needs, and customer satisfaction.
• Provide proactive customer guidance to help prevent recurring problems and improve system reliability.
• Maintain proficiency and required certifications on all AccuWeather TV graphics systems.
• Maintain a working understanding of AccuWeather and other meteorological data to effectively support customers and meteorologists.
• Test new software versions using current customer configurations and coordinate customer upgrades following release.
• Provide remote customer training on system operation, new features, and troubleshooting procedures.
• Occasionally travel to customer sites to install and configure systems, verify proper operation, and provide training.
• Support sales efforts by demonstrating AccuWeather TV products remotely and, as needed, at customer sites and trade shows.
• Identify customer needs for upgrades, additional systems, or training, and communicate those opportunities to the appropriate sales or account management team.
• Provide technical training, guidance, and mentorship to new staff and sales team members.
• Coordinate support coverage with the team during travel and other scheduled activities.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

BACKGROUND AND QUALIFICATIONS
• At least one year of professional experience supporting PC or Mac computers, software, or hardware required. Relevant education or extensive technical training may be considered in place of employment experience.
• Strong customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm, responsive, and professional when customers experience urgent technical issues.
• Ability to troubleshoot software and hardware problems, prioritize competing requests, and follow issues through to resolution.
• Ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues with varying levels of technical knowledge.
• Ability to read and interpret instructions, technical documentation, procedural and policy manuals, and customer communications.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when documenting issues, coordinating follow-up, and maintaining customer records.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating with support staff, sales, management, and developers.
• Availability to participate in assigned 24/7 on-call coverage, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Ability and willingness to travel occasionally for demonstrations, installations, training, and trade shows.
• Experience with broadcast systems, graphics systems, or meteorological data preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the job's essential functions. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The position requires extended periods of work at a computer workstation using a keyboard and mouse, as well as frequent communication by phone and video conference. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, and lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds during installations, demonstrations, or training. Specific vision abilities include color vision, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. Work is primarily performed in an office or remote support setting, with occasional work at customer stations and trade shows. The role includes responding to time-sensitive technical issues in a live broadcast environment and providing support outside regular business hours as part of the department’s assigned coverage schedule.

job.title: Creative Writer Intern: Forecasting and Communications
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking a highly creative, curious, and deeply collaborative Creative Writer Intern: Forecasting and Communications, to work directly with AccuWeather forecasters and the Writing Committee to further elevate the detail, clarity, precision, and distinctiveness of the language used to describe forecasts for our users. This role is designed for a graduate student or an individual with equivalent writing experience who brings fresh thinking about how complex weather information can be expressed in ways that are more detailed, precise, clear, engaging, and scientifically sound.

Embedded closely with Forecast Operations, this position will learn from meteorologists, participate in the forecast-writing process, and help develop new approaches, terminology, and descriptive frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more informative and better than what is available from any other source. The emphasis is on improving the consumer forecast experience - not traditional public relations - by helping forecasters communicate what the weather will be, what the impact will be, how it will evolve, what it may look like, and what details matter most to people making decisions. This includes a laser focus on developing stronger displays, greater artistry, and more effective visual communications that amplify the advantages of AccuWeather forecasts and content.

The Creative Writer Intern: Forecasting and Communications will serve as a bridge between meteorological expertise and exceptional consumer-facing writing, helping AccuWeather deliver forecast descriptions with greater depth, nuance, consistency, and usefulness while preserving the scientific accuracy and authority at the core of the AccuWeather brand.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Forecast Language, Detail & Description:

  • Work side-by-side with forecasters to craft and refine accurate, detailed, consumer-focused descriptions of daily weather, changing conditions, major storms, seasonal patterns, and forecast developments.
    • Elevate forecast language beyond basic conditions by identifying the most useful details, nuances, timing, impacts, transitions, and sensory descriptions that help users better understand what to expect. Use bold, catchy and descriptive language.
    • Translate complex meteorological concepts into clearer, more detailed, consumer-friendly language without sacrificing scientific meaning, accuracy, or appropriate expressions of forecast confidence.
    • Develop new descriptive approaches, vocabulary, sentence structures, and frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more distinctive, informative, and useful than competing forecast experiences.
    • Help establish consistent terminology for recurring weather patterns while preserving enough flexibility for forecasters to communicate the unique character and details of each forecast.

 

Forecaster & Writing Committee Collaboration:

  • Embed with AccuWeather forecasters to understand how forecasts are created, where language choices can add value, and how writing can better communicate meteorological insight to users.
    • Work closely with the AccuWeather Writing Committee to test, evaluate, and introduce new approaches to forecast writing and description.
    • Bring an outside writing perspective to established forecast workflows, asking thoughtful questions and proposing new ways of thinking, writing, and working.
  • Challenge conventional approaches to forecast description and explore new ways to communicate weather that provide users with greater detail, context, understanding, and value.
    • Gather feedback from meteorologists and other stakeholders, iterate on language, and help turn successful approaches into practical writing guidance and repeatable standards.
    • Support a collaborative environment in which meteorological expertise and strong writing work together to create a richer forecast experience.

 

Consumer Forecast Experience & Innovation:

  • Review forecast descriptions across AccuWeather consumer experiences and identify opportunities to add specificity, context, clarity, and useful detail.
    • Develop and test language that helps users better understand the timing, intensity, duration, variability, uncertainty, and real-world impacts of weather events.
  • Explore new ways to make routine forecasts more useful, engaging, descriptive, and impactful, bringing the same level of creativity and attention to detail to both high-impact weather coverage and everyday conditions such as temperature, wind, precipitation, cloud cover, humidity, visibility, and changing conditions.
    • Help ensure forecast descriptions are clear and effective across digital platforms while retaining the depth and detail that distinguish AccuWeather.
    • Contribute ideas that reinforce AccuWeather’s Superior Accuracy™ through the quality, precision, and usefulness of the forecast language itself.

 

Writing Standards & Continuous Improvement:

  • Help evolve AccuWeather’s authoritative, trustworthy, detailed, and forward-looking forecast voice.
    • Identify new ways to describe weather phenomena that are vivid, memorable, consumer-relevant, and scientifically sound.
    • Contribute to forecast-writing standards, terminology guidelines, examples, and best practices used by forecasters and content teams.
    • Study how forecast language performs in practice and recommend improvements based on clarity, usefulness, consistency, and differentiation.
    • Encourage experimentation and fresh thinking while respecting operational requirements, meteorological accuracy, and established review processes.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

 

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Writing, or a closely related writing-intensive field is required.
    • Current graduate student in communications, writing, journalism, English, creative writing, technical writing, or a related discipline, or equivalent advanced or professional writing experience.
    • Exceptional command of written language, including tone, clarity, precision, descriptive detail, structure, and audience awareness.
    • Demonstrated ability to take complex or technical information and make it clear, specific, useful, and engaging for a broad audience.
    • Strong collaborative skills and genuine interest in working closely with meteorologists, subject-matter experts, and a writing committee.
    • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn meteorological concepts and forecast workflows.
    • Ability to receive expert feedback, revise quickly, and improve language through an iterative process.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Interest in or familiarity with meteorology, weather forecasting, climate, environmental science, science communication, or technical writing.
    • Experience developing descriptive language, style guidance, editorial standards, or writing frameworks.
    • Experience collaborating directly with technical or scientific subject-matter experts.
    • Portfolio examples demonstrating precise, vivid, explanatory, or detail-rich writing.

 

Skills & Competencies:

  • Creative thinking grounded in accuracy, precision, and credibility.
    • Exceptional descriptive and explanatory writing.
    • Ability to identify and elevate the details that matter most to users.
    • Strong editing, revision, and language-development skills.
    • Curiosity about weather and willingness to learn from forecasters.
    • Collaborative, workshop-oriented approach to writing.
    • Ability to develop practical writing standards while continuing to experiment with new approaches.
    • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
    • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of an embedded team.

 

About AccuWeather

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

A billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 225 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Samsung, Vizio, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers is a visionary entrepreneur and has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times. He has been recognized in Entrepreneur Magazine’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs as one of the greatest entrepreneurs in American history.  Myers received the American Meteorological Society’s 2018 Award for Outstanding Contributions to the Advancement of Applied Meteorology and the National Weather Association’s 2017 Lifetime Achievement Award, in addition to numerous other accolades.

job.title: Data Architect I
job.description:
Want to lead the technical design behind modernizing AccuWeather For Business — the platform that delivers AccuWeather’s data and services to more than half of the Fortune 500? We are looking for a Data Architect I who combines strong platform design expertise with the judgment to assess legacy infrastructure and design an implementable, cloud-native architecture; someone who wants to own the technical direction of a critical modernization initiative without compromising the reliability enterprise clients depend on. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this position will assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business and design the cloud-native architecture that will support its future. You will produce architecture and modernization design documents — including current-state assessments, target-state designs, transition and sequencing plans, and technical specifications — and work alongside engineering teams to implement key components of the architecture, while maintaining the reliability of the backend data systems that support critical data delivery services.

You will demonstrate high-level knowledge across cloud platforms and legacy enterprise systems, independently resolve complex architecture and modernization challenges, and collaborate closely with the Data Architect II and engineering teams. Your work will help modernize the technology foundation behind AccuWeather For Business, creating a more scalable, resilient, and cloud-native platform while maintaining the reliability expected by the Fortune 500 companies that depend on it.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business, documenting current-state architecture, system dependencies, data flows, and technical debt to inform modernization priorities.

· Design the cloud-native architecture, producing architecture designs, technical specifications, and other documentation needed to guide implementation.

· Own the architectural direction for the modernization effort, ensuring a cohesive approach across the platform rather than individual services or components.

· Develop a roadmap and sequencing plan that provides a practical path from the current environment to the cloud-native architecture while minimizing disruption to enterprise clients.

· Design backend data systems to maintain continuity of critical data delivery services throughout the transition.

· Partner with engineering and data teams to validate and implement architecture designs, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, performant, and maintainable.

· Contribute hands-on to the implementation of architecture designs, including developing and modifying code, data models, schemas, and supporting data platform components.

· Estimate data consumption, capacity, and infrastructure requirements, incorporating cloud infrastructure costs into architecture decisions and trade-offs.

· Identify and document architectural and operational risks associated with modernizing a customer-facing production platform, and design appropriate mitigation strategies.

· Ensure the cloud-native architecture addresses performance, security, scalability, resiliency, recoverability, compliance, and data residency requirements.

· Understand system scheduling, integrations, and dependencies across the platform and incorporate them into planning and sequencing.

· Serve as a technical point of contact for questions and decisions related to the modernization effort’s architectural direction.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data or enterprise architecture, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

o High-level knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and cloud-native architecture.

o Demonstrated experience assessing legacy, on-premises systems and designing modern, cloud-native architectures.

o Demonstrated experience planning or supporting large-scale modernization initiatives for production, customer-facing platforms.

o Experience designing production data platforms for performance, scalability, resiliency, and recoverability.

o Experience analyzing complex system dependencies, integrations, data flows, and scheduling requirements to inform architecture and modernization decisions.

o Demonstrated experience working with PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, schema design, and query development.

o Advanced proficiency in Python or Go, with experience developing production-quality code for data platforms or backend systems.

· Preferred Qualifications:

o Experience designing backend data platforms that support data delivery to external or enterprise clients.

o Experience evaluating technology and architecture options, including build-versus-buy decisions and alternative modernization approaches.

o Experience evaluating infrastructure requirements and costs to inform cloud architecture decisions and design trade-offs.

o Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and data governance requirements, including SOC 2 and data residency considerations.

· Skills & Competencies:

o Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design architectures that engineering teams can implement and maintain effectively.

o Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce clear, actionable architecture and technical design documentation.

o Sound technical judgment, with the ability to translate business and platform requirements into pragmatic architecture without overengineering or underspecifying solutions.

o Ability to move effectively between architecture and hands-on implementation, translating designs into working solutions in collaboration with engineering teams.

o Ability to mentor team members and help develop the architectural judgment of less experienced engineers.

o Ability to independently lead complex, large-scale architecture initiatives and drive technical decisions through ambiguity.

 

About AccuWeather 

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

job.title: Director, Advertising Sales
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking an accomplished, strategic and results-driven Advertising Sales Director in New York to help build and sell digital advertising solutions. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced sales leader with a proven track record to navigate complex digital media and data targeting solutions, work cross-functionally to develop innovative advertising solutions and build lasting client relationships. You’ll contribute to a high-caliber team in a business that is experiencing rapid and dramatic growth. We are looking for demonstrated performance in a constantly changing, ambiguous environment and problem-solving leadership with limited oversight.

This role will manage Holding Company agency relationships with a focus on the C-Suite, Agency Investment Leads, Brand Teams, Buying Teams, Programmatic Buying Arms and Data Analytics & Strategy Teams. In partnership with senior leadership, this role will develop a strategy specific to assigned holding companies, while driving AccuWeather’s media, data, measurement and analytics revenue. This position requires extensive knowledge of the changing agency & media landscape, the drive to develop industry-transforming strategies and the ability to build relationships with senior agency management and brands direct. The ideal candidate has media agency planning experience, a deep knowledge of measurement & analytics used to evaluate performance, ability to develop and effectively communicate creative ideas and solutions along with a proven ability to influence multiple levels of an organization.

This position will be located onsite at AccuWeather’s New York City office with the expectation of being in office with teammates three days a week.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Achieve and exceed revenue goals set by the company for existing and new accounts. Focus on selling AccuWeather digital advertising products to advertising agency and brand direct partners maintaining and fostering positive relationships across both new and existing clients.
  • Build and elevate relationships at the highest levels within the assigned agencies, C-Suite, Senior Agency Influencers to continuously uncover strategic opportunities to drive AccuWeather revenue on a global, regional, and local level.
  • Serve as internal voice of the agency customer to help shape product and marketing roadmaps. Assess the revenue potential of assigned account list and identify highest value targets.
  • Prospect new business opportunities within territory through regular, thoughtful outreach to new clients/agencies with face-to-face meetings, presentations, events, entertainment and other related efforts.
  • Identify revenue opportunities to grow existing clients/advertising agencies relationships.
  • Client account management including, but not limited to: maintaining contact lists, establishing meeting cadence with (internal and external) key stakeholders, seeking out new relationships/contacts, developing quarterly business reviews, organizing and coordinating agency education initiatives (cross discipline agency days and/or training sessions), fulfilling ad hoc client requests, campaign performance reviews along with client entertaining.
  • Consistent pipeline maintenance, and strong internal communications skills to ensure leadership and cross functional partners are apprise of pipeline updates, progress to goal, territory updates and opportunities, along with challenges
  • Contribute to AccuWeather’s tentpole senior-level events, conferences and activations within assigned agencies.
  • Collaborate with internal specialists (i.e. marketing, strategy, data, operations/analytics) as needed to meet revenue requirements and to continuously identify relevant opportunities for agencies/brands.
  • Contribute to agency holding company partnership level agreements, with opportunity to lead specific initiatives in addition to capturing revenue opportunities at the account level
  • Be a trusted thought leader to both external stakeholders and investment teams by leading consistent customer and prospect education initiatives and events.
  • Operate at the ‘tip of the spear’, immersing in industry shifts (in-housing, rise of independent agencies and consultancies etc.) and competitive offerings, to bring an ‘outside-in’ perspective, framing new sales initiatives and recommendations
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in the industry; act as an ambassador and spokesperson for AccuWeather in the advertising community.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS 

  • BA/BS degree required with 5+ years digital ad sales experience with a focus on digital media, programmatic, first party data and analytics; experience executing large scale brand partnerships across channels ideal.
  • High performer – achieve and exceed revenue targets through effective sales strategies, performance optimization and development of innovative campaign strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically about a particular industry and/or product set to achieve customer goals and KPIs; ability to think creatively to solve problems to maintain and grow revenue, and to break new business
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills along with strong presentation skills in both small and large groups.
  • Familiarity with agency holding companies and strong relationships across the agency and brand direct
  • Ability to work collaboratively amidst cross-functional teams including but not limited to strategy, marketing, ad operations and analytics.
  • Tenacious and driven self-starter who takes a hands-on approach in discovering new business opportunities and proactive outreach with a focus on high-value prospects.
  • Hunter mentality – focus on cold outreach and prospecting to secure meetings with new clients and expanding relationships with existing.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Ability to build internal networks to accomplish goals through collaboration with resources across teams.

job.title: General Counsel
job.description:
AccuWeather is searching for a dynamic General Counsel to join its leadership team. The General Counsel leads AccuWeather's Legal Services team and serves as chief legal advisor to the CEO and business leaders across a global B2C digital media business, and enterprise B2B weather-data and insights business, and a linear broadcast/OTT network. This role owns the company's legal risk, commercial contracting, IP, privacy, and litigation strategy, and is responsible for modernizing the legal functions, including through the adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows to deliver faster, leaner, and more scalable legal support to the business.

The position is located on-site at AccuWeather's Headquarters in State College, PA  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Legal Operations & AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Champion the adoption of AI legal tools (contract lifecycle management, legal research, drafting assistance) to cut cycle time, reduce outside counsel spend, and scale the legal team's output.
  • Build and own the company's internal AI governance framework and advise the business on legal and regulatory risk arising from its own use and development of AI.
  • Redesign commercial contracting and other legal workflows for speed, consistency, and measurable efficiency gains.
  • Structure and manage the internal legal team and legal support staff; manage outside counsel relationships and budget for cost-effective coverage.

Commercial & Corporate Transactions

  • Negotiate and draft high-value commercial agreements, including content and technology licensing, strategic partnerships and alliances, and ad-tech platform arrangements.
  • Serve as lead legal advisor on M&A, divestitures, joint ventures, and corporate investment transactions.
  • Advise on financing activity, including business and legal-entity structuring.
  • Advise on content delivery and distribution issues across broadcast, cable, and OTT platforms.

Data Privacy, Cybersecurity & Regulatory

  • Act as subject-matter expert on consumer data privacy for a digital media company with a global user base, and monitor emerging privacy, cybersecurity, and AI regulation for business impact.
  • Partner with Security and IT on cybersecurity risk, vendor data-processing terms, and incident response.
  • Ensure company-wide compliance with applicable domestic and international laws and standards.

Litigation, IP & Risk

  • Direct litigation strategy and outside counsel on matters filed by or against the company; approve settlements.
  • Protect the company's intellectual property portfolio, trademarks, copyrights, patents, and trade secrets — including strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Oversee contract enforcement and delinquency collections.

Corporate Governance & Board Support

  • Serve as key advisor to the CEO and Board of Directors on corporate governance, risk, and major transactions.
  • Participate in defining corporate policies, procedures, and programs, and advise on their legal implications.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • JD and 15+ years of relevant experience, including service as General Counsel or senior in-house counsel in a corporate environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of AI legal tools and a demonstrated record of using AI to drive legal-department efficiency (not just familiarity, but hands-on experience selecting, implementing, or championing AI tools in a legal setting).
  • Broad intellectual property experience, including patent law, IP licensing, and IP due diligence.
  • Working familiarity with employment law and compliance investigations (DOL/OFCCP).
  • Proven ability to negotiate and draft complex, high-value contracts and to quickly analyze agreements from varied origins.
  • Strong executive presence; able to advise and present to senior management, the Board, and international clients and partners.
  • Experience managing a team of attorneys and legal support staff and managing outside counsel cost-effectively.
  • Experience with corporate governance matters involving a Board of Directors.
  • General knowledge of tax laws and standards as they relate to corporate transactions.

Preferred

  • Experience in digital media, broadcast/OTT, or a comparable data- or platform-driven industry.
  • Exposure to board governance, M&A processes, or strategic planning cycles.
  • Experience directing strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Experience managing or coordinating cross-functional teams without direct authority.

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 225 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Samsung, Vizio, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee. AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers is a visionary entrepreneur and has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times. He has been recognized in Entrepreneur Magazine’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs as one of the greatest entrepreneurs in American history. job.title: Development Security Operations (DevSecOps) Engineer
job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

Job Summary

The Development Security Operations (DevSecOps) Engineer is a technical role responsible for implementing and maintaining secure software development practices across the organization. Working closely with development, operations, and security teams, this position helps ensure that software delivery processes and environments align with industry best practices while maintaining operational efficiency and strong security controls. The DevSecOps Engineer supports the integration of security throughout the software development lifecycle, assists in identifying and mitigating security risks, and contributes to the continuous improvement of security automation, monitoring, and compliance capabilities.

Essential Functions

  • Implement and maintain secure software development practices across the organization by:
    • Performing code reviews and collaborate with development teams to address security vulnerabilities and implement secure coding practices.
    • Providing guidance and support to development teams in implementing secure coding practices and integrating security into the development lifecycle.
    • Work to provide security efforts with DevOps team to secure infrastructure and ensure secure deployment and operation of applications.
    • Work with cross-functional teams to define security requirements, standards, and guidelines for software development projects.
  • Enhance and monitor the tools used within the development and operations process.  This includes:
    • Reviewing and enhancing CI/CD pipelines using Github Actions, Azure DevOps, AWS Code pipeline, and Jenkins.
    • Utilizing tools like Orca Security, Sysdig, Codacy and Azure Log Analytics to monitor and analyze system logs and application code for security vulnerabilities.
    • Staying up to date with the latest security trends, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices, and ensure their integration into our software development processes.
    • Secure Image and Artifact Management: Protect container images, build artifacts, and other software packages used in the CI/CD pipeline. Scan these artifacts for vulnerabilities before deploying them and utilize secure registries for storage and distribution.
  • Work on the implementation as well as help maintain a security program.  This includes:
    • Conducting Risk Assessments using frameworks like the OWASP top 10
    • Developing a Risk Treatment Plan
    • Determining and create needed information Security Policies
    • Determining and create needed information Security Objectives
    • Maintain and help develop Security Reports
    • Help implement Security Controls within each dev group
    • Manage vendor relations
  • Work with internal and external team in working on audits, incident response, and/or compliance processes.
  • Work to define requirements and processes for Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity.  After requirements and processes are determined and approved, assist in the facilitation of a DR test.

Required Qualifications

 

  • BA/BS Degree (4- year)
  • 2-5 years of related work experience
  • Have experience managing vendor relationships and running an implementation from start to finish.
  • Has been a team lead or managed a team of security professionals.
  • Experience with a unified, real-time monitoring and analytics platform, such as Azure Log Analytics, Google Cloud Operations (Stackdriver), AWS CloudWatch, Sentry, Splunk or Datadog
  • Experience in at least one programming language (JavaScript, Ruby, Python, PHP, C#)
  • Experience with cloud environment such as AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience using a CI/CD tool like Github Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline
  • Experience with apply frameworks in the Software Development Lifecycle like OWASP top 10, NIST, etc
  • Experience configuring infrastructure and application alerts, alarms, and notifications.

Position Summary

The primary responsibilities of the Touring Director are to drive touring revenue through owned, co-promoted, and strategic touring opportunities while leading the development and execution of CMN's touring strategy. This role is responsible for identifying and securing content, evaluating market opportunities, and determining where, when, and how the company strategically assumes risk to maximize revenue and profitability. The Touring Director builds and maintains long-term relationships with artists, agents, promoters, venues, and industry partners to expand touring opportunities and strengthen CMN's market position. This role exercises substantial independent judgment and discretion in evaluating investments, negotiating touring opportunities, developing market strategies, and allocating resources to achieve business objectives. Additionally, the Touring Director ensures a seamless transition of confirmed tours and shows to Touring Managers for execution and delivery.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

  • Drive touring revenue through owned, co-promoted, and strategic touring opportunities.
  • Lead the development and execution of touring strategies that support company growth and profitability objectives.

  • Determine where, when, and how the company assumes risk on touring, co-promotion, and event opportunities.
  • Develop and execute market expansion strategies to increase touring revenue and strengthen CMN's presence in key markets.
  • Negotiate tour agreements, co-promotion deals, artist agreements, venue agreements, and other business arrangements.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with artists, agents, managers, promoters, venues, and industry stakeholders.

  • Develop tour budgets, revenue forecasts, and financial models to support business planning and decision-making.
  • Represent the company at industry conferences, showcases, meetings, and networking events.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities, partnerships, and revenue streams within the touring and live entertainment sectors.
  • Present strategic recommendations, business cases, and performance analyses to senior leadership.
  • Transition confirmed tours and shows to Touring Managers and Operations teams for execution and delivery.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned that are consistent with the nature and level of the position.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Entertainment Management, Music Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field; equivalent industry experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in touring, concert promotion, live entertainment, talent buying, event production, artist management, or related industry roles.

  • Demonstrated experience evaluating business opportunities, financial risk, and market expansion strategies.
  • Experience negotiating artist agreements, tour agreements, co-promotion deals, venue agreements, and related contracts.
  • Strong understanding of the live entertainment, touring, concert promotion, and venue industries.
  • Established network of industry contacts, including artists, agents, managers, promoters, venues, and business partners.

  • Exceptional negotiation, business development, and relationship management skills.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to evaluate risk and make informed business decisions that impact revenue, profitability, and company growth.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, CRM platforms, and financial reporting tools.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and lead cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of current industry trends, touring economics, market conditions, and emerging opportunities.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally and work evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in evaluating touring opportunities, negotiating business agreements, managing financial risk, and making strategic decisions that impact company performance.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and forward-thinking Security Architect (ESA) to join our Information Security team. Reporting to the VP of Information Security, and operating within the global security team under the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this role serves as the lead security architect responsible for designing and implementing secure architectures that enable the business while reducing risk. The Security Architect will work closely with IT, Venues, Infrastructure, Application Development, Legal, Compliance, and the Security Operations team to define and embed security standards into enterprise technology solutions. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of deep technical expertise, architectural experience, and strong business acumen to drive secure design practices across a complex and distributed environment.

Essential Functions

  • Secure Architecture Design:
    • Develop and maintain security architecture standards, reference architectures, and design patterns across cloud, infrastructure, network, endpoint, identity, and application environments.
    • Define secure architecture principles that support network segmentation, identity-driven access controls, and secure access to enterprise resources.
    • Ensure new technologies and solutions are designed with security in mind and align with organizational security, risk, and compliance requirements.
    • Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to ensure security architecture initiatives support strategic objectives and CISO priorities.
    • Create architecture guidance for enterprise applications, cloud platforms, integrations, identity services, and venue technologies.
    • Incorporate threat intelligence, threat modeling, and emerging risks into architecture decisions and security design standards.
  • Solution Reviews and Advisory:
    • Provide hands-on security guidance throughout solution design, implementation, and deployment efforts.
    • Lead security architecture reviews and deliver risk-based recommendations for new technologies, major initiatives, and significant system changes.
    • Work closely with engineering and operations teams to implement approved security architectures and controls.
    • Evaluate and recommend security controls that balance risk reduction with business and operational needs.
  • Cross-Functional Engagement:
    • Partner with IT, Application Development, Infrastructure, Security Operations, and PMO teams to align security requirements and integration efforts.
    • Serve as the security subject matter expert within project teams, helping stakeholders navigate security requirements, risks, and tradeoffs.
  • Security Standards and Frameworks:
    • Develop and maintain enterprise reference architectures, secure configuration standards, and reusable security patterns.
    • Align architecture principles and security controls with frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Cloud and SaaS Security Enablement:
    • Lead security architecture and design reviews for cloud platforms, SaaS solutions, enterprise applications, integrations, and emerging technologies.
    • Partner with Cloud Engineering and DevOps teams to implement secure deployment and operational practices.
    • Provide architectural guidance for cloud services, enterprise applications, and security technology implementations.
  • Innovation and Future-State Planning:
    • Monitor emerging threats, technologies, and industry trends to identify opportunities for improving the organization's security posture.
    • Contribute to the long-term security architecture roadmap in support of business, technology, and security strategies.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) (Advanced Degree Preferred) Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Master's degree or advanced certifications preferred.
  • 8-10 years Experience in information security, cybersecurity, or information technology, including at least 5 years in security architecture, security engineering, or related technical leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and securing enterprise solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Hands-on experience with identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption, logging and monitoring, and SSDLC practices.
  • Experience developing security architecture standards, reference architectures, and secure design guidance.
  • Experience performing architecture risk assessments, threat modeling, and security reviews for enterprise systems and technologies.
  • Proven ability to work with engineering, infrastructure, application development, and business stakeholders to deliver secure technology solutions.
  • Deep understanding of security technologies including firewalls, WAFs, IAM, endpoint protection, cloud security tools, and SIEM/SOAR platforms.
  • Experience designing and securing identity and access management solutions, including authentication, authorization, federation, and privileged access controls.
  • Familiarity with modern IT architectures including cloud-native platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevOps pipelines.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess technical risk and provide sound recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey complex topics to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills across IT, Security, Legal, and business teams.
  • Proficiency with architecture modeling tools and documentation platforms (e.g., Lucidchart, Visio, Confluence).
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of network segmentation strategies and modern identity-centric security models.
  • Licenses/Certifications Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, AWS Certified Security – Specialty (SCS-C03), Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate, CISA, or equivalent certifications preferred.

job.title: Financial Settlements Specialist - AXS
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

 

The Role

The Financial Settlement Specialist will play a role in the financial operations, ensuring accurate and timely settlement of events through the AXS ticketing platform. The role involves collaborating with internal teams, reconciling financial data, and providing exceptional support to both clients and venue partners.

What you will do

  • Run weekly reports from our AXS ticketing system to track revenues and liabilities.
  • Assist with reconciliation and financial analysis projects.
  • Work with our clients’ finance teams to ensure the timely and accurate financial settlement of events using the AXS ticketing platform.
  • Calculate settlement amounts and fees for events sold in the AXS system to support payments to clients.
  • Provide reporting to our clients to support settlement payments and invoices.
  • Assist our venue partners with reporting and financial issues related to AXS ticketing.
  • Respond to client inquiries about settlement and finance issues with prompt and clear communication.
  • Accurately audit our fee structures based on client contracts.
  • Work with our accounting team to produce journal entries that provide general ledger support.

Qualifications (ALL)

  • AA/AS Degree (2-year) (BA/BS Degree Preferred) Finance, Accounting, or relevant field of study
  • 2+ years years of experience in Accounting or Finance OR Live Event or Ticketing
  • Proficient knowledge of MS Excel required, including pivot tables and some macros.
  • Creative problem solving.

  • Familiarity with auditing procedures.

The Digital Product Manager is responsible for managing and optimizing fan-facing digital experiences across web, mobile app, and ecommerce platforms. This role will support the execution of the organization’s digital product roadmap with a focus on improving user experience, conversion, engagement, and revenue performance.

This position will work cross-functionally with marketing, analytics, ticketing, technology, and external partners to deliver scalable digital experiences and support personalization, testing, optimization, and website development initiatives across the fan journey. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of modern web platforms and front-end technologies and be comfortable working directly within content management systems to support the creation, launch, and ongoing optimization of digital experiences.

Essential Functions

  • Support the execution and management of the organization’s digital product roadmap across web, app, and ecommerce platforms.
  • Coordinate cross-functional digital initiatives that improve fan experience, conversion, engagement, and operational efficiency.
  • Assist in managing UX, CRO, and site optimization efforts to improve digital performance and customer satisfaction.
  • Support the creation, development, launch, and ongoing management of websites, landing pages, and digital experiences across CMS platforms.
  • Utilize a working knowledge of HTML and CSS, along with basic JavaScript, to support front-end enhancements, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate effectively with developers and technology partners.
  • Partner with analytics teams to monitor digital KPIs, conversion funnels, and behavioral insights to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work with Technology, AEG, hosting providers, and external vendors to manage platform enhancements, integrations, hosting environments, domain and infrastructure considerations, issue resolution, and product releases.
  • Help prioritize digital enhancements and feature requests based on business impact, fan feedback, technical feasibility, and performance insights.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) (Advanced Degree Preferred) Digital Marketing, Digital Techology, Product or related technical field
  • 4-6 years Related work experience
  • Proven experience supporting and managing digital product strategy across web, mobile app, and ecommerce platforms, including UX optimization, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and digital roadmap execution.
  • Experience creating, launching, managing, or significantly contributing to consumer-facing websites and digital products.
  • Experience managing and optimizing fan-facing digital experiences, including ticketing flows, ecommerce journeys, content experiences, landing pages, and customer engagement touchpoints.

The Graphic and Motion Designer will conceptualize and execute creative design concepts for communication across print, digital and multimedia formats for the LA Galaxy and Dignity Health Sports Park. This role is approximately 70% graphic design and 30% motion design, supporting digital, social media and video teams with visual communication through the build out of static and animated creative assets. Grow and evolve brand and brand relevance of the LA Galaxy and Dignity Health Sports Park.

Essential Functions

  • Collaborate on and design logos, digital and social graphics, stadium videoboard graphics, print ads, out of home ads and retail merchandise; design advertisements, print materials, still digital imaging, web graphics, marketing campaigns and sales promotions that reach and retain fans, per strategy set by the Head of Creative and Brand
  • Animate and adapt existing brand assets into motion graphics for social media, videoboard, LED and broadcast use, including title cards, lower thirds, transitions, logo stings, sponsor animations and short-form animated storytelling; translate static campaign design systems into motion while ensuring visual and brand consistency across every format and screen size
  • Serve as the daily point-of-contact for Dignity Health Sports Park graphic design needs by interacting directly with Dignity Health Sports Park employees and project managing and designing their graphic requests
  • Execute game day digital strategy for both home and away matches by designing in-game static and animated graphics for use on web, social media and videoboard
  • Collaborate with Creative and Brand leaders on strategizing and developing methods to increase fan engagement and brand awareness across all digital platforms

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) Graphic Design, Motion Design or a related field.
  • 2-4 years Related work experience.
  • Portfolio showcasing graphic design and motion design work across digital, print, and video platforms.
  • Ability to create compelling visual communication for print, digital and video platforms.
  • Advance proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, including keyframing, basic 2D animation and exporting to platform and videoboard specifications.
  • Strong knowledge of print, web and social media best practices.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize competing deadlines, and effectively manage stakeholder expectations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Creative thinker with the ability to develop innovative design solutions and contribute new ideas to enhance fan engagement and brand storytelling.
  • Collaborative team player who demonstrates professionalism, accountability, initiative, and dependability.
  • Flexible and adapts to various environments and situations.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required by the professional sports industry.
  • Knowledge of soccer, Major League Soccer (MLS), and the Los Angeles sports market is a plus.
  • Professional sports, entertainment, agency, or live event experience preferred.
  • Experience with Cinema 4D, Blender or other 3D software is a plus.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer - Fullstack - AXS
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

AXS is seeking a Lead Software Engineer – Full Stack to lead the design and development of our core ticketing platforms.

You will lead full-stack work across user interfaces, back-end services, APIs, and integrations. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership, architecture, and team guidance in a complex enterprise environment. You’ll own initiatives end-to-end on front-end and back-end, drive technical direction, and partner with Product, Design, and engineering to ship secure, scalable software for high-demand, global use cases.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain front-end and back-end features for web applications.
  • Lead full-stack architecture and design reviews; author or review technical design as needed.
  • Set standards for code quality, security, performance, accessibility, and scalability on UI and services.
  • Build APIs, business logic, and integrations that support strong user experiences.
  • Support agile delivery: planning, estimation, backlog breakdown, risk and blocker management.
  • Champion testing, CI/CD, observability, and operational practices for apps and services.
  • Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, and improve documentation and knowledge sharing.

What to Bring

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including technical leadership.
  • Strong front-end experience: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript; frameworks such as React or Next.js; modern UI architecture, accessibility, and responsive design.
  • Strong back-end experience: C# and .NET Core; building APIs, services, and business logic that power web applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to own work across front-end and back-end, not only one layer.
  • Solid understanding of API design, integrations, and modern application architecture.
  • Experience optimizing UI performance and service performance/reliability.
  • Proven ability to lead engineers, set engineering standards, and drive work from concept through production.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication; strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have

  • AWS; Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, or similar data stores; Node.js.
  • Design systems, CI/CD, distributed or event-driven patterns.



 

At AXS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles. 

 

Pay Scale: $165,000 - $185,000

Bonus:  This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. 

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 *Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position. 

* There is an onsite interviewing round required for this role. 

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace.

 

 

 

More about AXS

 

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment. 

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

 

 

More about AEG

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

Job Summary

The Marketing Manager- Festivals is responsible for all marketing assets for festivals on calendar.  This position will work in conjunction with artist management, Radio/TV, and marketing team to create and develop an effective marketing plan that will reach the correct demographic and target customers appropriate for each show.  The Marketing Manager will develop graphic content used to inform the general public of shows for the purpose of gaining ticket sales.  This position will also be responsible for maintaining and tracking budgets to make sure funds are allocated correctly.  The Marketing Manager will oversee social media accounts and ensure they are up to date with engaging material.

Essential Functions

  • Responsible for development and execution of marketing and promotional plans. Collaborates with festival directors, talent buyers, and marketing director to plan and oversee the marketing spend.
  • Generate and adhere to marketing budget. Book and account for all advertising and media ensuring funds are allocated to correct partners. Prepare advertising settlements for each show
  • Oversee Social Media accounts for each show.  Develop ad copy; implement ad schedules to appeal to a specific demographic and target customer.
  • Oversee and evaluate show performance, making adjustments to meet marketing strategy in changing market or competitive conditions
  • Supervise publicity, advance press interviews, secure and coordinate artist availability for promotions with management, label and public relations agencies.
  • Develop and pitch promotions to media outlets.  Contact radio and schedule radio time and set up giveaways.  Negotiate rates and contracts with various media outlets
  • Develop additional marketing opportunities to increase ticket sales when needed.   Keep up with current marketing and social media trends to brainstorm new ideas and concepts for assets and promotions to market events.
  • Work with marketing team and artist management to strategize new ways to market shows and reach the correct audience.   Request graphics for ecards, banners, posters, social media post, radio station needs and e-mails
  • May be responsible for overseeing interns and assistants.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4 years) in Marketing/ Business Communications, PR Preferred
  • 4-6 years Of related work experience
  • 4-6 years Experience with media buying
  • May be responsible for overseeing interns and assistants.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Knowledge of social media and online marketing initiatives and strategies
  • Must be internet savvy
  • Proficient in Photoshop and MS Office
  • Creative, detail-oriented person who can juggle multiple tasks
  • Knowledge of Music industry preferred
  • Passion for music preferred

Payscale: $76,072.00 - $100,000.00

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.
