job.title: Manager, Payments and Fraud Analytics - AEG
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

 

 

The Role

AXS is seeking a Manager, Payments and Fraud to lead macro-level analytics for AXS payment performance and fraud risk. The role uses advanced SQL, data visualization, and payments expertise to identify opportunities to increase authorization and conversion, reduce processing costs, prevent material fraud and chargeback losses, and improve payment reliability across markets, channels, and providers. Unlike transaction-review roles that make accept-or-decline decisions on individual orders, this position analyzes portfolio trends and converts findings into business, product, routing, and risk recommendations. The manager partners with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and internal Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Fraud Prevention teams. The role initially leads through expertise and cross-functional influence and is expected to assume direct people-management responsibility as the analytics team grows.

 

What Will You Do?

  • Lead deep-dive analysis of payment authorization, decline, conversion, routing, settlement, and processing-cost data; identify material trends and quantify opportunities by market, issuer, network, gateway, payment method, and customer segment.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and loss data at the portfolio level; identify emerging patterns and control gaps, size financial exposure, and recommend changes to fraud strategies, rules, tools, and operating processes.
  • Build and maintain trusted KPI definitions, SQL analyses, dashboards, and executive reporting for payment performance, fraud, chargebacks, costs, and customer impact; establish data-quality controls and clear measurement methods.
  • Develop business cases and lead cross-functional optimization initiatives, experiments, and post-implementation measurement for payment routing, authorization uplift, fraud controls, payment methods, tokenization, 3DS, and cross-border performance.
  • Monitor high-volume on-sales and material payment or fraud events; perform root-cause analysis, coordinate stakeholders, and translate incidents into corrective actions and longer-term improvements.
  • Partner with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and other providers to review performance, investigate issues, evaluate capabilities, and hold partners accountable for agreed service and optimization actions.
  • Advise Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Fraud Prevention, and senior leaders on priorities, tradeoffs, and policy or process changes; communicate complex findings and gain support for recommendations with financial and customer impact.
  • Establish the operating model, priorities, documentation, and performance standards for the analytics function; coordinate work across analysts and develop, coach, and manage direct reports as positions are added.

 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 4-6 years of hands-on advanced SQL analysis using large transaction-level datasets and development of dashboards or data visualizations for business decisions.
  • 4-6 years of progressive experience in payments analytics, fraud analytics, payment operations, risk, or a closely related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, coordinating the work of analysts, or managing and developing team members.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to join, validate, segment, and interpret large payment and fraud datasets.
  • Advanced data visualization and dashboard development skills using Tableau, Looker, or comparable tools; experience working with Snowflake or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Strong knowledge of card payments, authorization and decline behavior, routing, processing economics, interchange and network fees, settlement, chargebacks, disputes, and fraud controls.
  • Working knowledge of payment networks and processors or gateways, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, and Stripe.
  • Knowledge of tokenization, 3DS, alternative payment methods, cross-border payments, and the customer checkout experience.
  • Ability to frame ambiguous business questions, perform root-cause analysis, quantify financial and customer impact, and recommend practical actions.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis to technical and nontechnical audiences and influence decisions across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, vendors, and senior leadership.
  • Leadership skills to set priorities, establish standards, coordinate work, coach analysts, and build a high-performing analytics function as the team grows.

 

Pay Scale: $95,000 - $109,000

 

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 

 

*Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace

Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment. 

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

job.title: Product Knowledge and Enablement Manager - AXS
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

The Product Knowledge & Enablement Manager creates clear, client-facing education for complex AXS products and workflows. This role strengthens the Knowledge Base as the primary self-service learning resource while supporting advanced client education, product adoption, GTM initiatives, and release communications. The role partners with Product, Product Operations, Ticketing Operations, Client Services, Account Management, Training, Documentation, and business unit stakeholders to convert complex product knowledge into searchable, actionable, and AI-ready content.

 

 

What you will do

  • Develop complex process documentation and workflow-based learning resources for assigned AXS products, services, and client use cases. Create playbooks, checklists, job aids, process guides, decision support materials, and other resources that help users complete work accurately and independently.
  • Improve the quality, structure, and usability of Knowledge Base content. Apply content standards, templates, taxonomy, metadata, tagging, lifecycle practices, and content consolidation strategies. Identify documentation gaps, duplicate guidance, outdated content, and failed-search topics.
  • Design and deliver advanced, client-facing product education and adoption activities. Facilitate product deep dives, feature education, office hours, workshops, and other learning experiences that support continued education and effective product use beyond initial onboarding.
  • Support product launches, releases, GTM initiatives, and product communications by translating product changes into audience-specific education plans and resources. Coordinate related KB content, Academy materials, webinars, job aids, and client-facing communications.
  • Use participation, search, content, support, and adoption data to evaluate the effectiveness of learning resources and recommend improvements. Maintain strong stakeholder relationships and communicate risks, priorities, and progress.

 

What we'd like to see

 

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) Client education, product enablement, instructional design, training, communications, customer success, or a related field.
  • 5+ year's experience in product education, client enablement, technical writing, knowledge management, instructional design, product adoption, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting complex B2B software, SaaS, ticketing, venue operations, event operations, or another workflow-intensive technology environment.
  • Experience creating client-facing documentation, playbooks, job aids, workflow guides, learning content, or product adoption resources.
  • Experience supporting product releases, GTM initiatives, feature adoption, advanced training, webinars, or client workshops.
  • Experience with knowledge management, content lifecycle management, taxonomy, metadata, search optimization, or learning management platforms.
  • Experience using generative AI tools for content development, analysis, classification, or workflow improvement with appropriate human review.
  • Strong understanding of complex software workflows, business processes, user personas, and product adoption challenges.
  • Excellent technical writing, editing, presentation, facilitation, and plain-language communication skills.
  • Ability to create practical, audience-specific content, including articles, playbooks, checklists, job aids, tutorials, and learning resources.
  • Knowledge of information architecture, taxonomy, metadata, search optimization, content governance, and content lifecycle management.
  • Ability to structure accurate, current, searchable, reusable content for users and future AI-enabled search or chatbot experiences.
  • Proficiency using generative AI tools to support content analysis, drafting, summarization, tagging, search-gap analysis, and workflow improvement.
  • Understanding of AI risks, including hallucinations, outdated information, privacy concerns, unsupported answers, and the need for human validation.
  • Strong client-facing and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Strong project management, prioritization, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to use search, support, engagement, and adoption data to identify knowledge gaps and improve education resources.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing products, processes, and release timelines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or comparable productivity, collaboration, project management, content, analytics, and communication tools.

 

At AXS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

job.title: Sr. Marketing Manager - The Complex SLC
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

The Sr Manager Marketing is responsible for the development and execution of marketing and promotional plans for shows. This position will execute long-term marketing initiatives and oversee issues and risks that affect the marketing campaign. The Sr Manager Marketing will work with artist managers, agents and marketing teams to develop effective integrated marketing plans that will reach the correct demographic and target customers appropriate for each show. In addition, this position will work with talent buyers, local and central leadership to oversee execution of best practices across email, social, media buying, customer relationship management, reporting, etc.

Essential Functions

  • Responsible for the development and execution of marketing and promotional plans for shows. Develop and execute long-term marketing initiatives. Oversee issues and risks affecting the marketing campaign.
  • Generate marketing budget, book and account for advertising and media ensuring funds are allocated to correct partners. Manage advertising settlements for each show to ensure those are settled accordingly.
  • Work with national tour director, talent buyers, and regional marketing director to plan the marketing spend. Work with central digital media buying, partnerships, CRM and creative teams to develop digital marketing plans for targeted audiences, custom creative and impactful partnership activations.
  • Oversee and evaluate show performance market-by-market, making adjustments to meet marketing strategy in changing market or competitive conditions. Develop digital advertising plans to optimize campaigns for best performance to drive ticket sales.
  • Oversee publicity, advance press interviews, secure and manage artist availability for promotions with management, label and public relations agencies.
  • Collaborate with agencies and vendor partners like Ticketmaster and AXS on marketing opportunities, product development, and improving efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) (Advanced Degree Preferred)
    • Marketing/Business Communications or a related field
  • 6-8 years
    • Of related work experience
    • Experience with media buying, executing digital media plans and omni-channel digital marketing
    • Experience working with email, mobile and digital marketing programs
    • Experience sourcing and managing content development and publishing
    • Experience and knowledge of music industry
  • Strong knowledge of data analysis and budgeting
  • Strong knowledge of programmatic media and real time bidding
  • Strong knowledge of social media and online marketing initiatives and strategies
  • Displays in-depth knowledge and understanding of Social Media platforms, their respective participants (Facebook, Twitter, Yelp, Google +Local, YouTube, Instagram, Pinterest etc.) and how each platform can be deployed in different scenarios
  • Computer savvy with knowledge of MS Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Google AdWords, Rubicon, CMS, Photoshop, WordPress
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel); and ability to learn required business systems
  • Strong proficiency in content marketing theory and application
  • Must be detail orientated with a high standard for quality and able to multitask and manage multiple campaigns and projects at once
  • Executes creativity and documented immersion in Social Media
  • Excellent interpersonal, as well as written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to effectively supervise and lead a productive team
  • Ability to switch from the creative side of marketing to analytical side, ability to prove ideas are analytically sound

Payscale: $76,406.94 - $90,000.00 annually

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.title: Talent Buyer - Southwest
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

A Brief Overview
The Talent Buyer is responsible for building relationships, identifying talent and confirming profitable shows. This position will create budgets, map scaling for venues and build offers for artists. Additionally, the Talent Buyer will compile all relevant documents and ensure that all shows are settled accurately. They will also work in conjunction with management to identify and build festivals.

Essential Functions

  • Buy profitable talent by actively reaching out to agents with booking possibilities. Respond to inbound requests from agents and artist management. Follow-up on leads from other talent buyers.
  • Negotiate offer details with music agents for artist performances. Gather all relevant information to build offer and present to artist management.
  • Networking and building relationships with agents, artist management, venue managers and other potential clients. Maintain current client relationships.
  • Oversee the marketing and ticketing of events. Confirm show details and artist requests with marketing and ticketing departments. Ensure that shows go on sale and tickets are being sold.
  • Create show or event budgets. Monitor spending and make sure that event stays in budget.
  • Travel to cover road shows, events, festivals and seek new clients, projects and partners. Handle the settlement of shows when necessary.
  • Work with managers on potential festival projects. Identify potential third party venue and festival sites for events. Assist on festival and concert projects as assigned by manger. Develop creative properties that can be grown into annual events.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) In Marketing, Public Relations, or a related area
  • 4-6 years Of related work experience
  • Previous experience in the music industry with demonstrated ability to assess current music trends
  • Previous experience supervisor, leading, and/or mentoring team
  • Knowledge of general accounting principles
  • General understanding of ticketing systems
  • Computer savvy and skilled in MS Office (Outlook, Word and Excel); knowledge of social media platforms
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must have an outgoing personality with the ability to build and cultivate relationships.
  • Exceptional negotiation skills with an ability to analyze complex documents
  • Ability to work independently to perform job, as well as in a team environment
  • Must have established contacts and relationships in the music industry
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule which may include nights, weekends and holidays.

Description

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for an experienced Paid Media Marketing Manager to join our Amazon Music Performance Marketing team. This person will build highly impactful full funnel campaigns from Awareness to Acquisition driving and test into white space opportunities. You will define, execute, and measure Paid Media marketing from strategy to execution to drive scalable growth for the business - including manual campaign execution, testing, and developing scalable processes. An entrepreneurial spirit, a creative mindset for pushing boundaries, and the ability to work effectively with a large number of partners and international stakeholders are some of the key skills we are looking for.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive and develop new Paid Media initiatives across multiple channels to drive customer acquisition and build awareness for Amazon Music
- Embrace a test-and-learn approach, scaling strategies, and exploring expansion opportunities.
- Plan, activate, optimize, and manage search media buys aligned with brief, customer journey, and audience insights
- Establish automated reporting and optimization processes. Provide complete performance reporting and analysis on marketing campaigns and take relevant action on insights gained.
- Manage relationships with key partners in the digital marketing ecosystem (DSPs and Social platforms).
- Audit and update existing data pipelines in collaboration with the Business Intelligence and Tech teams to ensure the highest level of data quality
- Partner with strategic cross-functional teams to support GTM plans and drive transparency and education in insights derived from Paid Media

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
- Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
- Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels
- Experience across affiliate marketing, PPC, SEM and social media advertising

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in multi-territory campaign management
- Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process

Amazon Jobs home pageMy careerMy applications My profileAccount securitySettingsSign outAmazon Jobs home pageProgram Manager (French Speaking), Amazon Music International Product

Job ID: 10523979 | Amazon Digital France SAS

Apply now

Description

Français:
Amazon Music est un service de divertissement audio immersif qui connecte les fans, les artistes et les créateurs. Des playlists personnalisées aux podcasts exclusifs, en passant par la diffusion de concerts en direct et les produits dérivés des artistes, Amazon Music innove à l’intersection entre musique et culture. Nous proposons des expériences adaptées à tous les auditeurs grâce à nos différentes offres: les membres Prime bénéficient d'un accès sans publicité à l'ensemble du catalogue musical en mode aléatoire, ainsi qu'aux meilleurs podcasts sans publicité, le tout inclus dans leur abonnement; les clients peuvent opter pour Amazon Music Unlimited afin d'accéder en illimité et à la demande à 100 millions de titres, dont des millions en HD, Ultra HD et audio spatial ; enfin, chacun peut écouter de la musique gratuitement en téléchargeant l'application Amazon Music ou via des appareils compatibles avec Alexa. Rejoignez-nous pour contribuer à façonner la manière dont Amazon Music interagit avec les fans, les artistes et les créateurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable de programme (Program Manager) maîtrisant le français (langue maternelle ou niveau C2). Vous intégrerez notre équipe International Product, responsable de l'expérience client dans les nombreux pays où Amazon Music est présent. Vous contribuerez à améliorer le quotidien de nos clients francophones et à définir les exigences linguistiques pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités d'Amazon Music qui améliorent leur expérience musicale. Vos missions consisteront notamment à analyser et résoudre les problèmes rencontrés par les clients, à identifier les lacunes de l'expérience client (CX) via des audits de parcours et des workshops, à fournir un support produit et créer des rapports personnalisés pour les parties prenantes internes et externes, ainsi qu'à accompagner nos équipes mondiales Produit et QA (Assurance Qualité) pour tester l'expérience locale des nouvelles fonctionnalités. Nous recherchons une personne à l'aise avec les données et les produits technologiques pour prendre des décisions et proposer des améliorations de l'expérience client, et qui s'épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide.

English:
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music ad-free in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for a Program Manager with native / C2 level proficiency in French. You will be part of our International Product Team that owns the customer experience in our vast number of Amazon Music supported countries around the world. You will help us improve the day-to-day experience of our French speaking customers and define language-specific requirements for new Amazon Music features that make it easier for customers to fall in love with music. Your focus will be to analyze and fix current customer issues, identify CX gaps by conducting walk-the-store and workshops, provide product support to and create customized reports for internal and external stakeholders, and support our global Product and QA teams to test the local experience of brand-new features. We're looking for someone who is comfortable working with data and technology products in order to make decisions and suggest improvements to the CX, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities
Français:
- Connaissance client : Vous adorez vous mettre à la place des clients, et êtes curieux(se) d'explorer les différentes manières dont ils consomment la musique. Vous tirez des enseignements des retours clients, des données d'utilisation et d'études externes, et alimentez la réflexion de nos chefs de produit grâce à des analyses ponctuelles ou des rapports hebdomadaires/mensuels sur l’expérience client.

- Gestion des problèmes : Vous gérez simultanément de nombreuses demandes ponctuelles, tout en priorisant et en résolvant les lacunes de l'expérience client, qu'elles soient internes ou externes. Vous simplifiez des problèmes complexes, produisez des rapports personnalisés grâce à votre capacité à analyser les données, et communiquez efficacement avec les chefs de produit ainsi qu'avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

- Soutien au lancement de fonctionnalités : Vous incarnez la voix locale du client pour les nouvelles expériences Amazon Music. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes mondiales d'assurance qualité (QA) pour comprendre et vérifier l'expérience client locale. Vous communiquez vos conclusions de manière précise et orientée vers les solutions, tout en sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre rapidité d'exécution et obsession du client.

- Soutien éditorial : Vous travaillez avec les équipes éditoriales, de programmation de contenu et de relations avec les labels pour garantir une expérience produit optimale lors de nos campagnes marketing et artistiques. Vous conseillez sur l'expérience visée, puis définissez et mettez en œuvre des solutions créatives pour ravir nos clients.

- Benchmarking : Vous êtes l'expert(e) concernant l'expérience client du streaming musical local. Vous comparez notre produit à ceux d'autres fournisseurs internes et externes, et utilisez vos conclusions pour formuler des recommandations à nos chefs de produit.
- Gestion des parties prenantes: Vous collaborez avec un large éventail d'interlocuteurs clés, notamment les chefs de produit locaux et mondiaux, le service client, les ingénieurs QA, le marketing, la programmation de contenu et les équipes chargées des relations
avec les artistes et les labels.
- Gestion des processus : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres chefs de programme et membres de l'équipe à l'élaboration de protocoles et de processus pour les mécanismes existants et futurs. Vous évaluez en permanence les outils et processus de collecte de données et proposez des solutions pour garantir leur efficacité, leur qualité et leur évolutivité.

- Adoption de l'IA : Vous identifiez des opportunités d'utiliser des outils d'IA pour optimiser et automatiser des processus tels que l'analyse de l'expérience client, le reporting et le tri des problèmes, réduisant ainsi la charge de travail manuel tout en étendant la couverture géographique. Vous restez à l'affût des capacités émergentes de l'IA et formulez des recommandations concrètes pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe grâce à ces technologies.

English
- Customer Insights: You live and breathe customer insights, and are curious to explore the differences in how customers consume music. You derive insights from customer feedback, usage data, and external research, and provide input to our product managers through ad-hoc analyses or weekly/monthly CX reporting.

- Issue Management: You manage numerous ad hoc requests concurrently, and prioritize and resolve internal and external customer experience gaps. You simplify complex issues, provide customized reporting with the ability to understand and analyze data, and effectively communicate to product managers, internal and external stakeholders.

- Feature Launch Support: You are the local voice of the customer for new Amazon Music experiences. You work closely with global QA to understand and verify the local CX. You communicate findings in a precise and solution oriented manner and are able to walk the fine line between speed and customer obsession.

- Editorial support: You work with editorial, content programming and label relations to enable a great product CX for our artist and marketing campaigns. You consult on the desired experience, and define and execute creative solutions to delight our customers. Benchmarking: You are the subject matter expert for the local music streaming CX. You benchmark our product against other internal and external providers, and use your findings to make recommendations to our product managers.

- Stakeholder Management: You work with a broad set of key stakeholders including local and global product managers, customer service, quality assurance engineers, marketing, content programming and artist/label relations.

- Process Management: You partner closely with other Program Managers and team members on protocol/process development for existing and future mechanisms. You continuously evaluate data collection tools and processes and offer solutions to ensure they are efficient, high quality and scalable.

- AI Adoption: You identify opportunities to apply AI tools and automation to streamline processes such as CX analysis, reporting, and issue triage — reducing manual effort while scaling coverage across territories. You stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and bring practical recommendations for where they can improve team efficiency.

Basic Qualifications

- Expérience en gestion de programmes ou de projets / Experience in program or project management
- Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (oral et écrit) au niveau C2 ou supérieur / Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English at C2 level or above
- Expérience dans la facilitation de la collaboration interne entre différentes équipes / Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

- Connaissance d’outils d'IA généralistes / Knowledge of general AI tools
- Expérience dans des tâches ou projets analytiques impliquant le traitement de données / Experience in analytical tasks or projects, working with data
- Expérience dans la définition et la mise en œuvre des exigences d'un programme / Experience defining and executing program requirements
- Capacité avérée à travailler en autonomie au sein d'une équipe répartie géographiquement, en collaborant efficacement avec des parties prenantes situées sur différents sites et fuseaux horaires / Demonstrated ability to work autonomously within a distributed team, collaborating effectively with stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones
- Expérience de travail avec des technologies et des produits numériques / Experience working with technology and digital products

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Responsibilities include driving complex financial models together with Finance, evaluating the impact of negotiated royalty structures, and proactively performing analytic deep dives across a variety of key performance indicators. This role will also work closely with Legal to structure licensing agreements and review contract language, and work closely with Product Development and Marketing teams on our feature roadmap and go-to-market strategies. The Senior Content Acquisition Manager will have 6+ years of work experience in a content acquisition, business development, financial analyst, or related analytics-focused role.

Basic Qualifications

- 6+ years of entertainment industry deal negotiation experience
- Experience negotiating complex agreements with a firm understanding of legal terminology and reasoning
- Experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to support business decisions, or experience building and managing financial models for business forecasting and problem solving

Preferred Qualifications

- J.D., or MBA
- Experience in content negotiation, acquisition or business development
- Experience working with global and cross-functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development and legal
- Experience at a streaming service or record label
- Familiarity with music licensing models, variable streaming economics, and multi-tiered streaming service offerings

Description

Are you passionate about music, entertainment, and building creative partnerships that drive growth at scale? Do you excel at identifying actionable insights that translate into strategic growth initiatives? Amazon Music is seeking a Senior Partner Growth Manager to lead and execute partnership growth strategies. This role will own the end-to-end partnership marketing lifecycle — from strategy through execution — working closely with internal teams and external partners to drive new audience growth, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention for Amazon Music.

For someone to be successful in this role, they need to embody the following:

Strategic Growth Leader: They must be a senior marketing professional with deep experience in partner-focused growth marketing or partnership marketing, able to define and drive the long-term vision for their portfolio of partnerships. They set strategy in ambiguous environments, handle complex problems, and use their expertise and judgment to design scalable solutions that deliver sustained business results.

Cross-Functional Influencer: They influence across external partners, internal teams, and geographies to deliver outcomes. They build consensus across diverse functions (Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Business Development) and present strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Relationship Builder: They excel at fostering and maintaining strong relationships across all levels — from C-suite executives at partner organizations to internal stakeholders — demonstrating exceptional communication skills and the ability to earn trust and influence.

Data-Driven Decision Maker: They have a natural curiosity for analytics and metrics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic decisions. They dive deep into performance data to identify trends, reduce churn, and optimize the full customer lifecycle.

Results Oriented & Operationally Excellent: They take ownership and drive initiatives from concept to completion at scale, mitigating long-term risks and making trade-offs between short and long-term needs. They model best practices, drive process improvements, and develop efficient, scalable mechanisms that ensure operational excellence and sustained growth impact.


Key job responsibilities
- Define and execute the partner marketing and growth strategy for Amazon Music partners, delivering against customer acquisition, engagement, and retention goals
- Own and execute the go-to-market of partner launches for growth marketing efforts, including ideation, planning, execution, analysis/reporting, and optimization
- Continually optimize partnerships from launch through ongoing sustaining efforts to maximize offer discoverability, frequency in communications, share of voice and identifying new opportunities within existing partnership
- Lead, implement, and launch partner campaigns with the North Star of delivering best-in-class creative excellence that represents the Amazon Music brand and drives awareness through partners
- Dive deep into data to understand insights and learnings that drive strategy; lead performance management for partners and share market intelligence with stakeholders and teammates
- Collaborate cross-functionally across Product, BI/Data Science, Marketing, Finance, Legal and Business Development to deliver best-in-class campaign opportunities and assets for partners
- Develop efficient, scalable mechanisms that ensure operational efficiency of the team and maximize impact
- Function at a global level, sharing best practices and scaling programs or campaigns that benefit multiple regions
- Experiment with new approaches to drive partnership success and raise the bar on growth marketing innovation

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
- 8+ years of experience in B2C partner-focused growth marketing or partnership marketing

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience aggregating and analyzing internal and external campaign metrics to assess performance drivers and identify insights
- Experience working independently with minimal supervision, or experience in guiding, training and mentoring others
- Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
- Experience in the entertainment/music/streaming industry
- Experience in global and/or centralized marketing leadership teams
- Experience creating centralized programs that can be leveraged on a global scale
- Experience working across multiple geographies and cultures
- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic partners with global or multi-market footprint
- Demonstrated track record in developing, implementing, and optimizing multi-channel, integrated marketing campaigns focused on growth/performance marketing
- Experience managing complex, multi-partner relationships and projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Proven ability to communicate effectively with senior management both internally and externally, including writing strategic documents
- Experience with AI-powered tools to improve efficiency and marketing outcome

Job ID: 10515728 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Description

As a Senior UX Designer focused on the visual experience for millions of fans worldwide, you'll own large, complex design projects end to end, from customer research and early concept through evaluation and delivery, creating immersive experiences that delight customers across our suite of surfaces. This role sits at the intersection of elevating craft and driving coherence: you'll dive deep into your own work while partnering closely with other designers to develop and refine the visual design, IA, and interaction patterns that raise the bar for the team. Through those partnerships, you'll help ensure each surface and our full product suite feel unified, leveraging customer research, frameworks like Jobs to Be Done, and shared IA patterns. Success in this role requires strong craft, critical and inventive thinking, clear design chops, deep customer obsession, and the ability to communicate your ideas effectively to senior leaders. Being a music fan is a big plus.

Key job responsibilities
• Own complex visual design projects end to end, from customer research and early concept through evaluation and delivery, effectively communicating design strategies and interaction behaviors throughout the process.
• Develop high-level customer experience strategy for both the near and long term, navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity to design decision-making through your work.
• Partner closely with other designers across Amazon Music to elevate the craft and raise the quality bar for what we ship.
• Develop and refine visual design, IA, and interaction patterns that drive coherence within each surface and across our full suite of experiences, leveraging customer research and frameworks like Jobs to Be Done.
• Contribute to and evolve a central design system and its application across touch, mouse & keyboard, and remote-specific features.
• Work with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, research, data analysis, and conversation design, to define requirements, assess features, and optimize experiences.
• Present design work to the UX team, product team, engineering team, leaders, and partner organizations for review and feedback.
• Proactively manage your own work queue, time, and expectations, communicating needs and tradeoffs when priorities shift.


A day in the life
You will own large, complex visual design projects end to end, from customer research and early concept through evaluation and delivery, creating immersive experiences that delight millions of fans worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of elevating craft and driving coherence: you'll dive deep into your own work while partnering closely with other designers to develop and refine the visual design, IA, and interaction patterns that raise the bar for the team. Through those partnerships, you'll help ensure each surface and our full suite of experiences feel unified, leveraging customer research, frameworks like Jobs to Be Done, and shared IA patterns. Working from high-level requirements, you'll define design flows, interactions, and content strategies in collaboration with business leaders, engineers, and product managers. To be successful, you must be a strong craftsperson and critical, inventive thinker with clear design chops, deep customer obsession, and the ability to communicate your ideas effectively to senior leaders. Being a music fan is a big plus.

About the team
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music.

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of design experience
- Have an available online portfolio
- 5+ years of experience in UX design for consumer facing products
- Degree in UX Design, Animation, Fine Arts, Cognitive Psychology, HCI, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading complex, multi-platform design projects (mobile, desktop, TV) that span multiple disciplines and departments, navigating ambiguity while managing your own work, timelines, and tradeoffs independently
- Experience directly contributing to design system frameworks and defining visual, IA, and interaction patterns that scale across a product suite
- Experience designing for LLM-enabled, AI-driven, or multimodal customer experiences, with proficiency in industry-standard design tools (e.g., Figma) and AI-assisted prototyping methods
- Experience integrating qualitative and quantitative data into design decisions and iterations, including conducting usability studies, user research, and journey mapping
- Proven ability to present strategic design rationale clearly and persuasively to senior stakeholders across product, engineering, and business teams
- Relentless desire for innovation, balanced with business needs and customer expectations, and a deep passion for defining the future of audio entertainment experiences

Description

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

Are you passionate about audiobooks, entertainment, and building partnerships that drive growth at scale? Do you excel at turning insights into growth initiatives? Amazon Music is seeking an analytical, results-oriented Sr. Product Marketing Manager to grow audiobooks on Amazon Music. You will build and launch product marketing initiatives that acquire new audiobook listeners and deepen engagement among existing ones, working cross-functionally across Amazon Music and Audible to influence partners and deliver against shared roadmaps.

The successful candidate is an independent, creative problem-solver with strong business acumen who can lead multiple projects against competing deadlines. You bring proven product marketing, program management, and stakeholder management skills, and you deliver results under time constraints. You will partner with teams across Amazon Music to drive acquisition and engagement strategies that grow audiobook listenership, lead the Audiobooks product marketing strategy, report progress and upcoming projects to senior leadership, and champion best practices across global teams. You are well versed in customer behavior and business drivers, and you conceive new initiatives that measurably move key KPIs.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end marketing strategy to drive acquisition, adoption, and engagement of audiobook listeners worldwide, across owned, paid, and lifecycle channels.
• Lead complex, cross-functional go-to-market initiatives for new audiobook features, from positioning through launch and post-launch measurement.
• Partner with product teams across Amazon Music and Audible to influence the roadmap and shape features that grow audiobook acquisition, adoption, and retention.
• Define and own an experimentation roadmap for audiobook adoption, reporting results to leadership and scaling wins into lifecycle programs (e.g., adoption and reactivation campaigns, in-app education).
• Partner with content and content marketing teams to connect premium content marketing with growth marketing, turning tentpole titles and catalog into durable listener habit.
• Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform messaging and positioning, sharing insights and clear next steps with leadership.
• Tailor strategy across international marketplaces, accounting for differences between established and newer markets, and partner with regional teams on localization.
• Identify and pursue cross-category opportunities across Amazon (e.g., Prime, retail, devices) to reach new audiobook audiences.
• Lead the definition of ROI and success metrics for new strategies, partnering with BI, Product, and Finance on trade-offs and funded recommendations.

Basic Qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches
- Experience in customer lifecycle marketing or partner marketing management
- Experience mentoring, coaching, and influencing colleagues, collaborators, and stakeholders
- 6+ years of experience developing and executing product positioning, messaging frameworks, and value propositions for consumer-facing digital products or services
- 5+ years of experience managing marketing budgets and making data-driven investment decisions across paid, owned, and earned channels
- 6+ years of experience working with product management and engineering teams to influence product roadmaps based on customer insights
- 5+ years of experience designing and running A/B tests or experimentation programs to optimize marketing performance
- 6+ years of experience creating and presenting strategic marketing plans, business cases, and post-launch analyses to VP-level or above audiences

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- MBA
- 5+ years of experience in subscription-based, streaming, or digital media/entertainment marketing
- 3+ years of experience marketing audiobooks, podcasts, or audio entertainment products
- 5+ years of experience driving adoption and engagement within an existing user base (not just net-new acquisition)
- 3+ years of experience leveraging cross-category or cross-platform partnerships to drive incremental growth (e.g., bundling, co-marketing, retail integration)
- 4+ years of experience with lifecycle marketing automation tools (e.g., Braze, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar)
- 5+ years of experience working in a matrixed organization where influence without authority is required to drive results

Description

We are seeking an ambitious Technical Program Manager to join our Metrics and Data Platform team at Amazon Music. The Metrics and Data Platform team plays a central role in enabling Amazon Music's business decisions and software development by processing billions of streaming events and delivering the behavioral and operational metrics that teams across Music, Prime, and Retail depend on every day. We maintain a scalable and robust data platform to support Amazon Music's business operations and growth, and collaborate closely with data producers and data consumers to accelerate innovation using data.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will own and drive multiple high-impact programs across Amazon Music. You will start by owning and curating Amazon Music's data model, serving as the central steward of how the business represents customer behaviors as data concepts. You will standardize key concepts across teams, simplify our event model to make it more intuitive and valuable, and grow the event model over time so it keeps pace with an evolving business. A major part of this work is building GenAI tooling to automate the curation and evolution of the event model, reducing manual effort and helping the platform scale. From this foundation, you will grow to take on additional high-impact programs across Amazon Music, driving org-wide priorities as they emerge. A successful candidate will be customer obsessed, highly analytical, adept at managing multiple complex programs simultaneously across a data-heavy organization, and energized by the opportunity to shape how an entire organization defines and uses its data.

Key job responsibilities
- Owning and curating Amazon Music's behavioral data model, serving as the central steward for how core data concepts are defined and represented across the business
- Standardizing key data concepts across teams, driving alignment between data producers and consumers so that shared concepts are defined consistently and unambiguously
- Consulting on the design of high-quality instrumentation specifications for new products and features
- Simplifying the event model to make it more intuitive, reducing complexity and redundancy so teams can find and trust the data they need
- Evolving the event model with the business, partnering with data producers and consumers to enhance and grow coverage as new products, features, and use cases emerge
- Building GenAI tooling to automate the curation of the event model, including improved attribution, automated validation, automated instrumentation specification generation, and reduced manual overhead in maintaining the model
- Leading cross-org programs with central Amazon teams, including driving technical alignment and program execution with teams outside of Music (e.g., AWS, Devices, Stores), navigating ambiguity where business and architectural strategies are not clearly defined, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
- Collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, business analysts, and senior leadership, to align on priorities and drive program execution
- Writing effective narratives and presenting program updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership
- Proactively identifying risks and removing blockers to keep programs on track
- Defining and managing program roadmaps, milestones, and goals in partnership with engineering and product stakeholders
- Identifying strategic opportunities for the Metrics and Data Platform team to expand its impact and influence across Amazon Music as part of annual planning

About the team
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design
- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps
- Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Excellence in verbal and written communication with peers and senior leaders
- Experience managing large, complex, cross-functional programs from concept to launch
- Experience driving technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience identifying and mitigating program risks and removing execution blockers
- Experience with iterative, agile development methodologies
- Experience with data modeling or feature/product instrumentation
- Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, EMR, Redshift, S3, Airflow, or Kinesis
- Experience with AWS services (Lambda, Redshift, Kinesis, SQS, SNS)
- Experience with data quality frameworks, data modeling concepts, or ETL workflows
- Experience leveraging GenAI tools or initiatives to improve operational efficiency or program delivery
- Experience with data governance or compliance programs at scale

job.title: Audience Analyst
job.description:
Position Summary:

American Public Media Group is seeking an Audience Analyst to join the Audience Insights & Analytics team. This role offers a unique opportunity to use data, analysis, and insights to support audience growth, fundraising performance, and community impact at a mission-driven media organization.

This role supports strategic decision-making, revenue growth, and operational efficiency by analyzing audience, donor, and other first-party data. Its primary focus is partnering with the Membership and Audience Development & Marketing teams to provide reporting, analysis, and actionable recommendations for marketing campaigns, member drives, ongoing fundraising campaigns, annual planning, and overall strategy. The role also supports Philanthropic Development, Broadcast, Digital Products, and Finance teams.

The Audience Analyst will serve as a key contributor in utilizing data from the organization’s CRM, marketing activation platforms, data warehouse, and external sources. The role will develop and deliver efficient, reliable reporting and analysis while identifying opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and strengthen analytical processes.

We are looking for someone who is self-motivated and demonstrates the ability to work collaboratively and effectively with colleagues in multiple departments across the organization. Success in this role requires combining technical depth with business judgment, producing accurate and reusable reporting, identifying meaningful patterns in audience and donor behavior, and translating findings into recommendations that stakeholders can act on.

Expected Compensation Range: $37.50 - $40.85 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Hybrid

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Collect, analyze, and interpret data from multiple internal and external sources with focus on CRM, marketing activation platforms, and other first-party data systems.
  • Develop proficiency with a variety of data platforms and reporting tools including Salesforce NPSP, Marketing Cloud, Power BI, and other tools as needed.
  • Provide analytics support for Membership teams by measuring and evaluating member drives, fundraising campaigns, and ongoing strategy; developing actionable reporting and recommendations; and supporting annual planning, revenue projections, and tracking of key performance indicators.
  • Provide reporting and analysis for our broadcast channels and teams across multiple stations and markets.
  • Translate data into clear recommendations, risks, and opportunities for senior leaders.
  • Query, mine, and analyze large data sets using SQL and other tools to identify patterns, troubleshoot discrepancies, validate data, and develop analyses that help the organization better understand its members and audiences.
  • Develop and maintain automated reporting and well-documented workflows that improve efficiency and ensure accuracy, consistency, and relevance across reporting used to support marketing, fundraising, and audience strategy.
  • Partner with technical and business teams to define business questions, develop measurement strategies, conduct analysis, validate findings, and deliver actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with the Audience Insights & Analytics team to prioritize recurring reporting and ad hoc requests, meet agreed-upon deadlines, and communicate clearly with leaders and stakeholders about scope, timelines, tradeoffs, and analytical opportunities.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Economics, Business, Analytics, Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, related field, OR equivalent work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in marketing analytics, business analytics, database analytics, audience analytics, donor analytics, or a similar role.
  • 2+ years of experience and proficiency using SQL independently for data extraction, transformation, validation, troubleshooting, and analysis of large or complex data sets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify patterns and anomalies, retrieve and manipulate data, investigate discrepancies, and draw well-supported conclusions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate data into clear business recommendations.
  • Ability to self-manage goals, priorities, workload, deadlines, internal client relationships, and process development.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.), Teams, Slack, or similar productivity software.

Preferred Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Experience working with Salesforce, Marketing Cloud, or other CRM platforms and associated data.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a similar business intelligence tool.
  • Proficiency in SQL or other analytical programming languages or tools, such as DAX, R, Python, or SAS.
  • Familiarity with advanced techniques to support marketing such as clustering, predictive modeling, lifetime value (LTV), attribution, media mix modeling, or other concepts to support marketing spend, conversion, and strategy.
  • Experience analyzing performance across content, media, digital publishing, or membership/subscription businesses.

Reporting To This Position:  None.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position in an office environment with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Physical Demands: Required to move about in an office environment and sit for extended periods of time. Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping.

APMG offers a comprehensive benefits package including Medical plans with HSA and FSA options, Dental, Vision, Life and AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability, Paid Parental Leave and Paid Caregiver Leave after 1 year, Vacation (3 wks./per year, pro-rated, based on hours worked), Sick time (12 days, pro-rated, based on hours worked), Holiday Pay (10 holidays + 2 floating holidays each year), Volunteer Time (8 hours per year), Long-Term Care and Critical Illness insurance options, Employee Assistance Program, 403(b) Retirement Plan, and more.

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to hiring a breadth of diverse professionals and encourage members of diverse groups to apply.

job.title: Audio Engineer - On-Call
job.description:
Position Summary:

The on-call position’s primary focus and responsibility is the production of live broadcasts, podcast production, recordings, and events for APM|MPR. The Audio Engineer works in support of Marketplace, APM’s national portfolio, and Minnesota Public Radio’s three regional services (MPR News, YourClassical, and The Current).

Expected Compensation Range: $36.00 - 38.00 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: On-Site

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Your role:

As an on-call Audio Engineer you’ll play a key role in creating high-quality‑quality live broadcasts, recordings, and podcasts that reach national audiences. You’ll collaborate with hosts, producers, and technical teams across APM|MPR to deliver exceptional content to audiences.

The Audio Engineer works in support of Marketplace, APM’s national portfolio, and Minnesota Public Radio’s three regional services (MPR News, YourClassical, and The Current). We welcome candidates with a variety of audio backgrounds, including studio, broadcast, live sound, and podcast production.

Position Responsibilities:

Live Broadcast Mixing

  • Perform live audio mixing: on-air board operations, studio mixing of both talk and music, and sound reinforcement.
  • Mix and process audio for multi-channel distribution.
  • Recording and mixing of talk and music-based audio content.

Audio Mixing & Production

  • Mix stories, podcasts, and interviews under quick deadlines
  • Maintain advanced knowledge and operational skill in digital audio production using in-house software-editing platforms (currently utilized systems include Dalet, Pro Tools, and Adobe Audition) as well as mixing consoles (currently utilized systems include Axia, Midas, and Yamaha digital consoles.)
  • Test, connect, and monitor codecs and other equipment necessary for live broadcasts (currently utilized systems include Comrex Access, LiveU, Opal, Riverside, Teams, and more.)
  • Operate audio/visual systems for events and meetings
  • Operate digital audio recording devices and interfaces for both in-house and field recording.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Respond in a timely and professional manner to internal and external requests for production, audio files, technical assistance, and planning details.
  • Collaborate closely with show hosts, directors, and producers to accommodate an efficient and creative broadcast/production environment. 
  • Provide excellent customer service to both internal colleagues and external constituents.

Quality, Standards, & Workflow

  • Establish and maintain high standards of audio and video production.
  • Follow standard operating procedures and workflows to provide consistent production quality.
  • Work with other departments and/or external partners to remain up to date on technical and content changes and modifications.

Operational Support

  • Provide back-up for other Audio Engineers and assist on various department activities as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, such as:
    • 3+ years in audio engineering, live sound, studio production, or related audio fields, or
    • A strong demonstrated portfolio through professional, freelance, or community work
  • 1+ year of audio and/or video production experience

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

Audio Engineering & Production Skills

  • Knowledgeable and skilled in operating signal processing equipment and digital plug-ins including equalizers, compressors, limiters, de-essers, reverb, and other digital effects.
  • Fluency in digital audio workstations, Pro Tools or Adobe Audition experience preferred.
  • Problem-solving and technical troubleshooting skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to support and troubleshoot computer hardware and software.
  • Demonstrated skills operating and knowledge of audio consoles, microphones, mic pre-amps, patch bays / routers, multi-track recorders, AD/DA converters, and related audio equipment.

Professional Skills

  • Planning, communications, and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain positive working relationships to achieve common goals.
  • Able to perform work independently or in a team environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate, both written and orally.
  • Ability to maintain composure and perform well under pressure. 
  • Ability to multi-task daily.
  • Excellent customer service skills.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience in a broadcasting or media environment.
  • Experience recording in many environments including studios, control rooms, concert halls, churches, clubs, and outdoor venues.
  • Operational experience with Internet Service Provider (ISP) technologies such as DSL, fiber, cable, and wireless technologies.  This includes applications and equipment such as VoIP, IP codecs, consumer modems/routers and network switches.
  • Knowledge of digital production and content management systems for 'on-air' program production and automation.
  • Solid background in electronics, audiovisual systems, audio systems signal flow, and basic electronics wiring.
  • Working knowledge of audio/visual equipment including projectors, video switchers, and other presentation technology.
  • Ability to think about content editing from the perspective of the audience to help shape a story or piece with creative editing and production techniques.
  • Experience and interest in video editing

Reporting to this Position:

  • None

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Position will require early morning hours and will, at times, require weekend, evening, and holiday work.
  • Physical Demands: 
    • Move about in an office environment
    • Move about in the community
    • Reach with hands and arms
    • Balance, stoop, kneel, or crouch
    • Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping.  
    • Lift audio and video equipment up to 70 lbs.
  • Working Conditions: 
    • Moderate noise level
    • Occasional exposure to prevalent weather conditions

APMG offers a comprehensive benefits package including Medical plans with HSA and FSA options, Dental, Vision, Life and AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability, Paid Parental Leave and Paid Caregiver Leave after 1 year, Vacation (3 wks./per year, pro-rated, based on hours worked), Sick time (12 days, pro-rated, based on hours worked), Holiday Pay (10 holidays + 2 floating holidays each year), Volunteer Time (8 hours per year), Long-Term Care and Critical Illness insurance options, Employee Assistance Program, 403(b) Retirement Plan, and more.

We are committed to hiring a breadth of diverse professionals and encouraging members of diverse groups to apply.

Intern, Accounting/Finance

Are you driven by numbers, details, and analysis? Do you want to launch your career in non-proﬁt ﬁnance, but lack the hands-on experience required to land your dream job? This

Accounting/Finance internship provides exposure to the inner workings of ﬁnance and accounting, equipping you with the technical and supporting skills to succeed and grow in your career.

In this role, you’ll support the Finance team to strengthen the organization's ﬁnancial integrity, business processes, and system of internal controls by working on ﬁnancial projects and providing accounting support, insight, and recommendations.

This 22-week internship is offered at 24 or 40 hours per week, based on the candidate's availability.

 

Key Learning Goals:

The goal of this internship is to provide you with immersive learning and real-world experience through impactful work. By the end of your internship, you will be able to:

  • Expand Accounting Fundamentals - Learn the monthly and annual accounting cycle by completing account reconciliations and supporting schedules, accounting entries, and ﬁnancial reports to develop core accounting skills. Leverage technology to improve processes.
  • Participate in internal process improvements - Learn how document and analyze workflows (e.g., internal controls, accounting policies, systems, and procedures) and implement solutions to strengthen the team.
  • Build Critical Skills - Goals will be developed to help you sharpen the soft skills crucial for success like project management, collaboration, and business communications.

We are excited to help you step out of the textbook and into real-world ﬁnance experience!

 

Responsibilities:

As the Accounting/Finance Intern, you will work on projects to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of the Finance Department including:

  • Review and improve internal controls
  • Analysis and implementation of cost savings initiatives
  • Accounting operations process and related technology improvements

job.description:
