  • Location: This is a fully remote position (anywhere within the U.S.A.)
  • Compensation: $20.00/hour
  • Application deadline: Application will close once finalists are selected

 

Intern, Digital - Marketplace:

Eager to gain digital experience at one of the top business news shows in public radio? The Marketplace digital team seeks a creative, motivated intern who has an active interest in business and economic journalism. This internship will provide support to the digital team, which is responsible for our website and newsletters. You will have an opportunity to work alongside editors, reporters, and producers with a focus on making sure the website is kept current and engaging. You will learn how to strengthen skills in reporting, writing, homepage curation, SEO and remote teamwork.

 

Key Learning Goals:

The goal of this internship is to provide immersive learning and real-world experience through impactful projects. Our goal for you is to:

  • Gain insight into the journalism industry and Marketplace’s properties: in addition to original reporting for the website, the digital team works across the newsroom with radio and podcasting teams
  • Learn how to help the website team drive audience engagement and help further our mission to raise the economic intelligence of the country
  • Get tangible experience in daily website homepage curation for a journalism organization
  • Hone your reporting and writing skills

 

Responsibilities:

In this hands-on role, you will work directly to:

  • Help to source, optimize, and place relevant images into digital stories
  • Research and add links to Marketplace stories
  • Work with team members to rewrite radio stories into website articles

job.title: Senior Editor, Watchdog
job.description:
Position Summary:

As senior editor of our watchdog team, you will lead a small team of experienced reporters with the mandate to hold local government and powerful institutions to account. And there’s a lot of ground to cover in Southern California, where cutbacks across the news industry have left much of the region unwatched by journalists.

Because of that, we’re keeping the focus wide: from major L.A. law enforcement agencies to county government to workplace safety and the continuing housing and homelessness crises. The team will include a reporter focused on transportation, two government accountability reporters and additional newsroom resources.

As senior editor, you’ll shape ideas, deepen reporting and look for creative ways to tell stories across multiple platforms: radio, digital, social, video, on-demand and live events. You’ll be an advocate for collaborating with other newsrooms and the communities we cover, and partner directly with LAist’s general assignment and beat reporters as needed.

The senior editor should bring a track record of reporting, writing, and editing in-depth enterprise or investigative stories that reveal wrongdoing and injustice. You should have an interest and aptitude in analyzing data and guiding others on public records requests. This will be a quick-paced team with a goal of producing no fewer than 12 stories each month.

LAist is a leading practitioner of engaged journalism. We believe engaging with our audience throughout the reporting process can result in coverage that better reflects and listens to the concerns of our audience. We also believe community members know things that can lead us to groundbreaking work if we’re talking with them regularly.

LAist reporters and editors work closely together and highly value collegiality and a sense of humor, especially under pressure.

Please include a cover letter that links to your best work and describes the role you played in that work, what you learned along the way, and what you’d bring with you to the LAist newsroom.

Expected Compensation Range: $120,000 - $124,000 per year. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Hybrid, Pasadena, CA

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled. 

Position Responsibility:

  • Oversee high-impact investigations and daily enterprise reporting that betters the lives of Southern Californians, producing 12 stories or more per month from your team.
  • Develop and execute cross-platform strategies for your assigned beats that reflect LAist’s mission to deliver distinctive and unique content to our audiences.
  • Work with the engagement team to learn and uphold best practices for creating content that emphasizes an audience-first approach.
  • Develop strategies to diversify sources and, in cooperation with the engagement team, establish new relationships with readers, listeners, and other stakeholders.
  • Assign and edit daily stories, special projects, and other content for accuracy, fairness and inclusivity across broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Provide clear guidance, feedback and supervision to assigned staff.

  • Embrace LAist’s digital strategy and partner with senior leaders to make data-informed decisions.
  • Encourage creativity and high standards.
  • Work with direct reports to develop short- and long-term goals.
  • Represent LAist at public events.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Five years reporting or editing experience, with two years editing or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of two years supervisory experience.
  • Experience in maintaining high journalistic standards under deadline pressure, including standards of accuracy and fairness.
  • Experience assigning stories and editing copy.
  • Experience with digital news production and presentation.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Ability to make decisions on deadline, direct coverage and communicate effectively with colleagues and supervisors.
  • Ability to effectively execute multiple assignments on deadline.
  • Leadership and personnel skills and ability to develop high-performing teams.
  • Ability to consistently work well with others and to inspire and lead the staff.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Ability to develop complex story ideas that provide analysis and add context.
  • Ability to recognize and act on opportunities for tapping audience expertise.
  • Well-established contacts and knowledge of the journalism community.
  • Commitment to public service journalism.
  • Communicate effectively and cordially with colleagues across platforms.
  • Juggle multiple projects and deadlines.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience producing and editing audio.
  • Experience producing and editing video.
  • Fluency in Spanish or other languages commonly used in Southern California.
  • Experience as a reporter, producer or editor in L.A. or Orange County.

Reporting To This Position:   Watchdog reporters

  • Physical Demands:

job.title: Global Member Services Representative
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job Overview:

The Global Member Services Representative provides customer service to ASCAP’s members via telephone, email and ASCAP’s proprietary online account management system (Member Access). The position serves the goals of the ASCAP Global Members Services department in ensuring ASCAP writers, publishers, and internal partners receive the best experience possible. This is a hybrid position with currently a minimum 3 day per week in-office requirement, based out of the ASCAP New York Office.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Member Customer Service:
    • Provide customer service to ASCAP’s writer and publisher Members via telephone, email and ASCAP's proprietary online account management system
    • Communicate effectively with individuals from both within and outside of the organization in order to resolve writer and publisher Member issues and answer all questions
    • Resolve and track inquiries and other types of incoming requests by researching and resolving any issues that may arise from writer and publisher Members and/or their representatives
    • Inquiry subjects vary, but often regard the following:
      • Performance crediting
      • ASCAP’s repertory
      • Royalty distribution
      • Overpayment recoupment
      • International collections and distributions
      • Membership elections
      • General membership concerns
    • Escalate and resolve Member issues by effectively leveraging your expert knowledge of ASCAP’s business and communicating with other departments within ASCAP as necessary
    • Use sound judgment to determine if claims need to be escalated
  • Distribution Support:
    • Liaise with Members on behalf of ASCAP’s Distribution Team whenever additional information is required to process a writer or publisher claim
    • Liaise with other departments to seamlessly resolve Member issues

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Excellent administrative, written, and verbal communication skills
  • The ability to clearly and simply communicate complex issues
  • Skilled at prioritizing multiple tasks or projects simultaneously
  • Self-motivated and organized to ensure internal and external responsiveness
  • Effective and creative problem solver
  • Prior customer service experience
  • Knowledge of ASCAP’s systems, policies and procedures is a plus
  • Music and music industry interest a plus
  • This position currently requires the incumbent to be in the office 3 days per week- In-office requirements are subject to change

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option which includes a company match
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
  • Employee gym discounts at select gyms
  • Commuter benefits
  • Voluntary pet health insurance
  • Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
  • Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
  • Voluntary ID protection Coverage

The above summary of the current benefits is subject to the terms and conditions of the benefit plan documents. This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. Please note that ASCAP reserves the right to amend or otherwise revise or terminate, at any time and in its sole discretion, its benefit plans, programs, and policies.

Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $50,000 to $50,000 and will be determined on an individualized basis depending on several factors that are unique to each candidate including geographic location (due to differences in the cost of labor), skills, education and prior relevant experience.

job.title: VP, Creative Membership
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.# # #

Job overview:

The VP, Creative Membership is responsible for championing, supporting and advocating on behalf of ASCAP’s diverse community of creators in the UK/European market. They will serve as a key point of contact for high profile members, developing member outreach initiatives, recruiting and retaining UK/European creative talent, and building and maintaining a deep network of relationships across labels, publishers, lawyers, managers and other industry stakeholders in order to increase value of the ASCAP repertory. The UK/Europe Membership department is directly responsible for outreach to some of ASCAP’s most prominent and successful UK/Europe-based members.

This position is based in our London office and will report to the EVP, Head of Creative Membership located in the New York office. This position is subject to ASCAP’s in-office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Establish, cultivate, and maintain deep, trusted relationships with our diverse community of songwriters, composers and producers in the UK/European market to protect, strengthen, and grow the value of the ASCAP repertory.
  • Serve as the primary ASCAP point of contact for assigned high-profile creator members and their key representatives, providing high-touch service and resolving complex membership, catalog and distribution inquiries with diplomacy.
  • Proactively escalate highly sensitive or complex issues to the relevant internal subject matter experts and ASCAP executive leadership to ensure swift, white-glove resolution.
  • Act as a brand ambassador and strategic voice for ASCAP at industry panels, conferences, award shows, and high-profile events to drive market awareness of ASCAP’s creator-first mission and value proposition.
  • Foster relationships between ASCAP members and the broader music ecosystem by maintaining relationships with publishers, artists, record labels, licensees, lawyers, managers, agents and trade organizations.
  • Provide strategic leadership, coaching, and career development for direct reports; and oversee, inspire, and manage the day-to-day operations of the Membership team in the London office.
  • Partner with the Marketing & Communications team to plan, curate, and host high-impact member events and recognition initiatives.
  • Develop a deep, authoritative understanding of ASCAP’s Survey and Distribution System and ASCAP membership policies and procedures, to confidently guide members through membership- and distribution-related inquiries.
  • Translate market analysis and industry trends into visually engaging and compelling presentations (including advanced PowerPoint collateral), with the versatility to confidently pitch, present, and align both small, high-profile talent teams and large organizational audiences around the ASCAP value proposition.
  • Analyze critical market share data and deliver strategic recommendations to key internal stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Collaborate seamlessly across the ASCAP Creative Membership team to share best practices, align regional goals, and unify strategies.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal departments to continually expand and refine ASCAP services, including career development, member benefits, education, and advocacy programs.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Music Business, Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field. MBA or JD preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive, leadership-level experience in the music industry.
  • A deep, well-established network of high-level relationships spanning licensing, songwriting, music publishing, and record labels specifically within the UK/European market and broader music industry.
  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing diverse teams of direct reports at varying career stages.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate highly autonomously, navigate ambiguous environments, and communicate with exceptional clarity and diplomacy with ASCAP executive leadership.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, with a proven track record of designing highly influential, executive-level PowerPoint presentations that distill complex strategies into compelling visual narratives for senior leadership.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities, with an ability to evaluate complex market trends, track competitor landscapes, and translate raw data into actionable strategic insights.
  • A discerning instinct for songwriter and composer talent (an “ear” for music) and a proven track record of identifying, onboarding, and nurturing high-potential creators toward long-term career success.
  • Excellent organizational, and time-management skills, with a track record of delivering flawless executive-level work under tight deadlines and during high-volume periods.
  • Ability and willingness to attend Nashville and other music industry events, including on the weekends and in the evenings, with ability to travel for meetings and events as needed.
  • Comprehensive understanding of music publishing, copyright law, and performance rights dynamics on a global scale.
  • A passionate, authentic advocate for ASCAP’s core values, including transparency, fairness, a future-forward outlook, and putting creators first.
  • Ability to comply with ASCAP’s current in-office policy (subject to change).

Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

Please be aware that ASCAP is not a nut-free or other allergen-free workplace.

ASCAP is an equal opportunity employer. All ASCAP employment decisions are made on the basis of individual qualifications and performance and not on the basis of race, national origin, ethnicity, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, genetic information, disability, handicap, color, creed, religion, veteran status, or any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

job.title: Consumer Product Strategist
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

The Associated Press seeks a Consumer Product Strategist for AP News based in New York City. We are a hybrid environment, with employees on site Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.  

  

About the Role  

As a Consumer Product Strategist, you will help AP News better understand its audience and use those insights to shape the future of our digital products and user experience. You will look beyond the numbers to uncover the story of how users discover, experience and engage across web and app platforms, turning those findings into clear, actionable recommendations that inform product strategy, experimentation and long-term growth.  

 

This role sits at the intersection of consumer insights, product strategy and analytics. The ideal candidate is naturally curious about consumers, comfortable digging into data and skilled at communicating what the data means with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  

  

What You'll Do: 

  • Analyze how audiences discover, navigate and engage with AP News by building repeatable analyses and dashboards in BigQuery, Looker, Omni and Hex to identify patterns in user behavior, feature adoption, engagement and friction points 

  • Connect behavioral data across journeys, funnels, features and retention to explain not just what is happening, but why 

  • Support tracking implementation in Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager to ensure the right data is captured to answer critical product and business questions  

  • Translate complex product and user data into clear recommendations that inform product priorities, audience growth and monetization decisions  

  • Identify strategic opportunities to improve user journeys, feature design and engagement funnels to deepen loyalty   

  • Development and evaluate product experiments and A/B tests, turning results into actionable product recommendations  

  • Build trusted relationships across product, editorial and technical teams to bring consumer insights into product decisions 

  • Translate business questions into meaningful analysis and clearly communicate what the data means  

  • Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data infrastructure supports critical decisions 

  

Who You Are:  

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience in digital product analytics, product strategy, growth analytics, audience insights, user analytics or a related role  

  • You have a bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as communications, journalism, Data Science, Marketing or equivalent professional experience 

  • You communicate effectively and are a strong storyteller who can take complex or ambiguous data and turn it into a clear narrative about consumers, products and business opportunities 

  • You have demonstrated ability to analyze user behavior, product performance and using those insights to influence product or business decisions 

  • You bring curiosity, consumer empathy and sound judgment to open-ended questions and are comfortable making recommendations  

  • You have strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python or R for querying large datasets, identifying trends and building repeatable analyses  

  • You have hands-on experience with analytics and visualization tools such as BigQuery, Hex, Omni and Looker

  • You have experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, including event tracking and measurement strategy  

  • You are comfortable collaborating with product managers, engineers, editorial teams and other cross-functional stakeholders 

 

What will set you apart:  

  • Experience using consumer insights to influence the strategy or development of a digital consumer product 

  • Experience in digital publishing, media subscription, marketplace or other content-driven consumer products  

  • Background working with BigQuery or other large-scale data warehousing platforms  

  • Familiarity with content recommendation systems or personalization strategies  

  • Experience with experimental design and A/B testing platforms  

  

  

Why join us:  

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.   

  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.   

  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.      

  

The anticipated salary range for this position is $103,000 – $128,000, based on a candidate’s skills and qualifications. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:      

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage      

  • Retirement benefits      

  • Company paid life insurance      

  • Paid vacation and sick days      

  • Paid parental leave for any new parent      

  • Mental well-being resources      

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Director, Newsroom Communications
job.description:
Company Overview

The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

 

Role Overview

AP seeks a strategic, collaborative and highly skilled communications professional to serve as Director of Newsroom Communications. Reporting to the Chief Communications Officer, this person will shape how AP communicates about its newsroom internally and externally, strengthening the organization and public's understanding of AP’s journalism, mission, standards and newsroom priorities among staff, media, customers, partners and other key audiences.    

 

The Director will develop global communications strategies and materials that strengthen employee connection, elevate distinctive AP journalism, support newsroom leaders and help prepare the organization for sensitive or high-profile issues. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of the news industry and is both a strategist and a hands-on operator: someone who can advise senior newsroom leaders, write staff notes with precision, pitch media, support internal programming, and move quickly in a demanding global news environment.    

 

This position is part of AP’s Corporate Communications team and will work closely with newsroom leadership, journalists, communications colleagues and other partners across the organization.

 

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute communications plans that support AP’s newsroom priorities, elevate distinctive journalism and reinforce AP’s reputation for accuracy, independence and nonpartisanship.   
  • Write clear, compelling and audience-appropriate materials for internal and external use, including staff notes, internal announcements, talking points, speeches, briefing materials, media pitches, executive messages and announcements.   
  • Serve as a trusted communications partner to newsroom leaders, helping them communicate clearly with staff, explain priorities, support change and recognize work across AP’s global newsroom, while navigating the considerations of a global and partially unionized workforce.  
  • Identify strong AP journalism and newsroom initiatives that merit broader visibility, then work with the wider communications team to amplify across earned media, owned channels, internal platforms, events and executive visibility opportunities.   
  • Support rapid response and issues management by monitoring risks, preparing messaging, coordinating with legal, human resources and editorial partners, and helping AP respond consistently and responsibly to sensitive matters.  
  • Strengthen newsroom culture and connection by shaping internal programming, editorial calendars, staff-facing updates and communications that make important information timely, accessible and useful. 

 

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 10+ years of communications experience in a large, complex organization, including experience developing communications strategies, advising leaders and managing both external and internal communications. 5+ years of experience working for a news organization is required.
  • Impeccable writing, with the ability to express ideas clearly, succinctly and compellingly for a range of audiences and channels. 
  • Demonstrated experience forging consensus among varied stakeholder groups.
  • Media fluency, with a strong understanding of the news industry, the broader media landscape, and how to identify opportunities to elevate AP journalism. 
  • Experience communicating in a unionized environment, particularly the U.S. and/or the U.K.
  • Experience working with broadcast bookers, producers and media  
  • Understanding and belief in the value of AP’s nonpartisan journalism 

 

Education

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent experience 

 

Work Location

This position is based in New York City and follows a hybrid work model.

 

Compensation & Benefits

The anticipated salary range for this position is $140,000 to $150,000, based on the candidate’s skills and qualifications.

The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage.
  • Retirement benefits.
  • Company-paid life insurance.
  • Paid vacation and sick days.
  • Paid parental leave for any new parent.
  • Mental well-being resources.

 

Application Deadline is October 19th at 11:59PM ET. 

 

Inclusion & Diversity

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or status as a veteran. We encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply.

job.title: Junior HR Business Partner (Remote)
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Why this role matters:

We are seeking a proactive and collaborative Junior HR Business Partner to support our HR Business Partner team in delivering a high-quality employee and manager experience across AP. Reporting to the HR Director, News, this role will serve as a key partner to HR Business Partners and business leaders, providing HR support on talent, organizational, and workforce matters.

 

What you will do:

Working closely with HRBPs, HR Operations, and other HR specialist teams, the Junior HR Business Partner will support a wide range of employee and manager needs across assigned client groups. This role will provide hands-on HRBP support on both routine activities and contribute to strategic initiatives led by HRBPs, while partnering directly with managers and employees to resolve issues, coordinate HR processes, and ensure effective delivery of HR services.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as support to HRBPs on a variety of requests, providing guidance and support across a range of day-to-day HR topics and escalating more complex matters as appropriate.
  • Partner closely with HRBPs and HR Operations to support managers and employees and ensure smooth coordination and follow-through on requests and cases.
  • Support managers and HRBPs with employee and labor relations matters, including performance management, disciplinary processes, providing guidance within established policies and practices and escalating complex or higher risk matters as appropriate.
  • Help facilitate employee transfers, mobility-related processes, immigration, and other cross-functional HR activities as needed.
  • Partner with the Talent and HRIS teams to understand data as it relates to people and ensure HRBPs and HR specialist teams are connected on people data.
  • Contribute to HR projects, process improvements and operational initiatives that support team effectiveness and employee experience.
  • Help document and improve HR processes and ways of working in partnership with the HR Operations team.

This role is ideal for someone currently in an HR Adviser or Generalist role, with an interest in developing as an HR Business Partner in a fast-paced global environment. The successful candidate will have HR generalist experience supporting employees and managers across the U.S and other countries.

 

The Junior HRBP will support across the employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, employee and labor relations, manager coaching, employee mobility and organisational change, while helping ensure HR policies practices are aligned with local employment requirements and business needs.

 

The successful candidate will be highly organized, solutions-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable managing a variety of operational, tactical and strategic support activities simultaneously.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn across both HRBP and HR Operations disciplines.

 

Required:

  • Up to 3 years of HR experience in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Experience supporting managers and employees across day-to-day HR processes and inquiries.
  • Experience supporting employee relations processes, HR policies, and employee lifecycle. 
  • Experience applying HR policies and employment practices across multiple jurisdictions, including recognizing when local requirements or specialist guidance apply.
  • Experience working with HR systems, maintaining and analyzing employee data with accuracy, and using data to inform decision making.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to drive actions and initiatives through to completion and deliver agreed outcomes in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.
  • Experience partnering across all HR functions and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

 

What will set you apart:

  • Experience supporting employees and managers in a unionized environment, or an interest in developing experience in labor relations, preferred.
  • Knowledge of SAP and Success Factors preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, is preferred.

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.
  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.
  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.

 

If you are passionate about people, thrive in a collaborative environment and are committed to driving business success, we encourage you to apply.  

 

Salary & Benefits: 

The anticipated salary range for this position is $65,000 - $75,000, based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications and location. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:

The anticipated starting salary range for Denver-based individuals expressing interest in this position is base salary plus unlimited commission - $40,000.00/Yr to $60,000.00/Yr. (on-target earnings $80,000 - $120,000+).

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

 

Overview:

Audacy's Denver office seeks a self-motivated sales professional to develop and sell fully integrated marketing campaigns to new and existing clients. With an emphasis on new business development and full funnel digital sales, the Account Executive will use a wide variety of Audacy's products in their portfolio to solicit local and national businesses for advertising on its radio, events and digital platforms. 

 

We are looking for an Account Executive who not only possesses a passion for creating strategic solutions and delivering client success, but also has an appreciation for how music, podcasting, well-known personalities, and events connect with audiences. There has never been more time spent creating meaningful connections in the audio space than now. Audacy’s award-winning podcasts feed passions, and our epic concerts and experiences create memories that last a lifetime.  

 

Our ideal candidate is self-motivated, creative, curious, proactive problem solver, tenacious, detail-oriented, money-motivated and would approach this job as if they were their own CEO. Audacy Account Executives are handsomely compensated with an attractive base salary plus commission, along with potential for bonus compensation.

This is a hybrid role based out of our Audacy - Denver office. 

Why you will want to join our sales team at Audacy - Denver and what can we offer you:

  • Targeted digital solutions, with killer lifestyle events and e-commerce
  • Access to selling on a national level within 50 states
  • On-going coaching and training and development
  • Resources and support to be successful and earn a great income
  • Opportunity to bring innovative marketing ideas to life that make a difference for clients and their businesses
  • A creative, collaborative, and high energy work environment

What You'll Do:

  • Primary focus will be to proactively develop new business and build strong relationships with local/regional decision-makers, with the goal of converting them to repeat clients 
  • Create strategic and creative multi-platform, multi-channel advertising campaigns that leverage the broad reach of Audacy’s product suite
  • Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales quotas
  • Aide in the collections process for all campaigns sold
  • Prepare sales collateral for clients 
  • Provide highest-level of customer service and be the point person for resolving client/campaign issues
  • Communicate with other departments to assure quality service in executing all aspects of advertising campaigns
  • Attending sales meetings, company trainings, and events

Required Qualifications:

  • 1-3 years of experience in media sales (broadcast radio and digital media preferred)
  • A hunter mentality with the ability to proactively generate new business and manage the full sales cycle, with a proven track record of exceeding goals and renewing business
  • Thorough understanding of advertising and marketing, especially in digital, audio, and interactive
  • A creative and strategic mind to put together unique campaigns focused on solving client needs
  • A solutions and goal-oriented mindset – you’re someone who identifies a problem as an opportunity to develop business.
  • Proficiency in Google Suite, MS Office programs, SalesForce, Media Monitors, Xray, Nielsen, Google Analytics, Google Ads (SEM), Facebook Ads
  • A positive attitude and a desire to continuously grow your income
  • Ability to be in-person in our Denver office for a minimum of 3 days per week (Tues-Thurs)

Job Title: Account Executive

Reporting To: General Sales Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Houston, TX

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

 

Overview:

Build Your Business. Grow Your Clients. Grow Your Income.

 

Audacy Houston is looking for a motivated, creative and driven Account Executive to join our sales team.

 

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a business, not just manage a list of accounts. You’ll work with local, regional and national businesses to understand their goals, uncover opportunities and create marketing solutions that help them grow.

 

You’ll have access to one of the most powerful media portfolios in the market, including iconic radio brands, streaming audio, podcasts, digital marketing solutions, video, OTT, social, events, sponsorships and original content. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell campaigns beyond Houston through Audacy’s extensive national footprint.

 

If you’re competitive, curious, persistent and motivated by the opportunity to make money based on your success, we want to meet you.

 

Why Join Audacy Houston?

 

The opportunity to sell a powerful combination of radio, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and content

The ability to build campaigns for local, regional and national advertisers

Access to major Houston events and opportunities, including Houston Texans programming, Rodeo, Radio Row, and more.

Ongoing coaching, training and development to help you become a better salesperson

A collaborative sales environment where ideas, creativity and teamwork matter

The tools, research and resources you need to prospect, sell and grow your business

Competitive base salary plus commission and bonus opportunities, including additional earning potential beyond quota attainment

The opportunity to bring creative marketing ideas to life and see the impact they have on your clients' businesses

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop new business through consistent prospecting, networking, referrals, email, phone calls and face-to-face meetings - minimum of 100 outreach per week
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business owners, marketing leaders and decision-makers
  • Conduct thoughtful discovery conversations to understand a client's business, challenges, goals and target audience
  • Create customized, multi-platform marketing solutions based on each client's needs
  • Sell across Audacy's portfolio, including broadcast, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and other marketing solutions
  • Manage the entire sales process from prospecting and presentation through closing and campaign execution and retainment 
  • Consistently work toward and exceed individual sales goals
  • Maintain a strong pipeline and actively look for opportunities to grow existing accounts
  • Deliver exceptional customer service and become a trusted marketing partner to your clients
  • Stay current on industry trends, consumer behavior and new advertising opportunities
  • Work collaboratively with sales management, marketing, programming, digital and other internal teams to deliver successful campaigns
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, client meetings and events

Qualifications

Required:

We’re looking for someone who is driven to win and motivated/disciplined to build something of their own.

 

You may be a media salesperson already, or you may come from another sales environment. What matters most is your ability to prospect, build relationships, understand business needs, present solutions and close.

 

Our ideal candidate is:

 

  • A proven hunter who enjoys developing new business
  • Self-disciplined and comfortable creating their own opportunities
  • Confident communicating and presenting to business owners and decision-makers
  • Curious and willing to ask questions to uncover client needs
  • Creative and able to think beyond a traditional advertising solution
  • Persistent and resilient when faced with rejection or obstacles
  • Organized and able to manage multiple clients and opportunities
  • Competitive and motivated by achieving and exceeding goals
  • Comfortable working independently while being a strong team player
  • Someone who takes ownership of their business and their results
  • Experienced in media, advertising, sponsorship, digital or another consultative sales environment preferred

 

Qualifications

 

  • Proven track record of success in sales, preferably new-business development
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to manage the full sales process from prospecting through close
  • Comfortable using CRM and standard Microsoft Office programs
  • Ability to learn and confidently present new products and marketing solutions
  • Valid driver's license and satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check. Reliable transportation and valid insurance is required.

 

The Bottom Line

 

If you’re someone who wants to build relationships, create opportunities, win new business and control your earning potential, this could be the opportunity for you.

  • Hit & Exceed Goals: Staying driven to hit your revenue targets and grow your own income.

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Account Manager

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Senior Account Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): New York, NY | Los Angeles, CA

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid (3 to 4 days on-site, remaining remote)

 

Pay Transparency:

 

The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $75,000-90,000/yr. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

Audacy’s Enterprise Team is looking to add to our Account Manager team. The Account Manager role is responsible for quarterbacking the post-sale process once a campaign has been sold, as well as helping strategize what we’re going to market with from a pre-sale perspective. The Account Manager oversees the entire Sales process, from the point of RFP to the final wrap report and must be familiar with each part in the process to ensure we’re going to market with the best service possible. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional client-facing skills, have a thorough understanding of marketing and integrated media channels, and be able to lead large-scale campaigns from start to finish while being the main point of contact for Audacy. You will have a knack for communicating efficiently and effectively under pressure to both internally & externally, and the detail orientation skills to ensure that the client’s needs are met.

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Quarterback internal strategy calls to ensure we’re providing our best recommendations.
  • Lead conversations with internal creative and execution teams to ensure client expectations and deadlines are met.
  • Provide “white glove” client service to advertisers through great communication and properly setting expectations.
  • Quarterback Internal & External pre-sale/post-sale Kickoff Calls
  • Work with Marketing to create in-depth detailed wrap reports, calling out prominent metrics to keep the client satisfied
  • Work closely with the Campaign Management team to ensure that we’re delivering well, or optimizing with the goal of delivering in full.
  • Manage all post-sale correspondence with the client and creative stakeholders.
  • Monitor and convey recording timelines and manage expectations for closed campaigns.
  • Present campaign performance reports including delivery, optimizations, insights, and program recommendations including mid-campaign and wrap reports
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on your client, and track anything that could result in risk
  • Work with planning on re-allocations while being cognizant of what the client is and is not interested in.
  • Communicate effectively with Podcast Partner Management to manage custom facets of campaigns and ensure we’re keeping to timeline.
  • Vet & monitor the podcast vetting portal to ensure we have approvals to run in shows at the point of sale

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Minimum 2 years working with a media company, digital agency, or integrated media sales position, preferably in a client-facing capacity.
  • Basic understanding of digital advertising strategy and measurement is preferred.
  • Problem solver and solution-oriented thinker with great organizational skills.
  • Public speaking skills and ability to lead a room
  • Skilled at interpreting data to properly position sellback metrics.
  • A background working with and leading communication with internal teams
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detail-oriented work environment
  • Exceptional communication and writing skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Account Executive

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Senior Vice President of Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-time

 

Pay Transparency: $65,000 to $75,000 base salary

 

Location(s): Roseville, California 

 

Work Arrangement: On-site

 

 

The anticipated starting base salary range for California based individuals expressing interest in this position is $65,000 to $75,000, plus uncapped commission. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

The Opportunity: 

 

Are you a proven hunter who lives for winning new business? Do you have a track record of opening doors, building relationships, and closing deals in a competitive marketplace?

Audacy is looking for a driven Digital Account Executive to accelerate growth and make an immediate impact. This is more than a sales job—it's an opportunity to build your own book of business, sell industry-leading digital marketing solutions, and earn without limits.

 

If you're competitive, entrepreneurial, and motivated by uncapped income potential, we'll give you the platform, products, and support to win big.

 

Who We Are: Industry Digital Leader with Best In Class Technology

 

At Audacy, you'll have the opportunity to sell one of the most comprehensive digital marketing portfolios in the industry. Backed by strategic partnerships with Google Premier Partner, Meta Premier Partner, Amazon Advanced Partner, and other leading technology platforms, you'll help businesses accelerate growth through data-driven marketing solutions that deliver measurable results.

As a Digital Account Executive, you'll work with a powerful suite of products that spans the entire customer journey—from building brand awareness to driving conversions and customer acquisition. You'll collaborate with local businesses, regional brands, and national advertisers to create customized marketing strategies using cutting-edge digital solutions.

 

Our multi-platform ecosystem combines the scale of premium audio with the precision of digital targeting, giving you access to:

  • Digital Streaming Audio
  • Podcast Advertising & Host-Endorsed Content
  • Amazon DSP & Programmatic Advertising
  • Connected TV (CTV) & OTT Video / Live Sports
  • Display & Native Advertising
  • Search Engine Marketing (SEM)
  •   Search Engine Optimization (SEO) / AIO (AI Optimization)
  • Social Media Advertising
  • First-Party Audience Targeting & Data Solutions
  • Attribution & Performance Measurement Tools

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Hunt New Business: Relentlessly prospect, uncover opportunities, and win new clients through strategic outreach, networking, and relationship-building.
  • Build a Pipeline That Produces: Consistently generate qualified opportunities and maintain a healthy pipeline to exceed revenue goals.
  • Own the Close: Take control of the entire sales process, from first conversation to signed agreement.
  • Compete to Win: Thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where results are recognized and rewarded.
  • Sell Industry-Leading Solutions: Help businesses grow with best-in-class digital marketing solutions.
  • Become a Trusted Advisor: Understand client goals, uncover challenges, and deliver strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Outwork the Competition: Stay ahead of market trends, identify emerging opportunities, and bring fresh ideas to every client conversation.

This is more than a sales role—it's an opportunity to become a trusted marketing consultant, helping businesses navigate today's evolving digital landscape while building a rewarding career with an industry leader.

 

If you're energized by prospecting, passionate about digital marketing, and motivated by uncapped earning potential, Audacy provides the tools, training, partnerships, and support to help you succeed.

Qualifications

More About You:

  • Proven Sales Success: 4+ years of digital media or advertising sales experience with a track record of winning new business and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Hunter Mentality: You thrive on prospecting, opening doors, and building a pipeline from the ground up.
  • Digital Marketing Expertise: Deep understanding of digital advertising solutions, including programmatic, search, social, video, and audience targeting.
  • Strategic & Consultative Approach: You uncover client challenges, develop customized solutions, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Executive Presence: Confident presenting to business owners, marketing leaders, and C-suite decision-makers while simplifying complex digital strategies.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Comfortable using campaign metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, ROI, ROAS, and conversion rates to guide recommendations and prove performance.
  • Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and client relationship skills that drive long-term partnerships.
  • Tech-Savvy: Proficient in Salesforce, Google Workspace, and digital marketing platforms, with the ability to quickly adapt to new technologies.
  • Self-Starter: Highly motivated, accountable, and driven to succeed in a fast-paced, performance-focused environment.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Overview:

 

This is the ideal role for a high caliber-marketing professional with significant success in digital campaign management who is looking to join a growing, fast-paced business. As a Digital Campaign Manager, you will be responsible for managing the successful implementation of campaign activities for several assigned markets. This role is focused on post sales fulfillment, working with a variety of teams to gather assets and launch campaigns across a wide range of platforms including display, email, social media, SEM, SEO and more. Responsibilities also include optimizing marketing campaigns, monitoring performance data to ensure campaigns are running properly, and communicating the results to clients on a regular basis.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Accountable for ownership of the post-sale process, ensuring full and complete delivery of all digital campaigns, including but not limited to order entry, fulfillment, optimization, and reporting.
  • Account Management: You will work with sales teams and digital clients to support their needs and communicate client expectations to the fulfillment and trafficking teams.
  • Project Management: Ability to work in a fast paced environment, handling several campaigns and markets at one time while tracking timelines/due dates for campaign deliverables, launches and/or revisions.
  • Continuity with Production: Ensure all digital campaigns are moving through the fulfillment process between teams while meeting necessary timelines for client orders.
  • Monitor Campaigns to ensure they are hitting the agreed upon goals during their flights. Adjust as appropriate. Alert appropriate parties of any anticipated problems and be prepared with suggested solutions.
  • Assist with ongoing and month end campaign/order reconciliation to verify delivery against monthly billing amount.
  • Maintain working knowledge of digital inventory: Achieve a thorough understanding of our internal systems so as to effectively and efficiently respond to internal and external requests in a timely fashion.
  • Campaign Reports: At month end and/or campaign end, prepare performance reporting for digital campaigns and provide results to the client with the Account Executive.
  • Stakeholder Communication: As this role will support several assigned markets; clear, professional and efficient communication is imperative between stakeholders (sales team and fulfillment teams) to ensure client campaign execution and performance meets or exceeds standards.

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Minimum two years experience working with digital marketing campaigns
  • Minimum two years experience working in a sales environment
  • Ability to multi task efficiently in a organized, logical, process-oriented manner
  • Professional demeanor; comfortable presenting to and interacting directly with clients 
  • Demonstrates ability to successfully collaborate with various team across the company
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and is able to prioritize accordingly
  • Quick-witted, understanding and offering solutions in regards to various responsibilities

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Digital Content Producer

 

Department: Digital 

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Part Time

 

Work Arrangement: On-site

 

Job Description:

 

1010 WINS is looking for a digital journalist with strong news judgment, sharp social instincts and a passion for visual storytelling. This role will focus on turning breaking news, reporter content and broadcast material into engaging digital content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Threads and X. The ideal candidate understands how people consume news on social media, can quickly identify the strongest angle in a story, and knows how to make content feel native to each platform while maintaining high journalistic standards.

The anticipated starting salary range for New York-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $20.00/Hr.-$25.00/Hr. 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Produce short-form videos, graphics, photos and infographics from broadcast reports, reporter assets and breaking news, primarily using Canva
  • Monitor broadcast rundowns, AP Newsroom, Bloomberg, press releases, social media and other news sources to identify strong local, national, political and trending stories
  • Work closely with digital producers, broadcast editors, anchors and field reporters to gather video, photos, audio and other assets
  • Source additional visual material from Getty, AP Newsroom, Citizen, Bloomberg and other approved third-party sources
  • Verify content and ensure all material meets station editorial standards, copyright requirements and media licensing rules
  • Write sharp, engaging social copy and headlines tailored to each platform
  • Publish and schedule content using Sprinklr across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Snapchat and Threads
  • Apply accurate photo, video and source credits
  • Respond quickly to breaking news and changing newsroom priorities
  • Identify opportunities to turn reporter coverage into stronger social and digital content
  • Write and publish web stories when appropriate, including content supporting newsletters and other digital initiatives
  • Contribute ideas for recurring social franchises, original video and new ways to grow audience and engagement

Qualifications

 

More About You:

 

Desired Characteristics:

 

  • Experience using Canva for social video and graphics
  • Experience with Sprinklr or similar social publishing tools
  • Familiarity with AP Newsroom, Bloomberg, Getty, Citizen and other newsroom content sources
  • Experience working in a broadcast, digital or breaking-news newsroom
  • Understanding of social media analytics and how performance can help guide editorial decisions
  • Experience publishing stories in a digital content management system
  • Strong instinct for trending, visual and highly shareable stories
  • Willingness to experiment with new formats and platforms
  • Genuine interest in how younger audiences discover and consume news
  • Curiosity, creativity and a desire to help build something that is still evolving

 

 

Required & Preferred:

 

Qualifications:

 

  • Strong news judgment and a commitment to accuracy, verification and journalistic standards
  • Experience creating short-form video and visual content for platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong writing and copywriting skills, including the ability to quickly identify the strongest hook in a story
  • A strong understanding of major social platforms and what works on each one
  • Ability to work quickly and calmly in a fast-paced breaking-news environment
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Knowledge of New York City, the Tri-State area, major national news, politics, culture and current events
  • Understanding of copyright, asset licensing and proper attribution
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a larger newsroom
  • Availability to work evenings, weekends and holidays as required

 

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Digital Content Producer

 

Department: Digital

 

Reporting To: Director, Digital Content Strategy

 

Employment Type: Part-Time

 

Location: Miami, FL

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

  Pay Transparency: The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $15.00/hr - $18.00/hr. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity. Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

 

A highly motivated, creative, and versatile audio and video producer who can identify the best moments, viral content, and news to drive user engagement, downloads, and listening. The ideal candidate has a sharp instinct for what both passionate and more casual fans will engage with, balanced with a mastery of best production practices -- isolating news-making segments and optimizing titles and descriptions. Must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be able to bridge the UX gap between our over-the-air product and web/app streaming platforms.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Manage daily (M-F) live video stream
  • Leverage over-the-air content into short and long-form podcast clips and VOD content
  • Use creative headline copy and tagging concepts to help build customized user experiences to drive downloads and “superfans” (consistent users)
  • Produce and publish “Best of” episodes by compiling the top segments from the show each week
  • Work with central digital and local-market staff on workflow for optimizing top content clips (e.g. isolating exclusive interviews)
  • Help activate around breaking news by quickly getting reaction content onto user platforms
  • Partner with local staff to maximize Audacy’s ‘chaptering’ experience
  • Contributing topics and ideas for the show

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • 3+ years of audio production/editing experience
  • Proficient with Adobe Audition and video editing software
  • Experience with content management systems preferred
  • Experience with VMIX, OBS, and/ or Tricaster preferred
  • Sports knowledge, including current and historical figures and storylines
  • Strong writing and editorial skills and the ability to drive engagement for both local and national audiences
  • Strong news judgment, including the ability to make real-time judgments and react independently around breaking/viral audio

job.title: Digital Sales Specialist
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Digital Sales Specialist

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Digital Sales Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Austin, TX

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

 

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a Digital Sales Specialist to spearhead revenue growth through the strategic adoption of our comprehensive digital portfolio. This is a consultative sales support role with client-facing interaction. The role is designed for a candidate with technical and strategic digital knowledge who does not just help sell "products," rather moves our sales team to create comprehensive multi-channel digital strategies tailored to a client’s business objectives.

 

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of the digital landscape — customizing campaigns that bridge top-of-funnel awareness tactics (such as OTT and Digital Audio) with high-intent, bottom-of-funnel conversion tactics (such as Search), including conversion tracking best practices. You will act as a strategic advisor to both our internal local sales team and our valuable clients.

job.title: Executive Producer
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Executive Producer - The Chris & Amy Show

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): St. Louis, M.O

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

KMOX Radio, the legendary Voice of St. Louis, is looking for a modern, creative and digitally savvy Executive Producer to help take The Chris & Amy Show to the next level. We're looking for someone who understands that a great show can live far beyond the radio clock — on YouTube, social media, podcasts, video, digital platforms and wherever St. Louis audiences consume content. The Executive Producer will oversee the show's daily content strategy, preparation and execution while helping expand The Chris & Amy Show into a multi-platform St. Louis media brand. You'll work closely with Chris and Amy to develop ideas, create compelling conversations, find great guests and stories, and turn the best moments from the show into content that can reach new audiences. You should have a great ear for radio — but you should also have a great eye for content.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop the daily content strategy and show rundown with Chris and Amy.
  • Identify the stories, conversations and personalities that will drive the show.
  • Create original features, recurring benchmarks, games, bits and listener-driven content.
  • Research for interviews, conversations and major topics.
  • Constantly look for ways to make the show more entertaining, surprising, relevant and local.
  • Running a live radio board and executing a show in real time.
  • Understanding clocks, formats, commercial breaks and station logs.
  • Editing and producing audio quickly and cleanly.
  • Booking and preparing guests.
  • Writing compelling intros, teases, promos and digital copy.
  • Managing live callers, interviews and breaking content.
  • Working with newsroom, traffic, weather and other station resources.
  • Making quick decisions when the show doesn't go according to plan.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

But you also need to think beyond radio.

We're looking for someone who understands that the best moments on The Chris & Amy Show shouldn't end when the microphone is turned off.

You should be able to identify an on-air conversation and immediately see its potential as:

  • A YouTube video.
  • A short-form video.
  • A podcast segment.
  • A social clip.
  • A behind-the-scenes piece.
  • A digital-only conversation.
  • A community or live event opportunity.

The goal is not simply to produce a better radio show.  The goal is to build a bigger Chris & Amy audience — on the radio and everywhere else people consume content.

Expand the show beyond radio

  • Develop a daily content strategy that extends the show across YouTube, video, social media, podcasts and digital platforms.
  • Identify moments during the live show that have the potential to become compelling digital content.
  • Think proactively about content that should be created specifically for digital audiences.
  • Develop short-form video, social clips, interviews, behind-the-scenes content and other original digital features.

The ideal candidate is:

  • An experienced radio producer with a modern content mindset.
  • A strong writer and storyteller.
  • Someone who understands personality-driven radio.
  • Highly knowledgeable about digital video, social media and audience growth.
  • Comfortable creating and editing short-form video and digital content.
  • Someone who understands platforms such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook and knows that each platform requires a different approach.
  • Highly organized but not afraid to throw out the rundown when a great idea comes along.
  • Curious about culture, entertainment, sports, news and — most importantly — St. Louis.
  • Comfortable working with strong personalities.
  • An idea generator who is constantly thinking about "What more can I do?"

Overview:

We are looking for an experienced media professional for a key role in a pre-sales department. The primary responsibilities of this role will be to provide strategic planning, pricing and inventory management. This position also provides support for sales teams incorporating all digital media tactics Audacy has to offer. The Audacy portfolio consists of streaming, podcast, social, video, OTT, search, display and more.

This role will work hand-in-hand with Audacy's Account Executives in designated markets to understand customer objectives and design programs that deliver results. Integrated Sales Planners are pillars to success; acting as internal and external product experts for all of our digital solutions.

Overview

Job Title: Manager, Legal Operations & Strategic Projects

 

Department: Legal

 

Reporting To: Vice President Senior Counsel

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location: Remote

 

The anticipated salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $95,000.00/Yr. - $105,000.00/Yr. 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a Manager of Legal Operations & Strategic Projects to serve as the lead for strategic projects and manage workflows and documents across our legal department. This role will serve as the central driver for all legal department initiatives and projects, while maintaining a high standard for document organization, retrieval, and life-cycle contract management.

 

The ideal candidate brings a strong project management background (preferably within the legal and/or broadcast media landscape). You will keep key transactions and departmental projects running seamlessly, while maintaining effective contract management, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and driving strategic legal initiatives to support overall organizational growth and efficiency.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Lead legal operations and  department initiatives and manage and execute legal department projects.
  • Lead project management for multi-faceted transactions (e.g., M&A and financings), including efficiently organizing complex contracts into virtual data rooms for internal and external stakeholders, coordinating cross-functional due diligence streams and responses to counterparty diligence requests, building and maintaining project management tools and trackers to monitor diligence requests and pre- and post-closing matters; maintaining closing conditions checklists, tracking corporate approvals (board resolutions, shareholder consents), overseeing legal document execution and escrow mechanics, securing third party consents, managing closing exchanges, and compiling closing binders. 
  • Function as the primary driver and manager of strategic projects at the request of attorneys and other internal business partners ensuring clear communication of tasks and setting and meeting deadlines.
  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert on document and storage management, contract retrieval, leveraging a strong understanding of contracts and key terms in order to accurately organize, classify, and audit documents for internal searchability. 
  • Manage administration of contract-related resources and collaboration tools, including but not limited to iManage, DocMinder, and physical files and related licenses.  
  • Draft agreements and notices using templates, as well as disclosure schedules for M&A transactions, in each case with attorney oversight.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required & Preferred:

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex transactions and projects, and building or maintaining contract databases and virtual data rooms for transactions and audits. 
  • Proven ability to critically evaluate, analyze, and synthesize disparate information gathered from cross-functional teams such as Finance, HR, IT, and Programming.
  • BA/BS from an accredited college or university, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Proficient in the Google, Microsoft, and Adobe suites, including building and maintaining project trackers.
  • Ability to handle and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously and operate with limited supervision in a fast-paced, high-volume workplace.
  • Ability to work well with others in a collaborative environment. 
  • Exceptional initiative, judgment, prioritizing and organizational skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication, analytical skills, and problem-solving ability.
  • High degree of discretion, professionalism, judgment, and follow-through.
  • Prior personnel management experience preferred.

Overview:

 

A highly motivated, creative, and versatile audio and video producer who can identify the best moments, viral content, and news to drive user engagement, downloads, and listening. The ideal candidate has a sharp instinct for what both passionate and more casual fans will engage with, balanced with a mastery of best production practices -- isolating news-making segments and optimizing titles and descriptions. Must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be able to bridge the UX gap between our over-the-air product and web/app streaming platforms.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team.
