job.title: Senior Engineer -Commercial Technology
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

About you

You are an experienced senior engineer and technical leader with a strong software engineering background and a track record of providing technical direction across business-critical products and platforms.

You combine deep technical expertise with pragmatic engineering judgement. You are comfortable navigating complex systems, shaping architecture, making and facilitating significant technical decisions, and helping engineering teams turn business requirements into secure, resilient and sustainable solutions.

You think beyond individual features and solutions to the long-term health of the technology: architecture, reliability, security, scalability, operability, developer experience, technical debt and the ability of teams to evolve their systems sustainably.

You are comfortable working with engineers, Product, Programme and business stakeholders, communicating complex technical considerations clearly and making thoughtful trade-offs between immediate delivery needs and longer-term technical investment.

You are also motivated by developing engineering capability. While this is not a people-management role, you will mentor engineers, encourage technical ownership, create opportunities for others to develop their expertise and help build a strong engineering culture based on learning, collaboration and constructive technical challenge.

About the team

Commercial Technology is part of the Internal Products group within FT Product & Technology. We are a multidisciplinary group of Engineers, Product Managers and Business Analysts responsible for building and operating the technology platforms that support the FT’s commercial capabilities across Marketing, Sales, Service and Commercial Data.

We are undertaking a significant evolution of our commercial technology landscape, bringing these capabilities together around a more connected Salesforce platform and establishing a strong foundation for how our commercial teams engage with customers and use data.

In Marketing & Commercial Data, we are evolving our marketing technology landscape towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360, while continuing to operate and transition from established platforms including Bloomreach, Marketo and Legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud products for B2B & B2C marketing.

In Sales & Service, we are consolidating several Salesforce CRM orgs with their associated processes and procedures into a leaner Commercial Technology estate, utilising data available to us via Data 360, into a setup that aligns with the FT’s future commercial capabilities and setup.

In Commercial Platform, we are establishing a centre of excellence at the heart of the commercial workflow, tasked with ensuring the security, health and viability of our day-to-day commercial operation and providing a primary support route for our business users

The Technical Lead will provide technical leadership for one of the engineering capabilities within Commercial Technology, working closely with the Engineering Manager, Product, engineers, other Technical Leads and the wider Commercial Technology leadership team.

What you’ll work on

As Technical Lead within Commercial Technology, you will provide technical leadership for the engineering capability responsible for the delivery, operation and continuous evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology.

You will be accountable for the technical direction and engineering integrity of the capability, ensuring our technology is secure, resilient, scalable, maintainable and aligned with wider Commercial Technology and FT engineering standards. You will lead architectural thinking, guide significant technical decisions and ensure technical risks, dependencies and opportunities are understood and actively managed.

You will help lead the technical transformation of the FT’s commercial technology landscape, shaping the transition from our established marketing platforms towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next, Data 360 and the wider Commercial Technology ecosystem while ensuring our existing technology remains sustainable throughout that transition.

You will work in close partnership with the Engineering Manager – Marketing & Commercial Data. Together, you will provide the complementary people, delivery and technical leadership required to operate and evolve the capability successfully. The Engineering Manager is primarily accountable for people leadership, delivery, capacity and operational coordination, while you will be primarily accountable for technical direction, architecture, engineering standards and technical sustainability.

You will remain close to engineering delivery, working directly with engineers to solve complex technical problems, review and challenge approaches, improve engineering practices and create opportunities for engineers to develop greater technical ownership and expertise.

You will also work with the Principal Engineer, Principal Architect and other senior technical leaders on decisions that extend beyond your capability, ensuring local technical decisions contribute to a coherent and sustainable Commercial Technology landscape.

You will report to the Principal Engineer for the Commercial Technology domain.

Your responsibilities will include

Technical Direction & Architecture

  • Own the technical direction for the Marketing & Commercial Data capability, ensuring technology decisions align with the wider Commercial Technology strategy and FT engineering standards.
  • Lead architectural thinking and significant technical decisions across the capability, balancing immediate delivery needs with security, resilience, scalability, maintainability and long-term sustainability.
  • Establish and champion appropriate engineering standards, patterns and practices across the team.
  • Maintain visibility of architecture, technical debt, lifecycle risks, dependencies and emerging technology opportunities.
  • Work with the Principal Engineer, Principal Architect and other Technical Leads on decisions that span multiple capabilities, platforms or technology domains.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, modernise and improve the technology landscape while avoiding unnecessary complexity and duplication.

Engineering Quality & Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership and guidance to engineers while creating appropriate autonomy for individuals to make decisions and take ownership of the technology they work with.
  • Mentor engineers and technical specialists, helping them develop their technical expertise, engineering judgement and confidence in making technical decisions.
  • Support engineers through complex technical challenges without becoming the decision-maker or implementation owner for every issue.
  • Promote strong engineering practices including testing, automation, observability, security, documentation and sustainable software development.
  • Encourage constructive technical challenge, knowledge sharing and continuous learning across the team.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager to identify technical skills and capability gaps and help develop the engineering capabilities required for our future platform.

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Engineering Manager – Marketing & Commercial Data to ensure technical strategy, people, delivery and operational priorities remain aligned.
  • Provide technical input into roadmaps, planning and prioritisation, ensuring delivery plans are technically achievable and account for complexity, dependencies, technical risk and longer-term investment.
  • Work with Product, Programme and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into appropriate technical approaches and clearly communicate technical considerations, trade-offs and opportunities.
  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early and work with the Engineering Manager and wider Commercial Technology leadership to ensure they are understood and appropriately managed.
  • Work closely with Technical Leads, Engineering Managers and engineers across Commercial Technology to coordinate technical decisions and shared dependencies.
  • Work effectively with external technology partners and delivery vendors, providing technical direction and ensuring solutions align with FT architecture, engineering standards and practices.

Operational Excellence & Technical Health

  • Be accountable for the technical health and sustainability of the Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities throughout their lifecycle.
  • Ensure solutions are designed and engineered with appropriate consideration for security, resilience, scalability, observability, maintainability and supportability.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager and Commercial Platform team to ensure new and changed capabilities are operationally ready and can be effectively supported within the wider Commercial Technology operating model.
  • Provide technical leadership during incidents affecting Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities, supporting diagnosis, technical decision-making and sustainable resolution.
  • Ensure technical debt, lifecycle risks and engineering improvements are visible, understood and appropriately considered alongside product and programme priorities.
  • Ensure learning from incidents and operational issues informs architecture, engineering standards and future technical decisions.

Change & Platform Evolution

  • Provide technical leadership for the evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology landscape.
  • Shape the technical transition from established marketing platforms, including Bloomreach and Marketo, towards the FT’s strategic Salesforce-based marketing and data capabilities.
  • Define and evolve the architecture, engineering patterns and technical practices required to support the future Marketing & Commercial Data platform.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager to ensure the team develops the technical skills and knowledge required to own and evolve the future platform sustainably.
  • Work with Commercial Platform, other Technical Leads, the Principal Architect and the Principal Engineer to ensure platform changes integrate coherently with the wider Commercial Technology ecosystem and maintain operational continuity.

Our Technology

Our Commercial Technology landscape is evolving. Technologies and platforms within or interacting with Marketing & Commercial Data include:

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next (Advanced Edition)
  • Salesforce Data 360
  • Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud
  • Sales Collaboration & Enablement Tooling
  • Bloomreach
  • Marketo
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • APIs and integration technologies
  • AWS Technologies
  • Data platforms and integrations
  • CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
  • GitHub
  • Monitoring and observability tooling
  • Jira & Confluence

You do not need experience with all of these technologies to apply. We are particularly interested in technical leaders who can work across complex technology ecosystems, provide strong engineering judgement and help teams develop the skills required for an evolving platform.

Technical and Leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Experience managing, leading or designing a Customer Data Platform, ideally utilising Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360.
  • Significant software engineering experience working with complex production systems, platforms or enterprise technology.
  • Experience providing technical leadership across engineering teams or significant technology capabilities.
  • Strong architectural and engineering judgement, with experience making and guiding significant technical decisions.
  • Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices and the design of secure, resilient, scalable and maintainable systems.
  • Experience identifying and managing technical debt, architectural risk, technology lifecycle concerns and cross-system dependencies.
  • Experience working closely with engineers to solve complex technical problems while enabling others to take ownership and develop their expertise.
  • Experience balancing immediate delivery needs with longer-term architecture, engineering quality and technical investment.
  • Strong understanding of operational excellence, observability, reliability and production engineering.
  • Experience working effectively with Product, Engineering, Data, Programme and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical considerations and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across teams and influencing technical decisions beyond your immediate area.
  • Experience leading technical change across significant platform or technology transformations would be beneficial.
  • Experience with Salesforce, marketing technology, customer data platforms, enterprise SaaS ecosystems or complex integration architectures would be beneficial, but is not essential

Characteristics we value

  • Strong technical judgement and curiosity.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for technical outcomes.
  • Pragmatism when balancing technical quality, delivery needs and operational risk.
  • An ability to make complex technical concepts understandable.
  • Confidence challenging technical approaches constructively.
  • An instinct for enabling and mentoring engineers rather than becoming the person through whom every technical decision must pass.
  • An appreciation for simplicity, reliability and long-term technical sustainability.
  • A collaborative approach to working across Engineering, Product, Data and business teams.
  • Calm and clear technical leadership during incidents and periods of change.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn.
  • An interest in how technology and data can enable better customer experiences and commercial outcomes.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, please contact the FT Talent team via email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

job.title: Senior Process & Knowledge Specialist (Customer Care)
job.description:
About Us:

The FT has an uncompromising mission: delivering independent, quality information, news and services to individuals and companies around the globe. It’s the cornerstone of our reputation and the heart of our ambitions for the future. But for our people, the FT offers so much more than what we do. FT people come from all kinds of backgrounds and work across a huge range of disciplines and locations, and find empowering, warm and welcoming culture that values curiosity and rewards smart, ambitious thinking. Those who are willing to unite around our mission and live our values will find plenty to challenge, inspire and interest them. Like the audiences we serve, no two FT people are the same; but together we help our audience be better informed and understand the world around them. It’s a job that’s never mattered more, and a career that can take you anywhere you want to go. 

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion in the workplace:

At the FT, we give all employees a voice so that diverse perspectives are heard and valued. We believe that a supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves at work. We'll continue to remove barriers for all, and in particular, barriers facing employees from underrepresented groups. 

About the role:

The Senior Process & Knowledge Specialist (internal business title) is responsible for driving the strategic development, governance, and continuous improvement of Customer Care operational processes and knowledge management practices. The role designs and governs the operational knowledge and process ecosystem, ensuring workflows, operational guidance, and knowledge assets are structured, scalable, and aligned to support consistent, efficient, and customer-focused service delivery across agent, self-service, and AI-assisted support experiences.

Working collaboratively across Customer Care and key business functions, the role plays a key part in enhancing operational efficiency, agent and customer experience, process consistency, and knowledge effectiveness. The role also oversees the ongoing optimisation of the Customer Care knowledge base, ensuring content remains accessible, compliant, and aligned with evolving operational and business needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define, manage, and continuously improve the structure, governance, usability, and discoverability of the Customer Care knowledge base, ensuring the content is intuitive, accurate, scalable, and effectively supports agent, self-service, and AI-assisted Customer Care experiences.
  • Design and optimise operational workflows, process guidance, policies, and decision-making tools that simplify complex processes, improve agent experience, and support Customer Care teams in fast-paced operational environments.
  • Ensure knowledge content and operational guidance are designed with both agent and customer experience in mind, balancing usability, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Define and oversee standards for operational knowledge content, workflows, and guidance, ensuring information is structured, scalable, operationally effective, and aligned across internal, customer-facing, and AI-assisted support channels.
  • Manage and optimise the Customer Care knowledge base platform, including Salesforce Knowledge, ensuring content governance, change requests, updates, approvals, and standards supporting AI-assisted support experiences are effectively administered and prioritised.
  • Analyse operational workflows, customer journeys, and knowledge content to identify inefficiencies, gaps, risks, inconsistencies, and opportunities to enhance customer experience, self-service effectiveness, operational efficiency, and scalable service delivery.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Customer Care and other business functions to gather requirements, align processes, and deliver continuous improvements across workflows, knowledge management practices, and supporting tools.
  • Champion knowledge management best practices, industry trends, and continuous improvement initiatives, and promote the adoption of knowledge base tools, content standards, and process improvements across Customer Care.
  • Ensure all operational guidance, policies, and process documentation are accurate, compliant, and regularly reviewed in alignment with legal, regulatory, and business requirements.
  • Lead and facilitate process review discussions, workshops, and stakeholder sessions to support operational alignment and improvement initiatives.
  • Utilise QM data, AI-driven insights, analytics, user feedback, and content performance metrics to improve knowledge structure, discoverability, content effectiveness, process usability, operational efficiency, and overall Customer Care and customer experience.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of Customer Care products, services, policies, systems, and operational processes to ensure knowledge content remains accurate and relevant.
  • Provide support to the Quality Manager as required for improvements across the Customer Care team.

Core Competencies

Experience

  • Proven background in knowledge management, process improvement, operational excellence, business process analysis, or similar roles within Customer Care, Customer Service, or Contact Centre environments.
  • Design, documentation, and optimisation of operational workflows, policies, process maps, and agent-facing guidance using formats such as written guidance, visual workflows, and quick-reference materials.
  • Identification of operational gaps, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement, with the ability to recommend and support effective solutions.
  • Management of knowledge management platforms, content governance processes, and knowledge base administration, including Salesforce Knowledge or similar systems.
  • Structuring and governance of knowledge content to support consistent experiences across agent, self-service, and AI-assisted support channels.
  • Collaboration with Global teams across Customer Care and other business functions to support operational alignment and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Utilisation of operational data, customer or user feedback, and performance trends to support decision-making, process optimisation, and content improvements.
  • Support of operational change, continuous improvement initiatives, and process optimisation activities.
  • Use of AI tools, analytics, or technology solutions to support knowledge management, operational efficiency, or process improvements.
  • Understanding of process improvement and continuous improvement methodologies, including familiarity with frameworks such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace with a solid command of its core features.

Skills & Behaviours

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance customer experience, operational efficiency, scalability, and business objectives when designing processes and knowledge solutions.
  • Excellent writing, editing, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate complex operational information into clear, structured, and user-friendly guidance for diverse audiences.
  • Strong capabilities in workflow, process design, and information architecture, creating logical, intuitive, and operationally effective experiences for Customer Care teams and customers.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify trends, gaps, risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Strong understanding of operational usability and agent experience, ensuring guidance is practical and effective within fast-paced customer service environments.
  • High attention to detail, ensuring accuracy, consistency, compliance, and reliability across operational processes and knowledge content.
  • Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills, working effectively across teams, functions, and seniority levels.
  • Leadership mindset with the ability to drive alignment, support operational change, champion continuous improvement initiatives, and challenge the status quo through a proactive and solutions-focused approach.
  • Data-driven mindset, confidently using analytics, AI tools, operational insights, and performance trends to inform recommendations and improve knowledge effectiveness, operational efficiency, and user experience.
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, effectively managing multiple projects and requests amid changing priorities.
  • Adaptable and collaborative team player, motivated by continuous learning and improving customer, agent, and business outcomes.
  • Schedule flexibility, with a willingness to work UK hours, ability to adapt to shifting timelines, and support during public holidays.

Customer Care Values 

  • Customer-Centric: We put the customer at the heart of everything we do, going above and beyond to deliver the gold-standard service our customers expect and deserve.
  • Collaborative: We believe in the power of individuals and teams working together across different roles and responsibilities in a respectful and open-minded way so that we can deliver the best customer outcomes.
  • Accountable: We act with integrity, whilst taking responsibility for our performance and personal growth, to ensure that we give our best to both customers and colleagues.
  • Resilient: We are adaptable, flexible and brave, maintaining a positive attitude during times of challenge and change, so that we can respond to the needs of our customers and the FT.
  • Effective: We are creative and productive whilst remaining focused on our goals with a results-driven approach so that we deliver the right outcomes for our customers and for the FT.

What’s in it for you? Our Benefits:

Our benefits vary depending on location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices as well as an inclusive environment to develop your career. Examples of our benefits include: generous annual leave, flexible working (including working from home), health coverage (medical & dental), company match and enhanced family leave packages. Full details of our benefits can be found here.

Further Information:

The FT is committed to providing an inclusive working environment for all. We are an equal opportunities employer who seeks to recruit and appoint the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion and/or belief. We also promote flexible working and will consider specific requests around flexibility for all roles where it can be accommodated. Please let us know if you require any adjustments as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, please contact a member of our HR team, who will be happy to help.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Specialist Titles
job.description:
Company & Department Context

The Financial Times (FT) is one of the world’s leading business news and information organizations. We are recognized globally for our authority, integrity and accuracy. We provide a broad range of essential services, including news, comment, data and analysis, to the growing audience of internationally minded business people.

We have offices in more than 35 cities, including London, New York, Hong Kong, Beijing, Manila, Sofia, San Francisco and Tokyo. Join us and find an inclusive and fast-paced environment with unique opportunities to support every step of your career.

Learn more about the FT, including announcements and career opportunities, at aboutus.ft.com and FT Specialist 

 

Position Summary 

This is an exciting opportunity for an engineer to join the FT Specialist group as part of the Product & Technology organisation within FT.

A key part of the business, providing significant revenue and contribution to the FT, is Specialist Titles. This is an exciting time for Specialist Titles as we are creating a large new cross functional product & technology team in Sofia to support the needs of this part of the business. FT Specialist is entering a new era. We have a golden opportunity to renew our technology estate, to use best practices and to build a modern sustainable technology stack that will underpin the success of the business for years to come.

FT Specialist brings together a portfolio of niche digital publications, including ones with more than 160 years of tradition.

  • Investors’ Chronicle

  • The Banker

  • FT Adviser

You will have the autonomy to select the tools and technologies you need to build and operate services responsible for FT Specialist brand critical capabilities. Someone who is comfortable with the ever changing technical landscape and is keen to contribute to the company’s processes and broader know-how would thrive in this role.

Working in the FT Specialist team you will be responsible for delivering innovative technical solutions as you build and operate world class platforms to grow the Financial Times strategic business models. 

We have recently published our Engineering Progression framework and associated competencies for a Software Engineer relevant to this position

 

The Tech Stack

We often use these, it's not an exhaustive list but gives you a taste of what our technology stack and tools look like:

  • JavaScript

  • React

  • GraphQL

  • Node.js

  • CircleCI

  • Cloudflare

  • AWS

This role will be right for you if you are happy to:

  • Application performance tuning and optimisation.

  • Understand the importance of diversity and equality in a well functioning team

  • Be able to communicate clearly and concisely

 

Desirable skills and experience 

  • An understanding of CDNs and the role they play is web application architecture. e.g.Cloudflare, Cloudfront, Akamai etc.

  • Instrumenting for observability and operability

  • Understand how to build and maintain APIs

  • How to design software to support easy scaling using a methodology like the 12 factor app

  • 25 days paid leave
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Enhanced Parental Leave policy

job.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (9 month parental leave cover)
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The Role

The Financial Times is looking for an experienced Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global Talent Acquisition team on a 9-month fixed-term contract.

This is a hands-on recruitment delivery role managing a varied and fast-moving portfolio of vacancies across the FT. Working across multiple business areas, including commercial, corporate support, GTM and technology. You will manage recruitment at a range of levels, including senior, specialist and business-critical appointments, while partnering with stakeholders across our global organisation.

You will take ownership of the full recruitment lifecycle, from initial role briefing and market assessment through sourcing, screening, interview management and offer. You will independently manage approximately 15–18 live requisitions at any one time, including the associated scheduling and candidate communication.

While the role will primarily support UK hiring, you will also recruit across other regions, particularly the US and APAC, according to business demand.

This is an opportunity for an experienced in-house recruiter who enjoys being close to recruitment delivery and can move confidently between different functions, levels and geographies, build credibility with senior stakeholders and personally drive searches through to successful appointments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently manage a portfolio of approximately 15–18 concurrent requisitions, taking ownership from initial briefing through to accepted offer.
  • Deliver recruitment across a broad range of functions adapting your approach to different roles and talent markets.
  • Manage recruitment across a range of levels, including senior, specialist and business-critical appointments.
  • Lead detailed role briefings with hiring managers to establish requirements, assessment criteria, recruitment strategy and realistic hiring timelines.
  • Write and optimise job adverts and determine appropriate attraction and sourcing strategies for each vacancy.
  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, direct headhunting, talent mapping, referrals and other appropriate channels.
  • Screen and assess candidates against agreed requirements and provide hiring managers with clear, evidence-based recommendations.
  • Design and manage effective interview and assessment processes in partnership with hiring managers.

  • Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and senior leaders, advising and constructively challenging recruitment strategy, candidate quality, market conditions, assessment and hiring decisions.
  • Provide clear updates on recruitment progress, pipeline health, risks and recommended actions, and lead structured interview wash-ups and selection discussions.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners and other People colleagues to understand priorities and anticipate recruitment requirements.
  • Manage recruitment across UK, US and APAC markets according to business needs, working effectively across different locations and time zones.
  • Develop proactive sourcing strategies and build strong and diverse pipelines for specialist and hard-to-fill vacancies.
  • Champion fair and inclusive recruitment practices and advise hiring managers on structured and inclusive assessment approaches.
  • Maintain accurate and timely recruitment data in Greenhouse and Workday, monitor pipelines and take proactive action to keep recruitment moving.
  • Use recruitment data and market insight to inform search strategies and stakeholder conversations.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Significant end-to-end talent acquisition experience, ideally within a complex, international organisation and/or fast-paced in-house recruitment environment.
  • Demonstrable experience independently managing a high-volume portfolio of concurrent vacancies while maintaining a strong candidate and stakeholder experience.
  • Broad recruitment experience across multiple functions, including GTM, commercial and corporate support. Technology recruitment experience is desirable. 
  • Experience recruiting at a range of levels, including senior and specialist appointments, with confidence partnering directly with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience managing recruitment across multiple countries or regions, ideally including exposure to UK, US and/or APAC hiring.
  • Strong direct sourcing and headhunting capability, including identifying and engaging passive candidates for difficult-to-fill roles.
  • Confidence managing recruitment independently from sourcing and screening through interview management, candidate communication and offer negotiation, without dedicated coordinator or sourcer support.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to advise, challenge and manage expectations constructively.
  • Excellent organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to maintain momentum across multiple competing recruitment processes.
  • Strong judgement and assessment skills, including the ability to understand unfamiliar roles and identify the capabilities required for success.
  • Experience applying inclusive recruitment practices and supporting fair, structured candidate assessment.
  • Confidence using recruitment data and market insight to inform hiring strategies and stakeholder conversations.
  • Experience using an Applicant Tracking System, ideally Greenhouse or similar. 
  • A proactive, pragmatic and delivery-focused approach, with the ability to work autonomously and remain effective in a fast-moving environment.

What's in it for You?

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

job.description:
About us

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

The role

The FT’s visual and data journalism team is looking for an experienced data journalist to cover US politics, economics and financial news. This is a full-time staff position.

The successful applicant will collaborate with US-based news editors and correspondents across North America as well as colleagues in London, Hong Kong and beyond. You’ll help us deliver compelling journalism on our core coverage areas of trade, economics and financial markets, as well as US electoral politics and campaign finance. 

You will have a record of working self-sufficiently, from story pitch to final product, and an interest in providing a global perspective for both US and overseas readers. You will also collaborate with the wider Visual & Data Journalism team, and reporters and editors from across the FT’s network who need support applying data-driven methods to their work. 

We are happy to consider candidates wishing to be based in Washington DC or New York City. External applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Occasional weekend/flexible working may be required as part of covering fast-moving news.

 

Essential skills

You will have a strong portfolio of work in data journalism, ideally focused on business, finance, economics or politics in North America. In addition, we are looking for:

  • Experience using data journalism or data science techniques to find and tell news stories
  • Confidence using R or Python for data sourcing (including web scraping, APIs and large databases), cleaning and analysis
  • Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to explain your quantitative analysis work simply to non-specialist audiences
  • A passion for continuously learning in order to keep your skills at the forefront of current practice
  • The ability to pitch, write and deliver original data driven stories

 

Desirable Skills

While this is not a graphics-production role, experience of using data visualisation effectively in reporting would be a distinct advantage. 

In addition, while we don’t expect you to have all of these skills, any of the following would be beneficial, so please mention them in your cover letter and résumé:

  • Training in statistics, data science or quantitative social science methods
  • Experience building, maintaining or working with pipelines for continuously acquiring and processing data
  • Experience applying data analysis in financial or business journalism
  • Knowledge of working collaboratively with others on coding projects using version control systems such as Git
  • Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator

This position is represented by the News Guild.

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. The role

The Financial Times is looking for an experienced journalist to join the New York bureau to cover law and the legal industry.

The beat has essentially two interlocking halves, one focusing on white collar crime and financial enforcement, and the other centered on the powerful law firms and larger-than-life characters operating in the world’s largest legal market.

The first half is rooted in the federal prosecutor’s offices in New York’s Southern and Eastern Districts, and the enforcement arms of the Securities and Exchange Commission and Commodity Futures Trading Commission. That means covering some of the US’s highest profile white collar cases – past examples include the investigations into First Brands’ Patrick James, Archegos’ Bill Hwang and FTX’s Sam Bankman-Fried. 

You will also collaborate directly with the US Justice correspondent and corporate beat reporters to cover top legal cases elsewhere in the country. That requires proficiency in developing relationships with both defence attorneys and prosecutors in New York and beyond.

Coverage of the legal industry means breaking news and writing about the top American lawyers and law firms who act as powerbrokers across business, finance and politics. Lawyers pop up as key donors and advisers on both sides of the political aisle and litigation – or the threat of it – is the constant companion of corporate activity, government regulation and the electoral process. 

The FT has been expanding its footprint in the US professional services sector at a time of significant change that is challenging the business models of the big law firms. Consolidation is accelerating, as are high-profile poaching raids. Private equity is eyeing a way into the profession. AI threatens to upend both training and billing norms, and some venerable firms are struggling while upstarts expand into new practice areas

 

Key responsibilities

  • Cover federal and New York authorities responsible for investigating and prosecuting financial and corporate malfeasance
  • Develop sources in the criminal defence bar and state and federal courts to break stories in core FT areas, including money laundering, insider trading and financial fraud
  • Work closely with Washington, London and corporate correspondents while cooperating within a distributed team to pursue big cases
  • Pick out unique angles on New York law firms and prominent lawyers for compelling reads on the legal community
  • Weekend shifts are required as part of the team rota

 

Who we are looking for

You will have a proven track record of breaking stories on news-heavy beats, and shown an ability to work well within a team. You will be expected to quickly parse complex legal documents and translate legal jargon to deliver clean copy and compelling narratives. Familiarity with the intricacies of international finance is preferred, given the frequently complicated cases brought by federal authorities.

job.title: US Summer Newsroom Intern
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading business news organisations, recognised internationally for its authority, integrity, and accuracy.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing. 

The FT has a record paying readership of 1.6 million, more than 1.4 million of which are digital subscriptions. It is part of Nikkei Inc., which provides a broad range of information, news, and services for the global business community. We have offices in more than 35 countries, including London, New York, Hong Kong, Beijing, Manila, Sofia, San Francisco, and Tokyo.

Our Internships

We are looking for passionate and motivated students who are interested in pursuing a career in media to join our team! We expect our interns to be in the office a minimum of three days a week. 

This program offers the opportunity to connect and collaborate across the FT — in the US and globally. You’ll develop ideas that help drive our growth, present your work to US leadership, and gain valuable insights from across the business. Plus, you’ll be paired with a dedicated Buddy to provide mentorship and support throughout your experience.

This internship pays $22 per hour for 40 hours per week and runs from June 7, 2027 - Aug 13, 2027. Before applying, please ensure you will be available on these dates.

Applicants must be authorised to work in the US.

Role Overview

The FT’s US newsroom internship offers aspiring journalists a front-row seat to the fast-paced world of global news. This is your chance to learn from and contribute to a dynamic multimedia newsroom that values curiosity, creativity, and sharp storytelling.

No two days are the same. From breaking stories and in-depth research to innovative digital projects, you’ll work alongside editors and reporters to bring ambitious journalism to life. We’re looking for versatile, driven interns who are eager to dig into stories that matter and help shape how the world understands the news.

Key responsibilities

  • Pitching, reporting, and writing original news stories
  • Conducting interviews and developing sources
  • Assisting senior correspondents with research, document analysis and reporting
  • Curating newsletters and contributing to digital projects
  • Collaborating with staffers on special projects

Required skills / experience

  • Proven interest in journalism
  • Some experience or knowledge of financial journalism, business, economics, or related areas
  • Curiosity about global markets, companies, and economies
  • Initiative to pitch and complete story ideas
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • Excellent research and analytical skills
  • Strong communication and writing skills across platforms
  • Sound news judgment and high ethical standards

Please submit your application by November 2nd by 5pm Eastern Time and be sure to include the following documents in your application:

  • Resume
  • A cover letter explaining why you would be a good fit, and explaining your interest in joining our team
  • Three writing samples or published clips

Any application submitted after the deadline will not be considered.

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. For this reason, FT editorial staff do not use AI tools to write articles or create reader-facing content.

AI may be used in specific, pre-approved cases to assist with research, such as in data investigations. We expect internship applicants to refrain from using AI in writing tests or written materials submitted during the application process. All submissions must reflect your own knowledge, skills, and experiences.

Candidates may use AI to assist with research and interview preparation. However, the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure fairness and transparency for all applicants.

Our commitment to a fair and inclusive workplace

At the FT, we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone has equal opportunity to succeed. We welcome and value different perspectives and strive to ensure all employees are heard and supported. We believe people do their best work when they can be themselves and have the flexibility they need to balance their work and personal lives. We are an equal opportunity employer and align with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination.

job.title: Associate Manager, Commerce
job.description:
FOX News Media is seeking a creative, organized, and highly motivated Manager, Commerce to support the development and execution of commerce content, brand partnerships, and product integrations across FOX Nes platforms.

This role will work closely with the Managing Editor, Commerce, serving as a key creative and operational partner in bringing commerce ideas to life. The Manager will help develop segment concepts, identify and communicate with relevant brands, coordinate products and samples, track deliverables, and ensure projects move smoothly from initial idea through execution.

The ideal candidate understands the intersection of editorial content, commerce, brand partnerships, and broadcast production. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment and managing multiple projects at once.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Support the development of commerce segments, seasonal content, product features, and integrated brand opportunities.
  • Research and identify relevant products, brands, retailers, and emerging trends for potential editorial and partnership opportunities.
  • Conduct brand outreach and maintain ongoing communication with brand representatives, agencies, and public relations contacts.
  • Help coordinate product samples, product information, pricing, links, assets, approvals, and other materials needed for segments and commerce content.
  • Manage project timelines, requests, feedback, deliverables, and follow-up across multiple initiatives.
  • Coordinate with editorial, production, digital, social, sales, legal, marketing, and affiliate teams to support seamless execution.
  • Assist with the development of pitches, presentations, segment briefs, talking points, and integration ideas.
  • Support on-air, digital, social, streaming, and affiliate commerce opportunities.
  • Help prepare products and materials for on-air appearances, shoots, demos, and live or taped segments.
  • Track brand participation, campaign details, content needs, deadlines, and post-segment follow-up.
  • Monitor commerce trends, consumer interests, seasonal moments, and timely opportunities for FOX audiences.
  • Contribute creative ideas for new commerce franchises, recurring segments, sponsorship opportunities, and brand integrations.
  • Attend meetings and represent the Commerce team with professionalism, organization, and strong follow-through.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • 3+ years of experience in commerce, brand partnerships, media, public relations, production, marketing, editorial, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of brands, products, consumer trends, and content development.
  • Excellent communication, writing, organization, and project-management skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with brands, agencies, internal teams, and external partners.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow projects through from concept to completion.
  • Comfortable working with product samples, digital assets, spreadsheets, presentations, and project-tracking tools.
  • Ability to think creatively while also managing the operational details required to execute a successful segment or partnership.
  • Experience with broadcast, digital media, affiliate content, social media, or on-air integrations is a plus.
  • Must be comfortable working in person in New York City and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

job.title: Associate Manager, Strategy Promo Planning
job.description:
The Associate Manager, Strategic Promo Planning (Digital) will support the planning and execution of promotional strategies for FOX Entertainment programming across FOX One, Hulu, Tubi, MVPD partners, and other digital and synergy platforms. This role will help translate FOX’s programming priorities into organized digital plans and ensure that assets, messaging, metadata, and partner support are delivered accurately and on time.

The Associate Manager will manage day-to-day coordination across digital and distribution partners, including promo trafficking, on-platform merchandising, CRM planning, asset approvals, partner communications, and support tracking. The role will work closely with the Strategic Promo Planning team and partners across Creative, Publicity, Legal, Platform Marketing, Distribution, and Performance & Insights. The Associate Manager, Strategic Promo Planning (Digital) will report to the Senior Manager, Strategic Promo Planning.

We are looking for a strategic-minded marketing professional with impeccable attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate takes initiative, communicates clearly, builds strong working relationships, and can take ownership of projects from planning through execution. They should be comfortable adjusting as priorities change while maintaining accuracy and a high level of organization.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the development and execution of digital and non-linear promotional plans across FOX One, Hulu, Tubi, VOD, MVPD partners, and synergy platforms
  • Coordinate promo trafficking, asset delivery, approvals, and partner support in collaboration with the team coordinator and internal stakeholders.
  • Plan and track synergy support across TMZ, Tubi, and News, including AV, banners, and pause ads
  • Support FOX Entertainment CRM planning and coordinate CRM opportunities with FOX One, Hulu, and other internal partners
  • Coordinate FOX One support, including short-form content, on-platform merchandising calendars, marketing updates, and title visibility
  • Coordinate Hulu support, including show page openings, promotional placements, Hulu Spotlight opportunities, key art delivery, marketing briefs, and upcoming slate presentations
  • Manage and update Tubi episode release schedules, monitor for discrepancies, and manage communication with Tubi counterparts
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for FOX Distribution and MVPD partners by sharing marketing updates, tracking support, coordinating asset approvals, and helping present upcoming programming priorities
  • Oversee the metadata library and legal lines in partnership with Publicity, Legal, and other internal teams
  • Keep trackers, calendars, planning documents, and status updates while monitoring deadlines, work orders, and deliverables
  • Provide campaign details and execution context to the team for performance reporting, post-campaign recaps, and future planning recommendations
  • Communicate plans, changes, deadlines, and follow-up needs clearly and contribute to a collaborative team environment

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 4+ years of experience in digital marketing, media planning, entertainment marketing, distribution, broadcast operations, or a related field
  • Experience working with digital platforms, streaming services, MVPDs, content partners, or other media and entertainment businesses
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external partners
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to keep information, assets, and schedules accurate
  • Comfort working with spreadsheets, trackers, calendars, presentations, and asset-management or cloud-based systems
  • Familiarity with streaming platforms, on-platform merchandising, CRM, digital promotion, or content operations
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adjust quickly in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

job.title: Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM)
job.description:
The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service.

Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise.

Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms.

At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM) to lead FOX One's subscriber acquisition strategy and paid media investment across Latin America. As FOX One expands its international footprint, this leader will play a critical role in developing and scaling regional growth strategies, driving efficient subscriber acquisition, and establishing a strong market presence across LATAM.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Acquisition Marketing, this role will serve as the primary strategic lead for LATAM acquisition marketing, overseeing multi-million-dollar media investments, agency partnerships, and regional campaign performance. The Director will collaborate closely with U.S.-based leadership and international marketing teams while providing dotted-line leadership to LATAM-based team members.

JOB TITLE: Executive Producer of Investigations

Vibe: Driven, strategic, organized, and obsessed with high-impact journalism across every platform.

The Mission FOX6 Milwaukee is looking for a detail-oriented, creative, high-caliber journalist to lead our investigative team and our Contact 6 consumer advocacy unit. We need an Executive Producer who can manage major investigative projects, oversee our investigative podcast, and reimagine how deep-dive stories reach modern audiences on streaming, digital, and broadcast.

This isn't a role spent sitting in an office waiting for project updates. We need a hands-on leader who is in the middle of our daily news operation—working alongside reporters and producers every day to bring investigative thinking, public records digging, and relentless follow-up into our everyday coverage. You'll lead with curiosity, courage, accountability, and empathy while coaching journalists to move beyond traditional package formats, guiding the team through complex ethical calls, and lifting the investigative standards across the entire newsroom.

Clear communication is essential in this position. Beyond being organized, you must proactively connect employees across all departments so everyone clearly understands available elements, expectations, and deadlines needed to deliver a seamless, high-quality product. 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and inspire seasoned investigative journalists to conceive, execute, and deliver multi-platform investigative projects and consumer advocacy coverage.
  • Work directly with daily news reporters and producers to bring an investigative lens, public records strategies, and deeper context into daily enterprise reporting.
  • Collaborate with news managers to build a high-trust newsroom culture through open communication and clear feedback.
  • Keep momentum going on major stories across all platforms.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on complex journalistic ethics, legal vetting, public records requests, and investigative standards.
  • Work across departments to drive new strategies for distributing investigative work beyond packageable content.

What You Bring

  • Proven track record producing or managing investigative journalism, enterprise reporting, or long-form investigative units.
  • Sharp project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple initiatives, keep cross-department teams aligned, and keep long-term investigations on schedule while staying involved in daily newsroom needs.
  • Ability to coach journalists past standard TV package formats into dynamic visual storytelling built for modern audiences.
  • Clear strategy for distributing investigative work across streaming, digital video, podcast, and social media platforms.
  • Strong command of legal standards, FOIA/public records laws, libel law, and ethical newsgathering techniques.
  • Experience using modern newsroom production software, with the adaptability to quickly master our station's specific workflow tools.

job.description:
We are looking for a Freelance Long-Form Editor to join the Fox Nation Post-Production Team. As a Freelance Long-Form Editor, you will be part of a collaborative effort to craft highly creative, narratively compelling, and technically sound content across multiple platforms. As an exceptionally adaptable storyteller, you will build projects from start to finish—diving deep into raw footage, shaping engaging narratives, designing graphics, finishing audio, and delivering polished, broadcast-ready long-form programming.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Craft Compelling Narratives: Edit and deliver distinctive, stylized long-form programming across diverse genres, specifically focusing on News, Politics, True Crime, Lifestyle, and Sports.
  • Master the Flow: Work collaboratively with producers to build strong story arcs, ensuring an exceptional sense of pace and narrative rhythm throughout the show.
  • Design Dynamic Graphics: Conceptualize, create, and integrate engaging motion graphics and visual elements to elevate the storytelling and overall production value.
  • Elevate with Audio: Serve as a key creative voice by expertly selecting, placing, and pacing music to maximize emotional impact and drive the story forward.
  • Maintain Quality Control: Act as the "last line of defense" on all audio and video requirements to ensure pristine, broadcast-quality final deliverables with no technical mistakes.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5-10 Years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of skills and demonstrated experience.
  • A proven track record and deep understanding of the News, Politics, True Crime, Lifestyle, and Sports genres. 
  • Extensive proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (specifically Premiere Pro, Media Encoder, After Effects, Audition, and Photoshop), including deep experience with collaborative production workflows in Premiere for multi-editor environments. 
  • Strong motion graphics skills, with a demonstrated ability to create polished, high-quality show graphics and visual treatments using Premiere, After Effects, and Photoshop.
  • An exceptional ear for picking and utilizing music, coupled with a masterful sense of pacing.
  • The ability to transform raw footage into captivating, dynamic long-form content that holds viewer attention from start to finish.
  • A sharp eye for detail and highly organized project management skills.
  • A creative, enthusiastic, and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Bonus: Experience editing and delivering long-form content for streaming platforms as well as proficiency with generative media creation tools (such as Adobe Firefly, or similar AI tools) is a plus.

To apply, please include your resume along with links to example work that specifically demonstrate your long-form editing and graphics experience.

job.title: Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting
job.description:
The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is an integral member of the Finance team supporting the Fox Digital & Technology organization. The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is responsible for the financial integrity and operational oversight of the Digital & Technology P&L, managing monthly and quarterly close processes to ensure accurate, timely, and complete financial reporting. In addition, this role serves as a key business partner to operational stakeholders and external suppliers across all purchasing and invoicing activities. The Manager oversees the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, collaborating cross-functionally to drive financial discipline, process efficiency, and strong internal controls. This position plays a critical role in validating financial results, including reconciliation of the full Balance Sheet and P&L, investigating variances, and ensuring reported results align with business expectations.

The Manager exercises strong independent judgment in resolving issues, demonstrates ownership, and consistently delivers high-quality, timely results without the need for constant supervision. Additionally, this role collaborates with the FP&A team during budget and forecast cycles to support planning activities and ensure alignment between actual results and forward-looking projections. This position reports directly to the Sr. Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting.
 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Month-End Close/General Accounting 

  • Manage monthly and quarterly close processes for the Operating Division, including oversight of third-party goods and services, proper expense codification, and accurate general ledger recording

  • Analyze actual spending results and review accrual journal entries to ensure completeness and accuracy of third-party costs across both the P&L and Balance Sheet

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on monthly financial results, clearly articulating drivers of spend, key variances, and accounting treatments to finance and operational stakeholders

  • Partner with operational leaders and the FP&A team to investigate expense fluctuations, provide variance explanations, and support reporting deliverables

  • Perform and validate monthly reconciliation of key Balance Sheet accounts to ensure reported financial results are accurate, supported, and compliant with internal controls

job.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead a high-volume Accounts Payable shared services function. This role is responsible for overseeing large-scale invoice processing and company-wide payment operations across multiple business units.

The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, ensure strong internal controls, and lead continuous process improvement initiatives. This role requires a hands-on leader with deep expertise in high-volume environments, AP systems, and scalable procure-to-pay operations.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing AP team in a shared services environment

  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and results-driven culture
  • Oversee end-to-end processing of high-volume invoice intake and payment execution across multiple payment methods

  • Oversee company-wide payment and settlement processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Manage throughput, backlog, and workload distribution to maintain operational efficiency

  • Identify and implement scalable process improvements across the procure-to-pay lifecycle

  • Maintain strong vendor relationships and resolve escalated invoice and payment issues

  • Drive supplier adoption of digital tools (e.g., Coupa Supplier Portal)
  • Define and track KPIs such as invoice cycle time, first-pass yield, exception rates, cost per invoice, and on-time payment performance
  • Provide data-driven insights and reporting to leadership

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • 7+ years of progressive Accounts Payable Manager experience
  • Experience driving process transformation and automation initiatives
  • Proven experience managing high-volume Accounts Payable operations in a shared services environment
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, Accounts Payable processes, and financial controls

job.title: Manager, Podcast Marketing
job.description:
Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

Red Seat Ventures partners with the world’s top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content through advertising, subscriptions, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our proprietary technology stack, including Supercast for subscriptions and Speakeasy for hosting, distribution, and monetization.

Named after Ted Williams’ longest home run at Fenway Park, Red Seat Ventures was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we are the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is looking for a Manager, Podcast Marketing to lead cross-promotional campaigns across our portfolio of nearly 70 podcasts while building relationships with external shows, creators, and platforms. Reporting to the Senior Director, Podcast Marketing, you will own campaigns from initial planning and creative development through ad operations, measurement, and reporting. You will translate campaign performance into clear insights that help senior leaders understand what worked and what we should do next.

This position sits within a growing Audience Development function with established systems and active campaigns already in place. The work is currently hands-on and high-volume as we continue to improve and automate our processes. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys owning complex systems, maintaining operational precision, and turning campaign data into a compelling and actionable story.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Book and manage in-network and out-of-network cross-promotional campaigns, including launches for new shows and always-on promotional rotations
  • Own campaign execution details, including flight dates, frequency caps, audience targeting, creative trafficking, and delivery
  • Build and deliver weekly and monthly reports on net-new listeners, conversion, and retention for senior leadership
  • Develop clear performance narratives and recommendations based on campaign data
  • Maintain consistent campaign naming conventions across booking, hosting, and measurement platforms so promotional activity can be accurately matched to results
  • Research and pitch podcasts and YouTube channels for promotional swaps, collaborations, and client guest appearances
  • Manage scheduling and promotional materials, including biographies and headshots, in partnership with client teams, host-show contacts, and Creator Partnerships
  • Maintain the programming calendar for editorial pitches to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, iHeart, and YouTube
  • Track upcoming show moments, platform requirements, and submission lead times to support timely and relevant editorial pitches
  • Help improve and automate campaign workflows, reporting processes, and other repetitive operational tasks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

job.title: Regional Streaming Director
job.description:
FOX Television Stations is growing its streaming operation, and the Florida region is a critical part of that growth. This role sits at the center of that effort — serving as the streaming authority for FOX Tampa (WTVT) and FOX Orlando (WOFL), responsible for building and evolving a high-performing local streaming operation across both markets.

Reporting to the News Director(s) at WTVT & WOFL, this position works in close partnership with FTS Streaming and weather leadership to align regional execution with broader FTS strategy and the Executive Producers of both FL stations. As the streaming team grows and the business evolves, so will this role — expanding in scope, team size, and responsibility. The right candidate is someone who is ready to grow with it.

This is a role for a streaming-first leader who understands where the industry is heading, knows how to bring a newsroom along on that journey, and has the editorial instincts, technical fluency, and analytical rigor to drive measurable growth across the full streaming universe — CTV, FAST channels, and social video.

A Snapshot of Your Responsibilities - Editorial & Content Leadership

  • Lead with a streaming-first mindset across both newsrooms, driving editorial vision, cultural adoption, and a commitment to continuous content improvement.
  • Make fast, sound editorial decisions in breaking news environments, balancing urgency with accuracy.
  • Manage and evolve streaming programming schedules across Tampa and Orlando, working toward expanded hours and a long-term 24/7 weather and streaming operation at both stations.
  • Elevate content quality at every level — from live breaking news to long-form storytelling — with an eye toward what works for a streaming-native audience.
  • Operate fluidly across digital and streaming, shaping content intentionally for each format and platform.

Team Development & Newsroom Adoption

  • Motivate, coach, and develop a team of streaming journalists and producers in Tampa, and support alignment with the Orlando & Tampa Executive Producers of Streaming.
  • Serve as the leading voice in both newsrooms for streaming adoption — building buy-in, growing participation, and helping teams evolve their workflows and mindset to support expanded streaming output.
  • Partner with the station and FTS Executive Director of Streaming to identify opportunities to grow the team and the operation over time.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Own streaming performance data and reporting for the FL region across all platforms — including FOX Local CTV, FAST channels, YouTube, social video, and weather.
  • Produce regular growth reports for both stations, surfacing trends, opportunities, and areas that need attention.
  • Use real-time and historical data to inform editorial decisions, optimize audience engagement, and support the case for expanded resources and investment in the region.
  • Provide regular performance and strategy updates to FTS Streaming leadership to ensure regional activity is visible and aligned with company goals.

Technology & Distribution

  • Master and expand the use of TriCaster and all streaming production technology across both markets.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the full streaming distribution landscape — CTV, FAST channels, and social video — and ensure both stations are operating effectively across all surfaces.
  • Prioritize the CTV viewer experience: ensure content is surfaced intentionally, programming decisions are made with audience growth in mind, and both stations are actively working to drive viewers toward longer-form, high-value content.
  • Stay attuned to how platforms, discovery mechanisms, and viewer habits are shifting, and bring that awareness into day-to-day and long-term planning.

Strategy & Industry Awareness

  • Serve as the regional expert on streaming industry trends — platform evolution, audience behavior, competitive landscape, and emerging opportunities.
  • Develop and execute short- and long-term streaming growth strategies for the FL region, aligned with FTS goals and built to adapt as the industry and business change.
  • Collaborate across FOX and with external content partners, contributors, and creators to expand live coverage opportunities.

What You Will Need

  • 5+ years in a digital or broadcast news leadership role; live streaming or CTV experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the full streaming landscape: CTV, FAST channels, OTT platforms, social video, and mobile apps.
  • Proven ability to lead teams through high-stakes breaking news and live events.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience building and presenting performance reports across multiple streaming platforms and distribution surfaces.
  • Deep understanding of CTV user experience and content distribution strategy, with a viewer-first approach to programming and platform decisions.
  • Proficiency with streaming production technology; TriCaster experience strongly preferred.
  • A streaming-first editorial mindset with the ability to work fluidly across digital, and streaming formats.
  • Current knowledge of streaming industry trends, audience behavior shifts, and platform evolutions.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive newsroom culture change and build enthusiasm for streaming at all levels.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, weekends, and holidays as news demands.
