job.title: Senior Payroll Tax Analyst
job.description:
As a Senior Payroll Tax Analyst, you will be responsible for payroll tax reporting, compliance, liabilities, and the filing of associated employment tax returns for multiple FEINS in multiple states.  You will also ensure the integrity of employee wage and tax data reported on employees’ Form W-2.

You will drive efficiencies through creative problem-solving and analysis as you work with large volumes of complex data to draw conclusions that identify process improvements and automations, improving accurate and timely tax payments and filings.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of all monthly, quarterly, and annual tax filings, amendments, and reporting including employee W-2s and W-2c’s
  • Reconcile all tax and wage amounts for multiple legal entities monthly, quarterly, and annually between the payroll system and third-party tax service including reconciliation of W-2s to payroll tax reports and the quarterly 941 returns to W-2 totals. Research and correct any discrepancies
  • Analyze payroll tax issues and provide recommendations for solutions relating, but not limited to employee mobility, reciprocal taxation, stock taxation and reporting, inpats and expats, employer-provided fringe benefits and local taxation
  • Review and reconcile all daily tax and wage amounts submitted to third-party tax services and research any discrepancies and handle accordingly
  • Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual reconciliations of gross earnings to taxable wages to validate accuracy of taxable wages
  • Submit tax notices and facilitate resolutions in coordination with third-party tax vendors timely to avoid penalties and interest; research and determine the root cause, and work with the appropriate parties to take action to prevent future issues
  • Provide excellent customer service in researching and responding to payroll tax-related inquiries from employees, agencies, and other internal/external parties
  • Research all W-2 correction inquiries, complete and submit all W-2c’s for review and approval, and distribute W-2c through appropriate channel
  • Review all Workday tax updates and test accordingly, and communicate key changes to the Payroll team and HR as necessary
  • Partner with the Payroll team to ensure state and local taxes are set up correctly for employees, particularly for employees who live and work in different states
  • Maintain unemployment tax rates and communicate changes to third-party tax services
  • Apply and register for new state SUI and withholding tax accounts for new locations, FEINS, as needed
  • Prepare various tax returns and reporting not filed by third-party tax services, including other required government reporting
  • Review third-party sick pay and ensure appropriate reporting
  • Collaborate with the Manager to enhance, streamline, and document payroll tax processes
  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state, and local tax regulations, including taxation of fringe benefits, by studying existing and new legislation and ensure compliance and advise management on needed actions


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of experience and education
  • FPC or CPP certification strongly preferred
  • 5+ years of relevant work experience servicing a large volume of employees (including a remote workforce) in a multi-state, multi-entity organization
  • Comprehensive knowledge of federal, multi-state, and local wage and hour and tax regulations
  • Strong working knowledge of taxation of fringe benefits and long-term equity incentive instruments (RSUs, NQ Stock Options, etc.)
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail with high service orientation, integrity, discretion, and ownership of work with the ability to work independently
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, be self-motivated, and piece together facts and data necessary to identify issues, propose resolutions, make decisions, and operationalize necessary changes to improve taxes and service delivery
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Intermediate to advanced analytical skillset, including the use of Excel V-Lookup and Pivot Tables and/or other tools
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
  • Able to handle confidential information and issues effectively and without breach of confidentiality


NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience with Workday and ADP systems
  • Experience with inpats and expats
  • Experience with international payroll (UK, EU, Israel)

job.title: Senior Union Payroll Associate
job.description:
The Senior Union Payroll Associate performs a variety of functions necessary for the accurate and timely processing of multi-state, multi-company, weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees. The Senior Union Payroll Associate coordinates, validates, and implements work procedures that require comprehensive operational knowledge of union collective bargaining agreements and federal and state regulations related to wage garnishment, taxation and wage‐hour law.


While there are no direct people responsibilities, the Senior Union Payroll Associate will coordinate independently with other associates, leaders, and teams outside of Payroll Shared Services to accomplish tasks, meet deadlines, champion process improvement initiatives, and enhance the employee experience.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform all duties necessary to ensure timely and accurate processing of multi-state, multi-company weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees in accordance with collective bargaining agreements and other contracts and in compliance with applicable FOX policies and federal, state, and local regulations
  • Process on demand payments, retroactive payments, one-time payments, tax adjustments, stop payments, void checks, direct deposit reversals, and overpayment collections in accordance with FOX policies, collective bargaining agreements, and in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations
  • Interpret and set up withholding orders for levies, garnishments, child support, and other involuntary wage assignment orders in the payroll system within the regulated period
  • Understand union pay and paid time off rules and the timekeeping system and address employee questions as needed
  • Provide testing support during the implementation of the new timekeeping system and assist with team training
  • Perform detailed pre-payroll processing audits of earnings, deductions, benefits, garnishments, and tax setups to prevent pay-impacting errors when payroll is processed
  • Audit and reconcile union-related inputs, including union dues, initiation fees, and retirement contributions, to ensure accuracy and strict adherence to collective bargaining agreements
  • Understand proper taxation of all employee payments, including employer paid union benefits, and address employee questions as needed
  • Review, test, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) regularly to ensure operational accuracy, compliance, and continuous process efficiency
  • Provide subject matter expertise on union timekeeping rules and processes, to include paid time off plans. This requires the ability to interpret rules outlined in collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) and other union related documents
  • Assist employees and management with questions, concerns, or requests regarding union payroll. This includes properly applying technical knowledge and skills, communicating, and listening effectively
  • Serve as a go-to expert for union payroll questions, managing the timely resolution of customer issues, including handling customer escalations, performing and documenting Root Cause Analysis, and implementing remedial procedures to close gaps identified
  • Ensure compliance with all company policies, internal controls, and SOX controls

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 4+ years hands-on union payroll processing experience, preferably with IBEW, IATSE, AFTRA, and/or NABET collective bargaining agreements
  • Experience with interpreting and setting up withholding orders for levies, garnishments, child support, and other involuntary wage assignment orders
  • Experience and knowledge of automated time and attendance systems
  • Experience with initiating and leading standardization and process improvement initiatives
  • Strong working knowledge of FLSA, federal, state, and local wage and hour and tax regulations. 
  • Ability to interpret collective bargaining agreements for pay and paid time off rules.
  • Strong interpersonal skills – you are approachable, responsive, and team focused
  • Intermediate Excel using VLOOKUP and pivots.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Excellent judgment, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High degree of professionalism and solid ability in delivering high quality customer service and establishing/maintaining effective and collaborative working relationships

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation
  • Experience with Workday Payroll

job.title: Sr. Manager, Ad Sales Engagement & Events
job.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Senior Events Manager to support the Ad Sales Engagement & Events team. Reporting to the Director, Ad Sales Engagement & Events, this role is responsible for planning and executing a range of events that support the sales organization, including bespoke client experiences, internal engagement initiatives, and on-site event execution.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is detail-oriented, and can manage multiple projects simultaneously while delivering high-quality experiences for both clients and internal stakeholders.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Plan and execute bespoke client events that support ad sales relationships and business development efforts
  • Manage end-to-end event logistics, including venue sourcing, vendor management, catering, production, hotel block management, transportation, and overall guest experience
  • Own all event communications and documentation, including attendee tracking, rooming lists, travel manifests, and activity selections with a high degree of accuracy
  • Oversee the development and approval of event communications (Save-the-Dates, invitations, RSVP materials, event branding collateral) in partnership with internal design teams
  • Develop and manage event budgets from inception through reconciliation, including expense authorizations, real-time tracking, and coordination with Finance
  • Manage vendor relationships, including onboarding, contracting, and invoice processing via Coupa
  • Lead internal engagement events such as team gatherings, leadership meetings, and employee experiences
  • Provide on-site event management, ensuring seamless execution from setup through breakdown
  • Partner closely with Ad Sales leads, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to align events with business objectives
  • Develop and maintain timelines, run-of-show documents, and all event-related communications
  • Proactively troubleshoot and resolve issues in real time to ensure a high-quality attendee experience
  • Manage premium/merchandising programs, including concept development, sourcing, packaging, shipping, inventory tracking, and recipient management
  • Maintain key sales resources, including event calendars, inventory trackers, and client program materials
  • Create and maintain detailed event dossiers for each Ad Sales hospitality program
  • Support internal Ad Sales events, including charitable initiatives, team-building activities, and recognition programs
  • Partner with team coordinators to ensure timely and accurate reconciliation of all event expenses

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Extensive experience in corporate event planning a must (media experience preferred)
  • Proven experience managing client-facing events and corporate programs
  • Strong vendor relationships and negotiation skills
  • Demonstrated experience managing budgets and financial processes
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple events simultaneously
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience working with VIPs, C-level executives, and high-profile clients
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure and problem-solve in real time
  • Highly detail-oriented with excellent time management and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • High level of professionalism and strong interpersonal skills
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, and travel as needed
  • This role supports a dynamic event calendar and is not a traditional 9–5 position
  • Availability and responsiveness during active events and after-hours are required
  • Evening and extended hours will be necessary based on event schedules
  • Flexibility and a solutions-oriented mindset are essential

job.title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

Position Overview

The Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations bridges the gap between sales strategy, technology, and data analytics. You will eliminate friction in the sales cycle by optimizing our revenue, building robust forecasting models, and maximizing inventory yield. This role is highly cross-functional, requiring close collaboration with Sales Leadership, Finance, and Account Executives (AEs) to align sales performance with our overarching financial targets.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Technology & Infrastructure

  • Optimize Systems & Maintain Data Integrity: Act as the system administrator to ensure clean data entry, accurate tracking, and seamless integration between platforms.
  • Automate Workflows: Design and deploy automated processes to reduce administrative tasks for the sales team.
  • Maintain and refine Account Executive (AE) coverage lists.

Forecasting & Pipeline Management

  • Build Models: Develop data-driven revenue forecasting models to provide executive leadership with predictable, forward-looking insights.
  • Sales Planning: Connect sales goals to pipeline, historical performance, product opportunity and forecast assumptions. 
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal stage to anticipate shifts in ad spend and market demand.
  • Guide Strategy: Turn pipeline data into actionable insights that help sales teams proactively address gaps in the revenue funnel.Investigate questions that are not readily answered by existing reports, distinguish signal from noise, and analyze performance by product, show, AE, account, advertiser, and campaign. Turn findings into decisions and follow-through.

Go-To-Market (GTM) Data & Analytics

  • Unified Dashboards: Build holistic reporting structures tracking performance by product (Video, YouTube, Audio, Direct Network, Programmatic). Also provide AEs and Leadership with customized reporting, dashboard and account spend analysis.
  • AE Specific Reporting: Create centralized dashboards for individual AEs to track weekly closed revenue and pipeline metrics, serving as the champion of the CRM.
  • Deep-Dive Analytics: Conduct revenue analysis, track year-over-year (YOY) account growth/declines, identify non-returning quarterly revenue, etc.
  • Business Planning: Formulate annual and year-end AE business plans using historical performance data to help FY planning in top down and bottoms up formats.
  • Build the capability to scale: Partner across departments to ensure processes, reporting, and technology support commercial decision-making. Help automate recurring analysis and establish repeatable practices as Red Seat Ventures grows.
  • Identify growth opportunities: Use client, advertiser, market, product, and pipeline data to identify untapped accounts, categories, agencies, products, and distribution opportunities. Develop options for where Sales could focus and how existing relationships could grow.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience: 5-7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Commercial Finance, ideally within media, digital advertising, or SaaS.
  • Analytical Skills: Mastery of Excel/Google Sheets and data visualization tools to synthesize messy data sets into clean, executive-ready charts.
  • Agility: Can answer ambiguous business questions and  work with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to turn analysis into action.

Preferred Skills

  • Industry Context: Deep understanding of the advertising sales industry and accounts lists; including the advertising ecosystem, specifically Podcasting, YouTube and Social.
  • Commercial Decision Influence: Experience with using data to influence sales planning, account prioritization, pricing, packaging, ratecards, yield, and revenue planning.
  • Communication: Ability to explain complex data trends to non-technical sales reps and executives alike.
  • CRM Expertise: Advanced, hands-on administration experience with Salesforce (building dashboards, custom objects, and reports).

job.title: Streaming Associate Producer
job.description:
FOX 13 Tampa Bay/WTVT is seeking a Streaming Associate Producer to support daily streaming coverage and help maintain a consistent, engaging viewer experience across FOX LOCAL and our digital platforms. This role will help produce weekend streaming coverage alongside the weekend host while spending the remaining weekdays supporting live coverage, identifying and booking timely newsmakers, preparing interviews, and helping the streaming team respond quickly to breaking news and developing stories across the Tampa Bay area.

This is a hands-on role for a journalist who understands how audiences consume news across streaming, digital, social, and linear platforms. The ideal candidate is a strong writer and creative thinker with solid news judgment who can move quickly, contribute ideas, and help build compelling coverage that informs and serves Tampa Bay audiences.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

●     Support the development and production of live and on-demand streaming content for FOX 13 Tampa Bay and FOX LOCAL.

●     Help produce weekend streaming programming, including rundowns, segments, interviews, video, graphics, and other production elements.

●     Identify timely Tampa Bay stories, newsmakers, and guests who can add context and perspective to live coverage.

●     Research, pitch, and book guests for live interviews and streaming segments.

●     Prepare interview research, questions, background materials, and supporting visual elements.

●     Monitor breaking news and developing stories and help the streaming team quickly build and update live coverage.

●     Write clear, compelling, and accurate copy for streaming, digital, social, and linear platforms.

●     Select and organize video, soundbites, graphics, maps, user-generated content, and other visual elements for assigned stories and segments.

●     Write copy that effectively complements video, sound, and other visual elements.

●     Proofread and edit streaming, broadcast, and digital copy for accuracy, grammar, spelling, and editorial standards.

●     Track developing stories and provide timely updates as new information becomes available.

●     Proactively research and gather the information, video, graphics, and other materials needed to complete assigned stories.

●     Work with reporters, photographers, editors, producers, and field teams to coordinate video, graphics, logistics, and other production needs.

●     Assist with live-streaming production and help ensure streams run smoothly and accurately.

●     Organize, write, and edit stories for streaming, newscasts, digital, and social platforms as assigned by Producers and/or the Executive Producer.

●     Contribute ideas for conversational segments, interviews, and new streaming formats.

●     Build productive relationships with newsroom leadership and colleagues to strengthen content development and production.

●     Maintain a strong commitment to journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, and community service.

●     Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

●     A Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, broadcasting, digital media, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

●     2+ years of experience in news production, digital journalism, streaming, or a related newsroom role.

●     Strong writing, editing, research, and storytelling skills.

●     Strong news judgment and a commitment to factual accuracy.

●     Experience writing and producing content for digital, streaming, broadcast, or social platforms.

●     Ability to identify compelling stories, guests, and angles for live and on-demand coverage.

●     Ability to work quickly and accurately during breaking news and developing stories.

●     Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments under tight deadlines.

●     Familiarity with video, graphics, digital publishing, and social media workflows.

●     Ability to quickly learn and effectively use newsroom, editing, publishing, and production software systems.

●     Ability to collaborate effectively with producers, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and digital teams.

●     Ability to respond well to direction, feedback, and changing editorial priorities.

●     Dependability, professionalism, and a willingness to work a flexible schedule.

●     Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced newsroom and live-production environment.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

●     Experience producing or assisting with live newscasts, streams, or digital programming.

●     Experience researching and booking guests or newsmakers for live interviews.

●     Experience preparing interview questions, research, and supporting materials.

●     Experience with FOX LOCAL, CTV, OTT, or other digital video platforms.

●     Experience creating graphics, maps, and other visual elements for news coverage.

●     Experience with newsroom rundown, content-management, video-editing, graphics, and social-publishing tools.

●     Experience producing short-form or vertical video for social platforms.

●     Experience monitoring audience engagement or content-performance analytics.

●     Experience working in a fast-paced local newsroom.

●     Knowledge of Tampa Bay news, communities, weather, politics, public safety, culture, and other issues important to local audiences.

job.title: Streaming Executive Producer
job.description:
Do you understand how audiences consume news today — on their phones, through streaming apps, social feeds, and connected TVs? Are you driven to create storytelling that meets viewers wherever they are? If you’re ready to help reinvent how local news connects with a digital-first audience, FOX 35 Orlando wants to hear from you.

As Executive Producer, Streaming, you’ll lead the expansion of streaming content across PM and weekend hours, providing dedicated leadership for these growing dayparts. You’ll collaborate with anchors, reporters, producers, and digital journalists to develop focused, live programming built for the way people watch now — live, on demand, and on every screen. This includes developing live debate formats, newsmaker interviews, interactive viewer segments, and other original programming during hours when live event feeds may not be readily available.

This is an off-camera leadership position focused on programming, production, and strategy rather than hosting. You’ll serve as a key owner of the station’s CTV experience, ensuring FOX LOCAL programming, content shelves, live coverage, and sponsorship opportunities are updated, strategically positioned, and aligned with what audiences want to watch. Your leadership will help FOX 35 expand its streaming presence across multiple dayparts while creating a consistent, engaging experience for viewers across Central Florida.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

●      Lead Daypart Expansion: Oversee and develop streaming content specifically for PM and weekend hours, building a clear programming strategy for these dayparts.

●      Develop Original Live Programming: Create focused programming such as live debates, newsmaker interviews, interactive viewer segments, and other formats designed specifically for streaming audiences.

●      Own the CTV Experience: Oversee the station’s CTV presence, ensuring FOX LOCAL programming, content shelves, and live offerings are current, relevant, and positioned around viewer interests.

●      Champion Innovation: Drive the evolution of local news for streaming, FAST channels, CTV, and social platforms.

●      Collaborate Across the Newsroom: Partner with teams across the newsroom to produce live coverage, original features, breaking news, and special programming tailored for streaming and digital audiences.

●      Shape the Strategy: Develop a forward-thinking content approach that blends live, on-demand, and social-first storytelling across multiple dayparts.

●      Drive Audience Interaction: Develop programming that encourages real-time viewer participation and creates opportunities for audiences to actively engage with live content.

●      Enhance Viewer Experience: Experiment with new formats and technologies to deliver visually engaging, high-impact news experiences.

●      Use Data to Drive Decisions: Analyze performance metrics and audience behavior to inform programming, placement, and content decisions and grow engagement.

●      Support Revenue Opportunities: Collaborate with appropriate teams to identify and support sponsorship opportunities within streaming programming while maintaining editorial standards.

●      Elevate the Brand: Ensure content reflects high editorial and production standards across digital and streaming platforms.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

●      A bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

●      Proven experience producing or leading content for streaming, digital, or social platforms.

●      Leadership experience developing programming, managing content strategy, or overseeing newsroom production.

●      Strong editorial judgment and the ability to make fast, accurate decisions in a live news environment.

●      A deep understanding of how audiences engage with news across platforms — from connected TVs to mobile and social.

●      Experience with live-streaming technology and a willingness to learn, teach, and innovate.

●      The ability to develop original programming concepts and turn them into repeatable live formats.

●      The ability to inspire collaboration, influence change, and lead teams toward a shared vision.

●      A creative mindset, an experimental spirit, and a passion for elevating local news storytelling.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

●      Prior experience as an Executive Producer, including management experience.

●      Local News Expertise: Experience working in a fast-paced local newsroom and a strong understanding of how to identify, prioritize, and tell stories that matter to the community.

●      Streaming Programming Expertise: Experience developing live, scheduled, or recurring streaming programming beyond traditional simulcasts and breaking-news feeds.

●      CTV & FOX LOCAL Experience: Understanding of CTV and streaming programming, including content organization, programming shelves, live content placement, and the overall viewer experience.

●      Digital Platform Fluency: Proficiency with digital content management systems (CMS) and live-streaming technology, with the ability to publish and optimize content across multiple platforms.

job.title: Streaming Line Producer
job.description:
Streaming Line Producer

FOX Television Stations – FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 PLUS

The Opportunity

FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 Plus is seeking a sharp, creative, and decisive Streaming Line Producer to lead compelling live coverage across linear television and digital streaming platforms. Reporting to the Executive Producer, you’ll shape rundowns as stories develop, make real-time editorial decisions, and help drive the future of local streaming news.

Bring strong news judgment, crisp writing, control-room confidence, and a digital-first mindset. You’ll use video, sound, graphics, live elements, social platforms, and audience insights to make coverage immediate, useful, and engaging wherever viewers watch.

What You’ll Do

• Lead live coverage and editorial execution. Write, stack, time, and line produce structured newscasts and continuous coverage for linear and streaming platforms; adjust rundowns as news develops; guide breaking-news coverage from the control room; manage multiple live elements; and direct anchors, reporters, field crews, and production teams.

• Create streaming-first, multiplatform content. Develop live streams, explainers, interviews, and presentation elements for digital audiences and the station’s broader content strategy; write broadcast and digital copy; log, clip, and edit video; coordinate graphics; produce interviews and digital video packages; and repurpose content before, during, and after live broadcasts.

• Grow reach through smart distribution and insights. Optimize and distribute video and live content across station digital products and YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram, tailoring presentation to each platform and its audience. Monitor real-time metrics, social feeds, and regional news trends to inform live coverage, story placement, follow-up content, and streaming priorities.

• Collaborate across the newsroom. Partner with anchors, reporters, writers, digital producers, video editors, assignment teams, and production staff to deliver cohesive, accurate, high-quality journalism across platforms.

• Use evolving newsroom technology. Work confidently with iNews, live streaming tools, control room automation, digital video editing and publishing tools, audience analytics platforms, Outlook, and Workday, while adapting as station technology evolves.

What You Bring

• Experience. Two to four years as a news producer, line producer, or in a similar role in a medium-to-large broadcast newsroom; live streaming or digital-first news production experience is strongly preferred.

• Editorial and live-production strength. Strong news judgment, AP-style writing, and demonstrated control-room leadership, with the ability to manage breaking news, multiple live elements, and intense deadlines. Working knowledge of broadcast law, FCC regulations, journalistic standards, and editorial best practices.

• Multiplatform expertise. A strong understanding of multiplatform storytelling, social media strategy, digital video distribution, and audience engagement.

• Technology fluency. Experience with linear rundown software, live streaming production tools, control room automation, digital video editing and publishing workflows, and audience analytics, plus the ability to learn evolving systems quickly.

• Education and leadership. A bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, along with clear professional communication, strong collaboration, sound decision-making, and the composure to lead effectively in fast-moving live-news situations.

Additional Information

Benefits

• Comprehensive package. Excellent health benefits, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match.

• Lifestyle perks. Access to an onsite fitness center, vibrant local dining, and shopping options.

Work Schedule & Adaptability

FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 Plus is a 24/7 news operation. This position supports the morning show and requires overnight hours. This role requires flexibility to work varied hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, breaking news, and special events. Extended shifts may be required during severe weather, major news events, or emergencies to support continuous coverage across linear and streaming platforms.

Ready to combine strong line-producing discipline with the creativity and speed of digital-first journalism? Apply today and help FOX 5 DC deliver meaningful live coverage across every screen.

job.title: Streaming News Producer
job.description:

This role is centered on live streaming, social video, and platform-native storytelling. You will be responsible for producing, managing, and optimizing live and on-demand content across FOX LOCAL and major social platforms, ensuring coverage is fast, accurate, visually compelling, and technically sound.

Reporting to the Streaming Executive Producer, the ideal candidate is fluent in the mechanics of streaming production and social/digital distribution, CTV, and understands how audiences consume news outside of linear TV with a balance of speed, quality, and journalistic integrity. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in a live environment and wants to build the future of local news.

Does This Sound Like You?

You are digitally native, technically confident, and calm under pressure. You understand streaming workflows, live video production, and best practices for digital and social platforms. You have strong news judgment, pay close attention to detail, and can make smart editorial and technical decisions quickly. You enjoy collaborating across teams, experimenting with new formats, and using data to improve performance. You want to create content that reaches audiences where they are and keeps them coming back.

Responsibilities

  • Produce and manage live streaming coverage of breaking news, live events, press conferences, and original programming for FOX LOCAL and social platforms.
  • Operate and oversee streaming production tools, including live switching, encoding, clipping, publishing, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Create platform-native digital and social video content, including live clips, short-form video, graphics, and text-based storytelling optimized for mobile & CTV consumption.
  • Distribute and optimize content across the FOX Local app, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, and emerging platforms with an emphasis on audience growth and engagement.
  • Collaborate with newsroom, digital, social, and production/engineering teams to align coverage, workflows, and priorities across platforms.
  • Monitor real-time analytics, audience behavior, and trending topics to inform editorial and production decisions before, during, and after live streams.
  • Ensure all content meets journalistic standards, legal requirements, and FOX group guidelines for quality, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Participate in ongoing testing and refinement of streaming formats, tools, and workflows.
  • Assist in the planning, production and publication of regular podcasts on both VOD and audio platforms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.



Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, ideally in Journalism, Communications, Media Production, TV/Film production, or a related field with a digital focus.
  • 3 or more years of experience producing digital video, live streams, or social-first news content; newsroom experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong technical proficiency with live streaming workflows, including video switching, live publishing, clipping, and distribution.
  • Hands-on experience with video editing tools and production software, Adobe Creative Suite experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated understanding of social media platforms, video formats, and audience behavior across digital ecosystems.
  • Experience using analytics tools to measure performance and adjust content strategy in real time.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, writing skills, and attention to detail in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
  • Flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and non-traditional hours as news demands.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

●     Experience creating short-form vertical video for social platforms.

●     Familiarity with video-editing, graphics, rundown, content-management, and social-publishing tools.

Working conditions

Physical requirements

job.title: Summer 2027 FOX Corporation Internship Program - Studio ID - Los Angeles, CA
job.description:
The Studio ID Intern will play a vital role in supporting our physical security operations by executing detailed procedures for badge and access management, as outlined in department guidelines. This position offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in security operations within a dynamic studio environment.

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree during the length of the program
  • Current class standing of sophomore, (second-year college student) or above
  • Strong academic record
  • Committed and available to work for the entire length of the program
  • Access to own housing and transportation to/from the assigned internship site
  • Must be able to work on-site in Los Angeles, CA

STUDENTS SELECTED TO MOVE FORWARD IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS:

  • Must demonstrate knowledge of the company and media industry

STUDENTS ACCEPTED INTO THE SUMMER 2027 PROGRAM:

  • Are required to provide a copy of an unofficial transcript or letter from the adviser/registrar showing proof of enrollment and GPA

TO APPLY:

  • Submit a 1-page resume (PDF preferred)
  • Submit a cover letter (PDF Preferred)
  • Explain why your background and experience make you a good fit for our program

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Badge and Access Management: Execute detailed procedures for managing badge requests and access levels, ensuring compliance with department guidelines.
  • Profile Management: Manage staff profiles and production details within the access control system, ensuring profiles use legal names, unique email addresses, and accurately reflect production activation/expiration dates.
  • Badge Request Processing: Process all badge requests submitted through the Studio ID Portal, meticulously validating photo submissions to ensure they meet mandated requirements, such as being in JPEG format, showing the cardholder only, and featuring a blank or non-distracting background.
  • System Setup and Configuration: Perform initial badge setup in the Lenel system, configure base and group access levels, manage access activation and end dates, and follow protocols for restricted access levels.
  • Deactivation Procedures: Execute comprehensive deactivation procedures, ensuring badges are assigned the correct status (e.g., "Lost," "Non-Op/Broken," "Returned," or "Inactive").
  • Administrative Support: Manage administrative tasks, ensuring all input data is correct and validated. Assist with the activation and deactivation of badge credentials, ensuring these processes are completed accurately and in accordance with outlined procedures.

SUMMER 2027 SCHEDULE:

General Application Deadline: Sunday, January 10, 2027

Summer Session 1: Monday, June 7, 2027 - Friday, July 30, 2027
Summer Session 2: Monday, June 21, 2027 - Friday, August 13, 2027

Scheduled Weekly Hours: 32 - 40 hours per week 

NOTE: Schedules vary based on department needs and your availability. We do our best to work around your class schedule.

STANDING OUT AS A TOP CANDIDATE:

  • Currently pursuing a degree or career in Criminal Justice, Information Technology, Business Administration, Security Management, Management Information Systems (MIS), Communications, or Public Administration is preferred 
  • Familiarity with access control systems and security protocols is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow complex procedures
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook)

PROGRAM FEATURES:

FOX Master Classes: A variety of presentations, panels, discussions, and trainings geared toward advancing your knowledge of our company, industry, and software systems

Professional Development Series: A variety of activities geared toward enhancing your professional development

Networking Opportunities: Numerous opportunities to connect with fellow interns and other professionals within the company

#EntryLevel #EarlyCareer

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review corporate and partnership federal, state, and local income tax returns in accordance with relevant tax laws and regulations

  • Review quarterly estimated tax payments and tax return extensions, including monitoring payment deadlines

  • Review interim and year-end tax provisions with a focus on current taxable income calculation and validation of deferred balances in accordance with ASC 740

  • Develop an understanding of business operations

  • Assist with responses to tax notices, including corresponding with taxing authorities to resolve inquiries and disputes

  • Day-to-day management of tax team members and/or consultants on assigned projects

  • Provide tax support to other corporate and operating groups

  • Assist with various projects related to income tax audits and planning

The FOX Studio Lot is looking for a Telephone Operator to join their team.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Actively participate in the day-to-day operations, to include but not limited to operating the switchboard, connecting internal and external callers with the appropriate individual or department
  • Respond to incoming requests (e.g., e-mails, telephone calls, voicemail, or in person) and accurately identify, diagnose, prioritize, log, and dispatch the appropriate team
  • Utilize the electronic ticketing system according to department procedures for the opening, closing, resolution, escalation, and tracking of all requests
  • Provide updates, status, and completion information to staff and/or users via telephone, e-mail, or in-person communication
  • Ensure the highest level of customer service and professionalism
  • Provide back-up support for other administrative departments or job functions
  • Promote and sustain a professional, positive, productive, and safe work environment
  • Act as the direct liaison to employees, customers, tenants and service personnel
  • Log and report suspicious, nuisance or hostile calls to Security
  • Coordinate various service requests using the telephone, e-mail and two-way radio
  • Perform general clerical duties including but not limited to, ordering supplies, placing service calls for equipment, filing, record keeping and photocopying

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Recent prior experience working in a Call Center, Help Desk or other environment with heavy incoming telephone calls
  • Possess strong general knowledge of Call Center, Help Desk or PBX operations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent customer service, time management, interpersonal, organizational and analytical skills
  • Aptitude to coordinate multiple concurrent activities and multifaceted service requests 
  • Maintain confidentiality of company and customer information, data and materials
  • Dependable/reliable person with excellent attendance record and able to work nights and weekends as needed
  • Valid California driver's license (without restrictions)
  • Ability to operate in a dynamic, fast paced, demanding startup environment
  • Ability to train across multiple job functions
  • Ability to readily adapt to changing requirements
  • Ability to work cooperatively and collaboratively with all levels of staff, employees, tenants and vendors
  • Ability to gain and retain comprehensive knowledge of all equipment, tools and software used in the Call Center as well as supported services
  • Ability to listen carefully and respond quickly and effectively
  • Able to follow standardized operating procedures
  • Able to manage multiple priorities and follow through on assignments
  • Able to work overtime with short notice
  • Able to stand, walk and sit as required to perform all job functions including lifting up to 50 lbs.
  • Able to learn and retain large amounts of general information about the Company
  • Follow all company, safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries

job.title: Temp Senior Union Payroll Associate
job.description:
Our East Coast Union Payroll team is looking for a Temp Senior Union Payroll Associate to join the team. The Temp Senior Union Payroll Associate performs a variety of functions necessary for the accurate and timely processing of multi-state, multi-company, weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees. The Temp Senior Union Payroll Associate coordinates, validates, and implements work procedures that require comprehensive operational knowledge of union collective bargaining agreements and federal and state regulations related to wage garnishment, taxation, and wage‐hour law.


While there are no direct people responsibilities, the Temp Senior Union Payroll Associate will coordinate independently with other associates, leaders, and teams outside of Payroll Shared Services to accomplish tasks, meet deadlines, champion process improvement initiatives and enhance the employee experience.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure compliance with all company policies, internal controls, and SOX controls

  • Serve as a go-to expert for union payroll questions, managing the timely resolution of customer issues, including handling customer escalations, performing and documenting Root Cause Analysis, and implementing remedial procedures to close gaps identified

job.title: Vice President, Event Experience (ARENA)
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Red Seat Ventures is launching a new premium membership business and is hiring a Vice President of Event Experience to drive operational excellence on a nightly basis across a portfolio of luxury suites and premium seating at venues around the country. This is a highly operational leadership role for someone who knows how to translate an elevated service vision into repeatable, scalable execution across markets.

This role reports to the Senior Vice President, Strategy & Operations and will be a key member of the leadership team. The VP will define and scale a luxury experience across multiple markets and venues, delivering excellence at every touchpoint from staffing to in-suite catering, branding and decor, and event run-of-show.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the end-to-end member experience at events occurring every night across multiple venues and markets
  • Translate the company’s service vision into scalable operating standards, processes, procedures, and playbooks that drive consistent execution across events and markets
  • Recruit, train, schedule, manage, and develop a high-performing team of Suite Hosts who deliver exceptional member service
  •  Develop event staffing strategies and determine appropriate staffing levels based on the size, format, and service requirements of each venue and event
  • Oversee all member-facing elements of the event experience, including arrival, seating layouts, branding, decor, food and beverage, hospitality, and the overall run-of-show
  • Establish policies, procedures, and escalation protocols for anticipating and resolving event-related issues quickly and professionally
  • Partner cross-functionally with internal teams, venues, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of the member experience
  • Develop mechanisms for capturing member feedback and post-event insights, using findings to continuously improve future experiences
  • Own the P&L for event experience, balancing exceptional service and hospitality with disciplined financial and operational management
  • Identify opportunities to innovate and elevate the event experience as the business scales, while maintaining consistent standards across events and markets

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 10+ years of extensive experience leading complex, multi-location hospitality, event, or guest-service operations, with a track record of delivering consistent execution across multiple markets
  • Proven experience building and managing hourly or frontline teams, including recruiting, training, scheduling, performance management, and team development
  • Strong operational leadership skills, with the ability to translate service standards into repeatable processes, training programs, playbooks, and measurable operating practices
  • Demonstrated P&L ownership and financial acumen, including labor planning, budgeting, cost management, and balancing service excellence with financial discipline
  • Experience managing high-touch guest or member experiences where attention to detail, responsiveness, and consistent execution are critical
  • Ability to oversee multiple events, venues, and teams simultaneously while maintaining quality, compliance, and service standards in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently across markets and be hands-on during events, particularly as the operation and team scale

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  •  Experience delivering high-touch guest experiences within luxury hotels, private clubs, premium hospitality, or other membership-based environments
  • Experience opening, launching, or scaling hospitality operations across multiple locations or markets
  • Background working with premium live events, sports, entertainment, or venue-based hospitality
  • Experience working in startup environments or new business incubation teams where operating models, processes, and teams are being built from the ground ups

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX News Media is seeking a creative, organized, and highly motivated Manager, Commerce to support the development and execution of commerce content, brand partnerships, and product integrations across FOX Nes platforms.


This role will work closely with the Managing Editor, Commerce, serving as a key creative and operational partner in bringing commerce ideas to life. The Manager will help develop segment concepts, identify and communicate with relevant brands, coordinate products and samples, track deliverables, and ensure projects move smoothly from initial idea through execution.

The ideal candidate understands the intersection of editorial content, commerce, brand partnerships, and broadcast production. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment and managing multiple projects at once.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Support the development of commerce segments, seasonal content, product features, and integrated brand opportunities.
  • Research and identify relevant products, brands, retailers, and emerging trends for potential editorial and partnership opportunities.
  • Conduct brand outreach and maintain ongoing communication with brand representatives, agencies, and public relations contacts.
  • Help coordinate product samples, product information, pricing, links, assets, approvals, and other materials needed for segments and commerce content.
  • Manage project timelines, requests, feedback, deliverables, and follow-up across multiple initiatives.
  • Coordinate with editorial, production, digital, social, sales, legal, marketing, and affiliate teams to support seamless execution.
  • Assist with the development of pitches, presentations, segment briefs, talking points, and integration ideas.
  • Support on-air, digital, social, streaming, and affiliate commerce opportunities.
  • Help prepare products and materials for on-air appearances, shoots, demos, and live or taped segments.
  • Track brand participation, campaign details, content needs, deadlines, and post-segment follow-up.
  • Monitor commerce trends, consumer interests, seasonal moments, and timely opportunities for FOX audiences.
  • Contribute creative ideas for new commerce franchises, recurring segments, sponsorship opportunities, and brand integrations.
  • Attend meetings and represent the Commerce team with professionalism, organization, and strong follow-through.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • 3+ years of experience in commerce, brand partnerships, media, public relations, production, marketing, editorial, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of brands, products, consumer trends, and content development.
  • Excellent communication, writing, organization, and project-management skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with brands, agencies, internal teams, and external partners.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow projects through from concept to completion.
  • Comfortable working with product samples, digital assets, spreadsheets, presentations, and project-tracking tools.
  • Ability to think creatively while also managing the operational details required to execute a successful segment or partnership.
  • Experience with broadcast, digital media, affiliate content, social media, or on-air integrations is a plus.
  • Must be comfortable working in person in New York City and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Fox Business Network

FOX Business Network (FBN) is a financial news channel delivering real-time information across all platforms that impact both Main Street and Wall Street. job.title: Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service.


Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise.


Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms.


At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Director, Acquisition Marketing (LATAM) to lead FOX One's subscriber acquisition strategy and paid media investment across Latin America. As FOX One expands its international footprint, this leader will play a critical role in developing and scaling regional growth strategies, driving efficient subscriber acquisition, and establishing a strong market presence across LATAM.


Reporting to the Senior Director, Acquisition Marketing, this role will serve as the primary strategic lead for LATAM acquisition marketing, overseeing multi-million-dollar media investments, agency partnerships, and regional campaign performance. The Director will collaborate closely with U.S.-based leadership and international marketing teams while providing dotted-line leadership to LATAM-based team members.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in performance marketing, international media strategy, and incrementality-based measurement, along with the ability to balance short-term subscriber growth objectives with long-term brand development. This individual will be instrumental in shaping FOX One's regional acquisition roadmap, identifying opportunities to scale investment, and building a sustainable, data-driven growth engine across Latin America.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and lead FOX One's subscriber acquisition strategy across LATAM, developing regional growth plans that align with global business objectives, subscriber targets, and market expansion priorities.
  • Manage and optimize multi-million-dollar paid media budgets across LATAM markets, driving investment decisions, resource allocation, and acquisition efficiency to maximize subscriber growth and return on marketing investment.
  • Provide strategic oversight of integrated paid media campaigns across paid social, paid search, Youtube, display, and connected TV (CTV), ensuring effective planning, execution, and optimization across markets.
  • Serve as the acquisition lead for LATAM, partnering with the U.S.-based leadership and regional stakeholders to translate global growth strategies into locally relevant marketing initiatives.
  • Establish and advance incrementality-based measurement frameworks, including geo-lift studies, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and holdout/control testing, to evaluate media effectiveness and inform investment decisions.
  • Lead and develop strategic relationships with media, creative, and measurement agency partners, establishing performance expectations, accountability, and opportunities for innovation.
  • Provide dotted-line leadership and strategic direction to LATAM-based team members, fostering collaboration, accountability, and alignment across regional and global teams.
  • Own regional acquisition performance reporting, including CPA/CPS, subscriber growth, campaign pacing, and marketing efficiency, delivering actionable insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Partner with measurement, analytics, creative, product, and international marketing teams to develop integrated go-to-market strategies that support FOX One's regional launches and ongoing growth.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities, evolving consumer behaviors, and competitive dynamics to inform regional acquisition strategies and long-term investment planning.
  • Drive continuous improvement in regional marketing operations, establishing scalable processes, testing frameworks, and best practices that support FOX One's international expansion.
  • Travel throughout LATAM markets as needed to strengthen strategic partnerships, support market launches, and deepen understanding of local market dynamics.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 10+ years of progressive experience in performance marketing, subscriber acquisition, growth marketing, or digital media, including significant experience leading acquisition strategies and large-scale paid media investments.
  • Professional-level fluency in Spanish, including the ability to participate in business meetings.
  • Extensive experience overseeing multi-million-dollar paid media budgets and driving investment decisions across paid social, paid search, online video (OLV), display, and/or connected TV (CTV).
  • Proven ability to lead and manage external media agency partners, establish strategic priorities, and drive accountability for performance and execution.
  • Deep expertise in incrementality-based measurement, including geo-lift studies, marketing mix modeling (MMM), holdout/control testing, and other advanced marketing effectiveness frameworks.
  • Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex performance data into actionable business recommendations and investment decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate cross-functional organizations, and align regional execution with broader business priorities.
  • Experience providing leadership, mentorship, or strategic direction to cross-functional or geographically distributed teams.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across multiple markets and time zones.
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally throughout Latin America as needed to support business operations, market launches, and strategic partnerships.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Demonstrated expertise in building and executing user growth initiatives across Mexico, Central America, or South America, leveraging a nuanced knowledge of regional consumer habits and media landscapes.
  • Experience leading subscriber acquisition or growth marketing for streaming, subscription-based, or direct-to-consumer (DTC) businesses.
  • Experience developing market-entry strategies or scaling consumer subscription products across international markets.
  • Familiarity with the competitive streaming and digital media landscape across Latin America.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. JOB TITLE: Executive Producer of Investigations


Vibe: Driven, strategic, organized, and obsessed with high-impact journalism across every platform.


The Mission FOX6 Milwaukee is looking for a detail-oriented, creative, high-caliber journalist to lead our investigative team and our Contact 6 consumer advocacy unit. We need an Executive Producer who can manage major investigative projects, oversee our investigative podcast, and reimagine how deep-dive stories reach modern audiences on streaming, digital, and broadcast.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on complex journalistic ethics, legal vetting, public records requests, and investigative standards.

What You Bring

  • Proven track record producing or managing investigative journalism, enterprise reporting, or long-form investigative units.
  • Sharp project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple initiatives, keep cross-department teams aligned, and keep long-term investigations on schedule while staying involved in daily newsroom needs.

job.title: Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is an integral member of the Finance team supporting the Fox Digital & Technology organization. The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is responsible for the financial integrity and operational oversight of the Digital & Technology P&L, managing monthly and quarterly close processes to ensure accurate, timely, and complete financial reporting. In addition, this role serves as a key business partner to operational stakeholders and external suppliers across all purchasing and invoicing activities. The Manager oversees the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, collaborating cross-functionally to drive financial discipline, process efficiency, and strong internal controls. This position plays a critical role in validating financial results, including reconciliation of the full Balance Sheet and P&L, investigating variances, and ensuring reported results align with business expectations.

The Manager exercises strong independent judgment in resolving issues, demonstrates ownership, and consistently delivers high-quality, timely results without the need for constant supervision. Additionally, this role collaborates with the FP&A team during budget and forecast cycles to support planning activities and ensure alignment between actual results and forward-looking projections. This position reports directly to the Sr. Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting.
 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Month-End Close/General Accounting 

  • Manage monthly and quarterly close processes for the Operating Division, including oversight of third-party goods and services, proper expense codification, and accurate general ledger recording

  • Analyze actual spending results and review accrual journal entries to ensure completeness and accuracy of third-party costs across both the P&L and Balance Sheet

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on monthly financial results, clearly articulating drivers of spend, key variances, and accounting treatments to finance and operational stakeholders

  • Partner with operational leaders and the FP&A team to investigate expense fluctuations, provide variance explanations, and support reporting deliverables

  • Perform and validate monthly reconciliation of key Balance Sheet accounts to ensure reported financial results are accurate, supported, and compliant with internal controls

Principal Partner and Procure-to-Pay Process

  • Manage the Procure-to-Pay Process including day-to-day vendor management and invoicing, including answering vendor inquiries, overseeing invoice processing, working closely with cross-functional teams to secure appropriate approvals, and resolving payment issues.

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to Accounts Payable, operational stakeholders, and external vendors, facilitating vendor onboarding, issue resolution, and adherence to internal policies

  • Ensure compliance with Purchase Order policies and approval workflows to support accurate accruals and timely expense recognition

  • Partner cross-functionally to review and interpret contractual terms, supporting appropriate financial treatment and alignment between purchase orders and invoice processing

  • Proactively identify and implement process improvements, including automation and system enhancements, to drive efficiency and scalability

Other Activities

  • Partner with the FP&A team during month-end and budget/forecast cycles to support financial planning and performance analysis

  • Ensure timely completion of close deliverables in coordination with the General Accounting team, maintaining accountability for assigned reporting deadlines

  • Prepare and contribute to management presentations and supporting materials related to financial results and operational performance

  • Assist in supporting Internal and External Audit requests including ensuring proper compliance with identified “Key SOX Controls” and proper documentation of transactions and tracking status of requests

  • Reconcile and validate embedded cost reports from cross-divisional partners, collaborating with stakeholders to investigate material variances and ensure accurate financial reporting

  • Respond to ad hoc financial inquiries and support quarterly reporting requirements from Corporate Accounting, ensuring timely and accurate deliverables

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field

  • 3–5+ years of accounting or finance experience, preferably within public accounting or a large corporate environment

  • Strong understanding of accrual accounting and working knowledge of GAAP

  • Strong analytical thinking

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret financial data and identify variances

  • Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy and accountability

  • Demonstrated experience supporting month-end close processes, financial reporting, and balance sheet reconciliations

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables and the ability to analyze large data sets; working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate financial concepts to stakeholders at all levels

  • Ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience with Workday Financials and Coupa

  • Experience supporting Engineering, Technology Infrastructure, or SaaS-driven operating environments

  • Familiarity with data analytics tools and emerging technologies (including AI-enabled tools)

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Television Stations is growing its streaming operation, and the Florida region is a critical part of that growth. This role sits at the center of that effort — serving as the streaming authority for FOX Tampa (WTVT) and FOX Orlando (WOFL), responsible for building and evolving a high-performing local streaming operation across both markets.

Reporting to the News Director(s) at WTVT & WOFL, this position works in close partnership with FTS Streaming and weather leadership to align regional execution with broader FTS strategy and the Executive Producers of both FL stations. As the streaming team grows and the business evolves, so will this role — expanding in scope, team size, and responsibility. The right candidate is someone who is ready to grow with it.

This is a role for a streaming-first leader who understands where the industry is heading, knows how to bring a newsroom along on that journey, and has the editorial instincts, technical fluency, and analytical rigor to drive measurable growth across the full streaming universe — CTV, FAST channels, and social video.

A Snapshot of Your Responsibilities - Editorial & Content Leadership

  • Lead with a streaming-first mindset across both newsrooms, driving editorial vision, cultural adoption, and a commitment to continuous content improvement.
  • Make fast, sound editorial decisions in breaking news environments, balancing urgency with accuracy.
  • Manage and evolve streaming programming schedules across Tampa and Orlando, working toward expanded hours and a long-term 24/7 weather and streaming operation at both stations.
  • Elevate content quality at every level — from live breaking news to long-form storytelling — with an eye toward what works for a streaming-native audience.
  • Operate fluidly across digital and streaming, shaping content intentionally for each format and platform.

Team Development & Newsroom Adoption

  • Motivate, coach, and develop a team of streaming journalists and producers in Tampa, and support alignment with the Orlando & Tampa Executive Producers of Streaming.
  • Serve as the leading voice in both newsrooms for streaming adoption — building buy-in, growing participation, and helping teams evolve their workflows and mindset to support expanded streaming output.
  • Partner with the station and FTS Executive Director of Streaming to identify opportunities to grow the team and the operation over time.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Own streaming performance data and reporting for the FL region across all platforms — including FOX Local CTV, FAST channels, YouTube, social video, and weather.
  • Produce regular growth reports for both stations, surfacing trends, opportunities, and areas that need attention.
  • Use real-time and historical data to inform editorial decisions, optimize audience engagement, and support the case for expanded resources and investment in the region.
  • Provide regular performance and strategy updates to FTS Streaming leadership to ensure regional activity is visible and aligned with company goals.

Technology & Distribution

  • Master and expand the use of TriCaster and all streaming production technology across both markets.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the full streaming distribution landscape — CTV, FAST channels, and social video — and ensure both stations are operating effectively across all surfaces.
  • Prioritize the CTV viewer experience: ensure content is surfaced intentionally, programming decisions are made with audience growth in mind, and both stations are actively working to drive viewers toward longer-form, high-value content.
  • Stay attuned to how platforms, discovery mechanisms, and viewer habits are shifting, and bring that awareness into day-to-day and long-term planning.

Strategy & Industry Awareness

  • Serve as the regional expert on streaming industry trends — platform evolution, audience behavior, competitive landscape, and emerging opportunities.
  • Develop and execute short- and long-term streaming growth strategies for the FL region, aligned with FTS goals and built to adapt as the industry and business change.
  • Collaborate across FOX and with external content partners, contributors, and creators to expand live coverage opportunities.

What You Will Need

  • 5+ years in a digital or broadcast news leadership role; live streaming or CTV experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the full streaming landscape: CTV, FAST channels, OTT platforms, social video, and mobile apps.
  • Proven ability to lead teams through high-stakes breaking news and live events.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience building and presenting performance reports across multiple streaming platforms and distribution surfaces.
  • Deep understanding of CTV user experience and content distribution strategy, with a viewer-first approach to programming and platform decisions.
  • Proficiency with streaming production technology; TriCaster experience strongly preferred.
  • A streaming-first editorial mindset with the ability to work fluidly across digital, and streaming formats.
  • Current knowledge of streaming industry trends, audience behavior shifts, and platform evolutions.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive newsroom culture change and build enthusiasm for streaming at all levels.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, weekends, and holidays as news demands.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group.
