JOB DESCRIPTION

The Senior Union Payroll Associate performs a variety of functions necessary for the accurate and timely processing of multi-state, multi-company, weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees. The Senior Union Payroll Associate coordinates, validates, and implements work procedures that require comprehensive operational knowledge of union collective bargaining agreements and federal and state regulations related to wage garnishment, taxation and wage‐hour law.


While there are no direct people responsibilities, the Senior Union Payroll Associate will coordinate independently with other associates, leaders, and teams outside of Payroll Shared Services to accomplish tasks, meet deadlines, champion process improvement initiatives, and enhance the employee experience.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform all duties necessary to ensure timely and accurate processing of multi-state, multi-company weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees in accordance with collective bargaining agreements and other contracts and in compliance with applicable FOX policies and federal, state, and local regulations
  • Process on demand payments, retroactive payments, one-time payments, tax adjustments, stop payments, void checks, direct deposit reversals, and overpayment collections in accordance with FOX policies, collective bargaining agreements, and in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations
  • Interpret and set up withholding orders for levies, garnishments, child support, and other involuntary wage assignment orders in the payroll system within the regulated period
  • Understand union pay and paid time off rules and the timekeeping system and address employee questions as needed
  • Provide testing support during the implementation of the new timekeeping system and assist with team training

  • Review, test, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) regularly to ensure operational accuracy, compliance, and continuous process efficiency
  • Provide subject matter expertise on union timekeeping rules and processes, to include paid time off plans. This requires the ability to interpret rules outlined in collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) and other union related documents

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 4+ years hands-on union payroll processing experience, preferably with IBEW, IATSE, AFTRA, and/or NABET collective bargaining agreements
  • Experience with interpreting and setting up withholding orders for levies, garnishments, child support, and other involuntary wage assignment orders
  • Experience and knowledge of automated time and attendance systems
  • Experience with initiating and leading standardization and process improvement initiatives
  • Strong working knowledge of FLSA, federal, state, and local wage and hour and tax regulations. 
  • Ability to interpret collective bargaining agreements for pay and paid time off rules.
  • Strong interpersonal skills – you are approachable, responsive, and team focused
  • Intermediate Excel using VLOOKUP and pivots.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Excellent judgment, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High degree of professionalism and solid ability in delivering high quality customer service and establishing/maintaining effective and collaborative working relationships

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

This role will help produce weekend streaming coverage alongside the weekend host while spending the remaining weekdays supporting live coverage, identifying and booking timely newsmakers, preparing interviews, and helping the streaming team respond quickly to breaking news and developing stories across the Tampa Bay area.

FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 Plus is seeking a sharp, creative, and decisive Streaming Line Producer to lead compelling live coverage across linear television and digital streaming platforms. What You’ll Do


• Lead live coverage and editorial execution. Write, stack, time, and line produce structured newscasts and continuous coverage for linear and streaming platforms; adjust rundowns as news develops; guide breaking-news coverage from the control room; manage multiple live elements; and direct anchors, reporters, field crews, and production teams.


• Create streaming-first, multiplatform content. Develop live streams, explainers, interviews, and presentation elements for digital audiences and the station’s broader content strategy; write broadcast and digital copy; log, clip, and edit video; coordinate graphics; produce interviews and digital video packages; and repurpose content before, during, and after live broadcasts.

What You Bring


• Experience. Two to four years as a news producer, line producer, or in a similar role in a medium-to-large broadcast newsroom; live streaming or digital-first news production experience is strongly preferred.


• Editorial and live-production strength. Strong news judgment, AP-style writing, and demonstrated control-room leadership, with the ability to manage breaking news, multiple live elements, and intense deadlines. Working knowledge of broadcast law, FCC regulations, journalistic standards, and editorial best practices.


• Multiplatform expertise. A strong understanding of multiplatform storytelling, social media strategy, digital video distribution, and audience engagement.


• Technology fluency. Experience with linear rundown software, live streaming production tools, control room automation, digital video editing and publishing workflows, and audience analytics, plus the ability to learn evolving systems quickly.


• Education and leadership. A bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, along with clear professional communication, strong collaboration, sound decision-making, and the composure to lead effectively in fast-moving live-news situations.


Additional Information


Benefits


• Comprehensive package. Excellent health benefits, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match.


• Lifestyle perks. Access to an onsite fitness center, vibrant local dining, and shopping options.

FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 Plus is a 24/7 news operation. This position supports the morning show and requires overnight hours. This role requires flexibility to work varied hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, breaking news, and special events. Extended shifts may be required during severe weather, major news events, or emergencies to support continuous coverage across linear and streaming platforms.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive – Outside Sales

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Erie, PA area | Hybrid (home office with client/prospect visits as needed)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Are you looking to launch or grow your career in sales and marketing? Our Account Executive role is an excellent opportunity for motivated early-career professionals who are eager to learn consultative selling, develop business relationships, and make a direct impact on local businesses.

In this role, you'll identify new business opportunities, engage with prospective clients, and recommend marketing solutions that help businesses grow. You'll partner with local businesses to understand their goals, present tailored marketing recommendations, and support their growth through a combination of digital and traditional advertising solutions. You'll also collaborate closely with our post-sale support teams, who manage campaign performance, reporting, and optimization.

During your first 90 days, you'll participate in structured onboarding, learn LocaliQ's products and sales process, and begin building your prospecting and client engagement skills. Our goal is to provide the coaching and resources needed to help you ramp successfully and build a long-term career in sales.

Why This Role Stands Out

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission potential

Comprehensive training and structured onboarding program

Hands-on experience in consultative sales and digital marketing

Mentorship and ongoing coaching from experienced sales leaders

Clear career path into senior sales and leadership opportunities

President's Club, contests, and recognition programs

Hybrid flexibility and autonomy in managing your territory

Access to industry-leading marketing solutions and technology

Strong support from marketing specialists, strategists, and post-sales teams

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Build relationships with prospective clients and identify business growth opportunities.

Conduct discovery conversations to understand client needs and business goals.

Partner with experienced team members to develop and present marketing recommendations.

Maintain accurate CRM records and develop strong pipeline management habits.

Collaborate with internal teams to support positive client experiences.

Participate in ongoing sales training, coaching, and professional development.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent work experience.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Motivated self-starter with a desire to learn and grow in a sales career.

Comfortable speaking with new people and building professional relationships.

Organized with strong time-management skills and attention to detail.

Experience using Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM systems

Interest in digital marketing, advertising, or business growth solutions.

Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.

Who Thrives Here

Successful Account Executives are curious, coachable, resilient, and motivated to learn. They enjoy connecting with people, are comfortable stepping outside their comfort zone, and view challenges as opportunities for growth. Whether you're coming from sales, customer service, hospitality, athletics, recruiting, or are an upcoming graduate, this role offers the training and support needed to build a rewarding career in consultative sales.

This version should resonate strongly with new graduates, recent graduates, athletes, retail/customer-service talent, recruiting backgrounds, and early-career professionals while still supporting LocaliQ's consultative sales model.

job.description:
Assistant Delivery Manager

The Democrat & Chronicle | Rochester, NY

Pay: $20.00 per hourSchedule: Part-Time | 30+ hours per weekMileage Reimbursement: $0.72 per mile

Join Our Distribution Team!

Gannett Publishing Services, located at The Democrat & Chronicle, is seeking a dependable and motivated Assistant Delivery Manager to support our newspaper distribution operations in Rochester, NY.

This is a hands-on, part-time position ideal for someone who enjoys working independently, staying active, solving problems, and helping ensure our customers receive their newspapers on time.

What You’ll Do

As an Assistant Delivery Manager, you’ll help keep daily distribution operations running smoothly. Responsibilities include:

Distribute and handle daily and non-daily publications for carriers, haulers, retailers, and customers.

Load and unload trucks containing newspapers and other print publications.

Open and prepare the Distribution Center for independent contractors.

Print, prepare, and distribute required reports and paperwork.

Assist with newspaper delivery routes as needed.

Respond to and help resolve subscriber service issues.

Complete required documentation and operational reports.

Maintain a clean, safe, and organized Distribution Center.

What We’re Looking For

High school diploma or GED.

Valid driver’s license and satisfactory motor vehicle record.

Dependable personal vehicle and required liability insurance.

Strong communication and organizational skills.

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office.

Ability to repetitively lift newspaper bundles weighing up to 25 pounds.

Ability to push and pull carts loaded with newspapers weighing up to 500 pounds with assistance.

Flexibility to work varying nights and hours, including weekends and holidays as needed.

We Offer:

Benefits, including health care, dental and vision coverage, flexible health spending account, 401(k) and paid vacation time.

Why This Role?

Earn $20.00 per hour while working a part-time schedule of 30+ hours per week, plus receive $0.72 per mile in mileage reimbursement when applicable.

If you’re dependable, organized, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and ready to play an important role in getting the news into the hands of our customers, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today to join The Democrat & Chronicle distribution team in Rochester!

Pre-employment background and drug screening is required.

job.title: Associate Producer, Visual Content
job.description:
USA TODAY is seeking an Associate Producer, Visual Content to join its national photo and video team. This role combines content programming, AI-assisted video production, and visual storytelling through galleries and playlists. This role will be specifically focused on USA TODAY’s entertainment vertical and will play a critical role in identifying and covering red carpet moments, celebrity interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, and viral entertainment trends.

We're looking for a digital-first journalist who understands audience behavior, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and can create, optimize, and distribute visual content across platforms. This role will help drive audience growth, engagement, and revenue through strategic programming and scalable content production using AI-powered platforms and tools.

Responsibilities

Content Programming & Distribution

Program and optimize visual content across USA TODAY, Network sites, mobile apps, articles, playlists, galleries, and social platforms.

Serve as a centralized programming resource, making real-time editorial decisions to maximize audience engagement and content performance.

Monitor analytics using tools such as Parse.ly and Google Analytics to inform programming strategy.

Monitor real-time analytics and entertainment trends to identify visual opportunities and adjust content strategy accordingly.

Write compelling headlines, metadata, descriptions, and promotional copy optimized for SEO and audience growth.

Identify, source, and distribute the most relevant in-house, third-party, and publicly available content while ensuring editorial quality and rights compliance.

Manage automated and third-party video feeds, playlists, and related content experiences.

AI-Assisted Video Production

Serve as the national hub for AI-assisted video creation using platforms such as Stringr, Wochit, and future automation tools.

Produce high-volume short-form video content for breaking news, service journalism, entertainment, sports, obituaries, trending topics, and high-interest local stories.

Create vertical video optimized for platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.

Repurpose automated and AI-generated content for owned and social platforms.

Fulfill newsroom video requests and support priority local markets and network editorial initiatives

Visual Curation

Create and curate entertainment photo galleries that capture the emotion, artistry, and defining moments of celebrities, events, and fan culture.

Program visual experiences into articles, section fronts, and promotional placements across the Network.

Source and manage visual assets from the USA TODAY Network, wire services, and approved third-party providers.

Editorial Collaboration

Maintain high standards for editorial quality, accuracy, and brand consistency.

Collaborate with local and national newsroom teams on coverage planning, major events, and visual storytelling opportunities.

Support the USA TODAY Network by answering questions, troubleshooting workflows, and sharing best practices.

Develop training materials and assist with newsroom education initiatives related to video production, programming, galleries, playlists, and AI-powered workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Consistent delivery of high-quality visual content across video, galleries, playlists, and promotional experiences.

Growth in audience engagement metrics, including views, watch time, click-through rates, article engagement, and content consumption.

Increased adoption of AI-assisted production workflows that improve newsroom efficiency while maintaining quality standards.

Strong content discoverability through strategic programming, SEO optimization, and effective distribution tactics.

Successful support of major news, sports, entertainment, lifestyle, and breaking news coverage initiatives.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, digital media or related field.

2-5 years of newsroom, digital media, content production, audience engagement, or visual storytelling experience for an entertainment news publisher or brand.

Experience programming content and producing video for digital platforms.

Strong understanding of SEO, audience development, analytics, and content optimization.

Experience with analytics tools such as Parse.ly and Google Analytics.

Excellent headline writing, editing, and communication skills.

Strong news judgment, organizational skills, and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Knowledge of AP Style.

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Stringr, Wochit, True Anthem, or similar platforms.

Experience creating photo galleries, playlists, and audience-focused visual experiences.

Familiarity with Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, Canva, or similar editing tools.

Experience using AI tools for content creation, automation, and audience optimization.

Knowledge of video rights management and content licensing.

Experience producing content for social and mobile-first platforms.

Who You Are

A digital-first storyteller with strong audience instincts.

Obsessed with celebrities, movies, music, Hollywood, red carpets, and trending moments.

Equal parts programmer, producer, and visual curator.

Passionate about analytics, optimization, and content performance.

Curious about AI and emerging newsroom technologies.

Organized, collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable working at scale.

Schedule

This role requires flexibility, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and breaking-news coverage as needed.

Application Instructions

Please submit a single document containing:

Resume (1-2 pages)

Cover letter explaining your experience and approach to the role

Five examples of work demonstrating video production, content programming, visual storytelling, galleries, playlists, or audience growth initiatives

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.description:
Driver Gannett Publishing Services/USA Today Co.

Canton, OH

Safe Transport: Operate cars, vans, or trucks to deliver goods or people on schedule.

job.title: Entry Level Office Admin
job.description:
Office Administrator – "Public Notice Advisor"

Location: Green Bay, WI – Green Bay Press-GazetteSchedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PMPay: $15.73/hourWork Arrangement: In-office – off N. Broadway

Looking for a Monday–Friday Job With a More Consistent Routine?

If you've built strong people skills in retail, restaurants, hospitality, customer service, call centers, or another fast-paced environment, you may already have many of the skills you need to succeed in an office.

LocaliQ/USA TODAY is hiring an Office Administrator – Public Notices to join our Green Bay team. This is a great opportunity to take the skills you've developed in a customer-facing environment and put them to work in a Monday–Friday office setting while learning new administrative and computer-based skills along the way.

You'll work with customers and internal teams, process information, manage deadlines, and help ensure important public notices are handled accurately and on time.

What You'll Be Doing

Your day will include a variety of administrative and customer-focused responsibilities, such as:

Assisting customers and sales representatives with public notice questions

Handling incoming phone calls and emails

Entering and updating information in computer systems

Reviewing notices and proofs to ensure information is accurate

Processing public notices and advertisements

Managing deadlines and keeping work moving on schedule

Partnering with internal teams to answer questions and resolve issues

Learning and using new systems and processes through hands-on training

You don't have to know everything coming in the door. Reliability, attention to detail, organization, and a willingness to learn are what matter most.

What We're Looking For

You don't need a long administrative background or a resume filled with office experience.

We're looking for someone who:

Is dependable and follows through on their work

Enjoys working with and helping others

Is comfortable working with computers and learning new systems

Has strong attention to detail

Can prioritize and stay organized throughout the day

Communicates clearly and professionally

Is willing to learn new processes and responsibilities

Cares about getting the details right

Experience in retail, restaurants, hospitality, call centers, reception, customer service, or other fast-paced, people-focused environments can be a great fit for this role.

Previous office or public-notice experience is not required. We'll provide training on our systems, processes, and responsibilities.

And if you don't have notary experience, that's okay too — we can assist with becoming a notary if needed.

Build Your Office Experience

This could be a great next step if you're ready to move from an unpredictable customer-facing environment into a steady Monday–Friday office role.

You'll have the opportunity to build experience in administration, customer service, computer systems, and office operations while working alongside a supportive team.

You'll also have access to:

Health, Dental & Vision coverage

401(k) with company match

Paid Time Off

Company holidays

Training and development opportunities

A supportive team environment

If you're ready for a consistent Monday–Friday schedule and an opportunity to build your office skills, apply today. We'd love to meet you.

The hourly rate for this role will range between $15.00 and $16.00. Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, education level, location, and union representation, if applicable

job.title: Executive Editor, The Asheville Citizen-Times, Ashville, NC
job.description:
The Asheville Citizen-Times, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is seeking a digital savvy, strategic and community minded executive editor who is committed to audience growth, digital innovation and powerful journalism in fast-growing Asheville and Western North Carolina.

The ideal candidate has a collaborative mindset and is eager to work together to raise the newsroom’s digital acumen and drive high-quality journalism that is essential to the Western North Carolina communities it serves. This is a person fluid in news analytics, energized by new ideas, and whose enthusiasm for great journalism is contagious.

The ideal candidate will be a transformational leader who is passionate about watchdog and enterprise reporting who also possesses a deep knowledge of audience.

This editor must understand and illustrate how community engagement and subscriber loyalty are at the forefront of what we do and how we operate.

We need a strong communicator and collaborator, as well as someone who understands how to inspire and lead even more sophisticated work through community engagement, social media and other platforms.  We also need a leader who embraces the ethos of servant leadership and continuous self learning.

This person must have impeccable journalism credentials, outstanding leadership skills, and a keen grasp of the ever-changing digital space, including a strong knowledge of visual storytelling. The right editor is people-centric, has lofty standards, remains focused on the most important priorities and opportunities, and easily shifts between strategy and execution.

The executive editor will work collaboratively with partners in the USA TODAY Network South Region to become the voice of authority for Western North Carolinians through quality journalism, strategic outreach and diverse storytelling.

Responsibilities:

Uphold the highest journalism standards across digital and print platforms, strongly support the First Amendment and conceive, pursue and execute watchdog reporting.

Develop and implement a multi-platform digital vision and strategy focused on achieving target audience specific goals and objectives.

Provide leadership and be knowledgeable in state and local news, investigative journalism, Helene recovery issues, public service and government issues.

Champion change management efforts that include strong communication of the company’s strategic initiatives, purpose, vision, culture and plan.

Lead the planning and oversee execution of content strategies with a keen eye focused on strategic audiences. Special emphasis is placed on digital and other new platforms. Creativity and an ability to develop and execute innovative approaches are essential.

Facilitate strong community connections with a relevant editorial voice and personal interaction.

Attract, retain and develop top talent.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Minimum of five years in significant leadership roles in a newsroom with demonstrated success.

Clear understanding of the First Amendment and the highest regard for upholding those standards.

Experience in high-level decision-making with complex, impactful or sensitive news content.

Experience working in industries undergoing substantial change and transformation.

A history of successful leadership, innovation and goal achievement.

Demonstrated change leader who collaborates and communicates effectively.

Personal charisma, comfort with public speaking and commitment to staff interaction.

Understanding of the changing media landscape and ability to adapt strategies that address continually changing market and consumer needs and desires.

Demonstrated strong competitive instincts and intellectual curiosity.

Demonstrated ability to effectively manage and coordinate in an environment of accountability.

Demonstrated track record in recruiting a highly successful leadership team.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

1.    Your resume – one to two pages.2.    A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.3.    Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Government and politics editor
job.description:
IndyStar, part of the USA TODAY Network, has an immediate opening for a watchdog-minded, politically savvy journalist who can lead a team of reporters in a competitive, newsy market.

This is a key newsroom role, particularly following the 2026 midterm elections and heading into the start of the Indiana legislative session. Meanwhile, a highly competitive mayoral election has already kicked off ahead of next year's election.

This government and politics editor will work with reporters on the front end as well as the back to shape the full range of politics and government coverage, from breaking news to contextualized enterprise to investigative and watchdog journalism only IndyStar delivers.

The editor will put audience at the center of our coverage, asking with every story what do residents of Central Indiana want and need to know about their governments. They will embrace change and experimentation, learning from failures and pivoting quickly. And they will recognize the value of urgency and scoops.

The successful candidate will have political reporting experience, a keen editing eye and sharp news judgment — someone who is a team player and self-directed, passionate and compassionate, someone who finds success in the success of others.

People skills are as important as journalism skills in this role. Our government and politics editor will be part of a small but mighty team of news editors who rely on each other daily. You will lead your team with empathy while also challenging them to do their best work — whether they're interns still in college, our most experienced staffers or somewhere in between.

IndyStar is the winner of three Pulitzer Prizes, most recently in 2021. You’ll work with and learn from some of journalism’s best while living in a vibrant and diverse city in the heart of the Midwest.

Our mission is clear: IndyStar informs, empowers and inspires the people of Central Indiana with our journalism. We deliver journalism that is essential to the communities we serve with urgency. We are a people-centered newsroom that’s obsessed with thoughtful experimentation and developing our next generation of industry leaders.

If you’re up to the challenge of moving us forward, read on for job requirements and information on how to share your qualifications and best work.

Key responsibilities:

Manage a team of news reporters, including reporters covering Indianapolis city hall, Hamilton County, the Indiana Statehouse and our federal delegation

Lead and provide coverage of national or statewide interest for the USA TODAY Network

Mentor reporters on source-building, interviewing and public records

Meet our audience where they are by using different story formats, video and other visuals to convey information

Use metrics and our internal metrics experts to guide your team's approach to stories

Handle other editing duties as needed, including evening and weekend editor rotations

Requirements:

At least five years of journalism experience, including experience in political reporting or editing

Proven proficiency in applying analytics to content strategy

Strong communication and collaboration skills

Comfort in deadline-driven environment

Exceptional planning and organizational skills

Social-media and SEO knowledge

Strong line-editing skills

Strong people-management skills

Strong problem-solving skills

Experience with public records and data journalism

Command of media law and principles of ethical conduct

Bachelor's degree

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer pre-employment background check.

We are eager to learn more about you and what you will add to an already-great newsroom. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to 3 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

job.title: Manager, Client Success
job.description:
LocaliQ is looking for a Manager, Optimization Strategy, for our Local Client Success group. The role will lead a team of experts responsible for delivering smart, innovative and performance-driven digital campaigns for our local clients.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years experience managing a growing team and 10+ years in digital marketing, specifically with PPC campaign execution (including tagging and trafficking).  You will manage, motivate and coach a team of Optimization Strategists and are ultimately responsible for campaign fulfillment and success.

You will partner closely with account management and sales, along with many other internal teams to manage workflow and grow the client relationship. You will connect the dots between high level strategy and how to best deliver it via tactical Paid Search/Social channel plan recommendations.

You are also expected to provide thought leadership to your clients and maintain a high-level knowledge of your clients’ line of business by staying on top of industry trends.

About Your Responsibilities:

Provide oversight for your team, ensuring they are delivering on campaign excellence across the accounts they manage (including flawless launches, delivering in full and hitting campaign KPIs)

Thrive in managing up and down.  You will be in the weeds to provide audits of campaigns where performance needs a boost, as well as partnering with leadership to identify proactive opportunities to support business objectives

Be comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and varying needs at 1 time

Provide trouble shooting support and guidance as your team or campaigns dictate

Conduct weekly meetings with those you manage to provide feedback and guidance to help achieve client objectives, meet team goals, and ensure quality of work

Create and roll out processes that will streamline digital execution

Ensure tight communication between all internal teams so we have consistent messaging and presence across paid search, organic presence, display, and social media marketing channels

Develop and advise on marketing strategies by understanding client expectations, cost of marketing goals, assessing feasibility and identifying marketing and advertising opportunities for our clients

Develop and refine onboarding, training, and mentoring new hires, as well as keeping the team’s skills fresh

Key Qualifications

5+ years of experience in the digital space, in an agency environment, or in-house equivalent

Display exceptional written and verbal communication skills and can communicate digital/social concept

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public relations or related fields, advance degree preferred

You have an entrepreneurial mindset; you bring a can-do mentality and can thrive in gray areas

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously with great precision and accuracy.

Advanced knowledge and understanding of SEM, SEO and display, social, email marketing and an understanding of new media consumer behaviors and trends

Ability to manage heavy workloads with flexibility to rapidly shift priorities based on organizational needs

Creative thinker with strong time management and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $85,000 and $90,000 base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

job.title: Photographer/Videographer
job.description:
Photographer/Videographer

The Arizona Republic/azcentral.com, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is looking for an experienced and talented videographer/photographer to join our team.

We are a creative, innovative, hardworking group covering everything from breaking news, sports, and in-depth story projects. Our visuals team at The Arizona Republic and azcentral.com has won numerous Emmy Awards, countless regional, national, and international awards.

We are looking for a professional Videographer/Photographer with at least three years of journalism experience, who is a confident, creative, and proven leader who believes flexibility, adaptability, and creativity are crucial to success.  We offer many opportunities for experimentation, growth, and storytelling on our digital platforms. The candidate must be flexible, motivated, and respond effectively to creative feedback.

Demonstrate high command of techniques and sophisticated craftsmanship in photo/video storytelling and community engagement. Acts as a community watchdog in this area of expertise.

Collaborate and connect with the community through visual storytelling and outreach (social media, on camera, forums, community leadership, etc.)

Work with content coaches and other journalists to evaluate what works, what doesn't and develop ongoing plans to satisfy audience needs better. Work on special projects and perform editing of visuals when needed.

Knowledgeable, coachable, and receptive to constructive criticism.

Self-motivated and self-directed.

Strong industry knowledge.

Organizational skills.

Effective communicator; able to get along with diverse personalities.

job.title: Prinicipal Multi Media Designer - Creative Stategy & Enablement
job.description:
designIQ is a full-service creative, design, and pre-media group supporting internal and external partners across print, digital, social, video, branding, campaign creative, imaging, and ad production services.

Our work ranges from high-volume production to agency-level creative solutions. That includes print and digital advertising, social media creative, short-form video, logos, brand identity systems, company stationery, branded materials, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product design, glossy and newsprint products, campaign assets, and custom creative solutions.

We’re looking for a senior creative leader who can operate beyond execution. This person will serve as creative counsel to the Sr. Director of Creative Operations, support sales and partner conversations, help shape creative standards, and assist with training and enablement across the creative operation.

This role is ideal for someone who can think like an agency creative, work like a production expert, communicate like a client-facing partner, and help move a large creative operation forward.

Role Summary:

The Principal Multimedia Designer, Creative Strategy & Enablement is a highly experienced creative professional responsible for supporting elevated creative work, client-facing creative conversations, internal training, sales enablement, and quality improvement across designIQ.

This role sits at the intersection of creative strategy, multimedia design, production excellence, client consultation, and operational enablement. The person in this position should be able to understand a business need, translate it into a creative approach, guide others toward stronger work, and produce high-quality creative when needed.

The role will regularly partner with the Sr. Director of Creative Operations to help shape creative direction, review strategic opportunities, support new business conversations, advise on creative capabilities, and strengthen the overall quality and consistency of designIQ’s work.

This person may attend internal meetings, external partner meetings, sales calls, discovery calls, client-facing creative discussions, and training sessions. They should be comfortable speaking with sales teams, customers, creative teams, production teams, leadership, and external partners.

The ideal candidate brings agency-level design experience, strong multimedia capability, polished communication skills, and the ability to teach, coach, and influence without needing direct authority in every situation.

Key Responsibilities:

Serve as creative counsel and strategic design partner to the Sr. Director of Creative Operations.

Support sales calls, discovery calls, partner meetings, and client-facing conversations where creative expertise is needed.

Help translate client goals, sales objectives, and business challenges into clear creative recommendations.

Provide creative direction and guidance on complex, high-value, or strategically important work.

Create, review, or advise on agency-level creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product design, glossy publications, newsprint products, and campaign-based deliverables.

Assist in shaping creative approaches for new business opportunities, partner onboarding, premium creative services, and custom creative requests.

Help determine whether a creative request belongs in standard production, premium creative, Studio-level work, or a custom scope.

Support the development of creative briefs, intake standards, client discovery questions, and creative readiness requirements.

Join internal planning meetings to represent creative quality, design feasibility, production needs, and client experience.

Partner with sales and customer-facing teams to explain design recommendations, creative limitations, available solutions, and best-fit options.

Present and explain creative work, design direction, and creative recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.

Create polished finished creative when needed, especially for strategic work, sample work, pitch support, training examples, or high-priority client needs.

Assist with creative training across the operation, including design fundamentals, multimedia best practices, AI-assisted workflows, social creative, video, brand consistency, production standards, and quality expectations.

Help develop training materials, creative playbooks, design examples, before-and-after reviews, checklists, templates, and quality standards.

Mentor designers and creative team members by providing thoughtful feedback, coaching, and design guidance.

Review creative work for concept, execution, accuracy, visual hierarchy, brand alignment, production readiness, and overall effectiveness.

Help identify quality gaps, workflow issues, training needs, and recurring creative weaknesses across the operation.

Use AI-assisted creative tools to improve ideation, versioning, image exploration, workflow efficiency, and scalable creative output.

Guide responsible use of AI across creative work, making sure final output remains accurate, brand-safe, original, legally appropriate, and professionally finished.

Stay current on design trends, digital advertising trends, social media formats, video trends, AI tools, print production practices, and evolving client expectations.

Support the creation of scalable templates, design systems, campaign frameworks, and repeatable creative solutions.

Design with performance in mind, including audience behavior, offer clarity, mobile-first composition, visual hooks, readability, and conversion-focused calls to action.

Apply accessibility-minded design practices, including legibility, contrast, hierarchy, mobile readability, and inclusive digital design principles.

Serve as a trusted creative voice in conversations about workflow, staffing, capabilities, quality, training, AI adoption, and creative operations strategy.

Required Qualifications:

Portfolio required. Portfolio must show advanced creative work across multiple media types and demonstrate strong design thinking.

Significant professional experience in multimedia design, graphic design, advertising, agency creative, publishing, brand design, digital media, or a related creative field.

Proven ability to create and guide agency-level creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, and campaign-based work.

Experience creating or directing logos, brand identity systems, corporate stationery, branded collateral, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product-related creative, glossy publications, newsprint products, digital campaigns, and social media assets.

Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including typography, layout, hierarchy, color, composition, branding, messaging, visual storytelling, and production accuracy.

Ability to create polished finished work with limited direction.

Ability to evaluate incomplete briefs, identify missing information, and still move work forward with sound creative judgment.

Strong client-facing communication skills.

Ability to interact confidently with internal teams, external customers, sales leaders, creative teams, production stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Ability to explain creative decisions clearly to non-design audiences.

Experience participating in client meetings, sales conversations, creative reviews, or discovery calls.

Strong understanding of print, digital, social, video, branding, and production workflows.

Working knowledge of digital advertising, social platform requirements, mobile-first design, paid social formats, display creative, email graphics, and campaign extensions.

Experience with video, motion graphics, animation, HTML5-style creative, short-form content, or multimedia storytelling.

Working knowledge of AI-assisted creative tools and how to use them responsibly in a professional design workflow.

Ability to write effective prompts, refine AI-assisted outputs, identify weak results, and avoid generic or low-quality creative.

Strong ability to teach, coach, mentor, and influence other creative professionals.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance strategic work, meetings, training, creative reviews, and hands-on design needs.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining high creative standards.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communication, digital media, advertising, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience working in an agency, media company, publishing organization, creative studio, in-house agency, or high-volume production environment.

Experience supporting local, regional, and national advertisers.

Experience developing creative for new business, pitch support, client presentations, sales enablement, or strategic account growth.

Experience building or improving creative training programs.

Experience developing creative playbooks, design standards, quality checklists, templates, or internal enablement materials.

Experience mentoring designers or serving as a senior creative reviewer.

Experience supporting brand development, campaign concepts, product launches, promotional campaigns, or multi-channel marketing efforts.

Experience creating campaign extensions across print, digital, social, email, outdoor, video, and branded materials.

Experience reviewing creative performance or designing with campaign outcomes in mind.

Understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG-informed digital design practices.

Experience helping teams adopt new tools, including AI, automation, design systems, or workflow platforms

Technical Skills:

Advanced working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator required.

Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Adobe Express, Figma, Canva, or similar creative tools preferred.

Experience with AI-assisted creative tools such as Adobe Firefly, Photoshop generative tools, Canva AI, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway, or similar platforms preferred.

Experience with tools that support motion graphics, digital animation, short-form video, HTML5-style creative, social creative, and platform-ready digital assets preferred.

Strong understanding of print specs, prepress standards, file packaging, bleed, trim, resolution, color profiles, image quality, vendor requirements, and production-ready file preparation.

Familiarity with digital campaign specs, social media specs, display ad specs, email creative requirements, and landing page asset needs.

Microsoft Office experience required.

Ability to learn company-specific workflow tools, ad tracking systems, digital asset systems, approval platforms, and production processes.

Leadership and Influence:

This role may not require direct people management, but it does require strong creative leadership.

The Principal Multimedia Designer should be able to influence through expertise, clarity, collaboration, and credibility. This person should be trusted by designers, sales teams, customers, production partners, and leadership.

They should be able to step into unclear situations, bring creative order to the conversation, and help move the work toward a better outcome.

This person should know when to teach, when to challenge, when to simplify, and when to raise concerns.

What Success Looks Like:

Serves as a trusted creative advisor to the Sr. Director of Creative Operations.

Improves the quality, consistency, and strategic value of creative work across designIQ.

Supports sales and client conversations with confidence, clarity, and practical creative guidance.

Helps turn vague requests into clear creative direction.

Strengthens creative training and helps raise the skill level of the broader team.

Creates or guides polished creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, and multimedia channels.

Balances creative excellence with production realities, deadlines, scalability, and business needs.

Uses AI and emerging tools to improve speed, quality, exploration, and efficiency without weakening creative standards.

Helps identify gaps in intake, workflow, training, quality, and client communication.

Builds trust with internal and external customers.

Can move between strategy, consultation, training, review, and hands-on execution with ease.

Helps designIQ present itself as a serious creative partner, not just a production resource.

Portfolio RequirementsL

Applicants must submit a portfolio that demonstrates:

Advanced print and digital advertising work.

Branding, logo, or identity system work.

Social media and digital campaign creative.

Agency-level creative, such as billboards, direct mail, packaging, product design, branded materials, signage, glossy layouts, newsprint layouts, campaign assets, or client presentations.

Strong typography, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy.

Ability to create finished work from limited direction.

Examples of campaign thinking, concept development, or multi-channel creative.

Examples of performance-minded creative, audience-focused design, or conversion-driven layout.

Video, motion, animation, or multimedia samples preferred.

Training, presentation, creative review, or before-and-after examples preferred.

AI-assisted creative examples are welcome when the candidate can explain their process, judgment, and role in the final work.

job.title: Writer/Editor, The Stockton Record
job.description:
The Stockton Record/recordnet.com, part of the USA TODAY Co., seeks an ambitious writer/editor to serve as a player/coach at one of the Central Valley’s most storied print and digital mastheads

You’ll be physically based in Stockton – and if you’re the right candidate, that’s the only way you’d have it. Stockton is home to some 320,000 people and is among America’s most diverse cities – full of vibrant culture, a global smorgasbord of food options and an endless supply of great stories. Its local government and public schools remain mired in controversy and allegations of corruption. A political operator runs a large-scale local influence network posing as news. Local journalists here have to rely on tough skin and fierce determination. There are few places where the need for professional journalism is greater.

In short, somebody could win the Pulitzer covering Stockton. It might be you and your team.

The prevailing candidate will lead by example, pursuing high-interest and impactful journalism while serving as a mentor and assigning editor to fellow journalists.

As a player/coach you will divide your time to maintain a consistent flow of quality journalism, some of which you will pursue and some of which you’ll provide guidance for, from idea to publication, to deliver stories that engage on key issues and interests within the community. This will mean working with reporters to hone ideas into focused stories driven by readers’ interests and needs. You will help to cultivate a high-performing team and intentionally create a culture of collaboration and belonging.

As a hands-on digital leader, you will make effective use of social media, SEO and trends garnered from metrics. You’ll watch analytics throughout the day, adapting to the audience in real time; and you’ll be a voracious consumer of content strategy reports that show trends in our coverage and readers’ interest. The successful leader in this role is adept at translating raw data into the language of journalism and motivating front-line journalists. Dedication to transparency and accountability is key, as well as an eye for meaningful enterprise and quick-turn watchdog stories with a focus on solutions.

Player/coach journalists are part of a team in Gannett’s Center for Community Journalism, a nationwide leadership, editing and planning structure supporting small and mid-sized newsrooms. They may work across multiple newsrooms and even across state lines, so curiosity and commitment to remote teams and other communities is essential. The CCJ is designed to prioritize what matters most to local communitie

The player/coach reports to the group editor and supervises frontline journalists within the wider context of the CCJ.

Responsibilities:

Coaching and directly supervising front-line journalists.

Ensuring steady productivity around high value topics and adjusting as needed.

Prioritizing DEIB values in story selection, sourcing, hiring and coaching.

Being the local face of the news organization for the community and ensuring local engagement by frontline journalists. Must live in the area or be able to relocate.

Helping the staff hone skills in a wide range of storytelling: from real-time digital updates to narrative storytelling, employing alternative story forms and multimedia.

Using metrics and analytics to determine how to best reach and grow the audience.

Increasing digital audience and engagement and growing digital subscriptions.

Assuring daily work is completed on time and efficiently, setting priorities and coordinating with colleagues.

Receiving assignments in the form of objectives to meet goals; administering company policies that directly affect team members.

Assigning and editing articles for context, completeness, fairness, accuracy, balance, and adherence to news values. Demonstrating strong news judgment in the selection, prioritization and editing of content.

Writing effective digital headlines, social media posts, briefs and breaking news alerts that help attract audiences.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, marketing, or related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

3-5 years of relevant work experience. Management/supervisory experience a plus.

Commitment to values of fairness, diversity, inclusion, and professionalism.

Live and work in the coverage area – this position is not remote

Strong writing skills and a command of grammar and style.

Strong story and word editing skills.

Knowledge of data-based reporting and use of spreadsheets such as Excel.

Ability to work collaboratively with others locally and regionally to meet common goals.

Candidates should have facility with AI and automation and experience in using it to enhance their journalism

Demonstrated commitment to reader interest and reader questions in helping reporters frame stories, utilizing tools such as Google Trends and Parse.ly.

Top-notch planning, organizational and time management skills.

Understanding of metrics, social media, and SEO and how they relate to the audience funnel.

Self-motivation and self-direction.

Ability to work as a member of a team.

Ability to multi-task and excel under deadline pressure in a rapidly changing environment.

Solid news judgment and mastery of ethical and legal principles in day-to-day journalism.

This role requires a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the minimum liability insurance required by state law.

Employment is contingent on passing a pre-employment, post-offer background check, drug screen & motor vehicle record check

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to no more than three published stories, writing samples and/or audio samples.

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: ESPN Cleveland Digital Account Executive
job.description:
Digital Marketing Consultant (Account Executive)

(Cleveland, OH)

Good Karma Sports is seeking an experienced and high-performing Digital Marketing Consultant to join our Cleveland team. This role will help local and regional businesses connect with highly engaged sports audiences through Good Karma Sports’ diverse portfolio of digital, video, streaming, CTV, content, and premium sports media offerings.

Our portfolio includes ESPN, March Madness, NBA, New England Sports Network, SportsNet Pittsburgh, and other premium sports and digital platforms. The ideal candidate will be passionate about helping partners grow their businesses through creative, customized, and results-driven marketing solutions.

The Digital Marketing Consultant will develop and grow long-term relationships with local and regional businesses by identifying their marketing objectives, uncovering challenges, and building integrated digital strategies that deliver meaningful results. This teammate will own the full sales cycle - from prospecting and proposal development through campaign execution, partner retention, and account growth - while serving as a trusted marketing advisor.

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to

  • Identify, uncover, and develop new digital advertising partnerships   
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local and regional decision-makers   
  • Create customized, results-driven digital marketing solutions aligned with partner objectives    
  • Present and sell customized solutions across Good Karma Sports' full portfolio of digital, video, streaming, CTV, content, and premium sports offerings
  • Grow and retain an active book of business through consultative selling   
  • Develop deep knowledge of Good Karma Sports’ full digital portfolio and targeting capabilities   
  • Stay current on digital media trends, products, and best practices
  • Effectively uncover marketing challenges and position solutions at all organizational levels, including the C-suite
  • Network within the Cleveland business community to expand market presence and develop new business opportunities   
  • Maintain accurate activity and pipeline reporting using CRM tools   
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to improve new business outreach, partner research, campaign development, communication, and sales effectiveness while maintaining a high level of personalization and partner interaction
  • Other assigned tasks
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to the company core values: Listen, Be Honest, Follow Through, Work Hard, Teamwork and Over Deliver   

   

Preferred knowledge, skills, and qualifications   

  • 3+ years of successful sales experience in digital sales or at an advertising agency
  • Digital and digital video knowledge and experience   
  • Passion for sales and service with an entrepreneurial spirit
  • Demonstrated success meeting and exceeding sales goals with local business owners, CEOs, general managers, and advertising agencies   
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills   
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment 
  • Proficiency in leveraging AI-powered productivity tools and integrations to enhance traditional business applications, including document creation, spreadsheet analysis, presentations, and workflow automation.
  • Occasional travel for out of market partner meetings may be required
  • Valid driver’s license required; in-market partner meetings are an essential function of this role    

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is an exempt role with a competitive base salary plus commission. This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more. This position requires occasional evening and weekend work for events and games, and other partner needs.


Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates can continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing our story and core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  


How to Apply  

Apply by submitting your resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than October 29, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  


About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Home to 3TV, CBS 5, and Arizona’s Family Sports, Arizona’s Family produces 100+ hours of local news and programming every week. 3TV is #1 in Arizona and one of the strongest independent stations in the country. Our CBS station is highly competitive in news and has top-rated sports and prime content. Our digital reach is also best-in-market—Azfamily.com leads the market in multi-platform unique users and is home to Arizona’s Family Originals (long-form programs, documentaries, docuseries, and podcasts, including True Crime Arizona, nearing 2M downloads). Arizona’s Family Sports features premier properties, including the Arizona Cardinals, Phoenix Suns, Phoenix Mercury, Phoenix Rising, and AIA state championships.

Job Summary/Description:  

We are seeking a decisive, high-energy, and exceptionally organized Assignment News Editor to help lead evening news-gathering operations. The ideal candidate is a galvanizing leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses impeccable news judgment, and maintains a calm, collected demeanor under the intense pressure of breaking news. As the central nervous system of our newsroom, you will coordinate our field crews, monitor breaking developments, and collaborate across digital and broadcast platforms to ensure our coverage is fast, accurate, and impactful.

Duties/Key Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

Editorial Leadership & News Judgment:
* Drive the Daily Agenda: Actively monitor scanner traffic, social media, wire services, public records, and viewer tips to identify compelling, original local stories.
* Daily Pitching & Collaboration: Attend daily editorial meetings and pitch story ideas for potential coverage.
* Decisive Prioritization: Exercise sharp, ethical news judgment to determine which stories merit coverage, dispatching crews efficiently to maximize impact.
* Galvanize the Team: Serve as an inspiring and motivating force in the newsroom, encouraging collaboration, high energy, and dedication to our community-first mission.

Operations & Breaking News Management:
* Strategic Logistics: Coordinate daily assignments, scheduling, and logistics for reporters, photographers, and multi-skilled journalists (MSJs).
* The Calm in the Storm: Maintain absolute composure and clear-headed decision-making during breaking news, guiding field crews safely and directing information flow with precision.
* Ability to Pivot: Adapt instantly as news conditions change, seamlessly shifting resources and re-prioritizing stories without losing organizational focus.
* Deadline Performance (A MUST): Demonstrate the ability to meet short deadlines, prioritize assignments, and handle multiple tasks simultaneously with a positive, can-do attitude.

Clear & Collaborative Communication:
* Cross-Platform Integration: Partner closely with Executive Producers, Digital/Streaming Leaders, and the Digital Team to ensure content is optimized for broadcast, web, and streaming platforms.
* Outside Relationship Building: Proactively build and maintain strong professional relationships with outside sources, including public information officers (PIOs), subject experts, and community leaders.
* Concise Dispatching: Deliver clear, brief, and actionable instructions to crews in the field and anchors in the studio.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Hard & Soft Skills:
* Experience: 2+ years of experience in a commercial newsroom (assignment desk, producing, or digital reporting preferred).
* Sharp News Judgment: Deep understanding of defamation laws, journalistic ethics, AP Style, and what makes a story impactful for local audiences.
* High-Volume Multitasking: Able to track multiple moving parts, crews, and short-term deadlines simultaneously under pressure.
* Calm & Collected: Possesses a naturally steady, reassuring presence that stabilizes the newsroom during high-stress breaking news cycles.
* Galvanizing Leadership Style: Known for rallying teams around a shared vision, mentoring emerging talent, and building a positive, collaborative newsroom culture.
* Exceptional Agility: High tolerance for ambiguity and a proven ability to pivot strategies in seconds when the situation demands.

- Maintain alignment with Gray Media corporate IT and broadcast technology initiatives

Qualifications/Requirements:

Desired Qualifications/Requirements:
- Working knowledge of Grass Valley switchers, Evertz, Imagine,& Grass Valley Routers, and ENPS
- Understanding of SDI signal flow, routing, audio distribution, and monitoring systems
- Experience with VMware virtual environments, Windows server, Active Directory, and system backups
- Knowledge of VLANs, routing, and network configuration within a broadcast plant
- Basic understanding of transmitters and RF fundamentals preferred

job.description:

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. About WKTB (Telemundo Atlanta):

Telemundo Atlanta is a premier Spanish-language television station providing award-winning local news and programming. Telemundo Atlanta is available to the Atlanta DMA on a million-watt full-power over-the-air signal on channel 47.1. Telemundo Atlanta has received 61 Emmy® Awards since 2012, including the top honor of Station Excellence in 2013, 2014, 2016, and 2017, and News Excellence in 2017, 2018, and 2019. Telemundo Atlanta was nominated for Best Newscast and News Excellence in 2020. Telemundo Atlanta is the first Spanish-language television station to receive the coveted Overall Station Excellence recognition in Georgia. Telemundo Atlanta produces essential daily local news, which can also be accessed over our website www.telemundoatlanta.com and mobile application.

Job Summary/Description:

Telemundo Atlanta is seeking a dynamic, bilingual, news-driven journalist who is passionate about informing our local community and thrives in a fast-paced, digital-first newsroom. As our Digital Host / Producer, you’ll lead the production of original Spanish-language content for our digital platforms, engage viewers through live streams, and create standout segments that bring audiences coming back. You’ll solo-anchor from our OTT/TV studio and produce digital segments from start to finish, while contributing to daily newsroom operations and helping shape our multiplatform content strategy. If you’re ready to innovate, inform, and make an impact across screens, we want to hear from you.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Produce and anchor multiple daily digital segments or shows for OTT/TV and social platforms in native Spanish.
    • Collaborate with show producers and anchors, assisting with repurposing news content.
    • Post and update local stories and content on web and social platforms.
    • Manage livestream scheduling across digital platforms.
  • Implement livestream best practices to grow and engage the audience.
  • Engage viewers on social media, including maintaining a consistent presence on Facebook Live and Instagram.
    • Build a broad working knowledge of the viewing area, including key people, places, events, and local personalities.
    • Research, gather, shoot, write, and edit stories for broadcast and online publication.
    • Participate in daily editorial meetings and fill in on other newscasts as needed.
    • Report live during breaking news and develop reliable sources of information.
    • Pitch and produce enterprise, hard-news, and research-driven stories under tight deadlines.
    • Apply strong news judgment to story selection and presentation; write clearly and conversationally in native Spanish.
    • Conduct interviews and deliver stories with confidence on camera.
    • Maintain professional and ethical conduct, contribute to a collaborative newsroom, and stay current on local and national news.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• High proficiency in spoken and written Spanish and English.
• At least one year experience of producing digital content.
• Experience with ENPS, Edius, Canva and Adobe preferred.
• BS/BA in journalism or communications preferred.
• Ability to shoot, write, and edit original stories for digital platforms.
• Familiarity with OTT procedures and operations, including platforms like FB and YouTube.
• Strong news judgment, interviewing skills, and on-camera presence.
• Able to work under pressure, meet daily deadlines, and adapt in a high-energy newsroom.
• Positive attitude and team player.
• Valid driver's license.

About WTVG:

WTVG is located in Northwestern Ohio. Our viewers and customers are extremely friendly and down-to-earth. We are a region of proud automotive workers home to Chrysler and GM plants. We are extremely passionate about our collegiate sports teams, including The Ohio State University Buckeyes, the University of Michigan Wolverines, the University of Toledo Rockets, and the Bowling Green University Falcons.

We enjoy all four seasons and the activities that come with each. Nature is always a short distance away, with many surrounding parks and Lake Erie for recreation. The roller coaster capital of the world, Cedar Point, is just a short drive from the television station. We have two minor league sports teams. The Toledo Mud Hens have a rich baseball history and loyal following. Not to be outdone are the fans of our hockey team, the Toledo Walleye. We also love our food. There are many outstanding restaurants and local festivals throughout the year.

Since 1948, generations of families have grown up counting on WTVG to be a window to their world on-air and now digitally. Our people, on-air and behind the scenes, are trusted friends and neighbors in the community. job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WSAW:

WSAW is Wausau's first TV station, debuting 71 years ago in 1954. Together, WSAW/WZAW produce more than 30 hours of news each week. We work hard and celebrate our wins. In 2026, the news team was recognized as the Wisconsin Broadcasters Association "News Operation of the Year" and also the small-market "Station of the Year" (for coverage airing in 2025). Also in 2026, WSAW's podcast "Wisconsin Cold Cases: Who Killed Gerald Mork?" was honored with a Regional Edward R. Murrow Award. These are just a few examples of the honors WSAW has received in recent years.

North Central Wisconsin is also known as "Wisconsin's Basecamp." In Wausau, you will live and work where thousands of people come to vacation each year. Whether you're skiing down the slopes of Granite Peak, boating on Lake Du Bay, or enjoying Concerts on the Square or a show at The Grand Theater in downtown Wausau, there's something for everyone, and you will enjoy the community we serve. Wausau is also located within 3 hours or less of Minneapolis, Milwaukee, and Green Bay; and is just a two-hour drive from Madison, the state's capital city.

WSAW's viewing area covers 11 counties, including the cities of Stevens Point, Wisconsin Rapids, Marshfield, Rhinelander, and the summer retreat hotspot of Minocqua. WSAW is dedicated to serving the community and does so through several weeks-long campaigns such as Share Your Holidays and the annual Diaper Drive.

Job Summary/Description:

Have you ever wondered what it's like to be at the heart of a newsroom where digital isn't just an afterthought - it's the priority? WSAW is looking for a Digital Content Creator who can own the story from the first alert to the last update, ensuring our audience stays connected on every screen.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Own breaking news: Move with lightning speed to send push notifications and update web stories as news unfolds.
- Craft compelling narratives: Write and produce dynamic digital news content that stops the scroll and keeps our audience informed.
- Drive social engagement: Manage our social media presence by posting timely updates and creating content specifically for our digital communities.
- Manage the hub: Split your time between the assignment desk and content creation, helping decide what we cover and how we share it.
- Create multimedia assets: Produce video, photo galleries, and live streams that add depth and visual punch to our local reporting.
- Collaborate for impact: Work closely with crews and producers to ensure our digital voice is consistent, professional, and approachable.
- Lead the charge on digital-only newscast: WSAW produces 715 Live, the only current digital-only newscast in the market. The chosen applicant will produce and anchor the p.m. version of this show.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- College degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or a related field.
- Previous experience in a professional newsroom environment is preferred, but we are willing to train the right candidate.
- Availability for weekend hours; willingness to work flexible shifts for breaking news, specialized coverage, or covering a colleague's PTO.
- A genuine desire to win, the ability to reflect on your work, and a willingness to apply feedback.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with solid knowledge of AP Style *and writing conversationally for Broadcast.
- Ability to edit video in digital formats.
- Proficiency with Photoshop, Canva, or comparable software to create and edit graphics.
- Ability to work well under pressure and collaborate effectively with a diverse team.
- Strong understanding of journalistic principles and ethics.
- Ability to balance long- and short-term projects while consistently meeting daily deadlines.
- Proven record of digital and social media success; must maintain a responsible and professional social media presence.
- Strong research skills and the ability to employ critical thinking to dig beyond the press release and verify incoming tips.
- Ability to carry 35+ pounds of equipment.
- Valid driver's license with a clean driving record (Motor Vehicle Records check required).

Job Summary/Description:

WNEM is looking for a forward-thinking, high-energy Digital Content Manager to lead our growing digital operation and oversee the creation and publishing of content across all WNEM multimedia platforms. This role will drive audience engagement and expand CTV/streaming performance, while ensuring the station stays ahead of digital best practices and emerging trends—including SEO and social strategy.

As part of the newsroom leadership team, the Digital Content Manager helps deliver accurate, timely, and compelling content for a diverse audience. The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer and communicator who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Write and publish breaking and enterprise coverage across WNEM’s digital and various social platforms.
- Lead the collection and verification of user-generated content and produce enterprise/interactive storytelling, including interactive maps, infographics, special online streams, and CTV shows.

- Lead and coach a team of digital content creators, ensuring they are trained, supported, and meeting goals.
- Collaborate closely with reporters, producers, and newsroom staff to identify breaking news, trends, and features for digital distribution.
- Manage content flow by prioritizing coverage and monitoring all digital channels to ensure timely, accurate publication.
- Coordinate with marketing and promotions to align digital strategy with station-wide initiatives.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Minimum 3 years of experience developing, creating, and executing content for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.
- Knowledge of SEO best practices and social media strategy.
- Familiarity with digital publishing tools and content management systems (CMS).
- BS/BA in Journalism/Communications or equivalent experience.
- Demonstrated ability to evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, including AI’s role in SEO optimization.

Preferred:
