KTVF (NBC-affiliate and flagship station celebrating 70+ years of broadcasting), KXDF (CBS-affiliate), and KFXF (Gray Sports Network) are Interior Alaska's most viewed and respected commercial broadcast stations. Collectively, we serve our community with important news, information, and entertainment both on-air and digitally. This group of stations also places an important emphasis on community service with year round campaigns directly benefiting area non-profit organizations.

Job Summary/Description:  

The digital marketing & content producer is a dual-impact role designed to integrate on-air station promotion, community branding, and multi-platform digital execution. This role drives audience engagement and station brand loyalty by planning and executing creative station marketing campaigns while actively producing, packaging and managing digital-first content across station websites, mobile apps, social media channels, and FAST/streaming properties.

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but are not limited to):

• On-Air & Cross-Platform Promotion: Conceive, write, produce, and edit high-impact on-air topical promos, image campaigns, sports programming spots, and station initiative announcements.

    o Experience with enterprise Content Management Systems (CMS) and social media publishing suites.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or equivalent practical experience.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

About KLTV:

KLTV is the dominant station in the Tyler/Longview, TX area of East Texas. We are an ABC affiliate and have been #1 by every ratings measure, uninterrupted in every newscast for 30+ years. We also have a very powerful, dominant digital presence in the market. We are a leader in the industry in digital innovation and digital products--operating and populating 11 different apps and producing an 19-hour a 19-hour-a-day live streaming news service from our newsroom on OTT, desktop, and on our mobile apps.

Modern facility. Top-notch equipment. Experienced News Managers. Positive, encouraging workplace with an emphasis on teaching job skills and journalism. Dominant station preparing for the future in a very powerful company in this industry. We believe we are among the best newsrooms in the country.

Job Summary/Description:

This is a unique position. For the last nine years, KLTV/KTRE has operated a successful, live digital broadcast from our newsroom. Thousands watch each day as our hosts report news as it is breaking, live from our newsroom. East Texas Now is live, local news and talk 19 hours a day and in operation seven days a week. This is an established, mature streaming production that has served as the model for many others in the industry.

The hosts produce, present, and technically direct their shows every day using a special interface developed for and with the input of KLTV/KTRE. East Texas Now is live each day on desktop, mobile devices, in our apps, and on Amazon Fire and Roku OTT devices. East Texas Now even has its own dedicated app with integrated chat that allows viewers to interact with the host. If you can talk, love breaking news, and are technically inclined to multitask while talking in front of one of multiple cameras, this is an exciting, groundbreaking position.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Handle Breaking News
- Talk to reporters and news makers via FaceTime and Skype
- Self-direct the show
- Set up and coordinate guests for in-studio or remote appearances
- Plan content for each day
- Perform "live read" commercials from the East Texas Now desk
- Talk a lot!

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Competence in reporting live, online, and on air
- Reporting on digital platforms, often live via FaceTime or Skype
- Setting up guests and reporters
- Computer skills
- Position generally alternates schedules dayside/nightside weekly
- Experience in talk radio is a plus

In 2026, KFVS was named Missouri Medium Market Station of the Year.

Job Summary/Description:

An Engineering Supervisor is comfortable with RF broadcast equipment and transmitters, as well as IP-based newsgathering and IT infrastructure. You will be the backbone of our technical operations, ensuring our content reaches our community on every screen, every time.

Assist the Chief Engineer in directing our engineering, IT, and facilities teams to keep our stations performing at their best. Oversee installation and maintenance of equipment. Ensure safety and compliance. Bridge the gap between traditional broadcast and modern IP communication, making sure our content flows seamlessly across all platforms.

· Lead the technical charge: Assist the Chief Engineer in directing our engineering, IT, and facilities teams to keep the station at the top of its game.
· Own the infrastructure: Oversee the installation and maintenance of everything from audio/video switchers to critical IT systems and RF equipment.
· Manage the daily grind: Help with management of a diverse team of engineers, IT pros, and technical media producers to ensure seamless 24/7 operations.
· Ensure safety and compliance: Serve as a guardian of our standards, potentially acting as the Safety Coordinator and ensuring we’re always in line with FCC and OSHA regulations.
· Drive digital integration: Bridge the gap between traditional broadcast and modern IP communication, making sure our content flows seamlessly across all platforms.
· Support the bottom line: Assist with the preparation and maintenance of the departmental budget to keep our technical operations running efficiently.

· Broadcast expertise: You have 5+ years of experience in a broadcast engineering environment (field operations and IP news-gathering experience is a huge plus!).
· Technical versatility: You’re a pro with digital broadcast equipment—transmitters, encoders, automation systems, and audio consoles are your second language.
· A calm-under-pressure mindset: You can manage multiple tight deadlines and make clear, smart decisions when things get stressful or unexpected.
· Problem-solving DNA: You have a deep understanding of both serial and IP communication and a knack for project management.
· Educational foundation: A bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or IT is great, but we also value equivalent real-world experience that proves you know your stuff.
· Flexibility: You understand that news doesn’t stop at 5 PM; you’re ready to support a 24/7 operation, including occasional nights, weekends, and on-call shifts.
· A valid driver’s license: You’re ready to head to the transmitter site or into the field whenever the job calls.

Why You’ll Love It Here:
· Innovation at the core: You’ll work with cutting-edge technology in an environment that is constantly evolving to meet the needs of a multi-platform audience.
· Real community impact: Your work ensures that vital news and information reach our neighbors when they need it most.
· A supportive team: Join a group of passionate professionals who value scrappiness, empathy, and high-fives as much as technical precision.
· Growth opportunities: At Gray Media, we don’t just maintain equipment; we grow careers and invest in our people.

Ready to lead the future of broadcast technology? Let’s build something great together.

About WILX:

Gray Media Lansing (WILX-WSYM) News 10, home of the highly rated NBC and FOX affiliates in Lansing, Michigan, is on a dynamic growth trajectory. Our combined operations produce over 50 hours of local news per week—and counting. We are Mid-Michigan's undisputed media leader, home to Emmy Award-winning journalists, the Michigan Association of Broadcasters’ “Station of the Year,” your exclusive home for the Detroit Lions on FOX 47, and home to Studio 10, our popular daily local lifestyle show. Alongside our powerhouse primary stations, our family of channels includes MeTV (10.2) and the regional Great Lakes Sports & Entertainment Network (47.2).

Beyond traditional broadcast, we are a true 24/7 multi-platform powerhouse. Through www.News10Lansing.com and our dedicated News 10 and First Alert Weather apps, and our continuous livestreaming channel News10+, our audience stays connected to trusted local coverage whenever and wherever they need it.
We are a breaking news and weather-first station with a fierce commitment to original, local reporting. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. It is a vibrant, diverse, stable, and highly affordable region that offers an outstanding quality of life. Lansing is ideally located just an hour from Grand Rapids and downtown Detroit, and is perfect for day trips “up north” to explore some of the most beautiful scenic spots in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, craft breweries, local wineries, Broadway shows, Big Ten sports, minor-league baseball, and professional NFL, NBA, and NHL games... Michigan has it all! Come grow your career with our winning, forward-thinking team.

Job Summary/Description:

WILX-WSYM, the dominant news leader in Lansing, Michigan, is seeking an experienced, dynamic News Executive Producer/Anchor to lead and host “The 517 Report”, a new local newscast focused on the mid-Michigan market. This is a leadership role for a hands-on journalist who wants to shape a new program from the ground up, combining editorial leadership with a primary on-air presence. 

The ideal candidate will oversee all aspects of newscast production, manage the daily editorial workflow, and anchor the show. A key component of this role is conducting high-impact, live and pre-recorded interviews with local newsmakers, business leaders, and community voices on the most critical issues and events affecting viewers across Ingham, Jackson, Eaton, and Clinton counties. 

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

• Lead the editorial vision, content development, and production of a new local newscast focused on the Lansing and Jackson communities — ensuring high standards of journalism, production quality, and brand consistency.
• Oversee the daily editorial direction of the newscast. Collaborate closely with producers to shape daily content, review scripts, and deliver dynamic newscasts.
• Coach and mentor newsroom staff, providing constructive feedback.
• Anchor newscasts with high energy, credibility, authority, and a conversational delivery.
• Schedule, prepare, and conduct compelling in-depth interviews with local newsmakers, public officials, and community leaders on major issues.
• Pitch, research, write, and produce compelling local news stories.
• Deliver live reports from the field and in-studio during breaking news and severe weather events.
• Publish engaging, timely content to the station’s website, mobile app, and social media channels.
• Conduct live interviews with local newsmakers, community leaders, and experts.
• Represent the station professionally at community events and station initiatives.
• Maintain a collaborative, team-first attitude in the newsroom.
• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• At least two years of professional television news anchoring and reporting experience.
• Proven ability to manage, motivate, and collaborate with a diverse team of journalists and production professionals under tight deadlines.
• Strong news judgment, deep knowledge of journalism ethics, and excellent writing skills for on-air and digital platforms.
• Excellent on-air presence, exceptional ad-libbing and interviewing skills, and a calm, decisive demeanor during live breaking news and unscripted coverage.
• Experience with standard newsroom computer systems (such as ENPS), non-linear video editing (such as Edius), website content publishing, and social media platforms.
• Ability to work a demanding early-morning schedule.
• Valid driver’s license and a good driving record are required.

WEAU 13 News, the NBC affiliate in Eau Claire, Wisconsin, is the dominant news organization serving western Wisconsin. Owned by Gray Media Inc., we are a market leader in news, digital, and social media, broadcasting to 14 counties across western Wisconsin and southeastern Minnesota in the Eau Claire-La Crosse market (Nielsen DMA #129) across linear, streaming, digital, and social.

We are committed to earning and keeping the public's trust through accurate, transparent, and unbiased journalism across every platform — broadcast, digital, mobile, streaming, and social.

Located about 90 miles east of Minneapolis-St. Paul, Eau Claire is a growing community offering affordable housing, great schools, strong regional health care including Mayo Clinic Health System, a vibrant arts and indie music scene anchored by UW-Eau Claire and Pablo Center at the Confluence, and abundant outdoor recreation with 35+ miles of trails and local rivers.

 Job Summary/Description: 

WEAU-TV in Eau Claire, WI, is seeking an accomplished, dynamic General Manager to oversee all station operations, including Digital and Linear Spot Sales, Marketing and Sales Management, Linear and Digital News Content Development, and Newsroom Operations. The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking strategist with proven management experience driving growth through strategic planning, collaboration, and team development. We are looking for a mentor and motivator who can inspire managers and staff while navigating the evolving media landscape with agility and vision.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

WEAU is seeking a community-focused, growth-driven General Manager to lead a fully functioning multi-platform station in a highly competitive market, operating in Gray's decentralized, local-first culture.

* Growth & Performance:
- Own all revenue and audience performance: broadcast, digital, CTV/OTT/streaming, sponsorship, political, and new business development.
- Develop and execute strategic and operating plans for audience and revenue growth across linear, streaming, and social, aligned to WEAU's local brand.
- Manage pricing, inventory, and yield in partnership with Sales leadership; drive digital agency growth and new direct business.

* Content & Product:
- Lead multi-platform content strategy with News leadership: trusted local journalism, live/breaking, weather, sports, and community storytelling.
- Drive streaming and social video growth using data: Nielsen, Comscore, and digital analytics to test, measure, scale, or sunset initiatives.
- Ensure responsible innovation, including compliance with Gray's Generative AI Policy: all Gray-originated news content is created by humans, approved vendors only, with transparency and human oversight.

- Lead with positive motivation, direction, and accountability. Foster a collaborative, high-performance, team-based environment.
- Recruit, develop, engage, and retain top talent; own succession planning and training and development at all levels.
- Build trust and belonging; uphold Gray Media's Employee Handbook with the highest ethical standards.

- Champion local service, community events, and partnerships that strengthen brand equity.

About WLBT:

WLBT is Mississippi's flagship television station and the clear #1 local TV and digital media brand in Central Mississippi. As an NBC affiliate, WLBT consistently delivers award-winning local news coverage, and we keep our viewers safe and informed with the most accurate First Alert Weather team. Located in the state's largest TV market and capital city, our area features top-tier museums, multiple universities, and the state's leading medical facilities, including the renowned University of Mississippi Medical Center. With Mississippi's mild climate, outdoor recreation is a way of life, supported by an extensive network of walking, running, and cycling trails throughout the metro. Sports fans will feel right at home here. Our DMA includes two SWAC programs, Jackson State and Alcorn State, and fans of SEC athletics are near four powerhouse schools: Ole Miss, Mississippi State, Alabama, and LSU. Pro sports are close by as well, with Saints and Pelicans action in New Orleans and Grizzlies games in Memphis.

Job Summary/Description:

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented Graphics Artist to support our newsroom's daily and long-term visual storytelling. This position will be responsible for creating compelling motion graphics for newscasts, digital platforms, and special coverage, while also helping edit and refine headlines for daily newscasts.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Create motion graphics, animations, opens, transitions, explainer graphics, maps, charts, and other visual elements for newsroom content.
- Build graphics for daily newscasts, breaking news, severe weather coverage, investigations, elections, sports, and special projects.
- Manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
- Work closely with producers, anchors, reporters, photographers, digital teams, and newsroom managers to support daily coverage.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Experience creating motion graphics, animations, or video graphics for broadcast, digital, social, or related media.
- Excellent attention to detail, especially with spelling, grammar, names, locations, and facts.
- Ability to work well under deadline pressure.
- Experience with Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar creative software.

KFVS12 is the #1 local TV station serving as the CBS/CW/MeTV/Outlaw/Telemundo/Oxygen/GRIT affiliate in the Cape Girardeau, Missouri/Paducah, Kentucky/Harrisburg, Illinois market. Founded in 1954, KFVS12 has a rich heritage of serving "America's Heartland" with the best local news and weather information, along with a legacy of community service and disaster relief. KFVS12 produces more local news than any other station in the market, currently offering over 50 hours of news content every week, along with special high-profile, topical local programming. Heartland News on KFVS12 consistently leads the competition in award-winning journalism having been honored this year with numerous Missouri and Illinois Broadcasters' Awards as well as the prestigious Edward R. Murrow Awards.

The Cape Girardeau market covers 45 counties in four states and is home to four division-one universities. It is where the North meets the South and the East meets the West. The area is rich with many diverse communities, including historic riverfront towns, that offer a variety of unique benefits and recreational opportunities. The station has an exceptional staff that is committed to maintaining the legacy of the institution of KFVS. They are forward-thinking with news coverage in on-air newscasts and 24/7 on numerous digital platforms, consistently leading the competition in digital traffic across the board. WKYT-TV is home to the CBS and CW affiliates in beautiful Lexington, KY. The station sits amongst picturesque horse farms in the Thoroughbred Capital of the World.

The Lexington DMA (#63) provides a competitive news environment, and WKYT has emerged as the news leader, producing 11.5 hours of news per day. Our team of award-winning professionals thrives in a fast-paced, yet fun, environment.

Lexington is home to a thriving downtown scene, phenomenal restaurants and breweries, and, of course, Keeneland Race Course, the most beautiful horse track you'll ever visit. For outdoor enthusiasts, Red River Gorge and the Appalachian Mountains are calling your name. And in the summers, Lake Cumberland is just a short drive south to get your boating fix.

Lexington is home to the University of Kentucky, where basketball is a way of life! Once you see a game at historic Rupp Arena, your life will never be the same!

Job Summary/Description:

WKYT is looking for an innovative producer/host for its talk and lifestyle program called "Everyday Kentucky."

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a program produced by the station's news department. The "Everyday Kentucky" producer /host works closely with the on-air talent, production department, sales team, and marketing and digital teams in creating compelling lifestyle content on-air and across digital platforms.

The "Everyday Kentucky" producer will create, lead, and organize content utilizing strong editorial, journalistic, organizational, and communication skills. • Multi-Platform Digital Strategy: Adapt broadcast content into highly engaging web articles and social media assets (reels, video clips, and social posts) to build a robust digital footprint for the show.
• On-Camera Presence: Conduct interviews or present segments on-air.
• Journalistic Standards: Ensure all show elements maintain high editorial and journalistic standards, keeping local community connections at the heart of the broadcast.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field (required).

Technical Skills:
o Knowledge of and ability to operate state-of-the-art television newsroom and production equipment.
o Proficiency with digital CMS platforms for website publishing.
o Non-linear video editing skills (Premiere, EDIUS, or similar) are highly preferred.

 Core Strengths:
o A proven self-starter with exceptional organizational and time-management skills.
o Excellent written and verbal communication, with an ability to work quickly and decisively under daily broadcast deadlines.
o Passion for local community storytelling, food, travel, and lifestyle topics in Central and Eastern Kentucky.

Requirements: Must possess a valid driver's license and a clean driving record.

job.title: MEDIA EXECUTIVE - KSFY/KDLT (SIOUX FALLS)
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KSFY/KDLT:

Sioux Falls and the surrounding area remain one of the fastest-growing regions in the Upper Midwest and are home to 300,000 people, constituting more than 30% of the state's population. Healthcare and finance make up much of a diverse and broad workforce. The business climate in South Dakota continues to be one of the top in the nation, fueled by no state income tax and a diverse workforce.

There is never a shortage of activities or events, with summers packed with outdoor festivals and concerts, including free concerts at the Levitt at the Falls outdoor music venue.

Still, many also enjoy the city’s nearly 30 miles of bike trails and parks, including the namesake of the city, the beautiful waterfalls of the Big Sioux River! Yes, winters can be challenging, but it does not mean people hibernate. Colder temperatures provide plenty of outdoor and indoor activities all winter long. From parades like the annual Parade of Lights down Phillips Avenue to outdoor ice skating parks, life does not slow down in the winter in Sioux Falls.

The city is home to a 12,000-seat arena that is continually hosting major events and entertainment acts, ranging from the Professional Bull Riders, college and semi-professional hockey, indoor football, to concerts with names like Paul McCartney, Garth Brooks, and Elton John.

The city is also home to a new indoor aquatic center, an indoor ice-skating facility, a basketball arena, and an indoor tennis complex. Multiple award-winning golf courses, both public and private, surround the city, offering a relaxing and challenging day on the links

Culinary appetites never need to look far from being satiated, as there is no shortage of places to eat. Not only is Sioux Falls home to many familiar restaurant chains, but it’s also known for many great locally owned, nationally recognized restaurants and restaurateurs. For those looking for a quick weekend getaway, nothing to fear. You can drive to Omaha in three hours, Minneapolis in four, and the Black Hills in five. Since Sioux Falls is centrally located in the Midwest, direct and connecting flights to almost anywhere in the United States are often less than a few hours in length.

Dakota News Now is an award-winning television operation serving viewers in the eastern half of South Dakota as well as portions of southwest Minnesota and northwest Iowa. The stations operate from a relatively new studio in downtown Sioux Falls, branding all stations under the Dakota News Now umbrella. The facilities put Dakota News Now on the cutting edge of television and news gathering technology, making it one of the most state-of-the-art television stations in the market and the region. The Dakota News Now team produces 36 hours of news each week.

Some of our employees have been here for more than 25 years. For others, this is their first job out of college. It’s a great mix that gives us different perspectives while covering the news and assisting local clientele in achieving their marketing goals.

Learn more about Dakota News Now & Sioux Falls here: https://www.dakotanewsnow.com/page/ksfykdlt-careers/

About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KSFY/KDLT:

Sioux Falls is one of the fastest-growing cities in the Upper Midwest and is home to more than 220,000 people. Healthcare and finance make up much of the workforce in Sioux Falls. There is never a shortage of things to do here. Summers are packed with outdoor festivals and concert events. Many also enjoy the city’s nearly 30 miles of bike trails; be sure to stop by the beautiful waterfalls of the Big Sioux River! And winter doesn’t mean people hibernate; there are plenty of outdoor and indoor activities all winter long. In 2014, the city built a 12,000 seat area that has hosted everything from PBR events, hockey and indoor football, to concerts with names like Paul McCartney, Carrie Underwood and Elton John. The city is also home to a new indoor aquatic center, indoor ice skating facility, basketball arena, and an indoor tennis complex. There is no shortage of places to eat either. Not only is Sioux Falls home to many familiar restaurant chains, but it’s also known for many great locally-owned restaurants. And if you want to get away for the weekend, you can drive to Omaha in three hours, Minneapolis in four, and the Black Hills in five.

KSFY/KDLT is an award-winning television operation serving viewers in the eastern half of South Dakota as well as portions of southwest Minnesota and northwest Iowa. The stations operate from a new studio in downtown Sioux Falls as one rebranded organization called Dakota News Now. The facilities put Dakota News Now on the cutting edge of television and news gathering technology, making it one of the most state-of-the-art television stations in the market and the region. This isn't just about reading a map; it's about owning the screen—whether it's a 65-inch TV in a living room or a 6-inch phone in someone's hand. Job Summary/Description:

Be a journalist who can truly do it all! We’re looking for a high-energy, multi-talented storyteller to join KNOP-TV in North Platte, Nebraska. This isn't a "stay in your lane" kind of job. From the anchor desk to the sidelines, and from breaking news to live weather updates, you will master every facet of modern media across broadcast and streaming platforms.

• Screen presence: Whether you’re behind the anchor desk or live on a smartphone in the field, you bring charisma, clarity, and a digital-first mindset.
• Technical curiosity: You’re ready to master ENG gear, non-linear editing (Edius), and newsroom systems (ENPS) to produce professional content on tight deadlines.
• Storytelling chops: You have a degree in journalism (or equivalent experience) and a passion for finding the "why" behind every story.
• Composure under pressure: When news breaks, you’re the calm in the storm, able to synthesize facts quickly and go live at a moment’s notice.

About WILX:

Gray Media Lansing (WILX-WSYM) News 10, home of the highly rated NBC and FOX affiliates in Lansing, Michigan, is on a dynamic growth trajectory. Our combined operations produce over 50 hours of local news per week—and counting. We are Mid-Michigan's undisputed media leader, home to Emmy Award-winning journalists, the Michigan Association of Broadcasters’ “Station of the Year,” your exclusive home for the Detroit Lions on FOX 47, and home to Studio 10, our popular daily local lifestyle show. Alongside our powerhouse primary stations, our family of channels includes MeTV (10.2) and the regional Great Lakes Sports & Entertainment Network (47.2).

Beyond traditional broadcast, we are a true 24/7 multi-platform powerhouse. Through www.News10Lansing.com and our dedicated News 10 and First Alert Weather apps, and our continuous livestreaming channel News10+, our audience stays connected to trusted local coverage whenever and wherever they need it.
We are a breaking news and weather-first station with a fierce commitment to original, local reporting. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. Enjoy all four seasons in the booming Greater Mankato metropolitan area. The friendly, welcoming region is a happy mix of city and country living. We maintain the most highly visited social media sites in southern Minnesota.

Job Summary/Description:  

KEYC News Now is searching for that rare talent who can not only chase down a story but also command the anchor desk and produce a killer newscast. If you're a storyteller who thrives on urgency, connects deeply with people, and sees every platform—from broadcast to TikTok—as an opportunity to inform, then get ready to make your mark. We're talking about owning the news from concept to air (and online!), delivering content that truly resonates with our viewers.

Ready to report and help anchor for a station that truly impacts its community? We want to hear from you!

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

What You'll Do:
* Create compelling content: Report, shoot, write, voice, and edit daily news stories for both television and our buzzing digital platforms, making sure every piece is relevant and engaging.
* Lead the newscast: Anchor and produce dynamic newscasts as needed, bringing energy and authority to every broadcast and ensuring our viewers are informed and connected.
* Own the story cycle: From generating 3+ fresh story ideas daily to breaking news live on location, you'll be the force driving our local coverage.
* Drive digital engagement: Master social media and online news production, updating our website and social accounts throughout the day with urgency and immediacy.
* Connect with the community: Build authentic relationships and truly "think like a viewer," delivering news that matters most to the local community.
* Collaborate seamlessly: Work hand-in-hand with the news team, bringing a great attitude and leadership skills to every shift, even when schedules shift.
* Uphold our standards: Adhere to the highest standards of news judgment, ethics, and station branding in all content you create.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:
* A Bachelor's Degree in Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field—you've got the foundation.
* Proven broadcast journalism experience: You know the rhythm of a newsroom and the demands of live television.
* Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills: You craft balanced, clear, and concise copy that grabs attention.
* A true digital-first mindset: You don't just understand digital/social media strategy; you execute it with urgency.
* Sharp news judgment and unwavering ethics: You know what's important and how to tell the story responsibly.
* The grit to go get the story: Able to carry 35-45 pounds of ENG equipment and ready to cover anything from features to breaking news.
* Impeccable time management skills and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines.
* Integrity, accountability, and a team-player attitude—you make the newsroom better.
* A valid driver's license and a clean driving record—you're ready to hit the road when news breaks.
* Flexibility to work various schedules, as news doesn't always keep regular hours.

Why You'll Love It Here:
* Multi-faceted impact: This isn't just a job; it's a chance to truly shape local news across all platforms.
* Community connection: You'll be at the forefront of stories that matter, building real relationships within the KEYC News Now community.
* Dynamic environment: One day you're digging deep into a feature, the next you're live on breaking news. Every day is different, and every day is exciting.
* Competitive compensation: We offer a salary/wage of $20-23 per hour (DOE), reflecting your valuable experience and versatility.
* Be part of the future: Gray Media is committed to innovation, and you'll be a key player in how we deliver news in a digital-first world.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who is naturally curious about the world around you? KTTC in Rochester, MN, is looking for a high-energy Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) who is ready to start their career by making a real impact. We’re not just looking for an employee; we’re looking for a storyteller who is eager to share facts, seek the truth, and own the news cycle across every screen—from the TV in the living room to the phone in the palm of a viewer's hand.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

What You'll Do:

• Own the news cycle: Gather, shoot, and edit high-impact content for multiple platforms, ensuring our audience stays informed.
• Pitch with purpose: Come ready to the editorial meeting with researched ideas pitched through Microsoft Teams. You’ll have already made the calls and prearranged interviews to hit the ground running.
• Master the multi-platform: Write and adapt stories for different screens—from the morning news to quick social updates and deep-dive web articles.
• Report live from the scene: Be the first on the ground when news breaks, delivering authoritative and calm live reports that keep our viewers connected.
• Verify and validate: Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and deep research—because accuracy is our foundation.
• Manage your time: Take charge of your daily workflow—from getting out the door for fresh video to editing your final masterpiece before the deadline hits.
• Stay agile: Update stories as they evolve and be ready to fill in on different shifts when the news demands it.

Why You'll Love It Here:

• A launchpad for your career: Join a young, energetic newsroom led by anchors with decades of experience who are eager to mentor the next generation of journalists.
• Growth every day: We believe feedback should happen in real time, not just during a yearly review. You’ll grow faster here than anywhere else.
• Innovation focus: KTTC is evolving on purpose—we’re serious about the future of media and want you to help shape it.
• Community impact: Tell stories that actually matter to the people of Rochester and the surrounding area.
• Supportive culture: We value scrappiness and digital innovation, but we also value our people. You’ll have the tools and the team to do your best work.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:

• The mindset: Above all else, a relentless desire to learn, seek the truth, and share stories that matter.
• Strong writing chops: You craft scripts and articles that are tight, clear, and compelling (AP style is your best friend).
• Technical potential: While we can teach you to shoot and edit video, a familiarity with camera equipment and systems like ENPS or Edius is a great head start.
• Self-motivated hustle: The ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment without breaking a sweat.
• Versatility: You can manage multiple projects at once and pivot quickly when breaking news hits.
• A valid driver’s license: You’re ready to hit the road and go where the story takes you.
• Human qualities: Empathy for the stories you tell, urgency in how you tell them, and the flexibility to roll with the punches of a dayside shift.

Ready to start your journey and own the news cycle in Rochester? Let’s create something amazing together.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WEAU:

WEAU News is the dominant news organization serving western Wisconsin. We are committed to earning and keeping the public’s trust through accurate, transparent, and unbiased journalism. We deliver essential local news across every platform our audience uses — digital, mobile, streaming, and broadcast — and we take that responsibility seriously.

Job Summary/Description:  

WEAU News is hiring an evening anchor to help lead a digital-first newsroom serving Eau Claire, La Crosse, and western Wisconsin. Our goal is to be the premier multi-platform news organization in the state, putting streaming, on-demand video, mobile alerts, and social media at the center of how our audience connects with us.
The most valuable trait for this role is ownership. When news breaks, we expect our anchors to ensure WEAU owns the story with speed, accuracy, and strong news judgment across all platforms. This is a high-visibility role that demands excellence, adaptability, and unwavering editorial integrity.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Storytelling & Digital Execution (Primary Focus):
• Write for Different Platforms: Write clear, accurate, and engaging copy adapted specifically for each platform, seamlessly shifting styles between broadcast scripts, in-depth web articles, quick-strike push alerts, and social media.
• Digital-First Storytelling: Commit to immediate digital delivery, including creating platform-native vertical videos, mobile-optimized clips, and real-time text updates during active news events.
• Audience-Focused Engagement: Publish stories, video clips, and breaking developments to the station website, app, and social channels with compelling, attention-getting framing that avoids clickbait and maintains our high standards of trust.
• Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Apply strong SEO best practices, including keyword optimization, clear headline writing, and metadata tagging to maximize the reach and searchability of our local reporting.
• Collaboration: Work closely with digital producers and editors to ensure accuracy, speed, and editorial integrity online.

On-Air & Streaming Performance:
• Anchor afternoon and evening newscasts, breaking news cut-ins, and streaming segments with consistent quality.
• Conduct compelling, live interviews with newsmakers, experts, and community leaders across both broadcast and digital platforms.
• Pivot seamlessly during breaking news, delivering timely updates for streaming, mobile alerts, and social media feeds.
• Maintain a professional, credible, and engaging on-air presence tailored to each distribution platform.

Newscast Production & Story Development:
• Collaborate with producers on story selection, rundown stacking, and digital-first coverage plans.
• Pitch and develop unique local stories that resonate in mobile, social, and streaming environments.
• Participate in daily editorial meetings with a sharp focus on multiplatform distribution.
• Review and approve copy, ensuring all scripts meet strict standards for accuracy, clarity, and digital optimization.
• Produce newscasts and assist with video editing when necessary.
• Contribute original reporting, including special in-field coverage and digital-exclusive projects.

Community Engagement:
• Engage with viewers across on-air, streaming, social media, and in-person channels.
• Represent WEAU at community events, station partnerships, and public appearances.
• Monitor and respond to audience feedback to help shape coverage based on local needs and emerging digital trends.

Skills & Competencies:
• Digital Audience Engagement: Skilled at writing high-performance, attention-getting headlines and social copy that drive traffic while strictly upholding traditional editorial standards and avoiding sensationalism or clickbait.
• Multiplatform Writing: Expert ability to pivot writing styles, structure, and length to fit the specific constraints and audience expectations of web, social, mobile app, and broadcast.
• Digital Video Strategy: Fluent in the use and optimization of digital video, including horizontal streaming formats, platform-native vertical video, and social teasers.
• Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Strong understanding of search trends, Google News ranking factors, and keyword placement to increase the digital footprint of local stories.
• Leadership: Sets the tone for digital-forward coverage and positively influences newsroom culture.
• Adaptability: Thrives under the pressure of breaking news, rapid updates, and shifting multiplatform demands.
• Collaboration: Works seamlessly with producers, reporters, photojournalists, and digital teams.
• News Judgment: Makes sound, ethical editorial decisions with strong digital instincts.
• Integrity: Upholds strict ethical standards, never compromising accuracy for speed.
• Resilience: Successfully manages a demanding evening schedule and the fast pace of live television and digital news.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Previous anchoring and/or reporting experience in a professional, multiplatform newsroom.
• Proven track record of digital content creation, including writing for the web and producing native social media videos.
• Strong writing and copy-editing skills with a complete mastery of AP Style.
• Demonstrated experience with SEO best practices and digital analytics tools.
• Excellent on-camera presence with a natural, conversational, and authoritative delivery.
• Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or a related field.
• Deep knowledge of journalism ethics, public records laws, and source verification practices.
• A valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

Job Summary/Description:

WOWT First Alert 6 is looking for an experienced, dynamic Morning Anchor to lead the market's largest morning newscast. Our morning block runs on broadcast and streaming from 4:30 am to 7 am, then continues streaming-only from 7 am to 9 am — making this the most expansive morning franchise in the market. This is not a read-the-prompter role. We want someone who is deeply invested in the news, brings strong editorial instincts to the desk, and is an active presence in the newsroom every day.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Lead our morning newscasts — anchoring on broadcast and streaming from 4:30 am to 7 am, and continuing streaming from 7 am to 9 am — with authority, credibility, and a strong First Alert presence.

• Champion the First Alert brand on-air and in the newsroom, modeling urgency, accuracy, and viewer-focused storytelling.
• Respond to breaking news with confidence and composure, leading coverage live on-air and across platforms.
• Own our extended streaming block from 7 am to 9 am, delivering compelling, viewer-focused content that keeps audiences engaged beyond the broadcast window.
• Write and prepare material for newscasts with strong, clear, conversational copy.
• Engage actively with viewers on social media, including Facebook, Instagram, and other platforms.
• Serve as a positive, collaborative presence in the newsroom and a trusted face in the Omaha community.
• Make public appearances on behalf of the station as needed.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• At least 3 years of experience as a news anchor in a professional broadcast environment.
• A genuine passion for news and a desire to be more than a face on the set — someone who wants to be involved in the content.
• Strong editorial instincts and news judgment, with an understanding of what makes a story a First Alert.
• Excellent on-air presence and the ability to deliver news clearly, professionally, and with authority.
• Strong writing skills and the ability to write accurately and creatively under deadline pressure.
• Comfortable and confident leading live breaking news coverage.
• Comfortable and enthusiastic about streaming — willing to anchor special content and breaking news coverage on streaming platforms.
• Active and engaging on social media, with an understanding of how to connect with audiences across platforms.
• Strong people skills and a collaborative, team-first attitude.
• Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or related field preferred.

Real community impact: You’ll be working at KOTA/KEVN in Rapid City, a station deeply rooted in the community and committed to local journalism. Growth and innovation: Gray Media is evolving on purpose, and you’ll be at the forefront of how we define the future of local media. A team that has your back: Work alongside passionate professionals who value collaboration and "scrappiness" as much as you do. Never a dull moment: With opportunities across broadcast, streaming, and digital, you’ll never feel stuck or stale. Ready to be more than just a producer? Let’s create something amazing together.

Job Summary/Description:

We’re looking for a News Producer at KOTA/KEVN who wants to be more than a traditional newscast architect. We want a storyteller who can work the phones, grill sources, and find that "breakout angle" that turns a standard report into a must-watch (and must-click) event. If you’re ready to lead the conversation across every screen—from the living room TV to the palm of our viewers' hands—let’s talk.

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but not be limited to):

- You'll own the story cycle: Go beyond handling content created by others; proactively find, update, and elevate local stories that impact our community.
- Drive multi-platform urgency: Get fresh information into our newscasts and onto our digital platforms with speed and accuracy.
- Be the interviewer: Don't just set up the meeting; be the one asking the tough questions and digging for the truth in the interviews you coordinate.
- Collaborate for impact: Work closely with reporters to find unique angles and expand content, ensuring our coverage is never stale.
- Craft conversational scripts: Write engaging, punchy copy for broadcast and streaming that sounds like a human talking to a human.
- Master digital storytelling: Pivot from broadcast scripts to long-form digital print for our website and social media platforms with ease.
- Navigate the newsroom: Utilize ENPS and other newsroom software to keep our operations running like a well-oiled machine.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring: - A journalism pedigree: You have a degree in journalism (or equivalent experience) and a deep understanding of news ethics and storytelling.
- Hands-on experience: You didn't just watch from the sidelines; you’ve worked in a campus news station and completed an internship where you actually did the work.
- Digital-first mindset: You understand that news happens everywhere, and you’re just as comfortable posting to social media as you are producing a 6 PM block.
- Sourcing skills: You know how to work a phone, build relationships with sources, and uncover information that others miss.
- Software savvy: Experience with ENPS is a huge plus, but your ability to learn and master newsroom systems is what really matters.
- Flexibility and grit: You thrive in the fast-paced, sometimes unpredictable world of news and aren't afraid to pivot when a story breaks.
- Killer writing skills: Whether it’s a 15-second tease or a 500-word web article, your writing is clear, compelling, and accurate.   If you feel you’re qualified and want to work with a great group of people, go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, you may type in the job title, station call letters, or click on "apply now", upload your resume, cover letter, and references

WECT News has been Where News Comes First in Southeastern North Carolina for over 70 years. We're the NBC affiliate in the rapidly growing Wilmington market, serving New Hanover, Brunswick, Columbus, Pender, and Bladen counties that make up the beautiful coastal Cape Fear Region. WECT is the most accessible local news outlet in our market, with WECT.com, News & Weather apps, and streaming platforms. WECT is the dominant #1 station in the market.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you a visual storyteller who lives for the "wow" factor?

Do you thrive on the adrenaline of a breaking story and the satisfaction of a deep-dive community piece? We’re looking for a Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) who doesn't just report the news but owns it—across every screen.

Whether you’re crafting a lead for one of our on-air newscasts, going live on our streaming newscasts in the WECT Digital Studio, or engaging with our audience on social, you’ll be the heartbeat of the Cape Fear region.

If you’re a scrappy, digital-first journalist who wants to make a real impact in southeastern North Carolina, let’s talk.

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but not be limited to):

What You'll Do:
* Own the story: Manage and develop compelling content from initial concept to final publication across digital, social, and broadcast platforms.
* Drive digital engagement: Create platform-specific content that meets our audience where they are—on their phones, their TVs, and everywhere in between.
* Master the craft: Write, edit, and produce high-quality stories with speed, accuracy, and a killer creative eye.
* Respond with urgency: Jump into breaking news situations with authority and calm, keeping our community informed in real-time.
* Connect with the community: Build deep roots in the Cape Fear region, developing sources and uncovering the stories that truly matter to our neighbors.
*Step into the spotlight: Take advantage of potential anchoring opportunities to lead our coverage and connect directly with viewers.

What You Bring:
* A digital-first mindset: You understand that "news" happens 24/7, and you’re ready to feed the beast on social and streaming first.
* Killer storytelling skills: You know how to find the "human" element in every story and make it resonate with an audience.
* Technical chops: You’re a pro with a camera and an editing suite (and you’re not afraid to learn new tools as they emerge).
* Sharp news judgment: You know what’s important, what’s interesting, and how to tell the difference under pressure.
* A positive, "can-do" attitude: You’re a team player who lifts others up and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
* Urgency and empathy: You care about the stories you tell and the people they affect, and you move fast to get them right.
* Flexibility: News doesn't follow a 9-to-5 schedule, and neither do you—you’re ready to go where the story takes you.

Qualifications/Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field preferred
* Strong writing skills (broadcast and print style)
* Experience with CMS/digital publishing platforms
* Experience with broadcast newsroom software such as ENPS
* Experience with video editing software (preferably Edius)
* Must be able to lift 25-30 lbs and pass a motor vehicle background check

The Toledo Mud Hens have a rich baseball history and loyal following. Not to be outdone are the fans of our hockey team, the Toledo Walleye. We also love our food. There are many outstanding restaurants and local festivals throughout the year.

Since 1948, generations of families have grown up counting on WTVG to be a window to their world on-air and now digitally. Our people, on-air and behind the scenes, are trusted friends and neighbors in the community. There is a culture within our walls that recognizes the responsibility we carry, to continue what was started seventy years ago. We take pride in our ratings, our content, our status, and the need to maintain the work ethic that got us to where we are.

There has always been a family atmosphere at WTVG. We care about each other, and know that we are stronger as one team than as many individuals. We take our jobs seriously, and know that we can be successful and have fun at the same time.

Now let our team tell you why our viewers say “This Is Home.”

Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, as well as studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KBTX:

KBTX Media operates the CBS and CW affiliates in Bryan-College Station, Texas, serving an 18-county area known as the Brazos Valley. For nearly 70 years, we’ve been the dominant choice for local news and entertainment. Our team produces nearly 40 hours of broadcast content each week, along with a constant presence online at KBTX.com.
KBTX is routinely recognized among the best in the state by organizations including the Associated Press, RTDNA, and the Lone Star EMMY Chapter of the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences. The station has won four consecutive Texas Association of Broadcasters’ Bonner McLane Public Service awards, and in 2023 won a National Edward R. Murrow Award for Digital content. KBTX is also a recent Texas AP Broadcasters/Freedom of Information Foundation of Texas Station of the Year and Texas Associated Press Broadcasters Station of the Year.

The station has launched the careers of many well-known journalists, meteorologists and network executives, and takes pride in helping talent grow quickly into the nation’s largest television markets. The work family of KBTX is made up of a group of dedicated, professional, and passionate individuals who are the backbone of our daily mission.
Bryan-College Station, Texas, is a community of more than 250,000 people and the largest single metro in the Waco-Temple-Bryan DMA. The twin cities have a unique small-town feeling, but offer big city amenities, including a vibrant arts community, a city-wide, all-terrain trail system, and world-class dining and nightlife. Bryan and College Station are routinely recognized as a leader in quality of life and as one of the fastest-growing communities in the country.
College Station is home to Texas A&M University, the nation’s largest university. Aggie home football games attract more than 100,000 in the stands, with tens of thousands more camped outside celebrating at tailgates during football weekends.

Learn more about KBTX at www.kbtx.com.

Job Summary/Description:

KBTX Media is looking for a part-time photojournalist to join the Brazos Valley’s most-watched television station. The photojournalist will take an active role in the production of several station franchises and work alongside both the news and creative services departments.

A successful candidate will write, shoot, edit, and present compelling content both on-air and online. You’ll also play a key role in working with other KBTX journalists to develop both long- and short-term stories with a focus on uncovering the human side of each story.

- Meeting daily and weekly deadlines in a fast-paced environment, including a strong digital focus

Qualifications/Requirements:

About KSFY/KDLT:

Sioux Falls is one of the fastest growing cities in the Upper Midwest and is home to more than 220,000 people. Healthcare and finance make up much of the workforce in Sioux Falls. There is never a shortage of things to do here. Summers are packed with outdoor festivals and concert events. Many also enjoy the city’s nearly 30 miles of bike trails; be sure to stop by the beautiful waterfalls of the Big Sioux River! And winter doesn’t mean people hibernate; there are plenty outdoor and indoor activities all winter long. In 2014, the city built a 12,000 seat area that has hosted everything from PBR events, hockey and indoor football, to concerts with names like Paul McCartney, Carrie Underwood and Elton John. The city is also home to a new indoor aquatic center, indoor ice skating facility, basketball arena, and an indoor tennis complex. There is no shortage of places to eat either. Not only is Sioux Falls home to many familiar restaurant chains, it’s known for many great locally-owned restaurants. And if you want to get away for the weekend, you can drive to Omaha in three hours, Minneapolis in four and the Black Hills in five.
KSFY/KDLT is an award-winning television operation serving viewers in the eastern half of South Dakota as well as portions of southwest Minnesota and northwest Iowa. The stations operate from a new studio in downtown Sioux Falls as one rebranded organization called Dakota News Now. The facilities put Dakota News Now on the cutting edge of television and news gathering technology, making it one of the most state-of-the-art television stations in the market and the region. The Dakota News Now team produces 36 hours of news each week. Some of our employees have been here for more than 25 years. For others, this is their first job out of college. It’s a great mix that gives us different perspectives while covering the news. People here enjoy the work they do, and everyone steps up to the plate during major news events like breaking news and severe weather.

Learn more about Dakota News Now & Sioux Falls here: https://www.dakotanewsnow.com/page/ksfykdlt-careers/

job.title: SPORTS REPORTER AND ANCHOR - WILX
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WILX:

Gray Media Lansing (WILX-WSYM) News 10, home of the highly rated NBC and FOX affiliates in Lansing, Michigan, is on a dynamic growth trajectory. Our combined operations produce over 50 hours of local news per week—and counting. We are Mid-Michigan's undisputed media leader, home to Emmy-award-winning journalists, the Michigan Association of Broadcasters’ “Station of the Year,” your exclusive home for the Detroit Lions on FOX 47, and home to Studio 10, our popular daily local lifestyle show. Alongside our powerhouse primary stations, our family of channels includes MeTV (10.2) and the regional Great Lakes Sports & Entertainment Network (47.2).

Beyond traditional broadcast, we are a true 24/7 multi-platform powerhouse. Through www.News10Lansing.com and our dedicated News 10 and First Alert Weather apps, and our continuous livestreaming channel News10+, our audience stays connected to trusted local coverage whenever and wherever they need it.
We are a breaking news and weather-first station with a fierce commitment to original, local reporting. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. It is a vibrant, diverse, stable, and highly affordable region that offers an outstanding quality of life. Lansing is ideally located just an hour from Grand Rapids and downtown Detroit, and is perfect for day trips “up north” to explore some of the most beautiful scenic spots in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, craft breweries, local wineries, Broadway shows, Big Ten sports, minor-league baseball, and professional NFL, NBA, and NHL games... Michigan has it all! Come grow your career with our winning, forward-thinking team.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who lives for the Friday night lights and the roar of a Big Ten stadium? Do you believe that sports are about more than just box scores — that they’re about the heartbeat of a community? We’re looking for a high-energy Sports Reporter and Anchor to join our powerhouse team at WILX and WSYM. Whether you’re breaking down a massive Spartans win, profiling a high school underdog, or owning the conversation on social media, you’ll be the face of sports in Mid-Michigan. This isn't just a job behind a desk; it’s a multi-platform mission to tell the stories that matter most to our fans.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What You'll Do:
• Own the sports desk: Anchor high-energy sportscasts that move beyond simple highlights to provide the context and depth our viewers crave.
• Tell "More Than a Game" stories: Shoot, write, and edit compelling packages that capture the raw emotion and community pride of Mid-Michigan sports.
• Drive the digital conversation: Break stories on our website, mobile app, social media channels – engage with fans on digital platforms and find creative ways to grow our streaming presence.
• Lead the "Prep Rally": Take a front-row seat in our award-winning live high school, college, and pro sports coverage, from Friday night football specials to athlete profiles.
• Enterprise local features: Dig deep to find the stories no one else is telling, building relationships with coaches, athletes, and local legends.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:
• A killer on-air presence: You’re confident, authentic, and you know how to connect with an audience.
• Digital-first DNA: You understand that "the game" happens on Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, and our app just as much as it happens on the field.
• Scrappy MMJ skills: You’re a pro at shooting your own video and editing on the fly.
• Deep sports IQ: You know your way around a playbook and can speak the language of everything from Big Ten basketball to local golf.
• Urgency and accuracy: You thrive under the pressure of a ticking clock and never sacrifice the facts for speed.
• A team-player mindset: You’re ready to jump in, take feedback, and help the whole team win.
• The essentials: A degree in Journalism or a related field, a valid driver’s license, and a clean driving record are must-haves.

Why You'll Love It Here:
• The Ultimate Sports Market: From the intensity of Michigan State University to the deep-rooted traditions of our local high schools, you’ll never run out of great stories to tell.
• Innovation First: We’re not stuck in the past. You’ll have access to the latest tech and a team that’s obsessed with the future of digital media.
• Community Impact: You’ll be a local celebrity with a purpose, using your platform to highlight the best of Mid-Michigan.
• Growth Opportunities: As part of Gray Media, you’re joining a company that invests in its people and provides a clear path for career advancement.
• A Winning Culture: Work with a team of exceptional journalists who are as passionate about excellence as you are.

Ready to take the field and make your mark in Mid-Michigan? Let’s talk.

About WMTV:

WMTV is the NBC affiliate and Gray Television-owned station serving south-central Wisconsin. We are the #1 station—leading the market in news and weather coverage. We are recognized for sharing information with accuracy and immediacy on all platforms.

We work hard and take pride in getting it right. For four years in a row, WMTV was honored as the Wisconsin Broadcasters Association “News Operation of the Year”. As well as being the recipient of the Edward R. Murrow Regional "Overall Excellence" Award.

What’s better than working at the #1 station in the nation’s #1 city? Join our award-winning team and live, work, and play in a community that is consistently named one of the best places to live in America. We are just 1.5 hours from Milwaukee, 2.5 hours from Chicago, and 5 hours from Minneapolis/St. Paul.

Job Summary/Description:

WMTV has an immediate opening for a Technical Media Producer. The Technical Media Producer (“TMP”) is responsible for operating the equipment in our broadcast control center that keeps WMTV’s programming on air and online. The TMP directs live and prerecorded productions as assigned, using our Ross Overdrive production automation system paired with coding in ENPS to deliver a quality News Show. The TMP also handles all master control duties in our facility, such as recording, playback, switching, and quality-checking programming for air. This position offers an opportunity for video editing and field directing.

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

- Monitoring and quality control of all inbound and outbound / broadcast signals, as well as ensuring that all content airs as intended and is logged
- Maintaining compliance with relevant FCC and other governmental agency regulations
- Directing assigned live and prerecorded productions using Ross Overdrive production automation
- Preparing the production rundowns for automation operation by coding the rundown in AP ENPS / Ross Overdrive plugin
- Understanding of all relevant equipment in the studio, production, and technical core areas
- Editing video for playback and working closely with the news team to ensure quality
- Field directing Special projects including WMTV's "Share your Holidays", UW Madison's Homecoming Parade, and our "On the Road segment

Qualifications/Requirements:

- 2 years of previous broadcast or production experience with master control or production control is preferred, but we will train the right person. Ross Overdrive experience is a plus.
- Demonstrated ability to learn new concepts quickly and thoroughly
- Proven track record of prioritizing complex tasks
- Ability to communicate effectively – written and verbal
- Strong commitment to working effectively with others; both being trained by and training others in a team environment is a must
- Positive attitude and ability to adapt to changes
- Must be willing to work holidays and weekends if needed

The Technical Media Producer (TMP) Directs Newscasts, Special Programs, Breaking News, Live Sports and Severe Weather, while also providing QC support to Network and Local programming. • Daily care and maintenance of equipment and studio
• Operate master control Nverzion Automation and Video Servers, including the ability to effectively perform commercial/program ingest & QC, insuring all syndicated programs and commercials are available for playback on playlist.
• Ability to operate between multiple control rooms with no change in overall performance, and proper effective communication within the Media Control team.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Flexibility with scheduling and job assignments

• A successful applicant will be dependable, focused, detail-oriented, and able to work under pressure with strict deadlines and have strong multitasking skills.

KOLO is a station that gets the job done. Many of our employees have been with the company for years, and they pride themselves on their expertise and their ability to succeed. While Reno/Tahoe is a 100+ market, it has all the characteristics of a much larger West Coast market. In fact, some say Reno has a superior lifestyle and outdoor activities to its much larger neighboring markets. For these and many other reasons, KOLO is able to attract top-notch individuals. We pride ourselves on not limiting ourselves to the "news conference or press release journalism" stories that are easy to get. Our journalists know they need to tell stories on issues that matter to the Northern Nevada community and our viewers. Much of the station's identity is from KOLOCares, a program designed to better serve Northern Nevada through the wonderful non-profit organizations that are part of the community. Reno has an illustrious history of boom or bust, and right now the area is booming! Life in Reno/Tahoe is not just about work. Northern Nevada boasts remarkable outdoor activities highlighted by the spectacular beauty of Lake Tahoe, world-renowned ski resorts in the Sierra, trout fishing in the Truckee River and Pyramid Lake, placid campgrounds, miles of hiking and biking trails and, yes, casinos. San Francisco, Yosemite, and Napa Valley are all an easy drive for a weekend getaway. Many Northern Californians spend their weekends in Reno, especially with the summer festivities that feature balloon races, Hot August Nights, and the nation's largest BBQ rib festival. There is always something happening in Reno, the "Biggest Little City in the World."

Job Summary/Description:

Do you have a passion for holding the powerful accountable? Are you the kind of reporter who can take a complex legislative bill and turn it into a story that actually matters to a family in Duluth, Mankato, or Rochester? We’re looking for a high-energy, autonomous State Capitol Reporter to be the face of Minnesota politics for our stations across the state. Based in the heart of the Twin Cities, you’ll be the bridge between the halls of power and the communities we serve—delivering news that lives on every screen, from the 6 PM broadcast to a viral social thread.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

What You'll Do: 

• Own the Capitol: Be the first to know—and the first to report—on the legislative sessions, policy shifts, and political maneuvers that shape Minnesota.
• Tell stories that travel: Craft compelling content for four major Gray stations (KBJR, KEYC, KTTC, KVLY) and occasionally represent Minnesota on a national stage.
• Master the multi-platform pivot: Shoot, write, and edit your own content, ensuring it’s optimized for a digital-first audience before it even hits the airwaves.
• Lead the election charge: Take a featured role during election cycles, breaking down races and results with urgency and authority.
• Connect the dots: Coordinate with newsrooms across the state to provide live hits and localized angles on statewide issues.
• Build a source network: Quickly develop deep relationships with lawmakers, advocates, and community leaders to uncover the stories others miss. 

Why You’ll Love It Here 

• Unmatched reach: Your work will be seen across the state and the country, giving you a massive platform to grow your brand.
• True autonomy: You’re the lead on this beat. We trust you to find the stories and tell them your way.
• Innovation at scale: Join a company that is leading the digital evolution of local news—not just talking about it.
• Community impact: You aren’t just reporting on politics; you’re helping Minnesotans understand the decisions that affect their lives every day.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:

• 2+ years of on-air experience: You’re comfortable in front of the camera and even more comfortable digging through a legislative docket.
• A "Digital-First" brain: You don’t just "post to web"—you understand how to engage an audience on social and streaming platforms.
• Technical scrappiness: You can shoot, edit, and go live from the field (and yes, you can handle the 50 lbs of gear that makes the magic happen).
• Political curiosity: You have a deep interest in state government and the ability to explain "how it works" without the boring jargon.
• Independence and urgency: You thrive in a remote setup where you’re the boss of your beat, meeting deadlines with ease and a "desire to win."
• A clean driving record: You’ll be traversing the Twin Cities and beyond, so a valid license is a must.
• Humanity and grit: You have the empathy to tell human stories and the toughness to ask the hard questions.
