job.title: 2027 Summer Internship- Creative (eGreetings)
job.description:
ABOUT HALLMARK’S INTERNSHIP PROGRAM  

We're looking for curious, creative, and consumer-focused interns who are passionate about storytelling, trends, culture, creativity, and human connection. 

 

 eGreetings Creative Intern 

This internship focuses on the future of digital connection through animated, interactive, and video-based greeting experiences. Interns will research consumer trends, explore emerging digital behaviors, and develop concepts that help Hallmark engage younger and new consumers through innovative digital greetings experiences. Interns will partner with creative, digital, and media teams to develop concepts, storyboards, and recommendations that could influence future product development 

What you'll do: 

  • Research consumer behaviors, creative trends, and digital connection experiences.  
  • Explore opportunities for animated, video-based, and interactive greetings.  
  • Partner with Digital Greetings, Media Studio, and Creative teams to understand current capabilities and future opportunities.  
  • Develop innovative concepts focused on personalization, interactivity, and social sharing.  
  • Create storyboards, visual concepts, and creative recommendations.  
  • Gather feedback from cross-functional partners and refine concepts based on insights.  
  • Present digital greeting concepts and recommendations to business and creative leaders. 

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

The following are required to be considered for this role: 

  • Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Digital Media, Graphic Design, Animation, Motion Design, User Experience (UX), Interactive Media, Creative Technology, Film/Video Production, or a related field
  • A graduation date of December 2027, May 2028, December 2028, May 2029, December 2029, or May 2030 

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

Your resume and application will stand out if you are: 

  • Demonstrated interest in digital content, creative storytelling, emerging media, interactive experiences, or consumer engagement
  • Passionate about how people connect and communicate through digital platforms, social media, video, gaming, or emerging technologies
  • Familiarity with social, cultural, and consumer trends relevant to Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences
  • Skilled at generating creative ideas and translating them into visual concepts, storyboards, mockups, presentations, or prototypes
  • Familiar with content creation tools, design software, video editing, animation, or other digital creative platforms
  • Comfortable collaborating across creative and business disciplines and incorporating feedback into evolving concepts
  • Experience through coursework, publications, student organizations, freelance work, or personal creative projects is a plus

  

ADDITIONAL DETAILS 

  • A portfolio is required for this position. Your portfolio should be compiled into one PDF document that is no larger than 5 MB. If your portfolio file size is above the 5MB limit, you can submit a one-page overview of your work (see example). You can also submit a link to a personal portfolio website to supplement your uploaded portfolio. Applicants who do not upload a portfolio or one-page overview will not be considered.
  • Our internship program is 12 weeks long, starting in late May and ending in early August. 
  • This summer internship is a hybrid position, with the flexibility to work from both our recently renovated headquarters building in Kansas City, MO, and from your summer residence within the KC metro area. 
  • Some relocation and housing assistance is provided for interns whose permanent address is outside of the KC metro area. Relocation is required for this role. 

       

      Interested? Follow the application instructions below to apply. 

       

      APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS  

      You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT.  

       In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks. 

       

      ABOUT HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important  

       

      For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like!  

      When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.  

      Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the ings we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.title: 2027 Summer Internships- Finance & Accounting
job.description:

                      For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like! 

                      When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success. 

                      Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the things we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.title: Brand Experiences Manager (remote)
job.description:
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO

The Brand Experiences team at Hallmark is dedicated to creating large-scale, emotionally resonant experiences that bring the brand to life for fans and consumers. From the Hallmark Christmas Cruise to the Hallmark Stars Live, we design and deliver immersive, joy-filled moments that deepen brand love and build lasting connections with audiences. We are experience architects and strategic storytellers who translate Hallmark’s iconic brand into real-world events that celebrate connection, inspire joy, and bring the brand’s emotional essence to life. Our work is high-profile, high-impact, and deeply rooted in creating meaningful moments that resonate with fans and leave lasting impressions.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO & HOW IT SHAPES OUR SUCCESS

The Brand Experiences Manager plays a key role in executing strategic, consumer-facing events that bring the Hallmark brand to life in immersive and emotionally resonant ways. This role manages two event team members and is responsible for delivering high-profile experiences such as the Hallmark Christmas Cruise, the Hallmark Stars Live, and future brand activations that deepen consumer engagement and drive business results. They will collaborate closely with brand experience leadership, senior stakeholders, and internal and external partners to ensure every experience reflects Hallmark’s iconic identity and delivers measurable results.

 

Key responsibilities include:

  • Strategic Planning & Leadership: Partner with brand experience leadership to develop strategic plans for revenue-generating consumer events that align with brand and business goals.
  • Event Execution & Oversight: Lead the planning and execution of large-scale, immersive brand experiences. Make informed decisions on logistics, vendor coordination, programming, and on-site operations to ensure flawless delivery.
  • Team Leadership: Manage and mentor two event team members, providing clear direction, support, and accountability throughout the execution process.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external agencies to ensure alignment and seamless execution across all touchpoints.
  • Budget & Performance Management: Support budget oversight; track KPIs, evaluate event performance, and apply insights to improve future execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a key point of contact for senior leaders, business partners, and vendors- communicating progress, resolving issues, and ensuring transparency.
  • Operational Excellence: Apply best practices and internal learnings to drive efficiency, consistency, and continuous improvement in event delivery.

 

This role is essential to Hallmark’s future as it ensures that strategic brand experiences are executed with excellence- strengthening consumer relationships, expanding brand reach, and reinforcing Hallmark’s leadership in meaningful connection.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

The following are required to be considered for this role: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree or 4 years professional work experience
  • At least 7 years of experience in event development, brand experiences, and or management 

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Your resume will stand out if you have the following:

  • Experience leading, managing and developing a team (e.g., direct reports).
  • Experience with online registration and event application development.
  • Strong strategic thinking and visionary planning capabilities, with the ability to execute complex projects that involve multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and project management skills, including the ability to translate complex business strategies into clear and impactful messaging.
  • Solid understanding of various, complex audiences and the nuanced, authentic ways the Hallmark brand comes to life for each audience.
  • Proven record of leading complex projects with multiple business partners and external stakeholders.
  • Business acumen and the ability to present plans (including a financial business case) and opportunities with individuals at higher levels in the organization
  • Exhibit corporate and interpersonal savvy and confidence leading projects and partners under tight timelines and high-pressure situations.
  • Event or project management certification.
  • Prior experience organizing branded consumer experiences and programs
  • Prior experience with cruises, theater and/or entertainment tours
  • Exemplary communication (verbal, written, consulting) and organization skills
  • Commands a fast paced, high volume of change environment requiring real-time adjustment and problem solving.
  • Effectively works with diverse audiences.
  • Personal leadership skills: self-motivated, high degree of personal accountability, leads beyond their role, resilient and positive attitude.

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • This is a U.S.-based remote role.* We’re committed to creating a connected, collaborative culture, no matter where you are. You’ll have access to virtual tools, team support, and opportunities to engage and grow with us. *Due to state-specific benefits regulations, Hallmark cannot consider candidates for remote positions who reside in Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, or any country outside of the United States. If based in Kansas City, this position offers a hybrid work arrangement, giving you the best of both worlds: collaborating in person at Hallmark Headquarters in Kansas City, MO and enjoying the flexibility of working remotely. Some meetings required in-person, many can be remote.
  • The salary range for this role is $105k - $120k. Final compensation varies based on several factors
  • This role is eligible for Hallmark’s Annual Incentive Plan. More information will be shared during the interview process.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.
  • In alignment with our culture of care, Hallmark offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, paid time off, 401K with company match, and profit-sharing.

 

COME JOIN US! Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark- just follow the instructions below to apply.

job.title: Customer Service Representative - Halls KC Concierge (On-call)
job.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Crown Center, one of the nation’s first mixed-use redevelopments, is an 85-acre complex that welcomes more than five million visitors each year. A subsidiary of Hallmark Cards, Crown Center is a ‘city within a city’ – combining hotel, office, retail, residential and entertainment land uses within its boundaries.

Halls KC provides the ultimate in trend-setting design, exclusive brands, and superior customer service. Our beautiful, 60,000 square foot store is located on the third level of the Crown Center shops in the heart of Kansas City. Halls KC offers shopping experiences in a fresh and exciting environment, taking an active role in Crown Center’s goal of creating a vibrant central city. 

 

WHAT WE DO AND HOW WE DO IT:

The On-call Customer Service Representative (Halls Concierge) is the first point of contact for Halls customers, delivering an exceptional shopping experience at Halls KC – a luxury retail store. This role requires a passion for customer satisfaction, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks with precision and professionalism. The On-call Customer Service Representative (Halls Concierge) is responsible for cash handling, gift wrapping, stocking supplies in Hall Concierge, and performs other responsibilities as required by management.

 

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

Provide exceptional customer service with a focus on creating memorable experiences and ensuring customer satisfaction. Exhibit empathy, patience, and a positive attitude when addressing customer needs or concerns. Uphold Halls’ brand image and demonstrate a passion for our customers in every interaction. Answer incoming phone calls, transfer calls appropriately, and assist with inquiries in a courteous and professional manner.

Collaborate effectively with team members, demonstrating a positive team player attitude within the department and the entire store. Perform gift wrapping and gift boxing services to maintain Halls’ high standards of presentation. Multitask in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail. Cash management and cash handling accurately and responsibly. Maintain and stock supplies in the concierge area to ensure readiness and efficiency. Keep the customer service area clean, organized, and visually appealing.

All Halls employees are responsible for protecting company assets by following established policies and procedures.

 

Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications (listed below) in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT. 

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc., and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

The following is required to be considered for this role:

  • High school diploma or GED or equivalent
  • Minimum one year customer service experience in a professional or public environment

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Your resume and application will stand out if you have:

  • Cash register and cash handling experience.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written & verbal.
  • Must have a professional disposition when working with customers.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Knowledge of MS Word, Excel and email.
  • Superior customer service & teamwork skills –have a great attitude and are a team player.

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS:

  • This is an on-call job opportunity, and the incumbent will work a flexible schedule. 
  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and some holidays.
  • Basic store hours: Monday – Saturday, 10:00am – 6:00pm, Sunday, 12:00pm – 5:00pm.

job.title: Hallmark Field Merchandiser (part-time) Inman, SC. 29349
job.description:
To learn more about this role, watch our field merchandisers in action. 

 JOB OVERVIEW 

As a Field Merchandiser, you'll have the opportunity to work independently to showcase your organization and time management skills, your ability to establish retailer relationships, while being the face of Hallmark.  You will collaborate with local store teams to optimize product placement and maintain inventory levels as well as support fellow team members with seasonal resets and installations, when needed. On occasion you may have the opportunity to work with other products from other companies in the stores that you service.  

SALARY AND SCHEDULE DETAILS

  • Your starting pay rate will be $12.00 - $14.00 depending on your skills and experience.
  • We provide paid training, delivered through live, hands-on instruction as well as virtual classroom training.
  • Hallmark part time employees are offered voluntary benefits that include medical, dental, vision etc.  

  • Eligible Employees receive annual pay increases.

  • This is a Part-Time position with a variable schedule during the work week.
  • Average weekly hours for this position are between 9-12 hours per week.
  • Availability the week before and after major holidays, which may include weekends is required.  
  • Availability to support season changeovers, extended services, installations, and inventory support.

YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE  

You'll perform service work in the Hallmark department of various retail stores such as grocery stores, drug stores, department stores, and mass retailers. The retail merchandiser position consists of three major components:

  1. Day-to-day engagement: Utilizing a mobile device provided by Hallmark, you'll restock, organize, and monitor the inventory of Hallmark products within and outside the Hallmark department.  The use of technology is critical in this role, for the day-to-day work as well as communication with your supervisor, reporting time, providing feedback, and answering surveys for required merchandising activities. Professional and courteous interaction with store employees, management, and customers is also vital for success in this role.  You are responsible for the entire Hallmark product display at your assigned stores. 
  2. Holiday support: Hallmark's operations revolve around seasonal demand. Leading up to and following holidays such as Valentine's Day, Easter, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and Christmas, you can expect additional days and extended hours during the work week. On occasions like Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, and Father's Day, you may be required to work on the actual holiday itself, which may include the weekend.
  3. Department Resets: At times, you may be part of a team responsible for installations and various tasks like building and installing Hallmark fixtures, relocating card departments and products, as well as resetting card sections. Typically, you will be notified two weeks in advance for remodel assignments. This could include evenings or weekend.
  4. One Team Vision:  As part of Hallmark's field organization, you are part of a network of merchandisers professionals that often times will support other team members as needed in their territories.  

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This is a physically demanding job that requires a high level of energy and a sense of urgency. You will be working on the selling floor as well as in back stockrooms. You must be able to consistently push, pull, lift, and carry cartons, merchandise, and display fixtures up to 30 pounds throughout the workday and up to 50 pounds on occasion. You will also be required to kneel, squat, walk, and stand throughout your workday, and you may be required to climb stairs and step ladders.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • You're at least 18 years of age.
  • You're able to read, write and understand English.
  • You have the ability to grasp, pull, lift, and carry products up to 30 pounds frequently and 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Able to operate a digital hand-held device to open and read documents and interpret information.
  • You have access to a Wi-Fi network and the internet.
  • You have access to consistent transportation to travel to and between assigned stores as scheduled.

Part-time employees with a work schedule less than 30 hours have access to a variety of voluntary benefits through Voluntary Benefits including dental, vision, critical illness, accident insurance, hospital indemnity and minimum essential coverage (preventive care).

Prior to applying, watch our field merchandisers in action. 

 

Now's your chance to Make Your Mark—just follow the instructions below to apply.

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF.  

Part-time employees with a work schedule less than 30 hours have access to a variety of voluntary benefits through Voluntary Benefits including dental, vision, critical illness, accident insurance, hospital indemnity and minimum essential coverage (preventive care).

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. 

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, and successfully pass pre-employment (post offer) background check.

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please. 

 

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important

For over 100 years, Hallmark has helped people connect and strengthen the relationships that matter most. Today, we’re building the next century of connection- blending the warmth of in-store experiences with the ease of digital innovation.

We’re looking for empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries from all backgrounds to help shape what’s next. If you’re ready to bring fresh ideas and energy, we’d love to have you on the team!

At Hallmark,  you’ll feel welcomed from day one- whether you’re remote, hybrid, or in-office. We’ll tap into your strengths, offer leadership opportunities, and support your growth every step of the way.

Our culture is rooted in care and inclusion. We celebrate diverse perspectives and actively seek out new voices- like yours- to help us grow and evolve. Let’s imagine the future of Hallmark together!

job.title: Hallmark Merchandiser Floater (part-time) Watertown, NY 13601
job.description:
To learn more about this role, watch our field merchandisers in action. 

 JOB OVERVIEW 

As a Merchandiser Floater you'll have the opportunity to work independently to showcase your organization and time management skills, your ability to establish retailer relationships, while being the face of Hallmark.  You will collaborate with local store teams to optimize product placement and maintain inventory levels as well as support fellow team members with seasonal resets and installations, when needed. On occasion you may have the opportunity to work with other products from other companies in the stores that you service.  

SALARY AND SCHEDULE DETAILS

  • Your starting hourly pay rate will be $16.50 - $19.00 per hour depending on your skills and experience.
  • We provide paid training, delivered through live, hands-on instruction as well as virtual classroom training.
  • Hallmark part time employees are offered voluntary benefits that include medical, dental, vision etc.  

  • Eligible Employees receive annual pay increases. 

  • This is a Part-Time position with a variable schedule during the work week.
  • Average weekly hours for this position are between 8-10 hours per week.
  • Availability the week before and after major holidays, which may include weekends is required.  
  • Availability to support season changeovers, extended services, installations, and inventory support.

 

YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE  

You'll perform service work in the Hallmark department of various retail stores such as grocery stores, drug stores, department stores, and mass retailers. The retail merchandiser position consists of three major components:

  1. Day-to-day engagement: Utilizing a mobile device provided by Hallmark, you'll restock, organize, and monitor the inventory of Hallmark products within and outside the Hallmark department.  The use of technology is critical in this role, for the day-to-day work as well as communication with your supervisor, reporting time, providing feedback, and answering surveys for required merchandising activities. Professional and courteous interaction with store employees, management, and customers is also vital for success in this role.  You are responsible for the entire Hallmark product display at your assigned stores. 
  2. Holiday support: Hallmark's operations revolve around seasonal demand. Leading up to and following holidays such as Valentine's Day, Easter, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and Christmas, you can expect additional days and extended hours during the work week. On occasions like Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, and Father's Day, you may be required to work on the actual holiday itself, which may include the weekend.
  3. Department Resets: At times, you may be part of a team responsible for installations and various tasks like building and installing Hallmark fixtures, relocating card departments and products, as well as resetting card sections. Typically, you will be notified two weeks in advance for remodel assignments. This could include evenings or weekend.
  4. One Team Vision:  As part of Hallmark's field organization, you are part of a network of merchandisers professionals that often times will support other team members as needed in their territories.  

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This is a physically demanding job that requires a high level of energy and a sense of urgency. You will be working on the selling floor as well as in back stockrooms. You must be able to consistently push, pull, lift, and carry cartons, merchandise, and display fixtures up to 30 pounds throughout the workday and up to 50 pounds on occasion. You will also be required to kneel, squat, walk, and stand throughout your workday, and you may be required to climb stairs and step ladders.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • You're at least 18 years of age.
  • You're able to read, write and understand English.
  • You have the ability to grasp, pull, lift, and carry products up to 30 pounds frequently and 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Able to operate a digital hand-held device to open and read documents and interpret information.
  • You have access to a Wi-Fi network and the internet.
  • You have access to consistent transportation to travel to and between assigned stores as scheduled.

 

Part-time employees with a work schedule less than 30 hours have access to a variety of voluntary benefits through Voluntary Benefits including dental, vision, critical illness, accident insurance, hospital indemnity and minimum essential coverage (preventive care).

job.title: Maintenance Mechanic - 1st Shift, Lawrence, KS
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

The Maintenance Mechanic position reports through the Maintenance Department within the Lawrence Production Center.  Individuals in this department provide the necessary skills to install and maintain the production equipment in support of manufacturing.    

 

The Maintenance Mechanic in Lawrence is full time 40 hours a week, Monday - Friday 7:30am - 3:30pm

  • Competitive hourly rate - $26-$38 based on experience

 

The Maintenance Mechanic demonstrates a broad range of mechanical and troubleshooting skills by having the ability to repair equipment that ranges from simplistic (i.e. batch counter) to complex (i.e. troubleshooting PLC/Ladder logic programming).  Specialists install machinery and equipment to be used in production or related process by assembling, leveling, and securing the equipment. Specialists are also responsible for making the necessary electrical, compressed air, gas, and water connections.  They dismantle machinery as required, transport, reassemble, and make new connections when either moving from one location to another or disposing of equipment.  Specialists repair and maintain machinery/equipment to keep in compliance with safety, blueprints, and manufacturer specifications. Maintenance Specialists install/troubleshoot/repair electrical wiring, replace belts, fabricate parts, read schematics, and troubleshoot Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), etc.  They also may be asked to modify existing equipment or designs and build new machines to improve capacity, quality, safety, or cost.  Specialists instruct operators and Operations Supervisors in the operation of new or modified equipment and work with them until they can satisfactorily and safely operate the equipment.  They often transport and handle hazardous waste material in-accordance-with all Federal, State, and Local regulations. They positively participate in performance dialogue and other team problem-solving activities, identify potential problems, and show willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Specialists must take the initiative to help problem solve and drive performance initiatives.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work areas as needed.

 

In this position you will:

  • Perform routine electrical connections, repairs, and troubleshooting on AC Control Systems for 120/240/480 voltages.
  • Perform repair of power transmission systems.  Safely operate shop machines in the fabrication of machinery parts and components.
  • Interpret basic machine schematics and building blueprint drawings.
  • Troubleshoot and repair machinery controlled by Programmable Logic Control (PLC) and A/C Freq Drive systems.  Read and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Perform basic utility connections and repair of pneumatic, hydraulics, and electrical systems.
  • Safely operate electrical and gas welding equipment; understand welding principles.
  • Troubleshoot and repair electro-mechanical and solid state circuitry systems.
  • Understand and perform basic Facility Support services on HVAC, vacuum, and air systems. 
  • Utilize good safety practices.

 

Requirements:

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

You must show how you meet basic qualifications (listed below) in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields.  Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT. 

 

Note –All selections will be based on skills, competencies and performance.  Color perception testing will be scheduled at time of interview. Sign-On Bonus: First payout is $250 after 90 days and $750 after 6 months contingent on a satisfactory performance review. 

     

     

    In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.

     

    BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

    • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.
    • Successfully completed technical training courses covering basic electrical fundamentals which includes high and low voltage electrical systems, circuits, and schematic reading OR HVAC training class(es) OR a minimum 2 years of work experience performing mechanical and electrical equipment repair on industrial manufacturing and/or commercial equipment.
    • Ability to push, pull, grasp, lift and carry items weighing up to 30 lbs frequently and 60 lbs occasionally.
    • Ability to constantly stand, walk, twist, bend, and reach at/above shoulder level.
    • Ability to frequently work in awkward positions and occasionally work from ladders.
    • Ability to pass a color perception test.

     

    PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

    • Basic math, written and oral communication skills, as well as basic computer skills.
    • Ability to set up area and work under pressure to meet production targets.
    • Ability to understand and follow established safety procedures for wearing PPE, lock/and tagout, and handling hazardous chemicals.
    • Ability to accept other duties as assigned.
    • Ability to learn and retain knowledge.
    • Ability to work as a team member.

     

    ADDITIONAL DETAILS

    • Work overtime as required during peak seasons
    • This is a maintenance environment that requires wearing appropriate PPE and following operating procedures when working with hazardous chemicals, hazardous energies, and in harsh operating environments without climate controls
    • Must wear PPE for Arc Flash protection, as well as other PPE such as safety glasses and safety shoes
    • Required to operate hand powered tools and industrial shop machinery
    • There is some noise and hearing protection is required by Hallmark

     

    This position is located in Lawrence, Kansas.  Relocation is not provided.

     

    WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING AT HALLMARK

    We want to help you be your best – at work and at home, now and in the future. It’s why providing benefits to support you and your family’s well-being is one of the most important investments Hallmark makes.

    • Your Health: Medical, vision, and dental plans; Specialized plan option for people with type 2 diabetes; Short-term and long-term disability coverage; Life and accident insurance
    • Your Well-Being: On-site registered nurses who provide health consultations and optional seasonal vaccinations. Health rewards program (earn up to $400 per year).

    • Your Work Environment: Climate-controlled and safety-first environment; On-site café that offers hot and cold meals; On-site Hallmark store where you can shop Hallmark products for 50%-75% off; Inclusive environment and a relaxed dress code, with a few safety rules to follow (close-toed shoes are required). Whether you have purple hair or express yourself through body art, we want you to bring your whole self to work.

    For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here.

job.title: Privacy Governance Administrator (remote)
job.description:
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO

The Consumer Marketing Analytics team provides powerful consulting along with key reporting and insightful analyses to the Hallmark Brand business. We focus on using data to understand our consumers, leveraging a vast number of sources to our advantage. We focus on complete storytelling to form an understanding of what has happened and use trends and analysis to drive future decisions. We are looking for motivated individuals who love exploring data to uncover hidden trends and developing new experiments to help meet our consumers where they are, with the right message, at the right time, and ultimately drive the business forward.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO & HOW IT SHAPES OUR SUCCESS

The Privacy Governance Administrator serves as a key steward of Hallmark's privacy program across Hallmark Media and Hallmark Product & Retail, helping ensure privacy principles are embedded into business operations, technology decisions, and data practices. This role provides governance, oversight, and operational leadership across the privacy landscape, partnering closely with Legal, Information Security, Information Technology, Procurement, Data & Analytics, and business leaders to ensure personal data is managed responsibly, ethically, and in compliance with applicable laws and company policies.

You will drive the execution of critical privacy processes, including Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs), data inventories, and data mapping, privacy impact assessments, vendor privacy reviews, and ongoing privacy governance activities. Acting as a trusted advisor to business teams, you will apply sound judgment and risk-based decision making to help teams navigate complex privacy requirements while balancing business objectives, customer expectations, and regulatory obligations.

Success in this role requires strong discernment, attention to detail, and the ability to influence outcomes across a diverse stakeholder landscape. The ideal candidate excels at translating privacy requirements into practical business solutions, identifying and mitigating risk, and fostering accountability for responsible data practices throughout the organization. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about shaping how privacy is operationalized at scale, connecting people, processes, and technology to strengthen trust, enable innovation, and advance Hallmark's commitment to protecting consumer data.

 

What You'll Do:

Lead Privacy Risk, Compliance & Assessment Activities:

  • Lead Privacy Assessments (PAs), Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and other privacy reviews for products, technologies, vendors, and business processes.
  • Serve as a key privacy stakeholder in third-party risk management activities, partnering with Legal, Procurement, and Information Security.
  • Maintain oversight of privacy risks, remediation plans, and compliance obligations across the enterprise.
  • Monitor evolving privacy laws and regulations, translating requirements into actionable business guidance and operational controls.
  • Lead the coordination of audits, regulatory inquiries, and compliance reviews, driving timely remediation and ensuring identified privacy risks are addressed effectively.

 

Own Privacy Governance & Program Operations:

  • Drive the execution, governance, and continuous improvement of Hallmark's enterprise privacy program.
  • Partner across Legal, Information Security, Information Technology, Procurement, Marketing, Product, Media, Data & Analytics, and other business functions to embed privacy into business operations.
  • Lead Privacy Council operations, including governance decisions, action planning, and accountability tracking.
  • Maintain privacy policies, standards, procedures, operating practices, and governance documentation.
  • Develop privacy scorecards, metrics, and executive reporting that provide visibility into program health, risks, and performance.

 

Steward Data Governance & Privacy Transparency:

  • Govern records of processing activities, data inventories, data maps, and related privacy documentation within OneTrust.
  • Partner with business leaders, application owners, and data stewards to maintain an accurate understanding of how personal information is collected, used, shared, retained, and protected.
  • Ensure privacy records, controls, and governance processes evolve as new products, technologies, vendors, and business capabilities are introduced.

 

Own Data Subject Rights Operations:

  • Administer and continuously improve Hallmark's Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) and consumer rights processes.
  • Direct cross-functional efforts to identify, validate, collect, and deliver responsive information within regulatory timeframes.
  • Monitor volumes, trends, performance metrics, and compliance obligations to ensure a scalable and effective consumer rights program.

 

Advance Privacy Awareness & Incident Response:

  • Promote privacy awareness and responsible data stewardship throughout the organization.
  • Develop practical guidance and communications that help teams make informed privacy decisions.
  • Support the governance, investigation, documentation, and remediation of privacy incidents and data breaches.

 

Success in this role requires leadership through influence, strong judgment, and the ability to drive outcomes across a highly matrixed organization.

 

You will:

  • Exercise sound judgment and a risk-based approach when evaluating privacy issues and business decisions.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Legal, Security, Technology, Analytics, and business teams.
  • Drive accountability and execution across cross-functional initiatives.
  • Communicate complex privacy requirements in clear, practical business terms.
  • Balance regulatory obligations, business objectives, and consumer trust. Continuously identify opportunities to strengthen privacy controls, governance processes, and operational effectiveness.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

The following are required to be considered for this role: 

  • Bachelor's degree or 4 years of professional work experience. 
  • At least 10 years of experience in data, analytics, data management, data governance, information management, compliance, risk management, or related disciplines.
  • At least 3 years of experience supporting or leading data privacy, compliance, privacy governance, privacy-by-design, data governance, or regulatory initiatives.
  • Experience managing projects or programs, including developing action plans, coordinating work across multiple stakeholders, tracking deliverables, and meeting established deadlines.
  • Experience leading cross-functional governance, compliance, operational, or transformation initiatives that require driving accountability, managing remediation activities, and influencing outcomes across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience documenting and analyzing data flows, system integrations, records of processing activities (ROPA), data maps, and the lifecycle of personal information across business processes and technology systems.
  • Ability to translate legal, regulatory, and policy requirements into practical business actions, operational controls, and process improvements.
  • Experience analyzing data, managing projects and priorities, resolving complex issues, and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Your resume will stand out if you have the following:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Management Information Systems, or a related data, technology, or business discipline.
  • Experience with OneTrust, including Data Mapping, Data Subject Rights (DSAR), Assessment Automation, and related privacy governance modules.
  • Experience supporting Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Privacy Assessments (PAs), vendor privacy reviews, privacy-by-design initiatives, or enterprise compliance programs.
  • Professional privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPM, CIPT, or equivalent.
  • Experience with privacy governance frameworks, records of processing activities, data inventories, consent management, or enterprise data governance programs.
  • Experience working with modern data platforms and ecosystems, including cloud data platforms, customer data platforms (CDPs), data warehouses, or data governance technologies.

job.title: Production Support Specialist (36) - 3rd Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

JOB OVERVIEW

You’ll be at the heart of our production center, helping millions of customers across the world enjoy Hallmark products. You will have a variety of duties that support the production process in numerous ways. You’ll be cross-trained across multiple departments by a support team of trainers and supervisors to help you learn every step of the way!


SALARY AND SHIFT DETAILS

  • Your starting pay will be between $19.80 - $22.65 depending on your shift.
  • This position is a full-time, 5-day work week position in the 3rd shift from 11:30pm - 7:30am, Sunday night through Friday morning.
    Don’t see a shift that works for you? We still encourage you to apply! We’ll work with you to find a shift that fits your lifestyle and gives you the flexibility you need.

The Production Support Specialist in Lawrence has a variety of duties that support production in numerous ways.  Prepares greeting card stock for the Cutter to cut.  Jogs, skids and moves stock to the cutter.  Carries stock to skids and moves finished skids into the outgoing area.  Responsible for complete make-ready, run, monitoring and maintenance.  Removes die cut cards from full sheets either using a hammer or by using an Automatic Card Extractor (ACE).  Performs make-readies on the ACE and prepares rails/bars and press set-up.  Responsible for quality sampling and stacking cards onto skids according to register, blockouts, salvage and spoilage.  Determines when adhesive will be mixed and when test will be performed on the mixture.  Responsible for ensuring that the ingredients are in the area for mixing the adhesive.  Assists the Webtron press operator with press set up and changeover, make-readies, machine adjustments and routine preventative maintenance procedures.  Responsible for supporting the production areas by ordering the correct stock, moving components in and out of the areas, inputting information on the computer system, and maintaining a clean, safe, work environment. 

Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.  Sets up and operates a Gem/Cello machine, wholesale sealer, accumulator and shrink tunnel which shrinks poly film around wholesale unit of specialty items and/or operates a lift truck and keeps track of stock in the OAI.  Performs all paperwork assigned involved in moving stock, either into or out of the department.  Packs finished goods on a packaging line.  Identifies potential problems and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work assignments as needed.

Important things to know:

  • Position may be in several departments and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

  • In the production areas there is some noise. Hearing protection is provided by Hallmark.
  • Overtime is available and will be covered during the interview process.

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready duties on the Gem/Cello machines, ACE press and Webtron presses.  Set up wholesale sealer and pack product into shipping containers.  Mix adhesives and assure the proper ingredients and quantities are available in the area. 
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage.  Perform quality and/or adhesive test and report results in a timely manner.  Plan and maintain the workflow through the department in accordance with work schedule.  Order and deliver stock, cartons, and other components needed for production to the work area. 
  • Achieve and continually improve specified production including production goals, throughput, etc. during training.  Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities.  .
  • Complete regular press maintenance and cleaning, including TPM’s.  Move skids of stock into and away from the press, including completion of related paperwork.  Transport and handle hazardous waste material in accordance with all Federal, State, and Local regulations.  Be certified to operate power lift equipment and skid inverting machine. 
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within shorter periods of time.  Effectively communicate information to the next shift to ensure consistency and continuous operation. 
  • Utilize good safety practices.

 

YOUR AREAS OF KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE

Basic Qualifications

  • You’re at least 18 years of age
  • You have the ability to grip and push/pull lifts of stock 2”-3.5” thick, 80-120 times per hour
  • You have the ability to lift 20-30 lb stacks of stock, 60-80 times per hour, with frequent lifting throughout the shift of 40-60 lbs.
  • You have the ability to constantly stand, walk, twist, bend, and reach above shoulder level
  • You have the ability to constantly use repetitive hand/wrist motion and perform fine motor skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Strong communication- and problem-solving skills

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING AT HALLMARK

We want to help you be your best – at work and at home, now and in the future. It’s why providing benefits to support you and your family’s well-being is one of the most important investments Hallmark makes.

  • Your Health: Medical, vision, and dental plans; Specialized plan option for people with type 2 diabetes; Short-term and long-term disability coverage; Life and accident insurance
  • Your Well-Being: On-site registered nurses who provide health consultations and optional seasonal vaccinations. Health rewards program (earn up to $400 per year).
  • Your finances: A 401(k) with a 4% company match vested from day one. Health savings (HSA) or Flexible spending (FSA) accounts.
  • Your life: During your first year, you’ll receive 18 days (144 hours) of PTO and 10 paid holidays. Paid parental leave, adoption assistance, and comprehensive fertility benefits for eligible employees.
  • Your work environment: Climate-controlled and safety-first environment; On-site café that offers hot and cold meals; On-site Hallmark store where you can shop Hallmark products for 50%-75% off; Inclusive environment and a relaxed dress code, with a few safety rules to follow (close-toed shoes are required). Whether you have purple hair or express yourself through body art, we want you to bring your whole self to work.
  •  Your career: A career with Hallmark can take you anywhere. Our career paths are shaped by your talents and ambitions. Whether you want to take the next step up in a role you know and love or are looking to move into an entirely new area or location. We can help you do just that.

Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply. 

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF.  

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. 

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks. 

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please. 

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important 

For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here.

Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like! 

When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success. 

Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the things we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.description:
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO

At Hallmark our Information Technology (IT) division is vital to helping Hallmark win in the marketplace. We proactively partner with business areas to develop new capabilities, build reliable solutions, and efficiently manage the corporation’s investment in technology and end-to-end processes. 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO & HOW IT SHAPES OUR SUCCESS

We are in search of a highly skilled Sr SAP ABAP Developer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be pivotal in designing, developing, and implementing SAP solutions to address our organization's business needs.

Collaboration with cross-functional teams is key, as you'll provide technical expertise and ensure the delivery of top- notch solutions within the SAP environment while maintaining Agile principles and methodologies.

By fostering a culture of continuous improvement, you'll empower Hallmark Technology to swiftly respond to market demands, deliver incremental value to customers, and sustain a competitive advantage in the ever-evolving tech landscape.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

The following are required to be considered for this role: 

  • Bachelor's degree or minimum 4 years' experience in a technology role
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as an SAP ABAP developer or similar role


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Your resume will stand out if you have the following:

  • Minimum 2 years of collaborating with and guiding a team and/or project
  • Experience with SAP PI/PO or BTP Integration Suite development
  • Agile certifications such as Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) or similar credentials
  • In depth experience developing with SAP ABAP programming in SAP modules such as SD, MM, FI/CO, PP using ABAP objects, BAPIs and Enhancement framework
  • Experience developing RICEFS and documentation
  • Experience with iDocs, sap non, sapuis, CDS view/OData services
  • Experience with performance tuning using ATC, Code Inspector and traces
  • Experience with SAPScripts and SMARTFORMS
  • Experience with SAP Workflow
  • Experience with Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP S/4HANA Development environment
  • Perform code reviews and mentor junior team members
  • Experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.)

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • This is a U.S.-based remote role.* We’re committed to creating a connected, collaborative culture, no matter where you are. You’ll have access to virtual tools, team support, and opportunities to engage and grow with us. *Due to state-specific benefits regulations, Hallmark cannot consider candidates for remote positions who reside in Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, or any country outside of the United States.
  • This is a progressive role that will be filled at the level based on the skills and experience of the selected candidate.
  • The salary range for this job is between $95,000 and $125,000. Salary will take into consideration several factors including location.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
KOAT, the Hearst, Inc. affiliate in Albuquerque, New Mexico is looking for an Account Executive. An Account Executive sells advertising to local businesses and negotiates impressions and rates with ad agencies. You will also solicit new businesses to advertise on TV and web. If you are motivated by an excellent product, great compensation, and working with a talented team of professionals, look no further. We will provide the tools for powerful multi-platform marketing solutions to create partnerships to retain and grow our client base. You will report to the Local Sales Manager. If you want to work for the best, we want to hear from you today!

Responsibilities

  • Produce revenue across all available platforms
  • Prospect, contact and present to new businesses
  • Develop new revenue through local business development
  • Form strategic and market partnerships
  • Manage an active account/client list
  • Conceptualize, create, and deliver sales proposals that are consistent with station strategies
  • Achieve individual sales goals while contributing to KOAT dynamic sales team

Requirements

  • 1+ years in media or digital sales, or similar sales field
  • Experience with the development of new business/non-traditional business
  • Have strong negotiation skills
  • Experience in a consultative customer-focused business atmosphere
  • Accountability within a goal-structured organization
  • Must be a team player
  • Experience selling to business owners
  • Understand and use qualitative research to further sales efforts
  • Related military experience will be considered

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That’s why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

Benefits

Hearst's benefit programs are modern, flexible and designed to focus on you. As a Hearst employee, you and your spouse or partner or dependents would have access to the following benefits.

  • Medical | Dental | Vision
  • 401(k) matching
  • Emotional Wellness Support
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • LGBTQ+ Health Services
  • Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

job.title: Broadcast - Assistant Chief Engineer
job.description:
WGAL, the Hearst Television owned NBC affiliate serving the Harrisburg-Lancaster-Lebanon-York, PA market has an opening for an Assistant Chief Engineer.  In this role, you will help lead a team of technical professionals ranging from studio operators to IT and RF specialists as you organize, plan, manage, document and complete assignments within our live broadcast environment. This includes oversight of the equipment itself and execution of both local and corporate-led systems deployments and upgrades. As Assistant Chief Engineer you will monitor multiple air channels, maintain regulatory compliance, and ensure quality control of the on-air product.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership and day-to-day directions to the Engineering and Technical Operations teams.
  • Oversee the operation, reliability, and maintenance of studio, field, transmission, and production equipment across multiple sites.
  • Assign daily priorities, communicate expectations, and guide technical staff in troubleshooting, maintenance, and project implementation.
  • Diagnose and resolve broadcast-system issues from RF transmission and signal distribution through equipment and component level troubleshooting.
  • Maintain transmitters, satellite antenna systems, microwave and RF systems, signal-routing and distribution systems, and related infrastructure.
  • Oversee the integrity, security, reliability, and maintenance of broadcast IT systems, networks, and infrastructure.
  • Train and coach team members on equipment operation, maintenance procedures, safety requirements, FCC regulations, and broadcast standards.
  • Assist the Chief Engineer with employee development, performance management, departmental training, and long-term technical planning.
  • Provide leadership and decision-making for the Technical Department in the Chief Engineers absence.
  • Assist with planning and execution of capital projects, system upgrades, equipment installation, and facility improvements.
  • Work with Operation Manager to develop schedules that support Master Control, Production, Technical, and other operational needs.
  • Ensure technical staff have the tools, test equipment, supplies, documentation, and information needed to perform their responsibilities successfully.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable FCC rules, licensing requirements, safety standards, and company policies.
  • Establish and maintain productive relationships with local vendors, contractors, and service providers.
  • Support facility and physical-plant management across multiple locations.
  • Promote a collaborative, accountable, service-oriented, and safety-focused work environment.

 

Requirements

  • This position requires a flexible schedule for operational needs. Evenings, weekends, holidays and participation in 24-hour emergency responses are expected.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Television Broadcast Operations/Maintenance
  • Demonstrated technical leadership or supervisory experience, including assigning work, coaching employees, and leading technical projects.
  • Strong understanding of the complete broadcast signal chain from RF transmission, studio production, routing, distribution, and monitoring systems.
  • Hands on experience diagnosing , troubleshooting, and repairing broadcast and production equipment at the system, board, and component levels.
  • Working knowledge of transmitters, antennas, satellite systems, signal-routing equipment, studio systems, test equipment, and IP-based broadcasting technologies.
  • Knowledge of FCC technical requirements, licensing, recordkeeping, and broadcast compliance.
  • Experience with broadcast IT systems, networking, network security, and infrastructure support.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, signal-flow diagrams, schematics, equipment manuals, and system documentation. Experience with AutoCAD is a plus.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and make sound technical decisions during time sensitive or high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds, climb ladders, work at heights, perform physical activities associated with equipment installation and maintenance with reasonable accommodation.
  • Must have current driver's license.

job.title: Broadcast Maintenance Technician
job.description:
WCVB-TV, the ABC affiliate in Boston, is seeking a full-time Broadcast Maintenance Technician to support the systems and facilities that keep our station on the air. WCVB Engineering supports Master Control, news, studios, production, cameras, transmission, station IT infrastructure, and building systems.

This position will maintain, troubleshoot, repair, install, and upgrade equipment across the station. The technician will support daily operations, planned projects, preventive maintenance, live news coverage, special events, and remote broadcasts. This position reports to the Assistant Chief Engineer and works closely with Engineering, IT, Master Control, News, Production, and other station teams.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair broadcast production systems including field and studio cameras, audio, video, routing, monitoring, and signal distribution systems.
  • Support technical systems in Master Control, the newsroom, studios, control rooms, transmitter sites, and remote locations. 
  • Support station IT team and infrastructure in coordination with IT staff, including network-connected broadcast equipment, workstations, cabling, hardware, and software.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, system checks, reboots, equipment installs, cabling, testing, and documentation. 
  • Assist with station projects, system moves, equipment replacements, and new installations from prep through return to service. 
  • Provide technical support for live news, special events, and large scale multi cam remote broadcasts.
  • Work with vendors and service representatives during troubleshooting, repairs, upgrades, and installations. 

 

Systems and Technology

 

The technician will help support a wide range of systems, including Florical master control automation, Pixotope virtual production, Vinten/Videndum robotic camera systems, Sony studio and field cameras, Clear-Com, RTS and Unity intercom systems, TVU Networks mobile transmission systems, broadcast routers, signal distribution, monitoring, IP-based video and audio systems, and station computer, network, and cabling infrastructure.

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a high-performing team environment. 
  • Experience maintaining, troubleshooting, or repairing electronic, broadcast, production, computer, or networked equipment. 
  • Strong understanding of electronics, signal flow, computer systems, and IP networking. 
  • Ability to troubleshoot methodically, communicate clearly, document work, and work effectively across departments. 
  • Experience with broadcast video, audio, cameras, transmission systems, satellite communications, C-Band/Ku-Band systems, or IT infrastructure is valuable. 
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and work on ladders, rooftops, equipment areas, and confined spaces with proper safety procedures. 
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and occasional off-site assignments as station operations require. 
  • Familiarity with Windows and Mac workstations and standard software applications. 
  • AutoCAD or Visio experience for system drawings and layouts is preferred. 
  • Technical education, SBE certification, military technical experience, or equivalent hands-on experience is valued. 

Salary

The estimated base salary range for this role is between $110,517 and $117,515. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, market demands and conditions, including geographic location where the work will be performed, and other factors permitted by law. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description:
Chief Engineer 

WVTM, the NBC and CBS affiliates in Birmingham, Alabama “The Magic City” is seeking a Chief Engineer. The successful candidate will lead a team and demonstrate the ability to organize, plan, manage, document and complete assignments within a live broadcast environment. You will work in collaboration with the other department heads and directly oversee the daily operation of the station. We are looking for someone with experience in broadcast excellence and teamwork, with a passion for serving the local community, ready to embrace the challenges and opportunities of our ever-evolving industry. The ideal candidate must excel in motivating and working with a high-energy team, enthusiastic about collaborating with all departments, integrating AI into solutions and workflow, focused on the future of our industry. Candidate should demonstrate success in budgeting, capital planning and personnel management. This position reports directly to the General Manager and partners with Hearst Television leadership.   

 

What You’ll Do 

Engineering Leadership 

  • Lead, coach, and develop the station’s engineering team, including staffing, scheduling, AI adoption and implementation, performance feedback, technical training, and on-call coverage. 

  • Set priorities and service standards for engineering work, build strong working relationships across departments, and communicate technical issues and their operational impact clearly. 

  • Partner with the General Manager and station leaders to align technology plans with local journalism, production, business needs, and Hearst Television standards. 

Broadcast and Facility Operations 

  • Oversee the reliability, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle planning of broadcast, newsroom, production, automation, master control, media storage, network, streaming, and transmission systems. 

  • Maintain station transmission and RF facilities, studios, control rooms, remote production equipment, and critical infrastructure such as generators, UPS, and HVAC systems supporting technical operations. 

  • Provide engineering leadership during live programming, breaking news, severe weather, outages, and other urgent events; coordinate response, recovery, and follow-up. 

Compliance, Safety, and Resilience 

  • Ensure required FCC, EAS, and other applicable regulatory and industry obligations are met, with accurate records, scheduled testing, inspections, and timely corrective action. 

  • Maintain preventive maintenance, equipment inventory, technical documentation, safety practices, emergency preparedness, backup power, and disaster recovery plans. 

  • Coordinate with Hearst Television and enterprise IT partners on cybersecurity, network resilience, access practices, and business continuity for station systems. 

 

Planning and Modernization 

  • Develop and manage operating and capital budgets, equipment replacement plans, vendor relationships, service contracts, and engineering projects from proposal through implementation. 

  • Evaluate and implement improvements to IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid services, streaming, and other emerging technologies while protecting reliable on-air operations. 

  • Use approved AI tools, where appropriate, to support technical research, summarize logs or documentation, identify workflow improvement opportunities, and organize maintenance or project information; verify outputs before use and follow company requirements for confidential, employee, and operational data. 

  • Review significant technical incidents, identify root causes, document corrective actions, and apply lessons learned to improve reliability. 

 

What You’ll Need 

  • At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in television broadcast engineering, media technology, or a closely related technical field, including experience leading or supervising technical staff. 

  • Working knowledge of television broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio and newsroom technologies, automation, IP-based media workflows, and applicable FCC and EAS requirements. 

  • Experience planning technical projects, managing budgets and vendors, prioritizing equipment lifecycle needs, and coordinating work across departments. 

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex systems, make sound decisions under deadline pressure, and explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical colleagues. 

  • Ability to provide support during live operations and occasional nights, weekends, holidays, or emergencies as station needs require. 

  • Education, training, or experience in broadcast engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, electronics, or a related field. Hearst Television will consider a college degree, trade school diploma, professional certificates, military training, or equivalent practical experience. 

  • Experience with broadcast automation, IP video and audio, streaming, cloud or hybrid media systems, cybersecurity practices, emergency planning, and relevant certifications such as SBE is valued. 

  • Related military experience will be considered.
