job.title: Director of IT
job.description:
Hearst Television is seeking a Director of IT Operations to lead enterprise technology operations supporting approximately 30 television stations and business locations. This role is responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and cost-effective infrastructure while driving operational excellence across a geographically distributed organization.

Reporting to the Vice President of Information Technology, the Director provides strategic and technical leadership through collaboration with station leadership, Shared Services, Corporate IT, and external technology partners. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, sound business judgment, and the ability to influence teams and stakeholders without direct reporting authority.

this is an in-person position that requires periodic travel to Hearst Television locations and participation in an on-call rotation supporting critical technology operations. 

What You'll Do

Lead enterprise IT operations that enable broadcast, business, and digital teams to operate securely, efficiently, and reliably. You'll establish technology standards, modernize infrastructure, strengthen cybersecurity, and leverage automation and AI-enabled tools to improve operational performance while partnering across the organization to support business priorities.

How You'll Use AI Here

Hearst Television is investing in AI-enabled technologies that improve operational efficiency, monitoring, documentation, and decision-making. You'll evaluate and implement AI capabilities responsibly while partnering with Shared Services Security to ensure appropriate governance, data protection, and risk management.

Responsibilities

Enterprise IT Operations

  • Lead day-to-day IT operations across approximately 30 Hearst Television locations, ensuring consistent service delivery and infrastructure reliability.

  • Establish and maintain enterprise standards for infrastructure, operational support, system availability, and technology lifecycle management.

Infrastructure & Cloud Strategy

  • Direct the design, deployment, and modernization of on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including virtualization, compute, storage, and backup platforms. 

  • Develop long-term infrastructure roadmaps supporting scalability, resiliency, disaster recovery, and business continuity.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

  • Partner with Shared Services Security to strengthen identity management, endpoint security, vulnerability management, privileged access, and multifactor authentication.

  • Guide secure infrastructure architecture, firewall standards, network segmentation, remote access, and incident response practices.

Network & Endpoint Services

  • Oversee enterprise networking including switching, routing, wireless infrastructure, connectivity, monitoring, and performance optimization.

  • Establish standards for endpoint management, operating system deployment, patch management, software distribution, and device lifecycle planning.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead technical incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and executive communications during operational events.

  • Develop operational metrics, documentation, runbooks, escalation procedures, and service performance reporting to improve consistency across all locations.

Financial & Vendor Management

  • Manage departmental budgets, forecasting, purchasing priorities, licensing, and technology investment planning.

  • Build strategic partnerships with technology vendors while overseeing contracts, renewals, service levels, and performance management.

Technology Modernization

  • Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives including virtualization upgrades, cloud adoption, and enterprise technology transformation projects.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled operational tools that improve efficiency while maintaining appropriate governance.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with station leadership, Shared Services, Corporate IT, Finance, Procurement, Engineering, and business stakeholders to align technology investments with organizational priorities.

  • Influence local technology teams through collaboration, technical expertise, and enterprise standards without direct management authority.

 

What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive Information Technology experience in enterprise or multi-site environments.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing complex technology operations across geographically distributed organizations.
  • Experience leading through collaboration, influence, and cross-functional partnerships.
  • Experience managing enterprise technology budgets, vendors, contracts, and service-level agreements.
  • Experience leading major incident response and supporting 24/7 operational environments.

 

Technical Expertise & Skills

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure including servers, virtualization, networking, storage, cloud services, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Experience administering Microsoft infrastructure and cloud technologies, including Microsoft 365 and Azure.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or VxRail.
  • Knowledge of Cisco networking, Palo Alto firewalls, Windows Server, and enterprise endpoint management solutions.
  • Strong understanding of identity management, Zero Trust principles, privileged access, vulnerability management, and endpoint security technologies.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, automation technologies, and responsible implementation of AI-enabled operational tools.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical, planning, and organizational abilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic planning with operational execution.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships across technical and business teams.

 

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Relevant industry certifications are preferred.
  • Related military experience will be considered.

job.title: Intern
job.description:
The WESH 2/ CW18 News Internship Program is a paid, rigorous and highly competitive hands-on experience that provides individuals the opportunity to learn about the operations of a broadcast television station. You will develop news writing, producing, reporting, and digital media skills while learning from award-winning staff at WESH 2 News. Additional opportunities are available in the behind-the-scenes areas of production/studio operations, weather and marketing/promotions. Your internship will prepare you for work in a real newsroom, giving you opportunities in nearly every aspect of news production.
 

Spring 2027 Session
Application Window: Nov. 14th, 2026– Dec. 15th, 2026
Session: Jan. 25th, 2027 – April 16th, 2027
*Dates are subject to change
 

WESH 2/CW18 offers paid internships in the departments below. In order to apply for an internship at WESH 2/CW18, please provide a cover letter with your application. The cover letter should include:
•    Semester i.e. Spring, Summer, or Fall (if applicable)
•    Department preference
•    Available start and end dates
•    Days and hours available to intern
 

Available Internships

Newsroom

Interns will work alongside reporters, producers, and news managers to learn skills in nearly all aspects of television news production. Examples include on-scene reporting, producing, video editing, research, and working at the assignment desk.

Production/Studio Operations

Interns will learn the technical aspects of live news broadcasts. Behind-the-scenes training will include learning robotic cameras, floor directing, lighting and show set-ups. Interns are required to be comfortable with height, able to lift light equipment, and work non-traditional hours.

Digital

Interns will learn how newsrooms publish content to digital platforms, analyze real-time online metrics and more. Interns will get the opportunity to research, write, and publish stories for WESH.com.

Weather

Interns must have working knowledge of a meteorology curriculum or closely related program of study. You will work with our team of meteorologists to learn the skills necessary in creating and delivering forecast information for a television and online audience.

Marketing/Promotions

Interns with an interest in marketing, advertising, promotion, or production will be given hands-on experience in these areas.

Orientation

Once you are accepted as an intern at WESH-TV, you will receive an instruction packet. Your first day at the station is set aside for orientation and you Must attend this. You will work three days a week, eight hours each shift with varying schedules. During the internship you should always check in with your assigned adviser upon entering the building.

Securing housing and transportation during the internship are the responsibility of the student. WESH-TV cannot offer support in this area.

job.title: Investigative Reporter
job.description:

job.title: Media Sales Account Executive
job.description:
Are you a driven, strategic sales professional looking for a high-impact opportunity in media? WBAL-TV, Baltimore’s NBC affiliate, is looking for a Media Sales Account Executive to develop and manage business across television, digital, and streaming platforms.

This is a rare opportunity to sell marquee sports programming and premium content, including:

  • Baltimore Ravens
  • Sunday Night Baseball
  • Sunday Night Football
  • NBA
  • The Olympics
  • The Preakness Stakes

 

Compensation: Commission-based (Potential earnings: $50,000 – $75,000+, plus discretionary quarterly bonuses)

If you’re passionate about delivering results for clients, enjoy working with big brands and premium content, and thrive in a high energy, fast-paced, competitive environment, this is the career move for you!

 What You’ll Do:

  • Generate revenue across WBAL-TV’s platforms (TV, digital, streaming, and web)
  • Prospect, contact and present to new businesses
  • Develop new revenue through local business development, non-traditional business
  • Form strategic and market partnerships with local businesses and national advertisers
  • Sell high-profile programming like Sunday Night Football, The Olympics, and major sports franchises
  • Manage and grow active account/client portfolio
  • Conceptualize, create, and deliver sales proposals that are consistent with station strategies, including customized, research-driven presentations
  • Achieve individual sales goals while contributing to WBAL-TV’s dynamic sales team

 

What We’re Looking for:

  • 3+ years of media sales experience preferred (TV, radio, digital, or related industry)
  • Proven ability to develop new business and sell to local business owners
  • Experience with the development of new business/non-traditional business
  • Strong negotiation skills and consultative sales approach
  • Experience in a consultative customer-focused business atmosphere
  • Accountability within a goal-structured organization; experience in a goal-driven, competitive environment
  • Understand and use qualitative research to further sales effort; ability to analyze market research and position clients for success
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with sales software (Wide Orbit, Wide Orbit Media Sales, or similar programs a plus)
  • Ability to analyze market research and position clients for success
  • Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record
  • Related military experience will be considered
  • In person attendance is required

 

Why WBAL-TV?

  • Work with one of the most respected media brands in the industry.
  • Access to premium, exclusive content that drives results for advertisers.
  • Competitive commission structure with unlimited earning potential.
  • Career growth opportunities within Hearst Television.
  • A collaborative, high-performance team and a strong company culture.

 

If you’re ready to take your media sales career to the next level, apply today!

job.title: Meteorologist (Part Time)
job.description:
KSBW-TV has an On Call Opening for a high energy, highly skilled Meteorologist. We are looking for a meteorologist who knows the science, and can tell a relatable weather story. Our next meteorologist will be an accurate forecaster, keep our viewers and employees safe, convey appropriate tone, summarize complicated information, and stay cool under pressure.  

 

Job Responsibilities:  

  • Get our viewers ready with accurate, compelling, and understandable weather forecasts.   
  • Will provide urgent, immediate weather information before and during severe weather events 
  • Will be able to simultaneously provide content on TV, for our radio partners, and on our digital platforms. 
  • Will utilize all the technology and tools available to us, to tell an intriguing weather story 
  • Will be deployed in the field during weather events 
  • Gather information 
  • Summarize fact and clearly communicate content for broadcast 

Experience Requirements: 

  • Previous on-air experience required. 

Qualifications Requirements:  

  • In-depth knowledge of weather science and forecasting.   
  • Proven on-air experience in handling breaking news and severe weather coverage 
  • Dynamic on-air presence with a conversational weather presentation 
  • Knowledgeable about how to interpret and translate high powered radar data 
  • Proficient in using WSI graphics and technology   
  • Excellent forecasting and on-air skills 
  • Strong organizational skills 
  • Ability to tell a compelling weather story 
  • Ability to use common television weather systems.  
  • Radar experience preferred 
  • Ability to do live field reporting on weather and other topics.   

Education: 

  • Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Meteorology or related field     
  • CBM and/or AMS seal preferred 
  • Military training and experience will be considered 

 

The estimated base salary range for this role is between $37.50 and $37.500. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, market demands and conditions, including geographic location where the work will be performed, and other factors permitted by law. job.title: National Digital News Curator
job.description:
Hearst Television is seeking a well-rounded, full-time Digital News Curator to create and distribute nationally focused news content for more than two dozen local Hearst Television stations across the country. The curator will write, publish, and edit digital content for station websites, mobile apps, and social media channels, elevating stories of national interest. This role requires an excellent storyteller who thrives under deadline pressure and can create compelling content in a competitive news environment. The curator will join Hearst Television’s National Desk and will report to the Senior Curator. This is a full-time, in-person position based in Pittsburgh, PA.

Responsibilities

  • Write, edit, and publish news stories of national interest for Hearst Television stations nationwide.
  • Write compelling headlines and craft effective mobile push notifications.
  • Respond quickly to breaking news with strong editorial judgment to determine how content should be distributed across stations’ digital platforms.
  • Curate and syndicate national and international news content from our stations/partners that aligns with the interests of local station audiences.
  • Copy edit content in adherence with AP Style.
  • Edit and create videos and graphics for our stations’ social channels
  • Manage live video streams and distribute them to Hearst Television stations across digital, mobile, and social platforms.
  • Coordinate with local stations and digital teams to support content and coverage needs.
  • Maintain high ethical and journalistic standards.

Requirements

  • Experience working in a newsroom or digital publishing environment.

  • Strong news judgment and editorial decision-making skills.

  • Excellent AP writing and copyediting skills.

  • Basic knowledge of video editing.

  • Understanding of social media best practices.

  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, often on short notice, to support a 24-hour news cycle.

  • Related military experience will be considered.

job.title: News Intern (Fall)
job.description:
Come join KCRA/KQCA TV, the Hearst Television station in Sacramento, as a Newsroom Intern! You will come to understand how a television station functions, the many jobs available and the roles the TV station plays in the community. As an intern, you’ll learn what it’s like to work with a collaborative team across multiple departments, how we get news on the air and on our digital platforms, and the vital role other departments play at the television station.

 

Newsroom interns will spend 10 to 12 weeks shadowing and gaining experience in the following departments:

 

Assignment Desk

  • Assist team members in gathering news and information. This includes taking and placing telephone calls from reporters, sources, governments agencies and general public
  • May also assist in research and other tasks

 

TV News Production

  • Practice writing and formatting scripts for broadcast
  • Time in the field shadowing reporters or anchors at a live report 

 

Digital News Production

  • Help research and write content for KCRA digital platforms including the KCRA app, KCRA.com and various social media platforms
  • When appropriate, the opportunity to help with photo and video production for digital platforms may be available
  • Assist with social media efforts and email communication

 

Photographers and Logistics

  • Assist team members with field work and news gathering

 

Sports

  • Monitor national sports feeds/accounts for any breaking sports news
  • Log all sports events recorded by the Sports staff
  • Write scripts for daily sportscast
  • Research team and player statistics
  • Pitch story ideas to sports department
  • May accompany reporters on location shoots

 

Weather

  • Analyze weather charts and models
  • Prepare daily forecasts
  • Produce weather graphics
  • Assist meteorologists in gathering critical & breaking weather information and data
  • Relay important information to/from News, Assignment Desk, and Web
  • Research statistical data
  • Practice forecast delivery in-studio
  • Assist with social media efforts and email communication

 

Salary

Interns will get paid $20.00 per hour.

job.title: Senior Digital Producer
job.description:
WBAL NewsRadio 1090 AM and FM 101.5 and 98 Rock, Hearst-owned radio stations in Baltimore, are seeking an innovative, data-driven Senior Digital Producer to lead digital strategy, audience growth initiatives and day-to-day platform operations.

The Senior Digital Producer will oversee the execution of digital strategy for WBAL.com and 98online.com. This role manages the organization and optimization of both WordPress content management systems (CMS) and works with editorial leaders to deliver timely, engaging digital experiences. The position focuses on digital planning, presentation and distribution; content priorities remain with each department’s editorial leadership.

Reporting to the Director of Digital & Creative Services, the Senior Digital Producer works closely with program directors, the Creative Services Director, newsroom staff, show producers and sales teams. The role develops strategies to grow audiences across websites, mobile, newsletters, podcasts, social media and emerging platforms, and uses performance data to recommend improvements. The salary range for this position is $50,000 - $52,000. 

The ideal candidate is passionate about digital publishing, audience development, analytics and emerging platforms. They bring strong editorial judgment, excellent organizational skills and experience managing digital content, using analytics to guide decisions and growing audiences across multiple platforms.

Job Responsibilities:                                     

  • Lead and execute the overall digital strategy for WBAL.com and 98online.com.
  • Manage and optimize the stations’ WordPress CMS platforms, ensuring content is accurate, current, well organized and visually engaging.
  • Analyze audience behavior, traffic trends and content performance to guide editorial and promotional recommendations.
  • Develop initiatives to grow audiences across web, mobile, newsletters, podcasts, social media and emerging platforms.
  • Lead SEO and content optimization efforts to improve discoverability and engagement.
  • Coordinate digital coverage plans for breaking news and major station events.
  • Work with Digital Content Producers, newsroom staff, show producers and on-air talent to support timely, effective digital publishing.
  • Train station personnel in digital best practices, content optimization, social publishing and emerging platform trends.
  • Use Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube and other platforms to engage audiences and promote station content.
  • Prepare regular analytics reports with actionable recommendations for editorial and business teams.

 

Experience Requirements:

  • Demonstrated success using analytics to drive audience growth and content performance.
  • Experience managing website content through a content management system.
  • Knowledge and experience with Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, and Audition preferred
  • Broadcasting degree or equivalent preferred
  • Knowledge of best practices for Facebook, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube

 

Qualifications Requirements:

  • Highly organized.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities.
  • Excellent news judgment.
  • Passion for audience growth and digital innovation.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent project management skills.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
  • Collaborative team player with strong cross-functional communication skills.
  • Ability to influence and train others without direct supervisory responsibility.
  • Flexible in schedule, with some availability needed outside regular hours for breaking news and major events.

 

Education:

  • Related experience and/or training considered as well as a combination of education and experience.
  • Military training from Defense Information School with experience will be considered
  • Hearst Television is a proud supporter of military veterans. Related military training and experience will be considered.

job.title: WLKY - Chief Engineer
job.description:
WLKY, the CBS affiliate in Louisville KY is seeking a Chief Engineer to lead the technical operation and continued modernization of a television station. Reporting to the General Manager, this role is a member of the station leadership team and is accountable for the reliability, safety, compliance, and performance of the systems and facilities that support broadcast, news, production, transmission, and digital distribution. The Chief Engineer partners across the station and with Hearst Television teams to keep service dependable today and plan for what comes next. The right candidate will be a proven leader with the ability to motivate teams and build a culture of excellence.

What You’ll Do

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the station’s engineering team, including staffing, scheduling, performance feedback, technical training, and on-call coverage.
  • Set priorities and service standards for engineering work, build strong working relationships across departments, and communicate technical issues and their operational impact clearly.
  • Partner with the General Manager and station leaders to align technology plans with local journalism, production, business needs, and Hearst Television standards.

 

Broadcast and Facility Operations

  • Oversee the reliability, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle planning of broadcast, newsroom, production, automation, master control, media storage, network, streaming, and transmission systems.
  • Maintain station transmission and RF facilities, studios, control rooms, remote production equipment, and critical infrastructure such as generators, UPS, and HVAC systems supporting technical operations.
  • Provide engineering leadership during live programming, breaking news, severe weather, outages, and other urgent events; coordinate response, recovery, and follow-up.

 

Compliance, Safety, and Resilience

  • Ensure required FCC, EAS, and other applicable regulatory and industry obligations are met, with accurate records, scheduled testing, inspections, and timely corrective action.
  • Maintain preventive maintenance, equipment inventory, technical documentation, safety practices, emergency preparedness, backup power, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Coordinate with Hearst Television and enterprise IT partners on cybersecurity, network resilience, access practices, and business continuity for station systems.

 

Planning and Modernization

  • Develop and manage operating and capital budgets, equipment replacement plans, vendor relationships, service contracts, and engineering projects from proposal through implementation.
  • Evaluate and implement improvements to IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid services, streaming, and other emerging technologies while protecting reliable on-air operations.
  • Use approved AI tools, where appropriate, to support technical research, summarize logs or documentation, identify workflow improvement opportunities, and organize maintenance or project information; verify outputs before use and follow company requirements for confidential, employee, and operational data.
  • Review significant technical incidents, identify root causes, document corrective actions, and apply lessons learned to improve reliability.

 

What You’ll Need

  • At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in television broadcast engineering, media technology, or a closely related technical field, including experience leading or supervising technical staff.
  • Working knowledge of television broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio and newsroom technologies, automation, IP-based media workflows, and applicable FCC and EAS requirements.
  • Experience planning technical projects, managing budgets and vendors, prioritizing equipment lifecycle needs, and coordinating work across departments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex systems, make sound decisions under deadline pressure, and explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Ability to provide support during live operations and occasional nights, weekends, holidays, or emergencies as station needs require.
  • Education, training, or experience in broadcast engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, electronics, or a related field. Hearst Television will consider a college degree, trade school diploma, professional certificates, military training, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with broadcast automation, IP video and audio, streaming, cloud or hybrid media systems, cybersecurity practices, emergency planning, and relevant certifications such as SBE is valued.
  • Related military experience will be considered.

We're looking for a reporter who can work a lead and break the big stories - who wants to own the big story every day.  You must be able to work quickly, under tight deadlines, understand and implement direction and feedback, develop sources and collaborate with a photographer in order to tell the best story possible. Your reel should demonstrate live reporting ability and your vertical video storytelling ability.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, gather and assemble stories on day-of news or special project assignments
  • Work with or without a photographer to gather and edit compelling video and captivating sound
  • Produce compelling vertical videos for social platforms
  • Contribute pictures, video and text updates to mobile platforms throughout the day
  • Coordinate with news managers and producers to develop stories that go beyond surface details, that accentuate unique enterprise angles, and have exclusive content
  • Develop a network of sources who provide tips, early access to information, and allow the reporter to break stories of significance
  • Work on different stories and projects at once and meeting all deadlines under pressure.
  • Have and exhibit unwavering journalistic integrity and ethical standards

Requirements

  • Professional reporting experience
  • Experience with enterprise reporting and ability to uncover details
  • Your demo reel is indicative of your everyday work, including reels 
  • Write clear, correct, compelling copy that supports images gathered
  • Operate mobile transmission devices and use latest technology
  • Can work in all weather conditions
  • Have and exhibit unwavering journalistic integrity and ethical standards
  • Have a valid driver's license and a clear driving record
  • Work varied shifts, including overnights and weekends
  • Can deal with the stresses and pressures of time-sensitive newscast production
  • Related military experience will be considered

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That’s why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

Benefits

Hearst's benefit programs are modern, flexible and designed to focus on you. As a Hearst employee, you and your spouse or partner or dependents would have access to the following benefits.

  • Medical | Dental | Vision
  • 401(k) matching
  • Emotional Wellness Support
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • LGBTQ+ Health Services
  • Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

job.title: WLKY - Video Journalist
job.description:
WLKY, the CBS affiliate in Louisville, Kentucky, has an opening for a Video Journalist/Photographer who understands the pressures and purpose of local television news. We are seeking an experienced video journalist who can collaborate and lead when collecting and editing visual elements for compelling storytelling on all WLKY platforms. You will be responsible for gathering visual content, working either individually to edit, or as a team to collaborate and edit newscast and online content. We are looking for a news photographer who understands the urgency of breaking news, the importance of deadlines, and the critical elements of collaboration and communication when working with reporters. Excellent editing skills, exceptional time-management abilities, effective communication style, organization, and attention to gear/equipment maintenance are critical. An excellent eye for video and the highest journalistic standards are a must. You will edit video for all platforms in multiple formats. This position reports to the News Director. Responsibilities

  • Shoot and edit VOs, VO-SOTs, packages and vertical videos for broadcast, social and digital platforms
  • Work with the Assignment Desk and Reporters to cover daily stories
  • Shoot on a full-size Sony ENG camera
  • Preferred drone certification, willing to become certified in drone operation
  • Edit in Adobe Premiere and use ENG, SNG, and wireless data to feed live shots and video to station
  • Work with reporters and desk to ensure the best content and facts are gathered
  • Work with the digital team to make sure information, images, and video from the fields are transferred quickly
  • Work with catalog systems to record and locate necessary video
  • Attention to detail regarding file management and technical workflow
  • Must be flexible with schedule, being on-call and respond quickly to breaking news
  • Ability to work under pressure, making quick decisions
  • Responsible for organization and care of gear/equipment and station vehicles
 Requirements 
  • Professional news video photographer experience preferred
  • Carry up to 50 pounds of equipment
  • Experience with ENG trucks and live transmission gear
  • Can work in all weather conditions
  • Have a valid driver's license and a clean driving record
  • Ability to operate digital editing tools
  • Must have computer and software experience
  • Knowledge of Adobe Premiere, Precis, and CNN platforms preferred
  • Have and exhibit unwavering journalistic integrity and ethical standards
  • Can deal with the stresses and pressures of time-sensitive content production
  • Related military experience will be considered
  • In-person attendance is required

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Hearst Times Union Media Group is looking for a driven Account Executive to join our Capital Region sales team. This is a full-cycle, new business-focused sales role where you’ll be responsible for prospecting, closing, and growing new accounts, while building long-term partnerships with local and regional companies.  You’ll also have a book of existing accounts that generate commissions and you can upsell on our wide swath of digital marketing solutions. 

You’ll have the backing of one of the most recognized media brands in the country, plus access to cutting-edge AI tools that help you prospect smarter, close faster, and maximize your earning potential.

 If you’re competitive, resourceful, and motivated by uncapped earnings, this is an opportunity to take your sales career to the next level.

Why Join Hearst Times Union Media Group?

Uncapped Earnings Potential
Base salary + aggressive commission structure. Top performers consistently exceed targets.

Sell with a Competitive Edge
Leverage advanced tools like ChatGPT Enterprise to streamline prospecting, sharpen presentations, and accelerate deal cycles.

High-Impact Role in a Strong Market
Albany is a dynamic market for SMB’s, with endless opportunity to build new business and expand client relationships.

Trusted Brand & Premium Products
Represent a respected media organization with a powerful portfolio of advertising solutions and a massive audience reach.  Our team makes sales from $5000 to $500,000. 

Career Growth & Mobility
We invest in our people. Whether you want to grow your book, move into leadership, or expand into new markets, there’s a path here.

Be part of a team of six AE’s reporting to a Sales Director who invests their time in you, making you better every day! 

Work inside (presenting on Microsoft Teams) and Go outside, we highly value in person meetings. 

Regular get togethers, happy hours, be part of a Sales office of over 30 sales and support staff. 

Hybrid schedule, Monday and Friday remote, Tues/Wed/Thursday in office. 

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the Full Sales Cycle
    Prospect, pitch, close, and grow accounts across digital, event, and print solutions.
  • Drive New Business
    Proactively identify and connect with small, medium and large businesses through outreach, networking, and market awareness.
  • Present a compelling suite of products including best in class Content Marketing, Hearst Any Screen Streaming Television Advertising, SEO, SEM, display including programmatic, paid social media marketing, Email marketing, print solutions, and more.
  • Build & Manage Your Pipeline
    Maintain a strong pipeline of new and existing business using Salesforce, Outreach, ChatGPT Enterprise, and consistently meet activity and revenue targets.
  • Deliver Compelling Presentations
    Lead discovery conversations and present media plans that clearly demonstrate value and ROI.
  • Leverage AI to Win More Deals
    Use over a dozen of our customized GPT’s, AI-powered tools that increase your efficiency, improve client engagement, and close business faster.

 

What Sets You Apart:

  • You’re a hunter who thrives on winning new business
  • You are dynamic on the phone and in person. 
  • You know Albany and the Capital Region well. 
  • You’re competitive and goal-oriented, with a track record of exceeding targets
  • You’re confident in client-facing situations, from cold outreach to executive presentations
  • You’re adaptable and resourceful, able to navigate challenges and find solutions
  • You’re strategic in your approach, not just transactional
  • You bring strong communication and relationship-building skills

 

 Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of B2B sales experience (media, advertising, business or related industry preferred)
  • Proven success in new business development and revenue growth
  • Experience managing a full sales cycle
  • Adept at using CRM tools (Salesforce, Outreach, or similar. 
  • Existing relationships in the Albany market are a plus

 

Our Benefits: At Times Union Media Group we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

Ready to Make an Impact?

Join us and be part of a team that’s transforming local media through technology and human connection.

Apply now to launch your next chapter as a trusted media partner to businesses across Albany.

Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York State. The reasonable estimated starting base salary, if hired in New York State, would start at about $50,000 (base salary), plus commissions with on target first year earnings potential of $75,000 - $125,000 (annualized) based on individual performance. There is no commission cap.  Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York State. If this role is open to candidates outside of New York State, the salary range would be aligned to that specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Title: Account Executive

Join Hearst Connecticut Media Group to help deliver impactful media campaigns for our customers, leveraging our rich history, extensive audience reach, best-in-class advertising solutions, and the power of cutting-edge AI tools!

Role Overview:  Hearst Newspapers is investing in its sales force, and we want you to be a part of it! We are looking for a digitally savvy, highly motivated Account Executive to join our advertising team at Hearst Connecticut Media Group. As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for developing and managing a sales pipeline and building new business relationships with local advertisers throughout the Connecticut area. You will work with your customers to promote compelling solutions that best fit their marketing needs. As an advocate for the customer within Hearst Connecticut Media Group, the role works in cooperation with other departments to ensure we can meet and exceed customer expectations both in performance and process. Hearst Newspapers operates on a hybrid work week schedule. 

Why Hearst Connecticut Media Group? 

Our people make the difference! Our diverse team is filled with passionate individuals who want to win. We offer an upbeat and collaborative working environment where challenging the norm is encouraged. With ample opportunities to learn new skills and advance within the organization, our team members are given the tools to learn and grow their careers.

Leverage Advanced AI for Maximum Efficiency and Earnings
Imagine having a personal assistant that never sleeps. Our state-of-the-art AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Gong.io, streamline your workflow, enabling you to close deals faster and manage your pipeline more effectively. 

This means more time to focus on what you love and a direct boost to your earnings potential.

Exclusive Partnership with OpenAI
Through our strategic content partnership with OpenAI and our exclusive ChatGPT Enterprise license, we have unparalleled access to the latest advancements in AI technology. 

This partnership provides us—and you—with a massive competitive edge in the market, ensuring you have the most powerful tools at your disposal to drive sales and exceed targets.

Personalized AI Tutors for Seamless Onboarding
Your success starts from day one. With our personalized AI tutors, every question you have, and every training need you encounter is met with instant, tailored support. 

These AI-driven mentors ensure you learn and sell as quickly and efficiently as possible, empowering you to hit the ground running and achieve your goals faster.

What will you do?

  • Drive Success with Innovative Tools: Utilize our AI-powered software to enhance every stage of the sales cycle, from prospecting and planning to presenting and closing deals.

  • Lead Generation: Call on local small to medium sized businesses to show the value of our suite of digital media advertising products from social media, display, video, programmatic, SEO/SEM to traditional advertisements. You will generate new leads through cold calling, networking, and prospecting, as well as staying aware of any new businesses opening in the area. You will own the sales cycle and will have the support of your local account management team to aid in continued support after the sale!
  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on our digital and print products/services. The first three weeks of hire, you will be provided with both global and local training to be fully educated before even going out on your own! You will also have full support throughout your career which includes continual learning and training to grow and achieves success as an Account Executive. 
  • Execute sales tactics: Implementing marketing strategies, delivering effective sales presentations with passion to consistently earn, retain and increase revenue.
  • Advertising Solutions: Create engaging advertising solutions to solve clients’ business needs.
  • Client Solutions: Recommend new products and promotional opportunities to current clients and handle objections efficiently. Be a large part of the local business community and boosting your clients’ businesses through multiple digital media channels.
  • Forecasting: Manage client pipeline and monthly revenue forecast in Salesforce.com.

 

What will it take to be successful?

  • Purposeful: You are direct and get things done quickly, with confidence, integrity, and determination.
  • Adaptable: You react and adjust to changing conditions and come up with practical ideas to deal with them.
  • Driven: You have self-assurance and competitive drive, delivering high-quality, organized, and repeatable results.
  • Communicator: You are a lively and intelligent person with a stimulating influence on others.
  • Trend-Savvy: you will keep informed of industry developments to ensure our digital advertising strategies remain cutting-edge and effective.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 2+ years of business-to-business outside sales in advertising or media, with a proven success in new business acquisition and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Skills: Superior presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills. Technically savvy with experience in Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Mindset: Goal-oriented, competitive, and forward-thinking with strong business and financial acumen.

 

What we offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: A great work environment where it's never boring.
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid in-depth sales and product training.
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary with uncapped commissions for unlimited earning potential.
  • Collaborative Culture: Ideas and input are always welcome.
  • Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

Join us at Hearst Connecticut Media Group and become part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Apply now to make an impact in the Connecticut advertising market!

Compensation: In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in Connecticut. The reasonable estimate, if hired in Connecticut, is $50,000 - $60,000 base plus commissions with on-target earning potential of $90,000 - $120,000 annualized in the 1st year, based on individual performance, commissions are uncapped for unlimited earning potential. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

Benefits: Eligible employees enjoy Health, dental, vision coverage, Health savings and/or flexible spending accounts, short & long-term disability insurance, 401k with company match, paid time off for vacation, sick days, company holidays and floating holidays. 

About Hearst Connecticut Media Group:

Hearst Connecticut Media Group (HCMG) is the leading news organization in the state, serving readers across all platforms through its news and lifestyle portfolio—including CT Insider, The Connecticut Post, Danbury News-Times, Greenwich Time, New Haven Register, The Middletown Press, The Norwalk Hour, The Register Citizen, Republican-American, Stamford Advocate, and Connecticut Magazine. 
 
With the largest news-gathering team in the state, HCMG is deeply committed to providing local, watchdog, and investigative reporting that informs, educates, and entertains the communities it serves. In addition to its journalism, the organization provides innovative, unique advertising and marketing solutions to help local and regional businesses grow and succeed

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 30 daily and 50 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News, The Dallas Morning News, Austin American-Statesman, Connecticut Post and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories–growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms–to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. 

Be a part of something bigger–Your Headline Awaits

job.title: Audience Intern
job.description:
Audience Intern

Job Description

The Houston Chronicle is looking for a curious and versatile student journalist to join its Audience team for the summer 2027 internship program.

Audience journalists help determine how journalism reaches people — and what makes them want to come back. You’ll work alongside editors, reporters and audience strategists to help shape coverage, craft compelling headlines and social posts, engage readers across platforms and use data to understand what matters to our audience.

You’ll gain experience at the intersection of journalism, storytelling and digital strategy while helping the Chronicle reach hundreds of thousands of readers across Houston and beyond. You may help package breaking news, promote enterprise reporting, build newsletters, identify search opportunities, analyze reader behavior and develop new ways to connect with audiences. 

This position is designed for motivated student journalists who want to build careers in audience journalism and gain hands-on experience in a major newsroom. Past interns have gone on to full-time roles at the Chronicle as reporters, producers and editors across our newsroom and audience teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor real-time analytics and identify patterns in what readers are viewing, sharing and returning to

  • Help editors and reporters frame stories for maximum clarity, relevance and impact
  • Write and refine headlines, social copy, push alerts and other promotional language with attention to SEO and news value
  • Create social posts and contribute to strategies for platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and more
  • Assist with newsletter planning, writing and audience-focused story selection
  • Help package stories for the homepage and other digital platforms
  • Research search trends, audience interests and emerging platforms
  • Pitch ideas for reaching new audiences and deepening connections with existing readers

  • Collaborate across the newsroom to translate Chronicle journalism into useful, compelling digital experiences

Requirements:

  • Juniors, seniors or recent graduates with prior experience at a college news publication or professional news organization.
  • A personal laptop and Wi-Fi or hotspot access.
  • Must obtain housing in Houston and work in the Chronicle’s office at least 3 days a week.

 

Internship Details:

  • 40 hours a week for 10 weeks, from early June and to early August. Interns will be paid $15 an hour. 
  • Interns will work Monday through Friday, with occasional weekend coverage based on news demands. 
  • The recruiting committee will assign all interns a mentor from the newsroom based on their interests.

 

Application details:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications, including the required documents, by October 25, 2026. 

Please submit a portfolio of 5 audience-related clips (social media posts, newsletters, alerts, etc.), a resume, and a 1-page cover letter addressed to the recruiting committee detailing your passion for journalism and what you hope to achieve through this internship.

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.  

Be a part of something bigger – your headline awaits.

Recognizing the diverse needs of our candidates, if you are interested in applying for employment and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or regarding the application process, please contact us by email at hnpemployment@hearst.com.  Please do not use this email address to inquire about the status of applications. We will only respond to inquiries concerning requests for a reasonable accommodation through this email address.

job.title: Breaking News Intern
job.description:
Reporting Intern

Job Description

The Houston Chronicle is looking for an adaptable and detail-oriented student journalist to join its Breaking News team for the summer 2027 internship program

Reporting interns will have the chance to work in one of America’s most exciting news markets, reporting and writing timely stories about the events, issues and trends shaping Houston and Texas. They will gain hands-on experience covering stories on deadline, developing follow-ups, pitching story ideas and collaborating with editors, photographers and audience journalists to deliver accurate, engaging coverage.

job.title: Digital Media Advisor
job.description:
Digital Media Advisor

Hearst Digital Marketing Services is seeking a highly motivated and experienced seller to join our team. job.title: Digital News Producer, Chron
job.description:
Digital News Producer, Chron

Are you a fast, digitally savvy journalist who thrives at the intersection of breaking news and audience growth? Join Chron’s audience team and help shape how our stories reach and engage readers across Houston and Texas.

Job Description

Chron, a digital-first news publisher, is seeking a Digital News Producer to play a critical role on our audience team, helping drive daily coverage, optimize the site experience, and ensure our journalism reaches the widest possible audience. This is a hybrid role combining audience production and fast-turn news writing.

The ideal candidate has strong news judgment, understands what audiences are searching for and sharing in real time, and can quickly turn around clean, accurate and buzzy stories and video rooted in verification and light additional reporting.

This role is scheduled Sunday–Thursday and will serve as the lead audience producer on Sundays. This person will report to the Deputy Managing Editor of News & Sports, with a dotted line to Chron’s Audience Editor.

What will you do?

  • Write 2–3 daily quick-turn stories, including breaking news and trending topics, with a focus on speed, accuracy, and strong headlines 
  • Shoot and edit timely, highly shareable video that connects with audiences off platform
  • Serve as the lead audience producer on Sundays, helping guide coverage, distribution, and real-time decisions
  • Package and distribute Chron content across social platforms to drive traffic, with a focus on emerging and secondary platforms such as Reddit and Nextdoor
  • Track newsletter cadence and performance, identifying gaps, trends, and opportunities, and regularly sharing insights with the audience manager

 

What will it take to be successful?

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a digital newsroom as a digital content producer, reporter, or audience producer 
  • Strong news judgment, particularly regarding issues that Texans care about, and the ability to prioritize quickly in a fast-paced environment 
  • Proven ability to write clean, accurate, and engaging news stories on tight deadlines 
  • Experience with breaking news and/or trending content workflows 
  • Familiarity with content management systems and digital publishing tools 
  • Understanding of audience metrics and tools such as Google Trends, Google Analytics, or Marfeel  
  • Solid understanding of AP Style and journalistic standards
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across newsroom teams 
  • Interest in Houston and Texas news and an understanding of what resonates with local audiences 

 

About Business Unit

Chron is a digital-first Texas newsroom based in Houston, covering the conversations, culture and everyday moments that shape life across the state—with the perspective of an independent culture publication and a voice that’s sharp, current and unmistakably Texan.

Since 2012, Chron has maintained an independent newsroom separate from the Houston Chronicle and provides free access to its coverage. 

 

About Hearst Newspapers

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate.

job.title: Digital Reporter
job.description:
Digital Reporter

Work Location: Beaumont, TX, Laredo, TX, Midland, TX, or Plainview, TX

Hybrid

Description:

This position demands initiative, accuracy, urgency and insight. It also demands strong news judgment and the ability to find and identify stories and trends that are immediate, important and influential across a variety of small community markets. Quick writing and reporting skills are crucial. This person can juggle a high volume of stories across multiple markets daily, all while staying focused on the digital details of story production: Headlines, SEO, multi-media assets and other points of optimization. 

The person who fills this position needs to be able to self-assign and re-prioritize in real-time. Additionally, this person needs to feel comfortable with being edited by peers – and to contribute to peer editing.  

Primary Responsibilities: 

  • Pitch and write 3 to 5 stories a day based on what's trending in local market (s)
  • Report quickly, clearly and accurately and deliver news via stories, video, newsletters, social media platforms or any other methods available to reach new audiences.
  • Identify top news stories of the day based on analytics and audience potential.
  • Quickly recognize and jump on breaking news for assigned markets and coordinate with other Hearst newspapers regionally. 
  • Work with local and regional editors as well as the Hearst development team to experiment with new ways of finding and engaging new audiences on social platforms and alternative storyforms.
  • Create and maintain a steady supply of sources for story ideas that allows a depth of ideas each day that can provide different options to choose from.
  • Be familiar with contact information for various agencies to obtain information as quickly as possible.
  • Pitch and create alternative forms of content, including listicles, slideshows, and timelines.
  • Work with other newsroom staff on shared byline projects as necessary. 

Competencies/Critical Skills: 

  • Solid news judgment and a strong understanding of the local market. Awareness of media standards around fair use and an accurate citation for content.
  • Proficient writer, fact-checker, and familiar with AP Style. 
  • Understand web metrics to guide story choices toward KPI growth. Knowledge of analytics and CMS tools such as Chartbeat and Google Analytics.
  • Organized and able to meet deadlines in daily and breaking news situations.
  • Open to off-typical schedules including early mornings, late evenings and/or weekends.  

What are the measures of success for this position? 

  • Deliver stories quickly, accurately and at a consistent pace 
  • Meeting daily and weekly KPIs for audience growth, including story visits and subscriber traffic 
  • Grow your social media base and regularly promote links to stories 
  • Great teamwork with digital and newsroom staff 

Experience, Qualifications, Technical Requirements, Education 

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism or related field required 
  • Understanding of audience engagement metrics is preferred 
  • News writing experience and familiarity with AP style required

job.title: Houston Chronicle Visuals Internship
job.description:
The Houston Chronicle is looking for a creative and ambitious student journalist to join its Visuals team for the summer 2027 internship program

The position is designed for motivated student journalists who want to build careers in visual journalism and gain hands-on experience producing photography and video in a major newsroom. The intern will help produce compelling still photography and short-form video for the Chronicle’s website and social platforms, including TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts. They will have the opportunity to collaborate across the newsroom to tell visually driven stories that capture Houston’s people, culture and breaking news moments.

Our summer interns are integral members of the newsroom, producing work that reaches hundreds of thousands of readers and viewers. Past interns have gone on to full-time roles at the Chronicle as reporters, producers and editors across our newsroom and audience teams.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Photograph and film daily and enterprise assignments in coordination with editors and reporters

  • Pitch, shoot, edit and publish short-form videos optimized for social platforms

  • Identify visual storytelling opportunities across beats and social trends

  • Edit and caption photos and videos with attention to accuracy, tone and engagement

  • Collaborate with reporters, editors and the audience team to translate Chronicle journalism into visual stories

  • Contribute ideas for visual storytelling that strengthen the Chronicle’s reach and connection with audiences

Requirements:

  • Juniors, seniors or recent graduates with prior experience at a college news publication or professional news organization.
  • Valid driver's license and access to a car.
  • Must obtain housing in Houston and work in the Chronicle’s office at least 3 days a week.

     

Internship Details:

  • 40 hours a week for 10 weeks, from early June to early August. Interns will be paid $15 an hour.

  • Interns will work Monday through Friday, with occasional weekend coverage based on news demands.

  • The recruiting committee will assign all interns a mentor from the newsroom based on their interests.

     

Application details:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications, including the required documents, by October 25, 2026. 

Please submit a portfolio of 5 visuals clips (portfolio websites are acceptable), a resume, and a 1-page cover letter addressed to the recruiting committee detailing your passion for journalism and what you hope to achieve through this internship.

job.title: Prepress Operator
job.description:
Prepress Operator

 

Position Summary

Responsible for reviewing, preparing, and processing newspaper and commercial print materials to ensure accuracy, quality, and compliance with production specifications before files are released to press. This position requires strong attention to detail, effective communication, the ability to manage multiple priorities, and the ability to work efficiently in a deadline-driven production environment.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Review pages, layouts, plans, and sections to ensure accuracy and completeness before files are released to press plates.
  • Verify production specifications for commercial print projects involving both internal departments and external vendors.
  • Monitor and maintain awareness of internal and external emails and communications to ensure production requirements, changes, and deadlines are addressed promptly.
  • Maintain constant communication with Editorial and Diagramming teams to resolve issues, coordinate changes, and maintain an accurate production workflow.
  • Manage multiple tasks and production assignments simultaneously across various platforms while meeting strict deadlines.
  • Operate and navigate production systems, including Newsway, CUE Print, Naviga, and PGL.
  • Use Adobe software to review, edit, troubleshoot, and prepare files for print production.
  • Monitor production workflows and identify issues that could affect page quality, deadlines, press schedules, or delivery.
  • Communicate production issues promptly and work with the appropriate teams to resolve missing, incorrect, or problematic files.
  • Follow established production procedures, deadlines, quality standards, and press requirements.
  • Provide support to other members of the production team as needed to maintain workflow and meet daily deadlines.
  • Work flexible hours as required, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on production schedules and business needs.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven production environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple assignments at the same time.
  • Experience working with Adobe Creative Cloud applications is essential.
  • Ability to learn and work with multiple production and publishing systems.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with Editorial, Diagramming, Prepress, and other departments.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

job.title: Social Media Coordinator
job.description:
Social Media Coordinator

We’re looking for a creative and driven social media coordinator to join our growing advertising operations social media team at Hearst Newspapers. You’ll be focused on fulfilling content requests (often referred to as “sponsored” or “co-branded” posts) from our advertisers on 6+ publisher social profiles. Other key job responsibilities will include supporting paid and organic strategists with their current agency clients. This is a great role for fine-tuning both organic and paid social media skill sets, all while working with nationally recognized media brands and clients!

What You’ll Do

  • Own advertiser’s content request fulfillment process from start to finish. You will ensure that the advertising client has provided the necessary assets for post creation, write/edit the copy for the social post, modify links/visuals as needed, get editorial and client approval on the post, and publish the post on the publisher’s social profile.
  • This process also includes managing the boosting budget for these sponsored content. This includes building the target audience, properly pacing the budget spend, and being able to share reporting on results if requested.
  • You will also support the rest of the social media team with the agency clients. Requests include copywriting, organizing client content assets, and setting up paid social media audiences/campaign structures.
  • You may also manage several publisher’s promotional-focused social media profiles. This means reviewing and responding to comments and ensuring daily content (through manual posting or automated feed implementation).

What You Need

  • 1 year of proven experience in creating and executing social media content and proven paid campaign experience from start to end.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in marketing, communications, advertising, or related field
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills, as well as the ability to effectively work with editorial teams
  • Experience with creating posts on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn. Twitter and other social channels are a huge plus!
  • Experience using Facebook Ads Manager and other paid social media tools
  • Ability to perform light design work (typically in Canva)
  • Self-starter and quick to execute, brainstorm, and communicate with clients and sellers
  • Content marketing and SEO writing experience is a plus!
  •

The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, market demands and conditions, including geographic location where the work will be performed, and other factors permitted by law.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team.

We are looking for candidates to focus on our multicultural suite of products, including Rumba 97.7, JAMN 94.5, and our national Latino network of broadcast, podcast, and experiential opportunities. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You must have full professional proficiency in English and Spanish.

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.
