job.title: Automotive Marketing Consultant
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Are you passionate about the automotive industry and energized by helping dealerships grow? iHeartMedia Automotive is seeking an experienced Automotive Marketing Consultant who understands the dealership business, thrives in face-to-face client relationships, and knows how to build innovative marketing strategies that drive traffic, leads, and vehicle sales. We're looking for someone who has spent time in dealerships, around dealerships, or working directly with automotive retailers. The ideal candidate understands the challenges dealers face every day, from inventory fluctuations and market share battles to lead generation and fixed operations growth. They can confidently sit across the table from Dealer Principals, General Managers, Marketing Directors, and agency partners, uncover business opportunities, and recommend solutions that produce measurable results. This is more than a media sales role. It's an opportunity to become a trusted business advisor backed by the industry's largest audio platform, exclusive automotive advertising solutions, proprietary audience targeting technologies, advanced attribution capabilities, and industry-leading automotive research resources.
If you love the automotive business, enjoy creating marketing ideas that dealers get excited about, and are driven by helping clients win, we'd love to meet you.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

 As an Automotive Marketing Consultant with iHeartMedia Automotive, you will help dealerships grow market share, increase showroom traffic, generate leads, and ultimately sell more vehicles.


You will:

  • Develop and grow relationships through consistent in-person dealership visits, networking, prospecting, referrals, and business development activities.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with Dealer Principals, General Managers, Dealer Operators, Marketing Directors, and agency partners.
  • Conduct discovery meetings to understand dealership objectives, competitive pressures, inventory concerns, fixed operations opportunities, and growth goals.
  • Create customized marketing strategies that help dealers drive awareness, shopper engagement, traffic, leads, sales, and service revenue.
  • Leverage iHeartMedia Automotive's comprehensive automotive marketing stack, including:
    • Broadcast Radio
    • Streaming Audio
    • Podcasts
    • Connected TV (CTV)
    • OTT Video
    • Social Media Solutions
    • Display Advertising
    • Influencer Marketing
    • Proprietary Automotive Audience Targeting
    • Automotive Attribution & Matchback Reporting
    • Dealer Traffic Generation Programs
    • Exclusive Automotive Consumer Insights & Research
    • Proprietary Automotive Advertising Solutions
  • Utilize industry-leading automotive research resources, shopper insights, audience intelligence, and consumer behavior data to identify growth opportunities and build strategic recommendations.
  • Present creative, innovative marketing ideas that dealers love and that help their stores stand out in highly competitive markets.
  • Collaborate with automotive strategists, campaign specialists, creative teams, and product experts to develop integrated programs that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Deliver compelling business presentations supported by market intelligence, automotive data, consumer insights, and performance reporting.
  • Conduct ongoing business reviews and campaign recaps that clearly demonstrate results, ROI, and future growth opportunities.
  • Consistently exceed revenue goals through consultative selling, exceptional client service, and long-term relationship development.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

Automotive Expertise

  • 3+ years of experience working directly with automotive dealerships, dealer groups, OEM programs, automotive agencies, automotive technology providers, or automotive marketing organizations.
  • Proven experience managing advertising, marketing, or lead-generation programs for automobile dealers.
  • Deep understanding of the dealership business and the factors that drive vehicle sales, service revenue, customer acquisition, and market share growth.
  • Ability to confidently engage dealership ownership, executive leadership, and key decision-makers.
  • Experience conducting face-to-face meetings with Dealer Principals, General Managers, Marketing Directors, and ownership groups.
  • Understanding of automotive retail trends, dealer operations, consumer shopping behavior, and omni-channel marketing strategies.
  • Familiarity with co-op compliance, attribution reporting, and performance-based marketing solutions is preferred.
  • A genuine passion for the automotive industry and helping dealers succeed.

Consultative Selling & Relationship Building

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships through face-to-face client interactions.
  • Strong consultative sales skills with a track record of identifying needs and developing customized marketing solutions.
  • Comfortable presenting strategic recommendations to dealer ownership and executive leadership teams.
  • Experience recommending and closing significant marketing investments.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and storytelling skills.
  • Highly competitive, self-motivated, and goal-oriented.
  • Ability to build a book of business that consistently produces budget-beating results through prospecting, presenting, and closing integrated marketing programs.

Strategic & Creative Thinking

  • Ability to develop unique marketing concepts and promotional ideas that drive dealership traffic and vehicle sales.
  • Experience building and managing complex, integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
  • Strong understanding of how audio, digital, video, social, and emerging media channels influence automotive shoppers.
  • Ability to translate research, data, and analytics into actionable business recommendations.
  • A passion for solving business challenges and helping dealers outperform their competition.
  • Creative thinker who enjoys bringing fresh ideas to dealers that generate excitement and results.

Technology & Organization

  • Experience using Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong analytical and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, and sales opportunities simultaneously.
  • Experience utilizing campaign analytics and reporting tools to demonstrate marketing effectiveness.

Requirements

  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Ability to travel throughout assigned territory and conduct regular in-person dealership visits.
  • High School Diploma required; Bachelor's Degree preferred.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.

What You'll Get

  • Unlimited earning potential through a highly competitive compensation plan and uncapped commission structure.
  • Access to one of the most comprehensive automotive marketing platforms in the industry.
  • Exclusive automotive products, data sources, and advertising solutions unavailable through traditional media providers.
  • Industry-leading automotive research resources, shopper intelligence, and consumer insights.
  • Advanced attribution and reporting capabilities that help prove campaign effectiveness.
  • A comprehensive onboarding and training program designed to immerse you in our products, processes, and automotive sales strategies.
  • Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • Eligibility for iHeartMedia's President's Club and CEO's Club recognition programs.
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, company holidays, wellness resources, and employee assistance programs.
  • The support of a dedicated team of automotive specialists invested in your success.

Why iHeartMedia Automotive?


At iHeartMedia Automotive, you'll represent one of the most powerful and differentiated automotive marketing platforms in the industry.


You'll have access to exclusive automotive advertising solutions, industry-leading research and consumer intelligence, proprietary audience targeting technologies, advanced attribution capabilities, and the scale of America's largest audio network.

Most importantly, you'll become a strategic growth partner to dealerships, helping them drive more traffic, sell more vehicles, improve market share, and achieve measurable business results. If you're looking for an opportunity to combine your automotive expertise with best-in-class marketing solutions, we want to hear from you.

 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

job.title: Board Op
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

At iHeartMedia, we believe in the power of audio to connect, comfort, and inspire. As a Board Operator, you are a critical part of that mission—ensuring our broadcasts run smoothly and sound great, so we can be a trusted friend to millions of listeners anytime, anywhere.

Your precision and professionalism ensure that every show, every ad, and every moment reaches our audience with clarity and impact. You help us fulfill our promise to be there for our listeners—whether they’re commuting, working, or winding down—making you an essential part of the iHeartMedia mission.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Operate broadcast console and studio equipment during live and pre-recorded shows.

  • Monitor on-air programming for quality, timing, and compliance with FCC regulations.

  • Coordinate with talent, producers, and traffic teams to ensure smooth transitions and accurate commercial placement. 

  • Troubleshoot technical issues in real time and escalate as needed.

  • Record, edit, and load audio content for playback using automation systems. 

  • Maintain logs and documentation for regulatory and internal compliance. 

  • Support remote broadcasts and live events as needed. 

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Strong technical aptitude and familiarity with broadcast equipment and automation systems (e.g., NexGen, Adobe Audition). 

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. 

  • Availability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; relevant certifications or coursework a plus. 

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Ability to work within standardized procedures and an understanding of when to escalate
  • Skills to solve straightforward problems using established procedures
  • Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved
  • Common courtesy when communicating with coworkers and outside contacts

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.


$15.92 - $17.00

                                                                             

Location:

Pleasantville, NJ: 8025 Black Horse Pike, Ste 100 -102, 08232

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The World's Largest Broadcast Software Provider.

 

RCS Worldwide is home to four industry-defining brands: RCS, Media Monitors, Mediabase, and Florical Systems — serving the broadcast, music, and media intelligence markets across 120 countries. Every day, thousands of radio and television stations around the world rely on RCS technology to stay on air, sound great, and compete in a rapidly changing landscape.

 

Here is what makes us different:

 

We are the company behind the scenes of media that billions of people consume every day. When a song plays on your favorite radio station, when a song charts in the music industry, when a TV network stays on air without a second of downtime — there is a good chance RCS technology played a role. Our portfolio touches every corner of the media ecosystem, from playout and music scheduling to international advertising intelligence and airplay analytics.

 

We are a global team passionate about the industry we serve and moving with the speed and ambition to lead it forward.

 

If this opportunity excites you, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. At RCS Worldwide, we know that great talent comes from many different backgrounds and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive, collaborative workplace where people can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

                                                                              

What We Need:

Join our team in a role with room to grow, reporting directly to the Director of Software Engineering. You'll work alongside data scientists and business stakeholders to turn data into reliable, production-ready solutions that drive decisions across the organization. If you're a self-motivated team player who enjoys a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering results, we'd love to hear from you.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Develop, test, deploy, and maintain data solutions that support business requirements, web applications, models, and analytics
  • Work closely with data scientists, analysts, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver reliable data solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows using PySpark, AWS Glue, Pandas, and orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or AWS Step Functions
  • Implement data ingestion, transformation, validation, storage, and pipeline monitoring
  • Build infrastructure to support model training, scoring, and retraining, along with related reporting
  • Deploy and manage applications and pipelines using AWS CodePipeline and ECS
  • Monitor data quality, troubleshoot issues, and optimize pipeline performance
  • Collaborate with a small, agile team
  • Resolve technical issues through debugging and troubleshooting

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in data engineering.
  • Experience developing high-performance applications for large enterprises
  • Hands-on AWS cloud experience (or a similar cloud platform), including Glue, CodePipeline, and ECS
  • Strong proficiency in Python (including PySpark, Pandas, and DataFrames) and SQL
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines using AWS Glue or similar data-processing technologies
  • Experience building and managing ETL/ELT workflows using Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions, or similar orchestration tools
  • Understanding of data engineering concepts, including ingestion, transformation, validation, storage, and pipeline monitoring
  • Familiarity with data quality, pipeline monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
  • Database experience with Postgres, MongoDB, DynamoDB, and Athena
  • Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices
  • Experience with agile development methodologies
  • Proven track record of meeting project timelines with a sense of urgency​‌

Preferred

  • Experience with AWS SageMaker or similar ML platforms
  • Knowledge of Apache Iceberg and Delta tables

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Expertise with various technical disciplines and applications

  • Close attention to detail and quality orientation

  • Ability to multitask on a variety of critical projects

  • Ability to work independently, while also collaborating with others

  • Strong communication skills, particularly when explaining complex technical information

  • Ability to provide solutions to problems in situations that are atypical/infrequent

  • Analytical thinking and the ability to identify patterns

  • Efficiency with own work and impact of team results

  • Informal leadership capabilities with an interest in mentoring less experienced team members

San Antonio, TX: 20880 Stone Oak Parkway, 78258

job.title: Lead Digital Producer, TikTok Radio Presents: Social Club From iHeart
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

The Lead Digital Producer is the digital engine behind TikTok Radio Presents: Social Club. Partnering closely with the show's Executive Producer, you'll pitch, develop and produce digital-first content for the nightly live stream, book the creators who join the show, turn each episode into a steady stream of clips, and grow the audience across TikTok, the iHeartRadio app and beyond. This role is equal parts producer, editor, community manager and analyst, and it's built for someone who lives on TikTok and knows what makes creators and fans show up.

Schedule: This is an evening role. Hours are 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM ET (12:00 PM to 8:00 PM PT), aligned to the nightly live show.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with the show's Executive Producer to pitch, develop and create digital-first content for the hour-long nightly live stream, plus companion digital content that promotes and elevates our creators
  • Lead booking and scheduling of third-party creators to appear on the show as the fourth mic, managing outreach, confirmations and day-of logistics
  • Prepare research, questions and content ideas for each guest, and plan what to capture on site with talent before, during and after the show
  • Clip and edit video from the nightly live show for distribution across TikTok Radio brand handles and creator accounts, tailored to each platform's format and trends
  • Deliver daily digital analytics recaps on show and clip performance, with clear recommendations to optimize content, scheduling and promotion
  • Lead coordination of push notifications, emails, in-app messages, newsletters and other owned channels to drive digital audiences to the show, working with app, CRM and marketing partners
  • Community manage the TikTok Radio social handles: respond to and engage with fans, spark conversation in comments and chat, and surface community insights to the team
  • Stay on top of TikTok trends, sounds, creators and platform features, and bring fresh ideas to keep the show ahead of the culture

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

Required

  • 1+ years of experience in digital production, social media or video content, ideally in music, entertainment or media
  • Deep fluency in TikTok, including LIVE, creator culture, trends and platform best practices
  • A deep understanding of youth and internet culture: the creators, sounds, memes and conversations shaping what Gen Z and young millennial audiences watch, share and talk about
  • Strong short-form video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar), with a fast turnaround on clips
  • Experience booking or working directly with creators, talent or their teams
  • Comfort with social and app analytics, and the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a voice that connects with fans
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, live environment
  • Availability to work the 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM ET (12:00 PM to 8:00 PM PT) schedule

Desired

As a Multi-Market Brand Integrations Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment
  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques
  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions
  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. In addition to salary, this position is also eligible for commissions. Commission rates generally range from 2.0% to 10%+ depending on product, station, and type of business.


$36,000 - $45,000

                                                                             

Location:

Modesto, CA: 2121 Lancey Dr, Suite 1, 95355

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

                                                                             

Time Type:

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

                                                                             

We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis.


The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status.


Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law.


Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Click Here to learn about the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance .


Our organization participates in E-Verify.  Click here to learn about E-Verify.

This is more than a sales leadership role. It is an opportunity to help shape the future of automotive advertising while leading one of the industry's most comprehensive audio and marketing platforms supported by exclusive automotive products, advanced attribution capabilities, proprietary audience targeting technologies, and industry-leading automotive research resources.

  • Drive successful execution of automotive sales initiatives, promotions, contests, and strategic programs.
  • Analyze performance trends and implement corrective action plans when necessary.

Dealer & Industry Leadership

  • Build executive-level relationships with Dealer Principals, General Managers, Dealer Operators, Marketing Directors, agency leaders, and ownership groups.

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Collaborate with automotive leadership, Market Presidents, Directors of Sales, and regional leadership teams.

  • Drive adoption of automotive products, platforms, tools, and best practices.

Cross-Functional Leadership

job.title: Audience Intelligence Analytics Intern
job.description:
Deadline to apply for KQED Internships is Friday, October 30, 2026. Please state which internship(s) you are applying for in your cover letter and apply to each internship individually.

This is a paid internship, working 16 hours per week from Tuesday, January 19, 2027, through Friday, June 25, 2027. The current hourly rate is $19.61 per hour.

Position Summary:

The Audience Intelligence team is charged with providing KQED with the data needed to make data informed decisions. The team serves as the central data hub for the organization and works with a variety of departments including news, science, arts, marketing, foundations and audience development. The Audience Intelligence intern will have many responsibilities including the mining of data sets for insights, automation, facilitating predictive analytics, and supporting research. The intern will also have the lead on a project allowing them to complete the internship with a deliverable that can be used in their future job search.

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role requires working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working in the field. 

Essential Functions:
  • Help develop new insights and analyses that inform organizational decisions and help us continue to engage our audiences
  • Support research projects by aggregating and analyzing data
  • Execute quantitative analyses that translate data into actionable insights
  • Build visualizations that expose the health and performance of our products
  • Presentation building for a variety of stakeholders
  • Other Duties as assigned

Knowledge/Experience Required:

  • Intellectual curiosity for data-driven products
  • Experience with data analysis and/or visualization
  • Excellent writing, research, and communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Problem-solving acumen
  • Capacity to balance multiple responsibilities
  • Ability to work independently
  • At least some knowledge of SQL

Knowledge/Experience Desired:

  • Bonus points for knowledge of Python or another programming language, dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, etc.), ETL tools, or databases.

Growth & Development Opportunities:  

Audience Intelligence interns have a huge impact on what we do. They are a full-fledged member of our team and their life experience, opinions, and ideas bring fresh approaches to the work we do and are incredibly valuable. As part of the audience intelligence team, the intern will learn what it means to put our audiences first as we look to find the stories in their data that will allow us to grow a younger, more diverse audience base. This internship will help develop and hone analytical, and communication skills. If there is anything specific an intern wants to learn about audience intelligence, we are committed to making that happen.

job.description:
Title: Content Analytics Lead (Temporary)

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $95,525 - $119,406

Temporary Until - December 31, 2029.

Position Summary

KQED is seeking a Content Analytics Lead to serve as a partner to our content teams, studying content performance data, developing insights into what works, what doesn’t, and why, and making data-driven recommendations. Working under the Executive Director of Insights & Growth, this person will be responsible for reporting and briefings to review performance across all of our platforms, with an emphasis on digital growth within priority content verticals.  

The person in this role will be first and foremost an analyst and tactical advisor to our content teams. The ideal candidate will go beyond basic reporting and apply data science and experimentation techniques to help us learn and improve. 

We have a strong preference for candidates who can work hybrid three days a week in our San Francisco headquarters, but are open to considering a remote arrangement for candidates with an exceptionally strong track record of delivering performance insights to publishers. 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely. 

Essential Functions

  • Lead the design, build, and management of content analysis and reporting systems and procedures
  • Analyze content data, produce reports on content performance, and generate insights into what drives performance 
  • Meet regularly with content leaders to present insights and learn about their needs
  • Work with others to automate data collection and analysis where possible 
  • Respond to ad-hoc data and analysis requests from other departments
  • Other duties as assigned 

Qualifications

  • Demonstrable experience analyzing and reporting on content data, including social media, YouTube, and/or podcasts
  • Demonstrable experience delivering data-driven insights to content teams
  • Excellent LLM prompting skills and familiarity with agentic AI products (Cowork/ChatGPT Work, Codex/Claude Code, etc.)
  • Bonus points for meaningful data science experience (especially linear models, classification, clustering, time-series analysis, and seasonal decomposition)
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, and ability to communicate complex concepts to senior and non-analytical audiences 

Physical Demands

  • Ability to lift a minimum of fifteen (15) pounds;
  • Ability to exert maximum muscle force to lift, push, pull or carry;
  • Ability to use abdominal and lower back muscles over time without fatigue;
  • Ability to stand and/or sit for extended periods;
  • Ability to bend, stoop, stretch, twist, sit, and reach;
  • Fine motor skills;
  • Good visual and auditory acuity.

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

job.title: Director of Membership Programs
job.description:
Title: Director of Membership Programs

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: Salary Range: $125,547 - $137,000

Position SummaryThe Director of Membership Programs leads the strategy and growth of KQED’s on-air, third-party, and emerging membership fundraising channels. This role manages a portfolio that includes on-air fundraising, matching gifts, vehicle and real estate donations, and other third-party programs, while identifying and testing new opportunities to grow membership revenue.This is a strategy and growth role with responsibility for evaluating the performance and potential of each fundraising channel, determining where KQED should invest, improve, scale, or shift resources, and building a disciplined pipeline of new tests and initiatives. The Director develops business cases, establishes goals and measures of success, manages key vendor relationships and contracts, and uses performance data to make recommendations about the future of the portfolio.

The Director supervises the Fundraising Manager, who leads the day-to-day planning and production of KQED’s radio membership drives and year-round on-air fundraising calendar, as well as a NABET-represented staff member who manages the day-to-day operations of KQED’s current third-party fundraising programs. The Director sets strategy, priorities, and revenue goals across both areas and is accountable for overall performance.

This role works closely with colleagues across Membership, Development, Product, Data and Analytics, Programming, Content and Donor Services to ensure fundraising channels work together to grow revenue, acquire new members and strengthen long-term donor relationships.

The ideal candidate is analytical and entrepreneurial, with experience growing or improving fundraising programs. They are comfortable testing new ideas, making decisions with imperfect information, managing external partners, and translating data into clear recommendations. They are also a collaborative leader with a strong commitment to public media and KQED’s mission.

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely.

Essential Functions:

Fundraising Channel Strategy & Growth

  • Own the strategy, growth, and performance of KQED’s portfolio of third-party and emerging membership fundraising channels.
  • Supervise and support the NABET-represented staff member responsible for the day-to-day management and administration of KQED’s existing third-party fundraising programs.
  • Manage key vendor and partner relationships, including contracts, performance expectations, and service levels.
  • Evaluate existing programs, including vehicle and real estate donations, to identify opportunities to grow, improve, restructure, or discontinue programs.
  • Develop a pipeline of new fundraising channel opportunities and establish a disciplined process for testing, evaluating, and scaling them.
  • Identify trends, technologies, partnerships, and fundraising models that could create new revenue opportunities for KQED.
  • Work closely with Donor Services, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and other teams to ensure programs operate efficiently and provide a strong donor experience.

On-Air Fundraising Leadership

  • With the department lead, set the annual strategy, revenue goals, and overall approach for KQED’s radio fundraising and year-round broadcast membership promotion.
  • Supervise and support the Fundraising Manager, who leads the planning, production, and execution of radio membership drives and the on-air fundraising calendar.
  • Partner with Programming, News, Content and Membership leadership on drive strategy, campaign timing, messaging and major promotional opportunities.
  • Review performance across drives and on-air campaigns and identify opportunities to improve revenue, donor acquisition, recurring giving and audience experience.
  • Ensure on-air fundraising strategies are coordinated with digital, direct marketing and other membership efforts.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Partner with acquisition and retention teams to ensure new fundraising channels complement existing donor strategies rather than operate in isolation.
  • Coordinate with Development on opportunities that connect membership fundraising with major donor and philanthropic initiatives.
  • Work with Product and digital teams to ensure donor journeys from broadcast, third-party, and emerging channels connect effectively to KQED’s digital donation experience.
  • Bring audience, donor, and channel insights into broader Membership planning and strategy.
  • Build alignment across teams around priorities, investment decisions, and measures of success.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Manage, coach and develop the Fundraising Manager and NABET-represented third-party fundraising staff member, providing clear priorities, feedback and support while respecting the roles, responsibilities and requirements of represented staff.
  • Foster a collaborative, creative and mission-driven environment within the Membership team.
  • Encourage experimentation while creating clear expectations for how tests are structured, evaluated, and learned from.
  • Champion continuous improvement and a culture where teams use data and audience insight to make stronger decisions.

Other Job Functions

  • Serve as a leader for new strategic initiatives within the Membership department as assigned by the VP of Membership.
  • Represent Membership in cross-functional planning and organizational initiatives when appropriate.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Candidate Qualifications

Professional Background

  • 7+ years of experience in fundraising, membership, revenue growth, business development, direct-to-consumer programs, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success launching, growing, or improving revenue-generating programs.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of programs or channels and making decisions about where to invest, scale, or shift resources.
  • Experience developing business cases, setting revenue goals, managing budgets, and forecasting performance.
  • Experience managing external vendors, partners, or contracts.
  • Experience managing and developing staff.
  • Ability to operate effectively in an environment where not every opportunity has a clear roadmap or established playbook.

Strategic & Analytical Skills

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to evaluate opportunities and make decisions.
  • Ability to move from broad strategy to clear priorities, tests, and action plans.
  • Experience establishing success metrics and evaluating performance against them.
  • Comfort balancing short-term revenue goals with longer-term growth opportunities.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to make recommendations with incomplete information.
  • Ability to clearly communicate the rationale behind investment and prioritization decisions.

Collaboration & Partnership

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively as a peer partner across teams and functions.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and experience bringing together stakeholders with different priorities.
  • Ability to influence without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Skilled at managing external partners and holding vendors accountable for results.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate strategy, performance, and recommendations clearly to a range of audiences.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in public media, nonprofit membership, subscription, direct response, or another audience-supported business.
  • Familiarity with on-air fundraising, broadcast fundraising, or public media membership programs.
  • Experience with third-party fundraising programs such as vehicle donations, planned giving lead-generation programs, or other external fundraising partnerships.
  • Familiarity with CRM and donor data systems; ROI Solutions experience is a plus.
  • Experience testing and launching new revenue or acquisition channels.

Mission Alignment

  • Deep commitment to the values and mission of public media, including service to diverse communities and audiences.
  • Commitment to fostering a workplace culture rooted in collaboration, equity, inclusion, and respect

job.description:
Title: Equity & Belonging Specialist

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $69,000 - $72,000


Position Summary:

Reporting to the Director, Organizational Equity & Belonging, the Equity & Belonging Specialist supports the implementation of KQED's equitable excellence strategy by coordinating DEI initiatives that foster belonging, curiosity, and inclusive engagement across the organization. Through project coordination, content development, facilitation, and operational support, the Specialist helps translate strategic direction into consistent, high-quality execution.

Working collaboratively with internal stakeholders, the Specialist supports DEI-related learning experiences, Employee Belonging Groups (EBGs), GUIDE Council initiatives, heritage month programming, and departmental operations. The role also maintains resources, coordinates logistics, tracks program outcomes, and serves as a trusted partner in ensuring DEI initiatives are organized, accessible, and effectively delivered in alignment with the strategic direction established by the Director.
KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics
The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely.

 

Essential Functions: The Equity & Belonging Specialist may assist with one or more of the following:

  • DEI Learning Support & Facilitation (40%)

    • Develop presentation decks, facilitator guides, participant resources, interactive activities, surveys, and other educational collateral that support DEI-related learning initiatives based on the curriculum strategy and learning objectives established by the Director.
    • Facilitate foundational DEI learning experiences and educational sessions for staff, creating engaging and inclusive learning environments.
    • Coordinate scheduling, invitations, room and virtual meeting logistics, materials, and resource repositories that support DEI educational programming.
    • Distribute post-session surveys, track attendance and participation, and compile data and insights that support evaluation and continuous improvement of DEI initiatives.

  • Heritage Month Content & Engagement Support (35%)

    • Coordinate the operational workflow for heritage month initiatives by managing content movement and communication between Creative, Product, and other internal stakeholders.
    • Draft introductory copy and supporting content for heritage month collections based on established content frameworks and organizational standards.
    • Audit, organize, and maintain multimedia content libraries that showcase KQED programming and storytelling across heritage month collections.
    • Provide logistical and administrative support for GUIDE Council-led heritage month events and cultural engagement activities, including scheduling, room setup, catering coordination, RSVP tracking, vendor support, and event execution.

  • Employee Belonging Group (EBG) Support (20%)

    • Support the onboarding of new EBG leaders by providing guidance on the EBG Guidebook, governance resources, templates, organizational processes, and operating expectations.
    • Serve as a liaison for EBG leaders by connecting them with appropriate internal partners, coordinating communications, and helping navigate organizational resources and procedures.
    • Maintain EBG documentation, resource libraries, budget tracking tools, and program records to support effective governance and long-term sustainability.

  • Administrative & Operational Support (5%)

    • Partner with internal stakeholders to maintain departmental calendars and coordinate scheduling that supports effective participation across DEI initiatives.
    • Maintain the department's internal knowledge base, ensuring DEI resources, templates, guidance documents, and reference materials remain current and accessible.
    • Provide general administrative and operational support for departmental initiatives, reporting, communications, and resource management
  • Perform other related duties as assigned in support of DEI programs and organizational needs.

job.title: Marketing Coordinator (Part-Time, Contract)
job.description:
Title: Marketing Coordinator (Part-Time, Contract)

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: Hourly : $33.89 - $42.37

Contracted / Part Time Role: Until September 30, 2027.

Position Summary

KQED is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Marketing Coordinator to support the Marketing team's paid promotion of KQED content across digital, social, out-of-home, and other advertising channels.

This role will be a key project management and creative production partner, helping move campaigns from brief through final delivery and launch. The Marketing Coordinator will manage creative production timelines, maintain campaign and asset trackers, coordinate deliverables with external agency partners, manage owned promotional inventory, and help identify content opportunities for marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, a keen eye for design and copywriting in a digital-first environment, and experience with social-first creative and short-form video.

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

The mission that drives us:

We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely. 
Essential Functions

  • Support the execution of paid marketing campaigns promoting KQED content across digital, paid social, video, out-of-home, and other advertising channels.
  • Manage creative production timelines and workback schedules, proactively tracking deadlines, outstanding assets, feedback, approvals, and deliverables.
  • Maintain detailed campaign and creative asset trackers, ensuring project status, source materials, specifications, links, approvals, and final assets are accurate and up to date.
  • Coordinate creative production with KQED's external agency partners, preparing briefs and source materials, tracking revisions, consolidating feedback, and confirming final deliverables.
  • Partner with internal Content, Editorial, Social, and Creative teams to gather photography, video, copy, publishing information, and other materials needed for campaigns.
  • Support copywriting and creative development for digital advertising, bringing a strong eye for clear messaging, visual hierarchy, and platform-appropriate creative.
  • Support the development of social-first creative and short-form video for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, with an understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, and platform conventions.
  • Review final creative for accuracy, brand alignment, technical specifications, and consistency with the KQED content being promoted.
  • Maintain organized archives of campaign creative and source materials for easy reference and reuse.
  • Assist with campaign reporting and post-campaign documentation by organizing creative examples, campaign records, and learnings.
  • Manage owned promotional inventory across KQED channels, tracking availability and coordinating how inventory is allocated across competing priorities in partnership with Marketing Interns.
  • Review upcoming Articles & Guides content and recommend which pieces should receive marketing support.
  • Manage KQED’s on-site merchandise kiosk, including inventory, merchandising, restocking, and coordinating merchandise needs with internal teams.

Required Experience

  • 3–4 years of experience in marketing, advertising, creative production, project management, social media, or a related field.
  • Strong project management skills, with experience managing a high volume of concurrent creative projects, deadlines, workback schedules, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and demonstrated ability to maintain accurate, organized project and asset trackers.
  • Experience coordinating creative production and working with designers, video producers, agencies, or other creative partners.
  • Strong eye for design and visual storytelling, with the ability to evaluate creative for clarity, hierarchy, brand consistency, and effectiveness.
  • Strong copywriting and proofreading skills, particularly for concise, audience-focused digital advertising.
  • Experience developing, producing, or coordinating social-first creative and short-form video.
  • Understanding of digital creative best practices across paid social, display, video, and other digital formats.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate feedback, deadlines, deliverables, and next steps.
  • Proactive working style with the ability to identify missing information, anticipate roadblocks, and independently move projects forward.
  • Ability to work effectively across internal teams and external agency partners in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as Airtable, Asana, Monday.com, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.
  • A passion for KQED's mission and connecting audiences with high-quality journalism and programming.

Experience in nonprofit, public media, journalism, media, or other mission-driven organizations is valued but not required.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely. 

Essential Functions

  • Understand, interpret, and apply KQED brand guidelines while completing projects according to established benchmarks and deadlines.
  • Develop and extend cohesive visual brand systems and identities for KQED programs, campaigns, initiatives, and sub-brands, translating creative direction into typography, color, graphic language, imagery, iconography, layout, logos, and other identity elements.
  • Apply and scale brand systems across digital, social, video, print, environmental, presentation, and promotional platforms, ensuring consistency while adapting the visual language to different audience experiences.
  • Translate visual brand systems into motion, conceptualizing and producing animated typography, title sequences, logo animations, transitions, lower thirds, information graphics, explainers, social video graphics, and video packaging that establish consistent brand behavior across platforms.
  • Develop reusable motion templates, toolkits, illustrations, infographics, and other graphic assets that enable consistent execution while supporting storytelling and audience engagement.
  • Design and animate using Adobe Creative Suite, with particular expertise in Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects and Premiere.
  • Collaborate with the Creative Director, Art Director, designers, producers, editors, and cross-functional stakeholders to develop and execute creative concepts.
  • Present and articulate design thinking and synthesize creative feedback and translate it into thoughtful design refinements while maintaining the integrity of the overall system.
  • Manage multiple assignments and production timelines within an on-call environment while maintaining a high standard of craft and attention to detail.

Candidate qualifications

  • Minimum 3–5 years of professional design experience, with demonstrated expertise in both brand identity/system development and motion design.
  • Bachelor’s degree in visual design, graphic design, motion design, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong conceptual and visual-design skills, with the ability to translate strategy, ideas, and storytelling into cohesive brand systems that extend across multiple applications and platforms.
  • Advanced motion-design skills with a strong understanding of timing, pacing, typography, composition, hierarchy, and storytelling through motion.
  • Strong typography, layout, information-design, and production skills across video, digital, social, and print, including working knowledge of print production and pre-press preparation.
  • Ability to move fluidly between concept development and hands-on production, managing multiple projects from concept through final delivery within limited timeframes.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to articulate design decisions, receive and synthesize creative direction and stakeholder feedback, and work effectively with creative leadership, designers, producers, editors, stakeholders, and internal clients.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign, with experience working in 3D environments or integrating 3D elements into motion design.
  • The successful candidate will be required to join NABET Local 51.

Portfolio + Reel Requirements

  • Brand identity and visual-system work demonstrating process and iteration—from initial exploration through a cohesive identity system and its application across multiple touchpoints.
  • Motion and motion-branding work demonstrating how visual identities translate into movement, including examples of motion typography, animation, transitions, information graphics, and/or video packaging.
  • Strong typography, visual hierarchy, layout, and composition skills across digital, motion, and print applications.
  • Clear identification of the candidate’s individual role and contribution to collaborative projects.

Knowledge/Experience Desired

  • Experience creating motion identity guidelines, animation principles, reusable motion templates, or toolkits that extend brand systems across platforms.
  • Experience designing for social and short-form video platforms and adapting creative systems for evolving audience and platform needs.
  • Additional craft capabilities such as hand-rendered/vector illustration and Cinema 4D, Blender, or other 3D design and animation tools.
  • Familiarity with accessibility and inclusive design principles, as well as emerging creative technologies and workflows, including generative and AI-assisted design tools.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to lift a minimum of fifteen (15) pounds;
  • Ability to exert maximum muscle force to lift, push, pull or carry;
  • Ability to use abdominal and lower back muscles over time without fatigue;
  • Ability to stand and/or sit for extended periods;
  • Ability to bend, stoop, stretch, twist, sit, and reach;
  • Fine motor skills;
  • Good visual and auditory acuity.

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully.

 

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

job.description:
Deadline to apply for KQED Internships is Friday, October 30, 2026. Please state which internship(s) you are applying for in your cover letter and apply to each internship individually.

This is a paid internship, working 16 hours per week from Tuesday, January 19, 2027, through Friday, June 25, 2027. The current hourly rate is $19.61 per hour.


Newscast interns learn the skills to become General Assignment (GA) reporters. They are sent into the field to cover local news stories and get to interview community members, elected officials and experts on the major Bay Area developments of the day. They learn how to write concise and important stories for a large audience, handle daily deadlines and pitch ideas that can turn into strong pieces of newscast content. 

We are looking for a diverse set of candidates from around the region for this position. In your cover letter please tell us what issues or places in the Bay Area you’d like to report on.

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely.

  • Newscast interns are assigned multiple stories a day. These include short reports that interns will eventually learn to voice and shorter stories that our hosts will read on air.
