job.title: Lead Fan Support Systems Engineer (Manchester, United Kingdom)
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Lead Fan Support Systems Engineer

Location: Manchester, United Kingdom (hybrid)

Division: Fan Support Technology

Contract Terms: Permanent, Full-time


THE TEAM


Live Nation Entertainment is the largest live entertainment company in the world, consisting of five businesses: concert promotion and venue operations, sponsorship, ticketing solutions, ecommerce, and artist management. Live Nation seeks to innovate and enhance the live entertainment experience for artists and fans: before, during and after the show.
 

At Ticketmaster Fans come first. We care passionately about our fans’ interaction with our service channels and as the world’s leading ticketing company, we are committed to setting the standard for a great fan experience. Our technology and services help make it easier for fans to connect with their favorite events and performers.


THE JOB


As a Lead Systems Engineer within the Global Fan Experience team, you will be the technical leader within your team for the design, configuration, and maintenance of contact center technology platforms serving 100+ different Ticketmaster & Live Nation brands around the world. You will lead cross-functional problem-solving, mentor and guide junior engineers, and coordinate resources across multiple teams to deliver complex, multi-team initiatives. Balancing competing priorities, you will drive alignment on system-level decisions, shape medium-term technical planning, and ensure our agent workspace platforms are scalable, secure, resilient, and well integrated with the wider ecosystem — while ensuring customer data is properly managed and protected.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Providing technical leadership within the team and owning the architecture, global configuration framework, reusable workflow patterns, and complex engineering changes for SaaS contact center platforms such as Zendesk and Five9. Establishing standards and guardrails for business administrators, while routine administration and local macros, views, and workflow configuration remain business-owned.
  • Leading the design of scalable, performant, secure, and resilient systems and integrations — defining clear system boundaries and ensuring alignment with both business and technical requirements.
  • Leading cross-functional problem-solving, coordinating resources across teams, and driving alignment on system-level decisions and trade-offs.
  • Mentoring and coaching junior engineers, sharing knowledge, and raising the technical bar across the team.
  • Leading improvements in system performance, incident resolution processes, and cost optimization, balancing operational efficiency with stability and proactively identifying risks.
  • Owning deployment automation and modular development practices, and building and maintaining custom integrations with other systems and applications using APIs.
  • Monitoring performance, ensuring availability, and leading troubleshooting and root-cause resolution of complex incidents as they arise.
  • Supporting, implementing, and optimizing contact center channels and workflows across markets.
  • Establishing and maintaining operating procedures, documentation, code review, and QA standards for the administration of the platforms in line with company policies and processes.
  • Applying AI tools appropriately to explore data, code, and processes that accelerate delivery and decision-making, validating outputs carefully for accuracy and bias.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Proven years of experience managing and configuring CX/CRM and contact center platforms, including a track record of acting as a technical leader within a team.
  • Proven experience leading the design of scalable, resilient, and secure systems and architectures, including defining system boundaries and planning for long-term scalability.
  • Strong operational excellence background: deployment automation, monitoring, incident resolution, and cost optimization.
  • Experience with multi-channel environments, including voice, email, social, chat/chatbots, and automations.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and coordinating work across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and data analysis skills, with the ability to balance competing objectives and drive alignment on system-level decisions.
  • Ability to lead projects and manage workload and multi-team initiatives within predefined time windows.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Working familiarity with AI tools and their appropriate application, including validating outputs for accuracy and bias.
  • Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Microsoft 365, Google Analytics, RESTful APIs, JIRA, Confluence, Zendesk, Five9, Decagon AI or equivalent contact center technologies preferred.
  • Experience with large contact centers is a plus.
  • Zendesk Certification Preferred.

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Working Professionally: You set and role-model high standards, consistently meeting quality standards even with competing priorities, and proactively communicate progress.
  • Working to Achieve Results: You take ownership and deliver results with appropriate independence, handle setbacks constructively by focusing on solutions and learning, and weigh both the short- and long-term impact of your work.
  • Working with Others: You proactively seek collaboration opportunities, share knowledge and resources to strengthen working relationships, and adjust your communication to ensure clarity and respect across different audiences and contexts.
  • Working Innovatively: You help solve cross-functional challenges by sharing ideas and seeking input from other perspectives, and you identify opportunities to add value through improved processes, solutions, and collaboration.


 

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER


We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.


Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. 


We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.


Our work is guided by our values:


Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.


Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team


Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent


Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive


EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES


We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.


HIRING PRACTICES


The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.


Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

Job Summary:

Title: Line Cook                

Location: House of Blues                       

Who are we?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment and eCommerce company, comprised of four market leaders: Ticketmaster.com, Live Nation Concerts, Artist Nation and Live Nation Network.  Ticketmaster.com is the global event ticketing leader and one of the world’s top five eCommerce sites, with over 27 million monthly unique visitors.  Live Nation Concerts produces over 22,000 shows annually for more than 2,300 artists globally.  Artist Nation is the world’s top artist management company, representing over 250 artists.  These businesses power Live Nation Network, the leading provider of entertainment marketing solutions, enabling over 800 advertisers to tap into the 200 million consumers Live Nation delivers annually through its live event and digital platforms. For additional information, visit www.livenation.com/investors.

HOB Entertainment, a division of Live Nation Entertainment, offers exceptional club venues nationwide. House of Blues Venues provide several genres of live music, from Rock, Hip Hop, Country, Rock en Español, Blues, Jazz, Reggae and Pop. House of Blues venues are also known for their southern-style cuisine, juke-joint inspired atmosphere and the World Famous Gospel Brunch.

House of Blues opened its doors on Thanksgiving Day in 1992, serving its first meal to the local shelters. Since opening, House of Blues has been committed to giving back to the community through the International House of Blues Foundation.

Who are you?

Passionate and motivated.  Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit.  Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

Preparation of food items for service in a high volume restaurant

  • Opening and Closing duties

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Executive Assistant/Booking Coordinator role will support the President/Lead Booker and other talent team members in all aspects of administrative support to the President, as well as buying responsibilities including preparation and distribution of offer sheets, talent research and prospecting. This role is expected to be in the office Monday through Friday unless stated otherwise.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


Administrative & Executive Support

  • Provide high-level administrative support to the President, including calendar management, travel arrangements, meeting scheduling, expense reports, and budget tracking.
  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date Outlook calendar for the President, including all shows, events, meetings, travel, and key deadlines.
  • Schedule and coordinate in-person, virtual, and Zoom meetings, including preparing agendas, materials, and follow-up communications as needed.
  • Partner with the President and booking team on special projects and office initiatives, including newsletters, team outings, volunteer events, holiday celebrations, and internal communications.
  • Process and track artist contracts, venue agreements, certificates of insurance, and related documents in accordance with company guidelines; return completed documents to artist agencies and venue partners in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate and track artist deposit payments in partnership with internal finance and accounting teams.
  • Maintain complete and organized show files, ensuring all required documentation is in place before the day of show, including headliner and support contracts, riders, W-9s, insurance certificates, and other required materials.
  • Assist with industry and guest ticketing requests and serve as an on-site liaison as needed.
  • Complete expense reports and arrange travel for the President and team members as needed.
  • Handle confidential information with sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism.

Booking Support

  • Create, prepare, and maintain accurate deal sheets, offer materials, and booking documentation.
  • Obtain venue holds; place and release holds in Rome; and update the corresponding booking grid promptly and accurately.
  • Gather all required show details from artist representatives and serve as a primary communication liaison between artists, agents, venues, promoters, and internal teams.
  • Coordinate announce dates, on-sale dates, and related timelines with artists, venues, and internal departments.
  • Prepare and distribute Show Confirmations and Event Status Sheets to internal staff, venues, and external partners.
  • Maintain and update offer templates, venue records, artist information, and show data in Rome and other internal systems.
  • Create and distribute reports for internal and external stakeholders as needed.
  • Support the booking team with artist history, performance data, market research, and other special projects.
  • Attend shows and events as needed to provide administrative and operational support to promoters and venue teams.
  • Track deadlines and follow up on outstanding contracts, holds, payments, and show-critical information.

Research & Talent Prospecting

  • Research emerging and developing artists, genres, market trends, and live-performance opportunities.
  • Compile and distribute relevant artist research and recommendations to the Lead Booker and booking team.
  • Participate actively in booking meetings and team discussions, contributing new artist ideas, process improvements, and best practices.
  • Maintain awareness of the live music landscape, including touring activity, venue markets, festivals, and competitive programming.

  • Five or more years of experience in data analysis, administration, operations, booking support, or a related field.
  • At least two years of administrative or executive assistant experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, including complex calendar management and group scheduling.
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working with databases, reporting tools, and internal sales or administrative systems.
  • Experience working with accounting and finance teams, including expense reporting, budgeting, invoicing, deposits, or payment tracking.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and with external partners.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential or sensitive information.
  • Ability to quickly learn new systems, processes, and tools.
  • Experience with contracts, agreements, insurance certificates, or legal documentation is a plus.

  • Passion for live music and the music industry.
  • Flexibility to work nights and weekends as needed for events and show support.

job.title: LN Concerts, Sr. Director of Operations – VIP Nation
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

VIP Nation is Live Nation's premium fan experience business, designing and delivering VIP packages, meet-and-greets, hospitality, and exclusive merchandise for artists and tours worldwide. Reporting to the SVP, VIP Nation, the Sr Director, Operations is the senior operating leader of the division and second-in-command to the SVP, accountable for how the business runs: its processes, its infrastructure, its supply chain, and its people.


This is a build role. VIP Nation has grown on the strength of exceptional show execution, and its next phase of growth requires a professional operating foundation underneath it. The Sr Director, Operations will take a clear-eyed inventory of the current state of the business, then design and implement the systems, standards, and organizational structure needed to replace manual, individually held workflows with repeatable processes that scale.


The SVP, VIP Nation leads the business, owns its vision and commercial direction, and is the division's primary voice with artists, management, and internal leadership. This role carries a high degree of delegated authority over how the business operates day to day, and making that balance work requires exceptional partnership and communication: operating decisively while keeping the SVP fully apprised, aligning ahead of consequential decisions, surfacing issues early rather than after the fact, and ensuring the SVP is never surprised by something happening inside her business.


Success is measured by operational reliability, margin improvement, the quality and consistency of the fan and artist experience, and the strength, clarity, and retention of the team.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


Operational Efficiency

  • Own the day-to-day operating cadence of VIP Nation — planning calendars, reporting rhythms, decision rights, and escalation paths — and establish and monitor, with the SVP, the key performance indicators covering operational efficiency, fulfillment accuracy, cost, fan satisfaction, and organizational health.
  • Maintain a disciplined communication rhythm with the SVP, including regular operating reviews, clear escalation of risks and issues, and visibility into the decisions being made across the department.
  • Conduct a structured assessment of the current state of the business — what exists, what is working, what is duplicative, and what is at risk — and present a prioritized roadmap to the SVP and executive leadership.
  • Own the supply chain and logistics strategy for VIP programs — sourcing, production, inventory, freight, warehousing, and delivery to venue — setting the direction and standards, strengthening vendor agreements and service-level expectations, while leading and coordinating the existing team and partners who execute it.
  • Institute service-level standards and quality controls across every VIP program so on-site execution matches what was sold to the fan, the artist, and the tour, and build a post-show and post-tour review process that converts lessons learned into documented standards.
  • Document the standard operating procedures, templates, and process maps required for the business to be audited, handed off, and replicated as it grows.

 

Leadership

  • Lead the functional teams responsible for program operations, fulfillment, logistics, vendor management, and business systems in coordination with the SVP.
  • Establish clear roles, workload planning, and accountability across the department, and build manager capability so the business is not dependent on a small number of individuals.
  • Assess talent across the division, identify capability gaps, and lead recruitment, development, and succession planning to build a durable leadership bench.
  • Partner with Human Resources, Legal, Finance, and Risk to ensure the division operates cleanly within Live Nation policy and controls, including contracting, approvals, travel, and safety.

 

Technology

  • Lead the modernization of the division's infrastructure, replacing manual, spreadsheet-dependent processes with integrated systems for order management, inventory, fulfillment, CRM, and reporting.
  • Create a single source of truth for VIP Nation data and reporting that gives leadership real-time visibility into sales, fulfillment accuracy, cost, and fan satisfaction — built to work with the platforms, data infrastructure, and tools already in place at Live Nation rather than standing up parallel systems alongside them.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 8+ years of progressive operations leadership, including experience as a head of operations or senior second-in-command of a multi-market business.
  • Background in live entertainment, touring, premium hospitality, experiential marketing, e-commerce, or consumer products — any environment combining live deadlines with physical fulfillment.
  • Demonstrated record of taking a fast-growing business from ad hoc execution to a scaled, process-driven operating model.
  • Deep supply chain and logistics expertise — sourcing, production, inventory, freight, warehousing, and fulfillment at scale — together with proven vendor and contract management, including negotiating master agreements, consolidating spend, and holding third parties to measurable service levels.
  • Experience selecting and implementing business systems (ERP, order management, inventory, CRM, or comparable platforms), with a clear understanding that the hard part is changing how people work, not buying the software.
  • Strong financial acumen, including P&L exposure, budgeting, unit economics, and margin optimization, and the ability to partner effectively with finance leadership.
  • Exceptional partnership skills, able to take ownership of an operation, drive change quickly, and keep the business leader and established team closely aligned throughout.
  • Credibility with both commercial and creative stakeholders — able to hold an operational line with artists, management, promoters, and internal leadership without slowing the business down.
  • Highly analytical and data-fluent, with advanced Excel and command of reporting and business intelligence tools, and the ability to build a business case for investment.
  • Sound judgment, a collaborative leadership style, and the ability to drive timely, effective execution in a high-volume, deadline-critical live events environment; availability to travel, including show-site and peak-season travel.
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent senior operating experience a plus.

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

Live Nation’s Media & Sponsorship division is seeking a Digital Campaign Manager to lead the setup, execution, and optimization of paid social and digital media campaigns for high-profile brand partnerships. This role will work closely with the Director and cross-functional teams to facilitate campaign launches, monitor performance, provide actionable insights, oversee billing processes, and support product rollouts. The Digital Campaign Manager will partner with platform representatives, external agencies, internal teams, and clients to ensure seamless execution and measurable results. The ideal candidate is highly organized, data-driven, collaborative, and passionate about delivering innovative digital solutions within the live entertainment industry.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Manage the setup, execution, monitoring, and optimization of paid social, digital, and proximity-based campaigns
  • Identify optimization opportunities to improve campaign performance, pacing, and cost efficiency
  • Meet regularly with digital and social platform representatives to ensure campaign alignment with best practices
  • Collaborate with the Director to maintain platform relationships and develop new advertising use cases
  • Partner with external social media agency to oversee campaign execution and optimization
  • Manage vendor invoicing, campaign cost reallocations, and timely submissions to Finance
  • Participate in partnership kickoff calls and recurring client meetings to share performance updates and optimization recommendations
  • Collaborate with Integrated Marketing to communicate campaign results for case studies and sales materials
  • Work closely with the Audience Strategy team to activate first-party data within campaign executions
  • Support media planners by providing timely and accurate campaign reporting and insights
  • Assist with influencer content amplification, FanFluencer campaign execution, and on-site event support
  • Assist the Director in rolling out new products and internal processes
  • Support monthly team office hours by sharing product knowledge and answering questions
  • Support special projects and ad-hoc initiatives as assigned by leadership

  • 3+ years of experience managing paid social and/or digital media campaigns
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field
  • Familiarity with major social platforms’ advertising products and campaign setups, including Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, X, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and Reddit
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising, media buying, and campaign optimization
  • Proven ability to manage high campaign volume and collaborate effectively across internal and external teams
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, particularly in campaign execution and vendor management
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze performance and identify optimization opportunities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present updates and collaborate with clients and internal teams
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, and manage projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and PowerPoint

job.title: Managing Director, Belgium
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Managing Director, Belgium

Location: Brussels, BE

Division: Ticketmaster International

Line Manager: SVP, Business Development North Europe  

Contract Terms: Full-time, Permanent

 

THE JOB

 

This role, working closely with the SVP, Business Development North Europe, is responsible for executing the local commercial plan by identifying, developing, and managing growth opportunities within the Belgian market. The focus is on managing and growing relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities to expand partnerships and secure new business.

 

As a senior member of the local leadership team, this role is responsible for the day-to-day commercial performance of the business, ensuring business priorities are translated into actionable plans and successfully delivered across the local market.

 

You will lead the execution of commercial initiatives across Ticketmaster's core business, including music and live entertainment, while supporting the growth of Live Nation partnerships, expanding into new market opportunities, managing existing client relationships, negotiating commercial agreements, and ensuring the successful delivery of events. You will also oversee the performance and development of the local team, ensuring operational excellence and high levels of client satisfaction.

 

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong commercial execution, sales management, client relationship skills, and operational oversight. You will spend significant time working with clients, supporting sales activity, driving business development opportunities, resolving commercial challenges, and ensuring teams are aligned to deliver against agreed objectives.

 

Using your knowledge, you will represent Ticketmaster in the market, maintain strong relationships with promoters, venues, and partners, and work closely with internal teams to deliver commercial commitments and excellent service.

 

Working alongside the SVP Business Development and regional support teams, you will implement agreed business plans, monitor performance against commercial targets, provide regular progress updates, and identify opportunities to improve business performance.

 

You will be responsible for leading regular local management meetings and ensuring effective communication across the business through team meetings and Town Halls. You will also oversee key local commercial functions, including Marketing, and ensure teams are aligned around shared priorities and deliverables, regardless of reporting lines.

 

Success in this role depends on building strong working relationships across local, regional, and global teams, ensuring effective collaboration with specialist functions including Operations, Client Management, Event Delivery, Global Touring, Market Pricing, and Fan Experience. You will coordinate with these teams to ensure successful client onboarding, event delivery, and ongoing account management.

 

You will foster a positive, accountable, and high-performing team culture by promoting collaboration, clear communication, service excellence, accountability, integrity, and continuous improvement.


 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 

Strategic Leadership:

 

  • As Managing Director, you will support the ongoing execution of the Market business and sales plan and ensure agreed commercial initiatives are delivered in alignment with Regional and Global priorities.

 

Team Leadership:

 

  • Be a figure head for the local business, you will ensure that all your local team are aware of the Local, Regional, and Global priorities and offer your team regular updates on business performance. This will include scheduling regular one-to-one team, and local office Town Halls with all staff within your local office, as well as contributing to and participating in wider Ticketmaster Regional forums, as and when required.
  • You will be responsible for leading and developing the local Sales and Marketing teams
  • Provide regular updates to the SVP and International Leadership team on market performance, client activity, and relevant competitive developments.
  • Drive a culture of innovation and excellence throughout the organization. With a strong commitment to internal communications strategies to all staff. Mentoring, Support, and People Development.

 

Commercial Revenue & Growth:

 

  • Deliver against assigned revenue, gross margin, and client satisfaction targets for the market.
  • Develop and present client proposals that incorporate available products, services, and commercial enhancements to drive revenue.
  • Manage commercial negotiations and coordinate the execution of client agreements
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships across all levels of client organizations, ensuring long-term partnerships.
  • Support client adoption of products and marketing solutions by recommending appropriate offerings and best practices.
  • Conduct prospect outreach, prepare proposals, and deliver sales presentations to acquire new clients.
  • Review client performance and market data to identify sales opportunities and recommend commercial actions.
  • Monitor competitor activity and identify potential new business opportunities within the market.
  • Ensure smooth transitions from business development to execution.
  • Work closely with Regional and Global teams to support product launches, share market feedback, and execute business initiatives.
  • Implement and monitor deal performance, proactively addressing underperformance.
  • Support the execution of regional and global business initiatives by providing local market insights and implementing agreed actions.

 

Collaboration and Governance:

 

  • Act as a key member of the regional leadership, contributing to wider organizational priorities and knowledge sharing.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and marketing teams reporting to SVP Business Development on market demands to ensure the country’s needs are represented in the broader roadmap.
  • Report regularly to regional and global leadership on progress, challenges, and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Global Lines of Business such as operations and fan experience to ensure client priorities are delivered
  • Reporting regularly to Regional and Global Leadership teams on any key developments in relation to business performance; client relationships; commercial negotiations; contract renewals; new business opportunities and competitor threats or activity within your market.

 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

 

  • 7+ years consultative sales, business development or commercial experience,
  • Must be fluent in Local language with strong English skills.
  • Demonstrated outstanding leadership ability.
  • Must have demonstrated the ability to effectively manage client relationships, manage and develop key employees, analyze numbers, and be proactive, flexible, and innovative.
  • Experience in ticketing, live events, venue management, promotion, e-business, media or entertainment industries preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communications skills.

 

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)


  • Prioritization: Ability to develop and execute on long-term business strategies.
  • Accountability: Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing teams.
  • Cross Collaboration: Strong cooperation and problem-solving abilities.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Developing others: Effectively train and develop teams to contribute to the goals of the organisation, providing regular feedback and fostering a commitment to grow.

The following attributes and this order determine how the role will be carried out and are required to be a success:

  • Outstanding leadership skills
  • Strong Business acumen.
  • Self-motivated and self-disciplined
  • Highly professional approach.
  • Results and Delivery Focused

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

 

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

 

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. 

 

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

 

Our work is guided by our values:

 

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

 

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

 

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

 

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

 

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state-of-the-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction. The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.

Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac’s events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company’s premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993.

THE ROLE

Insomniac Events is seeking a highly motivated and proactive Publishing Intern to join the records team in Calabasas, CA. This position will assist & learn catalog management, metadata, and creative operations. This is a hands-on role designed for someone passionate about music publishing, metadata organization, and the intersection of creativity and business in the music industry. This position reports to the Insomniac Music Group Publishing Manager. This is a paid internship and is not a remote position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Track ISWCs and audit publishing records for accuracy

  • Add split information for exploited songs in DISCO

  • Tag and organize the full catalog in DISCO

  • Upload audio to the Master Publishing Rights sheet

  • Support writer catalog cleanup and spotlight creation

  • Create writer spotlights for socials/marketing/sync

  • Update and maintain the Publishing Spotify playlist

  • Assist with publishing social channels, bios, and website content

  • Contribute to website upgrades and improvements

  • All other publishing related duties and projects as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be at least 18 years of age

  • Currently enrolled in an accredited college or university

  • Must be able to work out of Calabasas, CA office 

  • Typical commitment is 16-29 hours per week

  • Must be motivated with an “Everything is possible” attitude

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and an active problem-solving mindset with a sense of urgency for projects large and small

  • Passion for music publishing, A&R, or the music business

  • Experienced with Google Sheets/Excel

  • Must be comfortable learning new catalog platforms (DISCO)

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills 

  • Must have ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be willing to travel to work during holidays, evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines

  • Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels and drastic temperature climates while working on site at various event location

  • Must be able to work in open concept office space

job.title: Portfolio Manager, GRC Risk Operations
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 



THE ROLE

The Portfolio Manager, GRC Risk Operations is a hands-on player-coach responsible for the end-to-end operational health and delivery of an assigned Risk Operations portfolio. This role combines direct risk assessment execution, first-line quality assurance, intake and workload management, business engagement, reporting, project delivery, and people leadership.


The Portfolio Manager will directly manage risk analysts and oversee AI agents that support portfolio execution, creating a blended human-and-AI delivery model. The Portfolio Manager remains actively involved in the work, including completing assessments, QAing analyst deliverables, managing stakeholder communications and escalations, and driving projects and operational improvements. The role is accountable for ensuring work is prioritized, completed with quality, communicated clearly, and continuously improved in alignment with program requirements and broader security, privacy, compliance, and business priorities.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Own day-to-day operational delivery and overall health of an assigned portfolio, including intake, prioritization, workload allocation, backlog, cycle time, service levels, remediation, escalations, and stakeholder responsiveness.
  • Personally perform third-party risk assessments across the full assessment lifecycle, including standard, complex, Critical/High, expedited, fast-track, and escalated reviews as needed; review supplier documentation and evidence, identify risk, document findings, develop remediation requirements, support exceptions, and communicate assessment conclusions.
  • Perform first-line QA of analyst-completed assessments for completeness, accuracy, evidence quality, consistency, risk judgment, and adherence to standards; provide actionable feedback and coaching, identify recurring quality trends, and escalate work requiring independent final approval in accordance with program governance.
  • Manage, coach, and develop team of risk analysts, including work assignment, capacity planning, performance support, skill development, and guidance on complex assessments, remediation, exceptions, and stakeholder issues.
  • Lead portfolio intake support by reviewing incoming requests, confirming completeness, assessing urgency and complexity, aligning work to analyst capacity and expertise, and resolving or escalating intake issues that create delays or duplicate effort.
  • Serve as a primary operational point of contact for business leaders, internal stakeholders, and external suppliers; provide portfolio-level updates, manage escalations, clarify next steps and timelines, and translate requirements into clear business-facing communications.
  • Develop, gather, validate, and communicate portfolio metrics, dashboards, and status reporting, using data to monitor SLA achievement, backlog health, cycle time, workload, remediation, quality trends, stakeholder experience, and emerging portfolio risks; provide clear portfolio-health updates and recommended actions to leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Lead or support projects and workstreams by defining scope, timelines, deliverables, owners, dependencies, risks, action items, and status; maintain project plans and schedules, coordinate cross-functional execution, translate operational needs into actionable requirements, and drive adoption of new processes, tools, controls, and program initiatives.
  • Manage AI agents used to support portfolio operations by identifying appropriate use cases, directing and monitoring AI-enabled work, reviewing output quality, defining human-review and escalation requirements, and measuring operational value. Partner with the Technical Administrator and governance resources on agent configuration, integrations, controls, and technical enhancements while retaining accountability for how agents are used within the portfolio.
  • Drive continuous improvement across assessment workflows, intake, reporting, communications, quality, and automation by identifying recurring friction, rework, capacity constraints, stakeholder pain points, and control gaps and translating those findings into practical operational improvements that improve portfolio health and scalability.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 8+ years of experience in third-party risk management, information security, compliance, operational risk, audit, vendor risk, or a related risk discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in portfolio management, program/project management, business engagement, or operational leadership, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities.
  • 2+ years of people leadership or direct management experience, including coaching, workload management, performance support, and development of analysts or comparable risk professionals.
  • Hands-on experience conducting third-party risk assessments and evaluating supplier evidence, control environments, findings, remediation plans, exceptions, and ongoing due diligence.
  • Experience reviewing or QAing risk assessment work and providing clear, consistent feedback that improves quality and analyst capability.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to translate risk concepts for technical and non-technical audiences and provide clear portfolio-level reporting and escalation updates.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing scope, schedules, dependencies, risks, action items, and cross-functional delivery; experience with tools such as Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar is preferred.
  • Experience using metrics, dashboards, reporting platforms, workflow automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve operational visibility, efficiency, and scalability; experience overseeing AI-supported workflows or agent-based automation is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of common security, privacy, and compliance frameworks and requirements such as NIST, ISO 27001, PCI, SOX, and GDPR.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment in a fast-paced global environment, balance hands-on execution with leadership responsibilities, and manage sensitive or confidential information with discretion.
  • Relevant certifications such as CTPRP/CTPRA, CRISC, CISA, CISM and PMP, CAPM, Certified ScrumMaster, or comparable risk/project management credentials are preferred.

If the above description sounds like you and fits your background, apply online at http://www.livenation.com/careers/index.html to join the Live Nation Entertainment team today!

job.title: Promoted Ads || Senior Product Manager, Promoted Ads
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Senior Product Manager will own product strategy and roadmap execution for a defined area within Promoted Ads, Ticketmaster's proprietary advertising platform. Reporting directly to the VP of Product, you will lead annual and quarterly planning for your area, define and drive product strategy, and identify where AI can create differentiated value within your domain. You'll operate with significant autonomy in a fast-moving, often ambiguous environment, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market stakeholders to ship high-value features for Ticketmaster's B2B advertisers. This is a senior, high-trust role for a product leader who is comfortable defining scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to them.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Own and deliver the roadmap for your area within Promoted Ads, moving area-level KPIs and aligning core cross-functional partners around shared outcomes
  • Lead annual and quarterly planning for your area — mapping critical path, surfacing dependencies, and committing to measurable goals
  • Define and drive product strategy for your area, setting crisp choices and success criteria aligned to broader company priorities
  • Lead structured qualitative and quantitative discovery, triangulating fan, client, and market signals to inform roadmap decisions
  • Define domain AI opportunities within your area, connecting capabilities like recommendations, classification, and automation across relevant surfaces
  • Navigate complex, often ambiguous problem spaces, making well-reasoned decisions with minimal guidance
  • Resolve cross-team risks and make explicit trade-offs — balancing fan experience, client needs, and technical constraints — to land launches cleanly
  • Plan for scale, intentionally addressing usability and technical debt rather than letting them accumulate
  • Build and maintain a strong grasp of Ticketmaster's systems and standards, ensuring your roadmap strengthens core platform capabilities
  • Serve as the go-to voice for key product decisions in your area, creating clarity in ambiguity and accelerating your team's decision-making
  • Introduce documentation patterns (templates, checklists, decision logs) that your team and cross-functional partners adopt
  • Drive clarity across teams and write compelling strategy memos for senior stakeholders, adapting your communication approach to the audience

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including meaningful, hands-on time in both adtech and B2B SaaS environments (required)
  • Demonstrated ownership of a product roadmap with measurable, area-level impact; comfortable navigating ambiguity with minimal guidance
  • Proven experience leading planning cycles — both quarterly and annual — including dependency mapping and cross-team alignment
  • Strong track record setting and communicating product strategy, with the judgment to make and defend crisp trade-offs
  • Experience identifying and scoping AI/ML-driven product opportunities, partnering effectively with Data Science/ML teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex communication style across technical, cross-functional, and executive audiences
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where scope may shift based on evolving business priorities
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Bonus: experience in ticketing, live events, or marketplace/advertising platforms
  • Bonus: experience partnering with Data Science/ML teams on recommendation, classification, or automation features

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

job.title: Receptionist & Events Coordinator
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment and eCommerce company, comprised of four market leaders: Ticketmaster.com, Live Nation Concerts, Front Line Management Group and Live Nation Network.  Ticketmaster.com is the global event ticketing leader and one of the world’s top five eCommerce sites, with over 26 million monthly unique visitors.  Live Nation Concerts produces over 20,000 shows annually for more than 2,000 artists globally.  Front Line is the world’s top artist management company, representing over 250 artists.  These businesses power Live Nation Network, the leading provider of entertainment marketing solutions, enabling over 800 advertisers to tap into the 200 million consumers Live Nation delivers annually through its live event and digital platforms. For additional information, visit www.livenation.com/investors.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE ROLE

The Receptionist will be responsible for ensuring a great experience for all visitors and staff. The right candidate must be able to work under limited supervision, taking initiative when necessary. Success in this role means you take on job duties with a sense of ownership, commitment, confidentiality, and integrity and step in to help whenever and wherever necessary.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Greet and assist all staff and guests. Answer the main switchboard for Live Nation and transfer calls to the corresponding department.
  • Take messages for executives and relay the information to their corresponding assistant.
  • Ensure proper security protocol is followed by staff and guests; check-in and monitor visitors in reception area, provide access as necessary. Continuously communicate with security regarding the status of guests.
  • Assist in day-to-day operation of the lounge including, but not limited to, setting up morning snacks, refilling snack jar, and maintaining the space to ensure it is always in client-ready condition.
  • Coordinate conference room reservations and assist with general meeting support as needed (i.e. catering, guest check-in, etc.)
  • Assist with coffee requests for larger executive meetings.
  • Plan and coordinate company lobby events including happy hour, artist performances, live streams, and various office networking events
  • Coordinate with executives and assistants regarding messenger and food deliveries.
  • Maintain clean and professional reception area. Team with Facilities personnel to coordinate mail, deliveries, office supplies and routine maintenance.
  • Submit work orders for building maintenance and internal facility related requests. Point of contact between employees and the onsite car washing service.
  • Assist with various assigned tasks as they arise.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 2-3 years previous experience in front office of music or entertainment corporate environment.
  • Warm, engaging and professional demeanor both in person and on the phone.
  • Outstanding communications skills and business etiquette. Intermediate Microsoft Office Skills
  • Actively demonstrate good judgment and discretion related to confidential material.
  • Passionate and motivated.
  • Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed
  • Reliable and dedicated with a can-do attitude. Encourage and build mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
  • Scheduled to work 40 hours a week.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, Vision and Dental benefits for you and your family, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
  • YOURSELF: Generous paid time off policy including paid holidays, sick time and paid days off for your birthday, Free concert tickets

job.title: Sales Commission Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

Live Nation Entertainment's Media & Sponsorship Division seeks a highly analytical and detail-oriented Sales Commission Analyst to support the administration and execution of the division's sales commission function.

This role is responsible for reporting, administering, reconciling, and analyzing sales compensation across the division. Working closely with Finance, Sales, Sales Systems Operations, and HR, this person will translate approved compensation plans into operational processes, maintain accurate commission data, execute adjustments, and provide timely reporting and analysis to support the business.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with complex data, and able to manage recurring deadlines and high-stakes financial calculations with a high degree of accuracy.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

 

  • Administer approved annual sales compensation plans, implementing plan structures, rates, splits, advances, draws, and reconciliation schedules within the commission platform.
  • Maintain commission plan configurations within the platform, including formula updates, seller onboarding/offboarding, testing, and ongoing administrative changes based on approved plan decisions.
  • Execute commission administration including seller and manager access, approval tracking, dispute resolution, and updates to earnings information throughout the year.
  • Execute Salesforce data adjustments required for accurate commission calculations, including overrides, exceptions, splits, Regional Multi-Year Bonus qualifications, deal prorations, Division AOI and Teams Goals tracking, and bi-weekly data quality checks.
  • Perform quarterly and annual commission reconciliations to validate calculations, identify discrepancies, and support accurate and timely payments.
  • Produce bi-weekly executive scorecards and compensation reports summarizing sales performance, commissions, and payment obligations.
  • Analyze historical compensation and sales data to identify trends, variances, data issues, and opportunities for improved reporting and accuracy.
  • Support annual budget reporting and forecasting by providing commission data, historical trends, and analysis to Finance and Sales leadership.
  • Maintain commission dashboards and reporting by combining data from Salesforce, the commission platform, and other business systems.
  • Support scenario analysis and modeling to help Sales and Finance understand the potential compensation impact of business and performance changes.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for commission calculations, payments, adjustments, advances, and exceptions.
  • Coordinate with third-party commission platform vendors on system issues, licensing, renewals, and user administration, escalating issues as needed.
  • Respond to seller and manager questions regarding commission calculations, payments, reporting, and platform functionality, resolving issues or coordinating with the appropriate team.
  • Maintain field guides, training materials, and communications related to commission processes, deadlines, payment timelines, and system updates.
  • Identify and support process improvements, including opportunities for automation, improved reporting, and use of AI tools to increase accuracy and reduce manual effort.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

 

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Human Resources, Accounting, or a related field with 2–5 years of experience in sales compensation, financial analysis, sales operations, HR analytics, or a related analytical function.
  • Experience administering or supporting a sales commission process, preferably within a commission management platform such as CIQ, Spiff, Xactly, CaptivateIQ, or comparable system.
  • Strong Excel and data analysis skills, including pivot tables, lookups, data validation, reconciliation, and the ability to analyze complex payout calculations.
  • Experience working with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, with an understanding of how CRM data flows into downstream reporting and commission calculations.
  • Experience with BI and reporting tools and the ability to build and maintain management-facing reports and dashboards.
  • Understanding of sales compensation concepts including commissions, draws, advances, splits, multi-year deals, prorations, exceptions, and reconciliations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy when working with confidential compensation and financial information.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage recurring reporting cycles, payment deadlines, and multiple requests simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify the underlying cause of data or calculation issues.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain compensation calculations and reporting results to sellers, managers, and cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to work effectively in a process-driven, deadline-oriented environment and build structure and documentation around evolving operational processes.

 

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time-off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

Who are you?

Passionate and motivated.  Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

The Role:

The Venue Nation Analytics team is looking for a talented intern to support Food & Beverage (F&B) analytics across our owned and operated venues. This role will be responsible for data quality, business intelligence reporting, creating and maintaining dashboards, and post-event recap completeness. This is a paid internship that will be expected to start as soon as possible in 2027 on part-time hours (10-20 hours a week). The student would then move to a full-time role in the summer (40 hours) for 12 weeks. At the end of the summer, the student would then close out the year by going back to part time as the school year started again. Hours within the school year are flexible based upon the student’s schedule. This is an in-person role at our Chicago offices in Fulton Market.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Support Food & Beverage team with ongoing analyses, including custom data requests, tour insight reports, research requests, testing recaps, and data quality checks.
  • Organize and maintain Post-Show Event Recap data to ensure timely and accurate event-performance reporting.
  • Assist in creating and maintaining data dictionaries, business definitions, and related documentation to improve data accuracy and usability.
  • Review and resolve AI-assisted data-cleansing outputs, escalating exceptions or ambiguous records as needed.
  • Assist with Tableau dashboard and dataset maintenance.

 

Qualifications:

  • Pursuing or completing a bachelor’s degree in the following subjects: Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related major required.
  • Must have completed or in process of completing junior year coursework.
  • Must have strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including Lookups, Pivot Tables, Nested Formulas, and Logical Formulas.
  • Must have a positive attitude, the ability to communicate within all levels of the organization, and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Experience with Tableau and data visualization a plus.
  • Coursework in and/or understanding of relational database fundamentals, data warehouses, and basic SQL are a plus.
  • Experience leveraging LLM’s to help make day-to-day tasks more efficient.
  • Passion for Live Music is a must.

 

If the above description sounds like you and fits your background, please contact micheleburgess@livenation.com.

job.title: Breaking News Reporter
job.description:
Join McClatchy as a breaking news and watchdog reporter, where you’ll be at the forefront of urgent, high-impact public safety coverage. This role is built for a journalist who thrives on fast-moving stories — from gun violence to fires and accidents — and who’s ready to pivot from live coverage to deep-dive accountability reporting on public officials and institutions.

You’ll own the beat online and on the ground, publishing breaking news with speed and accuracy, capturing photo and video, and engaging audiences across platforms. You’ll build a robust network of sources to deliver stories that matter most to your local community, always with an eye on growing and serving readership. Quick-turn stories, open records work and occasional long-term watchdog reporting will all be part of your toolkit.

We’re looking for a journalist who:

  • Delivers urgent, accurate coverage and follows up with accountability reporting
  • Masters multimedia storytelling and audience engagement tactics
  • Uses data, analytics and SEO to inform coverage and reach more readers
  • Embraces AI and automation to focus on source-building and impactful journalism
  • Works collaboratively in a fast-paced, evolving digital environment

If you’re ready to combine watchdog instincts with digital agility — and you want to help shape the future of local news — we want to hear from you.

To apply, submit a persuasive cover letter, resume and references.

job.title: Kentucky Men's Basketball Insider
job.description:
Covering Kentucky basketball for the Lexington Herald-Leader is a high-impact, high-visibility assignment at the heart of college sports journalism. This is not a traditional beat: you’ll be the go-to source for Big Blue Nation, breaking news and delivering in-depth, personality-driven coverage of the winningest program in men’s college basketball history. You’ll dig into the stories behind the box score—NIL, recruiting, the transfer portal and the business of the UK brand—while also capturing the culture, personalities and community impact that make Kentucky basketball a year-round obsession.

You’ll work across formats, from rapid-turn breaking news to explanatory video, and connect with fans on every platform, from TikTok to live events. AI and automation will help you focus on what matters most: building sources, breaking stories and delivering journalism that sets the agenda for Kentucky sports. You’ll also pitch in on major events like the Kentucky Derby, keeping your reporting fresh and relevant all year.

What sets this role apart:

  • Own one of the most competitive and vital beats in college sports
  • Combine relentless reporting with digital storytelling and audience engagement
  • Use AI and automation to free up time for deeper journalism—never to replace your voice or judgment
  • Reach fans wherever they are, with vertical video, social media and in-person events
  • Be part of a collaborative, supportive newsroom that values experimentation and continuous learning

What you’ll bring:

  • A college degree in journalism or equivalent experience
  • 3-5 years of reporting experience, ideally in highly competitive environments
  • Strong writing skills, excellent news judgment and the ability to spot stories that matter
  • Relentless reporting drive and a commitment to accuracy and ethics
  • Experience building sources and using public records
  • Comfort working nights, weekends and traveling for coverage
  • Skill in shooting and appearing on video, plus a strong grasp of vertical and social-first formats
  • Familiarity with Facebook, X, TikTok, Instagram and emerging platforms
  • Experience with AI tools and/or a willingness to experiment in that space
  • A collaborative approach and eagerness to learn and adapt
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance
  • Residency in Lexington-Fayette County

If you’re ready to set the pace for Kentucky basketball coverage and thrive in a digital-first, audience-obsessed environment, we want to hear from you.

To apply, please submit a resume, work samples and a one-page cover letter explaining how you would approach the job.

job.title: Visual Journalist
job.description:
Bring stories to life in a fast-moving, digital-first newsroom. As a visual journalist at McClatchy, you’ll shape how our diverse and growing community sees itself—capturing moments, people and issues with photography and video that matter to our readers. You’ll work across formats, from original assignments to short-form verticals and multi-format versions of existing reporting, using company-provided tools that streamline production and let you focus on what counts: impactful storytelling.

You’ll pitch and develop your own visual story ideas, respond to breaking news and deliver timely, accurate and ethically captured photo and video content. Our visual journalists are audience-first, using analytics and feedback to inform coverage and drive growth. You’ll work with Nikon gear and the Adobe suite, and you’ll be expected to write clean, compelling captions and headlines that help your work get discovered and shared. We encourage you to experiment with AI and automation to take routine work off your plate—freeing you to focus on the stories that matter most.

What you’ll do:

  • Produce timely, credible and relevant visual journalism—photo, video and multi-format—for digital platforms
  • Pitch, develop and execute visual stories that align with newsroom priorities and audience needs
  • Use analytics and audience signals to inform coverage and measure impact
  • Build and maintain strong community contacts and sources
  • Edit, caption, tag and archive assets, managing rights and permissions
  • Use social media to distribute and highlight your work
  • Respond quickly to breaking news and shifting priorities
  • Write accurate, context-rich headlines, captions and video summaries
  • Embrace new tools, including AI and automation, to work smarter

What you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, photojournalism or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience
  • 1–3 years of experience in digital media, entertainment journalism or related fields
  • Strong photography and videography skills, with excellent news judgment
  • Experience with digital audience engagement, analytics and SEO
  • Technical proficiency with camera, lighting and audio equipment, editing software (Adobe suite), content management systems and Google Workspace or MS Office
  • Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation and required insurance
  • Flexibility to work nights, weekends and holidays as needed
  • Ability to work remotely and as part of a collaborative team

To apply, please submit a cover letter, resume and samples of your visual work.

job.title: Billing Clerk
job.description:
Herman Weissker Power, Inc. (HW Power), a proud subsidiary of Meruelo Enterprises, is California’s go-to electrical utility contractor powering the state’s most critical infrastructure with precision and passion. Since 2011, from our headquarters in Norwalk, we’ve been leading the charge in overhead and underground electrical systems, including expert vault installations, conduit placement, and high-voltage power line construction.

But we don’t stop there. Our team also brings cutting-edge planning, design, and traffic control services to the table making even the most complex utility projects run smoothly. Driven by an unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and high performance, HW Power is the trusted partner for public and private sector clients who demand reliable, future-ready energy solutions.

 

About the Role:

The Billing Clerk will be responsible for creating company invoices and send them to HW Power customers for payment; process adjustments or corrections as needed.  Process foreman daily timesheets and other accounting related tasks as identified by the Office Supervisor.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Assign new job numbers as needed

²  Open new jobs in the company’s accounting system; updating information when necessary

²  Timely / accurately prepare and send out customer invoices as required by the contract

²  Ensure proper documentation for contracts, change orders, adjustments and other pertinent billing information are maintained in A/R files

²  Maintain A/R files in a neat, organized manner; updating with new documentation as received. 

²  Prepare adjustments or credit memo when necessary; obtain proper approval

²  Assist with collections efforts for past due invoices

²  Investigate and resolve billing errors, inconsistencies or customer inquiries

²  Ability to learn and become proficient with multiple billing platforms

²  Other necessary and required duties

 

Qualifications:

²  A high school diploma or GED equivalent is required.

²  A minimum of two years of accounts receivable experience or equivalent training is preferred.

²  General knowledge of the various disciplines and procedures utilized by the Construction industry is preferred.

²  Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and knowledge of spreadsheet applications.

²  Ability to stay focused and work without close supervision.

²  Works well in a team environment as well as independently.

²  Ability to accurately enter data and perform mathematical calculations.

²  Able to adjust priorities on short notice, manage interruptions and work well under pressure.

²  Ability to timely meet deadlines; coordinate workloads with Supervisor.

²  Effective communication, organizational and problem-solving skills.

²  Complies with and maintains company confidentiality practices and policies.

²  Interacts professionally with all company employees and outside persons, such as customers, vendors and professional service providers.

²  Mental alertness is necessary to ensure accurate and thorough completion of work activities.

²  Ability to interpret and disseminate complex information appropriate and effectively.

²  Ability to sit for prolonged periods and efficiently operate computer, calculator, copier, fax and other business office equipment.

²  Comply with accounting and all other company policies, procedures, as well as all relevant federal, state and local reporting requirements.

²  Working conditions consist of a temperature-controlled office; noise level in work environment is usually moderate.

At HW Power, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
