job.title: Safety Supervisor
job.description:
DOTY BROS. EQUIPMENT CO.  

Job Title: Safety Specialist

Department: Operations

Reports to: Safety Director

FLSA: Exempt

Doty Bros Construction is a leading company in the construction and engineering industry. We perform engineering & construction work in a variety of market segments. We are headquartered in Los Angeles with business units in LA, Riverside, San Diego and Ventura performing work throughout California.

The Safety Specialist is responsible for administering the Company safety/health and accident prevention program and to ensure all employees have a safe environment in which to work.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Administer and audit the Company safety program; implement and coordinate safety and health activities
  • Conduct announced and unannounced occupational safety and health inspections of company facilities, equipment, materials, operations and job sites to ensure compliance with corporate safety policy, and all federal, state and local regulations.
  • Analyze inspection findings to determine the need for employee safety training; conduct safety-training classes as required; conduct required and selected company-wide safety certification classes; maintain records of all training classes; assist in development of safety and training manuals for equipment and work processes.
  • Assist in industrial hygiene surveys, as required review all accidents and make recommendations for corrective action as needed.
  • Recommend safety equipment to be used or worn; coordinate with safety committees and the purchasing departments concerning the purchase, storage and issuance of approved safety equipment and products for employees.
  • Provide project safety support.
  • Coordinate fleet safety programs; keep current on new trends and methods in accident prevention field; keep current on OSHA reports and standards.
  • Attend and participate in professional safety organization projects.
  • Conduct work area surveillance inspections, air-sampling tests for confined space entry, property damage and personal injury investigations.
  • Perform related duties as assigned.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

Associates or Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Industrial Hygiene or related discipline or a combination of education and experience providing equivalent knowledge (examples include but are not limited to 5 Years Journeyman experience with 3 years safety program experience or Advanced Safety Certificate through National Safety Council, etc.).  Recognized safety certification (CHST, CUSP, etc.) preferred.  Minimum 3 years safety related experience or field related experience in the underground construction industry.  OSHA 10 Construction required.

LICENSE:

Possession of or ability to obtain a valid class C California driver's license

SKILLS, PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Thorough understanding of and ability to enforce federal, state, local and company regulations.
  • Ability to recognize hazardous situation and implement corrective measures essential.
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills required.
  • Must have extensive knowledge of applicable safety regulations, regulatory requirement and industry standards for construction and general industry; knowledge of EPA, DOT and NEPA standards.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, possess good organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Word & Excel and have knowledge of spreadsheet applications.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee frequently is required to walk; stand and sit for prolong periods. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Must be able to operate a motor vehicle.

Working conditions consists of a temperature-controlled office, outside elements such as rain, cold, and heat when driving from jobsite to jobsite or attending meetings, etc. Noise levels are moderate to loud depending on jobsite.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of the work performed by employees assigned to this position. This description assists in ADA compliance, and is not intended for any other purpose such as compensation. All employees must comply with company policies and applicable laws. Management retains the right to assign additional duties periodically and the discretion to add or change the duties of this position at any time.

Doty Bros Construction offers a very competitive pay and benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance and 401k.

Doty Bros Construction is an Equal Opportunity Employer

job.description:
Job Type Full-time Description

 

Assistant Operations Manager


Midwest Communications, Inc in Evansville, Indiana is looking for an Assistant Operations Manager who is familiar with radio, understands what makes a station succeed, and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and jump in wherever they're needed. 


Your Responsibilities

  • Keep day-to-day operations running smoothly by tackling problems, supporting teammates, and stepping up where leadership is needed. 
  • Partner with programming, sales, promotions, and other departments to build strong brands that deliver results.
  • Ability to connect and interact with local listeners and serve our community in a meaningful way.
  • Have a strong understanding of ratings, audience research, and programming strategy.
  • Help fill on-air talent slots at any of our radio stations on an as needed basis. 

We Ask That You:

  • Have prior experience in radio programming, preferably as a brand manager, program director, assistant program director, or similar experience.
  • Are equipped with a tech-savvy background with the ability to learn a variety of platforms that include but are not limited: TextGroove, Socast, WideOrbit Playlist Editor, 11Labs (AI audio integration) our company portal website, and podcasting infrastructure. Experience with WideOrbit Automation and MusicMaster scheduling is a plus.
    • We can teach you the skills as long as you are willing to learn!
  • Have realistic and grounded understandings of modern radio operations and what it entails to create a successful brand and station.
  • Multi format radio experience is preferred, knowledge of CHR or Hot AC is ideal. 
  • Have a valid Indiana driver’s license, ability to pass a motor vehicle check, and satisfactory background check. 

Compensation/Benefits 

  • A full-time position with an established and successful business.
  • Competitive pay starting at $55,000 with full benefits.
    • Paid time off/holidays, health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending accounts, life insurance, and disability coverage. 
  • Opportunities to grow within Midwest Communications, Inc.

Culture at Midwest Communications

At Midwest Communications, Inc., we’re invested in the longevity and satisfaction of our employees. As a privately owned, family-founded company, we expect our team members to take ownership of their work while also enjoying a laid-back, collaborative atmosphere where growth and creativity are encouraged. We operate as a tightly knit staff and getting along with your coworkers is non-negotiable given the collaborative nature of the role. We truly are a united team where every department works together to achieve a mutual goal. 


You’ll have the tools and support of an established media company, along with the autonomy to get your work done and make the role your own. 

If this sounds like a role you would thrive in, don’t hesitate to apply today!

Wake up Central Wisconsin. Make someone’s day a little brighter.

 

Great radio is about more than playing the right songs. It’s about becoming part of someone’s routine, making them laugh on the way to work, and giving listeners a reason to keep coming back.

job.title: Control Room Technician / Television Studio, Apple Valley News Now
job.description:
About the Opportunity

Are you calm under pressure, comfortable juggling multiple priorities and ready to take on a new challenge? Apple Valley News Now, the local ABC affiliate serving Washington’s Yakima and Tri-Cities communities, is looking for a Control Room Technician / Television Studio team member to help bring our daily newscasts and entertainment programming to life.

This is a vital behind-the-scenes role. You’ll work with a collaborative team to ensure our broadcasts are accurate, polished and delivered to viewers on time. From master control and studio cameras to graphics and newscast directing, you’ll play an important part in telling the stories that connect our audiences with their communities.

If you want to begin or grow a career in television broadcasting, we’ll provide the training and support you need to succeed.

Why Join Apple Valley News Now?

We’re a family-owned, people-first company that values your work, your ideas and your life outside the station. You’ll have opportunities to learn multiple areas of broadcast operations while working alongside experienced professionals who want to see you grow.

You’ll also enjoy living in Washington’s beautiful Tri-Cities region, where thriving communities, great restaurants, outdoor recreation and scenic destinations are all close by—without the long commute found in many larger markets.

What You’ll Do

No two days in the control room are exactly the same. In this role, you will:

  • Monitor and operate master control to keep programming running smoothly and in compliance with station and FCC requirements.
  • Direct or assist with live newscasts.
  • Operate studio cameras, graphics and other production equipment.
  • Monitor the technical quality of on-air programming.
  • Troubleshoot technical and operational issues quickly and calmly.
  • Coordinate with News, Engineering, Programming and other departments.
  • Follow broadcast schedules, logs and established operating procedures.
  • Maintain focus, accuracy and quality throughout the broadcast day.

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for a dependable, engaged and creative team member with an interest in television broadcasting. Previous television production experience is helpful, but it is not required—we are willing to train the right person.

A successful candidate will bring:

  • Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new technology.
  • Clear and effective communication skills.
  • Sound judgment and a solutions-focused approach to problem-solving.
  • The ability to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage shifting priorities.
  • The ability to perform basic math quickly and accurately.
  • The ability to lift and carry 40 pounds or more.
  • Availability to work a flexible schedule, including various shifts and days of the week, when needed for station operations or emergencies.
  • A collaborative attitude and a genuine interest in broadcasting.

What You’ll Receive

You’ll join a supportive workplace where co-workers and managers value your contributions, time and perspective. We’ll provide hands-on training and the resources you need to do your job well. You’ll also work with people who care deeply about serving our viewers and communities.

Pay range: $17.75–$19 per hour

Benefits

We offer eligible employees and their families a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision and prescription coverage
  • Life and long-term disability insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Flexible spending and health savings accounts
  • 401(k)
  • Employee referral program
  • Paid time off, including vacation time equivalent to up to 80 hours per year depending on start date
  • One hour of paid sick time for every 40 hours worked
  • Two personal days
  • Nine paid holidays

Ready to Get Behind the Scenes?

If you’re ready to build valuable skills, work with a great team and help keep our local broadcasts on the air, we’d like to hear from you.

Apple Valley News Now is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Associate Producer - Local Media Game Production
job.description:
WORK OPTION

The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week. _________________ Associate Producer, Local Media Game Production (NABET)

Position Summary

The Associate Producer, Local Media Game Production, supports live NBA game broadcasts and related programming by managing production assets, coordinating content delivery, and ensuring broadcast-ready materials are available to game production teams. Reporting to the Game Production Lead, this role collaborates with internal departments and external production partners to maintain editorial, technical, and NBA brand standards while supporting efficient live game operations. Working in conjunction with the Local Game Production Supervisor, Producer, and onsite ATL Producer/Director team, the Associate Producer helps ensure production teams have timely access to the content, graphics, music, and other production assets necessary to execute assigned NBA broadcasts. This role serves as an important connection point across NBA content teams and game production teams, supporting content coordination and asset readiness across Local Media productions.

Major Responsibilities

Produce and distribute high-quality, shareable content aligned with NBA brand standards and relevant current and historical NBA storylines. Curate and package content for use across live broadcasts and related programming, ensuring required video and audio clearances are secured prior to content distribution. Coordinate the delivery, management, and distribution of music assets for live game productions, ensuring production teams have access to cloud-based music resources, receive necessary platform training, and maintain required onsite music assets. Perform quality control (QC) on video, audio, graphics, and other production elements to ensure materials meet established broadcast and production standards. Work with Advertising Sales and Traffic teams to support the maintenance, delivery, and quality control of sponsored graphic elements in accordance with established deadlines and production standards. Collaborate with Graphics teams to maintain, deliver, and quality-check graphic elements according to production schedules and broadcast standards. Support music licensing and related business operations by facilitating music requests, administering cue sheets, coordinating music clearances, validating third-party reporting, and tracking music budgets. Work cross-functionally across NBA content teams to identify daily content opportunities and opportunities to improve content-sharing efficiencies. Liaise with game production teams regarding newly created and available content relevant to their respective markets. Support the Local Game Production Supervisor, Producer, and onsite ATL Producer/Director team with content and production asset needs throughout pre-production and live game execution. Required Education/Professional

Experience

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Broadcast Journalism, Television Production, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional

experience

will be considered.

Experience

managing digital media assets, broadcast content, or production materials in a live production environment.

Experience

supporting content management and production operations.

Experience

working cross-functionally in a highly matrixed environment. Adobe editing proficiency and advanced content editing skills.

Experience

supporting live sports or broadcast production preferred.

Required Skills/Knowledge

Attributes Extensive knowledge of NBA teams, players, league storylines, historical context, and emerging digital and social media trends. Strong understanding of content and asset management within a live broadcast production environment. Diverse knowledge of music genres and an understanding of music workflows within a broadcast production environment. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple concurrent production needs. Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams and external production partners. Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects and production deliverables. Ability to perform effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced live production environment. Ability to work collaboratively with the Local Game Production Supervisor, Producer, onsite ATL Producer/Director, and other production personnel supporting assigned broadcasts. Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as required by the NBA schedule and live production needs. Commitment to maintaining high editorial, technical, operational, and NBA brand standards. Built around five professional sports leagues: the NBA, WNBA, NBA G League, NBA 2K League and Basketball Africa League, the NBA has established a major international presence with games and programming available in 214 countries and territories in more than 50 languages, and merchandise for sale in more than 200 countries and territories on all seven continents. job.title: Account Director, Performance & Growth (LA)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The NBCU Account Director, Performance & Growth will focus exclusively on driving demand for performance brands across our suite of linear and digital products including all streaming products, with a focus on driving new and incremental revenue for the full NBCU portfolio (One Platform). This individual will play a critical role within our fast-paced advertising sales team, managing relationships across external clients and independent media agencies. The role requires building relationships with key internal stakeholders and collaborative partners across the NBCU organization. Expertise within the performance and digital landscape is a must. This person must have the ability to operate effectively at the cross-section of performance and digital media as these skills are critical to achieving success in this role. This role will report directly into to the Vice President, Performance & Growth. 

  • Drive linear and digital advertising demand of the NBCU Platform for specific performance brands and agencies in the direct-to-consumer category 
  • Be an expert across NBCU digital and streaming products and convey meaningful and sustainable opportunities to emerging brands 
  • Execute on day-to-day sales strategy; develop target lists, lead client outreach and be in market often with full NBCU opportunities 
  • Leverage prospecting software such as Linkedin Navigator, Media Radar and Zoom Info to identify, research and engage prospective clients and partners 
  • Understand customer needs and provide feedback and market input that will strengthen our NBCU opportunities and value proposition 
  • Field proactive requests: collect, manage, and route RFP requests to key stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met 
  • Track sales revenue and establish a regular cadence for reporting on progress 
  • Partner with internal teams (Digital and Linear sales leads, Client Strategy, Agency Partnerships, Marketing, Legal, Research, etc.) to develop proactive packages and drive creativity throughout the sales process 
  • Develop strong relationships throughout NBCU to ensure a unified and coordinated strategy is presented in the market 
  • Proven ability to prospect and identify new/incremental revenue opportunities beyond servicing an existing book of business
  • Growth-oriented/hunter mindset, with experience developing new opportunities, expanding client investment, and converting whitespace into revenue
  • Strong technical aptitude, including demonstrated experience leveraging AI, automation, data, or emerging technology to improve workflows, prospect more effectively, or solve business problems
  • Demonstrated expertise in performance advertising, with a strong understanding of performance-driven digital media concepts, measurement, attribution, optimization, and the key levers that drive business outcomes.
  • Confidently applies performance principles across the full client lifecycle, from developing data-driven media strategies and communicating measurement frameworks pre-sale to analyzing campaign performance, identifying optimization opportunities, and using results to drive account growth post-sale.
  • Advanced client-facing skills with the ability to articulate value propositions, influence investment, and present integrated marketing solutions
  • Analytical and strategic thinker with a track record of creative problem-solving and driving innovation
  • Self-starter who can operate independently and effectively navigate a large, cross-functional organization
  • 5+ years of relevant experience across advertising sales, business development, account management, programmatic/ad tech, or a related advanced media environment
  • Digital video experience required

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

Location: This role is open to candidates based in Los Angeles or San Francisco.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $95,000 - $170,000 + sales compensation incentive eligible

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

job.title: Analyst, IP Operations
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Role Purpose:

The IP Operations team within NBCUniversal’s Intellectual Property Analytics, Operations, and Technology (IPAOT) department is seeking an Analyst to support the protection and enforcement of NBCUniversal’s intellectual property rights across digital platforms, with a primary focus on Generative AI-related enforcement.

This role will help monitor, investigate, and address unauthorized uses of NBCUniversal content, brands, characters, trademarks, and other intellectual property across Generative AI platforms, tools, services, and related digital ecosystems. The Analyst will play an important role in supporting NBCUniversal’s emerging Generative AI Piracy Program by identifying infringing AI-generated content, supporting enforcement actions, tracking platform and technology developments, and helping develop scalable monitoring and enforcement workflows as the AI landscape continues to evolve.

 

The Analyst will also help support NBCUniversal’s APAC anti-piracy program, including enforcement actions against infringing content found on piracy sites and Asia-specific platforms. They will do this while helping to ensure supporting vendors and staff remain consistent with key APAC partner priorities, concerns, and enforcement needs. Additional responsibilities will include monitoring and enforcement across key mobile application marketplaces and major online marketplaces involving counterfeit home entertainment items, such as DVDs, Blu-rays, and related physical media. The ideal candidate will use strong investigative skills and sound judgment to navigate digital platforms. They will also have an interest in emerging technologies and intellectual property protection efforts.

Here you can:

  • Conduct investigations to identify unauthorized use of NBCUniversal content, trademarks, brands, characters, logos, and other intellectual property across Generative AI platforms, tools, services, websites, social media platforms, and related digital properties
  • Support NBCUniversal’s Generative AI Piracy Program by identifying AI-generated infringement, monitoring emerging platform and technology trends, and helping develop scalable enforcement workflows
  • Review suspected infringing AI-generated content and determine appropriate enforcement actions in accordance with company policies and legal guidelines
  • Submit and manage takedown requests, platform complaints, and other enforcement actions across digital platforms, service providers, and relevant online intermediaries
  • Support NBCUniversal’s APAC anti-piracy program, including enforcement actions against infringing content found on piracy websites, streaming sites, download services, social media platforms, and Asia-specific digital platforms
  • Coordinate APAC enforcement workflows across internal stakeholders, vendors, and supporting staff to help ensure activity remains aligned with key APAC partner priorities, concerns, and title-level needs
  • Monitor piracy trends, platform activity, repeat offenders, and high-risk infringement patterns across APAC markets and Asia-specific platforms
  • Support monitoring and enforcement across key mobile application marketplaces involving unauthorized apps, infringing app listings, brand misuse, and other intellectual property abuse
  • Monitor major online marketplaces for counterfeit home entertainment items, including DVDs, Blu-rays, and related physical media using NBCUniversal intellectual property without authorization
  • Partner with IP Counsel, regional stakeholders, business units, external vendors, and internal operations teams to support enforcement initiatives and issue resolution
  • Assist with reporting, dashboards, metrics, and intelligence products related to Generative AI enforcement, APAC anti-piracy activity, mobile app enforcement, and online marketplace monitoring
  • Use AI and analytical tools where appropriate to improve investigative workflows, automate repetitive tasks, support analysis, and increase operational efficiency
  • Identify trends and opportunities based on investigative findings, enforcement activity, platform developments, vendor reporting, and recurring operational issues
  • Participate in team planning sessions, workflow discussions, continuous improvement initiatives, and additional projects as business needs evolve

Here you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree or 3+ years of equivalent experience in intellectual property protection, online investigations, anti-piracy, brand protection, trust and safety, digital enforcement, or a related field
  • Experience navigating and researching digital platforms, websites, social media platforms, mobile application ecosystems, online marketplaces, and emerging digital services
  • Understanding of copyright, trademark infringement, intellectual property rights, digital piracy, brand impersonation, and online enforcement concepts
  • Basic understanding of how Generative AI tools function, including how AI-generated images, video, audio, text, and other content may be created, modified, distributed, and misused across digital platforms
  • Solid analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Exceptional organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple teams

What we'll look for:

  • Experience conducting online investigations involving digital piracy, Generative AI misuse, trademark infringement, impersonation, counterfeit activity, unauthorized commerce, or intellectual property abuse
  • Familiarity with Generative AI platforms, large language models (LLMs), AI-generated image and video tools, voice/audio generation tools, and the broader AI content ecosystem
  • Experience supporting anti-piracy, trust and safety, content moderation, brand protection, or intellectual property enforcement programs
  • Familiarity with APAC digital platforms, piracy sites, regional enforcement challenges, or Asia-specific online ecosystems
  • Proficiency in both oral and written language skills, specifically Chinese or Korean, is a significant plus
  • Familiarity with major mobile app marketplaces, e-commerce marketplaces, social media platforms, and digital content platforms
  • Experience with data analysis, business intelligence tools, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, or similar reporting platforms
  • Strong project management, process improvement, and collaboration skills, with the ability to adapt to rapidly evolving technologies
  • Passion for protecting NBCUniversal content, brands, intellectual property, and consumer trust in the digital ecosystem

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the Universal City, CA office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.title: Animation Production Intern, DreamWorks Animation, Spring 2027
job.description:
DreamWorks Animation is looking for more adventurous dreamers who shoot for the moon. We tell stories about the journeys our unconventional heroes take to make dreams come true. As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world’s leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. We push to feel more, laugh more, and build immersive new worlds.

DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We place tremendous value on the experiences our talent brings to the table from their own non-traditional paths to success. We believe in frequent communication and that transparency and trust yield the best work. We are a community of artists, technologists, innovators, and creators, who are passionate about animation and also happen to love eating lunch together.

In the DreamWorks Internship Program, interns work in an engaging and exciting environment alongside creative leaders and artists who are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative culture. Interns are immersed into feature and TV productions while gaining hands-on experience at our studio. Open to students and recent grads, we love those who are driven and hungry to learn, are curious and resourceful, and most importantly, are passionate about animation.

The Internship Program also showcases best-in-class opportunities by offering executive speaker series, professional/career development workshops, artistic classes, community outreach opportunities, movie screenings, and much more!

If you are part of the fandom and believe teamwork makes the dream work, join us in #livingthedream and #doingyourdreamwork!

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés dans lesquelles nos employé·e·s, nos client·e·s et nos publics vivent et travaillent. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que nos employé·e·s aient l’occasion de servir leurs communautés. Nous défendons une culture inclusive et nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de diffuser une vaste gamme de contenus reflétant la diversité de notre monde.

Role Summary

NBCUniversal is seeking an experienced Associate Art Director – Characters to lead, define and drive the visual direction and consistency of characters for an ambitious new interactive entertainment experience. This role is responsible for ensuring that the full character ecosystem—including hero characters and large-scale population systems—achieves a high level of quality, cohesion, and scalability. 

Reporting to the Art Director, the Associate Art Director – Characters will work closely with Character Art Leads, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure alignment across pipelines, systems, and production goals. The role involves leading and managing Character Art Leads while providing high-level direction, establishing standards, and maintaining consistency across internal teams and external partners. 

Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate the visual direction for characters across the full project. 
  • Ensure consistency and quality across the full character ecosystem (hero characters and crowd systems). 
  • Lead and manage Character Art Leads and Review Artists, providing mentoring, direction, feedback, and alignment. 
  • Review assets and validate quality to ensure alignment with artistic and technical standards. 
  • Drive cross-discipline collaboration with Animation, Design, Tech Art, and Lighting teams. 
  • Ensure alignment between art direction, production constraints, and scalable pipelines. 
  • Maintain visual consistency across internal production and external partners. 
  • Identify risks and guide teams to deliver quality at scale across large production environments. 

Résumé du poste 

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne expérimentée au poste de directeur(trice) artistique associé(e) – Personnages afin de diriger, définir et faire évoluer l’orientation visuelle ainsi que la cohérence des personnages pour une nouvelle expérience ambitieuse de divertissement interactif. Ce rôle est responsable d’assurer un haut niveau de qualité, de cohérence et de scalabilité pour l’ensemble de l’écosystème de personnages, incluant les personnages principaux et les systèmes de population à grande échelle. 

Sous la direction de la Directrice Artistique, le·la Directeur.trice Artistique Associé.e – Personnages collaborera étroitement avec les Leads Character Art, les équipes d’artistes techniques et les équipes transverses afin d’assurer l’alignement entre pipelines, systèmes et objectifs de production. Le rôle inclut la gestion des Leads Character ainsi que la définition de standards, la direction artistique globale et la cohérence entre équipes internes et partenaires externes. 

Responsabilités 

  • Définir et communiquer la direction visuelle des personnages à l’échelle du projet. 
  • Assurer la cohérence et la qualité pour l’ensemble de l’écosystème (personnages principaux et systèmes de foule). 
  • Encadrer et manager les Leads Character Art, et les Artists de review, en assurant mentorat, direction, feedback et alignement. 
  • Réviser les assets et valider la qualité afin de respecter les standards artistiques et techniques. 
  • Piloter la collaboration transversale avec les équipes Animation, Design, Artistes Techniques et Éclairage. 
  • Assurer l’alignement entre direction artistique, contraintes de production et pipelines scalables. 
  • Maintenir la cohérence visuelle entre production interne et partenaires externes. 
  • Identifier les risques et guider les équipes pour livrer à grande échelle avec un haut niveau de qualité. 

 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Extensive experience (10+ yrs) in AAA game development with a focus on character art. 
  • Proven experience leading multiple teams or disciplines on published AAA title. 
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality character work and artistic direction. 
  • Strong understanding of modular character pipelines and real-time production workflows. 
  • Experience working with large-scale character systems including crowd or customization pipelines. 
  • Strong experience with real-time engines. Unreal Engine 5 and Metahuman experience is a plus. 
  • Solid comprehension of technical constraints allowing scalability on multiple platforms, from high-end to mobile. 
  • Ability to translate artistic vision into clear direction for teams. 
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Desired Characteristics 

  • Experience defining artistic vision and ability to maintain a scalable and cohesive character style identity on large-scale and open-world productions. 
  • Strong understanding of scalable character systems and production constraints. 
  • Experience working with outsourcing partners and distributed teams. 
  • Strategic mindset with strong prioritization and alignment skills. 
  • Strong sensitivity to realism, diversity, and character representation. 
  • Deep understanding of the gaming industry, current trends and player preferences. 
  • Excellent communication and natural practice of positive leadership skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Passion for storytelling through character design. 
  • Desire to think and explore innovative solutions. 

Eligibility Requirements 

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered. 
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week. 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada. 
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary 

Qualifications de base 

  • Expérience significative (+10 ans) en développement de jeux AAA avec un focus sur les personnages. 
  • Expérience avérée en gestion de plusieurs équipes ou disciplines sur une production AAA publiee. 
  • Portfolio solide démontrant une forte qualité en personnages et direction artistique. 
  • Bonne compréhension des pipelines de personnages et des workflows temps réel. 
  • Expérience avec les systèmes de personnages modulaires à grande échelle incluant foules ou systèmes de personnalisation. 
  • Expérience solide avec des moteurs temps reels. Expérience avec Unreal Engine 5 et Metahumain est un plus 
  • Solide compréhension des contraintes techniques permettant la scalabilité sur différentes plateformes de hautes qualités ainsi que sur mobile. 
  • Capacité à traduire une vision artistique en direction claire pour les équipes. 
  • Excellentes compétences en leadership, communication et collaboration. 

Atouts souhaités 

  • Expérience dans la définition d’une vision artistique et habilite a mainenir une identite visuelle coherente au travers d’une productions à grande échelle et monde ouvert. 
  • Bonne compréhension des systèmes de personnages scalables et des contraintes de production. 
  • Expérience avec partenaires externes et équipes distribuées. 
  • Vision stratégique et forte capacité de priorisation et d’alignement. 
  • Sensibilité au réalisme, à la diversité et à la représentation. 
  • Profonde compréhension de l’industrie du jeu vidéo, des modes actuelles et des gouts des joueurs. 
  • Excellente capacite de communication et pratique naturelle du leadership positif, ainsi qu’une facilite à s’épanouir dans un environnement dynamique. 
  • Passion pour la narration au travers des designs de personnages. 
  • Desir reel de penser et d’explorer des solutions innovantes. 

Exigences d’admissibilité 

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être considérées.  
  • Doit être disposé·e à travailler dans nos bureaux de Montréal au minimum quatre (4) jours par semaine.

We’re looking for an Associate Producer for an exciting interactive entertainment project to support the creation, tracking, and execution of game assets for a discipline (environment, characters, audio, animation). In this role, you will help teams stay organized by maintaining asset schedules, tracking progress, coordinating priorities, following up on dependencies, and supporting milestone delivery. 

You will work closely with craft directors, producers, pod leads, and multidisciplinary teams to support asset production from request through review, approval, integration, and delivery. You will help ensure creative and technical asset goals are translated into clear tasks, visible progress, and reliable execution across disciplines, pods, and pillars. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Help build and maintain asset schedules, task lists, production plans, and milestone deliverables.  
  • Track daily progress across assigned teams and ensure asset status is accurate in project tools.  
  • Maintain visibility on blockers, dependencies, approvals, reviews, known issues, and next steps.  
  • Coordinate priorities between craft directors, product owners, producers, pod leads, and pillar needs.  
  • Support asset reviews, feedback sessions, approvals, and follow-up actions.  
  • Identify risks, blockers, or priority conflicts and escalate them to producers or production leadership.  
  • Facilitate communication between design, engineering, art, animation, audio, QA, and other departments.  
  • Help maintain production tracking tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.  
  • Work with QA and development teams to ensure asset-related issues are tracked and followed up effectively.  
  • Support milestone readiness by helping ensure asset deliverables, dependencies, reviews, and known issues are clearly tracked.  
  • Help refine asset workflows, pipelines, tracking practices, and communication habits.  
  • Contribute to retrospectives or post-milestone reviews and follow through on actionable improvements. 

Nous recherchons un(e) Producer Associé(e) pour un projet interactif de divertissement passionnant afin de soutenir la création, le suivi et l’exécution des assets de jeu dans une discipline (environnements, personnages, audio, animation). Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez les équipes à rester organisées en maintenant les plannings des assets, en suivant la progression, en coordonnant les priorités, en assurant le suivi des dépendances et en soutenant la livraison des jalons. 

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les directeurs de discipline, les producers, les leads de pods et des équipes multidisciplinaires afin de soutenir la production des assets depuis la demande jusqu’à la revue, l’approbation, l’intégration et la livraison. Vous contribuerez à garantir que les objectifs créatifs et techniques liés aux assets sont traduits en tâches claires, en progression visible et en une exécution fiable à travers les disciplines, les pods et les piliers. 

Responsabilités Principales:

  • Contribuer à la création et au maintien des plannings d’assets, des listes de tâches, des plans de production et des livrables de jalons.  
  • Suivre la progression quotidienne des équipes assignées et garantir que le statut des assets est exact dans les outils de projet.  
  • Maintenir une visibilité sur les blocages, les dépendances, les approbations, les revues, les problèmes connus et les prochaines étapes.  
  • Coordonner les priorités entre les directeurs de discipline, les Product Owners, les producers, les leads de pods et les besoins du pilier.  
  • Soutenir les revues d’assets, les sessions de feedback, les approbations et les actions de suivi.  
  • Identifier les risques, les blocages ou les conflits de priorités et les escalader auprès des producers ou de la direction de production.  
  • Faciliter la communication entre les équipes design, ingénierie, art, animation, audio, QA et autres départements.  
  • Contribuer au maintien des outils de suivi de production tels que Jira, Confluence ou des outils similaires.  
  • Collaborer avec les équipes QA et de développement afin de garantir que les problèmes liés aux assets sont correctement suivis et traités.  
  • Soutenir la préparation des jalons en veillant à ce que les livrables d’assets, les dépendances, les revues et les problèmes connus soient clairement suivis.  
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des flux de travail des assets, des pipelines, des pratiques de suivi et des modes de communication.  
  • Participer aux rétrospectives ou aux revues post-jalons et assurer le suivi des améliorations identifiées. 

Basic Requirements: 

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in game production, asset coordination, project coordination, external development coordination, or related production roles.  
  • Experience supporting content teams, asset production, or a related production role for a specific discipline. 
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.  
  • Ability to track multiple assets, tasks, dependencies, priorities, and deadlines.  
  • Strong communication and follow-up skills.  
  • Comfortable working with creative and technical teams across multiple disciplines.  
  • Ability to clarify next steps, maintain visibility, and keep information organized.  
  • Proactive mindset with a willingness to solve problems and remove friction.  
  • Experience using JIRA or similar project management tools.  
  • Interest in AAA game development, asset production, and content pipelines.  
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing environment with professionalism and adaptability. 

Desired Characteristics:  

  • Experience with asset pipelines, review cycles, approvals, dependencies, and delivery tracking.  
  • Experience with production tracking, asset lists, delivery reporting, or milestone planning. 
  • Understanding of agile production, sprint planning, backlog tracking, or milestone execution.  
  • Experience working with craft directors, pod leads, artists, designers, engineers, or QA teams.  
  • Background in a creative production discipline.  
  • Experience with tools such as Confluence, Miro, Perforce, Git, or build tracking systems.  

Qualifications De Base:

  • Minimum de 5+ ans d’expérience en production de jeux, coordination d’assets, coordination de projet, coordination de développement externe ou dans des rôles de production similaires.  
  • Expérience en support d’équipes de contenu, en production d’assets ou dans un rôle de production associé à une discipline spécifique. 
  • Solides compétences organisationnelles et grande attention aux détails.  
  • Capacité à suivre plusieurs assets, tâches, dépendances, priorités et échéances simultanément.  
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en suivi.  
  • À l’aise pour travailler avec des équipes créatives et techniques à travers plusieurs disciplines.  
  • Capacité à clarifier les prochaines étapes, à maintenir la visibilité et à organiser efficacement l’information.  
  • Esprit proactif avec une volonté de résoudre les problèmes et de réduire les frictions.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Associate, Account Management supports the day-to-day management of key digital retail accounts, working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, operations, business intelligence, and other teams to drive transactional Film and TV revenue across digital distribution partners.

The Associate will help drive the business across new releases, catalog, pricing, promotions, and merchandising, while building strong partner relationships and providing responsive, detail-oriented account service. The role will support the development and execution of commercial initiatives, track business performance and identify opportunities and risks, and use data and marketplace insights to inform actionable recommendations.

The ideal candidate will combine strong organization and execution with commercial and analytical curiosity, proactively seeking to understand what is driving business performance, what actions can be taken, and how the team can continually improve the business and ways of working.

This position reports to the Sr. Director, Digital Platforms.

 

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a key day-to-day point of contact for account partners, providing best-in-class account service through prompt, proactive, thoughtful, and detail-oriented communication.
  • Help drive and maximize account performance across new releases, catalog, pricing, promotions, and merchandising by identifying opportunities and supporting the development and execution of commercial initiatives.
  • Manage ongoing priorities, timelines, and deliverables, proactively identifying risks and driving issues toward timely resolution.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to execute business and retailer priorities, ensuring effective coordination and alignment across stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key account partners, developing an understanding of their priorities, strategies, and business needs.
  • Track account and title performance against forecasts, plans, and historical benchmarks, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and areas requiring action.
  • Leverage partner sales data to understand what happened, identify key drivers and root causes, and translate findings into actionable insights, recommendations, and executive-ready reporting.
  • Support sales planning and forecasting and coordinate promotional initiatives, including managing and distributing relevant materials and deliverables to partners.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the transactional Film and TV business, including release windows, pricing, promotions, merchandising, retailer dynamics, competitive performance, and consumer behavior, and apply those learnings to account strategy and decision-making.
  • Collaborate with international counterparts on partner initiatives and share relevant business insights and learnings across markets.
  • Explore and leverage AI and other emerging tools to improve business processes, streamline workflows, enhance analysis, and support insight generation.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in media, entertainment, digital commerce, account management, sales, analytics, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.

 

Desired Characteristics:

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to take ownership, manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, and consistently follow through on commitments.
  • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills, with a commercially minded approach to account management and the confidence to engage effectively with external partners and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to identify key performance drivers, investigate root causes, and translate data into actionable recommendations and business decisions.
  • Intellectually curious, proactive, and resourceful, with a desire to understand how the business works, independently solve problems, and continually identify opportunities to improve and grow the business.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop and present clear, concise business updates, analyses, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience using Microsoft Copilot or similar AI tools.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, adapting to changing priorities, and proactively identifying and addressing issues with limited direction.
  • Willingness and enthusiasm to travel for partner meetings, business reviews, industry events, and relationship-building opportunities.

 

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV online to be considered.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program.
  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation.
  • Must be 18 years or older.

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company-sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $70,000 - $75,000.

About Us 

Universal Pictures Home Entertainment (UPHE) markets and distributes NBC Universal’s film and television offerings across transactional digital and disc formats worldwide. Distributed lines of content include contemporary and classic productions within the company’s expansive entertainment catalog, spanning properties from Universal Pictures, Focus Features, DreamWorks Animation, Illumination, Universal Television Studios and Peacock, as well as from select third-party partners. 

UPHE distributes through its own operations in parts of North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and South America and through a variety of licensee partnerships across major territories around the world. The Company is leading the way in exploring innovative technologies and in developing and adapting dynamic new windowing strategies and other initiatives for the evolving global home entertainment market. 

Its vast 4,000-plus title catalog is among the largest and most celebrated in the industry, comprising a wide variety of titles and genres. Among its most-prized properties are such franchise as The Fast and the Furious, Jurassic, Despicable Me, Minions, Mama Mia!, Downton Abbey, Shrek,  Back To The Future, Jaws, E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial and the legendary classic monster movies; recent films including Odyssey, Wicked, and The Super Mario Bros. Movie; as well as such acclaimed television series as the Chicago and Law & Order franchises and The Office. 

In addition, UPHE is committed to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) within its operations and content. As part of Universal Pictures, UPHE benefits from the company's comprehensive DE&I initiatives, which aim to create an inclusive environment both on-screen and behind the scenes.  

Global Business Operations – Release Planning

The Release Planning team helps ensure NBCUniversal’s Film & TV content is released accurately and on time across transactional digital platforms worldwide. The team manages global release schedules, licensing communication, and data accuracy, serving as a central resource for title-level information across the business. Working closely with commercial, operational, and technology teams, the team helps drive accurate execution, resolve issues, and maintain data integrity needed to support successful global content releases.

Who You’ll Work With 

  • An innovative team culture driven by impact, delivering meaningful outcomes globally. 
  • An over-performing yet culturally humble peer set that builds each other up, a WE mentality. 
  • Celebratory team that works hard and plays hard, holding each other accountable. #Together. 
  • A strength-based organization, where individual employee/manager collaborative growth conversations are valued. 

Responsibilities

Global Release Auditing

  • Serve as a primary operational resource for global release auditing across domestic and international markets. 
  • Conduct routine and exception-based audits to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and consistency. 
  • Maintain clear audit documentation, trackers, and reporting to support accountability and data governance. 

Cross-Functional Communication & Data Updates 

  • Partner with Release Planning, Release Operations, Licensing teams when audit findings require data confirmation, correction, or updates. 
  • Coordinate across teams to ensure updates are completed accurately and reflected in the appropriate source systems. 
  • Promote consistent data standards and auditing practices

Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Develop and maintain reporting that provides visibility into audit findings, data accuracy, issue status, and resolution trends. 
  • Analyze recurring discrepancies and system issues to identify opportunities for stronger controls, improved workflows, and automation. 
  • Provide reliable status updates on audit results, operational risks, and corrective actions.

  • 1+ years of experience in content operations, business systems, data analysis, quality assurance, or a related field. 
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Proven proficiency in Microsoft Excel, and experience working with operational data, trackers, or reporting tools. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, follow issues through resolution, and work effectively across global teams. 

Desired Characteristics 

  • Familiarity with data auditing, quality assurance, data governance, or exception management practices. 
  • Experience identifying, documenting, and coordinating the resolution of system-related issues. 
  • Comfort working with large datasets and investigating data anomalies.
  • True passion for working with data, leveraging analytics and numerical insights to solve complex problems, identify trends, and drive informed business decisions.

NBCUniversal is looking for a Post Production Billing Manager! The Post Production Billing Manager is a key member of the Finance team supporting Studio Operations Post Production business (aka StudioPost). In this position you will oversee day-to-day billing operations, ensures timely and accurate customer invoicing, manages billing-related systems and processes, and partners with operational teams to resolve billing issues. You will also supervise billing and payroll support staff and plays an important role in the month-end close process.

  • Serve as group billing lead managing all aspects of Sphere billing system

  • Respond to customer inquiries working closely with schedulers to resolve billing issues (SAP charge number, PO, invoice discrepancy) in a timely manner
  • Prepare and distribute recurring operational and financial revenue reports
  • Manage month-end close billing process notifying Schedulers and Billing Clerks of billing and accrual deadlines
  • Update and maintain services and rates in ScheduALL Sound subsystem
  • Provide documentation for internal and external audits
  • Support timekeeping and activities impacting Sphere deals

Let’s Talk About You…

  • Strategic Leader – You see the big picture and translate business objectives into scalable processes, controls, and service models that support Studio Post today and in the future.
  • Process Improvement Champion – You naturally identify inefficiencies, challenge outdated practices, and lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase accuracy, compliance, scalability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Data-Driven Decision Maker – You leverage financial, operational, and performance data to identify trends, assess risk, prioritize opportunities, and make informed recommendations.
  • Financial & Operational Acumen – You understand how operational decisions impact revenue, expenses, cash flow, customer satisfaction, and overall business performance, and you use that knowledge to drive better outcomes.
  • Tech-savvy – You are an MS Office whiz and can take on new software with ease
  • Communicates with ease – You have a way with words; written and verbal
  • Juggler – You know how to manage multiple tasks and priorities and move them all along effectively while keeping stakeholders updating and informed

What You Must Have:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

What Would Make You a Stand-out:

  • Entertainment or postproduction experience
  • B.S. degree in accounting or finance
  • Knowledge of SAP, ScheduALL, Sphere, Timekeeper
  • Demonstrated success leading process improvement, automation, standardization, and organizational change initiatives.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex business environments while balancing multiple priorities and driving results.
  • Collaborative leader with team-oriented approach to managing

job.title: Concepteur(trice) Technique Senior | Senior Technical Designer
job.description:
NBCUniversal est l’un des leaders mondiaux du secteur des médias et du divertissement. Nous créons des contenus d’exception, que nous diffusons à travers notre portefeuille de films, de programmes télévisés et de services de streaming, et que nous donnons vie grâce à nos parcs à thème internationaux, nos produits grand public et nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, les chaînes locales NBC, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de streaming premium financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des programmes de divertissement de premier ordre grâce à nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi qu’aux quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs à thème et des expériences de premier plan à travers le monde via Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment l’Universal Orlando Resort, qui abrite l’Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Rendez-vous sur www.nbcuniversal.com pour plus d’informations.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés dans lesquelles vivent et travaillent nos employés, nos clients et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement social et veillons à ce que nos employés aient la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous défendons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de former une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer un large éventail de contenus reflétant notre monde.

 

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

RESPONSIBILTÉS 
En tant que Concepteur(trice) Technique Senior, vous prendrez en charge des fonctionnalités de gameplay de leur conception jusqu’au niveau de finition final, en combinant de solides compétences en game design, du prototypage rapide et une certaine implémentation directement dans le moteur, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les programmeur(euse)s et les autres disciplines afin de livrer des expériences de jeu de haute qualité. 

 
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires afin de développer des systèmes de gameplay robustes, soutenir des interactions émergentes et établir des fondations propres et réutilisables capables d’évoluer tout au long de la production. 
 

  • Concevoir et implémenter des systèmes de gameplay majeurs, des mécaniques et des fonctionnalités interactives.  

  • Prototyper rapidement des concepts de gameplay à l’aide de Blueprint et d’outils techniques.  

  • Concevoir des systèmes de gameplay scalables et modulaires soutenant le développement à long terme.  

  • Développer des mécaniques systémiques et de monde ouvert favorisant le gameplay émergent et la créativité des joueurs.  

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de programmation, d’art, d’animation, UX et de production afin de livrer des fonctionnalités de gameplay de haute qualité.  

  • Implémenter et optimiser des systèmes de gameplay à l’aide de technologies telles que les State Trees, comportements IA, systèmes d’interaction et architectures événementielles.  

  • Faire évoluer les fonctionnalités à travers les tests utilisateurs, la télémétrie et les retours des joueurs.  

  • Encadrer d’autres designers en promouvant de solides pratiques d’implémentation, une forte pensée systémique et des approches efficaces de résolution de problèmes.  

  • Contribuer à la documentation de gameplay, aux spécifications techniques et aux guides de design.  

  • Identifier rapidement les risques de production et les risques techniques, puis proposer des solutions pratiques et scalables.  

  • Promouvoir des implémentations propres et maintenables favorisant l’extensibilité et la collaboration interdisciplinaire. 

 

RESPONSIBILTIES 

As a Senior Technical Designer, you own gameplay features from concept to polish, combining strong game design skills, rapid prototyping, and some in-engine implementation while collaborating closely with engineers and other disciplines to deliver polished player experiences. 

You’ll work closely with multidisciplinary teams to develop robust gameplay systems, support emergent interactions, and establish clean, reusable foundations that can evolve throughout production. 
 

  • Own the design and implementation of major gameplay systems, mechanics, and interactive features.  

  • Prototype gameplay concepts rapidly using Blueprint scripting and technical tools.  

  • Design scalable and modular gameplay systems that support long-term development.  

  • Develop systemic and open-world mechanics that encourage emergent gameplay and player creativity.  

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, art, animation, UX, and production teams to deliver high-quality gameplay features.  

  • Implement and optimize gameplay systems using technologies such as State Trees, AI behaviors, interaction systems, and event-driven frameworks.  

  • Drive iteration through playtesting, telemetry, and player feedback.  

  • Mentor other designers by promoting strong implementation practices, systems thinking, and problem-solving.  

  • Contribute to gameplay documentation, technical specifications, and design guidelines.  

  • Identify production and technical risks early and propose practical, scalable solutions.  

  • Advocate for clean, maintainable implementations that support extensibility and cross-disciplinary collaboration. 
     

 

QUALIFICATIONS 

Exigences de base :  

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience pertinente 

  • Solide expérience dans la conception et l’implémentation de systèmes de gameplay dans Unreal Engine 5+ à l’aide de Blueprint. 

  • Excellente compréhension des principes de game design, incluant le design systémique, le feedback joueur, l’utilisabilité, le rythme et le game feel. 

  • Capacité démontrée à mener une fonctionnalité depuis le concept jusqu’au prototype, à l’implémentation, l’itération et la finition. 

  • Bonne compréhension des pratiques de performance dans les jeux 3D modernes, incluant le streaming, le culling, la scalabilité et les bonnes pratiques de scripting conscientes des coûts CPU. 

  • Compréhension des pratiques d’implémentation orientées performance, incluant l’évitement de logique inutile exécutée à chaque frame, la réduction des surcoûts systémiques et la conception de fonctionnalités pensées pour la scalabilité. 

  • Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et aisance dans le débogage de comportements de gameplay et de flux de travail techniques. 

  • Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires. 

  • Expérience sur au moins un jeu commercialisé ou une fonctionnalité majeure développée dans un environnement professionnel. 

  • Capacité à encadrer et soutenir d’autres designers. 

Atouts recherchés :  

  • Expérience avec d’autres langages de scripting ou de programmation que Blueprint, tels que Lua, C# ou Python.  

  • Expérience avec les systèmes d’IA, State Trees, behavior trees, navigation ou gameplay systémique.  

  • Familiarité avec le profilage de performance et l’optimisation dans des environnements de grande échelle ou en monde ouvert.  

  • Expérience avec des systèmes multijoueur ou des systèmes de gameplay sensibles aux contraintes réseau.  

  • Expérience dans la création d’outils personnalisés, d’utilitaires éditeur ou de workflows pour designers.  

  • Familiarité avec les systèmes de gameplay data-driven, les workflows procéduraux ou les pipelines de jeux live-service.  

  • Compréhension des workflows UX/UI et du design d’interactions orientées joueur. 

 

QUALIFICATIONS 

Basic Requirements:  

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience 

  • Strong experience designing and implementing gameplay systems in Unreal Engine 5+ using Blueprint scripting.  

  • Strong understanding of game design principles, including systems design, player feedback, usability, pacing, and game feel.  

  • Proven ability to take features from concept through prototype, implementation, iteration, and polish.  

  • Strong understanding of gameplay performance practices in modern 3D games, including streaming, culling, scalability, and CPU-conscious scripting practices.  

  • Understanding of performance-aware gameplay implementation, including avoiding unnecessary per-frame logic, reducing systemic overhead, and designing features with scalability in mind.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort debugging gameplay behaviors and technical workflows.  

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across multidisciplinary teams.  

  • Experience shipping at least one game or major gameplay feature in a professional environment.  

  • Ability to mentor and support other designers. 

Desired Characteristics:  

  • Experience with other scripting/programming language other than Blueprint like Lua, C#, Python. 

  • Experience with AI systems, state trees, behavior trees, navigation, or systemic gameplay.  

  • Familiarity with performance profiling and optimization in large-scale or open-world environments.  

  • Experience with multiplayer or network-aware gameplay systems.  

  • Experience building custom tools, editor utilities, or designer workflows.  

  • Familiarity with data-driven gameplay systems, procedural workflows, or live-service pipelines.  

  • Understanding of UX/UI workflows and player-facing interaction design.
