job.title: Concepteur(trice) UX&UI Senior | Senior UI & UX Technical Designer
job.description:
NBCUniversal est l’un des leaders mondiaux du secteur des médias et du divertissement. Nous créons des contenus d’exception, que nous diffusons à travers notre portefeuille de films, de programmes télévisés et de services de streaming, et que nous donnons vie grâce à nos parcs à thème internationaux, nos produits grand public et nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, les chaînes locales NBC, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de streaming premium financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des programmes de divertissement de premier ordre grâce à nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi qu’aux quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs à thème et des expériences de premier plan à travers le monde via Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment l’Universal Orlando Resort, qui abrite l’Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Rendez-vous sur www.nbcuniversal.com pour plus d’informations.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés dans lesquelles vivent et travaillent nos employés, nos clients et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement social et veillons à ce que nos employés aient la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous défendons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de former une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer un large éventail de contenus reflétant notre monde.

 

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

RESPONSIBILTÉS

En tant que Concepteur(trice) UX&UI Senior, vous concevrez des interfaces utilisateur élégantes et centrées sur le joueur. Ce rôle combine la réflexion UX et l’esthétique UI. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’établissement des fondations des systèmes UI qui évolueront avec le projet et l’équipe.
 

  • Concevoir des maquettes UX, des parcours utilisateur et des mises en page interactives à l’aide de Figma.
  • Créer une direction visuelle UI avec des guides de style et des maquettes.
  • Collaborer avec les concepteurs, les ingénieurs et les artistes pour intégrer des fonctionnalités UX&UI alignées sur les objectifs de gameplay et de narration.
  • Soutenir l’intégration et le mentorat des futurs concepteurs UX&UI.
  • Maintenir une forte attention à la convivialité, à l’accessibilité et à la réactivité tout au long du processus de développement.
  • Assimiler des concepts complexes et les simplifier en une expérience utilisateur intuitive et facile à découvrir.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Senior UX&UI Designer, you’ll lead the design of elegant and player-focused user interfaces. This role blends UX thinking and UI aesthetics. You’ll be instrumental in establishing the foundations for the UI systems that will scale with the project and the team.

  • Design UX wireframes, player flows, and interactive layouts using Figma
  • Create UI visual direction together with style guides and mockups
  • Collaborate with designers, engineers, and artists to integrate UX&UI features that align with gameplay and narrative goals
  • Support onboarding and mentorship of future UX&UI designers
  • Maintain a strong focus on usability, accessibility, and responsiveness throughout the development process
  • Ingest complex concept ideas and simplify it to a discoverable and intuitive user experience

QUALIFICATIONS

Exigences de base : 

  • Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en développement de jeux, avec une forte spécialisation en conception UX&UI.
  • Maîtrise de Figma pour créer des maquettes de mises en page, de parcours et d’interactions.
  • Capacité démontrée à concevoir des maquettes artistiques UI et à créer des guides de style.
  • Maîtrise des principes d’utilisabilité et des normes d’accessibilité.
  • Aider à établir des lignes directrices et des standards pour le langage visuel au sein des produits et entre les lignes de produits.

Atouts recherchés : 

  • Familiarité avec Unreal Engine 5+ et ses systèmes Blueprints et UMG.
  • Expérience en leadership ou en mentorat d’équipes de conception UX&UI.
  • Familiarité avec l’animation UI et l’éditeur de matériaux.
  • Connaissance des pipelines de localisation, des systèmes de mappage de contrôleurs et des exigences de certification des plateformes.
  • Expérience dans la livraison d’interfaces UI sur plateformes PC et console.
  • Familiarité avec la recherche utilisateur, les entrevues et les tests utilisateurs.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

Basic Requirements: 

  • 5+ years of experience in game development, with a strong focus on UX&UI design and implementation.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma to build wireframes of layouts, flows and interactions.
  • Demonstrated ability to mockup UI art and create style guides.
  • Proficiency with usability principles and accessibility standards.
  • Help establish guidelines and standards for visual language within and across product lines.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Experience leading or mentoring UX&UI design teams.
  • Familiarity with motion design, UI animation, and material editor.
  • Exposure to localization pipelines, input mapping systems, and platform certification requirements
  • Experience shipping UI across both PC and console platforms.
  • Familiarity with user research, interviews and playtesting.
  • Familiarity with Unreal Engine 5+ and its Blueprint and UMG system.

Join our NBCUniversal EPIC Legal Team! EPIC symbolizes key foundational principles as we strive to be extraordinary partners to our businesses in an evolving environment. Here at NBCU Legal, we are Expert Partners who provide Inspiring and Creative solutions to our clients. We are subject-matter experts who collaborate with our legal colleagues and clients to guide, solve and push for our collective success. We inspire by bringing optimism and positivity to our work, and apply strategic and innovative thinking to support our businesses.

NBCUniversal is looking for a detail-oriented, highly organized, and highly efficient individual to support its Advertising Partnerships & Marketing Legal teams (with attorney oversight as necessary). The ideal candidate will have experience providing contract support for advertising sales and/or marketing initiatives and partnering with business teams on the creation and execution of innovative content, sponsorships, and promotional campaigns. 

Here you can:

  • Draft, review, revise, and negotiate clearance agreements, location agreements, vendor agreements, equipment rental agreements, non-disclosure agreements, venue agreements, SOWs, promotions documents for contests/sweepstakes, and other contracts
  • Provide timely and thoughtful advice on potential risks and issues
  • Research and evaluate production issues
  • Process and upload contracts and correspondence into group files and databases
  • Participate in task forces to evaluate and establish new procedures to streamline workflow and enhance department productivity
  • Coordinate with team on additional projects and priorities

Here you'll need:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree and 2+ years of experience, or a Juris Doctor Degree

What we'll look for:

  • Solid communication and organizational skills
  • Demonstrated proficiency with computer applications, such as Adobe Acrobat, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Proven ability to exercise sound judgment and to work independently, as well as collaboratively, with all levels of company personnel and with outside parties
  • Capability to process and analyze complex information, and utilize problem-solving skills
  • Willingness to work late and on weekends on short notice, if necessary
  • Experience drafting production agreements and/or handling production-related legal issues
  • Sound business judgment and flexibility/adaptability to manage multiple time-sensitive matters, including appropriately prioritizing among them
  • Paralegal or comparable experience
  • Basic understanding of legal terms and conditions relevant to the entertainment industry
  • Ability to maintain a positive attitude and flexibility in a fast-paced, corporate business environment
  • Spanish-speaking skills highly desired, including skill in reviewing contracts involving Spanish-speaking parties, the ability to understand and interpret complex legal language in Spanish contracts, and conduct professional communications in Spanish.

This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the Universal City, CA office four days per week.

Summary:

The Fashion & Living and FBC Coordinator supports the day-to-day management of licensees across assigned categories, including licensee coordination, category projects, marketing approvals, onboarding, and the quarterly forecasting process. The coordinator serves as a brand champion and ambassador for assigned properties and categories, demonstrating strong attention to brand integrity and stewardship while proactively coordinating with licensees and internal partners.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $55,120 - $63,440

Responsibilities include:

  • Supports the Category team with the day-to-day coordination and proactive follow-up of Fashion & Living/FBC licensees, including development projects, placement reporting, licensee information requests, visual line plans, and retail and prospective licensee outreach.
  • Provides operational support to the Fashion & Living/FBC team, including scheduling and coordinating team needs and confirming visitor passes.
  • Supports the contract management process by entering deal information into internal systems, confirming required information with licensees, tracking outstanding items, and coordinating with Category, Franchise, Legal, Finance, and Compliance partners through execution.
  • Assists in developing business review presentations, licensee contract summaries, and other category materials.
  • Supports and facilitates brand pitch presentations to prospective and existing licensees. Coordinates pitch follow-up, including proposal documents, sales materials, and other requested information. May occasionally lead portions of presentations with guidance from the Category team.
  • Attends internal Retail, Product Development, and other cross-functional meetings to track projects, development requests, deliverables, and follow-up items.
  • Coordinates the delivery of assets, materials, and key information to existing and prospective partners and follows up to ensure requests are completed in a timely manner.
  • Maintains placement materials and supports the development of visual line plan decks and other category materials. Collects and organizes licensee data, including SKU, ASIN, sell-in, placement, and other requested information, and follows up with licensees to ensure required information is provided to the Analytics team.
  • Maintains accurate and up-to-date licensee contact lists and related information for Category and Retail teams across assigned brands.
  • Supports the Category team during the quarterly forecast process, including communicating with licensees, tracking submissions, following up on missing information, and troubleshooting routine forecast entry issues to support accurate and timely reporting.
  • Coordinates the internal routing of licensee marketing materials for approval across Brand, Legal, PR, Franchise, and other partners. Creates and maintains approval trackers and proactively follows up on outstanding approvals.
  • Serves as the primary coordinator for marketing approvals through the online submissions system, monitoring submissions, tracking status, and communicating follow-up needs to the appropriate teams.
  • Serves as a key point of contact for new licensee onboarding, coordinating asset releases, system access, introductory meetings, and walkthroughs of the licensee hub and related resources.
  • Perform other related duties assigned to support the needs of the team.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in a highly visible sales function within one of the following industries – Entertainment, Licensing, Consumer Products, Retail, Apparel/Home.
  • Technical skills: Strong MAC skills including Keynote. Office essentials including Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Salesforce, Photoshop or Illustrator experience is a plus.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, strong time management skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with key attention to detail and ability to work independently.
  • Driven and goal oriented – ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial and fast-paced environment.
  • Able to multi-task and meet multiple deadlines and manage across multiple team members. 
  • Strong relationship building skills, flexible and adaptable; able to collaborate and be a team player.
  • Strong willingness to learn, a team player and good listener. Self-starter; problem solver.
  • Pro-active, forward thinking.
  • Flexible/ability to adjust to changing business environment.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Resourceful team player with high energy and a passion for product, entertainment, trends, fashion, culture, and marketing.
  • Comfortable dealing with people at all levels to develop and maintain relationships.
  • Ability to collaborate, take initiative, problem-solve, and have follow-through, and work independently.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. NBCUniversal’s Corporate Events Department produces high impact experiences for clients and C-suite executives across some of the most recognized brands in media and entertainment – from marquee tentpole events and events that support corporate initiatives, to brand activations and large-scale client programs.

The Corporate Events Coordinator will serve as a key point of contact for VIP hospitality, interfacing directly with clients and C-Suite executives. This role will support the Corporate Events team in planning client and internal events ranging from intimate dinners to large-scale programs. The role will also encompass a range of administrative functions that support the department’s SVP, and the team’s day-to-day operations. A strong command of registration platforms and a strong focus on guest communications are essential to this position. This position reports to a Manager in the Corporate Events Department.

 

Job Duties

Event Support

  • Serve as the primary guest communication liaison with event attendees: coordinating travel arrangements, answering attendee questions, troubleshooting event registration issues
  • Manage event invitation/RSVP process and maintain guests lists across multiple simultaneous events
  • Assist in the production of digital and print event collateral
  • Conduct research for upcoming events: venues, hotels, activities, transportation companies, gifting, merchandise, etc.
  • Serve as additional on-site support for local NYC events, and travel to events outside NYC as needed
  • Track extensive list of domestic and international shipments for events; liaise with FedEx and other couriers to resolve delivery issues
  • Help coordinate team shipping of supplies and materials for upcoming events, including unpacking and restocking upon return

 

Administrative Support (SVP and Department)

  • Provide administrative support to the SVP - including calendar management, travel arrangements and corporate card/p-card reconciliation
  • Oversee team’s p-card for event air travel, reviewing and approving all team members’ individual p-card charges
  • Set up new vendors in company’s financial database and submit invoices for wire/check payments
  • Manage department’s events calendar and team travel/PTO schedules
  • Manage the inventory and use of iPads/iPods for events, and keep Spotify playlists current
  • Organize and maintain department closets and event supply inventory
  • Restock office supplies on an ongoing basis, or when team members request: printer ink, FedEx shipping supplies, name place cards, etc.
  • Assist with onboarding new team members: equipment ordering and setup, providing access to all necessary NBCU portals and websites
  • Train and help mentor the Corporate Events Page(s)

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or related work experience
  • 0-2 years of experience in events, hospitality, entertainment or related field

Desired Characteristics:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented, and detail-oriented
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where priorities can shift quickly
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines
  • Reliable and flexible team player
  • Proficient in Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint and registration platforms
  • Experience booking both hybrid and virtual meetings on Microsoft Teams
  • Stays current on trends across food and beverage, hospitality, premiums, restaurants, entertainment, sports, etc.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY
  • Must be willing to travel up to 40%
  • Must be able to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays based on event schedule

This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $55,000 - $66,000

job.description:

The Coordinator, Publicity will support the Global Publicity team by managing department billing, invoicing, budget tracking, vendor coordination, and operational processes across film publicity campaigns. This role serves as a key partner to publicists and cross-functional teams, ensuring timely processing of financial and administrative activities while supporting special projects, events, and team initiatives as needed.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced entertainment marketing environment.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Process and track invoices, purchase orders, vendor payments, expense reports, and budget reconciliations across multiple film campaigns and projects
  • Partner with Finance and external vendors to ensure timely payment processing and accurate financial records
  • Create purchase orders, onboard new vendors, maintain vendor documentation, and resolve billing discrepancies as needed
  • Manage departmental budget trackers and reporting documents, ensuring spending is accurately recorded and communicated to publicity leadership
  • Assist with preparing presentations, recaps, and other departmental materials
  • Support publicity events including premieres, screenings, junkets, press days, film festivals, and special projects as needed
  • Provide project support for department initiatives, events, and special projects as assigned

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in entertainment, media, marketing, publicity, finance, operations, or a related field
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook
  • Willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends in support of publicity events and special projects

Join our NBCUniversal EPIC Legal Team! EPIC symbolizes key foundational principles as we strive to be extraordinary partners to our businesses in an evolving environment. We are subject-matter experts who collaborate with our legal colleagues and clients to guide, solve and push for our collective success. We inspire by bringing optimism and positivity to our work, and apply strategic and innovative thinking to support our businesses. 

Role Purpose 

The Counsel, Ad Tech & Partnerships will report to the VP, Ad Tech & Partnerships and help support the development, distribution and monetization of data-driven advertising products and services.  This role primarily involves drafting and negotiating a variety of commercial agreements and counseling on complex and novel legal issues in a fast-paced environment and requires a self-starter with a curiosity and enthusiasm for learning about NBCU’s ad technology stack and staying current on developments in caselaw and regulations impacting the digital advertising industry.   

Here you can: 

  • Provide legal support across the Ad Sales division, including Identity and Data Collaboration, Data Measurement & Insights (DM&I), Sourcing, Sales Enablement, Programmatic, Strategy, Commerce, and Partnerships, on the development of new ad technologies, products, partnerships, and other Ad Sales initiatives. 

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including vendor contracts with research and measurement companies, data licensors, programmatic partners, and other ad tech vendors and platforms, as well as partnerships with social media, streaming, gaming and other ad-supported digital platforms. 

  • Partner with the Privacy and Information Security teams to advise on data privacy considerations in advertising deals and initiatives, and ensure personal data and confidential information is collected, used, and secured in accordance with privacy laws and company requirements. 

  • Lead team initiatives, such as scaling and optimizing use of AI in the team’s workflows, improving the contract intake and tracking process, updating contract templates, supporting corporate transactions, and coordinating information for compliance reviews.  

  • Work collaboratively with stakeholders teams across legal and business functions, and propose practical, responsive solutions. 

  • Stay updated and counsel clients on the latest developments in the legal and regulatory framework impacting digital advertising, including data privacy and technology-related laws.

Here you'll need:

  • JD from an accredited law school and member of a state bar in good standing 

  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience at a law firm and/or in-house legal department  

  • Experience drafting and negotiating master service agreements, software-as-a-service agreements, licenses, amendments, SOWs, renewals, and other technology agreements, as well as data privacy and security terms.  

What we'll look for:

  • Solid contract drafting and negotiating skills 

  • Ability to work independently and escalate matters appropriately to senior members of the team 

  • Organized, detail oriented and able to multitask and re-prioritize work to meet deadlines  

  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex legal concepts, build consensus, think creatively, problem-solve pragmatically, communicate clearly and collaborate with clients to address evolving business needs 

  • Familiarity with U.S. data privacy laws 

  • Familiarity with the digital advertising ecosystem 

  • Passion for technology and proven ability to adapt, learn new skills, and develop new expertise as business needs evolve 

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the New York, NY office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

The NBCUniversal State & Local Government Affairs team develops and executes advocacy strategies that advance NBCUniversal’s business priorities and protect the company’s operations at the state and local levels. The team engages directly with state and local elected officials and manages relationships with trade associations and other third-party organizations to build support for NBCUniversal’s public policy agenda. This Director position will report directly to the Senior Vice President, Head of Public Policy with matrix reporting to Vice President of Government and External Affairs.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with policymakers, industry associations, community organizations, business groups and other key stakeholders in Los Angeles County and the City of Los Angeles.

  • Partner with internal stakeholders across NBCUniversal, including Legal, Compliance Communications, and relevant business units, to assess policy impacts, and to develop advocacy strategies for advancing business objectives.

  • Draft letters, presentations, testimony, and other materials communicating the company’s positions on legislative and regulatory matters.
  • Stay informed about industry developments, emerging state and local policy issues, and evolving regulatory frameworks.
  • Advise senior leadership on emerging legislative, regulatory, and political developments, providing strategic recommendations regarding potential risks, opportunities, and business impacts

The Global Security Operations team at NBCU seeks an energetic and enthusiastic safety and security specialist to support the daily work of NBCUs New’s teams across the U.S. This individual will be an integral part of a News Security team committed to delivering holistic support at a standard of excellence for all News personnel and newsgathering activities across the company.  

The Director, Security for NBCU will have oversight of security logistics and physical security operations for NBCU News personnel and spaces, including the planning and execution phases of all remote operations. This individual reports directly to the Senior Director of News Security, as part of the Global Security Operations team, working across all News properties.* This individual will manage vendor relationships and ensure the necessary resources, policies, processes, and plans are in place to protect the company’s employees, operations, physical property, and intellectual property. This position will deploy extensively with News personnel and will be based out of New York City. 

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

  • Work directly with News producers, camera operators, senior executives, talent and local staff on all aspects of the planning and execution of security logistics and operations, including, but not limited to, the planning and execution phase of all news remotes; this includes assessing security needs, securing appropriate vendors, traveling to remotes when required, and conducting post-mortems to identify lessons learned and opportunities for improvement.  
  • Assist in the management and coordination of News Security responses to dynamic and large-scale news stories, including coordinating across the team, and supporting a follow-the-sun model when appropriate.  Collaborate and coordinate across the News Security team to ensure a consistent and holistic approach to safety and security. 
  • Collaborate with the News Security team to stablish security guidelines and training requirements for News employees; coordinate all necessary security-related training, either as the training facilitator or as a direct liaison with contracted training vendors.  
  • Manage confidential and or sensitive information, and professionally, thoughtfully and sensitively provide support or guidance to News personnel and or management who might be navigating high-stress or emotionally difficult situations.  
  • Work Closely with the Global Security Operations and the NBCU Cyber Security team to coordinate and advise on News security needs and develop a regular communication rhythm with the NBCU Global Response & Intelligence Center (GRIC) team. Track news deployments and document and report incidents for data gathering and record-keeping purposes, and to facilitate regular monitoring, evaluation and learning to ensure industry-leading support.  
  • Assist appropriate News management (HR, Legal, etc.) with investigations when appropriate. Play an active role in representing the Security Department with Business Continuity and Crisis Management teams.  
  • Develop and maintain meaningful business relationships with Local and National law enforcement, government emergency response agencies, other news organizations, and other potential safety partners. Direct personal protection support for News senior executives and talent as needed.  
  • Provide guidance on the design, development, assessment, and effectiveness of company security policies, as well as training, tools, and resources related to newsgathering safety (e.g. PPE, specialist training, etc.).  
  • Develop, plan and execute against continued process optimization and quality improvement initiatives, focused on improving functions, quality, and costs including performance vs. best practice initiatives.  
  • Oversee vendors, including contracts, budgets, and invoice processing, and implement security action plans for News teams; coordinate all security vendors who operate remotely for News and ensure that standard operating procedures are fit for purpose, up to date, and adhered to.

Qualifications and Requirements  

  • Significant professional experience in media or news security, corporate security, military, law enforcement or similar.  
  • Experience managing budgets and stakeholder management, including working with external vendors.  
  • Experience with general security concepts and methods such as deployment planning, vulnerability assessments, privacy assessments, intrusion detection, incident response, and security policy creation. 
  • Must be willing to be on-call and available 24/7 for emergencies. 
  • Must be willing to travel, as needed, at times on short notice. 

Desired Characteristics  

  • Security experience in the field of News or Media safety or security. HEFAT experience is strongly preferred. 
  • Strong knowledge of trends and emerging threats to journalists and media organizations, particularly in the U.S.   
  • Self-starter, who leads with integrity, with strong attention to detail and time management skills.  
  • A team player with the ability to work collaboratively as part of a disbursed team. 
  • Experience working with senior level executives and/or high-profile talent, particularly related to security.  
  • Experience establishing and implementing departmental strategy as well as managing short and long-term projects. Ability to coordinate multiple projects, responsibilities, and deadlines concurrently. 
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, often with limited information.  
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred. 

Additional Information 

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. The Director, Software Engineering leads the Legal Engineering delivery pillar within our Legal, Privacy & Compliance Engineering organization. This is a build-and-lead role: you will own a portfolio that blends enterprise SaaS platforms with bespoke software and lead the engineering of the interoperability layer and differentiated custom applications that make the whole ecosystem greater than its parts. 

This role requires both deep technical and leadership with business acumen in the corporate legal space.  This leader will own the end-to-end delivery of legal technical solutions that enable capabilities across jurisdictions, partners directly with Product Management, Legal, and Cyber.  This role will be responsible for hiring, retaining, and continuously assessing the health and growth of the legal engineering team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Engineering Leadership & Delivery
    • Leads a team of engineering managers, staff software engineers, and architects), plus contractors and interns
    • Own engineering delivery, technical health, reliability, and quality across the legal technology portfolio — SaaS platforms, custom applications, integrations, and data flows
    • Drive engineering excellence: architecture reviews, code quality, CI/CD, automated testing, and operational readiness
    • Steer programs at the right altitude — owning key decisions, pro-active escalations, and delivery health in partnership with our Technical Program Management and Product Management functions
    • Establish and uphold software quality, legal architecture and engineering standards, and NBCU cyber guidelines
    • Drive delivery across multiple complex concurrent programs/projects
    • Partner with Principal architect, scrum lead, product owner, and technical project manager to ensure standards and stakeholder visibility
  • Platform Ownership
    • Provide technical leadership across contract lifecycle management, legal document management, eBilling, intellectual property management, and eDiscovery/legal hold capabilities
    • Lead the strategy and engineering for interoperability between SaaS platforms and bespoke software — APIs, data integration, workflow orchestration, and shared services
    • Ensure solutions meet enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and data governance standards
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Influence
    • Serve as the senior technical voice for Legal engineering
    • Communicate program status, risk exposure, and engineering trade-offs to SVPs, VPs and Directors in a clear and business relevant terms
    • Represent the organization in regulatory discussions, 3rd party audits, and external partner engagements as needed
    • Build a deep, strategic partnership with our Product organization — embedded in roadmap conversations, contributing engineering perspective to business process design in way of shift left mindset
    • Engage directly with Legal department and Legal Operations leaders; translate their operational needs into reliable, scalable and secure engineering solutions
    • Partner with our Principal Architect on technical standards fit for purpose design principles and with Cyber on secure integration practices while securing the perimeter protecting the brand, consumer’s rights, and data
  • System Reliability & Performance: Proactively manage reliability and performance of all systems to ensure they meet global business needs. Partner closely with SaaS providers and internal teams to maintain system health and performance. 
  • Defect & Enhancement Management: Manage the defect management process from identification to resolution. Manage the delivery of enhancements that improve user experience and system efficiency.

Focus on implementing minor enhancements or process changes to prevent future issues.  Manage the end-to-end response to major incidents impacting Legal business processes.  Manage RCA sessions and ensure timely executive – level communications.  Reduce “noise” in the system by analyzing ticket trends and automating routine fixes.

  • People Leadership

    • Grow your leaders through honest feedback, career development, and intentional coaching

NBCUniversal has an opportunity for a talented individual to join their dynamic Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Operations & Technology Team working in close partnership with the Global Security Operations and Business Continuity & Crisis Management teams. The purpose of this position is to support overall EHS program implementation with an emphasis on West Coast Studio Operations, Universal City Studios.  The successful candidate will work with management teams, Universal City facility, Universal Studios Hollywood, and support domestic operations, as assigned.

The ideal candidate must have strong technical knowledge, self-motivation qualities and excellent interpersonal skills, and be able to influence teams to ensure compliance with all NBCUniversal, federal, state, and local environmental, occupational safety and health policies, rules and regulations as applicable.

Responsibilities

  • Provide EHS-related support for the West Coast Studio Operations locations.
  • Conduct inspections and hazardous materials determinations, recommend updates or improvements to operations, identify trend changes based on gathered data, with a focus on environmental endpoints, and maintain government database information as assigned.  
  • Perform incident investigation and root cause analysis.
  • Perform health risk assessments of selected operations.
  • Manage consultants to perform health risk assessments, program development, and conduct indoor air quality (IAQ) investigations.
  • Manage and maintain site chemical inventory.  
  • Approve chemicals for use in the studio lot.
  • Conduct health and safety program audits.
  • Respond to incidents and complaints regarding chemicals, indoor air quality, mold, noise and radiation.
  • Develop programs for technical EHS areas.
  • Advise, direct and instruct personnel on correct implementation of technical EHS requirements.
  • Perform health and safety inspections.
  • Provide weekly and monthly metrics.
  • Perform training as needed.
  • Interact and provide guidance to tenants and non-employees.
  • Participate in Safety Team meetings including developing content and presenting.
  • Answer and respond to Safety Hotline concerns.  Respond to emergencies during work and off hours.
  • Manages day-to-day use of internal electronic systems (Gensuite) and ensures that all tasks, inspections, action items, etc. are properly tracked/documented and actions closed in a timely manner.
  • Analyze EHS Data for insights on how to support performance improvement and to effectively improve processes with minimal direction and information. 
  • Conduct investigations of incidents, significant events and emergencies promptly in accordance with company policies and/or applicable laws and regulations.
  • Assist operations with preparation and coordination of regularly scheduled audits and reviews from both internal and external inspections.  Meet deadlines on any action items/MAPs resulting from audit and provide documentation supporting resolution.
  • Coordinate and accompany outside regulatory agency regulators or inspectors that visit the operations as assigned, e.g., Los Angeles County CUPA, Los Angeles City CUPA. 

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in safety, occupational health or related discipline, or equivalent work experience 
  • Minimum one (1) year experience in the Environmental Health and Safety field or the television and/or live entertainment industry
  • Experience with EHS technical programs.
  • Working knowledge of US EPA, US OSHA, and US DOT regulations.
  • Must have ability to manage multiple priorities and drive implementation of key EHS initiatives.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and associated tools.
  • Excellent verbal, written skills and presentation skills and detail oriented.
  • Willing to travel up to 10% of the time.
  • Must be able to work outdoors with varied weather conditions.
  • Ability to lift / carry items weighing up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to stand / walk a minimum of four (4) hours per day.
  • Ability to work with a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to work at heights.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Position requires the individual to travel domestically and internationally.
  • Ability to work extended hours, on weekday nights, and on weekends as needed.

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively with all levels of the organization.
  • Detail-oriented, strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to take initiative.
  • Must possess time management skills and the ability to meet deadlines.

ABOUT UNIVERSAL TELEVISION (UTV)  
Universal Television (UTV), a division of Universal Studio Group, is one of the largest and most successful television studios in the world. Led by President Erin Underhill, the studio is known for programming with broad appeal and cultural relevance. UTV currently produces over 40 primetime comedies and dramas across broadcast, cable, and streaming platforms. Home to commercial hits such as Dick Wolf's enormously successful “Law & Order,” “One Chicago” and “FBI”-branded series, UTV also produces celebrated premium series including the Emmy® Award-winning “Hacks” and “The Gilded Age,” fan favorites “St. Denis Medical,” “Loot,” “A Man on the Inside” and “The Four Seasons,” as well as cultural phenomena “Bel-Air,” “Never Have I Ever” and “The Best Man: The Final Chapters.” UTV’s library comprises some of the greatest contemporary shows in television history, including “The Office,” “Parks and Recreation,” “The Good Place,” “Will & Grace,” “Friday Night Lights,” “New Amsterdam” and more.

The Entertainment Coordinator will provide administrative support to two Drama Development executives within the Universal Television Studio organization, and serve as office liaison communicating with internal NBCU divisions as well as the external business and creative community.

À propos de NBCUniversal 

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises mondiales de médias et de divertissement.  

Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial, que nous distribuons à travers notre portefeuille de cinéma, de télévision et de diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre par le biais de nos destinations de parcs thématiques mondiaux, de nos produits de consommation et de nos expériences.  

Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de divertissement et d’information de premier plan, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité.  

Nous produisons et distribuons des œuvres cinématographiques et des contenus télévisuels de premier plan grâce à nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi qu’aux quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de calibre industriel à travers le monde par l’entremise de Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, domicile de Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood.  

NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation.  

Visitez https://www.nbcuniversal.com pour plus d’information.  

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés dans lesquelles nos employé·e·s, nos client·e·s et nos publics vivent et travaillent.  

Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que nos employé·e·s aient l’occasion de servir leurs communautés.  

Nous défendons une culture inclusive et nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de diffuser une vaste gamme de contenus reflétant la diversité de notre monde.  

NBCUniversal is seeking a Lead Artist (Props) to own and drive prop production quality and pipelines for an ambitious interactive entertainment project. This role is responsible for overseeing the creation and implementation of props across the project, ensuring consistency, scalability, and high visual fidelity across a wide range of content including city dressing, interiors, vehicles, and user-generated content (UGC). 

Reporting to the Associate Art Director – World, the Lead Artist (Props) will work closely with Environment, Technical Art, and cross-functional teams to ensure that prop production supports both artistic vision and production requirements. The role involves leading and managing a team of prop artists while establishing pipelines, workflows, and scalable solutions, and acting as a key bridge between internal teams and external development partners to ensure aligned production from high-end to mobile. 

Responsibilities 

  • Translate artistic direction into high-quality prop assets across diverse categories including city dressing, interiors, vehicles, and UGC. 

  • Drive the development and production of prop assets supporting large-scale world building and environmental storytelling. 

  • Lead and manage the prop art team, providing mentorship, feedback, and direction. 

  • Define, maintain, and evolve pipelines and workflows for prop production with a focus on scalability and consistency. 

  • Ensure consistency and quality across all prop assets and integration within environments. 

  • Collaborate closely with Environment, Lighting, Tech Art, and Production teams for proper implementation. 

  • Ensure prop creation workflows meet both artistic goals and technical constraints. 

  • Act as a bridge between internal teams and external development partners, aligning production standards and expectations. 

  • Optimize asset production pipelines for efficiency and scalability from high-end to mobile platforms. 

  • Support production planning, milestone readiness, and continuous pipeline improvements. 

  • Maintain visibility on quality, risks, and production challenges across prop content. 

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste Chef.fe d’équipe Artiste (Props)  afin d’assurer la responsabilité et l’orientation de la qualité de production des accessoires ainsi que des pipelines associés pour un ambitieux projet de divertissement interactif. Ce rôle est responsable de superviser la création et l’intégration des accessoires dans l’ensemble du projet, en assurant la cohérence, l’évolutivité et un haut niveau de fidélité visuelle pour une vaste gamme de contenus, notamment l’habillage urbain, les environnements intérieurs, les véhicules et le contenu généré par les utilisateurs (UGC).

Relevant de la direction artistique associée, Monde, la personne occupant le poste Chef.fe d’équipe Artiste (Props)  travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’Environnement, d’Art technique et d’autres équipes multidisciplinaires afin de s’assurer que la production des accessoires soutient à la fois la vision artistique et les exigences de production. Ce rôle comprend le leadership et la gestion d’une équipe d’artistes d’accessoires, tout en mettant en place des pipelines, des flux de travail et des solutions évolutives. La personne retenue agira également comme principal point de liaison entre les équipes internes et les partenaires externes de développement afin d’assurer l’alignement de la production sur toutes les plateformes, du haut de gamme au mobile.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d’Environnement, d’Éclairage, d’Art technique et de Production afin d’assurer une intégration adéquate.

  • Optimiser les pipelines de production d’actifs pour améliorer l’efficacité et l’évolutivité sur les plateformes allant du haut de gamme au mobile.

  • Maintenir une visibilité constante sur la qualité, les risques et les défis de production liés au contenu des accessoires.

Basic Qualifications

NBCUniversal is seeking a Lead Character Artist to own and drive the visual quality of facial characters for an ambitious interactive entertainment experience. This role is responsible for ensuring that character assets meet high standards of quality, consistency, and technical excellence while supporting the project's artistic vision.
The Lead Character Artist  will work closely with the Associate Art Director – Characters and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure seamless integration across animation, rigging, and gameplay systems. This role also includes leading and mentoring artists, contributing to pipeline development, and helping scale character production to meet project needs.

Responsibilities

  • Translate art direction into high-quality character assets that support the project's visual and narrative goals.
  • Lead and mentor a team of character artists while fostering collaboration, growth, and artistic excellence.
  • Review and validate character assets to ensure they meet artistic, technical, and production standards.
  • Create and oversee the development of high-quality character content, including anatomy, materials, clothing, accessories, grooming, and overall presentation.
  • Partner closely with Animation, Design, Tech Art, Engineering, and Production teams to ensure successful implementation of character assets.
  • Ensure character content integrates efficiently into gameplay and production pipelines.
  • Establish and promote best practices for character creation within a modern real-time production environment.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, tools, and pipelines to support production scalability and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with external partners and outsourcing teams when required to maintain quality and consistency.
  • Support the definition and evolution of character art standards, documentation, and workflows across the project.
  • Apply best practices within Unreal Engine 5, Metahuman pipelines and others.
  • Identify and improve workflows to support scalability and production efficiency.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’un chef d'equipe artiste personnages pour diriger et assurer la qualité visuelle des personnages dans le cadre d’une expérience ambitieuse de divertissement interactif. Ce poste est responsable de veiller à ce que les ressources de personnages respectent des normes élevées de qualité, de cohérence et d’excellence technique, tout en soutenant la vision artistique du projet.

Le chef d'equipe artistique de personnages travaillera en étroite collaboration avec le ou la Directeur(trice) artistique associé(e) – Personnages ainsi qu’avec des équipes multidisciplinaires afin d’assurer une intégration harmonieuse avec les systèmes d’animation, de rigging et de jouabilité (gameplay). Ce rôle comprend également le leadership et le mentorat d’artistes, la contribution au développement des pipelines de production et le soutien à l’expansion de la production de personnages afin de répondre aux besoins du projet.

Responsabilités 

  • Traduire la direction artistique en ressources de personnages de haute qualité qui soutiennent les objectifs visuels et narratifs du projet.
  • Diriger et encadrer une équipe d’artistes de personnages en favorisant la collaboration, le développement professionnel et l’excellence artistique.
  • Réviser et valider les ressources de personnages afin de s’assurer qu’elles respectent les normes artistiques, techniques et de production.
  • Créer et superviser le développement de contenu de personnages de grande qualité, y compris l’anatomie, les matériaux, les vêtements, les accessoires, le coiffage numérique (grooming) et la présentation globale.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d’Animation, de Conception (Design), d’Art technique (Tech Art), d’Ingénierie et de Production afin d’assurer l’intégration réussie des ressources de personnages.
  • Veiller à ce que le contenu des personnages s’intègre efficacement aux pipelines de gameplay et de production.
  • Établir et promouvoir les meilleures pratiques en matière de création de personnages dans un environnement de production moderne en temps réel.
  • Identifier les occasions d’améliorer les flux de travail, les outils et les pipelines afin de soutenir l’évolutivité et l’efficacité de la production.
  • Collaborer avec des partenaires externes et des équipes de sous-traitance lorsque requis afin de maintenir la qualité et la cohérence du contenu.
  • Soutenir la définition et l’évolution des normes artistiques, de la documentation et des processus liés aux personnages à l’échelle du projet.
  • Appliquer les meilleures pratiques associées à Unreal Engine 5, aux pipelines MetaHuman et à d’autres technologies pertinentes.
  • Identifier et améliorer les processus de production afin de soutenir la croissance du projet et d’accroître l’efficacité opérationnelle.

Basic Qualifications 

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in AAA game development with a focus on character art.
  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, or managing artists within a production environment.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality character art for real-time applications.
  • Excellent understanding of anatomy, form, proportion, materials, and character design principles.
  • Experience creating character content for modern game engines and real-time environments.
  • Strong understanding of character production pipelines and asset creation workflows.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to balance artistic quality with technical and production constraints.

Desired Characteristics 

  • Experience with modular character systems, customization systems or scalable character pipelines.
  • Knowledge of facial rigging, blendshapes, simulation or performance capture workflows or any related character development workflows.
  • Experience shipping at least one AAA title in a senior or as a lead character art role.
  • Experience collaborating with outsourcing partners or distributed teams.
  • Passion for achieving high levels of realism and character expressiveness.
  • Experience with Unreal engine.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to pipeline and process improvements.

Qualifications de base 

  • Minimum de 7 ans d’expérience en développement de jeux AAA, avec une spécialisation en art de personnages.
  • Expérience démontrée en leadership, mentorat ou gestion d’artistes dans un environnement de production.
  • Portfolio solide démontrant la création de personnages de haute qualité pour des applications en temps réel.
  • Excellente compréhension de l’anatomie, des formes, des proportions, des matériaux et des principes de conception de personnages.
  • Expérience dans la création de contenu de personnages pour des moteurs de jeu modernes et des environnements temps réel.
  • Bonne maîtrise des pipelines de production de personnages et des processus de création d’actifs (assets).
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en leadership et en collaboration.
  • Capacité à concilier l’excellence artistique avec les contraintes techniques et les exigences de production.

  • Atouts souhaités 

  • Expérience avec les systèmes de personnages modulaires, les systèmes de personnalisation ou les pipelines de personnages évolutifs.
  • Connaissance des processus de rigging facial, des blendshapes, de la simulation, de la capture de performance (performance capture) ou d’autres flux de travail liés au développement de personnages.
  • Participation à la livraison d’au moins un jeu AAA dans un rôle principal ou senior en art de personnages.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des partenaires de sous-traitance ou des équipes distribuées.
  • Passion pour la création de personnages réalistes et expressifs, avec un haut niveau de fidélité visuelle.
  • Expérience avec Unreal Engine.
  • Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et approche proactive visant l’amélioration continue des pipelines et des processus de production.

job.description:

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Position Overview:

As part of the Peacock Data Science team, the Senior Lead Data Scientist will be responsible for creating recommendation and personalization solutions for one or more verticals of Peacock Video Streaming Service. 

You’ll collaborate with an international, cross-functional team of engineers, architects, product managers and analysts to identify and prioritize enhancements to Peacock’s personalization models. Your responsibilities will touch everything from feature creation to model evaluation and deployment, and you’ll have opportunities to work on cutting edge machine learning like foundation models and reinforcement learning.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Work with a group of data scientists in the development of recommendation and personalization models using statistical, machine learning and data mining methodologies.
  • Drive the collection and manipulation of new data and the refinement of existing data sources.
  • Translate complex problems and solutions to all levels of the organization.
  • Collaborate with software and data architects in building real-time and automated batch implementations of data science solutions and integrating them into the streaming service architecture.
  • Drive innovation of the statistical and machine learning methodologies and tools used by the team.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Advanced (Master or PhD) degree with specialization in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Operations Research or another quantitative field or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of combined experience in machine learning in industry or research.
  • Experience with commercial recommender systems or a lead role in an advanced research recommender system project.
  • Strong working experience with deep learning.
  • Proficient in Python.  
  • Experience in data processing using SQL and PySpark.
  • Experience working with foundation models and other GenAI technologies.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience in media analytics and application of data science to the content streaming and TV industry.
  • Good understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and graph methodologies.
  • Experience with multi-billion record datasets and leading projects that span the disciplines of data science and data engineering.
  • Experience with Kubeflow, Airflow, and Databricks (or equivalent).
  • Experience with large-scale video assets.
  • Team oriented and collaborative approach with a demonstrated aptitude and willingness to learn new methods and tools.

Additional Requirements: 

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $145,000 - $175,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible).

As a Lead Engine Programmer, you are responsible for defining, building, and guiding the core Unreal Engine–based systems that underpin gameplay, rendering, physics, tools, and pipelines on an AAA title. You provide technical leadership for engine architecture and low‑level systems while collaborating closely with Gameplay, Rendering, Tools, Pipeline, and Production to ensure Unreal Engine is extended, optimized, and maintained to meet project needs. You balance hands‑on development with mentorship, system ownership, and long‑term technical direction.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the design and implementation of core Unreal Engine systems, frameworks, and engine‑level architecture.
  • Define and maintain engine standards for performance, stability, scalability, and maintainability within Unreal Engine.
  • Provide technical leadership and hands‑on development for complex engine features and cross‑cutting Unreal systems.
  • Collaborate with other engineering leads to ensure Unreal Engine systems support gameplay, tools, pipeline, and content workflows.
  • Mentor and support engine programmers through code reviews, technical guidance, and best‑practice Unreal development.
  • Oversee engine performance, memory usage, and platform‑specific constraints within Unreal Engine.
  • Drive engine optimization efforts, identifying bottlenecks and coordinating improvements across Unreal subsystems.
  • Establish coding standards, documentation practices, and debugging workflows for Unreal Engine development.
  • Support production by identifying technical risks, estimating scope, and planning Unreal Engine evolution across milestones.
  • Debug and resolve complex engine‑level issues involving multithreading, memory, platform integration, and Unreal system interactions.
  • Guide Unreal Engine upgrades, custom engine changes, and long‑term technology decisions.
  • Stay current with Unreal Engine advancements, engine architecture trends, and low‑level performance techniques.

À titre de Programmeur ou programmeuse moteur Lead, vous êtes responsable de définir, développer et orienter les systèmes centraux fondés sur Unreal Engine qui soutiennent la jouabilité, le rendu, la physique, les outils et les pipelines d’un titre AAA. Vous fournissez un leadership technique pour l’architecture moteur et les systèmes de bas niveau tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes Gameplay, Rendering, Tools, Pipeline et Production afin de garantir qu’Unreal Engine est étendu, optimisé et maintenu pour répondre aux besoins du projet. Vous conciliez le développement pratique, le mentorat, la responsabilité des systèmes et l’orientation technique à long terme.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Diriger la conception et l’implantation des systèmes centraux, des frameworks et de l’architecture de niveau moteur d’Unreal Engine.
  • Définir et maintenir les normes du moteur en matière de performance, de stabilité, d’évolutivité et de maintenabilité dans Unreal Engine.
  • Fournir un leadership technique et contribuer directement au développement de fonctionnalités moteur complexes et de systèmes Unreal transversaux.
  • Collaborer avec les autres responsables techniques afin de garantir que les systèmes Unreal Engine soutiennent la jouabilité, les outils, le pipeline et les flux de travail de contenu.
  • Encadrer et soutenir les programmeurs et programmeuses moteur grâce aux revues de code, à l’orientation technique et aux pratiques exemplaires de développement sous Unreal.
  • Superviser les performances du moteur, l’utilisation de la mémoire et les contraintes propres aux plateformes dans Unreal Engine.
  • Piloter les initiatives d’optimisation du moteur en identifiant les goulots d’étranglement et en coordonnant les améliorations à travers les sous-systèmes Unreal.
  • Établir des normes de codage, des pratiques de documentation et des processus de débogage pour le développement sous Unreal Engine.
  • Soutenir la production en identifiant les risques techniques, en évaluant l’ampleur des travaux et en planifiant l’évolution d’Unreal Engine au fil des jalons.
  • Déboguer et résoudre des problèmes complexes de niveau moteur liés au multithreading, à la mémoire, à l’intégration des plateformes et aux interactions entre les systèmes Unreal.
  • Orienter les mises à niveau d’Unreal Engine, les modifications personnalisées du moteur et les décisions technologiques à long terme.
  • Se tenir à jour quant aux avancées d’Unreal Engine, aux tendances en architecture moteur et aux techniques de performance de bas niveau.

QUALIFICATIONS

Basic Requirements:

  • Expert proficiency in C++, with extensive experience developing low‑level engine or systems code in Unreal Engine.
  • At least 8+ years of professional experience in game programming, with shipped AAA titles using Unreal Engine.
  • Deep, hands‑on experience working with Unreal Engine at the engine‑systems level.
  • Strong understanding of Unreal Engine subsystems such as rendering, memory management, threading, streaming, and platform abstraction.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or technically guiding programmers on a production team.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to design robust systems under production constraints.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Perforce or Git.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience supporting multiple platforms within Unreal Engine (PC, console, mobile).
  • Experience modifying or extending Unreal Engine source.
  • Strong understanding of gameplay and content pipeline requirements from an Unreal Engine perspective.
  • A passion for building scalable, high‑performance engine technology.

Exigences de base :

  • Maîtrise experte du C++, avec une vaste expérience dans le développement de code moteur ou système de bas niveau sous Unreal Engine.
  • Au moins 8 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en programmation de jeux vidéo, avec des titres AAA commercialisés utilisant Unreal Engine.
  • Expérience approfondie et pratique de travail avec Unreal Engine au niveau des systèmes moteur.
  • Solide compréhension des sous-systèmes d’Unreal Engine tels que le rendu, la gestion de la mémoire, le threading, le streaming et l’abstraction des plateformes.
  • Expérience démontrée de leadership, de mentorat ou d’accompagnement technique de programmeurs et programmeuses au sein d’une équipe de production.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de résolution de problèmes et capacité à concevoir des systèmes robustes dans un contexte de contraintes de production.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec diverses disciplines.
  • Expérience avec des systèmes de gestion de versions tels que Perforce ou Git.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

À PROPOS DE NBCUNIVERSAL

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial, que nous distribuons à travers notre portefeuille de productions cinématographiques, télévisuelles et de diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre grâce à nos destinations de parcs thématiques mondiaux, à nos produits de consommation et à nos expériences. Nous possédons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des émissions de premier ordre par l’entremise de nos prestigieux studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de renommée mondiale par l’entremise de Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, qui abrite Universal Epic Universe, ainsi que Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez le www.nbcuniversal.com pour obtenir plus d’information.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des collectivités où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que les membres de notre personnel aient l’occasion de servir leurs collectivités. Nous valorisons une culture inclusive et nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer des talents diversifiés afin de créer et de offrir un vaste éventail de contenus qui reflètent le monde qui nous entoure.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Lead Material Artist (World/Props) to define and drive world material systems for an ambitious interactive open-world experience. This role is responsible for ensuring that environment and prop materials achieve a high level of visual quality, consistency, and scalability across large and diverse environments, from high-end platforms to mobile. 

The Lead Material Artist (World/Props) will work closely with the Associate Art Director – City Environment, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure materials are fully integrated within environment pipelines and rendering systems. The role involves leading and managing a team while defining scalable approaches for surfaces, tiling, modular shaders, and material libraries supporting production at multiple performance targets. 

Responsibilities 

  • Translate Art Direction into high-end world and prop materials that meet visual and technical requirements. 

  • Lead and manage the world material team, ensuring consistency and quality across assets. 

  • Define, maintain, and evolve scalable material pipelines, workflows, and best practices. 

  • Create and oversee surface materials, tiling systems, and modular shader approaches. 

  • Ensure consistency and scalability across environments, props, and large-scale worlds from high-end to mobile targets. 

  • Collaborate closely with Environment, Tech Art, and Lighting teams for proper integration. 

  • Ensure correct implementation within rendering, shading, and runtime systems. 

  • Act as a bridge between art, technical art, and pipeline development teams. 

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’un ou d’une Artiste des matériaux Lead (Environnements/Accessoires) pour définir et piloter les systèmes de matériaux d’environnement dans le cadre d’une ambitieuse expérience interactive en monde ouvert. Ce poste est responsable de veiller à ce que les matériaux d’environnements et d’accessoires atteignent un niveau élevé de qualité visuelle, de cohérence et d’évolutivité dans des environnements vastes et diversifiés, des plateformes haut de gamme jusqu’aux appareils mobiles.

La personne titulaire du poste travaillera en étroite collaboration avec la personne associée à la direction artistique, Environnement urbain, l’équipe d’Art technique et des équipes multidisciplinaires afin de garantir l’intégration complète des matériaux aux pipelines d’environnement et aux systèmes de rendu. Le poste implique de diriger et gérer une équipe tout en définissant des approches évolutives pour les surfaces, les systèmes de textures répétitives (tiling), les shaders modulaires et les bibliothèques de matériaux soutenant la production pour plusieurs cibles de performance.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Traduire la direction artistique en matériaux d’environnements et d’accessoires haut de gamme répondant aux exigences visuelles et techniques.
  • Diriger et gérer l’équipe responsable des matériaux d’environnement afin d’assurer la cohérence et la qualité des actifs.
  • Définir, maintenir et faire évoluer des pipelines de matériaux évolutifs, des flux de travail et des meilleures pratiques.
  • Créer et superviser les matériaux de surface, les systèmes de textures répétitives (tiling) et les approches de shaders modulaires.
  • Assurer la cohérence et l’évolutivité des matériaux à travers les environnements, les accessoires et les mondes à grande échelle, des plateformes haut de gamme jusqu’aux appareils mobiles.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Environnement, Art technique et Éclairage afin d’assurer une intégration adéquate.
  • Veiller à l’implantation correcte des matériaux dans les systèmes de rendu, d’ombrage et d’exécution.
  • Agir comme point de liaison entre les équipes artistiques, d’art technique et de développement des pipelines.

Basic Qualifications 

  • Extensive experience in AAA game development with a focus on environment material creation. 

  • Proven experience leading and managing a team of artists. 

  • Experience as a Lead on at least one shipped AAA title. 

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality world and prop materials. 

  • Strong understanding of PBR workflows, surface definition, and shader systems. 

  • Experience with real-time pipelines and multi-platform performance constraints. 

  • Experience working with modern game engines such as Unreal Engine. 

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills. 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience building scalable material libraries and reusable systems. 

  • Experience with Unreal Engine 5 and advanced shader workflows. 

  • Familiarity with procedural world-building workflows or systems. 

  • Experience working with outsourcing partners or distributed teams. 

  • Strong eye for realism, surface fidelity, and material consistency. 

QUALIFICATIONS DE BASE

  • Expérience approfondie du développement de jeux AAA, avec une spécialisation en création de matériaux d’environnement.
  • Expérience démontrée en direction et gestion d’une équipe d’artistes.
  • Expérience à titre de Lead sur au moins un titre AAA commercialisé.
  • Portfolio solide démontrant des matériaux d’environnement et d’accessoires de haute qualité.
  • Excellente compréhension des flux de travail PBR, de la définition des surfaces et des systèmes de shaders.
  • Expérience des pipelines en temps réel et des contraintes de performance multiplateformes.
  • Expérience avec des moteurs de jeu modernes tels qu’Unreal Engine.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en leadership et en collaboration.

ATOUTS

  • Expérience dans la création de bibliothèques de matériaux évolutives et de systèmes réutilisables.
  • Expérience avec Unreal Engine 5 et des flux de travail avancés de shaders.
  • Connaissance des flux de travail ou des systèmes de génération procédurale d’environnements.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des partenaires d’impartition ou des équipes distribuées.
  • Sens aigu du réalisme, de la fidélité des surfaces et de la cohérence des matériaux.

The Product Analytics & Experimentation team supports a data-driven, results-focused product organization. We are looking for a Lead who thrives at the intersection of product analytics, data science, product development, and business strategy, who will bring a strong combination of technical expertise, analytical rigor, and product background. 

Responsibilities 

  • Partner with the Senior Manager of Product Analytics to optimize acquisition product experiences, providing a data-driven, objective perspective that aligns cross-functional teams on performance against key goals.

  • Foster a culture of inclusion, empathy, analytical rigor, and teamwork, while driving the company's success.

This includes responding to service calls, escorting vendors on site, and collaborating with other departments to ensure the facility operates efficiently, remains safe and is compliant with all regulations.

  • Minor door and lock repairs

  • Perform general duties including debris removal, rain preparation, materials, and storeroom inventory
  • Assist maintaining a clean workplace environment, including job clean up, use of pressure washers and other cleaning devices and equipment  Respond to service requests and emergencies during and after business hours
  • Partner with NBCU departments to ensure compliance and safety tasks are addressed promptly
  • Adhere to OSHA, ADA and other regulatory requirements
  • Other duties as assigned

  • Cool Under Pressure – You handle stressful situations with ease and professionalism while juggling multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Communicates with ease – You have a way with words; written and verbal
  • Tech-savvy – You are an MS Office whiz and can take on new software with ease

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences.
