NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Role Purpose

At NBCUniversal, the Corporate Events Department produces high-impact experiences for clients and C-suite executives across some of the most recognized brands in media and entertainment — from marquee tentpole events and corporate initiatives to brand activations and large-scale client programs.

The Corporate Events Manager is an experienced event lead who independently drives small to mid-sized programs from ideation through execution while also contributing to larger-scale events as part of a broader team. This individual brings 5–7 years of experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, or related industries, along with a proven ability to lead programs, navigate complex logistics, and collaborate effectively across stakeholders. The Manager serves as a key partner to internal teams, clients, vendors, and executives, balancing strategic thinking with flawless execution. This position may provide guidance and oversight to Coordinators, Associates, Pages, or project-based team members depending on event staffing and department structure.

Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The position reports to a Vice President within the Corporate Events Department. At NBCUniversal, you’ll have opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact alongside some of the industry’s most talented professionals.

Job Duties

Event Leadership & Execution

  • Lead small to mid-sized programs from initial planning through on-site execution and post-event reconciliation
  • Contribute to larger-scale and high-profile events in partnership with senior team members, owning specific workstreams, logistics, vendors, or operational components within the broader program
  • Oversee all aspects of assigned events, including venue sourcing, vendor coordination, run-of-show development, premium sourcing, guest experience, and on-site logistics
  • Partner closely with internal stakeholders and clients throughout the planning and execution process, facilitating meetings and ensuring clear communication and follow-through
  • Interface directly with clients and C-suite executives with professionalism and discretion
  • Develop and track event budgets, process invoices, and support post-event reconciliation
  • Negotiate contracts, track deliverables, and maintain detailed production timelines
  • Coordinate event registration, attendee communications, and guest management to ensure a seamless experience
  • Produce or oversee the creation of digital and printed event materials in collaboration with vendors and internal/external partners
  • Travel domestically and internationally to execute and support events
  • Provide on-site support across the department’s broader event portfolio as needed

Team Collaboration & Department Support

  • Provide guidance and day-to-day direction to Associates, Coordinators, Pages, and project-based team members assigned to events
  • Foster a collaborative and supportive working environment while helping junior team members strengthen their event management skills
  • Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams on complex programs and department initiatives
  • Contribute to operational improvements, internal processes, and shared departmental resources
  • Maintain awareness of emerging trends across hospitality, food and beverage, entertainment, sports, venues, experiential marketing, and premium gifting

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, experiential marketing, production, client services, or related fields
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading and executing events from concept through completion
  • Experience working with executive-level stakeholders, clients, vendors, and cross-functional teams

Desired Characteristics

  • Solid project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple events and timelines simultaneously
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Experience managing budgets, contracts, production schedules, and vendor relationships
  • Ability to remain adaptable, resourceful, and solutions-oriented in high-pressure environments
  • Collaborative team player who can effectively guide and support project teams
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and event registration platforms
  • Knowledge of current trends within hospitality, entertainment, food and beverage, sports, experiential marketing, and premium gifting

Additional Requirements

  • Willing to work in New York, NY
  • Able to travel up to 40%
  • Work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the event schedule

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Manager, Corporate Governance/Legal Affairs (Corporate Secretary) to support corporate governance, legal entity management, and compliance for its U.S. and Canadian subsidiaries.

This role sits within a high-impact Corporate Secretary team that serves as the central resource for legal entity formation, governance, and compliance across NBCUniversal’s global portfolio of businesses.

The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented and collaborative professional who can manage a high volume of corporate governance activities, maintain data integrity across enterprise systems, and partner effectively with Legal, Tax, Finance, and external service providers.

This role is ideal for a strong corporate paralegal or governance professional looking to step into a broader, enterprise-facing position with meaningful ownership over legal entity operations and governance.

Here you can:

Corporate Governance & Secretarial Support

  • Provide corporate secretarial support for U.S. and Canadian entities, including:
    • Drafting secretary certificates and corporate certifications
    • Preparing written consents, resolutions, and governance documentation
  • Maintain corporate digital minute books, ensuring completeness and accuracy
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on governance matters relating to Canadian entities

Legal Entity Compliance & Filings

  • Prepare and file annual reports and other statutory filings to maintain entities in good standing
  • Track and manage compliance deadlines across a large portfolio of entities
  • Support regulatory filings and responses to governmental or compliance-related inquiries
  • Provide corporate support in connection with litigation, arbitration, and regulatory matters

Legal Entity Data & Systems

  • Manage and maintain the corporate legal entity database, the enterprise system of record for legal entity data
  • Ensure timely and accurate updates to ownership, governance, and structural data
  • Generate organizational charts and entity reports for internal stakeholders
  • Partner on system initiatives, including enhancements and data integrity efforts

Operations & Vendor Management

  • Oversee billing and invoicing for key corporate secretarial vendors in coordination with global counterparts
  • Review and process filing expenses and vendor invoices to ensure timely payment

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a key resource to Legal and business teams on matters relating to:
    • Corporate governance
    • Legal entity structure
    • Execution of corporate actions
  • Support entity formations, restructurings, and dissolutions by coordinating required governance documentation
  • Assist with corporate documentation required by internal stakeholders and external regulators

Scope

  • Primary responsibility for NBCUniversal’s U.S. and Canadian legal entities
  • Works closely with global Corporate Secretary team members across Europe and other jurisdictions

Here you'll need:

  • 4+ years of experience in corporate governance, corporate secretary, or legal entity management
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. corporate governance and compliance requirements
  • Experience managing corporate filings, minute books, and legal entity records
  • Experience working with legal entity management systems preferred

What we'll look for: 

  • Highly detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, global environment

This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the New York, NY or Universal City, CA office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

This role will partner with international territories and regional teams to translate global campaign strategies into locally relevant digital initiatives, oversee digital creative and asset delivery, and serve as a key point of contact for territory digital marketing needs. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and presenter who can translate complex ideas into clear, actionable guidance for global partners. They should be highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, agencies, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and support the markets on how to implement digital marketing plans for assigned films 
  • Supervise digital creative development with the Home Office digital agency on the market’s behalf 
  • Inspire local marketing teams to embrace digital innovation, sharing best practices and ideas on assigned films across territories with the objective of driving opportunities for innovation and excellence in the digital space 
  • Work to create bespoke social media elements for local platforms, including APAC platforms - aligning with senior stakeholders and licensing teams in the US, supporting markets with the development and approval of features (e.g. filters, AR) on local social platforms 
  • Work within the global Digital team on developing and communicating the digital campaign strategy while leading development of creative with roster of creative agencies 
  • Communicate updates on all digital materials available from Home Office to key territories for assigned titles 
  • Work closely with the media, publicity, creative, distribution and creative services teams to ensure the digital strategic direction for each release is successfully implemented to plan 
  • Communicate and work with the International Home Office team during the campaign planning and implementation process, to provide information as required for filmmakers, production companies and other stakeholders 
  • Key department lead and point of contact for major digital initiatives across markets for assigned titles 
  • Drive film strategy from key insights from social listening, and ensure that social insights are informing and shaping our creative campaigns
  • Understand the ever-changing social landscape and how it can strategically and tactically be applied to our campaigns 
  • Help to lead influencer programs, including strategy, content review, market nominations and set visits for select films.
  • Recommend and share best practices across Markets and with International Media team 
  • Key day to day contact for all digital enquiries from territories on assigned titles 
  • Official sites management. Roll out official sites and portal updates, franchise site updates where relevant, linkfire campaigns and theatrical showtimes for 20 markets.
  • Domains, cookie consent platform update management and general troubleshooting in partnership with our agency team

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in the entertainment industry specifically digital marketing, production, or post-production 
  • Minimum 1 year of experience working on global or international-only film campaigns 
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Working knowledge of Photoshop 
  • Experience managing digital assets across multiple international territories
  • Must be able to adjust working hours and occasionally work nights or weekends

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing or a related field preferred, but not required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization 
  • Familiarity with video post-production workflows and common digital file formats
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and shifting priorities efficiently while meeting deadlines
  • Self-starter who takes initiative with minimal direction, seeks information from appropriate sources, and demonstrates exceptional follow-through
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy

The Finance Manager is a key role on the Universal Studio Group (USG) Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team and will be responsible for driving Free Cash Flow (FCF) financial forecasting, reporting and analysis across the studio. This position partners with cross-divisional teams (including Production Finance, Controllership, Participations & Residuals teams, Studios, UTE, and NBCU Corporate) to drive strategic decision making, streamline processes, and ensure accurate financial performance. This role will report to the Director of Financial Planning & Analysis for USG.  

Essential Responsibilities 

Studio Delivery Volume Forecasting & Reporting 

  • Lead forecasting and reporting processes for the USG’s portfolio, including monthly presentations of production and delivery projections to Senior Finance Executives. 
  • Maintain and track key Studio volume metrics to ensure accuracy and transparency. 

Financial Modeling & Forecasting 

  • Build and manage detailed 3rd Party & Peacock Collections in partnership with the USG Operating Cash Flow (OCF) team and cross-divisional finance stakeholders (NBC/Cable/Peacock). 
  • Support long-range planning through the development of annual operating plans, forecasts, and five-year financial models. 

Free Cash Flow (FCF) Management 

  • Oversee the FCF pacing process by reviewing production spending, tax credits, development, collections, audits, Accounts Receivable (AR) aging, Participations & Residuals. 
  • Manage the 13-week cash flow forecast on a weekly basis. 
  • Identify and communicate risks and opportunities, delivering clear updates to USG/Studios Finance leadership and the corporate FP&A team. 
  • Manage FCF submissions, reporting, analytics, and scenario planning to support informed decision-making. 

Executive & Strategic Support 

  • Assist with preparing executive presentations covering key business topics (e.g., Year over Year (YoY) analysis, OCF to FCF conversion). 
  • Provide ad hoc financial analysis and insights to help guide strategic initiatives. 

Close & Controllership Support 

  • Lead critical close processes, including close checks, in close coordination with the Controllership team during month and quarter-end. 

Corporate Partnership & Reporting 

  • Collaborate with corporate FP&A to provide studio-level analytics, elimination details, and key supplemental reporting. 
  • Work in partnership with the Studios & UTE Finance teams to provide key analysis and reporting 

Project Management & Process Improvement 

  • Drive key initiatives across the studio, including process simplification, systems upgrades, and implementation of best practices to improve efficiency. 

Basic Requirements: 

  • BS/BA degree with Accounting/Finance focus preferred 
  • 4+ years public and/or private accounting, or FP&A experience preferred 
  • High proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint  
  • Accounting / Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) knowledge 

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Experience managing FP&A cycles is preferred 
  • Team player with ability to work well in a cross-functional environments and willingness to jump into projects to meet department goals 
  • Ability to quickly grasp new concepts and problem solve
  • Strong initiative and ability to manage multiple projects  
  • Ability to work independently 
  • Strong interpersonal skills: ability to work and communicate effectively with all levels of finance, operations, and senior management 
  • Continuous improvement attitude, willingness to seek out and implement best practices 
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational, analytical and PC skills 
  • Strong organization and time management skills; ability to deliver on multiple project assignments, meet tight deadlines and be effective under pressure 
  • Entertainment / Media / TV Production experience preferred 
  • SAP or Essbase knowledge preferred with exposure to BPC a plus

The Universal Television Entertainment team is seeking a strategic and culturally fluent brand marketer to join our Marketing Strategy team, supporting the evolution and activation of Peacock’s long-term brand strategy across campaigns, partnerships, platform experiences, and cultural moments. Reporting directly to the Senior Director, Marketing Strategy, the Manager, Marketing Strategy will help shape how Peacock’s brand shows up across the ecosystem, ensuring all work aligns with our positioning, reflects cultural relevance, and deepens audience connection on and off platform.

In addition to contributing to brand strategy development, you will partner with cross-functional teams to help streamline how brand guidance is integrated into campaigns and initiatives, ensuring clarity and alignment while complementing the broader workflows owned across the organization.

This role is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, deeply engaged in pop culture, passionate about Peacock’s content slate, and excited to connect insights and cultural narratives into compelling brand strategy.

The Person:

You are a thoughtful, culturally aware brand strategist who understands how content, audiences, and data shape a modern streaming brand. You are:

  • A cultural observer who stays tapped into Peacock’s slate, fan conversation, and the broader pop culture landscape.
  • An analytical thinker who can uncover the story behind the data and turn insights into action.
  • A brand guardian who connects dots, identifies patterns, and ensures strategic alignment across teams and touchpoints.
  • A skilled communicator who can confidently and clearly represent the brand perspective.
  • A proactive learner who asks smart questions and thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • A collaborator who leads with positivity, respect, and a commitment to moving the work forward together.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

  • Support the development and evolution of Peacock’s brand strategy across marketing, product, programming, distribution, creative, insights, and partnerships.
  • Translate brand positioning and audience insights into clear, actionable direction for campaigns, platform moments, and partner activations.
  • Synthesize performance data, cultural trends, and competitive intelligence into strategic recommendations that inform decision making.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to streamline how Marketing Strategy inputs are incorporated into campaign development and key milestones.
  • Maintain organized brand frameworks, strategic materials, and documentation to ensure consistency and visibility across workstreams.
  • Monitor brand health and engagement KPIs in collaboration with Consumer Insights and Decision Sciences, supporting leadership updates and strategic refinement.

Basic Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in consumer, entertainment, or brand marketing strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data, audience insights, and cultural trends into strategic recommendations.
  • Experience developing positioning, briefs, or narrative frameworks that guide cross-functional execution.
  • Proven ability to combine analytics with creativity to shape strategy.
  • Comfort interpreting KPIs and research to inform brand and marketing strategies.
  • Strong visual storyteller with excellent writing and presentation skills who brings strategies to life in compelling, easily understood ways, with fluency in Keynote for Mac (or willingness to learn).
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively within a matrixed organization.
  • Passion for entertainment, streaming, culture, and evolving audience behavior.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Strong cultural intuition and affinity for Peacock’s diverse and dynamic content slate.
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently and proactively keep leadership informed.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, master’s degree or MBA a plus.

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Role Purpose
The Manager, Multiplatform Planning leads the strategic planning, optimization, and execution of promotional inventory across NBC Entertainment's linear and digital platforms. This role owns the promotional scheduling strategy, oversees day-to-day inventory management, and drives cross-functional alignment to ensure marketing priorities are executed effectively across all platforms. Partnering closely with Marketing, Programming, Project Management, and Network Operations teams, the Manager maximizes promotional opportunities, supports key business objectives, and ensures seamless campaign delivery while maintaining operational excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the strategic planning and scheduling of promotional campaigns to maximize audience reach, frequency, and engagement across NBC platforms
  • Oversee promotional inventory management within Sintec, balancing NBC, Peacock, Sports, and cross-channel priorities to support business objectives
  • Own the development, maintenance, and optimization of promotional logs, ensuring accuracy, on-air readiness, and alignment with programming and marketing priorities
  • Serve as a strategic partner and key point of contact for Promotional Planning, building alignment across Marketing, Programming, Project Management, and Network Operations
  • Oversee campaign setup and maintenance in Sintec, ensuring accurate promo codes, versions, lengths, flight dates, and asset management
  • Provide strategic leadership for secondary campaign elements, collaborating with Program Operations and Project Management to align priorities, timelines, assets, and drive successful execution across promotional campaigns
  •  Proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve scheduling conflicts, inventory constraints, asset issues, tagging discrepancies, and other operational challenges
  • Drive continuous process improvements that enhance operational efficiency, scheduling accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Partner with Network Operations to ensure seamless execution of promotional inventory and business-critical priorities, providing responsive operational support and occasional off-hours coverage as needed
  • Lead ad hoc projects, workflow enhancements, and cross-functional initiatives in support of evolving business priorities

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Film, Television or related field
  • Experience in media planning, broadcast scheduling, network operations, promotional strategy, or a related field
  • Exceptional attention to detail and quality control skills
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively partner across teams and adapt to evolving business needs
  • Excellent computer skills, proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Powerpoint
  • Self-starter who is proactive and resourceful

Desired Characteristics:

  • Promo Scheduling experience a strong plus
  • Strong interest in promotions, advertising and television

  • Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $80,000- $110,000 (bonus eligible)

  • Help ensure the accuracy and consistency of streaming and audio data, reporting, and measurement methodologies across the organization

NBCUniversal is seeking a Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) Manager to join the Facilities Operations and Engineering team in Universal City, CA. As an individual contributor, the MEP Manager is responsible for overseeing day-to-day facility operations across the NBCUniversal Studio Lot, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence.
 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Works under the direction of the Director of Facilities Infrastructure Systems to support MEP operations across studio facilities and production environments, ensuring reliable and efficient infrastructure.
  • Enforce safety protocols across MEP operations, ensuring full compliance with EHS regulations and industry’s best practices. 
  • Monitor the quality of all MEP services, repairs, and installations to ensure work meets technical specifications and the highest performance standards. 
  • Collaborate with the asset management team to maintain accurate inventory and lifecycle tracking of all equipment and infrastructure, supporting long-term planning and capital replacement strategies. 
  • Ensure preventive maintenance programs and inspection routines are consistently executed to maintain system performance, safety, and regulatory compliance. 
  • Partner with the Contracts Manager to support procurement and financial activities, including vendor sourcing, RFP development, contract negotiation and administration, budget tracking, and purchase approvals. 
  • Engage with external vendors and contractors, ensuring work is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with quality expectations and contractual requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot and respond to operational challenges including after-hours issues such as equipment failures, HVAC disruptions, and electrical or plumbing incidents that may impact production and theme park/CityWalk operations in some instances. 
  • Coordinate and prioritize MEP work requests, ensuring timely and accurate completion across electrical, plumbing, and HVAC systems. 
  • Contribute to the development and management of the studio operations budget, ensuring effective resource allocation and cost control. 
  • Participate in the planning and oversight of capital improvement projects involving MEP systems, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery. Monitor project performance, including schedule adherence, cost control, quality standards, and estimate reviews.
  • Support critical infrastructure planning, enterprise standards development, and general building systems automation/reporting to include supporting external sites as needed.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and provide regular updates to leadership and stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate daily operational schedules across MEP functions to ensure alignment with production needs. 
  • Recommend and support the procurement of equipment, tools, and supplies to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness. 
  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to ensure successful project planning and implementation. 
  • Support the development and implementation of training programs to ensure MEP staff remain proficient with current technologies, codes, and standards. 
  • Support initiatives focused on energy efficiency and sustainability in alignment with organizational environmental goals. 
  • Partner with Emergency Services teams to ensure rapid and effective response to MEP related incidents. Ensure all facility modifications comply with applicable codes and regulations, including those related to fire protection and boiler systems.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in ongoing professional development to maintain technical expertise. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Let’s Talk About You…

  • Analytical - You create tools and processes quickly and accurately to provide job estimates for clients levering deep industry experience, historical trends, teams and vendor relationships.
  • Executer - You get things done and take accountability! Using strong business acumen, organizational and superior process/project management skills, you prioritize and execute numerous complex projects in parallel.
  • Customer Service Skills - You communicate effectively and solve problems to drive customer service and make client delivery a priority.  
  • Principles - Displays integrity, responsibility, accountability, teamwork, and ethics.
  • Team Player - Fosters a culture of teamwork, mutual respect, and collaboration across diverse teams. Builds and maintains strong, productive relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

  • 3+ years prior experience in facility maintenance operations
  • 3+ years of experience managing union personnel
  • 2+ years of experience in work planning and analysis
  • 2+ years of experience in cost-effective internal business practices
  • 2+ years of experience in data analytics and verification

  • Experience with enterprise Integrated Workplace Management Systems, work planning and scheduling and materials management
  • Demonstrates proficiency in Microsoft Office, ArcGIS, Building/Energy Management Systems such as Tridium and other relevant tools.

This is a project/limited term position, unless otherwise amended or terminated as deliverables within this project are completed.

The Media Management Operations Specialist is a specialized, hands-on technical role responsible for the processing, management, quality control, organization, storage, and lifecycle of media assets supporting network broadcast, sports, news, and production operations.

Job Duties:

  • Execute and monitor media ingest, transcoding, transfer, QC, archive, restoration, export, and distribution workflows across broadcast, post-production, and cloud-based environments.
  • Manage and organize media within MAM, AVID, Cloud systems, archive, and shared-storage systems, ensuring assets are properly processed, organized, accessible, and available within required deadlines.
  • Perform comprehensive technical and visual quality control (QC) of media, identifying issues involving video, audio, timecode, resolution, frame rate, synchronization, file integrity, metadata, and technical specifications.
  • Validate metadata, naming conventions, folder structures, media placement, and delivery specifications to ensure accuracy and compliance with established standards.
  • Monitor media storage, asset availability, retention, archive, and restoration activities in support of content lifecycle and storage-management requirements.
  • Independently troubleshoot failed or delayed ingest, transcode, transfer, archive, restoration, and delivery workflows and perform appropriate first-level corrective actions.
  • Analyze workflow failures, identify potential points of failure, gather relevant technical information, and provide detailed escalations to Engineering, Media Systems, and other technical teams when required.
  • Support time-sensitive media requirements for live events, sports, digital streaming, broadcast, and production operations.
  • Maintain accurate operational documentation and clearly communicate workflow status, technical discrepancies, risks, and escalations to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve media-management processes, operational efficiency, and workflow reliability.
  • Collaborate with Media Operations, Sports Operations, Production, Editorial, Engineering, Media Systems, and other technical teams to resolve issues and meet critical production deadlines.
  • Adapts to fluctuating schedules, including nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays, in a high-demand, fast-paced environment.
  • Works under the direct supervision of the Sr Manager of Media Operations and is responsible for completing any other tasks as assigned by the manager.

Basic Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a production, postproduction, broadcast, or communications environment
  • Fluency in English & Spanish
  • Strong technical knowledge of broadcast media management and post-production workflows, including ingest, transcoding, QC, media movement, storage management, archive, restoration, distribution, and content lifecycle management.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with professional MAM and AVID environments, including AVID Media Composer, Interplay, Media Central Cloud UX, Media Shuttle, or comparable broadcast and post-production platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of professional video formats, codecs, resolutions, frame rates, and media specifications, including HD, UHD/4K, MXF, MOV, MP4, Apple ProRes, XAVC, and proxy media.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based broadcast and post-production environments, including Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud technologies and the integration of cloud and on-premises media workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise in technical and visual media QC, including the ability to identify and assess video, audio, timecode, synchronization, metadata, file-integrity, and specification-related issues.
  • Strong knowledge of media storage, metadata management, naming conventions, folder structures, asset organization, retention, archive, and restoration principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot media workflow failures, identify probable causes, perform initial corrective actions, and determine when technical escalation is required.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an understanding of workflow dependencies and downstream impacts across editorial, production, distribution, and broadcast operations.
  • Ability to interpret technical specifications and media delivery requirements and ensure assets meet established technical and operational standards.
  • Ability to independently prioritize and manage multiple high-volume, time-sensitive workflows while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to quickly learn and develop proficiency in new broadcast, post-production, MAM, cloud, and media-management technologies.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Bachelor’s or 2-year degree in Communications or Media preferred
  • Experience in international broadcast operations or media.
  • Familiarity with broadcast and digital streaming media workflows.
  • Exceptional time management, facilitation, and organizational skills
  • Self-starter who exhibits ownership on assigned tasks and who will push for solutions that solve immediate problems while building towards long-term goals
  • Ability to multitask and work in a fast paced, dead-line driven environment
  • Accustomed to working in a team and collaborating with all levels within the organization
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail
  • Ability to build rapport with clients and manage expectations
  • Ability to effectively be flexible in approach, and respond well to pressure

Additional Requirements:

  • This position is required to be performed on onsite from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite. 
  • Must be willing to work in the greater Miami, Florida area
  • Willingness to travel with short notice and on weekends
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must be willing to work flexible hours including late and/or last-minute scheduling changes in a 24/7 production work environment
  • Must be available to work (whenever necessary for show production) early mornings, evenings, overnights, holidays and weekends
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, technically capable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform technical quality control (QC) of digital media assets, including long-form content, short-form content, metadata, captioning, subtitles, and various audio mixes.
  • Verify audio, video, subtitle/caption, and metadata integrity to ensure compliance with NBCUniversal and distribution partner specifications.
  • Support media ingest, transcode, edit, segmentation, and preparation workflows across multiple delivery platforms.
  • Prepare and fulfill media assets for broadcast networks, owned-and-operated stations, Peacock, internation platforms, and other digital outlets.
  • Conduct real-time, spot check, and file-based content QC to identify technical, legal, and creative issues.
  • Maintain accurate metadata and media records within Media Asset Management (MAM) and workflow systems.
  • Troubleshoot issues within media workflows, following established escalation paths and communicating status to stakeholders.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Program Operations, On-Air Marketing, Programming, and external partners.
  • Learn and execute new workflows, tools, and technologies introduced into the Media Operations ecosystem.
  • Support departmental performance goals related to reliability, accuracy, and timeliness of deliveries.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

  • A High School Diploma and relevant certification or Associate's Degree in Media or Communications, or equivalent professional experience in broadcast, digital, or post production role.
  • A solid understanding of television production, broadcast operations, and/or news/sports/entertainment technical production requirements.

Desired Characteristics:

  • 1+ years of experience in a production, post production, broadcast, or communications environment     
  • 2+ years' of experience in a job or school related activity using computers and software applications including MS outlook, MS Word, & MS Excel.     
  • Knowledge of various media formats/VTRs (Digibeta, HDcam, XDcam), file types (QT, WMV, MXF, DNX, DV, etc) and video standards (NTSC, PAL)     
  • Basic understanding of digital video/audio including compression codecs, file systems, file transfer applications and Content Distribution
  • Experience in international broadcast operations or media especially in a quality control capacity.     
  • A team player, who is always respectful, follows rules and policy, has good communication skills, and maintains a positive attitude.     
  • A punctual, hardworking, disciplined, and dependable individual     
  • Experience in a fast paced, quick turn and/or live broadcast environment.     
  • Fluency or intermediate understanding of other languages     
  • Understanding of international files standards & frame rates     
  • 2-5 years of experience in the multi-channel broadcast facility doing content-prep and quality-control work      
  • Professional experience with SD & HD tape decks and/or file formats and specifications.     
  • Intermediate understanding of audio and video signal flow (waveform monitors, vector scopes, patch bay and routing systems)      
  • Prior experience using Media Asset Management (MAM) and centralized workflow software.

job.title: Meteorologist, Telemundo T47 New York
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We are seeking a dynamic, engaging, and experienced Bilingual Meteorologist to deliver accurate, compelling, and impactful weather coverage across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

This role requires a strong on-air presence, advanced forecasting skills, and the ability to communicate complex weather information clearly in both English and Spanish.

The ideal candidate is a skilled storyteller who can connect with diverse audiences and play a key role during severe weather and breaking news coverage.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and present daily weather forecasts for television newscasts, streaming platforms, and digital channels.
  • Deliver accurate, timely, and engaging weather coverage in both English and Spanish.
  • Provide live coverage during severe weather events, hurricanes, winter storms, flooding, and other breaking weather situations.
  • Create weather-related content for websites, mobile apps, social media, and connected TV platforms.
  • Utilize weather graphics, radar systems, and forecasting technology to enhance storytelling and audience understanding.
  • Collaborate with producers, assignment editors, reporters, and digital teams to develop weather-driven content and enterprise stories.
  • Participate in community outreach events and public appearances.
  • Contribute to special projects and long-form content related to weather, climate, safety, and environmental issues.
  • Maintain familiarity with local, regional, and national weather patterns impacting the viewing area.
  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of on-air weather forecasting experience preferred.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish, including strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to deliver weather forecasts live and under deadline pressure.
  • Strong understanding of meteorological models, forecasting tools, and weather technology.
  • Experience with weather graphics systems, radar platforms, and digital content creation.
  • Excellent storytelling and presentation skills.
  • Strong social media presence and ability to engage audiences across multiple platforms.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended shifts during severe weather events.
  • AMS Seal, CBM certification, or equivalent credentials preferred.
  • Must be willing to join SAG-AFTRA.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience forecasting in a major television market in both English and Spanish.
  • Experience with live field reporting and breaking news coverage.
  • Familiarity with streaming, OTT, FAST channels, and emerging digital platforms.
  • Ability to produce bilingual content for multiple audiences and platforms.

Success Factors

  • Build trust through accurate forecasting and clear communication.
  • Connect authentically with both English- and Spanish-speaking audiences.
  • Demonstrate strong editorial judgment and newsroom collaboration.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, multiplatform local news environment.
  • Serve as a trusted voice during severe weather and emergency situations.

Additional Social Media & Streaming Responsibilities

  • Develop and publish daily weather content for social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
  • Produce short-form and real-time weather updates optimized for mobile and social audiences.
  • Engage with audiences through social media by responding to questions, providing weather updates, and building community trust.
  • Create original weather-related content, including explainers, behind-the-scenes videos, safety tips, and severe weather preparedness segments.
  • Deliver live weather reports and updates on streaming and digital platforms, particularly during significant weather events and breaking news situations.
  • Collaborate with digital and streaming teams to create weather-focused content that drives audience engagement and growth.

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite (New York, NY).

job.title: ML Solutions Architect - Architecte de solutions ML
job.description:
NBCUniversal est l’un des leaders mondiaux du secteur des médias et du divertissement. Nous créons des contenus d’exception, que nous diffusons à travers notre portefeuille de films, de programmes télévisés et de services de streaming, et que nous donnons vie grâce à nos parcs à thème internationaux, nos produits grand public et nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, les chaînes locales NBC, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de streaming premium financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des programmes de divertissement de premier ordre grâce à nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi qu’aux quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs à thème et des expériences de premier plan à travers le monde via Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment l’Universal Orlando Resort, qui abrite l’Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Rendez-vous sur www.nbcuniversal.com pour plus d’informations.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés dans lesquelles vivent et travaillent nos employés, nos clients et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement social et veillons à ce que nos employés aient la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous défendons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de former une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer un large éventail de contenus reflétant notre monde.

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We are seeking an ML Solutions Architect who brings broad software engineering expertise along with strong machine learning-adjacent experience. In this role, you will lead the high-level design of systems that integrate ML models into our broader product suite. You will act as a technical consultant, evaluating customer requirements and determining whether they can be addressed with off-the-shelf solutions or should be escalated as specialized research initiatives for our Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning teams. 

This role is ideal for a systems-minded engineer who can translate product vision into scalable architecture, while balancing technical feasibility, performance, and maintainability. 

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) architecte de solutions ML possédant une solide expertise générale en ingénierie logicielle ainsi qu’une bonne expérience connexe à l’apprentissage automatique. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la conception de haut niveau des systèmes qui intègrent les modèles ML à notre offre de produits. Vous agirez comme conseiller(ère) technique en évaluant les besoins des clients afin de déterminer s’ils peuvent être satisfaits à l’aide de solutions prêtes à l’emploi ou s’ils doivent être confiés à nos équipes spécialisées en apprentissage profond et en apprentissage par renforcement. 

Ce poste convient particulièrement à une personne ayant une vision systémique, capable de traduire une vision produit en une architecture évolutive, tout en conciliant faisabilité technique, performance et maintenabilité. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • System Integration & Coprocessing: Design and implement the software layers that allow ML models to interact with a real-time rendering engine. This includes managing data pre-processing and post-processing (coprocessing) to ensure high-performance execution. 

  • Technical Consulting: Evaluate incoming customer requirements to determine the optimal path forward. You will decide if a task can be solved using off-the-shelf tools or if it requires a deep-dive research project to be handed off to our Deep Learning or Reinforcement Learning engineers. 

  • Language-Agnostic Engineering: Build and maintain wrappers, APIs, and microservices that allow our ML stack to remain flexible and language-agnostic across different production environments. 

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary technical liaison between technical leadership, customers, and the core engineering team to spec out data and integration requirements. 

  • Modular Execution: Break down complex product visions into manageable architectural components, ensuring that ML components ship as part of a stable, scalable software product. 

Responsabilités principales 

  • Intégration de systèmes et coprocessing : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre les couches logicielles permettant aux modèles ML d’interagir avec un moteur de rendu en temps réel, y compris les composants de prétraitement et de post-traitement nécessaires à une exécution performante.  

  • Conseil technique : Évaluer les demandes clients et déterminer la meilleure approche à adopter, qu’il s’agisse d’outils disponibles sur le marché ou de projets de recherche spécialisés à confier aux équipes d’apprentissage profond ou d’apprentissage par renforcement.  

  • Ingénierie agnostique aux langages : Développer et maintenir des wrappers, API et microservices afin de garantir la flexibilité et l’interopérabilité de la pile ML dans différents environnements de production et langages de programmation.  

  • Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Agir comme principal point de contact technique entre la direction, les clients et les équipes d’ingénierie afin de définir les exigences d’intégration, de système et de données.  

  • Exécution modulaire : Décomposer des visions produit complexes en composantes architecturales claires afin de livrer des fonctionnalités ML au sein d’un produit logiciel stable et évolutif. 

Qualifications 

  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

  • Professional Experience: Proven experience as a Software Architect or Systems Engineer in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Industry Context: Prior experience in industries with complex multi-disciplinary teams such as robotics, smart grids, precision agriculture, game development, or aerospace. 

  • Technical Proficiency: 

  • Generalist Tooling: Fluency with Git, and the Unix shell, with a strong ability to work across multiple programming languages as needed (ideally including one or more of Python, C++, C#). 

  • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of how to integrate ML models into production software (e.g., API design, message brokers, and containerization, compute and memory budgeting). 

  • ML Literacy: While you may not be training models daily, you must have enough ML-adjacent experience to understand model constraints, data requirements, and the "state of the art." 

  • Experience with fine-tuning and deploying models is a plus. 

  • Attributes: 

  • Strategic Decision-Making: Ability to perform "Build vs. Buy" analyses for ML components. 

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to translate high-level product vision into concrete engineering specs for both technical leadership and specialized engineers. 

  • Conscientiousness: High attention to detail regarding system stability and interoperability 

Qualifications 

  • Diplôme en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe.  

  • Expérience démontrée en tant qu’architecte logiciel, architecte de solutions ou ingénieur(e) système dans un environnement dynamique.  

  • Une expérience dans des secteurs multidisciplinaires tels que la robotique, les réseaux intelligents, l’agriculture de précision, le développement de jeux vidéo ou l’aérospatiale est fortement valorisée. 

  • Compétences techniques 

  • Outillage généraliste : Excellente maîtrise de Git et des environnements Unix, avec la capacité de travailler dans plusieurs langages de programmation selon les besoins, idéalement Python, C++ ou C#.  

  • Connaissances architecturales : Compréhension approfondie de l’intégration de modèles ML dans des logiciels de production, incluant la conception d’API, les courtiers de messages, la conteneurisation ainsi que la planification des ressources de calcul et de mémoire.  

  • Littératie ML : Expérience connexe suffisante en apprentissage automatique pour comprendre les contraintes des modèles, les besoins en données et l’état de l’art, même sans entraîner des modèles au quotidien.  

  • Atout : Une expérience en ajustement fin (fine-tuning) et en déploiement de modèles d’apprentissage automatique constitue un avantage important. 

  • Qualités recherchées 

  • Prise de décision stratégique : Capacité à réaliser des analyses pertinentes de type build vs. buy pour les composants et systèmes intégrant du ML.  

  • Communication : Excellente capacité à traduire une vision produit de haut niveau en spécifications d’ingénierie concrètes pour la direction et les équipes techniques spécialisées.  

  • Rigueur : Grande attention accordée à la stabilité des systèmes, à l’interopérabilité et à la maintenabilité à long terme. 

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Telemundo Arizona seeks an individual with a comprehensive understanding of television news production, outstanding writing and verbal communication skills, and on-camera live reporting. Individuals must also know about Dalet, iNews, non-linear editing systems, and camera operation.

Responsibilities

  • This individual will manage shooting, writing, and editing daily stories and gather material to contribute to building the rundown.
  • This person is responsible and must be able to set up, run, and manage live shots independently.
  • File stories for our OTT (Over the Top) Platforms.
  • Write, produce, and present fair and correct news and feature stories.
  • Keep information on news events locally and nationally.
  • Develop and keep a network of contacts supplying access to exclusive stories.
  • Investigate information to show facts and find the truth.
  • Gather information on newsworthy events and write, produce, and present fair, correct, and unbiased news stories as assigned.
  • Handle supplying on-air news in the studio and frequent field shoots.
  • Draft stories, headlines, and news updates for television, online, and digital platforms.
  • Write, produce, and present fair, correct, and unbiased news stories as assigned through the creative use of the video camera and proficient lighting and editing skills.
  • Abide by NBC Telemundo news policies and guidelines.
  • Present newscasts to the viewer in a professional manner.
  • Responsible for presenting breaking news to viewers during live and outside regularly scheduled newscasts.

  • Send daily to the assignment desk an email with at least three-enterprise story proposals.
  • Able to make phone calls to set up interviews. These calls may happen outside of regular working hours.

  • Able to respond quickly to breaking news and take directions from and interact with the assignment desk, producers, reporters, anchors, and production control room personnel.
  • Keep technical equipment in optimal operating conditions, including cameras and lighting gear.
  • Minimum one year of experience shooting with HD Cam.
  • Minimum one year of experience working with film or video lighting.
  • Minimum three years of experience as a reporter in a Spanish top 10 broadcast television market.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

About the Role

NBC 5 Chicago (WMAQ) and is seeking a dynamic, engaging and enterprising multiplatform storyteller. This person should be a news breaker that our viewers trust and want to watch as they’re getting answers on issues that affect their lives. They will focus on audience impact and providing context for stories of multiple lengths and formats across linear television, streaming, social media, and digital publishing.

Why This Role Matters

Trust is at an all-time low in many parts of everyday life. Our communities need journalists who fight for them, explain why a story matters and tell it through people they can connect with. That means making complicated topics easy to understand, delivering clear takeaways and reporting with empathy. We need someone who feels relatable and authentic—someone viewers trust to have their back and help them better understand the world they’re living through.

What You’ll Do

  • Break news on issues that affect viewers in the Chicago market
  • Research, develop, write, and produce short, medium, and long-term news stories and projects
  • Deliver reports regularly on all platforms in multiple formats
  • Tell stories through the lens of viewer impact on their life, neighborhood, family, happiness, and physical, mental, and financial wellness
  • Craft compelling stories that viewers can connect with and want to watch
  • Produce breaking and developing news stories by contributing to both the overall newsgathering process and by producing reporting for airing/publishing
  • Build a deep bench of sources that allow you and the station to be ahead on a story to ensure our reporting is driving the conversation
  • Host special programming across platforms
  • Nurture relationships with a variety of sources that allow you to contribute to any relevant storyline we’re covering
  • Recruit new viewers to your reporting and our brand across multiple platforms including social media
  • Iterate on new storytelling methods with photojournalists and leadership
  • Be a great teammate that contributes to the mission and vision the newsroom
  • Work in concert with newsroom leadership and the NBC News Group Legal and Standards team to conduct and present legal, accurate, and ethical reports

You Should Have

  • A minimum of 10 years reporting on-camera delivering unique, engaging, and concise reports in multiple formats across platforms
  • A hunger to pitch enterprising stories every day to keep yourself, our news programs, and station relevant and a trusted first-to-check source in the market
  • A thirst to score exclusives, break news, elevate new storylines and win every day
  • A skilled storyteller who knows how to frame a story — no matter how dry — to make a viewer understand its importance and why the report matters
  • A sharp editorial eye focused on accuracy, ethics, fairness, and diverse
    community representation
  • A fail-fast mentality with a willingness to take risks, try new things, and learn from wins and failures for future use
  • A curious, creative spirit and an instinct for what will “stop the scroll” and attract loyal viewers to one or more of our products
  • An owner mentality to ensure that the entire organization always performs at its best

Bonus, If You Have A…

  • Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking Spanish
  • Experience anchoring newscasts or hosting multiplatform shows
  • Understanding of story-centricity and related workflows
  • Background shooting and editing on a variety of equipment and tools
  • History of producing written, video and graphical content for digital news outlets
  • Familiarity with linear and digital analytics and platform performance insights

Required Qualifications (The Corporate Stuff)

  • Adhere to NBC News Group standards, policies and ethics
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must be willining to work in Chicago, IL
  • Must be available to weekends, evenings and holidays as required
  • Must be able to work in the field and be licensed to operate a vehicle
  • Must join SAG-AFTRA union if not currently a member
  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

Salary Range: $100,000-$140,000 (based on experience)

NBCUniversal is seeking a Principal Character Artist (Face) to define and drive facial art standards and solve complex character challenges for an ambitious interactive entertainment experience. This role is responsible for ensuring that facial assets achieve the highest visual quality, expressiveness, and technical quality across the project.

The Principal Character Artist (Face) will work closely with the Lead Character Artist (Face), Animation, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure that facial systems support both artistic vision and production needs. The role focuses on advancing pipelines, methodologies, and facial systems, acting as a key expert in areas such as scanning, blendshape workflows, real-time character performance and will drive benchmarks.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define and maintain high-quality standards for facial assets across the project.
  • Solve complex artistic and technical challenges related to facial realism and performance.
  • Act as an expert in facial systems including scanning, blendshape pipelines, and real-time character workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Animation and Technical Art teams to ensure seamless integration of facial rigs and performance systems.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of facial pipelines, tools, and best practices.
  • Produce benchmarks and ensure consistency and quality across facial assets within the production pipeline.
  • Support the Lead Character Artist (Face) and broader team with high-level expertise and guidance.
  • Drive innovation in facial workflows to improve expressive realism, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Review and validate facial content to ensure alignment with artistic and technical standards.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste d’Artiste principal en personnages (Face) afin de définir et de faire progresser les normes artistiques liées aux visages et de résoudre des défis complexes liés aux personnages pour une expérience ambitieuse de divertissement interactif. Ce rôle est responsable de veiller à ce que les ressources faciales atteignent les plus hauts standards de qualité visuelle, d’expressivité et d’excellence technique à l’échelle du projet.

La personne occupant le poste d’Artiste principal en personnages (Visage) travaillera en étroite collaboration avec l’Artiste en chef des personnages (Face), les équipes d’Animation, d’Art technique et d’autres disciplines afin de s’assurer que les systèmes faciaux répondent à la fois à la vision artistique et aux besoins de production. Le rôle est axé sur l’avancement des pipelines, des méthodologies et des systèmes faciaux, en agissant comme personne experte de référence dans des domaines tels que la numérisation 3D, les flux de travail de blendshapes, la performance de personnages en temps réel, et en établissant des références de qualité.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Définir et maintenir des normes de haute qualité pour les ressources faciales à l’échelle du projet.
  • Résoudre des défis artistiques et techniques complexes liés au réalisme facial et à la performance des personnages.
  • Agir à titre de personne experte en systèmes faciaux, notamment en matière de numérisation 3D, de pipelines de blendshapes et de flux de travail en temps réel.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d’Animation et d’Art technique afin d’assurer une intégration harmonieuse des rigs faciaux et des systèmes de performance.
  • Contribuer à la conception et à l’évolution des pipelines faciaux, des outils et des meilleures pratiques.
  • Produire des références de qualité et assurer la cohérence et la qualité des ressources faciales au sein du pipeline de production.
  • Soutenir l’Artiste en chef des personnages (Face) et l’équipe élargie grâce à une expertise et à des conseils de haut niveau.
  • Favoriser l’innovation dans les flux de travail faciaux afin d’améliorer le réalisme expressif, l’évolutivité et l’efficacité.
  • Réviser et valider le contenu facial afin d’assurer son alignement avec les normes artistiques et techniques.

 

      Basic Qualifications

      • Extensive experience in AAA game development with a focus on modular character art.
      • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in high-quality facial modeling and realism.
      • Advanced understanding of human facial anatomy, expressions, and performance.
      • Strong expertise in facial systems, including blendshapes, scanning, and real-time pipelines.
      • Experience working closely with Animation and Technical Art teams.
      • Strong understanding of modular character pipelines and production workflows.
      • Ability to solve complex artistic and technical challenges.
      • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

      Desired Characteristics

      • Experience developing or improving facial pipelines and systems at scale.
      • Strong knowledge of performance capture workflows.
      • Experience with Unreal Engine and modern character pipelines (e.g., Metahuman).
      • Experience working with distributed teams or external partners.
      • Passion for pushing realism and character expressiveness.
      • Desire to think and explore innovative solutions.

      Qualifications de base

      • Expérience approfondie du développement de jeux AAA, avec un accent sur l’art de personnages modulaires.
      • Portfolio solide démontrant une expertise en modélisation faciale de haute qualité et en réalisme.
      • Compréhension avancée de l’anatomie faciale humaine, des expressions et de la performance.
      • Grande expertise des systèmes faciaux, y compris les blendshapes, la numérisation 3D et les pipelines en temps réel.
      • Expérience de collaboration étroite avec les équipes d’Animation et d’Art technique.
      • Excellente compréhension des pipelines de personnages modulaires et des flux de production.
      • Capacité à résoudre des défis artistiques et techniques complexes.
      • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en collaboration.

      Caractéristiques souhaitées

      • Expérience dans le développement ou l’amélioration de pipelines et de systèmes faciaux à grande échelle.
      • Excellente connaissance des flux de travail de capture de performance.
      • Expérience avec Unreal Engine et les pipelines modernes de personnages (p. ex., Metahuman).
      • Expérience de travail avec des équipes distribuées ou des partenaires externes.
      • Passion pour repousser les limites du réalisme et de l’expressivité des personnages.
      • Désir de réfléchir à des solutions innovantes et de les explorer.
