NBCUniversal is seeking a Principal Vegetation Artist to own and drive the quality, systems, and visual consistency of vegetation for an ambitious interactive entertainment experience. This role is responsible for defining high-quality standards across trees, plants, and ecosystems, while ensuring that vegetation content supports realism, artistic cohesion, and scalable world building. 

Reporting to the Lead Artist (Environment), the Principal Vegetation Artist will work closely with Environment, Procedural, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure vegetation systems support artistic direction, production goals, and technical constraints. The role involves acting as an expert authority for vegetation creation and implementation, driving innovation, guiding workflows, and supporting scalable ecosystem solutions across large environments. 

Responsibilities 

  • Define and maintain vegetation quality standards across trees, plants, ground cover, and ecosystem content. 

  • Drive the creation and implementation of vegetation systems that support realism, variety, and artistic cohesion. 

  • Act as an expert authority for assets vegetation workflows, eco-system logic, and content scalability. 

  • Collaborate closely with Procedural, Environment, Tech Art, Houdini and Lighting teams to ensure proper integration. 

  • Support the design and evolution of vegetation assets pipelines, tools, and best practices. 

  • Ensure vegetation assets and systems meet artistic, technical, and performance requirements. 

  • Contribute to scalable world-building strategies from high-end to mobile targets. 

  • Guide vegetation direction across biomes, neighborhoods, and environmental storytelling needs. 

  • Review and validate vegetation content to ensure consistency, quality, and implementation standards. 

  • Maintain visibility on quality, risks, and production challenges across vegetation systems and content. 

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste d’Artiste principal.e en végétation afin d’assurer la responsabilité et l’orientation de la qualité, des systèmes et de la cohérence visuelle de la végétation pour une ambitieuse expérience de divertissement interactif. Ce rôle est responsable de définir des normes de haute qualité pour les arbres, les plantes et les écosystèmes, tout en veillant à ce que le contenu végétal soutienne le réalisme, la cohésion artistique et la création d’univers évolutifs.

Relevant de l’Artiste Lead (Environnement), la personne occupant le poste d’Artiste principal.e en végétation travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’Environnement, de Génération procédurale, d’Art technique et d’autres disciplines afin de s’assurer que les systèmes de végétation soutiennent la direction artistique, les objectifs de production et les contraintes techniques. Le rôle consiste à agir comme personne experte de référence pour la création et l’implantation de la végétation, à favoriser l’innovation, à guider les flux de travail et à soutenir des solutions d’écosystèmes évolutives dans de vastes environnements.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Définir et maintenir des normes de qualité de la végétation pour les arbres, les plantes, les couvre-sols et le contenu des écosystèmes.
  • Diriger la création et l’implantation de systèmes de végétation favorisant le réalisme, la diversité et la cohésion artistique.
  • Agir comme personne experte de référence pour les flux de travail liés aux actifs de végétation, à la logique des écosystèmes et à l’évolutivité du contenu.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de Génération procédurale, d’Environnement, d’Art technique, Houdini et d’Éclairage afin d’assurer une intégration adéquate.
  • Soutenir la conception et l’évolution des pipelines, des outils et des meilleures pratiques liés aux actifs de végétation.
  • Veiller à ce que les actifs et les systèmes de végétation répondent aux exigences artistiques, techniques et de performance.
  • Contribuer à des stratégies évolutives de création d’univers adaptées aux plateformes allant du haut de gamme au mobile.
  • Orienter la direction de la végétation à travers différents biomes, quartiers et besoins de narration environnementale.
  • Réviser et valider le contenu végétal afin d’assurer la cohérence, la qualité et le respect des normes d’implantation.
  • Maintenir une visibilité constante sur la qualité, les risques et les défis de production liés aux systèmes et au contenu de végétation.
  • Extensive experience in AAA game development with a focus on vegetation, environment art, or ecosystem creation on at least one published title. 

  • Proven expertise in creating high-quality vegetation for real-time environments using tools like SpeedTree. 

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating vegetation quality across trees, plants, and natural systems. 

  • Strong understanding of vegetation pipelines, scalability constraints, and real-time performance for asset creation. 

  • Experience with ecosystem thinking, environmental composition, and world-building support. 

  • Experience collaborating across Environment, Procedural, Technical Art, and production teams. 

  • Strong understanding of modern game engines and vegetation implementation workflows. 

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. 

 

Desired Characteristics 

  • Experience building vegetation assets for large-scale or open-world productions. 

  • Familiarity with procedural world-building workflows and systemic ecosystem approaches. 

  • Experience with tools such as Houdini, SpeedTree, or similar vegetation authoring solutions. 

  • Experience working with Unreal Engine pipelines. 

  • Experience collaborating with outsourcing partners or distributed teams. 

  • Strong artistic sensitivity to realism, biodiversity, and environmental storytelling. 

  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to bridge creative and technical constraints. 

  • Desire to think and explore innovative solutions. 

Qualifications de base 

  • Expérience significative en développement de jeux AAA avec un focus sur la végétation, les environnements ou la création d’écosystèmes sur au moins un titre publie. 

  • Expertise démontrée dans la création de végétation de haute qualité pour des environnements temps réel utilisant des outils tels que SpeedTree. 

  • Portfolio solide démontrant une forte qualité sur arbres, plantes et systèmes naturels. 

  • Bonne compréhension des pipelines de végétation, des contraintes de scalabilité et des performances en temps réel pour la creation d’assets vegetaux. 

  • Expérience en logique d’écosystème, composition environnementale et soutien au world building. 

  • Expérience de collaboration avec les équipes Environnement, Procédural, Tech Art et Production. 

  • Bonne compréhension des moteurs de jeu modernes et des workflows d’implémentation de végétation. 

  • Excellentes compétences en communication, collaboration et résolution de problèmes. 

Atouts souhaités 

  • Expérience dans la création d’assets  végétataux pour des productions à grande échelle ou open world. 

  • Connaissance des workflows procéduraux et des approches systémiques appliquées aux écosystèmes. 

  • Expérience avec des outils tels que Houdini, SpeedTree ou autres solutions de création végétale. 

  • Expérience avec les pipelines Unreal Engine. 

  • Expérience avec partenaires externes ou équipes distribuées. 

  • Sensibilité artistique forte au réalisme, à la biodiversité et au storytelling environnemental. 

  • Forte capacité de résolution de problèmes et aptitude à faire le lien entre contraintes créatives et techniques. 

  • Desir reel de penser et d’explorer des solutions innovantes.

job.title: Senior Animator - Gameplay | Animateur ou animatrice senior, Jouabilité
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial, que nous distribuons au moyen de notre portefeuille de films, de télévision et de plateformes de diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre à travers nos destinations de parcs à thème, nos produits de consommation et nos expériences à l’échelle mondiale. Nous possédons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des émissions de premier ordre par l’entremise de nos studios de cinéma et de télévision de renommée mondiale, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que les quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs à thème et des expériences de calibre mondial partout dans le monde par l’entremise d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, y compris Universal Orlando Resort, qui accueille Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour obtenir plus d’information.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que les membres de notre personnel aient l’occasion de servir leur communauté. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer des talents diversifiés afin de créer et de offrir une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Senior Gameplay Animator, you will be responsible for bringing gameplay characters to life. You have a passion for NPC and player gameplay systems and a keen eye for animation detail and quality. You have a deep understanding of body mechanics and master core animation principles like weight, posing, arcs, anticipation, and follow-through.

In the role of Senior Gameplay Animator, you will be creating high-quality character animations for navigation, interactions, conversations, and other gameplay systems.

  • Collaborate closely with a team of skilled animators, designers, and gameplay programmers.
  • Ensure animation work meets artistic goals and quality standards while respecting project deadlines.
  • Participate in animation reviews and collaborate with other team members to maintain consistency and quality.
  • Exporting, implementing and testing animations into the game engine.
  • Troubleshoot animation gameplay issues and provide solutions to ensure smooth animation production.
  • Provide guidance and feedback to junior animators, helping to mentor their development and maintain consistent quality across the board.

RESPONSABILITÉS

À titre d’animateur ou animatrice senior, Jouabilité, vous serez responsable de donner vie aux personnages de jouabilité. Vous êtes passionné·e par les systèmes de jouabilité des NPC et des personnages joueurs et possédez un sens aigu du détail ainsi qu’un souci constant de la qualité de l’animation. Vous avez une compréhension approfondie de la mécanique corporelle et maîtrisez les principes fondamentaux de l’animation, notamment le poids, les poses, les arcs, l’anticipation et le suivi du mouvement.

Dans ce rôle d’animateur ou animatrice senior, Jouabilité, vous créerez des animations de personnages de grande qualité pour la navigation, les interactions, les conversations et d’autres systèmes de jouabilité.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec une équipe d’animateurs et animatrices, de concepteurs et conceptrices ainsi que de programmeurs et programmeuses de jouabilité hautement qualifiés.
  • Veiller à ce que les travaux d’animation répondent aux objectifs artistiques et aux normes de qualité tout en respectant les échéances du projet.
  • Participer aux revues d’animation et collaborer avec les autres membres de l’équipe afin d’assurer la cohérence et la qualité du travail.
  • Exporter, intégrer et tester les animations dans le moteur de jeu.
  • Diagnostiquer les problèmes liés à l’animation et à la jouabilité et proposer des solutions afin d’assurer une production fluide des animations.
  • Fournir de l’encadrement et de la rétroaction aux animateurs et animatrices juniors, contribuer à leur développement professionnel et maintenir un niveau de qualité constant au sein de l’équipe.

Basic Requirements: 

  • 6+ years of experience in 3D character gameplay animation.
  • Strong demo reel showcasing gameplay animations.
  • Solid animation skills with a great understanding of human motion, body mechanics, biped locomotion and animation principles.
  • Strong proficiency in industry-standard animation tools such as Motionbuilder or Maya.
  • Experience in working with motion capture data and keyframe animations.
  • Having shipped a AAA game.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and communicate effectively within cross-disciplinary teams.
  • Basic technical understanding of gameplay systems and animation blend systems.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Working experience with game engines such as Unreal
  • Experience working on occupation, conversation and traversal systems
  • Understanding of animation-graph techniques and workflows
  • Understanding of root-motion and motion matching
  • Experience in developing first-person and third-person gameplay systems and good understanding of 3C concepts
  • Experience with different animation styles
  • Experience animating animal and creature characters
  • Rigging experience
  • Facial animation experience
  • Experience developing Multiplayer games

QUALIFICATIONS

Exigences de base : 

  • 6 ans ou plus d’expérience en animation de jouabilité de personnages 3D.
  • Démo professionnelle solide présentant des animations de jouabilité.
  • Excellentes compétences en animation et solide compréhension du mouvement humain, de la mécanique corporelle, de la locomotion bipède et des principes d’animation.
  • Maîtrise avancée des outils d’animation reconnus dans l’industrie, tels que MotionBuilder ou Maya.
  • Expérience de travail avec des données de capture de mouvement (motion capture) et des animations par images clés (keyframe).
  • Avoir contribué à la livraison d’un jeu AAA.
  • Capacité à collaborer efficacement et à communiquer clairement au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Compréhension technique de base des systèmes de jouabilité et des systèmes de fusion d’animation (animation blend systems).

Caractéristiques souhaitées : 

  • Expérience de travail avec des moteurs de jeu tels qu’Unreal.
  • Expérience de travail sur des systèmes d’occupation, de conversation et de déplacement (traversal).
  • Compréhension des techniques et des flux de travail liés aux animation graphs.
  • Compréhension du root motion et du motion matching.
  • Expérience dans le développement de systèmes de jouabilité à la première et à la troisième personne ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des concepts 3C.
  • Expérience avec différents styles d’animation.
  • Expérience en animation de personnages animaux et de créatures.
  • Expérience en rigging.
  • Expérience en animation faciale.
  • Expérience dans le développement de jeux multijoueurs.

job.description:

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal’s Ad Sales Creative Group, part of Rock Studios, is an industry-leading, award-winning team that develops groundbreaking creative campaigns and premium marketing experiences for the world’s most influential brands. We partner closely with advertisers to deliver custom, multi-platform solutions that leverage the power of NBCUniversal’s iconic content, talent, intellectual property and audiences across linear, streaming, digital, social and live experiences.

We are seeking a Senior Executive Producer to serve as one of the senior production leaders within Rock Studios. You will oversee a significant slate of advertising and marketing productions, partnering with creative, sales, clients and internal business teams to bring ambitious ideas from concept through final delivery.

As an ideal candidate, you will have deep production expertise with strategic leadership, strong creative instincts and exceptional business judgment. You'll need extensive experience producing integrated campaigns across a wide range of budgets, timelines and production models and be equally comfortable developing a production approach, negotiating a major production bid, finding smart solutions within limited resources, advising senior stakeholders, managing high-profile talent, leading a set, and solving problems when the unexpected happens.

This is both a hands-on Executive Producer and senior leadership role. You will directly oversee marquee projects while mentoring production teams, strengthening external partnerships and helping evolve how Rock Studios approaches production at scale.

This position reports directly to the Vice President, Production & Operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as Executive Producer across a diverse portfolio of advertising, branded content and integrated marketing initiatives—from lean, fast-turn assignments to complex marquee productions—overseeing work from early creative development and scoping through production, post-production and final delivery.
  • Partner closely with creative teams to evaluate concepts for feasibility, identify the strongest production approach and translate ambitious ideas into exceptional, executable work while protecting the creative intent.
  • Lead production across a broad range of formats, including custom branded content, digital and social campaigns, talent-led content, original branded entertainment series.
  • Own the production strategy for assigned campaigns, including production methodology, schedules, budgets, staffing models, vendor strategy, risk assessment and contingency planning.
  • Develop and manage production budgets and estimates across a wide range of scales; oversee competitive bidding, bid leveling, vendor negotiations, cost reporting, change management and final reconciliation while maximizing creative value within available resources.
  • Lead director, production company and key vendor searches; identify and negotiate with the right creative and production partners for each assignment while maintaining a strong external network of directors, producers, crews, studios and post-production partners.
  • Oversee all phases of production and post-production, including pre-production, casting, locations, talent, crew, technical planning, on-set execution, editorial, motion graphics, VFX, music, sound, color, finishing, versioning and final delivery.
  • Partner closely with Legal, Finance, Music Services, Talent Relations and other internal teams to ensure productions meet NBCUniversal standards and business requirements.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of production contracts, rights and clearances, music licensing, releases, insurance, labor requirements and applicable union and guild considerations.
  • Serve as a trusted senior production partner to internal stakeholders, clients and agencies, helping teams understand production implications, solve challenges and establish realistic scopes, budgets and timelines.
  • Participate in the development and pitching of major opportunities when production strategy, feasibility, budgeting or executional expertise is required.
  • Build trusted relationships across NBCUniversal and with clients, agencies and external partners, representing Rock Studios with credibility and authority in senior-level conversations.
  • Oversee and mentor producers and freelance production teams, establishing clear expectations and helping develop the next generation of production leaders.
  • Partner with the Vice President, Production & Operations on resource planning, production forecasting, staffing strategy, vendor strategy and allocation of production resources across the broader slate.
  • Help evolve Rock Studios’ production organization by identifying opportunities to improve workflows, methodologies and infrastructure while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, creative ambition and responsible financial stewardship.
  • Proactively assess creative, financial, logistical, legal and reputational risk and develop solutions before those risks affect the work.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in advertising and marketing production, with significant experience leading multi-platform campaigns across a range of scales and budgets—from lean, fast-turn productions to complex, high-budget work.
  • Extensive experience working within an advertising agency, creative agency, production company, brand studio, entertainment marketing organization or comparable creative production environment.
  • Ability to operate simultaneously as a strategic production leader and hands-on Executive Producer, leading multiple concurrent productions while maintaining command of creative, financial and logistical details.
  • Exceptional understanding of physical production and post-production workflows across live action, editorial, VFX, motion design, music, audio and finishing.
  • Strong command of production finance, including estimating, bidding, negotiating, cost management, forecasting and reconciliation, with the ability to maximize production value at varying budget levels.
  • Extensive experience managing directors, production companies, freelance producers, crews and post-production partners.
  • Strong knowledge of production business affairs, talent agreements, music and footage licensing, releases, rights and clearances, union and guild requirements and other production-related legal considerations.
  • Proven experience producing with celebrity or high-profile talent and managing sensitive, high-stakes productions.
  • Strong creative judgment with the ability to contribute meaningfully to creative conversations while understanding the distinction between creative leadership and production leadership.
  • Exceptional business judgment, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance creative ambition, client objectives, production realities and financial responsibility while working with senior executives, clients, creative leaders and external partners.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, make decisions quickly and remain calm, pragmatic and solutions-oriented in high-pressure environments.
  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills with experience developing producers and building high-performing production teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 12+ years of professional production experience, including substantial experience in advertising, branded content, marketing or agency production.
  • Significant experience serving as an Executive Producer or equivalent senior production leader on integrated advertising and marketing campaigns.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex productions on time, on budget and at a consistently high creative standard.
  • Experience managing production budgets of varying scale and complexity and negotiating with production companies, vendors and creative partners.
  • Willingness to travel and work outside traditional business hours when productions require it.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience within a leading advertising agency, creative agency, entertainment company, network, streamer or sophisticated in-house brand studio.
  • Experience with both traditional advertising production and emerging formats across streaming, digital, social, experiential and creator-led content.
  • A deep and current network of directors, production companies, producers, crews and post-production partners.
  • A reputation for being an excellent partner to creative teams -- someone who finds ways to make ambitious ideas happen rather than simply identifying limitations.
  • Strong executive presence paired with a low-ego, collaborative leadership style.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working in an environment where the work, technology and production models continue to evolve.
  • Passion for outstanding creative work and a track record of building the teams and production environments required to achieve it.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

NBC News Digital is seeking a Senior Manager of Commerce Growth & Operations to lead the planning and execution of strategic, cross-functional initiatives across our commerce businesses, Shop TODAY and NBC Selected. 

This role will serve as a central project management lead across the Commerce organization, translating business priorities into structured project plans and driving revenue-focused initiatives from planning through execution. The Senior Manager will establish timelines and milestones, coordinate stakeholders and dependencies, proactively identify risks and blockers, and ensure teams remain aligned and accountable throughout the project lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, strategic, and collaborative project leader who is comfortable navigating a complex organization, managing multiple concurrent initiatives, and creating structure in ambiguous environments. They are skilled at communicating with stakeholders at all levels and can translate complex cross-functional work into clear plans, priorities, decisions, and next steps. 

The ideal candidate should also have a strong understanding of analytics and budget planning as well as in-depth knowledge of affiliate commerce, affiliate networks and affiliate tracking.  

Responsibilities 

  • Serve as a central project management lead for strategic initiatives that span multiple Commerce teams, driving projects from planning through execution and ensuring stakeholders remain aligned throughout the project lifecycle. 
  • Help discover and manage the evaluation of new affiliate networks, vendors and technology partners; spearheading the initial review and collecting feedback from stakeholders then passing to Product for execution  
  • Lead cross-functional project planning and execution for key initiatives across Shop TODAY and NBC Selected, partnering with stakeholders to translate business and go-to-market strategies into actionable execution plans. 
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve team workflows, operational efficiency, project execution, and customer experience, and partner with relevant teams to develop and implement scalable solutions. 
  • Support annual and ongoing Commerce planning by helping translate organizational priorities and goals into roadmaps, project plans, measurement frameworks, and execution plans. 
  • Partner across Editorial, Product, Analytics, Business Intelligence, AI, Partnerships, Finance, Audience Development, and Leadership to coordinate project execution, clarify responsibilities, manage dependencies, and drive initiatives forward. 
  • Review weekly Commerce pacing reports for leadership, noting key growth drivers, new opportunities, and areas requiring attention. 
  • Develop a monthly executive-level Commerce business report tracking overall performance against goals and providing updates on strategic initiatives and key projects. 
  • Use performance data and cross-functional inputs to surface relevant trends, risks, and opportunities and help inform project priorities, decisions, and next steps. 
  • Establish clear accountability across project teams, ensuring owners understand deliverables and deadlines and proactively following up to keep workstreams on track. 
  • Identify project risks, blockers, and cross-functional dependencies early; develop mitigation plans, facilitate resolution, and escalate issues when appropriate to protect timelines and business objectives. 
  • Develop and deliver clear project status communications for stakeholders and senior leadership, providing visibility into progress, upcoming milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions needed, and next steps. 
  • Manage and develop one direct report focused on site operations, providing strategic direction, prioritization, and professional development. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

We’re looking for a Senior Producer for an overnight shift on a dynamic morning show who thrives in live news, leads with clarity in the control room, and elevates every segment with sharp editorial judgment and strong production instincts. This is a hands-on leadership role — guiding a team of Segment Producers, Associate Producers, and Production Assistants while partnering closely with the Executive Producer and Anchors to shape daily coverage.

If you’re energized by building a show from the ground up, confident making high-stakes decisions under pressure, and committed to mentoring journalists, this is an opportunity to have real impact every day.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with the Executive Producer, Senior Producer and Anchors to shape the daily editorial vision and build smart, urgent shows finding the best and freshest possible angles
  • Oversee and elevate scripts, intros, teases, and banners to ensure clarity, authority, and consistency
  • Guide Segment Producers, ensuring segments are visually strong and editorially sharp
  • Play a key leadership role in the control room during live broadcasts, especially during breaking news
  • Ensure all scripts, graphics, and video meet NBC News standards for accuracy, fairness, and tone
  • Collaborate with colleagues across NBC to leverage reporting, bureaus, and enterprise coverage
  • Submit ideas for story coverage, guests and correspondents on stories breaking overnight
  • Spot and execute on high potential stories
  • Fill in for Executive Producer as needed
  • Oversee the long-term and day to day staffing schedule & assignments to make sure the team’s resources are being effectively used
  • Help troubleshoot technical problems in real time
  • Oversee the production, writing, and editing of occasional tape spots
  • Mentor and develop junior producers, fostering a culture of excellent journalism, dynamic producing, collaboration, and accountability
  • 6+ years of experience in broadcast, cable, or streaming news. Morning TV experience a plus.
  • At least 2+ years in a leadership role on a live daily news program
  • Fact-check under pressure, ensure strict adherence to journalistic standards, and handle copyright or legal & standards issues
  • Demonstrated experience leading in or closely alongside a live control room
  • Excellent and efficient writing, editing, and copy-editing skills
  • Strong editorial judgment and ability to make decisions quickly under pressure
  • Proven ability to manage multiple segments and priorities simultaneously
  • Confident, calm leader who communicates clearly in a breaking news situation in person and via Slack
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
  • Must be willing and able to work in person Monday–Friday at 30 Rock

Desired Characteristics:

  • A journalist first, with deep knowledge of national and breaking news
  • Strong visual sensibility and commitment to elevated production values
  • Experience editing video in Avid and/or Premiere
  • Willing and able to mentor and grow junior members of the team
  • A positive and infectious attitude
  • Collaborative and solutions-oriented in a fast-paced environment
  • A demonstrated commitment to building a long-term career in journalism

Additional Requirements:

  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from NBCUniversal’s 30 Rockefeller Plaza office in New York, NY, five days per week. This is an overnight shift that starts at 1am

The Sous Chef – Margaritaville, will be responsible for directing, managing and successfully operating a high volume branded concept on CityWalk. As Sous Chef, the position will be a primary “go-to” for the kitchen team and responsible for the functions and flow of the back of the house.

The Sous Chef is responsible for ensuring that the food served always meets or exceeds standards of excellence. While this position will report to the Restaurant Chef, this position is responsible for setting the expectations for all kitchen team members to maximize productivity. This individual must be able to work effectively with limited supervision and demonstrate leadership to motivate others.

Essential Functions:

  • Drive operating profit goals and sales.
  • Optimize profits by controlling food, beverage, and labor costs.
  • Consistently achieve operational excellence.
  • Develop and retain exceptional talent.
  • Ensure compliance with all local, state, and federal laws regarding food quality, safety, labor, and employment.
  • Partner with Human Resources to train and develop restaurant leaders at every level.
  • Maintain or exceed weekly budgeted variable operation profit by controlling cost of goods & variable labor.
  • Communicate restaurant results to the Restaurant Chef and General Manager with recommendations for improvement.
  • Ensure high Team Member and Guest Engagement.
  • Mentors and counsels team members and enforce appropriate policies and procedures ensuring that everything is within compliance of venue and company standards.
  • Promote company's mission and values.
  • Ensure company policy and brand standards are followed.
  • Optimize profits by controlling food, beverage, and labor costs.
  • Prepare and present hourly team member reviews.
  • Complete all tasks assigned by the Executive Sous Chef on time.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Order supplies, food and ingredients based on rapidly shifting demand.
  • Hire and train kitchen staff in specific stations, and cross-train as necessary.  
  • Create schedules for kitchen staff to ensure there are always enough workers to meet the demand.
  • Maintain inventory levels and conduct full inventories.
  • Schedule and oversee necessary maintenance and repairs on kitchen appliances.

job.title: Specialist, Casting
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Specialist, Casting actively participates in the creative identification and selection of talent for non-scripted productions, series, and pilots, while supporting the execution of business-related practices and strategies for casting, talent management, and talent relations within non-scripted programming for the U.S. Hispanic market.

Responsibilities

  • Works closely with the VP of Casting regarding projects, casting needs, preferences, and specific roles.
  • Participates in calls with Executive Producers and the Development team to discuss character profiles and casting needs.
  • Works with the Director and Executive Producers to develop and brainstorm potential talent proposals, taking into consideration the emotional characteristics, physical characteristics, and physical requirements of each character or role to be cast for reality series and pilots.
  • Creates project and casting schedules in Casting Networks or similar casting systems for performer auditions.
  • Follows up with performers and agents regarding availability and interest in projects for casting purposes.
  • Evaluates casting submissions and schedules casting presentations for review and evaluation by the VP of Casting and Talent Relations.
  • Continuously identifies new talent, casting agencies, and acting schools and provides talent recommendations.
  • Requests updated resumes, photos, reels, and video materials for performers under consideration and updates applicable systems accordingly.
  • Creates talent requests and presentations and maintains updated project documentation, including Casting Share, SharePoint, Scenechronize, PowerPoint presentations, Cosmogonias, cast lists, and other related materials.
  • Maintains talent and agent databases, performance notes and feedback, and detailed records of auditions, callbacks, candidate status, and brainstorming sessions.
  • Maintains the highest standards of confidentiality and discretion in handling sensitive casting, talent, production, and business-related information, and ensures such information is shared only with appropriate stakeholders and in accordance with Company policies and practices.
  • Maintains a strict code of professional conduct in interactions with talent, talent managers, and talent agencies, including appropriate discretion, confidentiality, and adherence to Company guidelines and regulations regarding conflicts of interest.
  • Builds and maintains strong relationships with talent, managers, publicists, Telemundo and external clients, and key executives.
  • Coordinates and supervises talent for assigned non-scripted series and projects, including castings, events, special dates, and related activities.
  • Works with the Director and VP of Casting on talent requests for local events, specials, and other business priorities.
  • Participates in and provides talent support on location, including media training, red carpets, show premieres, events, after-parties, press junkets, and promotional activities, as needed for assigned shows.
  • Assists with internal talent requests from Daytime properties, specials and shows, Digital, Telemundo International, Public/Community Affairs, Publicity, and other internal partners.
  • In conjunction with the Manager and client, supports talent and companion travel and logistics coordination, including airfare, hotel, transportation, per diem, glam, and agenda management.
  • Assists in coordinating talent participation at Telemundo-related events, including Billboard Awards and premieres, as needed.
  • Provides support to talent during production and promotional activities, as needed.
  • Supports travel and logistics arrangements for talent, including travel requirements, contact information, visas, and coordination with managers and publicists, as needed.
  • Supports talent requests for live events and specials, as needed.
  • Assists with Digital and Social Media talent activations, including social media outreach to talent and activations across platforms such as YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram.
  • Works under the direct supervision of the VP of Casting and is responsible for completing other duties as assigned by the supervisor.
  • Ensures all work is performed in accordance with technical guidelines, operating procedures, and applicable EHS/OSHA regulations and procedures.
  • Follows Company policies and applicable laws and regulations to protect their own health and safety, as well as that of other workers, the public, and the environment.
  • Raises concerns regarding potential violations of EHS policies to their manager, business leader, and EHS leader.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in casting and/or talent relations within the entertainment industry.
  • Must speak Spanish verbally. Spanish is a must.
  • Extensive knowledge of talent casting, television, contracts, negotiations, and recruiting.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Desired Characteristics

  • Knowledge of entertainment industry standards and practices.
  • Familiarity with Spanish-language television.
  • Experience in administrative roles, preferably within entertainment or event production.

The Sr. Business Analyst will be responsible for executing NBCU’s strategy and work in an HR technology team focused on SuccessFactors Recruiting and Onboarding solutions. Currently, the application portfolio includes SuccessFactors, SmartRecruiters, and ClickBoarding products, which are expected to be consolidated within a 3-5 year time frame.

Engagement with HR business partners is a critical competency of this role. Collaboration with a team of technology professionals as well as engaging with vendors and an engineering team are essential tasks to perform project and support activities. This role requires hands-on application configuration and testing work as well as collaborating across teams to enable enhancement development, reporting/analytics and security requirements for holistic solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Engage with business partners to understand processes in scope, requirements and business needs for support and project work
  • Collaborate with vendors, business partners and IT teams to provide the best solution based on requirements
  • Provide innovative solutions beyond system limitations
  • Execute system configuration and create reports (Report Stories, BIRT, other native reporting tools, etc.)
  • Collaborate on authorization model designs and work with engineering teams for enhancement / automation requirements (SAP BTP, automations, AI)
  • Manage and execute project activities for applications/modules in scope
  • Provide day-to-day support for applications/modules (tickets, vendor release adoption, IT governance tasks, enhancements, etc.)
  • Ability to navigate SAP HCM OM/PA modules for Talent Management specific data, understand and create RICEF specifications
  • Continuously review and optimize existing SAP HCM, SuccessFactors and other 3rd party SaaS solutions

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, IT, Systems Engineering, or other relevant fields in technology; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of delivering high-quality HR/IT solutions and related project/support work
  • 5+ years experience with core HR systems (preferred SAP HCM / SF Employee Central) and employee life cycle management (hire-to-retire)
  • Hands-on configuration experience in SuccessFactors 
  • 3+ years experience with SaaS HR solutions, specifically SuccessFactors, optional SmartRecruiters and PageUp
  • 3+ years of experience in requirements gathering techniques, solution modeling, and documentation
  • Expertise in SuccessFactors Onboarding (2.0); Employee Central / BizX / IAS touch point knowledge is required 
  • Understanding of SaaS recruiting solutions
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Foundational knowledge of HR Talent Management processes, specifically for the applications/modules in scope
  • Excellent project/task management skills with a track record of successful delivery
  • Proven ability to collaborate across business, operations, and IT teams (incl. engineering/development) to create holistic solutions
  • Availability for critical after-hours production deployments, system upgrades, data corrections, and patching
  • Ability to work with teams/team members across multiple office locations/geographies
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Occasional travel within the USA

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PageUp and SmartRecruiters SaaS solutions 

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

job.title: Sr Cyber Security Manager (AI)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Sr Cyber Security Manager is a critical member of the NBC Universal Cyber Security organization, responsible for executing and contributing to the Cyber Security strategy. This role will oversee operational engagement with key leaders across AI Product, Strategy and Engineering teams within the Operations & Technology organization.

NBC Universal takes a threat-centric, intelligence-forward view of Cyber Security, so this position requires a security professional with experience in proactive defense and the technical and business acumen to translate that insight into a tactical roadmap. The Sr Cyber Security Manager will build strong relationships with the Operations & Technology organization, leadership teams, and supporting teams to assess business practices, identify gaps in security controls and lead development and execution of cyber security strategies.  A successful candidate is expected to effectively engage with Cyber Security leadership, business technical teams, internal audit, clients and regulators. This role requires the candidate to communicate the importance of key NBC Universal Cyber Security programs and services to obtain support, trust, and buy-in from business partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with business leadership and service owners on the execution of the Cyber Security strategy; proactively addressing the needs of the business to consistently meet or exceed established levels of security
  • Communicate and coordinate NBC Universal’s Cyber Security strategy, programs and services with a diverse group of business stakeholders
  • Understand the business workflows and engage with business leadership and teams to identify risks and business-aware mitigation strategies.
  • Provide Cyber Security thought leadership and counsel, with an understanding of business culture, audience and climate
  • Effectively articulate the threat landscape to business stakeholders and how cyber security’s strategy is aligned to defend against these threats
  • Bridge individual security engineering assessments, compliance status and incident reports to calibrate the priorities.  Look beyond the individual results to find overarching messages--both successes and shortcomings--and identify the critical needle moving efforts
  • Track and coordinate Cyber Security involvement in technical and business driven technology projects
  • Partner with security incident response team to resolve and close the investigation of incidents with postmortem and remediation plans
  • Support and develop business-relevant metrics and key performance indicators supporting the measurement of Cyber security program maturity

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of work experience in Information Technology, or 7 years of experience with a Master’s level education in a related field
  • 3+ years of work experience in Cyber Security
  • 2+ years of experience in customer facing technical engagement roles, including service and solution delivery.
  • 2+ years of experience managing, coordinating, tracking projects using various PM tools
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of time
  • Must be located within a commutable distance to any of the following locations:
    • New York, NY
    • Universal City, CA
    • Centennial, CO
    • Stamford, CT
    • Miami, FL
    • Orlando, FL

Desired Characteristics:

  • Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, LLMs, and agentic workflows
  • News or Media Entertainment industry experience
  • Experience with security of enterprise products (i.e., Microsoft suite, Collaboration tools, development tools)
  • Ability to translate complex technical and security risks into business-focused recommendations for senior leadership
  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field of study
  • Understanding of data privacy, intellectual property, regulatory, and compliance considerations related to AI
  • Training or Certifications in Cyber Security specific disciplines
  • Experience leading Information Security or Technology teams and concurrent projects
  • Demonstrated work history delivering security solutions in a global enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate to all levels of an organization and build consensus
  • Demonstrated ability to oversee technical efforts while maintaining strategic alignment with key goals and objectives
  • Demonstrated negotiation and problem resolution skills
  • Demonstrated interpersonal, analytical, organizational, written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated knowledge of recognized Information Security related standards and technologies
  • Demonstrated knowledge of International Information Security and Privacy regulations, laws, and policies

Additional Requirements:

  • Commutable Remote: This position requires some onsite presence, as necessary, from an identified NBCUniversal location, with the ability to work remotely the other days. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $165,000 - $195,000 (bonus eligible)

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. job.description:

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. A successful candidate will be a key part of the Workforce Planning and Analysis team within the Universal Studios Hollywood Finance organization. They will have broad visibility and exposure to all departments of the park and to senior leadership as part of this important business priority. Specifically, the role will play a lead role in the Labor Forecasting (roster/hiring planning) process and bring data analysis and reporting capability broadly to operations management and to the Labor Support team. When successful, these contributions will help deliver the key USH business objectives of driving employee satisfaction, through optimizing labor utilization, scheduling consistency, new hire training, and hiring targets

Labor Forecasting

  • Owner of hiring plans for USH. Partners with Industrial Engineering, Theme Park departments, HR Staffing and Learning & Organizational Development teams to understand and model business labor needs, budget, and corresponding hiring targets for all departments and for all seasons
  • Analyze current staffing levels, attrition, availability, transfers, terminations, and anticipated business demand to help set hiring targets by department gain alignment to the recommended plan
  • Partner with HR staffing team to execute and be accountable to the plan within their hiring timing and capacity constraints
  • Thoroughly understand the drivers of Team Member utilization, quantify/measure them and then identify and execute initiatives to increase utilization and therefore reduce hiring
  • Support the labor schedulers to operationally execute the initiatives and strategies behind utilization, including reporting, tools and other support

Analytics and Reporting

  • Help identify the key performance indicators for WP&A across all groups and build corresponding analysis/reporting
  • Analyze past and current performance to provide a baseline for schedule quality and collaborate with department leadership to define future improvement goals
  • Leverage systems and available data to create and manage real-time tracking and evaluation of weekly schedules to enable labor utilization and consistency improvement targets
  • Identify and recommend key steps to improve performance, based on data analytics

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business/accounting/finance or related field with 3 plus years Finance experience with progression.
  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through nbcuni.careers.com to be considered.
  • Willing to work in Universal City and work overtime, and/or on weekends with short notice
  • Willing to submit to a background investigation and have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Strong problem-solving and project management skills
  • Excellent analytical abilities are required, including advanced Excel skills
  • SAP and/or Power BI knowledge a plus
  • Interpersonal and leadership capability with ability to influence diverse/cross-functional teams
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and communicate clear recommendations to cross functional partners / leadership.
  • Experience using AI-enabled software a plus.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $75,000 - $95,000

job.title: Sr Manager, External Affairs USH
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, External Affairs is responsible for shaping and executing strategies that strengthen Universal Studios Hollywood operations and reputation in California. This role serves as the Theme Parks primary on-the-ground external affairs leader by driving proactive engagement with key stakeholders including local and state elected officials, government agencies (City, County and State) and industry associations.  This role collaborates cross-functionally and works in partnership with Universal Destinations and Experiences (UDX), Comcast and NBCUniversal State & Local Government Affairs, Corporate Communications and Global Real Estate departments to support initiatives that drive growth strategies for the destination. This position will own the development and delivery of local government relations strategies that impact park operations by building and maintaining relationships with industry peers and associations to advocate theme park priorities and position the company as a trusted regional partner and employer of choice.  This leader protects and advances the corporate brand in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment. 

Major Responsibilities 

  • Research, track and provide briefing papers to internal stakeholders on local ordinances and state legislation on issues supporting or impacting tourism, transportation, park operations and business regulation. Leverages information to align, navigate, and execute Universal’s relationship strategy in accordance with government proceedings.
  • Partners with business units on local issues and response efforts for USH, including analysis, monitoring, escalation and on-the-ground coordination to support the Theme Park.
  • Manages business and industry association relationships throughout Los Angeles and California including board membership, sponsorship, and issues management. Positions USH as a business leader and partner by building and maintaining relationships with key community stakeholders and leaders. Ensures compliance with all government laws for hosting events following Comcast Political Affairs Guidelines.
  • Support business unit strategic plans that support park initiatives, including community impact, neighborhood engagement, and USH corporate communications.
  • Engages with numerous regulatory agencies at the local and state level with key internal stakeholders to ensure operational efficiencies and compliance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Public Relations, Communications, Business Administration or related field is required.
  • 10+ years of legislative, community relations, government, or external affairs experience is required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to identify, assess and remediate and execute external affairs strategies
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize issues management
  • Effective verbal, written communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability to interact with and influence all levels of the organization, community organizations and elected officials effectively

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the CDP product domain within the Customer Experience Platform (CXP) Martech team. This is a high-ownership IC (Individual Contributor) role responsible for the Customer Data Platform (CDP) as a shared global platform: the identity and audience data layer that serves Peacock, SkyShowtime, and NOW.

You'll be the primary intake point for CDP-related requirements from MarTech local teams across all three propositions, own and prioritize the backlog, and drive delivery in close partnership with Engineering (platform instrumentation) and Decision Science (data pipelines and attributes). A core operating principle for this role: solutions must be designed globally first, scalable across all applications, not built for a single product.

In this role you will:
Stakeholder Intake & Prioritization

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Peacock, SkyShowtime, and NOW MarTech and Marketing teams, owning all incoming CDP requests and proactively identifying data quality and data collection opportunities to scale our product customer lifecycle and marketing operation efforts.
  • Translate those needs into well-structured platform requirements, always with a global lens; solutions need to work across all three products, not just the one making the request.
  • Manage and prioritize the backlog, balancing urgency against platform impact and engineering capacity.
  • Keep documentation and roadmap status visible and current across all partners.

Platform Delivery & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner closely with Decision Science and Engineering teams to define business requirements for platform instrumentation (e.g., event schemas, platform events, and data capture), ensuring alignment with global standards and prioritizing delivery based on business needs.
  • Partner with Decision Science on pipeline requirements, new attribute builds, and feed delivery to make sure data flows correctly into downstream systems.
  • Own the coordination of delivery milestones, testing, and QA sign-off, acting as the connective tissue between marketing stakeholders and the technical teams who build and operate the platform.

What You Have

  • Ability to intake, synthesize, and prioritize requirements from multiple marketing stakeholders across competing products and timelines
  • A platform-first mindset — instinct to design solutions that are global and scalable across multiple products rather than solving for one at a time

job.description:

We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

As our Senior Software Engineer, you’ll join the Content Delivery Engineering team (CDE) within NBCUniversal’s Global Video Engineering organization in New York City, USA. Your mission is to get involved with delivering outstanding VOD, live event, and linear streaming experiences to millions of viewers across our US, UK, EU, and Africa services - including Peacock, SkyShowtime, Showmax, and NOW/WOW.

You’ll collaborate daily with colleagues across the US, UK and beyond – excellent communication skills are essential. Our team specializes in large-scale Multi-Content Delivery Network design and operations, performance telemetry and analytics, selection & interfacing with content origins via multiple workflows - dynamic ad insertion, manifest manipulation and integrating new player technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance software systems and features—primarily in Go—used to deliver world-class video content at massive scale for brands like Peacock, SkyShowtime, Showmax, and NOW/WOW.
  • Build reliable, testable, and user-focused services supporting key streaming workflows, such as VOD, live events, linear channels, dynamic ad insertion, and manifest manipulation.
  • Participate in thoughtful and consistent code reviews that promote high code quality, clear architectural patterns, and healthy engineering culture.
  • Partner closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to architect systems that are highly available, resilient, performant, and fault-tolerant across multiple regions.
  • Leverage observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces) and performance analytics to detect issues proactively and drive fast, data-driven root-cause analysis.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of multi-CDN strategies, routing logic, and origin workflows that ensure exceptional global streaming performance.
  • Collaborate daily with engineers across the US, UK, EU, and Africa—requiring clear communication and strong documentation skills.
  • Influence technical direction, system architecture, and best practices as a senior member of the Content Delivery Engineering team.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development in Go (preferred) or Python.
  • Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) using containers and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD workflows and experience using Git-based repositories, automated testing frameworks, and build pipelines.
  • Practical experience with Site Reliability Engineering concepts such as reliability targets (SLIs/SLOs), auto-scaling, distributed systems reliability, or incident response.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to articulate design decisions and collaborate with distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with CDNs (e.g., Akamai, CloudFront, Fastly, Cloudflare) or streaming media delivery systems.
  • Understanding of video streaming technologies such as HLS, DASH, manifests, origins, or content routing.
  • Experience building systems that support global scale, multi-region deployments, or high availability architectures.

job.title: SVP, Head of Studio Data & Insights
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Role Overview 

The SVP, Head of Studio Data & Insights leads Universal Entertainment's data strategy, analytics and AI insights functions in Los Angeles. Reporting to the EVP, the role owns the teams - their people, priorities, standards and delivery - and provides the sustained executive presence and stakeholder leadership that drives adoption of the function's agenda within the rhythms of the studio. 

Mission 

Over the past six years, the data function has built a substantial insights platform and analytical capability; this role will embed these capabilities in how the studio makes decisions throughout the content lifecycle, and will lead and develop the LA organization that delivers them.  

Success in this role requires a leader who shapes strategy with a one-company mindset, inspires transformation and innovation, drives execution excellence, and builds inclusive, empowered teams that can adapt through change while modelling NBCUniversal’s values. 

Core Responsibilities 

  • Act as the EVP's senior partner in-region, operating with delegated authority within an agreed decision framework and serving as the function's voice in executive, fast-moving, and cross-functional forums where in-region presence and judgement are required. 
  • Provide leadership and direction for the Los Angeles-based data strategy and analytics organization, including teams focused on insights, analytics, and AI-enabled decision support. Partner closely with the LA-based SVPs and their teams to align priorities, support delivery across the portfolio, shape the operating plan, and foster a high standard of work and impact across the region. 
  • Identify, develop, and empower talent across the leadership bench. Raise the bar through hiring, coaching, and succession planning; build collaborative and inclusive teams; grow senior leaders who can own their areas independently; and establish clear rules on which decisions genuinely need escalation. 
  • Lead and deepen the function's senior stakeholder relationships across UE's departments, owning the strategic agenda, the value narrative, and the forward asks for each. This includes establishing a consistent rhythm of engagement with department leadership — from quarterly strategic reviews to proactive intelligence — so that each senior partner has a clear, current view of the value being delivered and the opportunities ahead. 
  • Represent the Los Angeles’ studio’s requirements into the global data & analytics platform roadmap. Work with the EVP and the UK-based data platform team to translate stakeholder needs into prioritised input on analytics platforms and the underlying data and AI capability — qualifying genuine capability gaps, making the case for what the studio needs, and setting clear expectations with stakeholders on what the platform delivers and when. 
  • Partner closely with Strategy and Research teams as the function's nearest neighbours, ensuring data, analytics and AI insight is combined with strategic and audience research rather than delivered in parallel — presenting a single, coherent evidence base to decision-makers and jointly shaping the questions worth answering. 
  • Drive adoption and embedding of central insights platforms and AI-enabled analyses across creative development, greenlight, marketing, and distribution for Universal Entertainment's Film and TV divisions. The emphasis is evangelism, mandate-building, and integration into existing decision processes and systems — and success is measured in how deeply the capability becomes part of how departments work. 
  • Own the evidence of impact. Establish how the function's contribution is tracked and articulated — where insight changed a decision, and what it was worth — and carry that case to UE and NBCU leadership, so the mandate is renewed on demonstrated value rather than goodwill. 
  • Orchestrate across the function's teams in and outside the region, convening workstreams into strategically aligned and coherent outputs, and ensuring stakeholders experience the function as a single, joined-up partner rather than a collection of individual projects. 
  • Drive and maintain strategic partnerships across NBCU with a one-company mindset, identifying opportunities for data and insights sharing, supporting central initiatives focused on growth and innovation. 
  • BA/BS required, MBA or JD preferred  
  • Forward-thinking, strategic, tactical and detail-oriented; proven ability to work across an organization at all levels with technical, creative, and executive team members   
  • Ability to work with confidential and sensitive information in a discrete manner   
  • Superior analytical, presentation and communication skills – written and verbal   
  • Ability to identify key priorities and execute on them   

Desired Characteristics 

  • A proven senior operator from a studio, streamer, network, or adjacent entertainment technology environment, with a demonstrated record of selling, embedding, and scaling data and analytics capabilities within creative, marketing, or distribution organizations — someone who has won adoption and mandate, not only delivered analysis.  
  • A track record of leading multidisciplinary data and analytics teams at scale — hiring and raising the bar, developing senior leaders who operate independently, and running a delivery organization against competing priorities in a large, matrixed environment. 
  • Established, trusting senior-level relationships with C-suite entertainment executives, with the presence and judgement to hold senior relationships independently and advance an agenda as their own, while operating as part of a tightly aligned leadership team.  
  • Sufficient technical and analytical fluency to represent the capability with honesty and precision — able to engage substantively on what the data teams can and cannot do. 
  • A robust understanding of how film and television studios operate across the content lifecycle — creative development, production, marketing, and distribution — and of where data and analytics genuinely change decisions within it.  
  • A values-led culture carrier as much as an operator: self-aware, empathetic, curious, and open-minded; someone who models and reinforces the team’s values — candour, collaboration, inclusion, curiosity, and pride in the craft — while empowering others to perform and setting the leadership standard expected across NBCUniversal. 
  • Comfortable leading in a matrixed, fast-moving environment through complexity, ambiguity, and industry change with the ability to stay decisive and solutions-focused while inspiring innovation, running experiments and pilots, and turning open questions into evidence rather than waiting for the picture to settle. 

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $275,000-$350,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible)
