job.title: Talent Acquisition Intern, DreamWorks Animation, Spring 2027
job.description:
DreamWorks Animation is looking for more adventurous dreamers who shoot for the moon. We tell stories about the journeys our unconventional heroes take to make dreams come true. As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world’s leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. We push to feel more, laugh more, and build immersive new worlds.

DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We place tremendous value on the experiences our talent brings to the table from their own non-traditional paths to success. We believe in frequent communication and that transparency and trust yield the best work. We are a community of artists, technologists, innovators, and creators, who are passionate about animation and also happen to love eating lunch together.

In the DreamWorks Internship Program, interns work in an engaging and exciting environment alongside creative leaders and artists who are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative culture. Interns are immersed into TV and Feature animated productions while gaining hands-on experience at our studio. Open to students and recent grads, we love those who are driven and hungry to learn, are curious and resourceful, and most importantly, are passionate about animation. 

The Internship Program also showcases best-in-class opportunities by offering executive speaker series, professional/career development workshops, artistic classes, community outreach opportunities, movie screenings, and much more!

DreamWorks Talent Acquisition team seeks a positive and hard-working Talent Acquisition Intern who is self-motivated, hungry to learn and curious about what it's like to work in recruitment at a fast paced animation studio!

If you are part of the fandom and believe teamwork makes the dream work, join us in #livingthedream and #doingyourdreamwork!

Spring 2027 Talent Acquisition Internship: 

  • Applications close: October 19, 2026 at 11:59pm PT

  • Program Dates: January 25 - April 1, 2027

  • Time Commitment: Part-Time (24 hours per week required)

  • Format: In Person (Tuesday - Thursday)

Responsibilities: “What would you say you do here?”

  • Support recruitment team through job posting, interview scheduling, onboarding, event planning, organizing university visits, etc.

  • Assist in Early Career Program events facilitation (intern/trainee events, orientations, socials, final presentations, etc.).

  • Curate early careers newsletters, flyers and handouts for school visits, Intern events, etc.

  • Curate social media content to tell stories and build our audience through DreamWorks Careers social media channels

  • Provide candidates with a positive interview experience by communicating interview details to candidates.

  • Ability to troubleshoot video, audio, and communications signals.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple live events simultaneously.

  • Experience working in a 24/7 operational environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Experience supporting REMI / remote production models.
  • Ability to interpret signal flow documentation (CAD drawings) and perform systems-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting matrix communications systems and large-scale routing infrastructures.
  • Familiarity with SMPTE 2110 environments.

job.title: Vice President, Content Delivery Networks
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

The Vice President, Content Delivery Networks will be part of the Global Video Engineering organization and will be responsible for overall strategy, design, and execution of content delivery for our OTT products. The Vice President will oversee a team of CDN, Data and Software engineers who are subject matter experts in next generation distribution, who will ensure the fidelity, quality, and availability of our delivery network for the benefit of our global audiences.

Job Responsibilities

Technical Expertise

  • Devise and execute Content Delivery Strategy to deliver current and planned media products & events at necessary performance & scale.
  • Attract and retain a multi-national team of subject matter experts to deliver strategy.
  • Develop relationships and engage with partner ISPs & telco industry to ensure performant access.
  • Collaborate with procurement teams to manage key vendor commercial relationships.
  • Ensure technology decisions supporting strategy are made from the latest market research of vendors and competition.
  • Engage with Legal and Finance teams to negotiate vendor contracts and manage budgets.
  • Conduct Short/long term technology evaluations (e.g. multicast, p2p, hybrid/ISP CDNs, deeper distribution, self-build CDN)
  • Involvement in E2E technology planning, product governance and regulatory/legal matters.
  • Own the end-to-end CDN roadmap, including capacity planning, performance optimization, resiliency, cost efficiency, and future-state architecture across global streaming products.
  • Set and govern CDN reliability, quality, and performance standards, ensuring measurable KPIs and SLAs for availability, latency, startup time, rebuffering, and overall viewer experience.
  • Lead incident readiness and operational excellence for high-profile live events and peak traffic moments, including escalation protocols, risk mitigation, and post-event learnings.
  • Partner with Product, Operations, Distribution, and Platform Engineering to ensure CDN strategy supports business priorities, product launches, global expansion, and audience growth.
  • Drive vendor strategy and optimization, including multi-CDN strategy, contract performance, vendor scorecards, cost modeling, and negotiation support.
  • Champion innovation in next-generation content delivery, including automation, observability, traffic steering, edge compute, ISP partnerships, and emerging delivery models.
  • Establish data-driven decision-making practices by using real-time monitoring, analytics, and performance insights to improve delivery quality and business outcomes.
  • Ensure security, compliance, and risk controls are embedded into CDN architecture and third-party partnerships, especially for global content distribution.
  • Develop succession plans and an organizational structure for the CDN function to ensure scalability, continuity, and long-term leadership depth.
  • Represent the CDN function with senior executives, translating technical performance, risk, investment needs, and roadmap tradeoffs into clear business recommendations.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Strategic leader with the ability to set a clear vision, translate business priorities into actionable technology roadmaps, and drive execution across complex, global teams.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence, build trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and executive stakeholders, and align teams around shared outcomes. 
  • Strong people leadership skills, including attracting, developing, and retaining high-performing technical talent while fostering accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical topics, make data-informed recommendations, and influence senior leaders.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-scale environment, balancing innovation, operational excellence, risk management, and business impact.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of ten (10) years’ experience managing large-scale digital software systems, preferably in the Content Delivery Network space
  • Minimum of five (5) years’ experience leading a CDN function
  • Expertise in software security best practices and tooling
  • Expertise in digital video codecs and encoding profiles
  • Experience in digital media or direct-to-consumer video business highly preferred
  • Expertise in high-availability software patterns and performance testing
  • Knowledge of Cloud & Container Security

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience in deploying tools such as Web Application Firewalls, Container Security, Static & Dynamic Code Analysis
  • In depth knowledge of all OTT platforms, including optimization of delivery methodology of each with a passion for staying on the cutting edge of digital video delivery
  • Passionate about leading a team of engineers and committed to building world-class software systems
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, comfortable communicating with technical and non-technical colleagues and executives
  • Ability to understand large complex software systems and their interdependencies

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.description:

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. The Vice President of Product, Entertainment and Sports Engagement will develop and champion a product vision within a bold set of strategic ambitions, and lead its execution from concept through customer impact across three interconnected areas that are central to reimagining streaming and how fandoms come to life for the next generation of fans:

  • Entertainment and Sports Experiences: Create differentiated experiences around live sports, TV, movies, franchises, and major cultural moments, working closely with Sports and the NBCUniversal Studio Group to Innovate across fandoms, interaction mechanics, and content formats to deepen engagement and deliver outstanding fan experiences.
  • Discovery and Browse Experience: Define how customers explore Peacock and decide what to watch or play across platforms. Creating simple, intuitive journeys that thoughtfully integrate capabilities from other product groups including Search, Personalization, Advertising and content metadata teams into a coherent customer experience.
  • Mobile Reimagined: Define a differentiated vision for mobile that revolutionizes how customers discover, watch, play, and participate on their phones. Develop compelling formats beyond traditional streaming, including games, podcasts, microdramas, short-form and vertical video, while bringing these experiences together into a coherent and intuitive product.

This is a senior leadership role that requires product judgement, organizational leadership, and the ability to turn ambitious ideas into customer-facing experiences and roadmaps that scale across platforms and teams.

We are looking for an experienced, versatile product leader who can take an ambitious strategic direction and turn it into a distinctive product vision with measurable outcomes, and develop a growing product team in a competitive consumer landscape. A successful candidate will bring creativity to look at problems in new ways, discipline in using experiments and proof of concepts to validate hypotheses, strong collaboration skills to get things done across a matrixed organization, including the wider NBCUniversal and Sky businesses, and excellent communication skills.

This role will lead a team of approximately 20 product managers, report to the SVP, Product and UX, and work across the organization to deliver measurable improvements in customer engagement, including frequency, watch time, discovery success, and participation in entertainment and sports experiences.

In this role, you will:

job.title: Visual Development Intern, DreamWorks Animation, Spring 2027
job.description:
DreamWorks Animation is looking for more adventurous dreamers who shoot for the moon. We tell stories about the journeys our unconventional heroes take to make dreams come true. As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world’s leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. We push to feel more, laugh more, and build immersive new worlds.

DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We place tremendous value on the experiences our talent brings to the table from their own non-traditional paths to success. We believe in frequent communication and that transparency and trust yield the best work. We are a community of artists, technologists, innovators, and creators, who are passionate about animation and also happen to love eating lunch together.

In the DreamWorks Internship Program, interns work in an engaging and exciting environment alongside creative leaders and artists who are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative culture. Interns are immersed into TV and Feature animated productions while gaining hands-on experience at our studio. Open to students and recent grads, we love those who are driven and hungry to learn, are curious and resourceful, and most importantly, are passionate about animation. 

The Internship Program also showcases best-in-class opportunities by offering executive speaker series, professional/career development workshops, artistic classes, community outreach opportunities, movie screenings, and much more!

If you are part of the fandom and believe teamwork makes the dream work, join us in #livingthedream and #doingyourdreamwork! 

Spring 2027 Visual Development Internship: 

  • Applications close: October 19, 2026 at 11:59pm PT

  • Program Dates: January 25 - April 1, 2027

  • Time Commitment: Part-Time (24 hours per week required)

  • Format: In Person (Tuesday - Thursday)

Responsibilities: “What would you say you do here?”

For feature animated films and TV animated projects, Visual Development artists imagine and propose ideas for what the animated world should look like based on the story, characters, and action. They use reference, illustration, drawing, design skills and animation and 3D tools like Maya to build visuals that convey ideas about how they envision the look of the world.

  • The goal of the internship is to experience visual development in a production environment over the span of 10 weeks.

  • The intern will be partnered with a production over the span of 10 weeks working closely with Production Designers and mentors.

  • This intern will work through concept designs to final designs by pulling reference, crafting mood boards and designing sets, props, color keys, and more.

  • Ask questions, clarify notes, and ensure designs are completed per the feedback provided.

  • Ensure deadlines are consistently met and communicate progress of work to supervisors and to appropriate production staff.

Basic Qualifications: “What do I need to have in order to do this job?”

  • Strong skills in Photoshop

  • Pursuing an Associate, Bachelor or Graduate degree at a College/University (or equivalent), or be a recent graduate (within six months of graduation date)

  • Must be 18 years of age or older

  • Must be willing to work in Glendale, California

  • Ability to provide own relocation, housing and transportation

  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship

Desired Qualifications: “What can I offer?”

  • Experience with 3D tools (Maya, Blender, ZBrush) preferred.

Hourly Rate:  $18.47

Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, which currently requires contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week. Beginning January 5, 2026, hybrid employees will be required to work from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.title: VP, Corporate Communications
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Vice President, Corporate Communications will serve as a senior communications leader responsible for shaping and advancing the company’s corporate narrative, reputation, and executive voice. This role will lead a dynamic communications strategy spanning executive communications, thought leadership, corporate storytelling, and media relations, with a focus on proactively identifying and creating opportunities to elevate the company, its leaders, businesses, and strategic priorities. 

The ideal candidate is a strategic counselor, compelling storyteller, and proactive media strategist who understands how to translate complex business strategies into clear, differentiated narratives that resonate with employees, investors, industry leaders, policymakers, and the broader public. 

This role partners closely with the EVP, Corporate Communications and communications leadership team to develop clear, consistent messaging and execute communications plans aligned to business priorities. 

Key Responsibilities 

Corporate Narrative & Storytelling 

  • Help shape externally NBCU’s overarching story, positioning and messaging. 
  • Translate complex business strategies, innovation, and company priorities into compelling stories that are accessible and differentiated. 
  • Identify the stories, milestones, people, businesses, and innovations that can strengthen the company’s reputation and bring its strategy to life. 
  • Develop integrated messaging frameworks and communications platforms that can be used consistently across external and internal audiences. 
  • Anticipate emerging issues and opportunities and proactively develop communications strategies around them. 
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure communications are aligned with the company’s business objectives and broader reputation strategy. 

Proactive Media Relations 

  • Lead a highly proactive media strategy, consistently identifying and pitching compelling company stories. 
  • Coordinate closely with business-unit communications teams to amplify major company announcements, milestones, partnerships, innovations, and strategic initiatives. 
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with top-tier business, technology, trade, entertainment, , and industry reporters and editors. 
  • Develop creative, differentiated story angles and pitches that position the company and its executives at the center of important conversations. 
  • Drive earned media opportunities across business, corporate, trade, broadcast, podcast, and digital platforms. 
  • Develop rapid-response strategies when appropriate while maintaining a strong emphasis on proactive reputation building. 

Executive Communications & Thought Leadership 

  • Serve as a trusted communications advisor to senior executives, providing strategic counsel on positioning, messaging, visibility, and reputation. 
  • Develop executive communications strategies that establish leaders as credible, distinctive voices within the industry and broader business community. 
  • Create speeches, keynote remarks, talking points, presentations, and other executive materials. 
  • Identify opportunities for executives to participate in high-value industry conversations, conferences, interviews, panels, podcasts, and other forums. 
  • Develop proactive thought-leadership platforms and campaigns that connect executive voices to the company’s strategic priorities and broader industry trends. 
  • Prepare executives for high-profile media interviews, speaking engagements, and other external appearances. 

Integrated Communications Leadership 

  • Partner closely with internal communications, business communications, public affairs, marketing, and other functions to ensure a coordinated communications approach. 
  • Establish clear communications priorities and measurement frameworks to evaluate impact and inform strategy. 
  • Lead high-priority corporate communications initiatives and special projects from strategy through execution. 
  • Serve as a senior representative of the communications function with executives and key internal stakeholders. 
  • Help build and mentor a high-performing corporate communications team and foster a culture of strategic thinking, creativity, collaboration, and accountability. 

Basic Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, executive communications, media relations, journalism, or a related field, with significant experience advising senior executives. 

Desired Experience, Skills, and Characteristics:

  • Proven track record of developing and executing proactive corporate communications and media strategies that generate meaningful earned media. 
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex business topics compelling and accessible. 
  • Deep understanding of the media landscape and established relationships with influential business, industry, and/or trade journalists. 
  • Demonstrated ability to develop executive thought leadership that is authentic, differentiated, and connected to business strategy. 
  • Strong strategic judgment and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly visible environment. 
  • Ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate effectively across a large, complex organization. 
  • Experience managing sensitive or high-profile communications issues with discretion and sound judgment. 
  • Strong team leadership, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a demonstrated ability to find the story, create the opportunity, and move quickly to capitalize on it. 

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $190,000 - $235,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible).

The Writer is responsible for outlining and polishing the written content for entertainment daily show. The Writer is responsible for supporting the cases with accurate information of other related stories occurring around the world. 

Responsibilities:

  • Assists producers in all aspects of the production of daily newscasts with a focus on writing.

job.title: Director of Content
job.description:
Job Profile: Administrative Operations Manager 2 Job Family: Administrative Operations Time Type: Full time Apply before 11:59 PM Arizona time the day before the posted End Date. Minimum

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and five (5) years of

experience

appropriate to the area of assignment/field including two (2) years managerial experience; OR, Any equivalent combination of

experience

and/or training from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved. Job Profile Summary: Manages the intermediate to complex operations of a department within the division. Monitors budget, implements strategic priorities, and prepares reports for senior management. Job Description: Join the award-winning Arizona PBS team as our next Director of Content and help shape how we tell stories that inform, engage and inspire audiences across Arizona. Working closely with the Senior Director of Content, the Director of Content translates Arizona PBS’s content strategy into impactful storytelling across broadcast, digital and social platforms. As a key leader on the content team, you will guide experienced producers and content creators, champion innovative approaches to storytelling, and ensure our programming reflects the interests, needs and the communities we serve. This is a leadership role, you will deliver through your team, setting the standard for storytelling while developing the producers who create it. This role combines strategic thinking with day-to-day leadership. You will oversee content planning, guide production and distribution workflows, identify emerging opportunities, and use audience insights to strengthen engagement and expand our reach. From developing new storytelling formats to optimizing how content reaches audiences on different platforms, you will help Arizona PBS evolve how we serve our community while upholding the editorial integrity and public service mission that define public media. The ideal candidate is an editorially strong, collaborative leader who knows how to turn big-picture priorities into effective execution, empower creative teams, and balance innovation with sound judgment, resources and results. To be considered, applicants must submit a complete application that includes: Resume Cover letter Links to relevant work samples demonstrating content, storytelling or production

experience

Position Salary Range: $95,000 - $110,000 annually; DOE Essential Duties: Content Strategy, Editorial Leadership and Audience Engagement Translate Arizona PBS’s content strategy into actionable plans for local storytelling across broadcast, digital and social platforms. Lead the day-to-day planning, development, production and distribution of short-form and long-form content, ensuring projects align with organizational priorities and audience needs. Manage the content calendar, balancing immediate programming needs with long-term editorial priorities, special initiatives and emerging opportunities. Oversee the content greenlight process, evaluating ideas for editorial merit, audience relevance, strategic alignment, feasibility and impact. Guide producers in developing compelling, distinctive stories and experimenting with new formats, platforms and approaches to storytelling. Develop strategies to attract new audiences, deepen engagement with existing audiences and extend the reach and impact of Arizona PBS content. Analyze audience data, platform performance and industry trends to inform editorial decisions, refine distribution strategies and identify opportunities for growth. Champion inclusive, storytelling that reflects the experiences, perspectives and needs of communities throughout Arizona. Serve as a resource for editorial standards and practices, ensuring content meets Arizona PBS’s expectations for accuracy, fairness, independence and integrity. Monitor changes in public media, journalism, digital platforms and audience behavior, recommending strategic adjustments as needed. Team Leadership and Collaboration Directly supervise, mentor and develop content producers and the Producer/Social Media Manager, providing clear direction, constructive feedback and opportunities for professional growth. Foster a collaborative, creative and accountable environment that empowers team members to take thoughtful risks, solve problems and deliver high-quality work. Establish priorities, delegate effectively and manage team capacity to balance competing projects, deadlines and organizational needs. Collaborate with the Senior Director of Content and leaders across production, news and public affairs, digital, marketing, development and other departments to align priorities and maximize content impact. Represent the content team in cross-departmental meetings, planning sessions and organizational initiatives. Explore and test new digital experiences, distribution approaches and storytelling opportunities in collaboration with colleagues across Arizona PBS. Production and Operational Management Lead day-to-day production operations for local and national projects, coordinating producing, editing and delivery workflows to keep projects on schedule and within approved budgets. Guide platform-specific social storytelling for Arizona PBS programs and series, working within the station’s overall social media and brand strategy. Supervise social media content planning and execution to ensure platform-specific storytelling supports editorial priorities and audience engagement goals. Develop and monitor production budgets for review and approval by the Senior Director of Content. Coordinate freelance and contract hiring, vendor relationships and production resources as needed. Maintain effective project management systems, production schedules and communication practices to support efficient workflows and timely delivery. Ensure timely response to viewer inquiries and concerns related to local content, exercising sound judgment and professionalism. Ensure content performance data is available to support Development’s funding work. Produce content on an as-needed basis, but this is not the primary function of this role. Core Competencies and Leadership Expectations Success in this role requires both strong performance and a commitment to the collaborative, inclusive culture of Arizona PBS. The Director of Content is expected to: Lead with integrity: Model sound judgment, accountability and the highest standards of professional and editorial conduct. Think strategically: Connect day-to-day decisions to organizational goals and identify opportunities to advance Arizona PBS’s mission. Develop people: Coach, motivate and empower staff while fostering professional growth, creativity and accountability. Communicate effectively: Share priorities clearly, provide constructive feedback and proactively engage colleagues across the organization. Collaborate and build relationships: Develop productive working relationships, encourage perspectives and contribute to a cohesive, high-performing team. Adapt and innovate: Approach challenges with curiosity, a solutions-oriented mindset and a willingness to test new ideas and learn from results. Manage priorities: Demonstrate strong time management, organization and decision-making while balancing multiple projects and deadlines. Champion inclusion: Model inclusive behaviors and support content and workplace practices that reflect the communities Arizona PBS serves. Desired

Qualifications

Demonstrated success supervising, mentoring and developing creative or editorial staff. Strong understanding of public media standards, editorial independence and underwriting guidelines, including restrictions on pay-for-play arrangements.

Experience

in public media or broadcasting, including familiarity with PBS distribution and content delivery partners such as PBS, PBS Digital Studios (PBSd), NETA and APT, as applicable.

Experience

managing local, statewide, multi-organization or collaborative content initiatives. Knowledge of social media strategy, platform-specific storytelling and editorial standards for news and public affairs content.

Experience

developing or overseeing content for both traditional broadcast and digital-first formats, including vertical video. Proven project management and budgeting skills, including production scheduling, expense tracking, invoice approval and vendor coordination.

Experience

using audience analytics and performance metrics to inform content strategy and distribution decisions.

Experience

contributing content data, impact reporting or other materials for grant applications and funding proposals. Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Monday.com or comparable project management platforms, and professional video editing software such as Final Cut Pro. Working Environment: This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule, typically allowing up to two days of remote work per week. On-site attendance is expected for team meetings, monthly staff meetings, production needs and other activities requiring in-person collaboration. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required to accommodate production schedules, special projects and organizational priorities. Required to stand for varying lengths of time and walk moderate distances to perform work. Frequent physical demands may include stooping, bending, crawling under/around objects, reaching, lifting and pushing objects of varying weights up to 25 pounds Department Statement: Arizona PBS is an essential community institution that informs, engages and inspires audiences through trusted journalism, educational programming, original productions and meaningful community partnerships. As a service of Arizona State University, Arizona PBS connects people with ideas, perspectives and stories that deepen understanding of our state and the world. Join a team committed to public service, creative excellence and the power of storytelling to make a difference. Driving Requirement: This position may require driving. We are looking for a versatile Commerce Associate to join our team. This role will support all parts of our operation, evolving with business needs and experimentation. 


Applicants should be passionate about affiliate marketing, publisher and creator monetization, business development, and audience development. They should have a strong understanding of the digital landscape and the ability to translate data into actionable strategies that drive growth, identify new opportunities, and strengthen our partnerships. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Growth and offers the opportunity to contribute across a range of initiatives in a dynamic, evolving business.

job.title: Lifestyle News Editor, The California Post
job.description:
Job Description:


The California Post is seeking an experienced and audience driven Lifestyle News Editor to direct coverage of our lifestyle content in California — working across verticals including sex & relationships, fashion, real estate, parenting, travel, food & drink, science & technology and general interest. This role offers the right candidate the opportunity to set the lifestyle agenda in one of the most exciting cities in America.

The successful candidate will be skilled at identifying the topics everyone wants to read and talk about  — and then produce and edit content in The Post’s uniquely irreverent tone of voice. They should have both high level copy editing experience as well as an innate understanding of audience metrics, and how to write a sparkling headline that generates conversation and traffic. They will also be skilled in mining social media and competitive news sources for the best leads — and know how to turn online and real-life chatter into stories that give depth to the Post’s lifestyle section and put it ahead of the trends.

Application Instructions: Applicants should submit a cover letter and applicable work samples/clips for consideration.

Responsibilities:

  • Generating an endless font of innovative and agenda-setting daily trending and exclusive ideas.

  • Assigning and editing trending daily stories, as well as long lead stories where needed. 

  • Overseeing the production of a number of daily stories — from writing headlines in the Post’s signature wit to ensuring SEO best practices to coordinating photo shoots and imagery. 

  • Analyzing web traffic to drive audience engagement and meet goals of the department.

  • Monitoring the news to look for opportunities to add depth to our headlines through original reporting, first-person perspectives and expert explainers.

  • Managing the lifestyle reporters on the team.

  • Coordinating closely with departments such as photo, video, and audience development.

Requirements:

  • At least 10 years of progressive editorial experience in a news or high-volume magazine environment, preferably focused on lifestyle content, including experience in an editor or editorial leadership capacity.

  • Excellent news judgement and the sharpest of editing and writing prowess. 

  • Your finger on the pulse of the topics and trends of interest to the Post audience. 

  • Proven understanding of what makes a story successful across digital platforms - from headlines to visuals and optimization. 

  • Proficiency in WordPress or similar CMS.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple stories, writers, and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Comfortable making fast, decisive editorial calls in a breaking news environment.

  • Collaborative team player who can work across departments including visuals, social, and audience development.

  • An understanding of referral traffic, particularly, social, search and Discover.

  • Knowledge in driving and retaining audiences, with deeper, engagement focused content. 

  • Familiarity with analytics tools and performance metrics to help guide coverage and strategy.

​Note: This role will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week.

job.title: Manager, People Business Partner
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is looking for a Manager, Human Resources Business Partner to join our collaborative HR team of nine!


Reporting to the HR Director, this role will partner closely with managers, leaders, and employees across the organization on a broad range of HR responsibilities. You’ll serve as a trusted business partner to teams across our Commercial and Newsroom departments, providing guidance, coaching, and support on everything from day-to-day employee questions and performance management to employee relations, organizational changes, and other people-related challenges.


We’re looking for someone who is a strategic thinker, proactive, takes initiative, and enjoys finding creative solutions. You should genuinely enjoy partnering with people, educating and guiding managers and employees, and helping leaders navigate situations with thoughtful, practical advice. This is a role where things can move quickly and not every situation will come with a clear playbook, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, can think on their feet, and is willing to roll up their sleeves and help wherever needed.


You’ll work closely with the broader HR team, including Talent Acquisition, and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the organization. We’re a collaborative team that works hard, supports one another, and believes you can do great work while also having fun doing it. We’re looking for someone who is excited to join the team, build strong relationships, and contribute ideas rather than simply check boxes.


Responsibilities include:


  • Partner with managers, leaders, and employees across Commercial and Newsroom functions to provide thoughtful, practical HR guidance and support.
  • Serve as a trusted business partner and advisor to managers on employee relations, performance management, talent development, career progression, engagement, and other people-related matters.
  • Coach and educate managers on HR policies, processes, best practices, and how to effectively navigate employee situations.
  • Manage and conduct employee relations investigations, including gathering information, interviewing relevant parties, documenting findings, and recommending appropriate next steps.
  • Support managers and employees through performance concerns, workplace conflict, and other sensitive employee matters with sound judgment, discretion, and empathy.
  • Partner with employees and managers on workplace accommodations and other individual employee needs.
  • Help leaders navigate organizational changes, team dynamics, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.
  • Partner with the HR Director and broader HR team on people strategies and initiatives that support business and organizational priorities.
  • Collaborate closely with Talent Acquisition and other members of the HR team to ensure a consistent and connected employee experience from recruiting through the employee lifecycle.
  • Use data, workforce insights, and employee feedback to identify opportunities and recommend practical solutions.
  • Help develop and implement HR programs, processes, and initiatives that improve the employee experience and support the business.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes and introduce new tools, technology, and AI where appropriate to make our work more effective and efficient.
  • Stay current on employment laws, HR best practices, and emerging workplace trends and help ensure their appropriate application.
  • Handle confidential and sensitive employee information with a high level of professionalism and discretion.
  • Jump in and support projects and responsibilities outside of your immediate scope when the team or business needs it. We’re a small, collaborative team, and everyone contributes!

Requirements:


  • At least 5 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3 years of true HR Business Partner or equivalent client-facing business partnership experience.
  • Experience partnering directly with managers and leaders to provide HR guidance, coaching, and solutions.
  • Strong foundation in employee relations, investigations, performance management, and employee coaching.
  • Experience with workplace accommodations strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting fast-paced organizations, ideally within media, commercial, sales, editorial, creative, or another deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of HR best practices and working knowledge of applicable employment laws.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility with employees at all levels.
  • A strategic and solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand business needs and translate them into practical people solutions.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making thoughtful decisions without always having a clear roadmap.
  • Highly proactive and resourceful, with a willingness to take initiative and see things through from idea to execution.
  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential matters.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and move quickly without losing attention to detail.
  • Strong coaching, influencing, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to pitch in wherever needed.
  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, business, psychology, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.

Note: This role is based in our Midtown Manhattan office and requires working on-site three days per week.


Compensation: $120,000 - $150,000 Salary + Annual Bonus

job.title: News Reporter (Part-Time), The California Post
job.description:
Job Description:


We are looking for Part-Time News Reporters (~24 hours per week) to join the California Post team.

Reporting to the Deputy News Editor, the General Assignment News Reporter will have a focus on breaking exclusive stories and covering major events unfolding in Los Angeles and beyond. From delivering exclusive, engaging, agenda setting stories to covering wildfires, celebrity scandals, local politics, crime, courts and viral moments, this reporter will be on the front line of our coverage in one of the country’s most dynamic and newsworthy cities.

Application Instructions: Applicants should submit a cover letter for consideration.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver exclusive stories and cover breaking news across Los Angeles that drives engagement and audience for the California Post. 

  • Write fast, clean, and compelling copy that aligns with the Post’s distinctive voice and style

  • Spot stories that resonate nationally, especially ones with viral or exclusive potential

  • Develop sources across city agencies, emergency services, and local communities to get the inside track on stories

  • Monitor court filings, public records, and social media for scoops and trending topics

  • Collaborate with editors and fellow reporters to ensure comprehensive and coordinated coverage

  • File updates in real time and across multiple platforms, including web, social, mobile, and video

  • Uphold the highest journalistic standards of accuracy, fairness, and integrity

 

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience reporting for a fast-paced digital or print newsroom

  • Excellent news judgment and the ability to identify compelling angles others may miss

  • High level of self-motivation, commitment to teamwork and ability to win in a competitive environment

  • Proven ability to report and write on deadline while juggling multiple stories at once

  • Experience covering major metro areas, ideally including public safety, politics, or general assignment

  • Proven experience with WordPress of similar CMS highly preferred

  • Strong sourcing skills and a relentless approach to newsgathering

  • Proficiency in social media and SEO best practices

  • Familiarity with court and public records; ability to navigate legal documents a plus

  • A competitive drive to be first and best on big stories

  • Strong writing and reporting skills are the core of this role

  • On-camera experience is strongly preferred, as we’re looking for reporters who are comfortable discussing and presenting their stories on video to help extend our journalism across digital and social platforms

  • A strong social media presence or following is a plus

  • Spanish or other language fluency is a plus

job.title: Page Six Reporter (Tues-Sat)
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. With a 225 year legacy and a fast moving digital first newsroom, the Post operates across print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce, and continues to define the city’s most talked about stories.

Page Six Digital is the modern evolution of the iconic gossip column, delivering the latest in celebrity news, entertainment, and pop culture with a bold, fast-paced digital edge. As the go-to destination for breaking stories, exclusive scoops, and viral moments, Page Six has grown far beyond its print roots to become a dynamic, multi-platform brand that reaches millions of readers daily across web, social, and video.

Page Six is looking for a bold, sharp, and pop culture-obsessed Reporter (Tues-Sat) who lives and breathes celebrity news. This is your chance to join the authority in entertainment gossip and help drive the conversations that everyone will be talking about tomorrow. You’ll pitch and write buzzy, can’t-miss stories daily with speed, accuracy, and unmistakable voice. We want someone who’s always one step ahead—plugged into social media trends, fluent in fan culture, and relentless in uncovering those juicy, under-the-radar scoops that make Page Six sizzle. If you thrive in a fast-paced newsroom, know your way around SEO and analytics, and can spot a viral moment before it breaks, we want to hear from you. Let’s make headlines.

Note: The schedule for this role is Tuesday-Friday 1-9pm EST, Saturday 10am-6pm EST.

Responsibilities: 

  • Pitch and write 5-6 celebrity and entertainment-based stories quickly and with clean copy daily

  • Proactively seek out and uncover under-the-radar stories that will resonate with the Page Six audience 

  • Have your finger on the pulse of what fans are talking about on social media and the ability to create content that fits their interests

  • Help expand Page Six’s nighttime news coverage by monitoring social media and using analytics tools (Google Analytics, Parse.ly, etc.) to achieve success

  • Be a self-starter and have the ability to think quickly on their feet and multitask in a fast-paced news environment

  • Have an understanding of SEO best practices and analytics and use that knowledge to help guide coverage 

Qualifications:

  • At least two years of major journalism experience

  • A deep understanding of and passion for all things celebrity and entertainment

  • Exceptional writing and reporting skills

  • Ability to write succinct, eye-catching headlines and clean, ready-to-publish content

  • Knowledge and understanding of SEO best practices 

  • Strong editorial judgment and communication skills

  • Familiarity with content management systems (Wordpress, in particular), photo editing software & web analytics tools

  • Flexibility in covering live pop culture events (i.e. Oscars, Golden Globes, etc.) and working outside traditional business hours when needed

job.title: Part-Time Editor
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

The NY Post is looking for an experienced editor for a part-time role (16-24 hours per week) with the Sunday staff. The editor is expected to be a line and assignment editor who possesses fine attention to detail, critical thinking skills, and who can also aggressively transform breaking copy on deadline to sing in The Post's unique tabloid voice.

The editor should be able to mine, assign and edit an array of stories -- impactful, quirky, scandalous, etc. -- on immediate deadline for our website, and also for the Sunday print edition. The editor must be able to give clear direction to our team of award-winning field reporters and in-office journos.

The Sunday team breaks local, national and international news, investigates government corruption, crushes hypocrisy wherever we find it, mines the world for the quirky and the funny, and delivers award-winning, long- and short-form journalism in the boldest tabloid voice.

The NY Post is the nation’s 5th-largest U.S. newspaper by circulation and its website routinely generates tens of millions of pageviews every weekend. The ability to handle anything from a breaking brief to a sprawling news feature, in a wide range of subjects, is needed. And you’ll even get to spitball with the rest of us on our world-famous Page 1 headlines.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher
  • A minimum of 5 years of editing in a busy newsroom
  • Comfortable editing/re-writing both breaking news and long-form stories in lively tabloid prose for web and print
  • A keen understanding of the voice of the Post
  • A knack for finding stories our readers crave
  • A critical eye for facts and tone
  • Broad knowledge base
  • Willingness to collaborate and ability to communicate with a close-knit team of NYC’s best journalists

Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The New York Post is seeking a Part-Time Reporter (20–24 hours per week) to join our Sunday team. We're looking for a journalist with strong writing skills, curiosity, and a sharp eye for what makes a good story — someone who can move quickly, spot news value, and deliver clean, compelling copy on a tight timeline.


You'll help contribute to one of the most widely read print editions in the country, supporting our Sunday coverage.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Cover assigned stories and conduct interviews
  • Pitch interesting, relevant, and creative stories for our Sunday paper and Saturday web coverage
  • Rewrite and update existing stories as needed
  • Aggregate breaking news and trending topics from trusted sources
  • Write clean, engaging copy for both print and digital
  • Work collaboratively with editors and other reporters to develop strong story ideas
  • Stay on top of news developments and flag timely angles


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of reporting or newsroom experience preferred (internships count)
  • A bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or a related field
  • Strong writing and research skills
  • Ability to work on deadline and adapt quickly to breaking news
  • Comfortable covering a range of topics, from news and politics to entertainment
  • A team player with a strong work ethic and attention to detail
  • Passion for journalism and the fast-moving media world

Note: This position is eligible for remote work. The shift schedule is Tuesday, Friday and Saturday from 10 a.m. - 6 p.m. EST.

job.description:

job.title: Prepress Technician
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment and pop culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225+ years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


We are looking for a Prepress Technician to join our Prepress Operations team. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in our daily print production process, ensuring the accurate, high-quality, and timely preparation and production of our pages.



Responsibilities:

  • Manage the transmission of pages to all print sites, troubleshoot transmission systems, and distribute production schedules.
  • Maintain communication with print sites regarding production updates and page adjustments.
  • Monitor pages for technical errors and quality issues, and recommend actions to ensure quality and deadline adherence.

  • Foster strong, collaborative relationships with editorial staff and photo editors to ensure high-quality product delivery and effective communication.
  • Build and maintain page plans within production systems according to editorial specifications.
  • Stay current with departmental workflows, procedures, and emerging technologies.

  • Working knowledge of page transmission systems and troubleshooting production/output issues.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to monitor pages for technical and quality errors under deadline pressure.
  • Experience with pagination systems, such as Methode and NewswayX, preferred.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with editorial staff and photo editors.
  • Strong time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize complex or high-scrutiny work under tight deadlines.
  • A proactive approach to process improvement and staying current with emerging prepress technologies.

job.title: Reporter, California Post
job.description:
Job Description:


We are seeking a driven General Assignment Reporter (Courts & Crime Focus) to join the California Post team.


Reporting to the Deputy News Editor, this reporter will react quickly to major breaking news across the San Francisco Bay Area while focusing closely on courts, crime, and public safety. This role requires flexibility, sharp instincts, and a high-velocity reporting style—whether you’re responding to an urgent spot news event, covering a high-profile trial, or breaking down a rapidly developing regional story. You will be on the front lines of one of the nation’s most dynamic news environments, turning fast-moving events into clear, authoritative reporting.


Responsibilities:

  • Cover real-time general assignment and breaking news across the San Francisco Bay Area with speed, accuracy, and urgency for the California Post.
  • Anchor coverage on major criminal and civil court cases, law enforcement agency accountability, and public safety issues impacting the region.
  • Pivot seamlessly between broad general assignment reporting, spot news, public safety incidents, and regional enterprise assignments as stories unfold.
  • Spot local stories with viral potential or national resonance and deliver exclusive angles before the competition.
  • Cultivate strong relationships across law enforcement, legal communities, municipal agencies, emergency services, and local neighborhoods.
  • File rapid updates across web, mobile, social media, and video platforms, continuously updating developing stories in real time.
  • Actively monitor police blotters, court filings, public records, and social feeds to spot scoops and emerging trends.
  • Travel regularly across the Bay Area to cover breaking news scenes, courthouses, hearings, trials, and major verdict announcements in person.

Requirements:

  • Several years of experience reporting for a fast-paced digital or print newsroom, with a background in general assignment, breaking news, or public safety beats.
  • Superior news judgment with a proven ability to write fast, clean, and compelling copy on tight deadlines while managing multiple assignments.
  • Solid understanding of legal documents, court filings, and police operations, with the ability to translate complex legal jargon into clear, accessible prose.
  • A relentless approach to newsgathering and a track record of building trusted sources across public safety and municipal agencies.
  • Proficiency with CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress), SEO best practices, and social media distribution tools.
  • Comfort presenting short-form video updates or discussing stories on camera for digital platforms.
  • A desire to be first and best on major breaking stories while maintaining the highest standards of journalistic integrity and accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Spanish or secondary language fluency.
  • An established social media presence or professional digital following.

Note: This role is expected to be based remotely in the San Francisco Bay Area. All work arrangements are subject to change based on business needs.

job.title: Technical Support Engineer
job.description:
Core Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical assistance and support for incoming queries and issues related to computer systems, software, and hardware.
  • Respond to queries either in person or over the phone.
  • Respond to email messages for customers seeking help.
  • Walk customer through problem-solving process.
  • Install, modify, and repair computer hardware and software.
  • Run diagnostic programs to resolve problems.
  • Install computer peripherals for users.
  • Follow up with customers to ensure issue has been resolved.
  • Gain feedback from customers about computer usage.
  • Run reports to determine malfunctions that continue to occur.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Experience working with Windows 7/10, Windows servers 2003-2019, Mac OS.
  • Experience working with MS Office suite including email clients (outlook).
  • Experience with ticketing systems and helpdesk processes.
  • Experience in supporting proprietary software.
  • Experience with Active Directory, printers, anti-virus, backups.
  • Hands on experience with diagnosing and resolving basic technical issues.
  • Has the ability to understand user problems and the ability to explain technical fixes in a clear manner to non-technical users.
  • Experience working in 24x7 environment.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary. 
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
The Sales Account Executive generates advertising revenue by calling on established agencies, cold-calling new prospects and convincing potential clients of the merits of television advertising.

  • Implements strategies to consistently grow revenue and exceed revenue goals.
  • Establishes credible relationships with local business community.
  • Makes sales calls on existing and prospective clients.
  • Maintains assigned accounts and develops new accounts.
  • Prepares and delivers sales presentations to clients.
  • Explains to customers how specific types of advertising will help promote their products or services in the most effective way possible.
  • Provides clients with information regarding rates for advertising placement in all media.
  • Develops advertising schedules with clients and station personnel responsible for placing advertising into station media.
  • Works with clients and station personnel to develop advertisements.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

 

Requirements & Skills:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising or Mass Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Minimum one year’s experience in sales, preferably in the media field.
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Experience achieving long-range objectives and implementing the strategies and actions to achieve them.
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment.

  • Performs other duties as assigned

job.title: Broadcast IT Engineer
job.description:
Are you looking for a job where you are not sitting at a desk all day?  Have you always found a way to produce solutions to problems, sometimes outside the box?  Do you enjoy being a Hands-On person and do you like helping others?  Then you will fit right in as part of WFRV Local 5’s Engineering team.  WFRV needs a Broadcast IT Engineer who is an energetic and enthusiastic person, who is ready to join our team!  Key responsibilities, attributes, and characteristics include:

The Broadcast IT Engineer interacts with station personnel to make sure hardware and systems used for broadcasting and business operations function at the utmost efficiency by doing the following: 


  • Maintains all broadcast technology and equipment for the station.
  • Installs and tests new systems and technical infrastructure for the station.
  • Minimizes service interruptions at times of equipment and/or system failure by rapidly identifying and implementing solutions.
  • Sets up and operates equipment and transmission links during outside broadcasts.
  • Installs and maintains the IT network, switches, data backups, workstations and printers.  
  • Interprets and implements instructions and requests from other station personnel.
  • Communicates with members of the engineering team and other teams to effectively resolve equipment and system issues.
  • Work with other departments during special events as needed.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • This full-time position reports to the Chief Engineer.

 

Requirements & Skills:

  • Technical degree in Digital Electronics, Broadcasting, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written.
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Minimum three years’ experience with digital electronics systems in a television broadcasting environment.
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, and other office equipment.
  • Strong PC/MS Office experience.
  • Experience with fiber connectivity, production setups, A/V routing and patching, audio equipment, graphics systems and editing systems.
  • Experience with digital transmitters, microwave equipment, and other broadcast-related equipment is a plus.
  • Significant experience evaluating, selecting, installing, servicing, and maintaining broadcasting industry equipment and information technology systems.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

 

WFRV and Nexstar Media Inc. are an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Evening Anchor
job.description:
We are looking for a unicorn.  We need someone who can anchor our evening newscasts, produce those newscasts, create content for our digital platforms and CTV streaming channel, and mentor our young staff of reporters.  As news teams get small, staff members are having to take on additional responsibilities.  Those Jack-of-All-Trades will be the journalists that carry our industry into the future.  It will make you more valuable to all future employers. We’re an aggressive news organization that owns breaking news in the local market.

That’s the hard part. What’s in it for you?  You’ll be living and working in one of the most beautiful places in the country.  People pay thousands of dollars a week to vacation here in Panama City, Florida.  The people who live here are friendly, welcoming and hospitable. If you get involved in the community, they will embrace you as one of their own.  You’ll be working with a young, energetic staff of reporters, most fresh out of college and working in their first newsroom. There are also seasoned veterans on the staff who make up the core leadership of the newsroom.

The station signed on in October 1973, has been an ABC affiliate since 1982, a CW affiliate since 2024, and we’ve been part of the Nexstar Nation since 2014.

So, if this sounds like a team you want to join and help lead, we want to hear from you. You can read more about the job in the Nexstar job description below. Hope to hear from you soon.

job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
The Master Control Operator is responsible for the overall on-air look of television stations through airing programming and scheduled station breaks in a centralized broadcast hub environment. 

  • Updates and maintains signal control systems
  • Maintains programming logs as required by station management
  • Segments content and clips to the server and then trims and modifies it
  • Prints traffic logs and appends logs to the data management system
  • Monitors strength, clarity and reliability of incoming and outgoing signals and adjusts equipment as necessary to maintain quality broadcasts
  • Selects sources from which programming will be received, or through which programming will be transmitted
  • Reports equipment problems and ensures that repairs are made and makes emergency repairs to equipment when necessary and possible
  • Ensures the station’s compliance with Emergency Alert System requirements
  • Performs other duties as assigned

 Requirements & Skills:

 

  • Technical degree in Digital Electronics, Broadcasting, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Minimum three years’ experience with digital electronics systems in a television broadcasting environment (More or less depending on market size)
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment.
  • Strong PC/MS Office experience
  • Experience with digital transmitters and other broadcast-related equipment
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Previous broadcast hub or Master Control experience preferred

job.title: Morning Daypart Manager
job.description:
WIVB-TV and WNLO are seeking an innovative, hands-on journalist and content leader to serve as Morning Daypart Manager. This position oversees all content produced during the morning news cycle across broadcast, digital, social, and CTV platforms. The successful candidate will lead a multi-platform team focused on creating compelling local content that reaches audiences wherever they choose to consume news.


The Morning Daypart Manager will provide editorial leadership for all morning content, including live newscasts, streaming coverage, website content, social media distribution, and original CTV programming.


We are looking for a strong communicator and coach who can develop talent, drive audience growth, and ensure content is optimized for every platform. The ideal candidate understands that today's newsroom extends beyond television and embraces a digital-first, audience-focused approach to storytelling.

Job Responsibilities

·         Lead editorial decision-making for all morning content across broadcast, digital, social, and CTV platforms.

·         Oversee planning and execution of morning newscasts, livestreams, breaking news coverage, and original streaming content.

·         Work closely with content team to prioritize stories and maximize reach across all platforms.

·         Ensure content is updated continuously throughout the morning and distributed effectively to viewers on television, WIVB+, WIVB.com, mobile platforms, and social media.

·         Review scripts, digital stories, and streaming content for accuracy, clarity, and journalistic standards.

·         Collaborate with content team to develop enterprise and breaking news coverage.

·         Help identify opportunities for original content, community engagement, and audience growth.

·         Monitor analytics and audience trends to inform content decisions and improve performance.

·         Assist with staffing, scheduling, performance feedback, and training of content teams.

·         Lead newsroom coverage during breaking news and major weather events.

·         Work with newsroom leadership to continually refine and improve multi-platform workflows and content strategy.

·         Salary - $61,000 to $65,000 yearly

 

Requirements & Skills

·         Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, TV/Film, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.

·         Demonstrated leadership experience in a newsroom environment.

·         Strong news judgment, journalistic integrity, and understanding of audience needs.

·         Understanding of content distribution strategies across television, websites, mobile apps, social platforms, and CTV.

·         Experience using analytics and audience data to inform editorial decisions.

·         Ability to work effectively with anchors, reporters, producers, photographers, engineering, and newsroom leadership.

·         Ability to manage multiple projects and perform in a fast-paced breaking news environment.

·         Must be willing to work mornings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as needed.

job.title: Morning Show News Producer

The Morning Show News Producer produces daily newscast items, decides the order in which stories will be told, writes teases and other content, times news programs, edits video, and posts video to the website.

  • Produces newscasts for broadcast across all platforms
  • Writes and orders news stories
  • Approves scripts

  • Minimum two years’ experience in news operations (Depending on market size)
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Flexibility to work any shift

Pay Range: $33,280 - $37,440
Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, life insurance, Paid Parental Leave and more.

job.title: Multi Media Account Executive (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth)
job.description:
MULTI-MEDIA ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth)

Ready to help shape the future of media? At WAVY-TV, WVBT FOX43, and CW Hampton Roads, we do more than sell TV—we help local businesses grow with creative marketing solutions across broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms. We're looking for a driven, motivated Account Executive who enjoys building relationships, thinking strategically, and helping clients connect with their audiences through the power of multi-platform media.

About the Role:

As an Account Executive at WAVY-TV, WVBT and CW Hampton Roads, you'll serve as a consultative partner to local and regional businesses—developing custom advertising strategies across our robust multimedia portfolio. You’ll be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values creativity, integrity, and performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospect and secure new business through networking, referrals, and outreach.
  • Manage and grow a book of active clients, cultivating long-term partnerships.
  • Develop integrated marketing campaigns that include linear TV, streaming (OTT/CTV), digital display, social, and branded content.
  • Work cross-functionally with production, creative, promotions, and digital teams to bring campaigns to life.
  • Deliver clear, data-backed proposals and recommendations to clients.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual revenue goals and quarterly targets.
  • Stay current on media trends, competitive insights, and emerging platforms.

What We’re Looking For:

  • A creative, proactive problem solver who thrives on helping clients succeed.
  • A persuasive storyteller who can connect business challenges to tailored media solutions.
  • A self-starter with strong time management and follow-through skills.
  • A confident communicator—written, verbal, and in client-facing presentations.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum 2-5 years of proven success in media, marketing, or B2B sales.
  • Knowledge of digital advertising platforms (e.g., OTT, SEO/SEM, etc.).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; CRM experience is a plus.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

Why WAVY-TV, WVBT and CW Hampton Roads?

  • We're part of Nexstar Media Group, the nation’s largest local media company.
  • Our reach includes NFL, college football, Hampton Roads Show, and trusted news coverage.
  • Access to advanced tools, strong leadership, and hands-on sales training.
  • Full benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k) & monthly phone allowance provided.

To be considered for this job you must apply online at https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar. 

COMPENSATION RANGE:

Commission based

ADDITIONAL BENEFITS:

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

No calls

No telecommuting.

EOE/Minorities/Females/Vet/Disability
