job.title: Multi-Media Sales Executive
job.description:
Stop just working a job and build your career today! We are looking for great Salespeople in Springfield MO. Springfield is a top 75 Market where your potential is truly unlimited. As one of the largest DMAs geographically located in the heart of the Ozarks; we have all the excitement and attractions you would expect in our metro area with all the activities and relaxation in our Rural area. Springfield Metro has more than enough shows, concerts, restaurants, museums, events, and more to keep you busy. If you are into the outdoors then there is a multitude of lakes, rivers, and mountains to explore in this massive DMA. Our local economy is strong with many National companies using this market as their central and home base of operations like, O’Reilly Auto Parts, Bass Pro, and 3M. Our low cost of living and highly rated school systems also make this one of the best places in the Country to raise a family. 

So, what are you waiting for? Whether you are an experienced Media Seller ready to upgrade Markets or a great Salesperson looking for a REAL Sales CAREER, then Springfield MO is it! 

Multi-Media Sales Executive: 


This position isn’t for everybody. To be successful you must fully embrace our consultative approach that uses a multimedia strategy to help our clients grow their business. If you are an overachiever who likes wild growth, then keep reading…

The Nexstar Media Group in Springfield is comprised of; three Broadcast television stations CBS, FOX, & MyNetwork; plus our Nexstar Digital Agency Services selling ads on streaming TV & apps, along with retargeting ads across all devices & websites, and last but certainly not least our own local community portal website OzarksFirst.com. 
 

  • In this position, you will develop and increase sales volume for both TV and digital revenue.
  • Prospect, qualify, close and grow NEW business
  • Continue to learn and implement new strategies and products
  • Responsible for order entry, contracts, follow-up and collections
  • Play a role in the production of client’s creative elements
  • Be an advocate for our products and programs
  • Be a person: treat coworkers, prospects and clients with a service-centric attitude
  • Implement strategies to consistently grow revenue and exceed revenue goals
  • Ability to hold meaningful conversations with decision makers
  • Establish credible relationships within our business community
  • Sales experience is preferred
  • Prepare and deliver sales presentations to clients
  • Ability to CLOSE
  • Demonstrates personal integrity to differentiate from the competition
  • Know that that word “no” is an opportunity
  • Proficient with popular social media and digital platforms
  • Can make decisions without supervision
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, & Outlook
  • Educate customers on the variety of available TV and Digital products to most effectively promote their products and/or services
  • Provide clients with information regarding rates for advertising placement on television and digital platforms
  • Work with clients and station personnel to develop advertising and promotional campaigns
  • Develop and maintain a strong knowledge of market trends and the media landscape for the Greater Ozarks area
  • Perform other duties as assigned

  • Requirements:  

    Employment requires a Pre-employment criminal background check, Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record, strong oral and written communication skills. Candidate must be an overachiever that is a passionate team player, with the ability to develop presentations independently.

     

    Additional Information:

     

    Work Environment/Mental/Physical Requirements: High stress environment with deadline pressures. 

     

    NOTE: This job description contains the basic requirements for the position and is NOT intended to be a complete list of responsibilities; other duties may be assigned as needed. 

    Must apply at nexstar.tv/careers to be considered.  No phone calls, please.

Multimedia Journalist (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth)

job.title: News Producer/Digital Content Producer
job.description:
We're looking for a creative, organized, and digitally minded News Producer / Digital Content Producer to help deliver compelling local news across broadcast, digital, streaming, and social platforms. If you're passionate about storytelling, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy connecting with audiences wherever they consume content, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Produce engaging daily newscasts and special news coverage.
  • Write, edit, and publish content for television, web, mobile, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Create multimedia content, including video, live blogs, and breaking news updates.
  • Support live-streaming productions and special event coverage.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, photographers, and digital teams to deliver impactful stories.
  • Use audience insights and analytics to help grow engagement across all platforms.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills.
  • Excellent news judgment and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience with digital publishing, social media, or content management systems.
  • Video editing and live-streaming experience (VMIX, OBS, Adobe Premiere, or similar tools) is a plus.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, Communications, Media Production, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Previous experience in news, digital media, content production, or streaming platforms preferred.

 Why Join Us?

  • Tell stories that impact your community.
  • Gain experience across broadcast, digital, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Work with a collaborative, innovative newsroom team.
  • Play a key role in shaping the future of local news and audience engagement.

#LI-Onsite

job.title: Newscast Director
job.description:
We're seeking a skilled and innovative Newscast Director to lead live and recorded productions across television, streaming, and digital platforms. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom, enjoys leading production teams, and wants to help deliver engaging content to audiences wherever they watch.

What You'll Do

  • Direct live newscasts, special coverage, and locally produced programming.
  • Lead control room operations, coordinating cameras, audio, graphics, and production staff.
  • Produce and oversee content for broadcast, streaming, OTT, CTV, and FAST channels.
  • Direct breaking news, weather, sports, election coverage, and special events.
  • Operate and manage live-streaming technologies, including VMIX, OBS, and related production systems.
  • Partner with newsroom, digital, and engineering teams to deliver high-quality productions across multiple platforms.
  • Train and mentor production staff while helping develop best practices and workflows.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Experience directing live television or streaming productions.
  • Knowledge of control room operations, live production workflows, and digital streaming technologies.
  • Ability to perform under pressure and make quick decisions during breaking news situations.

NewsNation is a national Television News Network owned by Nexstar Media Group, delivering trusted news coverage across Cable, Streaming, and Digital platforms. Our teams in New York, Chicago, and Washington, DC work together to produce high-quality journalism supported by innovative technology and operational excellence.

Position Summary

The Editor creates compelling video content for NewsNation broadcasts and digital platforms. Working closely with Producers and Editorial teams, this role edits daily news content, breaking news, interviews, packages, and long-form projects while maintaining accuracy, speed, and strong editorial judgment.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:  Bachelor’s degree in journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience

job.title: PT Production Grip / Utility
job.description:
PART-TIME PRODUCTION GRIP / UTILITY


KTLA is seeking experienced Grip / Utilities to support the technical and operational needs of live televised special events broadcasts. This position is responsible for assisting with camera support, cable management, equipment movement, set and platform preparation, safety compliance, and general production logistics. Working in a fast-paced, outdoor environment, the Utility/Grip plays a critical role in ensuring that cameras, audio equipment, lighting, and transmission systems operate efficiently throughout the live event.


DUTIES:

• Install, run, label, secure, and maintain camera, audio, fiber, triax, and power cabling along the parade route or live event.

• Assist camera operators with positioning, setup, lens changes, monitor placement, and equipment adjustments.

• Build, maintain, and strike camera platforms, risers, and technical work areas as directed.

• Move, stage, and secure production equipment including cameras, tripods, pedestals, monitors, generators, and support gear.

• Assist engineering and transmission personnel with equipment deployment and troubleshooting.

• Monitor cable runs during the broadcast to prevent damage, signal interruption, or public safety hazards.

• Support lighting, audio, and communications teams as needed.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment throughout setup, broadcast, and strike operations.

• Respond quickly to production needs and changing operational requirements during live coverage.

• An understanding and knowledge of RF systems such as Starlink and Dejero or other related RF systems.

REQUIREMENTS:

• Three to five years professional experience as a grip / utility in live television or events.

• Experience with large-scale remote broadcasts or parade coverage.

• Knowledge of camera support systems, fiber-optic transmission, RF systems, and cable management best practices.

• Familiarity with broadcast safety standards and production logistics.

• Ability to work outdoors for extended periods in varied weather conditions.

• Comfortable working at heights on camera platforms, scaffolding, and elevated positions when required.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively under pressure.

• Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

• Ability to work flexible hours, including overnight setup, early morning call times, weekends, and holidays.

• Strong teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Commitment to maintaining a safe working environment.

• Must be a member of IATSE or willing to join.


AVAILABLE: Immediately.


Compensation: $46.19 hourly


EEO Statement: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.


KTLA will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

job.title: Traffic Coordinator
job.description:
Nexstar Media Group, Inc. has an immediate opening for a Traffic Coordinator! Do you have a knack for numbers? Are you a schedule follower? If keeping the largest television station ownership group in the country on-the-air and broadcasting around the clock could enhance your career journey, Nexstar Media Group invites you to be our next behind-the-scenes star. Help us broadcast and program commercials from coast to coast in Traffic operations hubs located in Tampa!

Nexstar owns America’s largest local broadcasting group comprised of top network affiliates, with 200 owned or partner stations in 117 U.S. markets reaching 220 million people. In addition to delivering exceptional content and service to our communities, Nexstar provides premium multiplatform and video-on-demand advertising opportunities at scale for businesses and brands seeking to leverage the strong consumer engagement of our compelling content offering.

We are extremely proud of our collection of outstanding television stations, digital businesses and talented employees nationwide. Within Nexstar, we are investing and building for the future while forging a culture that promotes our entrepreneurial spirit, embraces bold thinking and challenges the conventional way. If you have curiosity, passion, are inclusive and collaborative, work with us and let’s continue to make a difference for all our stakeholders ~ our colleagues, our customers, our owners, and the communities in which we operate.

What you’ll accomplish as a Traffic Coordinator (Essential Duties):

  • Multitasking with new orders and adjustments to existing logs
  • Daily interaction with television professions in markets across the country
  • Cross department collaboration with sales, engineering, master control, etc.
  • Processing of incoming orders and sales contract translation into the sales module
  • Daily generation of commercial and programming logs for 200 stations in 117 markets
  • Scheduling commercials and applying traffic instructions to every scheduled commercial
  • Inventory control, database library management, broadcast automation, logistical issues
  • So much more

What you’ll need as a Traffic Coordinator (Preferred Qualifications):

  • High school diploma
  • English language skills
  • Meticulous data-entry skills
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Knowledge of, and the ability to interpret, sales contracts
  • Ability to comply with deadlines and perform under pressure
  • Proficiency with computers and an ability to learn new software quickly
  • At least 1 year of experience in clerical support or administrative assistance

If this sounds like you, Nexstar Media Group could be your next home for thriving community involvement, omnichannel advertising innovation and supported career growth.

Nexstar offers full time employees a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, life and short-term disability insurance, worker’s compensation, and unemployment insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, paid vacation, paid sick time, employee assistance program, bereavement leave, jury duty service time off, military leave and medical/maternity and family leave.

Nexstar is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the industry’s top talent.  In compliance with the provisions of all applicable state and federal civil rights laws, every effort will be made to employ the most qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, disability, age, sex, national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, military status or any other protected personal characteristic. job.title: Vice President & General Manager
job.description:
Nexstar Media Inc, America’s largest local broadcasting company, is seeking an experienced television professional to serve as Vice President/General Manager to oversee its media properties in Peoria, Illinois (DMA #122). The Vice President/General Manager will have full oversight over Nexstar’s operations of WMBD (CBS) and will oversee its operational agreements with Cunningham Broadcasting providing services to WYZZ (Fox), as well as centralillinoisproud.com and all other digital, mobile, and social assets for the stations.   


The ideal candidate for this role will leverage their proven skill sets and extensive experience in leading broadcast operational teams within sales-driven organizations, including a strong understanding of advanced digital ad solutions, and new business development. Additionally, they will possess a strong background in creating locally originated content for multiple platforms (OTT, linear, web, social), driving audience engagement, and increasing our overall reach. A demonstrated ability to promote a collaborative culture within all station departments is essential, ensuring operational efficiencies and continued growth. Experience in managing a duopoly station is preferred.


Ideal candidates will have a minimum of five years of broadcast management experience at a commercial broadcast television station with accompanying digital assets. The right fit for this position will be a seasoned and knowledgeable professional who is a driven advocate of local broadcasting and digital service to the community in which they have previously served. This position requires a leader with exemplary strategic vision, focused execution, and a verified understanding of local outreach and thoughtful community involvement. In addition to having a proven track record of managing high-performing sales, and news teams, the successful candidate must be effective in collaborating with department heads, staff members and promoting teamwork within all areas of station operations. The ability to engage local community leaders and develop long-term relationships with key station clients is essential.


Peoria, Illinois offers a welcoming community with a low cost of living, making it an attractive place to call home. Known for its strong sense of neighborhood and excellent schools, Peoria combines the charm of a mid-sized city with easy access to outdoor recreation along the Illinois River. Residents enjoy a vibrant arts scene, diverse dining options, and short commutes, all while benefiting from affordable housing and a balanced lifestyle. Its central location also provides convenient travel to major Midwest cities, making Peoria an ideal spot for both work and leisure.


Compensation:   $185k+ commensurate with experience and skill level.  Position is eligible for bonuses and commissions.

Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, life insurance, Paid Parental Leave and more



If you are interested in joining the executive ranks of the Nexstar Media Inc, and making an impact in Peoria, Illinois, you are encouraged to apply online at www.nexstar.tv/careers/


About Nexstar Media Group, Inc.


Nexstar Media Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: NXST) is a leading diversified media company that produces and distributes engaging local and national news, sports and entertainment content across its television and digital platforms, including more than 317,000 hours of programming produced annually by its business units. Nexstar owns America’s largest local television broadcasting group comprised of top network affiliates, with more than 200 owned or partner stations in 116 U.S. markets reaching 220 million people. Nexstar’s national television properties include The CW, America’s fifth major broadcast network, NewsNation, a national cable news network, popular entertainment multicast networks Antenna TV and Rewind TV, and a 31.3% ownership stake in TV Food Network. The Company’s portfolio of digital assets, including its local TV station websites, The Hill and NewsNationNow.com, are collectively a Top 10 U.S. digital news and information property. job.title: Associate Counsel
job.description:
The NFL is seeking an experienced commercial transactional lawyer to provide legal and business affairs advice in support of the NFL's international growth strategy. Based in the NFL's London office, this role will serve as a key member of the NFL's London-based legal team and the broader global Legal Department, providing primary legal support to the League's European offices, business operations and International Games activities, while also supporting broader international initiatives. The successful candidate must be comfortable leading matters independently, exercising sound commercial judgment, and collaborating closely with colleagues across the legal team in both London and New York, while managing multiple priorities across jurisdictions and time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Structuring, drafting and negotiating contracts to support the NFL’s growing international work streams (e.g. International Games, International club marketing initiatives, International Player Development Programs, International Flag Football Programs, International Sponsorship and Licensing activities and the day-to-day activities of the international offices).
  • Providing robust legal advice and risk mitigation strategies in an efficient and effective manner to the international operational and commercial teams.
  • Supporting the Senior Counsel responsible for international legal matters in overseeing the European and broader international legal workload, including independently leading material matters, acting as a senior day-to-day legal contact for European stakeholders and deputizing on appropriate matters.
  • Supporting the NFL’s Head of Privacy to ensure the NFL’s international activities comply with relevant privacy laws and applicable League policies.
  • Monitoring legal developments and updating template documents to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements and best practice.
  • Managing outside counsel in relevant international markets.

Required Qualifications

  • 2-5+ years of commercial transactional experience as a qualified solicitor gained at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department
  • Strong contract drafting and negotiation skills
  • Experience driving compliance with data privacy laws, including a foundational knowledge of the GDPR and other international privacy regulations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience with sports law
  • Previous in-house experience
  • Previous experience advising or working for a US company
  • Foreign languages

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must be collaborative, personable and able to work effectively with a broad spectrum of different people
  • Must be able to adapt to rapidly developing business initiatives, multiple competing priorities and inconvenient time-zones

Travel

  • Periodic travel to NFL offices (including NY headquarters and international offices) and international events

Benefits Information
To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered. 

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

WHO WE ARE:

NFL Core Values:

  • Respect: Everyone matters. We celebrate diverse opinions, honor hard work, and value every contribution.
  • Integrity: We do what's right, even when it's tough. We hold ourselves accountable and always follow through.
  • Team Responsibility: We support each other and our communities. No one is bigger than the game, and every action impacts others.
  • Resiliency: We set high standards, overcome adversity, and adapt to challenges, always striving for excellence.

NFL Leadership Attributes:

  • Build Talent: We develop and nurture potential, empowering individuals to grow and succeed.
  • Execute: We take action with precision, delivering results that drive our goals forward.
  • Inspire: We motivate others through vision, energy, and a commitment to excellence.
  • Live Our Values: We embody our core principles in every decision and action.
  • Know the Business: We stay informed, understand our industry, and make decisions that strengthen our position.
  • Think Big: We challenge the status quo, envision bold possibilities, and strive for transformative impact

WHO YOU ARE:

Talent Attributes:   What we expect for our employees:

  • Embody an enthusiastic, proactive can-do attitude 
  • Embrace grit, free from ego or entitlement
  • Excel as a relationship builder, with the ability to influence
  • Eager learner, driven by passion rather than just ambition
  • Encompasses an incredible work ethic with an agile mindset

job.title: Associate, Communications and Public Affairs
job.description:
The Communications Associate will provide day-to-day communications and administrative support to the Manager, Communications & Public Affairs across NFL Major Events, Music & Entertainment, Marketing and Club Business Development. The role will assist with media relations, media operations, project coordination, and the development of communications materials that support league and club priorities.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist with the planning and execution of communications and media relations efforts for NFL major events, including Super Bowl, Pro Bowl, NFL Draft, NFL Kickoff and NFL Combine, as well as related events and programming in host markets.
  • Support publicity efforts for NFL Music & Entertainment initiatives by developing media materials, conducting research, maintaining media lists and helping coordinate interviews and other press opportunities for NFL executives and artist partners.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, host city partners, agencies and other external stakeholders to gather information, track deliverables and help ensure communications materials receive the necessary reviews and approvals.
  • Provide on-site media operations support at NFL major events, including credentialing, media check-in, red carpet logistics, press conference logistics, media previews, interview coordination and live broadcast opportunities.
  • Assist with communications efforts supporting NFL marketing initiatives, including brand campaigns, executive speaking opportunities/panels, creator programs, influencer partnerships and Latino marketing initiatives.
  • Support the Club Business Development teams priorities by helping coordinate communications with NFL clubs, collecting updates, and identifying opportunities to elevate club initiatives through national media and league channels.
  • Build and maintain relationships with national and local media, respond to routine media requests and support proactive outreach designed to generate positive coverage of NFL events, programs and business initiatives.
  • Craft communications materials including press releases, media guides, pitches and executive talking points.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, media relations
  • A team player with the ability to effectively support intra- and cross-departmental activities in public relations.
  • Excellent knowledge of current events and happenings in public relations, the NFL, general news, entertainment, music, pop culture and sports media, marketing and business.
  • Awareness surrounding social media trends and popular content creators.
  • A self-starter with strong written and verbal communications skills, excellent organizational skills, research skills and strong interpersonal skills.
  • Outstanding attention to detail and ability to design and develop processes from scratch.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must demonstrate strong initiative and provide clear, concise communication with team members and senior management, and set high standards.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • High moral and ethical standards. Can be relied upon to always act in the best interests of the league.
  • Strategic and proactive communications practitioner who will be a hands-on, sleeves-up team player.

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Employees are required to work minimum of 40 hours per week in the office.

job.title: Associate, Real-Time Systems (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Associate, Real-Time Systems supports the design, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of Real-Time Systems that power NFL Media digital graphics experiences, including FAST channels, NFL+, RedZone, and other digital productions. This role serves as a technical resource for Viz graphics workflows, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, data integrations, and real-time content delivery while helping ensure reliable operation of critical production systems.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Viz graphics systems, render engines, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, and supporting software environments to ensure reliable delivery of graphics across FAST, digital, and RedZone platforms.
  • Support end-to-end graphics workflows including data-driven Viz graphics, scorebars, ticker content, promotional elements, sponsorship integrations, countdown clocks, and lower-third graphic packages to ensure accurate on-air and digital presentation.
  • Maintain RTS applications, databases, APIs, and automated page generation tools while validating data flow between internal services, graphics systems, and production environments.
  • Serve as a frontline technical resource during live productions by diagnosing and resolving graphics, connectivity, software, and data issues to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Partner with production, engineering, and operations teams to support FAST channel graphics, RedZone L-Bar workflows, ticker content management, and digital platform graphics delivery.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, workflow guides, system inventories, and operational procedures while identifying opportunities for process improvements and automation.
  • Assist with preparation, testing, deployment, and operational support for major league events including the NFL Draft, NFL Combine, International Games, Kickoff, Playoffs, and Super Bowl coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Digital Media, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting broadcast graphics, digital media operations, production technology, or real-time systems.
  • Experience supporting Vizrt, graphics rendering systems, or similar real-time graphics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of networking, Windows administration, system configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with data-driven graphics, APIs, databases, and content automation workflows.
  • Experience supporting live production, digital streaming, or broadcast operations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting FAST channels, OTT streaming platforms, or sports media operations.
  • Experience with Viz Trio, Viz Engine, ticker systems, or graphics automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and scripting/automation tools.
  • Experience supporting major live sporting events.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure during live productions.
  • Strong customer service mindset and production support orientation.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in control rooms, machine rooms, and production environments.
  • Occasional lifting and movement of production or IT equipment up to 40 pounds.

Travel

  • No travel typically required.

 Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Flexible schedule required.
  • Evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday work may be required during live productions and major events.
  • Overtime may be required based on production schedules.
  • This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

job.title: Manager, Communications-Consumer Products
job.description:
Reporting to the Director of Communications, this role manages communications for the league’s Consumer Products business, works as a part of the international communications team supporting the League’s office in Canada, and oversees communications for Digital Media Partnerships and IT/Technology. Working across these teams, the role will develop proactive strategies that strengthen key business relationships, advance league priorities, and engage consumer, business, and trade audiences. The ideal candidate brings experience in a fast-paced consumer or brand environment and can effectively manage multiple internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and execute communications strategies for the league’s Consumer Products business, including product launches, campaigns, partnerships, and key retail moments.
  • Partner with internal teams and external organizations to increase awareness of NFL products and support business objectives across NFLShop.com and key retailers.
  • Manage the communications agency supporting the Consumer Products business, including priorities, deliverables, and results.
  • As a member of the international communications team, serve as the day-to-day comms point for the NFL office in Toronto supporting all Canada-related priorities.
  • Partner with communications colleagues across league offices and the 32 clubs to amplify priority stories and key moments.
  • Work regularly with league executives, business leaders, partners, and other external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain relationships with consumer, business, sports, entertainment, fashion, and technology media.
  • Contribute to issues and crisis communications as needed, supporting timely and coordinated responses.

Required Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications or related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of professional experience in communications, public relations, media relations, or a related field.
  • Experience working for a consumer-facing brand, communications agency, sports or entertainment organization, or similarly fast-paced business.
  • Strong writing, editing, pitching, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor stories for traditional, digital, social-first, and trade audiences.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing proactive communications campaigns, announcements, and media strategies.
  • Knowledge of cultural and consumer trends, particularly across sports, fashion, entertainment, arts, lifestyle, media, or technology.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Experience collaborating across functions and building effective relationships with colleagues, leaders, agencies, partners, and media contacts.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to work effectively in high-profile, high-pressure situations.
  • Experience supporting issues or crisis communications is preferred.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics: 

  • Strategic thinker: Connects communications plans to business goals and identifies proactive storytelling opportunities.
  • Collaborative partner: Builds trust across teams and works effectively with executives, clubs, agencies, partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Adaptable operator: Stays organized and composed while managing changing priorities, tight deadlines, and multiple workstreams.
  • Proactive team player: Takes initiative, contributes ideas, and is comfortable working hands-on to move projects forward.
  • Creative storyteller: Finds fresh, relevant ways to reach new audiences across established and emerging platforms.
  • Sound judgment: Handles sensitive information responsibly and acts with integrity.

Travel: 

Regular travel to NFL events such as the Super Bowl and Draft. 

Terms /Expected Hours of Work: 

NFL employees are required to work a minimum of 40 hours per week in the office.

job.title: Manager, Global Consumer Insights & Research
job.description:
The NFL's Marketing Strategy, Planning & Insights team serves as a center of excellence for the League, shaping how the NFL grows fans, strengthens the brand, and drives engagement across the U.S. and international markets. The team brings together consumer insights, audience strategy, business planning, initiative-level strategy, and performance measurement to ground decisions in fan understanding, market dynamics, and business priorities. Partnering across business functions and key stakeholders (e.g., the 32 NFL Clubs, partners), the team delivers actionable insights, strategic guidance, and planning frameworks that inform both long-term strategy and day-to-day decisions.

Within this team, Consumer Insights designs and conducts primary research, integrates syndicated and first-party data, and delivers actionable insights across global fan development, brand health, media, live events, marketing effectiveness, partnerships, social responsibility, and player-related priorities.

The Manager, Global Strategic Insights supports research development, analysis, and insights generation to inform global fan development and business growth. The role conducts and synthesizes primary research, syndicated sources, first-party data, and market intelligence to ensure Leaguewide decision-making is grounded in a fan-first perspective.

Responsibilities

Global Fandom Intelligence

  • Monitor fandom, avidity, engagement, and brand health, as well as the drivers of and barriers to each.
  • Analyze cultural, behavioral, and regional differences to identify opportunities to acquire, develop, engage, and monetize fans.
  • Leverage NFL-specific and macro landscape insights to support the development of audience-level strategies by demographic, market, and other relevant segmentation lenses, such as engagement level and football knowledge.

Strategic Insights & Business Planning

  • Support strategic analyses, forecasts, scenario planning, and performance measurement tied to near- and long-range priorities.
  • Connect fan behavior, research findings, and marketplace trends to business opportunities and actionable recommendations.
  • Develop executive-ready presentations, memos, and key planning documents.

Consumer Insights & Research Execution

  • Support qualitative and quantitative research from objective setting and methodology selection through questionnaire or discussion guide development, analysis, and reporting.
  • Manage day-to-day stakeholder and vendor coordination, timelines, and deliverables across multiple projects.
  • Synthesize primary research, syndicated data, first-party information, and secondary sources into concise, story-driven visuals and recommendations using best-in-class practices.

Brand, Media & Marketing Effectiveness

  • Measure brand campaigns, creative effectiveness, audience sentiment, cultural relevance, and other equity measures across markets and fan segments.
  • Analyze broadcast, streaming, direct-to-consumer, content, and emerging viewing experiences to inform audience growth, media, product, and marketing strategies.
  • Evaluate new products, events, experiences, and fan engagement initiatives across the NFL ecosystem.

Stakeholder Partnership & Team Contribution

  • Build collaborative relationships across the League, Clubs, markets, and external research partners, advocating for fan-centric, insight-driven decisions.
  • Communicate complex research through clear, concise storytelling tailored to varied audiences.
  • Coordinate multiple workstreams while maintaining quality, timing, and business relevance.
  • Support junior team members through coaching and project guidance, and improve research processes, reporting standards, and insight socialization.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in consumer insights, market research, strategy, analytics, or a related field.
  • Ability to translate business questions into research objectives and quantitative or qualitative research plans.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex findings and communicate concise, actionable insights to varied stakeholders.
  • Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with experience creating executive-ready presentations and insight-driven reports.
  • Strong project management, cross-functional collaboration, and relationship-building skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with research methods such as segmentation, surveys, ethnography, interviews, and focus groups, plus familiarity with syndicated media measurement and applied analytics.
  • Proficiency with analytical tools such as Microsoft Excel, SPSS, or Q.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience managing vendors and/or analysts; strong people management capabilities preferred.
  • Familiarity with sports and entertainment; knowledge of media and live events is a plus.
  • Experience working with global or multinational businesses and measurement frameworks strongly preferred.
  • Spanish, Portuguese, French, and/or German language proficiency is a plus.
  • Master’s degree in Market Research preferred.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Some travel required
  • NFL employees are required to work in office

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.title: Manager, Global Social Monetization
job.description:
The NFL’s Marketing department is seeking a Manager, Global Social Monetization to support social revenue priorities across the League and all 32 clubs. This role will track and report on sponsored social content across the ecosystem, help clubs optimize monetized assets through insights and best practices, and manage assigned partnership workstreams. The ideal candidate brings strong social media and analytical experience, along with the ability to collaborate effectively across clubs, internal teams, and external partners. Prior sponsorship experience is a plus. 

Responsibilities:

  • Function as the NFL’s day-to-day point of contact for all 32 clubs on social monetization-related topics.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on branded content trends, platform opportunities, and strategies that help the League and clubs maximize revenue generated through social media.
  • Develop and distribute playbooks, best practices, educational materials, benchmarks, and strategic recommendations for clubs and internal stakeholders.
  • Analyze monetization performance across club and League social channels.
  • Present insights, reporting, and recommendations through club meetings, trainings, internal stakeholder forums, and executive presentations.
  • Own tracking and reporting related to League social monetization initiatives, including sponsorship-related deliverables and business impact.
  • Help operationalize branded content and sponsored social deliverables for @NFL, ensuring timely execution and cross-functional alignment.
  • Identify available social inventory and emerging monetization opportunities, inclusive of opportunities with native platform monetization programs (i.e. Facebook Content Monetization, X Amplify, etc.).
  • Support strategic planning and execution for League content partnerships, including but not limited to Madden, Nike, etc.
  • Partner cross-functionally across a variety of departments and stakeholders to support key business objectives.
  • Manage and mentor at least one direct report.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or another related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in social media, content partnerships, sponsorship, media, monetization, or related field.
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Threads, Snap, and Reddit.
  • Experience building or maintaining reporting frameworks.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across levels.
  • Familiarity with social analytics, sponsorship measurement, and monetization reporting tools.
  • Ability to create clear, visually compelling presentations, reports, and dashboards.
  • Strong project management, organization, and attention to detail across multiple workstreams.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strategic, proactive, and solution-oriented.
  • Collaborative and service-minded, with the ability to build trust across a range of stakeholder groups.
  • Comfortable navigating evolving business areas and establishing clear processes where needed.
  • Detail-oriented and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting sponsorship, partnership, or revenue-generating digital programs.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Must be able to work nights and weekends during NFL gamedays, League events (e.g., Combine, Draft), and other peak periods.
  • Must be able to work holidays depending on the NFL game schedule, including but not limited to Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year’s Eve, and New Year’s Day.
  • Travel- 5%

job.title: Part-Time Segment Producer
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media office in Inglewood, CA is looking for a Part-Time Segment Producer. This position reports to a Senior Producer and is involved in all aspects of studio-based programming. A successful candidate will have experience working on live studio shows across both digital and linear platforms and possess a strong knowledge of football. Success in this role requires a self-starter mentality, creative thinking, strong editorial judgment, and the ability to produce compelling content in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for producing a wide range of content for live studio shows on streaming platforms.
  • Responsible for generating and researching content ideas and graphics.
  • Adjust segment content to accommodate breaking news situations.
  • Coordinate with on-air staff to write accurate and informative content for assigned segments.
  • Apply strong sports knowledge and news judgment to determine the agenda, concepts, and content of the assigned segments.
  • Oversee individual segments from development through execution.
  • Work with hosts and analysts on segment and element development.
  • Assign and provide creative and editorial notes for high-end element production.
  • Preview video and sound for assigned segments.
  • Communicate detailed edit notes and instructions to editors and associate producers.
  • Communicate daily story development with the Producer.
  • Pitch story ideas and participate in the planning and development of next-day stories.

 Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressively complex studio production or related experience.
  • Strong production skills related to sporting events and graphics.
  • Strong knowledge of live television production dynamics and working knowledge of equipment and technologies used in control rooms and edit bays.

job.title: Seasonal Associate Producer
job.description:
Overview        

The Seasonal Associate Producer contributes to editorial and production execution across a range of NFL Films programming. The role supports research, editing, scripting, and post-production workflows while collaborating closely with Producers.  

Key Responsibilities

  • Support Producers with research and logging footage using Avid Media Composer and NFL proprietary software.
  • Leads the organization and management of media assets throughout production.
  • Support story development through research, fact-checking, and editorial input.
  • Edit teases, short segments or blocks of programming.
  • Assist with scripting, narration drafts, and production documentation.
  • Participate in creative discussions and pitches ideas.

job.title: Seasonal Coordinator, Social Analytics & Listening
job.description:
The NFL is currently seeking a Seasonal Coordinator to join our Social Analytics and Listening Team (SALT) in the Social and Influencer Marketing department. This individual will be responsible for supporting SALT by working on reporting and analysis, with a special focus on the NFL’s international social handles. This individual will be key in deriving insights and driving global social strategy from data. The successful candidate will have a deep understanding of and passion for the National Football League, its member Clubs, Players, and social media strategy / data.

Essential Functions

  • Support the Social Analytics and Listening Team (SALT) by producing reporting and analysis of NFL social media performance.
  • Focus on international social media handles, identifying key trends and performance drivers.
  • Derive actionable insights from data to inform and optimize global social strategy.
  • Deliver regular reports and presentations to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor and evaluate the impact of campaigns, content, and influencer partnerships.
  • Assist in social listening to track fan sentiment, cultural moments, and engagement trends.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 1–2+ years of experience in social media analytics, marketing analytics, or related data-driven role.
  • Proficiency with social media platforms (Instagram, X/Twitter, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, etc.) and their analytics tools.
  • Strong skills in Excel/Google Sheets

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Prior experience in sports, entertainment, or digital media analytics.
  • Familiarity with social listening platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Talkwalker).
  • Experience working with global or multilingual social media accounts.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Collaborative team player with flexibility to support fast-paced projects.
  • Self-starter who can prioritize tasks and meet deadlines under pressure.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time RedZone Production Assistant
job.description:
The NFL Media Group located in Inglewood, CA is looking for a seasonal, part-time NFL RedZone Production Assistant. This position will report to the Coordinating Producer for NFL RedZone.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with editors to support content for NFL RedZone
  • Responsible for watching a game and producing multiple highlights for NFL RedZone halftime fill segments
  • Transcribing interviews, press conferences, and other related sound to be edited for NFL RedZone
  • Take direction from show Producers to enhance content on NFL RedZone
  • Must be able to respond quickly under tight deadlines and adapt to changing priorities while NFL RedZone is live on air
  • Good communication and writing skills are required
  • Daily adherence to established production schedules to meet deadlines
  • Responsible for archiving important video, teleprompting shows and other various tasks related to the production of NFL RedZone

Required Qualifications

  • Strong NFL knowledge (present day & historical)
  • Strong editorial judgement and attention to detail/organizational skills
  • Ability to decipher the most important and up-to-date information for NFL stories & live game action during NFL RedZone
  • Strong understanding of workflows in control rooms and edit environments
  • Strong writing skills
  • Have a good knowledge of the NFL and sports history
  • Ability to perform basic statistical and info-based research

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism or equivalent experience in a related field 
  • Previous professional experience in a TV production environment is strongly preferred
  • Basic understanding of linear editing and on-air graphics systems

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to establish open communication and perform well under pressure
  • A team-first attitude is mandatory

job.title: Seasonal Recruiter
job.description:
The Seasonal Recruiter will lead seasonal recruitment efforts for various NFL offices.  In this role, you will be a talent advisor and build strong relationships with the senior management team. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role with senior management, hiring managers, compensation, finance, and HR Business Partners in driving hiring and employee retention efficiencies that support the NFL's vision, mission, and values. 

Please note this role is in-person/office five days a week based in Mount Laurel, NJ. Up to seven months of anticipated engagement (subject to change based on business needs).

Responsibilities 

  • Manage 40 to 50+ open seasonal requisitions at once across multiple departments and locations during peak hiring periods 
  • Execute full-cycle, high volume recruitment including screening, interviewing, and extending offers 
  • Support Early Career recruitment efforts during non-peak seasonal hiring times 
  • Build strong working relationships with HR and hiring managers to understand business needs, seasonal headcount planning, and job requirements 
  • Identify, and recruit candidates for a wide range of temporary roles across media, production, and game operations 
  • Maintain accurate and organized data in the applicant tracking system (Greenhouse) for all candidates and requisitions 
  • Create and deliver regular search status updates to hiring managers and partners 
  • Ensure equitable hiring processes in line with NFL standards and policies 
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines to support recurring seasonal staffing needs 
  • Represent the NFL at in person or virtual hiring events, job fairs, and recruiting programs as needed 
  • Manage offer processes including recommendations, drafting and extending offers, and negotiations as permitted 
  • Ensure onboarding requirements are completed, including background checks, offer letters, new hire paperwork, and start date coordination 
  • Partner with HR teams to support smooth onboarding experiences 
  • Ensure compliance with EEO, ADA, and all applicable federal and state employment laws 

Required Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of high‑volume recruitment experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience 
  • Demonstrated ability to efficiently manage 40 to 50+ high‑volume requisitions simultaneously 
  • Experience working with various recruitment platforms including, but not limited to Greenhouse, LinkedIn, and HireVue. 
  • Strong working knowledge of federal and state employment law as well as corporate recruitment processes 
  • Superior candidate management experience 
  • Excellent project management skills  

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics 

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment 
  • Experience supporting large‑scale, fast‑turnaround staffing initiatives 
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly learn operational needs across multiple departments 
  • Ability to work both collaboratively and independently with minimal supervision 
  • Detail‑oriented with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines 
  • Consistent follow‑through, strong initiative, and proactive problem‑solving skills 

Terms /Expected Hours of Work 

  • Up to seven months of anticipated engagement (subject to change based on business needs) 
  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week and at times, this role may require overtime (time worked in excess of 40 hours) and/or weekends.  
  • FLSA non-exempt  
  • Please note that this job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. 

Salary / Pay Range 

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range. 

Salary $30—$40 USD

job.title: Senior Manager, Customer Engagement Analytics
job.description:
Fan Engagement Data Science turns fan behavior into the strategies that shape how millions of fans experience the NFL. In this role, you'll sit at the center of that work, partnering with our NYC team and stakeholders across Marketing, DTC, and Consumer Insights, while leading a distributed offshore delivery team to turn ambiguous ideas into sharp, high-impact analytics. You’ll work end-to-end, from framing the right question to presenting the answer to Director- and VP-level leaders, on a fast-moving team delivering against one of the NFL's biggest fan engagement programs.

Responsibilities

  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, DTC, and Consumer Insights stakeholders into scoped, high-impact analytical work.
  • Lead and coach a distributed offshore delivery team, keeping quality, pace, and prioritization on track across a compressed daily overlap window.
  • Own your work end-to-end — from framing a hypothesis to presenting recommendations directly to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships across marketing, technology, BI, and data engineering as a trusted analytics voice in the room.
  • Design segmentation, predictive models, and experiments (A/B tests) that convert fan behavior into targeted, actionable marketing strategies.
  • Apply GenAI/LLM-assisted analytics tools, within governed workflows, to move faster from data to insight.
  • Define and manage KPIs for fan engagement, partnering with the BI Center of Excellence to expand access to insight across the org.
  • Champion data quality and integrity across every initiative you touch

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in customer or fan data analytics, with a strong track record of translating data into marketing strategy.
  • Experience turning ambiguous business questions into scoped, delivery-ready analytical work.
  • Experience leading or closely partnering with distributed or offshore teams.
  • A confident, clear communicator — comfortable presenting directly to senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL and Python; working knowledge of ML frameworks and GenAI/LLM-based analytics tools.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Understanding of data management principles, including identity resolution and marketing consent.
  • Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data stack (e.g., AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with customer data platforms (Adobe Experience Platform, or similar).
  • Familiarity with PII management and data privacy practices.
  • Experience with governed AI-assisted analytics workflows.
  • Familiarity with data observability tooling (e.g., Monte Carlo, Atlan).

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Bias to Ownership: Treats an ambiguous or stalled workstream as something to unblock and drive forward, not something to report status on and wait for direction.
  • Leadership Excellence: Strong leadership skills with a history of managing diverse, distributed, and cross-functional teams effectively.
  • Communication Mastery: Excellent ability to simplify complex data insights into strategic actions and communicate these clearly to both business and technical stakeholders, including in contested or high-pressure settings.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sr. Manager of Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science to join our Data & Analytics team at the NFL. Based in the League’s New York office, this role partners with internal stakeholders and all 32 clubs to turn business questions and fan data into actionable recommendations, scalable analytics products, and measurable growth across ticketing, premium seating, sponsorship, and fan engagement. The role also works with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence to ensure solutions are accurate, governed, and scalable.

The ideal candidate combines business acumen, data science and advanced analytics experience, executive communication skills, and a consultative mindset to turn insights into action.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and collaborate with stakeholders from Club Business Development and the 32 clubs to understand their analytics needs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Oversee the development and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive analytics platforms to support ticketing, premium seating and sponsorship analytics and insights.
  • Lead advanced analytics to evaluate ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship behavior, including KPI monitoring, segmentation, customer profiling, and predictive modeling.
  • Effectively communicate analytical findings to stakeholders, translating complex data analysis into clear and concise insights.
  • Collaborate with BI and technology teams to ensure ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship platforms receive accurate, reliable data through regular quality audits and validation.
  • Perform data extraction, transformation and analysis using SQL and Python.
  • Develop and implement attribution models to measure the impact of different League-provided data products.
  • Work with the BI COE to create dashboards to provide insights and recommendations based on analytics findings.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in club analytics and data quality management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Club Business Development, Marketing and the 32 clubs to align analytics initiatives and drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Collaborate with analytics consulting vendors.
  • Foster a collaborative and agile work environment, leveraging tools like Jira for project management and task tracking.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in revenue analytics, pricing, customer analytics, ticketing, consulting, ecommerce, hospitality, sports, media, or another commercially oriented industry or other relevant industry experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, direct analytical work, and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with practical experience working with large customer, transactional, or behavioral datasets.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, customer segmentation, forecasting, experimentation or campaign measurement, and analytical storytelling.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex analytical workstreams and coaching analysts
  • Proven ability to communicate with senior business and technical stakeholders and present complex analysis in a clear, concise, and influential manner.
  • Experience partnering with data engineering, BI, product, or technology teams to deliver scalable analytical solutions with strong data quality and governance.
  • 3 years of management experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Sports, clubs, ticketing, live events, venue, hospitality, airline, subscription, or revenue management experience.
  • Experience with Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, or comparable ticketing and live-event datasets.
  • Experience developing club-facing, client-facing, or executive-facing recommendations in a consulting or analytics advisory environment.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
  • Strong collaborator who communicates transparently, supports shared goals, and welcomes constructive challenges.

job.title: Cloud Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking a Systems Engineer for its Distribution IT Infrastructure team to manage, test, and maintain our enterprise virtualized infrastructure, including servers, storage, and networking systems. In this role, you will deploy, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot modern virtualization platforms (such as VMware vSphere, HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, or Proxmox) to guarantee high availability, scalability, and security across NPR's core distribution technologies.

This role sits at the intersection of physical and virtual infrastructure: you will help stand up new data center hardware and build NPR's private cloud environment on top of it, from rack and cable to hypervisor and host networking.

Working collaboratively with Infrastructure and Security colleagues, you will analyze business workflows, implement structured change management processes, and support capacity planning initiatives to deliver resilient, mission-critical operations for NPR and our nationwide Member station network.

Responsibilities

  • Physical Infrastructure Build-Out: Partner with Infrastructure colleagues to install, rack, cable, and configure new server, storage, and network hardware, including firmware updates, out-of-band management (e.g., HPE iLO, Dell iDRAC), and RAID/BIOS configuration, to establish the foundation for virtualized workloads.
  • Virtual Infrastructure Deployment & Maintenance: Deploy, configure, and maintain virtualized systems using enterprise tools (e.g., HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, Proxmox, Nutanix, Incus, or VMware) to support operational reliability.
  • Architecture Evaluation & Testing: Evaluate virtual system architecture, compare existing applications, and create metrics to measure response times and availability for test environments.
  • Change Management Implementation: Recommend and execute system enhancements following established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  • Operational & Capacity Support: Assist the Distribution Infrastructure team in executing cloud/virtualization workflows and capacity planning tools focused on return on investment and business value.
  • Security Alignment & Compliance: Partner with Security Engineers to ensure virtual hosts, operating systems, and network configurations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Workflow & Process Analysis: Analyze and document Distribution IT process workflows, identifying areas for continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Technical Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create comprehensive documentation, procedures, instructions, and training materials for internal colleagues and system users.
  • Incident Escalation & Operational Support: Proactively communicate operational status to management, participate in an on-call rotation, and respond to critical system issues on a 24x7 basis as needed.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and administering servers and networking within a data center environment.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in the planning, design, deployment, and management of enterprise virtualized cloud infrastructure (e.g., VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, or open-source hypervisors).
  • Hands-on experience with physical data center hardware, including racking and cabling servers, configuring out-of-band 
  • Competence in DNS administration (BIND preferred).
  • Experience with IP address management (IPAM) and DHCP services.
  • Experience with configuration management (Puppet preferred).
  • Experience creating agentless automation workflows (Ansible preferred).
  • Experience with Mail Transfer Agent administration (Exim).
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server administration (2022+) alongside core directory and networking protocols (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS).
  • Practical experience supporting enterprise storage (NetApp or TrueNAS).
  • Comfortable with networking configuration of hosts, switches, and routers, including VLANs, trunking, and NIC bonding/link aggregation as applied to hypervisor hosts.
  • Proven track record as a key contributor or project leader on complex technical initiatives, including the creation of detailed technical documentation and workflow diagrams.
  • Demonstrated ability to participate effectively in a team environment, handle multiple concurrent projects, and contribute to an on-call rotation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Unix/Linux networking configuration and Cisco switches and routers (Catalyst or Nexus/NX-OS).
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript).
  • Experience with enterprise backup/recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam).
  • Experience with HPE ProLiant or Dell PowerEdge server hardware.
  • Knowledge of Linux operating systems and relevant industry certifications (VMware VCP, Microsoft, or AWS).

Required Skills/Competencies

  • System Troubleshooting & Diagnostics: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve complex issues across hardware, server, storage, network, and virtualized layers.
  • Structured Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills to present technical concepts and write actionable system documentation.
  • Prioritization Under Pressure: Capacity to prioritize tasks effectively during high-urgency system maintenance or operational incidents.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to partner seamlessly with Security, Network, and Distribution engineering teams.
  • Continuous Learning Mindset: Commitment to staying current with emerging virtualization tools, cloud platforms, and data center technologies.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience.

Work Location

Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.

Job Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $109,350 - $133,650 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.
