job.title: Editor II, Network Desk - Northeast Region
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions

  • Application Deadline: Monday, October 19th, at 5:00 pm ET.
  • Submission Instructions: Please submit a cover letter in addition to your resume including a direct link to a story (audio or digital) that you edited and were particularly proud of. Please describe any challenges you encountered, and call out the contributions you made.

Intro to Position

The Network Desk represents NPR’s strategic commitment to deepening, broadening, and transforming how we partner with Member stations and Regional Hubs. As the Northeast Regional Editor, you will serve as the essential bridge between local station newsrooms across the Northeast and national NPR news programs and digital platforms. In this role, you will help identify, curate, and elevate distinctive local reporting to national audiences while helping stations plan and execute ambitious enterprise and breaking news coverage.

The ideal candidate brings a collaborative editorial mindset, sharp line-editing skills across audio and text, and a commitment to expanding the diversity of sources and stories emerging from the region.

NPR defines its Northeast Region as ME, NH, VT, MA, RI, CT, NY, NJ, PA, DE, MD, and DC.

This is a union represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA. 

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.   

Responsibilities

  • Network Editorial Coordination: Communicate and collaborate daily with journalists, news directors, and editors across Northeast regional hubs and Member stations to identify, develop, and coordinate coverage with national resonance.
  • Content Editing & Quality Assurance: Edit, fact-check, and supervise the preparation of multiplatform material (audio, digital, broadcast) from station reporters and freelancers, ensuring all work meets NPR’s journalistic standards of fairness, accuracy, and technical quality.
  • Breaking News Leadership: Coordinate rapid-response breaking news coverage from the region, directing station updates and dispatches for national shows, digital platforms, and hourly newscasts.
  • Show & Platform Integration: Maintain ongoing communication with NPR daily news magazines (Morning Edition, All Things Considered, Here & Now), podcasts, and the digital news desk regarding story length, angles, framing, and scheduling.
  • Coverage Planning & Horizon Scanning: Track evolving regional news cycles, maintain forward-looking editorial calendars, and spot emerging cultural, political, and systemic trends across the Northeast.
  • Editorial Mentorship & Training: Partner with Regional Hubs to conduct workshops, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions that strengthen station reporting capabilities and familiarize partners with NPR production workflows.
  • Inclusive Sourcing & Story Development: Champion story ideas that reflect the full demographic and geographical diversity of the Northeast, actively expanding regional source networks.
  • Desk Administration & Contributor Management: Coordinate administrative desk workflows, including processing freelancer agreements, story commissions, and reporter filing payments in accordance with established agreements.
  • Network Collaboration: Partner with fellow regional editors and Network Desk leadership to refine communication pipelines, eliminate operational silos, and improve newsroom workflows.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time. 

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of professional journalism experience at with a reputable news organization.
  • 3+ years of experience editing regional or national daily news coverage across audio and digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated track record editing breaking news under tight deadlines with precision and journalistic integrity.
  • Proven experience editing enterprise, investigative, or feature journalism, guiding stories from pitch to final audio/digital production.
  • Sound journalistic judgment rooted in rigorous fact-checking, balance, fairness, and adherence to editorial ethics.
  • Track record of building collaborative partnerships with decentralized reporters, freelancers, or station partners.
  • Experience editing for both the ear (audio broadcast/podcasting) and the eye (digital news writing).
  • Willingness to travel up to 10% of the time for visits to member stations and other stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

  • Prior reporting or editing experience within the public media system (Member stations, regional news hubs, or public media collaborations).
  • Deep familiarity with the socio-political, economic, and cultural landscape of the Northeast region.
  • Bilingual or multilingual fluency relevant to regional coverage areas.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Editorial & Audio Craft: Exceptional news-writing, line-editing, and sound-rich audio structuring skills.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Ability to offer constructive, empathetic, and clear feedback to journalists of varied experience levels.
  • Adaptability & Calm Under Pressure: Ability to prioritize multiple assignments and navigate breaking news calmly and decisively.
  • Cross-Platform Agility: Comfort navigating modern digital content management systems, audio editing tools, and communication platforms (Slack, AirTable, etc.).

Education Requirement

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.

Work Location

  • Remote Required: This is a remote required role. This role includes duties that are better performed or are required to be performed in a designated location OUTSIDE of an NPR facility. The employee is required to work at a designated remote work location within the designated coverage area: ME, NH, VT, MA, RI, CT, NY, NJ, PA, DE, MD or DC.

Job Type

  • This is a full time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $110,000 - $112,000  plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

As the Insights Analyst, you will support data-informed decision-making for NPR’s digital ecosystem. Central to this role is hands-on SQL expertise—writing complex queries against massive, unaggregated datasets, translating raw digital behavior into actionable product insights.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact to create measurement plans, implement and QC analytics tags, build automated dashboards, and perform deep-dive analyses across app, web, and video platforms. Working closely with digital product teams, the newsroom, and member station leaders, you will apply a blend of data curiosity and technical pragmatism to expand weekly audiences, increase listening hours, and deepen daily habits.

This role reports to the Audience Insights Director, Digital Insights.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

  • Advanced SQL Analysis & Querying: Independently write, optimize, and streamline complex SQL queries across app, video, and web datasets; regularly handle raw event data, including unnesting nested arrays and struct fields (e.g., BigQuery GA4 export).
  • Tagging Implementation & QC: Develop and manage measurement plans for NPR's owned and operated platforms using Google Tag Manager; conduct quality control (QC) and validation of tracking tags across releases.
  • Data Infrastructure & Automation: Maintain and optimize scheduled queries, data summaries, and automated reporting pipelines to support sustainable backend data hygiene.
  • Stakeholder Consultation & Dashboards: Partner closely with Product and Data Products teams to design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards (e.g., Looker) and establish self-service analytics frameworks for internal stakeholders.
  • Product Optimization Insights: Support product analytics needs for the NPR App, website, and video platforms, extracting actionable user habit and audience retention insights.

  • Documentation & Best Practices: Write clear technical guides, tagging specifications, and documentation for app, video, and website analytics standards.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product managers, editorial teams, and technical groups to translate business questions into technical measurement plans and data infrastructure updates.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of App & Digital Analytics: Direct experience with app and web event tracking (Firebase, GA4, or similar platforms) and understanding the full tracking lifecycle from tag firing to analysis.
  • Tag Management Expertise: 2+ years of experience creating measurement plans and testing/QCing tracking implementations via Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Data Visualization & Tools: Experience building reports and dashboards in Looker (or similar BI tools) alongside advanced spreadsheet modeling capabilities (Google Sheets/Excel).
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Proven ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams, translating stakeholder needs into structured data infrastructure plans.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within news media, public broadcasting, or digital content platforms.
  • Experience modeling or analyzing data using statistical scripting languages (R or Python).
  • Familiarity with building sustainable data governance or self-service analytics systems.

  2. Tagging & Analytics Implementation: Technical competence in digital analytics architecture, Google Tag Manager deployment, Firebase event tracking, and data QA protocols.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. Application Instructions:

Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter please share your philosophy for leading a newsroom overnight in order to deliver the most up-to-date morning broadcast possible.

Intro to Position

Morning Edition and Up First are looking for a resilient journalist with strong news judgment, excellent writing skills and a willingness to work overnights as the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, managing  a production team that executes what is needed to get the live radio show to air and the Up First podcast to publication.

Millions of listeners depend on Morning Edition and Up First to set the news agenda to start their day. We deliver the latest national and international news stories paired with analysis to put headlines into context. Morning Edition is a platform for accountability through interviews with government officials and decision makers who make or influence policy that affect people's lives. The show also features culture stories about music, movies and books that bring joy and provoke thoughtful conversations about who we are in this world.

The right candidate for this position is committed to daily news, and is eager to deliver the freshest, most important stories to listeners. They put the needs and wants of audiences first. They believe in the mission of public media.

As the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, you will join a team of managers who collaboratively lead news and editorial coverage of events in the U.S. and around the world for Morning Edition and Up First. You ensure that the show is at the leading edge of the conversation across a range of issues. Most importantly, you work directly with our hosts to edit and make final changes to the show before and while it is live on air to ensure we are broadcasting our best journalism and editorial work.

Duties for this position include assigning stories and segments to hosts, producers and editors; editing show scripts, crafting live coverage and breaking news plans; leading the control room during the live broadcast; finding guests and reporters to feature on the show when needed; monitoring news and responding with show coverage plans as needed; mentoring and editing producers’ and editors’ writing for stories and show segments; managing staff work schedules as emergencies arise; coordinate and collaborate with other newsroom editors, leaders and journalists on show coverage plans, projects; upload editorial standards and ethics as the lead show manager during your shift. As a manager, you will be assigned direct reports and are expected to evaluate and develop staff.

This is an overnight position with a shift scheduled from approximately 11:30pm - 8:30am Eastern Time Sunday-Thursday.

Morning Edition is a 24/6 news operation. Successful candidates can work holidays and may be asked to temporarily change their work schedule to cover other show shifts and special assignments as needed.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the show production team in bringing the live radio show and podcast to air, including the most listened to segment that airs during the 7a ET hour
  • Manage the editorial operation of the control room during the live broadcast
  • Coordinate with teams for live updates for later news feeds
  • Work directly with show hosts, guests and reporters to prep, record and edit live and taped interviews for the show and podcast on a tight deadline
  • Line edit various scripts for the live show while maintaining NPR’s editorial standards for all parts of the final product
  • Make editorial, programming and news judgment decisions about edits and show coverage plans, especially during breaking news situations
  • Provide written and verbal editorial feedback to staff on work
  • Evaluate, develop, and manage staff performance
  • Collaborate with multiplatform news teams to maximize reach of show content
  • Participate in the hiring of individual staff
  • Cultivate, promote and advance diversity, equity, and inclusion in one’s work and in the workplace.
  • Demonstrated awareness of intersectional identities and ability to collaborate with people from diverse backgrounds
  • Other duties as assigned

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 3  years of experience managing direct reports in a newsroom or operation
  • At least 5  years of experience writing and editing broadcast journalism content
  • At least 5 years of experience producing daily news journalism content for a national or international news organization

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with audio production and mixing techniques
  • Experience working in a live control room
  • Experience being the lead producer or editor for a radio or podcast show 
  • Experience editing news content for various platforms
  • Familiarity in another written language other than English, such as Spanish or Mandarin

EDUCATION REQUIREMENT

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience.

WORK LOCATION

On-site: This is an on-site role based in Washington, DC .

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Mastery in project management such as managing deadlines and time management
  • Expert knowledge and demonstrated skill in news-writing techniques for varied formats such as guest interviews, breaking news,  feature stories
  • Mastery in AP style writing and editing skill for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability and experience in writing and editing news copy for varied platforms including broadcast, podcast, social, mobile, newsletters and other digital platforms, especially during breaking news situations
  • Proficiency in people management skills such as delivering constructive feedback, clear communication and conflict resolution.
  • Proficiency in independent, problem solving. 
  • Ability to adapt and accommodate differing styles of editorial workflows and communication.
  • Ability to negotiate and compromise.
  • Professional communication skills when representing the NPR organization.

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions

  • Application Deadline: Monday October 19th, at 5:00 pm ET.

  • Submission Instructions: Please submit a cover letter in addition to your resume answering the following question: How would you describe yourself as an editor?

Intro to Position

The Senior Editor, Editorial Review is part of a critically important team at NPR committed to providing additional editing support to our journalism and our journalists; to ensure that NPR maintains and solidifies its status as a trusted source of news and information for the American public. 

As part of a team, the Senior Editor will review journalistic work from across the Content Division as a final look before air or publication. The focus is on ensuring excellence, fairness, accuracy and consistency of individual work and work across platforms, recognizing that formats, story selection and story-telling techniques for different platforms will and should vary, in service of specific audiences. 

The ideal candidate is an  experienced journalist and editor with wide-ranging editorial experience, including expertise across different platforms and subject matter. They must be deeply curious, open-minded and flexible; be skilled at editing in a large, complex media organization where the topics and journalists vary greatly and where the deadlines and volume of content can be intense. 

This editor will work a Sunday through Thursday shift, for the general hours of 10 a.m. to 7 p.m., although some flexibility is required for breaking news. 

This role is an on-site role based in Washington, DC. The editor will be required to work onsite at a frequency set by their manager. There will be some flexibility to work remotely on occasion with manager approval. 

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA. 

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events. 

Responsibilities

  • Edit journalistic content for accuracy, fairness and consistency, as a final editorial review before air or publication. The level/kind of review will vary depending on the type of work it is, for what platform and the circumstances surrounding it; for example, is this a breaking news situation or a long-term enterprise story?
  • Copy edit digital news stories, breaking news, long-form features and multiplatform pieces, digital videos for grammar, general factual accuracy, as well as AP and NPR style.
  • Determine what kind of additional editing may be needed for specific stories, depending on their complexity or subject matter, and depending on what kind of review has already been done by legal, standards and practices editors or others. 
  • Collaborate closely with the main editors for all content you’re reviewing, as well as with the show/platform leads for which this content will appear. 
  • With guidance from the Managing Editor or Deputy Managing Editors for Editorial Review, understand the expected content coming through for review on a day-to-day basis so as to effectively manage your workflow.
  • Work closely with the Managing Editors for News and Planning and the newsroom Deputy Managing Editors who are managing both coverage planning and breaking news coverage so that your work is integrated with theirs, and you can effectively work as partners. 
  • Work closely with the Managing Editor for Standards and Practices and other leaders to develop guidance on editorial matters and best practices for the division. 
  • Review and understand data provided by content analysts about the division’s collective body of work and the review team’s impact on it; act on the findings as appropriate.  

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 8 years of distinctive, original news reporting or editing experience on a national level.
  • Demonstrated experience editing on multiple platforms and a familiarity with the different audience needs of individual platforms.
  • Demonstrated excellence in editing breaking news, explanatory journalism and feature stories. 
  • Excellent communication skills and a track record of working on collaborative projects.
  • Proven experience in editorial decision-making.
  • Ability to handle multiple and complex projects simultaneously under stringent timeframes, with changing priorities/conditions.
  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently under deadline pressure.
  • Demonstrated commitment to data analysis and its use in understanding the division’s work and in service of audiences. 
  • Deep understanding of NPR’s core values and public service mission.
  • Passion for connecting with diverse audiences on a range of platforms.
  • Proven ability to consistently work well with others.
  • Positive approach to embracing change.
  • Well-developed interpersonal skills, ability to get along with diverse personalities.
  • Ability to respect input but ultimately be confident enough to take decisive action and take responsibility for said action.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience

Work Location & Requirements

  • On-site: This is an on-site role based in Washington, D.C. The editor will be required to work onsite at a frequency set by their manager. There will be some flexibility to work remotely on occasion with manager approval. 

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $130,000-147,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. job.title: Senior Product Manager, Audience Lifecycle Tools
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is scaling and maturing our audience engagement practice into a unified, data-driven, cross-platform growth and engagement engine, and lifecycle management is at the center of that transformation. This role owns the lifecycle activation tools, with a mandate to replace manual, campaign-by-campaign execution with scalable, AI-enabled (where appropriate) processes, and their work focuses on key touchpoints of engagement such as email acquisition, repeat engagement and donation conversion/retention. This role works in daily partnership with Data, Editorial, Marketing, Design, Engineering and Product teams with a mission to make every relationship touchpoint personalized, measurable, user-friendly and tied to business outcomes.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with NABET-CWA DMU. 

Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: Lead the product roadmap for NPR's audience lifecycle and martech ecosystem (including Piano.io and Salesforce Marketing Cloud), translating stakeholder requirements into prioritized engineering backlogs.
  • Martech Operationalization & Tooling: Build, configure, and operationalize internal-facing audience activation tools, establishing intuitive self-serve processes, user permissions, and governance guardrails for content and marketing leads.
  • Audience Journey Optimization: Partner with cross-divisional teams to design scalable automation rules and capabilities that enhance the full listener journey—from email discovery and content re-engagement to recurring donation conversion and win-back.
  • Data Integration & Measurement Alignment: Collaborate with Data and Analytics teams to enhance customer data platform (CDP) segmentation, tracking taxonomy, and attribution modeling to measure the direct impact of activation campaigns.
  • Newsletter Product Infrastructure: Drive technical development and platform enhancements for the NPR editorial newsletter suite in close coordination with newsroom and product leadership.
  • AI & Workflow Efficiency Integration: Evaluate and deploy practical, responsible AI and automation capabilities within lifecycle workflows to minimize repetitive manual execution.
  • Diverse Audience Engagement: Support audience diversification goals by designing personalization and segmentation workflows that welcome and sustain cross-generational and diverse audiences across digital touchpoints.
  • Standard Operating Procedures & Enablement: Author product documentation, establish lifecycle governance best practices, and conduct internal training sessions to ensure cross-departmental adoption of activation tools.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 3+ years of digital product management experience managing complex platforms, with a track record of driving measurable business or audience outcomes.
  • Substantive experience managing enterprise marketing automation platforms, customer data platforms (CDPs), or audience lifecycle suites (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Piano.io, Braze, Segment).
  • Demonstrated experience translating complex cross-departmental requirements into structured user stories, technical specifications, and prioritized roadmaps.
  • Proven track record leading technical software migrations, vendor integrations, or enterprise tooling rollouts.
  • Strong background in data-informed product development, including experience with digital analytics, cohort tracking, and structured A/B testing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience within a media organization, digital publishing company, non-profit, or subscription/membership-driven enterprise.
  • Practical experience implementing AI-enabled automation or algorithmic segmentation within marketing workflows.
  • Familiarity with user privacy regulations, consent frameworks, and modern consumer data compliance standards.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Systems Thinking: Ability to synthesize inputs from across a federated matrix of stakeholders into a coherent product architecture and execution plan.
  • Internal Tool & Platform Enablement: Deep empathy for internal users, balancing self-service flexibility with structured organizational guardrails.
  • Data Literacy & Attribution: Fluency in customer segmentation logic, data pipelines, retention funnels, and performance reporting.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Superior written and oral presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
  • Iterative Problem Solving: Ability to prioritize high-leverage product enhancements and maintain roadmaps through periods of organizational or technical evolution.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Marketing, or related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent technical and product management capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $132,915.86  - $151,852.82 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.description:
Description

NRG Media’s Broadcast House in Lincoln has an opening to join our dynamic team of multi-media sales professionals. You will work with area business owners and decision makers to create marketing solutions by delivering their message to our audience. We have all the tools and training to succeed, but in need of additional sellers to help reach our local businesses! Our distribution channels include five radio stations: Froggy 98, B107.3, 1400/99.3 KLIN, Red 94|5 and 105.3 The Bone, as well as event marketing, sports marketing, lead generation, and a full digital platform involving target display, pre-roll, geofencing, search engine marketing and optimization, OTT/CTV, social media and more. This role is comprised of both account management and new business development. This is an excellent career opportunity for someone who is driven to succeed and who enjoys creatively strategizing with others.


The ideal candidate is a go-getter, able to handle multiple projects at one time, with excellent critical thinking and communication skills and a proven sales track record. Self-driven problem solvers who can identify clients’ needs to create effective marketing campaigns are encouraged to apply. If you desire to work in an environment that comes from a place of help in order to build long-term professional relationships and grow revenue for Lincoln’s local businesses, we need to talk!


NRG Media offers full-time employees medical, dental, vision, employee assistance and life insurance options, as well as the opportunity to participate in a 401k plan. To encourage a positive work-life balance, the company provides paid flexible time off, holidays and medical/parental (maternity/paternity) leave.


The company is headquartered in Hiawatha, Iowa and led by President/CEO Mary Quass.


NRG Media, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

· Strong communication talent

· Organizational and time management skills

· Ability to build strong professional relationships

· Must be comfortable being held accountable to prospecting metrics and various sales-related key performance indicators

job.title: Information Security Analyst
job.description:
About ONErpm

ONErpm strives to establish its legacy as a global brand that makes an impact on the artistic community, the music business, and society as a whole. We are an inclusive company driven by innovation, music, and technology. We believe in mutual respect and recognize that different perspectives drive innovation, accelerate growth, and lead to more sustainable decisions and results.

If you join us, regardless of your location or position, we will support you in doing your best and reaching your full potential.

As a pioneering company, ONErpm has captured more than 20% of Brazil’s digital music market in less than 16 years. Today, we operate in Mexico, the United States, Colombia, Argentina, Peru, Chile, Jamaica, Spain, Nigeria, Vietnam, and many other countries.

As of May 2026, ONErpm has more than 46 offices across 32 countries, with a presence on nearly every continent.

Responsibilities

  • Security in Design: Integrate security requirements and perform threat modeling/project risk analyses in the early stages of system design and feature development (Security by Design)
  • Pipeline & Code Security (AppSec): Implement, operate, and maintain automated security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA) in CI/CD pipelines; assist software engineers in remediating vulnerabilities using OWASP Top 10 guidelines and secure coding frameworks.
  • Cloud Security Posture: Evaluate, monitor, and improve the security posture of cloud infrastructure and technology environments based on recognized benchmarks such as CIS Controls and cloud security best practices.
  • Privacy & LGPD Compliance: Establish and manage operational workflows for data subject access requests (DSARs), maintain the continuous data mapping lifecycle, and evaluate privacy risks in new product features.
  • Penetration Testing Coordination: Coordinate regular external/internal pentesting procedures, including environment provisioning, scoping requirements between vendors and internal development teams, and managing remediation tracking.
  • Vendor & Third-Party Risk Management: Implement and oversee IT vendor security assessments to evaluate and mitigate the aggregate risks introduced by third-party tools, services, and partners.
  • Security Awareness & Culture: Plan and execute continuous security awareness programs, phishing simulations, and training sessions to build a proactive security mindset across the organization.
  • Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis: Monitor, respond to, and investigate information security and privacy incidents, analyzing root causes and implementing preventative controls.
  • Due Diligence & Audit Response: Conduct and respond to security and privacy due diligence assessments from customers, vendors, and regulatory auditors
  • Metrics & Indicators: Develop, track, and report Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) for Information Security and Privacy maturit
  • Compliance & Regulations: Ensure adherence to internal company policies, compliance regulations, industry standards, and workplace health and safety rules pertinent to the position.

Requirements

  • Higher Degree (Bachelor’s) in Information Security, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Analysis, or related technology fields.
  • Desirable Certifications: CompTIA Security+, AWS/Azure Security Specialty, Certified AppSec Practitioner (CAP), EXIN Privacy & Data Protection (LGPD/GDPR), or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.
  • Proficiency in SAST, DAST, and SCA tools and their integration into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
  • Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10, CIS Controls, and cloud security architecture (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • In-depth knowledge of the General Data Protection Law (LGPD), data mapping, and DSAR management workflows.
  • Familiarity with third-party risk management (TPRM) frameworks and pentest scoping/vendor management.
  • Solid fundamentals in networking, protocols, identity and access management (IAM), and technology infrastructure.

Benefits

  • Health and Dental Insurance

  • Meal Allowance (Groceries)

  • Meal Allowance (Restaurants)

  • Life Insurance

  • TotalPass

  • Birthday Day Off

job.title: Label Services Manager (Lagos, Nigeria)
job.description:
About ONErpm:

Founded in 2010, ONErpm business model revolves around artist discovery and development and offers three levels of service to meet the needs of creators at any stage of their career. As a global music solutions company with 45 offices and studios in +35 countries, ONErpm encompasses distribution, label solutions, content production, publishing, and an innovative marketing group that includes in-house advertising and influencer agencies. ONErpm currently has approximately 600 colleagues across the world, with significant presence in Brazil, the U.S, South America and other markets.

About The Role

The Label Services Manager, Nigeria will be based in ONErpm’s Lagos office and will be responsible for developing ONErpm’s business in Nigeria while managing a roster of artists and label clients. The role will work closely with artists, labels, DSPs and their teams to plan, release and promote music and video content, while providing strategic guidance to drive audience growth and revenue. The role will also support the management and development of the Nigeria team.

Working closely with the Director, A&R and Operations – Africa, the role supportsONErpm’s regional strategy and represents the company in Nigeria.

This role requires a minimum of three days per week onsite at the Lagos office.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Label Services & Client Management: Oversee day-to-day label services for ONErpm’s Nigeria roster, working closely with the A&R and Project Management teams to ensure clients receive effective support throughout the release cycle. Support client onboarding and provide guidance on ONErpm’s platform, analytics, and royalty reporting tools, while identifying opportunities to improvemclient performance and satisfaction.

2. Distribution & Release Management : Plan and deliver releases with accuratemmetadata and DSP compliance. Coordinate across teams to grow cross-market opportunities, resolve distribution issues, and keep clients’ releases on schedulemand performing well.

3. Business Development & Partnerships: Identify and develop strategic partnerships and commercial opportunities with DSPs, brands, media, and industry stakeholders to drive ONErpm’s growth, market presence, and audience reach.

4. Performance Tracking & revenue Optimization: Use streaming, audience and platform analytics to evaluate performance and provide actionable insights. Support clients in maximizing monetization across YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and other UGC platforms.

Qualifications:

3 to 5 years of experience in a senior music industry role, or 5+ years in distribution,

label, DSP, artist management or related roles across A&R, business development, account management or label services.

Strong knowledge of and relationships within the Nigerian music industry, with a proven track record in business development, client management and team leadership.

Passionate about music, comfortable managing multiple projects and timelines, technologically adept, commercially minded and able to think creatively and strategically.

A strong understanding of current music and pop culture trends, an entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive approach to problem-solving are essential.

Experience in team management with effective leadership skills.

Organized, thorough, and responsive.

Strong communication and teamwork skills

Creativity and willingness to think outside the box


The ideal candidate is …

... passionate about music

... a creative thinker with a demonstrated ability to apply ideas strategically while working to a set budget and timeline

... technologically adept and quick to learn new platforms

... up-to-date knowledge on all music and pop culture trends

... optimistic-minded, self-starter with an entrepreneurial attitude and knack for problem-solving.

We are ONErpm, a music solutions company for artists and content creators at any stage of their careers. With a global footprint, proprietary technology, genre-specialized marketing teams, and extensive promotional expertise, we deliver business solutions to artists, labels, and content creators around the world.

We are currently seeking a Youtube Specialist.

As part of the ONErpm team, you will have the opportunity to work closely with a talented group of professionals, connect with new people, and explore fresh creative proposals.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Market Research & Analysis: Conducting thorough market research and analysis of the music streaming landscape and YouTube ecosystem, including user trends, platform features, and competitor activity
  • Strategy Development: Developing and implementing a comprehensive YouTube growth strategy aligned with core business objectives.
  • Campaign Execution: Creating and executing data-driven campaigns to boost user acquisition, engagement, and conversions across YouTube and other video streaming platforms.
  • Performance Optimization: Analyzing platform and channel performance metrics to identify potential areas for optimization.
  • Reporting & Insights: Consolidating performance reports related to implemented marketing strategies to guide and inform continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Monetization & Growth: Evaluating channel growth and evolution to maximize revenue generation for our YouTube Multi-Channel Network (MCN).
  • Feature Utilization: Strategically leveraging YouTube tools and features, including Shorts, the Community tab, playlists, Content ID, Lives, and more.
  • Sales Planning: Formulating video-focused sales plans in close collaboration with the A&R team.
  • Strategic Support: Providing end-to-end support to the video team regarding strategic frameworks for assigned priority projects.
  • Industry Awareness: Staying up to date with the latest trends, innovations, and developments in the music streaming industry and YouTube ecosystem.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering with internal teams (e.g., Marketing, Content, Operations, A&R) to ensure a cohesive strategy across all channels.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in channel management or related roles.

  • Proven track record of success in developing and executing digital marketing campaigns.

job.title: 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

  Overview and Responsibilities:   Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician to support engineering maintenance and technical operations for the CBS Network and affiliated production units. This role offers essential support around the clock for broadcast systems that are on-air and in production. It involves setting up, monitoring, and solving problems related to complex technical systems.   We use several systems. These include SDI and ST 2110 IP video routers. We also have channel playout systems, high-speed Ethernet fabrics (25–200GbE), and structured fiber optic cabling. In addition, we utilize media storage and transfer platforms, switchers, and both satellite and terrestrial contribution and distribution systems. Our on-air graphics and internet/cloud streaming encoding systems are included as well.     Basic Qualifications:  
  • 3+ years of engineering support and troubleshooting experience in broadcast environments, including one or more of the following:
  • On-air playout in broadcast and/or streaming environments
  • Live broadcast control room operations, preferably in sports or live entertainment
  • Transmission operations supporting real-time monitoring and distribution across multiple delivery paths
  • Expert-level knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 IP video infrastructure, including uncompressed video (ST 2110-20), audio (ST 2110-30), and ancillary data (ST 2110-40) flows, with solid comprehension of PTP-based timing and synchronization
  • Proficiency with broadcast test and measurement equipment (waveform monitors, vectorscopes, rasterizers, signal analyzers) for validating video/audio integrity across SDI and IP signal paths
  • You need to know about broadcast network design principles for high-bandwidth, uncompressed video. This includes redundancy models such as dual fabric and hitless switching. It is also important to understand multicast design and how to manage essence flow bandwidth.
  Additional Qualifications:   IP & Broadcast Systems
  • End-to-end signal chain troubleshooting across IP, SDI, LTC, L-Band, and ASI signals, with a structured methodology for isolating issues across network, device, and workflow layers
  • Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Evertz IP-based systems, including ST 2110 routing, signal processing, control infrastructure, NMOS integration (e.g., Evertz Magnum), SDP generation/exchange, and control plane vs. data plane separation
  • Knowledge of broadcast engineering best practices related to signal redundancy, failover, and resiliency design
Playout & Monitoring
  • Experience supporting channel origination workflows with Grass Valley AMPP. This work involves playout service orchestration. It also includes graphics insertion, SCTE triggers, and content scheduling.
  • Experience supporting Imagine Communications SNP or equivalent IP gateway systems in live production or playout environments
  • Familiarity with TAG Video Systems multiviewers, including monitoring layout configuration, signal health validation, and alarm interpretation in IP video environments
  • Working knowledge of Telestream PRISM waveform monitors for real-time SDI and ST 2110 signal analysis, including video quality, color space accuracy, and HDR/SDR compliance
Color, HDR & Satellite
  • Knowledge of color space conversion and HDR/SDR compatibility is important. This involves working with LUTs and tone mapping. You should also be able to fix EOTF/gamma errors, address color space metadata mismatches, and ensure consistent HDR/SDR output across devices.
  • Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting IRDs, L-Band routers, and associated RF equipment; solid knowledge of end-to-end satellite downlink signal chains including RF, L-Band, ASI, and IP outputs
Cloud & General
  • Knowledge of cloud-based or hybrid broadcast workflows, including remote production or IP extension of linear streams into AWS or Oracle Cloud environments
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering teams to troubleshoot issues across routing control systems, multicast networking, and downstream playout or monitoring devices
  • Proficient written documentation skills. This includes operational procedures. It also includes troubleshooting guides and engineering run books.
  • You should communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should also be self-directed and able to work in environments where priorities change.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.  

 

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as 10 Streaming and on SVOD with Paramount+. 

 

 

We now have a rare opportunity for an experienced Ad Sales Account Manager to join our industry-recognised team in MELBOURNE.

 

What you’ll do as an Account Manager- Ad Sales:   

 

As an Account Manager you will work within Paramount’s high performing Ad Sales team representing and selling advertising across the Paramount ecosystem including Network Ten. You will be a champion of TV/Streaming and display a firm understanding of the role it plays in delivering effective outcomes for your portfolio of clients. You will act as the face of the Paramount brand in market, representing with passion, maximising revenue opportunities, creating best-in-class strategic solutions, and building meaningful relationships with your partners. 

 

Some of the key responsibilities include:  

 
  • Driving revenue growth across an allocated agency portfolio to meet and exceed targets
  • Market presence - regularly out in market presenting to, and meeting with, clients to provide advertising solutions and respond to their advertising briefs.
  • Facilitating and supporting the sale of cross platform sponsorships across general entertainment, sport, and social packages 
  • Providing accurate forecasting data on revenue for portfolio. 
  • Lead and mentor an Account Executive as an indirect report.  

  

What are the benefits?  

  •  Representing some of the world’s most powerful media & entertainment brands
  • Working for a Global brand, you will have career development opportunities which can expand to countries all over the world 
  • Ability to thrive in a highly successful Sales team who work hard and celebrate success regularly.  
  • Free subscription to Paramount + amongst other benefits 
     

  

What are we looking for in an Account Manager? What’s important?    

  • Account management experience in advertising and/or media sectors

  • Demonstrated experience in a sales-focused role and pitching solutions to clients  

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills  

  • First-rate presentation skills   

  • Genuine passion for television, streaming and video content  

  • Understanding of the broader media landscape  

  • Strong agency/buyer relationships  

 

   

Paramount ANZ is proud to be recognised by Diversity Council Australia as a 2024-2025 Inclusive Employer.  

 

Paramount embraces differences and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds regardless of factors such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property or birth. These grounds also include age, nationality, marital status, disability, place of residence and sexual orientation.

job.title: Account Manager, Programmatic Sales
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

As part of the Programmatic sales team, the Programmatic Account Manager plays an important role in growing our programmatic advertising revenue. Programmatic Account Managers are in charge of collaborating with the Programmatic and Direct AEs to manage existing business and generate new programmatic revenue from agencies and marketers, with a consultative and technical advertising approach.   This role requires deep knowledge and comprehension of programmatic advertising and the supporting AdTech ecosystem of DSPs and SSPs, and a strategic and analytical approach to troubleshooting, data analytics and client relations.   The Programmatic Account Management team is a central team within the Sales organization tasked with spearheading programmatic revenue and embracing the innovation and ad technology that our programmatic team brings to the marketplace. The Programmatic sales team partners with the convergent sales team and executives working with direct clients, agencies, and third-party partners (e. g. SSPs, DSPs, ATDs, etc).   Located in New York, the Programmatic Account Manager supports our programmatic sales team with planning, executing and monitoring the programmatic ad campaigns. This role works closely with Programmatic clients, the Programmatic and Direct Sales teams and the Programmatic Partnerships team to ensure impeccable campaign planning and execution. This includes diligent campaign management across all steps of the sales process (Pre-sales, Campaign Launch, Post Delivery) while working closely with internal stakeholders, clients and partners to maximize the effectiveness and revenue potential of their programmatic deals and campaigns.    

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Support the education and evangelization of our programmatic strategy, best practices, and offerings both internally and externally. Serving as a key programmatic subject matter expert, evangelist and sales resource to drive programmatic revenue via PMPs and PG.
  • Develop a solid awareness of our Ad Tech stack, integrated partners and the general programmatic ecosystem
  • Become power user of key third-party systems such as Salesforce, Operative and SSP user portals (such as FreeWheel, Magnite and PubMatic) which are utilized for deal set up, management, troubleshooting and forecasting.
  • Serve as the PMP Deal Manager and Client Service Lead for your assigned Hold Co and Accounts with:
  • Pre Campaign Launch/Deal Creation - Lead PMP Deal Set up and Troubleshooting including Creative QA process, Forecasting support
  • Deal Launch - Forward-thinking Deal Monitoring, Continued Troubleshooting to ensure campaigns start on time and without any issues
  • Deal Monitoring - Observant PMP campaign monitoring to maximize spend - including PMP pacing spend/deal health, optimizations/recommendations, Internal and External PMP Reporting from Salesforce/Freewheel, continued forecasting support
  • Client Servicing - Forward-thinking involvement with your Programmatic clients through regular check ins to provide regular PMP reports and insights related to deal health while Instilling PMP Best Practices with buyers
  • Sales Prospecting - Support your assigned Programmatic Account Executives proactive prospecting providing spend reports through indirect opportunities, bid CPM optimization, week over week top spenders across Direct & Indirect businesses
  • Collaborate with the Direct Sales team with Programmatic Guaranteed Deal Management to ensure campaign delivery and troubleshooting.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • A BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience
  • 2+ years proven advertising sales experience in the programmatic space

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Programmatic-savvy expertise and an entrepreneurial spirit who will thrive in a team, solution selling and goal-oriented environment
  • A solid knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem and current industry trends in display, video, and native
  • A deep desire to win and grow as a sales professional
  • A solid foundational comprehension of basic data analytics including key functions in programs such as Excel and Google Sheets
  • Remarkable organizational skills
  • An ability to solution-sell to both business and technical audiences
  • Well-developed presentation skills
  • An ability to manage stress well, and juggle multiple account challenges at once
  • An extremely detail oriented approach with solid analytical thinking, negotiation, strategic problem solving, organizational, and time management skills

 


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $69,000.00 - $84,000.00 + 45% Sales Bonus. 

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing compensation, or a range thereof, for roles where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, external market data, internal equity, skill set, experience, training, education, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of our total compensation package. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards.
This position is eligible to earn sales incentive compensation. 


What We Offer:

  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here.
  • Generous paid time off.
  • Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products.
  • Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more.

We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. AI Engineering Technical Lead


The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking an AI Engineering Technical Lead
to drive the design, development, and productionization of AI-powered data products acrossParamount streaming platforms.

 

This role will lead the development of intelligent systems that leverage real-time and batch data
to power personalization, recommendations, content discovery, and advanced analytics. You will
work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and software engineering,
building scalable AI systems that integrate tightly with our real-time data ingestion platform.
As a technical leader, you will define architecture, guide implementation, mentor engineers, and
ensure production-grade performance, scalability, and reliability of AI-driven systems.


Key Responsibilities
Lead AI System Design & Development
● Develop real-time and batch inference pipelines integrated with streaming data
platforms.
● Design feature engineering pipelines leveraging high-volume behavioral and content
metadata.
● Implement end-to-end ML workflows from data ingestion to model serving.
Build AI-Powered Data Products
● Develop production-grade AI services that power user-facing and internal data products.
● Design APIs and services to expose AI capabilities to downstream applications and platforms.
● Ensure tight integration between AI systems and the core data platform.
Architect Scalable ML Infrastructure
● Define architecture for model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
● Build and optimize feature stores, model registries, and inference services.
● Design systems that support low-latency, high-throughput model serving.
● Establish best practices for reproducibility, versioning, and lifecycle management.
Production Reliability & Model Performance
● Monitor and optimize model performance, latency, and system reliability in production.
● Implement observability for data quality, feature drift, and model degradation.
● Establish automated testing, validation, and deployment pipelines for ML systems.
● Ensure scalability and cost efficiency across AI workloads.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
● Partner with Data Engineers to integrate AI pipelines with real-time and batch data systems.
● Collaborate with Product Managers to define AI-driven product capabilities and roadmap.
● Work with Software Engineers to integrate AI services into user-facing applications.
● Align with analytics and experimentation teams to measure model impact.
Technical Leadership
● Lead architectural decisions for AI/ML systems and data-driven applications.
● Mentor engineers in machine learning engineering, system design, and best practices.
● Establish standards for model development, deployment, and operational excellence.
● Drive innovation in applied AI across streaming and content platforms.

Machine Learning & AI Systems
● Strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production.
● Expertise in recommendation systems, personalization, ranking models, or NLP.
● Experience with model training frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar).
● Understanding of feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation frameworks.
Data & Feature Engineering
● Experience designing large-scale feature pipelines using batch and streaming data.
● Strong knowledge of data modeling and transformation for ML use cases.
● Familiarity with feature stores and real-time feature serving architectures.
Streaming & Real-Time Systems
● Experience integrating ML systems with real-time data platforms (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub).
● Understanding of event-driven architectures and low-latency processing patterns.
● Ability to design real-time inference and decisioning systems.
Cloud & Distributed Systems
● Strong experience with cloud-native architectures (GCP preferred).
● Experience deploying ML systems in Kubernetes-based environments.
● Understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and fault tolerance.
Software Engineering & APIs
● Proficiency in Python, Java, or similar languages for production systems.
● Experience building microservices and APIs for model serving.
● Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, CI/CD, and observability.

Basic Qualifications
● Strong foundation in machine learning engineering, data systems, and distributed
architecture.
● Proven track record of building and scaling AI/ML systems in production environments.
● Experience working with real-time data platforms and high-scale user-facing systems.
● Ability to balance long-term architecture with rapid product delivery.
● Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
● Self-motivated, quality-driven, and focused on delivering measurable impact through AI.

Preferred Qualifications
● Experience in streaming, media, or consumer-facing platforms.
● Familiarity with experimentation platforms (A/B testing) and metrics-driven optimization.
● Experience building AI-powered data products and platform capabilities

Come join the Strategy and Insights team at Paramount Pictures and be part of a dynamic group who work across the entire lifecycle of the theatrical movie experience! Unlike traditional marketing, our insights team is involved from concept to release, ensuring the consumer’s voice is at the heart of every decision from brand development to fan engagement, to the actual movie in its final editorial stage, to identifying messaging for creative marketing materials that truly resonate. The Insights team drives impactful, data-driven decisions through audience surveys, focus groups, ethnographies, and screenings. Our global insights inform production and tailor marketing campaigns that excite moviegoers worldwide. This is an onsite hourly based full-time role requiring (5) days in office based out of the Paramount Pictures Studio Lot. 


This role works collaboratively to support the entire department. This is an exciting opportunity to deliver tangible value to a wide range of creative stakeholders and collaborators across the studio.


Responsibilities Overview
We're looking for a curious, driven individual with a love of movies and an aptitude for business strategy, psychology, sociology, and/or storytelling to join our team. If you're a natural problem-solver who thrives on understanding people and uncovering the ''why'' behind their behaviors, we want you. The ideal candidate is not only analytical and skilled at working with large datasets, but also a good communicator who loves translating insights into actionable strategies creative people can understand. If you’re excited by the idea of diving deep into consumer behavior, market trends, and how movie content connects with worldwide audiences –this is the role for you!

- Desk research
- Be a vocal and active contributor to brainstorming sessions / meetings

• BA or BS with a track record of high achievement

• Excellent visual communication skills (high PowerPoint proficiency required)
• Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy
• Highly organized with the ability to work under pressure and handle multiple projects

Overview:

The ideal candidate for this position will be an initiative-taking, highly creative proactive individual who possesses robust people skills and has 5+ years’ experience in sports graphics creation and execution environment. The Art Director will be a part of a robust, multi-faceted network sports on-air graphics department that supports both remote events and live studio programming.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee day to day creative output of the graphics department

  • Develop concepts and ideas for a variety of on-air productions

  • Direct, guide and mentor junior artists and animators

  • Expert design skills utilizing the Adobe Creative Suite

  • 3D design skills, including modeling, lighting and animating

  • Ability to communicate concepts and design expectations to third party design houses

  • Ability to integrate graphics and animations into complex production environments

  • Creative leader for both CBS Network, Sports Network Cable and Digital

  • Work with the department head in improving efficiency of the team and the overall department through technological improvements

  • Collaborate with outside graphics to unify our graphics look and the CBS Sports brand

  • Consult on the design direction of our expanded brand CBS sports.com, CBS Sports HQ and create a unified voice for the CBS Sports brand

  • Collaborate with CBS interactive on shared properties

  • Oversee the content creation of sets across cable and broadcast shows

  • Work with outside agencies and freelancers to build out show packages

  • Ability to communicate concepts and design expectations to third party design houses

  • Ability to integrate graphics and animations into complex production environments



Basic Qualifications:

  • 4–5+ years of professional experience in a media, sports, broadcast, entertainment, or agency environment, with a solid knowledge of the dynamic nature of live sports production

  • Experience designing a show package using motion design/3d graphics from start to finish
    • Concept design to execution
  • Advanced 3D graphics skills, including c4d, Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, and Adobe AFX

  • Solid communication skills

    • Clear in sharing creative ideas and helpful feedback

Overview:

60 Minutes is CBS News’ iconic news magazine, renowned for its investigative reporting, compelling storytelling, and interviews with influential newsmakers. For decades, the program has set the standard for rigorous journalism, uncovering important truths, holding powerful institutions accountable, and bringing audiences a deeper understanding of the people, issues, and events shaping the world.   60 Minutes is seeking an Associate Producer to join its dynamic team and support the producer/correspondent team in delivering the groundbreaking journalism that has defined the show for decades. The Associate Producer is a vital member of the broadcast team, supporting the development and production of stories that reflect 60 Minutes’ commitment to accuracy, fairness, and impact. This role requires well-developed editorial judgment, exemplary research skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced newsroom environment. The Associate Producer will work on-site at the historic CBS News Broadcast Center.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Collaborate with the producer and correspondent to pitch, research, develop, and advance story ideas across a wide range of subjects, including investigations, public affairs, business, science, culture, and global issues

  • Prepare comprehensive research memos, interview briefs, chronologies, and background packets for producers and correspondents
  • Help identify, vet, and pre-interview potential sources and contributors, and draft interview questions

  • Research, review, and clear archival and third-party materials, working closely with Rights & Clearances to secure footage, photographs, documents, and necessary permissions
  • Support script development and the scripting process; perform comprehensive fact-checking throughout and prepare a fully verified, footnoted final script prior to broadcast, in accordance with CBS News editorial standards
  • Collaborate with producers, correspondents, editors, and production teams throughout all stages of story development
  • Track developments on ongoing stories and monitor breaking news for potential enterprise opportunities
  • Build and maintain professional relationships with sources, experts, public officials, and colleagues
  • Handle sensitive information and high-profile subjects with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of television news, documentary, or related production experience, including primary source and international reporting
  • Well-developed editorial judgment and a commitment to accuracy, fairness, and journalistic integrity
  • Experience conducting research, fact-checking, booking, or story development in a newsroom, documentary, investigative, or long-form production environment
  • Well-developed written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience working with sensitive, complex, or high-profile subject matter
  • Proficiency with public and private records databases such as LexisNexis and PACER
  • Willingness and ability to travel as assignments require, including weekends and extended periods when necessary
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred
  • Exemplary organizational skills with the ability to multitask, manage multiple projects, and meet tight, competing deadlines

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

We are hiring an Audience Acquisition Specialist for our DTC Paramount team. This role is based (5) days on-site in Burbank, CA or New York City, NY. 


As an Audience Acquisition Specialist for MACS, you will own the day-to-day execution of paid mobile app user acquisition campaigns across Paramount+ and PlutoTV. You will manage recurring performance reporting, budget pacing and shifting, creative delivery and trafficking, and end-to-end PlutoTV campaign operations, while serving as the primary point of contact for key acquisition partners (e.g., InMobi, Moloco, Jampp, YouAPPi) and spearheading ongoing CPA optimization and A/B testing. The ideal candidate has prior experience in paid app user acquisition and is looking to grow their career within mobile app marketing, with a well-developed awareness of how to drive business goals and evaluate performance against key metrics (KPIs). Knowledge with the mobile app ecosystem - including app post-back tracking, the iOS ATT measurement framework, SKAN attribution, and MMP technology (e.g., Kochava) - is a strong plus. The candidate shows a robust work ethic and a drive to continually learn and grow their digital marketing skills, and must be organized, punctual, and professional. The role will support the team’s efforts on paid acquisition campaigns, with special focus on mobile app campaign operations and processes.

 

Your Day-to-Day:
●    Build, traffic, and manage paid mobile app user acquisition campaigns across Paramount+ and PlutoTV, working through various ad managers/DSPs and partner platforms (e.g., InMobi, Moloco, Jampp, YouAPPi)
●    Manage budget pacing and shifting across the app portfolio, including twice-weekly pacing checks, IO issuance, and reconciliation against monthly spend and CPA/CPIA targets
●    Own recurring performance reporting, including Monday/Wednesday reporting checks across Paramount+ app campaigns, bi-weekly US insights reporting, and monthly ad hoc reporting for priority titles
●    Coordinate creative delivery and trafficking, including banners, videos, and native creatives for top-tier shows, plus monthly creative selection across app partners
●    Run end-to-end PlutoTV campaign operations, including media planning, creative delivery, and performance reporting
●    Serve as the day-to-day point of contact across key acquisition partners, managing relationships, optimization, and testing roadmaps
●    Drive performance testing initiatives (e.g., carousel/CTA A/B tests) and ongoing CPA optimization across DSP and partner channels
●    Monitor campaign performance and delivery to ensure campaigns deliver in full against agreed flight dates and budgets, proactively taking action if campaigns fall short
●    Collaborate with partners and internal teams to ensure billing accuracy, invoice tracking, and data integrity across internal dashboards
●    Collaborate with the larger MACS team to communicate campaign progress, learnings, and updates in mobile app marketing, and monitor competitor activity and industry trends
●    Execute special projects as needed

Key Projects - 
●    Build and launch mobile app campaigns with accuracy for tags, names, and tracking details
●    Monitor campaign KPIs and pacing to benchmarks
●    Process invoices and ensure timely payment
●    Provide key reports + insights to aid in strategic decision-making across campaigns


What you bring to the team:
●    Bachelor’s Degree preferred
●    1-2+ years of hands-on mobile app user acquisition experience (e.g., Apple Search Ads, Google UAC, InMobi, Moloco, Jampp, YouAPPi, etc.) strongly preferred, ideally gained at a media agency or entertainment/streaming organization
●    Experience with mobile app acquisition platforms, including app DSPs and partner networks (e.g., InMobi, Moloco, Jampp, YouAPPi) and mobile measurement partners/attribution tools (e.g., Kochava, AppsFlyer)
●    Familiarity with the mobile app measurement ecosystem, including iOS ATT, SKAN attribution, app post-back tracking, and mobile measurement partners (e.g., Kochava)
●    Strong computer skills, including advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint
●    Ability to multi-task and adapt to a challenging, dynamic environment of multiple priorities and stakeholders
●    Enthusiastic, passionate and robust work ethic
●    Proactive and self-motivated
●    Able to work autonomously and manage routine campaign operations with general direction, while seeking guidance on new projects or initiatives
●    Flexibility and ability to handle multiple projects at one time
●    Strong verbal and written communication skills, proactively communicating bandwidth and deliverables

May also have -
●    Professional Certification: mobile app marketing or attribution certification (e.g., AppsFlyer, Kochava, Google Ads/App campaigns, etc.) or other equivalent
●    Experience with project management software or platforms such as Asana, Trello, JIRA, Basecamp or equivalent

CBS News is the news division of Skydance. It produces television programmes including CBS Evening News, CBS This Morning, 60 Minutes, 48 Hours and Face the Nation, as well as CBS News Radio. The London Bureau provides international news coverage for all broadcasts across the division.

The broadcast engineer placement will join the team responsible for the operation, maintenance and improvement of the technical facilities in the London Bureau and offsite.   • Switching of video and audio lines
