  • Recording of Zoom calls and other online conferencing solutions

  • QA of video feeds
  • Monitoring and maintaining broadcast facilities, and troubleshooting system failures

job.title: Cash Operations Expert
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

About the Role

Money moves our business—and you’ll be the one keeping it aligned.

As our Cash Operations Expert, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of Cash and Cash Equivalents across Skydance (Previously Paramount). If you’re a sharp, process-minded finance professional who thrives on turning complex ledger data into seamless automation and trusted business partnerships, this is the place to make a measurable impact.

What You’ll Do

This is a high-visibility, dynamic role with a blend of core cash accounting, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization.

  • Master the Ledgers: Drive the day-to-day management, standard journal entry preparation, and monthly reconciliation of all Cash and Cash Equivalent accounts.

  • Connect the Dots: Serve as a trusted finance partner providing hands-on accounting support across Treasury, Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Payroll and Production Finance teams.

  • Lead Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate monthly touchpoints with key global stakeholders to keep cash operations synchronized and transparent.

  • Maintain Gold-Standard Controls: Ensure internal policies, procedures, and SOX compliance framework controls are robust, active, and audit-ready.

  • Own Audit Operations: Partner directly with external auditors during annual reviews, managing information requests and technical inquiries.

  • Drive Automation & Efficiency: Bring a continuous improvement mindset—modifying rules, automating cash clearing processes, and standardizing workflows as activities migrate into our Global Business Services (GBS) model.

  • Mentor & Champion Projects: Guide, educate, and train junior team members while actively participating in broader finance transformation projects.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance.

  • Experience: 4+ years of post-qualification accounting experience across a broad range of finance functions.

  • Technical Mastery: Solid grounding in US GAAP and/or IFRS, paired with a clear understanding of general accounting principles to form sound business opinions.

  • Process Leadership: A proven track record of identifying inefficiencies, proposing practical solutions, and contributing significantly to process improvement projects.

  • Language & Tech: Strong Business English fluency (B2/C1 level) and proficiency across MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, SharePoint, MS Project, Outlook).

  • Work Ethic: Highly organized, proactive, and resilient—with the ability to prioritize effectively, take initiative, and deliver against tight deadlines.

Additional Mindset & Qualities

  • Ownership & Analytical Mindset: Highly structured thinker who takes pride in owning tasks, leveraging problem-solving skills, and applying analytical insights to support business decisions.

  • Effective Communicator: Confident presenter, open communicator, and persuasive partner who can translate big-picture vision into actionable daily plans.

  • Role Model & Mentor: A mature, positive professional with a can-do attitude who fosters a culture of learning, collaboration, and DE&I advocacy.

  • Risk & Control Awareness: Sharp eyes for process controls, risk mitigation, and compliance.

Why Skydance (Previously Paramount)?

You’ll be joining a creative, global media powerhouse where your analytical skills help protect and propel the business forward. We value innovative thinkers who aren't afraid to challenge current processes and build smarter ways of working.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

| Health & Wellness | Private health insurance with private clinic access and annual screening packages, plus eyewear support. | | Financial Flexibility | Monthly cafeteria plan featuring SZÉP card options, nursery support, and home loan assistance. | | Office Perks | Fresh fruit delivered weekly, cross-team social events, and a dog-friendly office—so your four-legged best friend can come to work with you! | | Growth & Culture | Company-sponsored language courses (post-probation) and exclusive pre-premiere movie screenings before official releases. |

  • Contract Type: 1-year fixed-term contract (with strong potential for extension)

  • Note for Internal Applicants: Moving to a fixed-term assignment does not impact your permanent contract status. You will retain employment continuity and return to your previous or equivalent role upon completion. 

  • Location: Budapest, Hungary (Hybrid / Office-based)

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

job.title: Counsel
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

The Counsel will work with Business Affairs executives in the negotiation, structuring, and management of deals across the studio's scripted television content – spanning development, production, and distribution/licensing. This role focuses on negotiating deals and/or drafting agreements for the studio's projects, with a primary emphasis on content intended for sale and licensing to various third-party broadcasters, cable networks, and streaming platforms. The Counsel will work closely with staff attorneys and cross-functional business teams. Strong transactional skills, a sophisticated understanding of the evolving content landscape, an ability to manage multiple high-stakes matters concurrently, and a great balance of legal expertise and business acumen are required. The role is critical in protecting the studio's interests, mitigating legal risk, and advising executives on strategic business and legal matters. This is a full-time in-office role, reporting to the VP, Business Affairs.    

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Deal Negotiation & Structuring: Lead and/or assist the negotiating and structuring of a wide range of complex agreements essential to scripted television, including: Acquisitions: Rights/underlying property acquisitions (e.g., life rights, book options/purchases). Above-the-Line Talent: Writers, producers, directors, and principal cast, interfacing directly with talent representatives and agencies. Production & Co-Production: Domestic and international co-production agreements, financing, and production services agreements. Licensing & Distribution: Sale/license of studio-produced content to third-party platforms (e.g., streamers, networks) and international distributors
  • Relationship Management & Collaboration: Cultivate strong, communicative relationships with various internal business groups, outside counsel, studio executives, and talent reps
  • Strategic Business Counsel & Risk Management: Provide timely, practical, and strategic advice to Development, Production, and Finance teams regarding deal terms, legal risks, rights analysis, chain-of-title, intellectual property, clearances, and guild/union compliance (WGA, DGA, SAG-AFTRA)
  • Leverage broad, in-depth understanding of the entertainment industry to identify creative, win-win solutions that achieve business goals while mitigating risk
  • Policy & Procedure: Collaborate on foundational practices for the department, leading to more standardized, consistent practices around procedures, deal-making, and contracts
  • Rights Management & IP: Partner with internal IP and Rights Management teams, as well as outside counsel, on rights matters, copyright and trademark matters, and clearance issues
  • Capacity: Proven ability to manage a high volume of negotiations and transactions while prioritizing key deadlines across various business teams

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years’ experience negotiating a wide range of deals and drafting agreements in scripted television development and production at a major production company, television studio, network, streamer, or top-tier entertainment law company
  • Juris Doctorate (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school
  • California Bar Membership (in good standing) or eligibility to register as in-house counsel in California
  • Working knowledge of major WGA, DGA, and SAG-AFTRA collective bargaining agreements
  • Meaningful experience with intellectual property law (copyright and trademark)
  • Exemplary negotiation and drafting skills with a track record of structuring and closing complex, high-value deals

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Top-notch communication skills, judgment, and strategic analysis
  • Impressive interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate skillfully and build trust with internal and external stakeholders at all levels
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent negotiations and projects concurrently
  • Ability to advise internal and external parties on business and legal affairs matters, resulting in collaborative, commercially sound outcomes

 


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Data Engineer – Data Pipeline & ETL

 

46034

 

Overview and Responsibilities

 

Job Summary

 

The Data Engineering team is hiring a Data Engineer – Data Pipeline & ETL. You will help build and maintain scalable data platforms and ETL/ELT pipelines in a fast-moving environment. In this role, you will build and support batch and real-time data systems powering analytics, ML, and AI applications. You will also grow your expertise in modern data architecture and cloud-native best practices.


Key Responsibilities

 

Build and Maintain Scalable Data Pipelines

Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines for large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.

Build robust ETL/ELT frameworks supporting analytics, BI, experimentation, and machine learning use cases.

Optimize pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Implement advanced ingestion patterns including CDC, incremental loads, and event-driven processing.

Data Modeling & Data Warehouse Architecture

Design scalable, dimensional, and hybrid data models optimized for analytics and ML use cases.

Develop reusable transformation layers (semantic layers) that serve BI, ML, and AI applications.

Write optimized, production-grade SQL for large-scale analytics workloads.

Contribute to query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and performance tuning across distributed systems and cloud warehouses.

Modern Data Pipeline Development

Build and maintain modular data components following established framework patterns.

Contribute to architectural decisions across streaming systems, data lakes, and warehouses.

Data Quality, Governance & Observability

Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and monitoring frameworks.

Establish data lineage and metadata standards to support reproducibility in ML workflows.

Enforce governance, privacy, and security best practices, particularly for sensitive AI datasets.

Ensure responsible AI data usage and compliance standards.

 

Required Technical Skills

 

Advanced Data Pipeline & ETL/ELT Expertise

2–4+ years of experience building and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines in production environments.

Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Composer, or similar platforms.

Strong understanding of distributed data processing concepts.

SQL & Data Modeling for Analytics & ML

Expert-level SQL skills for large-scale transformation and analytics.

Experience designing scalable warehouse schemas and ML-ready data layers.

Strong experience optimizing complex queries across multi-terabyte datasets.

Programming & ML Data Integration

Proficiency in Python (or similar language) for data processing and ML pipeline integration.

Experience with distributed processing frameworks such as Spark.

Familiarity integrating data pipelines with ML platforms such as Vertex AI (preferred), Databricks ML, or equivalent.

Streaming & Event-Driven Systems

Experience building real-time data pipelines using Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar technologies.

Understanding of feature streaming, low-latency data processing, and event-driven architectures.

Ability to architect and build real-time dashboards using Superset.

Cloud & Modern AI Data Platforms

Experience designing cloud-native data architectures (GCP preferred).

Experience with Lakehouse architectures and cloud data warehouses.

Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings pipelines, and AI-serving infrastructure is a plus.

 

Basic Qualifications

 

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

2–4+ years of experience in data engineering, data pipeline development, or related fields.

Strong foundation in modern data engineering principles, distributed systems design, and cloud-native architectures.

Demonstrated ability to design and operate large-scale production data systems.

Proven track record of technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in complex, fast-paced environments.

Detail-oriented and committed to engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

Understanding of feature streaming, low-latency data processing, and event-driven architectures. Work closely with the streaming team and architect/build Realtime dashboards using Superset. Cloud & Modern AI Data Platforms.

Experience designing cloud-native data architectures (GCP preferred) Experience with Lakehouse architectures and cloud data warehouses. Knowledge with vector databases, embeddings pipelines, and AI-serving infrastructure is a plus.

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

This is an exciting opportunity to help build the future of CBS Atlanta, and we’re looking for a journalist who is passionate about the future of digital journalism to help shape our coverage.   Digital producers are responsible for writing stories and clipping videos for the CBS Atlanta section of CBSNews.com, our app, our YouTube channel and across emerging digital platforms.   • Clip high-interest video content for distribution across platforms
  • Live stream breaking news and other high-interest events on YouTube
  • Create topical longform content for YouTube
  • Proactively plan content around key news events and tentpoles
  • Send push alerts and write newsletters
  • Support digital operations for CBS O&O stations in the region

The candidate we’re looking for is a great communicator, has strong technical, operational and organizational skills and can pivot in an instant from coded newscast to breaking news.  Imagine the endless possibilities coding and directing newscasts in an immersive virtual environment. job.title: Director Product Management
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

NYC and Los Angeles are also possible locations in addition to Nashville


Overview:

Own the product direction for one of the largest sports apps in the country. The CBS Sports App is home to some of the biggest sporting events in the world: The Masters, NFL, March Madness, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full app experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you’re in the details.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for the CBS Sports App and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on.
  • Own the app's plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to continue, change, or stop.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1–2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.
  How We Build (The Builder Culture):
  • We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions.
  • AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll model it and push what's possible further.
  • The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission.
  What success looks like:
  • The app's product strategy is coherent. People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not to do.
  • Ideas are tested before they're committed. Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity. Fewer false starts, less rework.
  • PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer environment, ideally mobile-first and at scale. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold app-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view on how AI changes what a product team can do.
 


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.title: Director, Content Operations
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:


The Pluto TV Content Operations team intakes, prepares, and publishes every title on our streaming service. We are a global team, based in the US, South America, and Europe. Each year we support twelve regional instances and tens of thousands of assets for hundreds of partners!

 

We are seeking a Director, Content Operations to guide our US content workflows and team. This role is a true team leader! You will be based in the United States. You will build a skilled, accountable team that keeps growing. You will also be our main voice with partners and teams.

 

You will own the US content pipeline: partner onboarding, ingestion, QC, metadata, packaging, and publishing. Every title ships on schedule, to spec, and at the highest quality! You will also scale the team wisely: developing talent, refining processes, and managing capacity. That way we handle more volume at the same quality and speed.

 

Operational excellence is the standard you set and keep. That means a pipeline that runs smoothly at scale, partners who get clear guidance, and a team energized by finding better ways to work. The ideal candidate pairs a talent for growing people with deep technical skill. You love to invent and automate, using cloud tools and data to build operations that scale.

 

You will work closely with Content Partnerships, Programming, Product, Marketing, and Pluto TV Streaming Operations. You will keep improving the Pluto TV viewer experience. You will also align with our International Content Operations leads in Europe and South America. That keeps global standards, best practices, and one way of working.

 

Responsibilities:

 

Content Delivery & Operational Workflow Leadership

 

  • Oversee the U.S. content operations production workflow, including onboarding, asset delivery, QC, metadata, artwork, closed captions, audio, ad-break structure, and final publishing. 
  • Partner with Programming and Content Partnerships to ensure content scheduling, delivery forecasts, and launch timelines are aligned with platform and partner expectations. 
  • Maintain deep expertise in Pluto TV’s evolving deliverable specifications (video, audio, captions, artwork, metadata, UUID’s, ad markers, localization assets etc.). 
  • Support localization pipelines and delivery of multi-language assets across global markets. 
  • Document, maintain, and continuously refine operational workflows, SLAs, SOPs, and cross-functional 
    communication processes. 

 

Team Leadership & Performance Management 

 

  • Coach and grow a skilled team with clear goals.
  • Plan capacity, coverage, and top tasks.
  • Build a good culture that adapts fast.

 

Partner & Vendor Management 

 

  • Manage daily communication with content partners, labs and preferred vendors. 
  • Oversee vendor bidding, cost analysis, rate negotiations, and operational performance reviews. 
  • Ensure partner expectations are met regarding deadlines, technical requirements, and quality standards. 

 

Cross-Regional Collaboration

 

  • Align U.S. Operations with LatAm/Brazil/Canada and European Content Operations leads on standards, tooling, vendor usage, quality baselines, and global workflows. 
  • Drive consistency across regions while supporting local market nuances (content regulations, ratings practices, localization requirements, etc.). 
  • Participate in global operations meetings and task forces supporting Paramount’s shared streaming infrastructure. 

 

Operational Analytics & KPI’s 

 

  • Track KPIs for output, quality, pace, and partner trust.
  • Build forecasts, budget plans, and staffing plans, and help fix supply chain gaps.

Technology, Tooling & Systems Expertise 

 

  • Maintain proficiency with MAM/CMS tools, cloud-based infrastructures and delivery systems, and automated ingestion workflows (S3, FTP, API, JSON/XML/MRSS feed ingestion). 
  • Partner with Content Systems Product and Engineering to define features that enhance Pluto TV’s content supply chain, automation capabilities, and operational observability. 
  • Ensure operational requirements are represented in tooling roadmaps and platform updates.

Compliance & Standards 

 

  • Follow FCC and platform rules for captions, access, and children's content.
  • Keep up with U.S. and global content rules, ad limits, and ratings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 7+ years in streaming operations, or content supply-chain management. 
  • Leadership experience managing a team of 10+ members.
  • Strong understanding of digital video encoding, UHD, HDR Dolby Vision and acceptance workflows.
  • Experience in defining content systems requirements and working within MAM and CMS’s and scheduling systems. 
  • Experience in managing content compliance elements (Closed Captions & Audio Description) and regional regulatory 
    requirements. 
  • Experience with JSON schema’s, XML and Content Metadata formats. 
  • Expertise in operational documentation, workflow design, and project management. 
  • Experience managing vendors, negotiating rates, and evaluating performance. 
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and industry-standard media operations tools. 
  • Exceptional communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in TV/Film, Media Operations, Digital Production, or related field. 
  • Experience in FAST, AVOD, SVOD, or other streaming environments. 
  • Familiarity with global content operations and regional compliance considerations. 
  • Experience in highly matrixed organizations supporting multiple brands or geographies.

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

job.title: Director, Digital Video
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

CBS News is looking for a director of digital video to lead development and execution of original YouTube shows and series. The ideal candidate is a skilled producer and editor with demonstrated experience driving watch time on YouTube for news and entertainment brands. This is a hands-on role: You will manage a small team but be expected to produce and edit yourself. You should also be a collaborative people-person, as you will tap into the broader CBS News ecosystem of reporters, producers and editors to help support our slate of shows. This position is onsite Monday through Friday 9 am - 5 pm ET.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 
  • Work across CBS News shows and beats to develop and execute on YouTube-first concepts spanning hard news and features
  • Produce, shoot and edit YouTube-first videos and series across a range of CBS News beats, from breaking news and explainers to features and original programming
  • Edit videos in Adobe Premiere Pro, shaping narrative, pacing, structure, sound and visuals to create engaging, polished content
  • Use YouTube performance and audience insights to guide editorial strategy, story selection, packaging and future content development, with a focus on watch time and revenue
  • Steer the pitch process for YouTube-first videos across CBS News
  • Write and review scripts, cuts, headlines, descriptions and other editorial elements, ensuring content is accurate, compelling, polished and ready for publication
  • Coordinate across Rights & Clearances, Legal, Standards, Graphics and other internal teams to identify and resolve issues, align on priorities and ensure content is accurate and ready for publication

 

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in video production within a fast-paced digital media environment
  • Prior management experience required
  • Demonstrated experience in digital-first video production for high-visibility news and entertainment brands
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, with a strong portfolio of video editing work and a demonstrated ability to provide thoughtful editorial and creative feedback
  • Exceptional writing, editing and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear direction, draft and edit copy quickly, and exercise strong editorial judgment
  • Strong understanding of media production workflows, including asset management and production platforms
  • Proficiency with analytics platforms like YouTube Studio and Tubular, with the ability to translate metrics into actionable editorial and content strategies

job.title: Director, Internal Audit, IT
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

We are seeking a top-tier IT Audit Director to join the Paramount team! This person will be tasked with implementing a comprehensive program of Information Technology (IT) internal auditing throughout the Company. They are primarily in charge of defining the scope of audits to identify control deficiencies, security weaknesses, opportunities to streamline and improve operations, and promote best-in-class business practices.
The Director will lead a team of audit professionals. They will assess risks related to technology, operations, and compliance throughout the organization; this includes evaluating applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and strategic technology initiatives. The Director will also conduct administrative tasks to support an elite internal audit function. They will oversee multiple audits and special projects. They will present findings to management. Additionally, they will build solid partnerships with business and technology leaders across the Company.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct audit planning and risk assessments to establish audit scope, resource allocation, and audit priorities across technology and operational audit engagements
  • Lead audits of highly technical areas within applications and infrastructure, security and vulnerability assessments, third party management, identity and access management, change control, asset management, disaster recovery, data privacy, cybersecurity, cloud services, and other emerging technologies
  • Evaluate the design and performance of internal controls and communicate audit and special project findings to management by clearly articulating risk exposure and providing realistic, cost-effective recommendations to mitigate risk and improve operational efficiency
  • Assess risks and controls associated with system implementations, major technology transformations, and pre- and post-implementation reviews
  • Coordinate audit activities with IT and business management while supervising and critically evaluating the performance of audit staff
  • Serve as a primary audit contact for assigned business and technology functions, developing trusted relationships and providing risk-based insights to management and executive teams
  • Perform special assignments, including business process reviews, due diligence activities, investigations, and strategic risk assessments, as directed by the Vice President of Internal Audit
  • Review work completed by staff members to ensure sufficient documentation, quality, and support for audit conclusions
  • Support the Internal Audit Vice President in periodic risk assessments and development of the annual audit plan
  • Draft, edit, and review audit reports, executive summaries, special project reports, and administrative communications
  • Develop the technical, management, and audit capabilities of IT Audit Managers and Staff through coaching, mentoring, and formal development activities
  • Stay informed on emerging risks and trends in cybersecurity, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, media technology, privacy regulations, and technology governance
  • Partner with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement initiatives and strengthen risk management and control environments across the organization
  • Some domestic travel may be required

 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Minimum of 10+ years of progressive audit experience, including 2+ years of leadership experience in IT audit/accounting 
  • Experience within a top public accounting company, consulting organization, or internal audit function of a large public company preferred
  • Prior IT consulting, cybersecurity, technology risk, or technical operational experience is a plus
  • BS or MS in Information Systems, Accounting, Information Systems Auditing, Computer Science, or a related field required
  • Ability to work successfully with senior business and technology leaders and establish credibility across all levels of the organization
  • Demonstrated team management capabilities, with a track record of developing high-performing audit teams
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex engagements simultaneously
  • Ability to understand the Company’s operational and technology environment, business objectives, key processes, and associated risks
  • Advanced knowledge of IT governance, cybersecurity, cloud security controls, infrastructure operations, application development and support, data privacy, and technology risk management practices
  • Experience applying IT and information security frameworks (e.g., NIST, SOX, COBIT) to audit testing and risk assessments
  • Strong comprehension of system development and implementation lifecycle methodologies and related controls
  • Experience auditing automated environments, enterprise applications, cloud technologies, and complex global security and compliance functions
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, build consensus, and drive successful outcomes in a matrixed organization through collaboration rather than direct authority
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, audit management tools, Microsoft Office applications, and collaboration platforms
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for executive audiences
  • Sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to think strategically and creatively

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CIA, or CPA preferred
  • Experience with Oracle and/or SAP environments preferred

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. job.title: Director, Product Management
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

Director, Product Management (CBS Sports Web)
Location: Nashville, TN / New York, NY / Los Angeles, CA Type: Full-Time, On-Site Org: CBS Sports Digital, Product, Design & Engineering


#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We've got the brands, we've got the stars, we've got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet. Now all we're missing is
YOU. Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also
enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together we co-create moments that matter, both for our audiences and our employees, and aim to
leave a positive mark on culture.


Overview
Own the product direction for one of the largest sports sites on the internet. CBSSports.com is the front door to CBS Sports for tens of millions of fans. It is where scores, live gametrackers, news, fantasy, and betting come together during the biggest moments in sports: the NFL, March Madness, The Masters, college football, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full web experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you're in the details.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for CBSSports.com and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on. Own the web plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to
    continue, change, or stop.
  • Treat web as the reach and discovery engine for CBS Sports. Grow organic and direct traffic, sharpen high-intent surfaces like
    gametrackers and scores, and turn anonymous visitors into registered users.
  • Own the role web plays in the broader portfolio: growing registered users at scale and converting web audiences into sticky products
    like the CBS Sports App.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use
    tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held
    the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1 to 2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Partner with editorial to make web the place where great storytelling and great product meet.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.

 

How We Build (The Builder Culture)
We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put
it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions. AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make
ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll
model it and push what's possible further. The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission. 

 

What success looks like:

  • The web product strategy is coherent.
  • People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not
    to do. 
  • Web reliably grows reach, grows registered users, and feeds the rest of the portfolio.
  • The funnel from anonymous visitor to registered user to sticky-product user gets measurably stronger.
  • High-intent surfaces like gametrackers and scores get sharper and convert better, especially during tentpole events when traffic peaks. Ideas are tested before they're committed.
  • Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity.
  • Fewer false starts, less rework.
    PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.


Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer web at scale, ideally high-traffic and real-time. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.


Additional Qualifications

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold site-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Fluency with the levers that move large-scale web: discovery and SEO, performance, identity and authentication, and conversion.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view
    on how AI changes what a product team can do.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

In this role, you’ll help manage our social video publishing and content calendar, making sure our audience of 38M+ is getting the biggest stories in entertainment.

The Social Media Coordinator will support ET's fast-paced social team with daily publishing, copywriting and asset management. This is an entry-level role for someone who lives and breathes pop culture, understands how people consume entertainment news on social media, and can move quickly without sacrificing accuracy. You'll write occasional copy and publish multiple pieces of content each day, help identify social-worthy moments as footage comes in, and make sure ET is part of the conversation when entertainment news breaks.

 

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Publish vertical video across ET's social platforms, writing engaging, accurate and platform-appropriate copy
  • Post long-form news videos and other content on Facebook, prioritizing breaking news
  • Prepare and publish Instagram Stories promoting ET’s daily show
  • Gather video and photo assets for the social team
  • Monitor incoming footage and identify timely, social-worthy moments for vertical video
  • Collaborate with producers, editors and other members across the ET production
  • May include occasional schedule shifts around big events

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 1+ year experience writing or creating content for social media through internships, freelance work, student media or an entry-level professional role
  • Strong familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and X
  • Excellent writing, grammar and proofreading skills
  • Basic video-editing experience with Adobe Suite, CapCut or other similar software

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Passion for entertainment, celebrity and pop culture
  • Strong news judgment and an understanding of accuracy and journalistic standards
  • Strong understanding of social trends, internet culture and platform-specific voices
  • Highly detail-oriented, organized and comfortable working quickly as priorities change

 

Additional Details:

  • The shift is Sunday — Thursday, 12-9pm | In-office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday
  • WFH allowed on Sunday and Wednesday
  • May include occasional schedule shifts around big events
  • Rate is $23/hr with OT. Full benefits
  • ET’s offices are located in Studio City, California

job.title: Experimentation Lead, Sign-Up and Cancellation Optimization
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Experimentation Lead, Sign-Up & Cancellation Optimization
Team: Applied Intelligence
Company: Paramount Streaming (Paramount+, Pluto TV)


About the Role
Paramount Streaming is investing heavily in personalization, experimentation, and applied AI to shape how millions of viewers begin — and continue — their journey with Paramount+ and Pluto TV. We are seeking an Experimentation Lead to own and scale experimentation across the sign-up and cancellation flows. This is a highly strategic and execution-oriented role focused on identifying, prioritizing, launching, and scaling experiments that directly impact conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Reporting to the Principal Machine Learning Engineer for Sign-Up Optimization, you will act as the connective tissue between product, ML, engineering, data science, design, and growth — ensuring we are running the right experiments, running them well, and learning from them rigorously. This role blends product thinking, scientific rigor, experimentation design, and operational management.

 

What You’ll Do
Experimentation Strategy & Roadmapping

  • Define and own the experimentation roadmap across sign-up, onboarding, and cancellation flows for Paramount+ and Pluto TV.
  • Identify high-impact test opportunities across UX, messaging, offers, personalization, pricing, bundling, and model-driven experiences.
  • Translate business goals (conversion, churn reduction, engagement, LTV) into structured, testable hypotheses.
  • Prioritize experiments using data-driven frameworks balancing impact, risk, and resource constraints.

End-to-End Experiment Ownership

  • Drive experiments from ideation → design → instrumentation → launch → feedback → iteration.
  • Partner with ML engineers and applied scientists to test model-driven experiences (ranking, personalization, content ordering, offer targeting).
  • Ensure experiment configurations are correctly implemented and debug issues in targeting, logging, or exposure.
  • Monitor live experiments for integrity, guardrail breaches, or unintended side effects.
  • Lead post-test readouts and translate results into clear, actionable next steps.


Scientific Rigor & Measurement

  • Design robust A/B, multivariate, and sequential testing frameworks.
  • Define primary metrics, guardrails, and success criteria aligned to long-term value, not just short-term conversion.
  • Improve offline-to-online validation practices in partnership with ML teams.
  • Standardize experimentation best practices across the Applied Intelligence group.
  • Champion causal reasoning and statistical discipline in decision-making.

Cross-Functional Management

  • Partner closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Design, Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering.
  • Serve as the central point of coordination for experimentation across the lifecycle entry/exit flows.
  • Communicate insights clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Create scalable documentation and experiment tracking processes.


Basic Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in experimentation, growth, product analytics, applied ML, or related quantitative roles.
  • Proven track record designing and executing high-impact A/B tests in high-scale consumer digital products.
  • Deep fluency in experimentation methodology: statistical inference, power analysis, guardrails, sequential testing, causal reasoning.
  • Experience working closely with ML-driven systems (recommendation, ranking, personalization) in production environments.
  • Strong analytical toolkit (SQL required; Python/R preferred).
  • Ability to debug experiment integrity issues (logging, targeting, traffic splits, instrumentation gaps).
  • Strong product intuition and ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured testable frameworks.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and executive-level communication.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in subscription businesses, streaming media, or lifecycle optimization.
  • Familiarity with experimentation platforms and feature flag systems.
  • Background in growth, pricing optimization, offer testing, or churn reduction strategies.
  • Experience working in ML-first or AI-driven product environments.


Why Join Us

  • Impact: Your work will directly shape how millions of users begin and end their relationship with Paramount’s streaming products.
  • Ownership: You will define the experimentation engine for some of our most critical user journeys.
  • Influence: Work alongside senior ML leaders and help establish how personalization and growth intersect across the company.
  • Scale: Paramount is investing heavily in foundational AI and experimentation infrastructure — this is an opportunity to build systems that operate at global streaming scale.

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.title: Finance Leadership Development Program (LA)- July 2027 Start
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Two years. Three rotations. One launchpad to lead.

 

The Finance Leadership Development Program turns ambitious, innovative Analysts into Skydance’s next generation of Finance leaders. Starting summer 2027, you’ll join as a full-time employee for a two-year program, rotating through three eight-month assignments across our Finance organization — learning the business from the inside, building real financial and leadership skills, and pitching your own capstone project directly to company leadership. A dedicated mentor is with you every step of the way.

 

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Financial Modeling & Forecasting 

    • Craft and maintain complex financial models that shape real budgeting, forecasting, and expense optimization across the business

    • Turn data into direction — translate KPIs and core business metrics into analyses leadership will use to drive decisions

  • Capstone Innovation Project

  • Identify a real business problem, build a solution, and pitch it directly to company leadership — a chance most analysts don’t get until years into their career

  • On-the-Job Training & Leadership Development

  • Own real, high-impact work from day one — guided by your manager and a dedicated mentor invested in your growth

  • Receive comprehensive AI training, including in-depth sessions on how and when to use finance and other enterprise-wide tools

  • Sharpen your leadership edge through recurring feedback, a day shadowing an executive, and dedicated leadership training

  • Reporting & Close

  • Own critical pieces of the monthly and quarterly close — accruals, reconciliation, and variance analysis that keep the business accurate

  • Dive into the general ledger and turn raw numbers into clear, actionable reports

  • Run the quarterly payment process end-to-end

  • Business Partnership

  • Partner directly with finance, accounting, and business leaders — your insight helps shape how the business plans ahead

  • Take on ad hoc, high-visibility requests that put your problem-solving in front of the people who matter

  • Build a cross-functional network of relationships that will follow you for the rest of your career

 

LEADERSHIP TRAINING | INNOVATION | CAPSTONE PROJECT | DIRECT EXECUTIVE ACCESS 

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Proper work authorization is required to be employed within the United States for the full length of the program (July 2027-July 2029). 

  • Associates or Bachelor’s in finance, accounting, or other related quantitative degrees.  

  • Strong proficiency in Excel (formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP’s, macros, etc.) 

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience in finance or accounting

  • Ability to work in a fast paced, high-pressure environment

  • Self-directed, highly developed motivation for accelerated development 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work well in a team environment

  • Must be detail oriented with organization skills and the ability to prioritize deadlines

  • Strong analytical skills to analyze financial data

  • Works well as a team member with strong interdependency within the team

  • Good written and verbal communication skills

As part of the evaluation process, applicants will be required to play a games-based assessment. This assessment is a mandatory part of the application process and will require approximately 30-45 minutes of your time.

 

 

Recruitment Timeline (subject to change):

  • Deadline to Apply: November 13
  • Excel Assessment: Late November
  • Video Interview Invitations: December
  • Zoom Interviews: Late January/Early February
  • Offers: February
  • Program Start: July 2027

 

Strong performers who complete the program will transition into a full-time, Senior Financial Analyst position.

job.title: FPI Intern
job.description:
Process Improvement Intern – Budapest

Want to see how global financial operations actually run behind the scenes—and how to make them smarter?

At Paramount, we believe even the smallest process tweak can make a massive impact. As a Process Improvement Intern, you’ll join our Controllership and Global Business Services (GBS) teams in Budapest. You’ll get a hands-on look at how a global media company operates, learn how to spot inefficiencies, and help us build simple, smart automation solutions.

If you like solving puzzles, working with data, and turning manual tasks into smooth workflows, this is the place to start your career!

What You’ll Be Doing (The Real Deal)

  • Keep Automations Running: Help monitor, run, and support the daily automations built by our Functional Process Improvement (FPI) team.

  • Troubleshoot & Fix: When an automated script hits a snag, you’ll be on the front line helping to debug and resolve simple issues.

  • Build Simple Automations: Work on basic Excel macros, scripts, and workflows (using tools like VBA, Alteryx, Python, or SAP GUI) to save time for the team.

  • Process Documentation: Map out existing workflows and write clear, easy-to-follow documentation for new process improvements.

  • Team & System Support: Handle administrative tasks within our FPI tools and help colleagues clean up templates and data.

  • Learn & Grow: Participate in workshops, online trainings, and team updates to build your technical and business skill set.

What We’re Looking For

  • Student Status: Active BSc/MSc studies in Business, Finance, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Tech Curiosity: A real interest in process optimization, digital tools, and automation.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: You enjoy digging into data, logical thinking, and figuring out why something isn't working.

  • Language Skills: Confident English communication (both written and spoken).

  • The Extras (Nice to Have, Not Required):

    • Basic finance or accounting knowledge.

    • Any previous exposure to VBA, Python, Alteryx, or SAP scripting (even from university projects or self-learning!).

    • Please note: This position is based in Budapest and requires active student status in Hungary with full current eligibility to work (no visa, work permit, or relocation sponsorship is provided).

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Mentorship: You won't be left alone—you’ll work directly alongside experienced pros who are ready to guide and train you.

  • Practical Experience: Move beyond theory and gain resume-building experience with enterprise tools.

  • Global & Inclusive Culture: Be part of an open, dynamic, and multicultural team in Budapest.

  • Flexible Student Environment: We understand university comes first and offer flexibility around your studies.

job.title: Growth Marketer, The Free Press
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

The Free Press is looking for a Growth Marketer to help drive subscriber acquisition and retention across our fastest-growing channels. We're looking for a hands-on marketing tactician: someone who can plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across paid and owned channels, while using data to know what's working and why. You'll blend creative instinct with a rigorous, test-and-learn mindset to help scale The Free Press's subscriber base. Our ideal candidate is also passionate about using emerging AI tools to move faster, building campaigns, analyzing performance, exploring agentic tools, and automating repetitive work so the team can experiment more and ship more.

 

Please note submitting a cover letter is required.

 

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Plan, execute, and optimize paid marketing campaigns across channels, including paid social, search, video, and O&O, to drive subscriber acquisition.
  • Manage and grow email and on-platform marketing efforts in support of subscriber growth and engagement.
  • Own campaign performance: monitor results, run tests, and adjust tactics in real time to maximize ROI.
  • Build and execute a testing roadmap for offers, creative, and messaging to improve acquisition and retention.
  • Use audience segmentation and subscriber data to tailor campaigns and messaging to different reader groups.
  • Support paywall, pricing, and promotional strategy by helping design and run experiments.
  • Collaborate with editorial, audio, video, and events teams to bring cohesive, on-brand marketing campaigns to life.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate campaign builds, reporting, and workflow automation across the growth function.
  • Help set and track growth and retention goals.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in performance marketing or growth marketing for a consumer subscription product. In media or at a startup is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience running paid social, search, and video campaigns.
  • Comfortable working in email marketing platforms and CRM/subscription management tools.
  • Strong understanding of the subscriber funnel, from anonymous visitor to registered user to paid subscriber, and what moves people through it.
  • Deep comfort and fluency using AI tools for campaign execution, analysis, and workflow automation, with a proactive mindset toward finding new ways AI can drive growth.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Data-savvy: comfortable using analytics tools to evaluate campaign performance and translate results into next steps. SQL or Excel fluency is a plus.
  • Creative thinker with a strategic mindset and a results-oriented, test-and-learn approach.
  • Exemplary writing and communication skills, with the ability to adapt The Free Press's voice across channels and audiences.
  • Thorough understanding of (or strong interest in) the independent media and news landscape. Interest in and familiarity with The Free Press is a plus.
  • Highly autonomous, curious, and proactive, comfortable in a scrappy, fast-moving environment.
  • Desire to partner cross-functionally with editorial, product, creative, and data teams.

job.title: Head of Commercial Innovation
job.description:
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount (a Skydance corporation) means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. 

 

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.    

 

 

 

We now have a LEAVE COVER role available in our Sydney team for an experienced leader in digital marketing, ad technology or commercial strategy within media or advertising.  

 

Purpose of the role: 

 

The Head of Commercial Innovation is responsible for delivering Paramount ANZ’s streaming innovation strategy and roadmap in line with the Commercial Strategy, bridging Paramount’s global capabilities with the local business requirements to mobilise and operationalise new commercial solutions that drive advertising revenue and business growth.  The role owns the advertising innovation narrative, both internally and externally, advocating and influencing stakeholders across the business whilst positioning Paramount ANZ as a recognised authority and leader in emerging trends, to ensure the organisation remains at the forefront of advertising innovation.    

 

Functions will include:  

  

Strategic Leadership 

  • Defining and delivering Paramount ANZs Digital Innovation Strategy and Roadmap, setting and tracking KKPIs to measure success
  • Providing strategic oversight of Innovation Initiatives against the Commercial strategy
  • Collaborating with VP Sales, National Digital Sales Director and Head of Commercial Data to ensure strategic alignment and delivery of the commercial strategy
  • Championing innovation for the Australian business, bridging Paramount’s global capabilities and innovation requirements with the local business and market relevance
  • Acting as an authority on emerging trends and technology across the streaming landscape
  • Owning the strategic direction of vendor and partner relationships
  • Representing the Commercial Innovation agenda at a leadership and forum level 

Cross-functional leadership and delivery 

  • Leading the delivery of strategic initiatives within the Innovation Roadmap, mobilising cross-functional teams to deliver on key requirements
  • Overseeing delivery of the Premium Ads Growth Strategy
  • Leading the development and execution of the Innovation Sales Strategy 

 Commercial performance and governance 

  • Overseeing commercial adoption of innovation solutions and measuring business impact
  • Assessing the success of Innovation Initiatives in line with KPIs
  • Evaluating commercial impact, scalability and alignment with transformation goals
  • Leveraging insights to refine innovation strategy and identify new opportunities 

People management 

  • Leading the Commercial Innovation team fostering a culture of curiosity, experimentation and constant learning
  • Coaching the team to grow capability, setting clear goals and giving them ownership to deliver against them
  • Creating clear pathways for the team to move fast, cutting through complexity, unblocking challenges and supporting new ideas to streamline processes and improve delivery 

 

What are we looking for in the Head of Commercial Innovation?  

  

  • 10+ years of experience working in digital marketing, ad technology, or commercial strategy roles within media or advertising. 
  • Deep understanding of digital media, programmatic, and streaming landscapes including ad technology vendors, emerging technologies, and sales/client environments. 
  • Experience leading and developing teams, including setting performance goals and building team capability. 
  • Experience executing strategic initiatives and influencing outcomes across multiple departments or business units.  
  • Experience in project and/or product management to bring new solutions and capability to market. 
  • Experience in strategic partnership development and management, including commercial negotiations, ensuring partnerships deliver long-term commercial value. 
  • Outstanding communication, presentation and influencing skills
  • Demonstrable creative problem-solving at a leadership level with the ability to prioritise and lead multiple concurrent strategic workstreams

HR Advisor - Amsterdam

You'll bring structure to complexity: managing sick leave cases, supporting performance cycles, and turning HR data into insights that drive real decisions.

This is a great opportunity to play a central role in delivering high-quality HR support and initiatives that make a real difference to our people and business.

  • A steady hand for juggling multiple cases and deadlines without losing quality 

  • Solid grounding in performance management, employee relations, absence management, compensation, and workforce planning

job.description:

Sitting within the vibrant, agile-focused EMEA HR Operations function, the HR Co-Ordinator, based in Poland, is the first point of contact for HR queries and plays a key role in supporting the efficient delivery of HR services to the business and wider People team. As part of the EMEA HR Operations Team, you will provide administrative and coordination support across the full employee lifecycle to employees predominantly in Poland, as well as Hungary, Czech Republic and Germany, ensuring a smooth and positive employee experience.

 

Working within a busy and fast-paced environment, you will manage day-to-day HR queries through our ticketing system, ensuring requests are handled promptly and within agreed service levels. You will support core HR processes such as onboarding, offboarding, and employee changes, while maintaining accurate employee records and data across HR systems.

 

As part of a team going through an exciting period of change, you will help shape the ongoing improvement of HR processes by spotting opportunities to enhance efficiency and service delivery. This role offers great exposure to a wide range of HR activities and is an excellent opportunity to build a strong foundation in HR operations.

 

What will you do:

  • Be the first point of contact for HR queries from employees and managers across Poland and the wider EMEA region via the AskHR Salesforce ticketing system,
  • Deliver a high-quality employee experience by responding within agreed SLAs and ensure effective queries resolution or, where needed, escalating to the relevant specialist team,
  • Coordinate the triaging and escalation of HR queries across other HR functions, including Payroll, Total Rewards, IT, and HRBP teams, to ensure a seamless and consistent HR service for the business,
  • Manage data change tickets and job requisition requests in line with internal process, partnering with HRBPs, Compensation, Finance, and the HR Data Team to ensure accurate and timely processing,
  • Contribute to accurate HR data through regular reporting, data validation, and system updates, partnering with the HR Data team on regular data audits,
  • Keep HR systems (e.g., employee records, trackers, ticketing tools, local third-party systems) in line with defined processes and SLAs,
  • Support core HR lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, reference checks, and employment changes, working closely with TA Ops, HR Data, Tech, and Facilities teams,
  • Support leave, absence, and time tracking administration, as well as HR-to-Payroll month-end processing and approvals,
  • Support T1 benefits queries,
  • Bring together face-to-face employee sessions, such as onboarding induction,
  • Take part in scheduled audits and data quality checks to ensure compliance with statutory, data protection, and internal requirements,
  • Help keep the maintenance and communication of HR policies and procedures for Poland and the wider EMEA region in line with changes in local legislation,
  • Keep accurate and up-to-date employee records in line with data protection and company standards,
  • Support to the EMEA HR Operations Manager and wider People team, including maintaining organisational charts, headcount files, and census reports,
  • Bring ideas to process improvements by spotting insights and trends, and getting involved in continuous improvement initiatives across the team.

 

We offer:

  • Employment contract (12 months FTC),
  • Multisport card + private medical care,
  • Access to e-learning and self-development platforms and office library,
  • English language lessons,
  • Active global inclusion and CSR groups,
  • Well located, modern office with lots of amenities – adjustable desks, electronics toolkit, 3D printer ready for you to use, pool table, console, table tennis, massage chair.

 

We are looking for people who have:

  • Great communication skills – you listen well and can clearly convey information, ideas and instructions to individuals and teams, both verbally and in writing,
  • Proficient in English (spoken and written); proficiency in Polish and/or another EMEA language such as Hungarian, Czech or German is an advantage,
  • At least 1 year of experience working in a similar HR role (e.g. HR administration, HR operations, or HR coordination),
  • Real attention to detail, accuracy and accountability,
  • Customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering a best-in-class and consistent employee experience,
  • Understanding of Polish and wider European employment law and HR operations,
  • Well organised, comfortable juggling multiple priorities and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment,
  • Experience using case management tools (Service Now, Salesforce), HRIS (Oracle, Success Factors) or equivalent, and Microsoft and Google applications,
  • A knack for spotting potential problems or issues, and taking the right action to resolve or escalate them,
