Paramount is home to CBS, Nickelodeon, MTV, and Paramount Pictures. Behind every show, film, and stream is a long list of suppliers who need to be paid accurately and on time. That's where you come in. We're growing our Procure-to-Pay (PTP) team in Budapest and looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed Invoice Auditor. You'll be the quality checkpoint for invoices across our international entities. You'll catch what's wrong, work out why, and help us stop it happening again.

Contract: Fixed term, 12 months, with extension possible based on business needs
Start: As soon as possible. We're looking for someone who can start at short notice and commit to the full 12 months.

Closing date: 17th October 2026

What you'll do

  • Work the invoice error queues in SAP and Oracle, digging into why invoices aren't posting and getting them unstuck
  • Chase down aged invoices and open purchase orders (GR/IR exceptions) with the business so suppliers are paid on time
  • Run fiscal and tax compliance checks on invoices for our international entities
  • Recover vendor credit balances, overpayments, and unapplied credits
  • Enter approved invoices manually when automation can't
  • Be the go-to for vendor and stakeholder queries, partnering with Procurement, Disbursements, and Finance teams
  • Spot patterns in recurring issues and help fix them at the root, improving both efficiency and control

What you'll bring

Essential

  • 1-3 years in Procure-to-Pay, Accounts Payable, or a similar finance operations setting
  • Hands-on ERP experience
  • Strong Excel skills (analysis, reporting, reconciliations)
  • Fluent English, written and spoken
  • A sharp eye for detail and a knack for problem-solving
  • Ability to commute to our Budapest office 2-3 days a week

Nice to have

  • Oracle Fusion Cloud and/or SAP experience
  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business
  • Hungarian or other languages
  • Experience in a shared services or GBS environment

You're likely a great fit if you like finding the needle in the haystack, take pride in getting it right, and are happy to pick up the phone or message to get an issue resolved.

Why this role

  • Real exposure: You'll work across systems, entities, and countries and see how a global media business runs its finance operations end to end
    Hands-on learning: You'll build deep knowledge of PTP processes, tax and compliance reviews, and SAP and Oracle
  • A genuine team: You'll join a collaborative GBS team in a friendly Budapest office
  • Perks: Private health insurance with a screening package, a monthly cafeteria package (SZÉP card, nursery, and home loan support), eyewear support, language courses after probation, weekly fresh fruit days and a dog-friendly office

If you are interested in a strategy focused on growth, transformation, and ongoing innovation where you can help “reinvent the broadcasting wheel,” Paramount Tech has a role for you. Paramount Tech is seeking a Senior Agentic AI Software Engineer to architect and build the next generation of our business-critical systems. This role focuses on modernizing our core engineering ecosystem using agentic AI and modern AI protocols, bridging robust legacy foundations with automated, intelligent workflows. We are looking for skilled engineers who understand the craft of building, deploying, and maintaining business-critical enterprise applications. While agentic AI continues to accelerate delivery, it does not replace the creativity and judgment required to ship applications at this scale. Whether you are grounded in Python, .NET, or Node.js, you should know how to construct, troubleshoot, deploy, and maintain top-performing applications in a dynamic delivery environment while continuously shipping new features without disrupting business operations.     Responsibilities
  • Deploy agentic workflows and MCP-enabled tools to bridge legacy APIs with modern application services.
  • Use agentic AI tools and MCP to automate boilerplate, refactoring, and the porting of legacy systems to an Angular front end backed by Python, .NET, or Node.js, leveraging native cloud services where appropriate.
  • Transform natural-language requirements and user stories into executable specifications, intent-based tasks, and acceptance criteria while automatically generating supporting documentation, diagrams, and impact analyses.
  • Use high-speed AI iteration to explore multiple architectural directions in parallel, shifting from concept to draft PR with minimal overhead.
  • Implement AI-driven testing agents for unit, integration, and property-based tests.
  • Lead human-in-the-loop reviews of AI-generated commits while keeping architectural integrity, security guardrails, and compliance front and center.
  • Curate codebase context, including indexing, agent rules, and MCP servers, and optimize developer-facing AI tools to minimize token usage and latency while maximizing generation accuracy.
  • Apply OWASP standards and additional security practices related to data and IP protection, encryption, secure key storage and rotation, and defense against internal and external threats.
  • Estimate effort and milestones using AI-assisted planning.
  • Translate delivery metrics into status updates that executive stakeholders can act on.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years of enterprise software development experience, including deep experience with .NET, Python, or Node.js in a business-critical setting.
  • 3+ years of experience with Angular and TypeScript.

  • Working knowledge of MCP for integrating AI tools with local and remote data sources.
  • Ability to translate complex technical and AI concepts for non-technical stakeholders and executive management.

 

Preferred Qualifications
  • Proven experience with Azure AI Services, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Google Vertex AI Agent Builder, or similar agent frameworks.
  • 3+ years of experience with database modeling, storage, and retrieval using SQL and/or NoSQL, including writing and maintaining complex queries.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or equivalent build and release pipelines.
  • Deep knowledge of system prompts, chain-of-thought prompting, planning and agent modes, and “rules” files used to govern AI behavior.
  • Experience specifically migrating systems using agentic AI.
  • Active contributions to open-source AI projects or frameworks.
  • Advanced certifications in Azure AI or cloud architecture.
  • Experience with RPA tools such as Automation Anywhere, UiPath, or similar enterprise automation platforms.
  • Experience with batch scheduling, queuing, or integration technologies.
  • Experience with multi-region or multi-zone cloud configurations.
  • Experience with multi-agent systems, orchestration, or RAG workflows.
  • Experience with application telemetry and observability.
  • A background in media technology.

  • Grow our existing licensee business profitably

What you will be doing?

Deliver the Softlines UK Consumer Products Strategy

  • Achieve or exceed the revenue targets for your categories: apparel & accessories and home
  • Lead local fashion collaborations and support global ones at a local level
  • Own budget planning and delivery
  • Build and implement a 2-year strategic Softlines plan by franchise and licensee, in line with commercial and franchise priorities and working alongside the Snr Category Manager and Director, to deliver revenue growth

  • Create new and innovative products by building market-leading partnerships

  • Deliver the annual sales target by managing the forecasting process with licensees and tracking actual reported sales against forecast
  • Review forecast submissions with licensees and set clear financial targets, including stretch targets by partner
  • Drive licensees to submit forecasts, royalty reports and payments on time

Legal & Contract Management

  • Lead negotiations for all local deals and contribute a UK perspective to Global/Regional deals. Make sure all rights are cleared before the deal closes
  • Drive timely negotiation and execution of all contracts (within 100 days), ensuring deals are closed and fully executed ahead of contract start date

Creative and Product Development

  • Work collaboratively with creative and PD teams so licensees have the right assets at the right time
  • Work collaboratively with creative teams and licensees on new product development and style guide interpretation
  • Identify creative licensee immersion/creative best-practice sessions as needed
  • Brief the creative team on bespoke creative material for key retail meetings and trade events

Account Management

  • Build strong relationships and play an active part in the day-to-day management of our licensee base
  • Share brand decks, updates and one sheets with licensees so every sales opportunity is maximised
  • Identify priority licensees and align with Category, Retail and Marketing teams to grow and maximise the business
  • Keep in regular contact with licensees and set up business reviews based on each partner’s priority status
  • Drive regular strategic meetings to identify retail listings, gaps, opportunities and risks. Ask questions to understand licensees’ wider business

  • Lead annual reviews and planning sessions and agree strategy with top 5 partners
  • Review business models with licensees in renewals and/or new partner negotiations and run financial modelling
  • Provide regular updates on the state of the business
  • Run regular competitor analysis to understand competitors’ business size, product category and retailer

Team & Culture

  • Bring an inclusive and collaborative mind-set to all stakeholders
  • Champion the needs of licensees within the broader Paramount organisation (UK and Global)
  • Share learnings and creative work with the broader UK Consumer Products team and relevant international and global teams

What are we looking for?
  • You’re an insightful and persuasive seller who can identify commercial opportunities and align our brands to them
  • You’re a strong negotiator who optimises the success and profitability of deals
  • You’re a straight-talker and clear communicator, both internally and externally, in writing and verbally
  • You’re decisive and creative, solving problems and reaching solutions fast

Job Title: Senior Front-End Developer (AI-Augmented Engineering) Team: Global Quality Engineering (GQE)
Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco   Overview Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Senior Front-End Developer to lead the development of high-performance, user-centric web applications that power the next generation of Quality Engineering platforms. This is a modern engineering role designed for a developer who has mastered the balance between expert-level coding and advanced AI-assisted development. In this role, you will not just write code; you will orchestrate it. You will leverage modern AI tooling—such as Claude Code, Gemini Code Assist, and GitHub Copilot—to accelerate delivery while acting as the ultimate authority on architectural integrity, security, and compliance. As part of the QE Innovation team, you will build the interfaces that streamline automation workflows and surface quality insights across the entire enterprise.   Key Responsibilities

 AI-Driven Application Development ● Accelerated Engineering: Design and build high-quality React applications using TypeScript. Use modern UI patterns and AI tools to improve coding efficiency. This includes optimizing boilerplate code, refactoring, and making feature development faster. ● Human-in-the-Loop Oversight: Act as the primary filter for AI-generated output. You must meticulously monitor, audit, and correct code produced by AI to ensure it adheres to Paramount Skydance’s strict architectural standards and security protocols. ● Design-to-Code Mastery: Rapidly translate Figma design comps into reusable UI components and design systems, leveraging AI to bridge the gap between design intent and production-ready code.

Platform & Tooling Innovation ● Build the front-end for internal QE platforms, including automation dashboards, triage tools, and AI-assisted testing interfaces. ● Implement real-time data visualizations and telemetry streams, ensuring that even complex, AI-curated data is presented with clarity and performance. Quality, Security & Compliance ● Validation and Verification: Ensure that all code, whether created by humans or AI, meets high standards. This includes performance, WCAG accessibility, and reliability. ● Security First: Audit AI suggestions for potential vulnerabilities, ensuring that sensitive data handling and API interactions remain compliant with enterprise security standards. ● Automated Testing: Implement robust testing strategies (Jest, Cypress, Playwright) to provide a safety net for rapid, AI-assisted iterations.
Required Qualifications ● 7+ years of professional experience in front-end or full-stack development. ● AI Tooling Fluency: Demonstrated "must-have" experience using Claude Code, Gemini Code Assist, or equivalent LLM-based coding agents to deliver complex features. ● Expert React & TypeScript: Deep proficiency in React Hooks, state management (Zustand, Redux, or Context), and component-driven design. ● Critical Oversight Capability: A solid ability to identify errors or bad patterns in AI-generated code. Can manually correct these issues to meet senior-level engineering standards. ● Security & Architecture: Proficient in secure front-end development according to OWASP standards. Knowledge of browser performance and scalable architectural patterns.

Preferred Qualifications ● Experience building developer productivity tools or internal engineering dashboards. ● Familiarity with data visualization (D3.js, Recharts) and real-time interfaces (WebSockets). ● Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and CI/CD workflows.   Key Competencies ● AI-Augmented Execution: The ability to achieve 10x output by effectively prompting and managing AI agents without sacrificing code quality. ● Architectural Rigor: A refusal to accept "working code" if it violates long-term maintainability or security standards. ● Systems Thinking: Understanding how front-end applications integrate with complex backend data pipelines and AI-driven quality insights.   Success Metrics ● Velocity & Quality: Delivery of high-quality features at an accelerated pace through the expert application of AI tooling. ● Standardization: Successful implementation of reusable patterns that pass all security and architectural audits. ● Efficiency: Significant reduction in manual UI development time through the adoption of AI-assisted workflows.   #LI-JC1

We are seeking a Sr. ML Platform Engineer who is excited to deploy MLOps products that shape business strategy, optimize content, inform marketing investment decisions, and enhance the user experience. You will build the foundations of our ML platform that will enable the Data Science team to deploy models at web scale data driving interactions with millions of customers across the globe. Specific projects will include designing the ML Ops platform and Agentic AI layer that will enable the Data Science team to scale their model deployments and automate analytical workflows. Success in this role requires a strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), comfort writing production-quality code in a collaborative environment, effective communication with Data Science team and stakeholders, and a team player who is excited to design and develop the MLOps deployment that will enable the team to multiply their impact.

  • Design and implement our greenfield ML platform and suite of analytical AI agents, 10Xing the Data Science team’s impact.

  • Work closely with Data Scientists to understand their development needs

  • Work closely with Stakeholders to understand the business problems driving model deployments, translating complex models into self-serve, LLM-callable tools that augment stakeholder workflows.

  • Assess and integrate cutting-edge software and practices in Data Science and MLOps.

  • Refactor disjointed data science scripts and workflows into modular 'skills' that act as procedural knowledge for AI agents, streamlining stakeholder interactions. 

Key Projects:

  • Manage deployment and contribute to models driving Paramount+’s global, financial forecasts 

  • Design and implement Paramount’s model deployment platform

  • Design and implement robust monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability of ML deployments

  • Design and implement UIs and natural-language AI agents that enable a variety of stakeholders to intuitively interact with DS models.

  • Drive adoption of best practices for CI/CD workflows tailored to Data Science & Agentic Workflows

  • Drive adoption of agentic workflows (e.g., automated SQL generation, variance diagnostics, model post-mortems) across Data Science and the larger Paramount organization.

Qualifications:

You Have:

  • 5+ years experience in Data Science and ML Engineering.

  • Deep experience developing as a team using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Docker, & Kubernetes

  • Deep experience designing and implementing MLOps platforms and multi-agent systems in a cloud environment.

  • Deep experience implementing CI/CD workflows that manage model deployments

  • Experience developing containerized applications

  • Ability to innovate without over-engineering

  • Familiarity with well-known statistical and ML models and methods

  • Strong detail orientation with a penchant for deployment reliability

  • Must successfully pass a background check

 

You might also have:

  • Experience integrating LLMs into existing business processes and creating tools using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Experience developing APIs

  • Experience working at Web scale

Overview and Responsibilities: 

 

The Senior Network Engineer role focuses on the implementation and support of reliable, scalable network solutions supporting media and corporate systems. This position is primarily hands-on and technical, working within the broader network architecture and engineering organization to deliver and maintain high-performance, mission‑critical network services. 

The role participates in network projects across the full lifecycle and collaborates closely with peer engineers, operations teams, and cross‑functional partners. 

 

Responsibilities Include: 

  •     Design, implement, and support scalable, highly available routing and switching solutions for media and corporate network environments. 
  •     Participate in the evaluation and testing of new networking technologies and platforms; provide technical input and recommendations. 
  •     Work with vendors and internal teams to troubleshoot issues and support hardware/software lifecycle activities. 
  •     Implement approved network changes following established change management processes, including maintenance windows and validation. 
  •     Serve as a technical resource for network operations teams, assisting with troubleshooting, incident resolution, and root cause analysis. 
  •     Create and maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and configuration standards. 
  •     Participate in peer design reviews and technical discussions, contributing feedback and best practices. 
  •     Collaborate with Level 2 and Level 3 teams to resolve complex routing, switching, firewall, and connectivity issues. 
  •     Assist with knowledge sharing and technical guidance for junior and mid‑level engineers during new deployments or upgrades. 
  •     Escalate issues as needed and work with senior engineers or architects on complex or high‑impact problems.

  •     Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  •     Strong experience in IP networking and IP security design and implementation (5–7 years preferred). 
  •     Hands‑on experience with major networking vendors such as Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto, NetScaler, or equivalent platforms. 
  •     Solid understanding of routing and switching protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF, MPLS). 
  •     Working knowledge of IP multicast and QoS concepts. 
  •     Experience using network monitoring and management tools. 
  •     Experience supporting medium to large enterprise or corporate network environments.

Senior Product Manager, Sign-Up Flow Optimization
Team: Applied Intelligence
Company: Paramount Streaming (Paramount+, Pluto TV)


About the Role
Paramount is building the next generation of personalization and discovery across our global streaming platforms, and we are looking for a Senior Product Manager to contribute to high-impact initiatives across the Paramount+ and Pluto TV sign-up/registration flow. In this role, you will help shape how millions of viewers discover films, series, live sports, and news on Paramount+, Pluto TV, and our future streaming products. You will work closely with senior engineers and applied scientists to build and deploy production systems that improve engagement, retention, and viewer satisfaction. This is a highly collaborative technical role where you will contribute to innovation at the intersection of ML modeling, retrieval and ranking systems, embeddings, experimentation, and real-time user understanding.


What You’ll Do

  • Contribute to the design and development of personalization in the Paramount+ sign-up flow and Pluto TV registration experiences.
  • Help define and lead the multi-year product strategy across Paramount+ and Pluto TV for sign-up flow/registration flow optimization
  • Build the specifications to develop real-time, personalized experiences in the sign-up flow (in cases with both low-information and high-information)
  • Partner with product, design, content, platform engineering, and data science teams to deliver measurable user outcomes.
  • Support the development of semantic search and browse experiences using embeddings, query understanding, and domain-specific model architectures.
  • Apply experimentation best practices, including A/B testing and offline evaluation, to inform model and feature improvements.
  • Collaborate with and learn from senior engineers and scientists, contributing to a solid and growing Applied ML culture.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on data, machine learning, or highly technical platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of machine learning concepts (e.g., recommendation systems, ranking, experimentation) and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of spearheading end-to-end product initiatives, from problem definition and strategy through execution, launch, and iteration.
  • Experience working closely with engineering, data science, and design teams to deliver data-driven products at scale.
  • Fluency in experimentation methodologies, including A/B testing, metric design, and interpreting results to inform product decisions.
  • Ability to define clear product requirements, prioritize successfully, and balance short-term wins with long-term platform investments.
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data to identify opportunities, measure impact, and guide decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels.
  • Familiarity with data and ML ecosystems (e.g., BigQuery, experimentation platforms, model lifecycle concepts) is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, media, growth, or user acquisition funnels (e.g., sign-up, onboarding, personalization) is a plus.


Why Join Us

  • Impact: Your work will directly shape how hundreds of millions of users get to their content.
  • Influence: You will help define our personalization architecture and grow a senior ML team.
  • Innovation: Work alongside experts across Core ML, Causal Science, Content Knowledge, and ML Platform.
  • Growth: Paramount is investing heavily in personalization and foundational AI capabilities—this is a ground-floor opportunity to build what comes next.

  • Liaise and align with producers, talent, and key internal departments, including Photo, Marketing, and leadership, to facilitate ongoing publicity support for the News division.
  • Plan, develop, and execute talent trips, press junkets, and on-set media visits in support of series.
  • Handle talent appearances at events.
  • Collaborate with units within the CBS Television Network for cross-promotional opportunities.
  • Write press releases, storylines, bios, and social media copy for News division programming and talent.
  • Work five days a week in the office, with the awareness that hours may fluctuate due to a 24/7 news cycle and may include mornings, evenings, and weekends.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years’ experience in media relations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in either English, Communications, Journalism, Publicity or related field.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • A positive attitude is a must.
  • Ability to build deep relationships with press/media (traditional print press as well as online, podcasters, blog writers, social media, and emerging platforms).
  • Exemplary communication, writing skills, and proofreading skills.
  • Deep knowledge and insight of culture and social media/digital/online press.
  • Fluent in social media with the ability to track trends emerging in the digital space.
  • Must be a creative and problem-solving driven individual who can create a well-thought-out press plan to maximize publicity, pitching traditional and non-traditional media.
  • Proficient organizational, leadership, and client/talent relations/customer service skills with great attention to detail.
  • An ability to multitask in high-pressure situations.
  • Must demonstrate a high quality of work performed, both precisely and proficiently.
  • Ability to work successfully in an extremely dynamic, deadline-oriented work environment while maintaining a positive attitude.
  • A team player available to also support fellow publicists and their projects when necessary.

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age.   Job Title: Senior Software Engineer in Test Team: Global Quality Engineering Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco   Overview Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Senior Software Engineer in Test to design, architect, and deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable automated testing solutions across our enterprise platforms. This role requires proficient skills in Java engineering. It also requires experience in advanced test automation and knowledge of the media and streaming industry. You will use modern CI/CD practices to improve quality and reduce risk. Your work will help provide great customer experiences on CTV, SmartTV, mobile, and web platforms. As a member of the Global Quality Engineering (GQE) organization, you will utilize our existing departmental automation framework, help drive quality strategies, and mentor engineers across GQE to elevate testing maturity and engineering excellence. You will also leverage AI-augmented development and testing practices using Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (in-IDE), Cursor, and similar tools.   Key Responsibilities   Create Robust & Reliable Automation Coverage across front-end and back-end • Create and maintain automated tests using our existing Java-based departmental test automation framework supporting API, UI, Mobile, CTV/SmartTV, and integration testing; introduce reusable libraries, utilities, and patterns to improve stability and scale. • Utilize scalable patterns for reusable test components, data management, assertions, parallelization, and distributed execution. • Integrate the framework deeply into CI/CD pipelines to support shift-left testing and continuous quality.   AI-Augmented Quality Engineering • Champion AI-assisted development and testing using tools such as GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, and LLM-based assistants to improve developer productivity, test authoring velocity, code reviews, and defect triage. • Apply prompt engineering and retrieval techniques to accelerate test case generation, log/telemetry summarization, video-quality anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis. • Evaluate and integrate functional AI capabilities that measurably reduce flakiness, false positives, and triage time within the existing framework.   Media & Multi-Platform Quality • Expand automation coverage for video playback, streaming resiliency, DRM flows, SSAI/CSAI ad insertion, captions/subtitles, and content protection. • Validate QoE metrics (startup time, rebuffering ratio, frame drops, video/audio sync, error recovery) across Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Apple TV, iOS/Android mobile apps, and modern web players. • Leverage media tooling such as ffmpeg/ffprobe, Charles/Fiddler, and player inspection APIs for diagnostics and validation. • Ensure consistent adoption of engineering best practices, coding standards, and high-quality test development patterns.   Cross Functional Collaboration • Partner with Video Engineering, Playback/Player, Ads/Monetization, CDN/Streaming Operations, and Platform teams to ensure robust validation of streaming experiences and ad workflows. • Collaborate with Product to ensure test coverage aligns to business priorities and quality goals. • Work closely with Platform and Data Engineering to support scalable test environments, quality data, and telemetry.   Technical Execution • Design and implement complex automated test suites using Java, Selenium, Appium, JMeter, Locust, REST-Assured, TestNG/JUnit, and related tooling within the existing framework. • Build and optimize testing strategies including API/contract, integration, performance/reliability, and device-level testing for CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web. • Diagnose and tackle issues related to automation reliability, environment instability, device fragmentation, and system integration.   Required Qualifications • 6+ years of experience in software engineering or quality engineering with solid Java development expertise. • Demonstrated experience using and enhancing an existing enterprise/departmental automation framework. • Deep expertise in common test automation tools (Selenium, Appium, Playwright, REST-Assured, TestNG, JUnit, Maven/Gradle). • AI experience (must-have): hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools. This includes tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, or similar. Candidates should also have useful prompt engineering skills for code and tests. LLMs are leveraged for tasks such as generating tests, suggesting code reviews, summarizing logs, and speeding up triage. • Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo, Spinnaker) and quality gates. • Proven experience testing media/streaming applications across CTV (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV), SmartTV (Tizen/webOS), iOS/Android mobile, and web. • Hands-on validation of HLS/DASH, ABR, DRM, captions/subtitles, and QoE metrics. • Cloud experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). • Solid knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and core engineering principles.   Preferred Qualifications • Familiarity with observability and APM tools (Grafana, Prometheus, NewRelic, DataDog) and media telemetry(Conviva, MUX, NPAW etc). • Experience with contract testing (PACT), service virtualization, or synthetic media test data. • Exposure to CTV/SmartTV automation stacks and remote device labs.   Key Competencies • Quality mindset – commitment to reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. • AI fluency – practical judgment on where AI adds measurable value in testing. • Systems thinking – understanding distributed systems and complex media pipelines.   Success Metrics • Increased automation coverage across CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web; reduced manual regression. • Measurable reduction in escaped defects and media playback incidents. • Improved stability and reliability of automated pipelines and device runs. • Faster release cycles through scalable, AI-augmented automation. • Broad adoption and consistent usage of the GQE test framework across teams.   #LI-JC1

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - CTV
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

Senior Software Engineer, Smart TV/CTV 

 

Location: New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale


Overview


You’ll build and ship Paramount’s Smart TV applications across Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and other CTV
platforms. These apps run on web-based runtimes with tight memory budgets, limited CPU, and hardware that
varies by model year and price point. You’ll write React and TypeScript that performs within those constraints.
You’ll own features from concept through certification. You’ll work with central video engineering, external
platform partners, and Product/Design to deliver what millions of viewers see on the biggest screen in the
house.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain application components for Paramount’s Smart TV apps using React and
    TypeScript
  • Optimize application performance on resource-constrained CTV devices. Profile rendering, measure
    memory, fix what’s slow
  • Collaborate with central video engineering teams to integrate and optimize video players across platforms
  • Work with external platform partners (Samsung, LG, and others) to develop, debug, and certify
    applications
  • Manage application state with Redux and RTK. Keep the store clean and selectors fast as the app grows
  • Write clean, tested code and participate in code reviews. Hold your teammates to the same standard
  • Coordinate with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to turn requirements into working features
  • Work across multiple agile teams and contribute to all phases of the development cycle
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure for multi-platform Smart TV deployments
  • Document components, platform-specific patterns, and technical decisions
  • Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years writing software
  • 2+ years building Smart TV or CTV applications on web-based platforms (Tizen, webOS, or similar)
  • BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • React and TypeScript. You build components, not just consume them
  • State management with Redux and RTK. You understand store shape, middleware, and when selectors
    cause unnecessary re-renders
  • Client-side routing patterns (React Router or equivalent)
  • Front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript. You can debug layout and rendering issues on
    a TV runtime
  • You’ve taken features from concept through delivery on CTV platforms, including certification
  • CI/CD environments with DevOps and SRE principles
  • RESTful API integration and data handling
  • You communicate technical decisions in writing and in conversation. People act on what you say because
    it’s clear
  • You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple CTV platforms (Tizen, webOS, Vizio, Xbox, PlayStation, or others)
  • Performance optimization on TV devices: profiling, memory measurement, rendering analysis. You know
    how to find the bottleneck, not just guess
  • Browser internals knowledge: rendering pipelines, compositing, layout thrashing, and how these behave
    on TV runtimes vs. desktop browsers
  • Video player integration experience (Shaka, hls.js, or native platform players)
  • Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry, or similar
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks across distributed teams and time zones
  • Rapid proof-of-concept experience. You’ve built throwaway prototypes to answer hard questions fast
  • Enthusiasm for sharing AI tools and workflows that save the team time
  • You care about UX on the 10-foot screen and you’ll push back when something isn’t right
  • You say “I don’t know” when you don’t know

 

What Good Looks Like

  • You open a Smart TV codebase you’ve never seen, connect a Tizen emulator, and start diagnosing a
    rendering issue the same afternoon
  • Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough
  • You spot a memory leak on a 2020-era LG TV before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what
    happened
  • When a certification submission fails, you read the rejection, fix the issue, and flag what the team should
    check next time
  • You own your features end to end. From scoping through deployment, you don’t wait for someone to tell
    you what’s next
  • You know which React patterns cause jank on low-end CTV hardware. You avoid them and explain why to
    teammates who ask
  • You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better approach
  • You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
  • You help your teammates get better. Through code reviews, pairing, or writing things down so the next
    person doesn’t hit the same wall

 

#LI-TG1

 

 

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Roku
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

 

Location: On-Site - New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

You'll build and ship the Paramount+ Roku application used by millions of viewers. The Roku platform has constraints other platforms don't: tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, device hardware that ranges from flagship to five years old. You'll solve problems inside those constraints.

 

We write software that's simple to read, cheap to maintain, and built to last. You'll own features from design through deployment, work across agile teams, and help other engineers get better at this work.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Design, build, and maintain core Roku framework components and application features for Paramount+

• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements

• Use RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing to find and fix performance problems before users hit them

• Build real-time personalization and engagement features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, ad engagement — within Roku's memory and performance budgets

• Write clear documentation for components, architecture decisions, and platform-specific patterns

• Measure and improve application performance and stability through instrumentation and observability

• Work across agile teams and coordinate with backend engineering and DevOps/SRE on service builds and deploys

• Review code, pair with teammates, and raise the quality bar across the team

• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure

• Design and run A/B tests, then act on what the data says

• Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• 6+ years writing software

• 3+ years building Roku applications

• BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience

• You know OOP, data structures, and algorithms well enough to design systems, not just pass interviews

• BrightScript and SceneGraph SDK, including RSG 1.3

• You can explain Roku's memory model, the render-thread/task-thread split, device tiers, and what certification requires

• RESTful API design and data serialization

• Roku frameworks and services: RAF, RMF, RokuPay

• Unit and integration testing on Roku

• HTTP protocol and caching behavior

• Git and GitHub

• You write and speak about technical decisions in a way that helps people act on them

• You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• BrighterScript and Roku community tooling (ropm, bslint, roku-debug)

• Other OTT platforms: Fire TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG webOS

• Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry

• Microservices and backend-for-frontend patterns

• You've worked with personalization or recommendation APIs on resource-constrained devices

• E2E testing for connected-device applications

• Docker and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins or similar)

• GraphQL

• You share AI tools and workflows that save the team time

• You care about UX enough to push back on Product and Design when something isn't right

• You say "I don't know" when you don't know

• You've worked across time zones without waiting for meetings to unblock you

 

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

 

• You open a 200-file BrightScript repo you've never seen and start making changes the same day

• Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough

• You notice a memory spike on a Roku Express before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what happened

• You track Roku OS releases and adopt new APIs when they solve a real problem, not because they're new

• You write architecture docs, component guides, and Slack explanations that save ten people from asking the same question

• You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better one

• You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features

• You make the people around you better at their jobs

 

Paramount is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

Senior Software Engineer, Front End – CBS Sports Digital

Req: 45930 | Department: CBS Sports.com Technology | Type: Full-Time, On-Site Locations: Nashville, TN; Louisville, KY; Fort Lauderdale, FL

 

 

 

About the Role

Join CBS Sports Digital and help build the web experiences that millions of sports fans use every day across CBSSports.com and our apps. We are looking for a Senior Front End Engineer to join our Content Management team, a small engineering group that partners closely with design and product to turn ideas into fast, accessible, production-grade fan experiences.

 

You will own the quality of what fans see and feel: how fast pages load, how components behave, and how reliably we ship. Candidates with Lead-level scope are also encouraged to apply.

What You Will Do

  • Build Front-End Features: Design and ship production-grade features for web using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, from prototype through launch.

  • Own Performance: Improve and protect Core Web Vitals through rendering strategy, code splitting, lazy loading, and image and asset optimization.

  • Contribute to Standards: Build and evolve reusable components and shared patterns that scale across the organization.

  • Collaborate and Prototype: Work with design and product to quickly design, develop, and test solutions to key business challenges.

  • Raise the Bar on Code Quality: Review code for style, testability, accessibility, and efficiency, and mentor engineers on front-end best practices.

  • Type Safety: Contribute to TypeScript standards (strict mode, shared types, codegen) so our codebases stay maintainable and refactor-safe.

  • Monorepo Workflows: Use and contribute to monorepo tooling (e.g., Turborepo, Nx) to support build, test, and deploy across web applications.

  • Operational Excellence: Build with reliability in mind, including testing, front-end monitoring, and alerting.

  • Document: Contribute clear documentation and diagrams to help onboard other engineers.

  • Use AI Tools: Use AI development tools to speed up your workflow and share what works with the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade web applications with React and Next.js.

  • Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, generics, strict typing, and modern ES6+ features.

  • Deep knowledge of HTML and CSS, including responsive layout, cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and performance optimization.

  • Solid understanding of browser behavior, rendering, and front-end performance (e.g., Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting).

  • Experience consuming APIs (REST and GraphQL), including Apollo Client.

  • Experience with monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx), including shared packages and task pipelines.

  • Experience with component libraries or design systems and with testing front-end code (unit, integration, end-to-end).

  • Working knowledge of Node.js for server-side rendering and API layers.

  • Strong debugging and performance troubleshooting skills, including monitoring tools (e.g., New Relic, OpenTelemetry).

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple styling approaches (StyleX, CSS Modules, SASS, CSS-in-JS) and design tokens.

  • Exposure to CMS platforms such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or Magento.

  • Experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and with setting up guardrails (rules, commands, skills, sub-agents) to keep AI-generated code clean and production-ready.

  • Familiarity with Generative AI and RAG concepts, or experience building AI-powered features.

  • Cloud experience (AWS preferred) and familiarity with containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Familiarity with caching (Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

  • Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP, OCI).

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

In this role, you will work on the core infrastructure and internal tools that enable high- quality metadata ingestion and curation directly impacting content discovery, recommendations, and user experience across Paramount's streaming portfolio.   This is a highly cross-functional role at the intersection of content, data, and machine learning, partnering closely with ML engineers, product teams, and data stakeholders to bring metadata-driven experiences to life.   The ideal candidate will be:   - Enthusiastic about spanning the full lifecycle of a content data system from ingest and enrichment through deployment, monitoring, and downstream delivery - Invested in going beyond moving data to understanding it; developing domain-level familiarity with the content catalog, and how data quality issues upstream affect systems downstream - Committed to continuous improvement; takes ownership of feature implementation, plans for future maintainability - Skilled at partnering with Product to translate evolving content strategy into concrete engineering decisions; asking clarifying questions and iterating toward well-defined solutions under ambiguity - Collaborative across engineering teams; working with upstream providers and downstream consumers to define integration contracts, and ensuring the sequencing of changes so that features ship cohesively - Eager to leverage AI agents in the software development process for understanding code, troubleshooting, developing new features, and fixing issues   Responsibilities Include: Metadata Ingestion & Enrichment - Design, build, and maintain backend services that support content understanding, metadata modeling, and enrichment workflows - Contribute to systems that process and manage metadata for a large-scale, global content catalog Backend Services & Data Modeling - Maintain and expand the API layer and data models across two provider contexts (Paramount+ and PlutoTV) as the codebase converges toward a unified multi-tenant architecture - Uphold engineering quality through test coverage, code reviews, and consistent application of coding standards Internal Tooling & Curation - Support editorial curation workflows that feed the personalization experience, ensuring curators have the tooling and data quality needed to make effective content decisions     Basic Qualifications     - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience - Strong proficiency in a Python web API and ORM framework (Django/ORM/DRF preferred) - Knowledge of cloud infrastructure including managed databases, object storage, and container orchestration (GCP, AWS, or Azure) - API design with backwards compatibility across multiple consumer teams - Relational data modeling for transactional systems - Experience building data engineering pipelines, including best practices like defensive coding at ingestion boundaries, instrumentation to surface anomalies early, and awareness of data drift so that quality issues are caught before they propagate downstream     Additional Qualifications     - Django and Django REST Framework for production backend applications - Google Cloud Platform: Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, GKE - Google Cloud Pub/Sub subscriber/publisher patterns - Your next step in finance, with real ownership

Are you a couple of years into your accounting career and ready for more than month-end tasks? Join Paramount's Controllership team in Budapest and own the accounting for compensation-related activity across our international networks business.

You won't be buried in a back-office queue. You'll work directly with Treasury, Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash, and you'll help shape how accounting work moves into our Budapest hub over the coming years.

 

What you'll do

  • Own your processes end to end, from monthly journals, accruals and prepayments to account reconciliations and balance sheet rollforwards

  • Turn the numbers into insight by building the financial and operational metrics the business uses to make decisions

  • Partner with Finance and Operations colleagues across the organisation, and be the person they come to when they need an answer

  • Help migrate new accounting activities into Budapest, and standardise how we do things as we grow

  • Spot where we can work smarter, then fix it. We want your ideas and we'll give you room to run with them

  • Keep our controls strong (SOX) and work with external auditors on quarterly and annual reviews

What you bring

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

  • 2+ years of accounting experience across a mix of activities (journals, reconciliations, close)

  • A proactive, structured approach: you see things through to the end

  • Experience in a shared services or multinational environment

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

Paramount is looking for Senior Counsel to join the Law Department team supporting the U.S. Distribution (USD) group. This role requires drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a wide range of agreements arising from the distribution of Paramount’s programming services and content. This includes a broad array of media platforms (e.g. cable and satellite television, internet/OTT, connected devices, integrated streaming platforms) with a focus on linear, VOD and streaming distribution agreements. The ideal candidate will bring prior relevant deal experience, and will be expected to take a leadership role on complex negotiations and to help guide the development of more junior attorneys.

job.title: Sr Data Engineer (Data Architecture and Modeling)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview and Responsibilities:

 

The Signal Intelligence (SigInt) team turns a high-volume, multi-source data ecosystem — operational systems, client-app event streams, ad-tech platforms, stitcher events, ad server logs, and telemetry — into the trusted data models, metrics, and dashboards that drive business, product, and ad-ops decisions.

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer who is, in equal measure, a data modeler, a SQL craftsperson, and an analyst — not only a pipeline builder. You will own data end-to-end: modeling raw events into conformed, analytics-ready marts; writing the analytical SQL that answers hard business questions; defining the metrics leadership relies on; and building the pipelines that feed it all. Because we sit close to the business, translating ambiguous questions into durable models and clear insight matters as much as engineering the pipeline.

In practice, you will be the team's data sherpa — the person who knows the data terrain cold, guides analysts and business partners through it, and turns an ambiguous “can we find out X?” into a trusted, well-modeled answer. You own the map — the definitions, lineage, and the “why” behind the numbers — as much as the pipelines.

This is an analytics-engineering role on a semi-business team. It is not a pure platform / infrastructure position — if your passion is exclusively distributed-systems plumbing with little interest in modeling, analysis, or guiding the business, this will not be the right fit.

 

Responsibilities Include:

 

Modeling & architecture — the core of the role

• Design and own the dimensional and semantic models — conformed dimensions, facts, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions (Type 2), and well-defined grain — that serve as the trusted source of truth.

• Architect data marts spanning operational, advertising, and telemetry domains for analytics, reporting, AI, and operational use.

• Establish shared definitions and a semantic / metrics layer so users, sessions, devices, content, campaigns, and impressions mean the same thing everywhere.

SQL & analysis

• Write and optimize sophisticated analytical SQL — window functions, cohort and funnel logic, sessionization, distributions — on large event-scale datasets.

• Analyze complex datasets to find patterns, quantify drivers, and produce actionable insight; define new metrics and KPIs (usage, revenue, etc.) and the logic behind them.

• Independently investigate variance across platforms and communicate findings clearly to peers and senior leadership.

Business partnership

• Be the go-to guide for the data — the person who knows where every number comes from, what it means, and its quirks and landmines.

• Own the institutional knowledge of the data — definitions, lineage, and the reasoning behind metrics — and make it legible so analysts, ad ops, product, and finance can self-serve with confidence.

• Partner with stakeholders and source-system owners to translate ambiguous business questions into durable data models and metrics, and support/conduct strategic investigations and analysis.

Pipelines, quality & delivery

• Build and harmonize the ingestion and transformation pipelines — event data from client apps, ad-tech platforms, stitchers, ad servers, and telemetry — that feed the models, handling deduplication, late-arriving data, sessionization, and schema evolution.

• Stitch identity and sessions across client, server, and ad-side events for accurate user, content, and revenue analytics.

• Establish data-quality standards (testing, monitoring, alerting, freshness and volume SLAs) and troubleshoot incidents end-to-end — from a dashboard anomaly back through marts, transformations, and raw logs.

• Support and improve BI dashboards; document datasets, lineage, and business logic so the data map stays trustworthy and current.

• Mentor engineers and analysts on SQL, modeling, event data, and engineering best practices.

 

Basic Qualifications

 

• Expert SQL, including analytical SQL craft (window functions, complex joins, cohort / funnel / sessionization logic) and performance tuning on large event-scale datasets.

• Deep data-modeling expertise — dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, conformed dimensions, grain, and data-mart design; able to design a trusted source of truth from messy multi-source data.

• Strong data analysis and business translation — able to independently investigate data, define metrics and KPIs, and act as a trusted guide who turns ambiguous business questions into clear answers and enables others to self-serve.

• A guide’s temperament — curiosity to learn the data terrain deeply, patience to help non-technical partners, and communication that earns trust across the business.

• dbt (or an equivalent transformation / modeling framework).

• Cloud warehouse — BigQuery strongly preferred (our environment); Snowflake or Databricks acceptable with a fast ramp.

• Python for data processing and pipeline development.

• Orchestration experience (Airflow).

• High-volume event data — clickstream, telemetry, ad impressions, or similar — including deduplication, late-arriving data, sessionization, and schema evolution.

• Proven track record harmonizing data across multiple source systems with conflicting schemas, identifiers, or grain.

• BI tools (DOMO, Looker, Mode) — comfort both consuming and supporting their development.

• Experience debugging data-quality issues across the full stack — from BI tool to warehouse to raw event logs.

• BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Physics, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

• Semantic-layer experience (LookML, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube).

• Streaming-media / ad-tech domain (ad servers, SSAI / stitchers, VAST/VMAP, impression and fill-rate metrics).

• Streaming ingestion (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

• Statistical analysis with R and predictive-analytics tooling; experimentation / A-B analysis.

• Master data management or entity resolution.

• MS in a quantitative discipline; experience mentoring or leading engineers/analysts.

 

How you will succeed in this role:

 

• You think in models and metrics, not just pipelines.

• You are the person others come to when they are lost in the data — and you like being that guide.

• You are as comfortable in a SQL console or a dashboard as in a DAG, and you move fluidly between business context and technical root cause.

• You treat data as a product — with users, definitions, SLAs, and documentation.

• You turn ambiguous business questions into clean models and clear answers.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?  


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. 

 Apply to join our new platform initiative and take ownership of building a centralized performance testing automation platform for games development. In this role, you will collaborate with developers, designers, and QA teams to design and deliver a unified system that aggregates performance data from multiple game engines, processes results, and clearly highlights performance issues. 

 You will play a key role in defining the software architecture, database schemas, and overall system experience, while helping to track and visualize optimization progress over time. As this is a brand‑new platform with no prior internal equivalent, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape its foundations and influence how performance testing is approached across our game development teams. 

 

What you will do:

  • Build and Maintain CI/CD Pipelines 

  • Script repetitive tasks and develop self-service tools for developers 

  • Design and manage infrastructure 

  • Implement and manage containers, stand up and manage VMs 

  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting 

  • Ensure infrastructure is scalable, secure, and reliable. 

 

We are looking for Engineers that: 

  • Is fully self‑reliant and can take responsibility for future deliverables,

  • Want to actively participate in decision making and fully understand products they work on,   

  • Open to learn new programing languages, 

  • Enjoy working in a team,   

  • Easily and openly communicate in English.  

 

And on the technical side, we need: 

  • 5+ years of experience in software development, build automation, delivery and deployment 

  • Very good understanding of concepts like CI/CD, GitOps, configuration management, cloud platforms, version control, automation, monitoring, analytics, containerization, and microservices architecture 

  • Proficient in coding in at least one programing language (preferred: Kotlin, Java, JavaScript, Python, C++/C#)

  • Experience standing up and maintaining Windows and Linux VMs 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience scripting in BuildGraph 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience in code collaboration using Perforce 

  

We keep our technologies up-to-date, and have a major impact on the tool set: 

  • CI/CD & Automation: Horde, Jenkins, ArgoCD 

  • Infrastructure & Platform: OCI, Terraform, Ansible 

  • Containers & Virtualization: Kubernetes, Podman, Proxmox, KVM 

  • Observability & Reliability: Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic

job.title: Sr Editor, NFL (CBS Sports)
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.
If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:
CBS Sports is seeking a skilled, creative and highly organized Senior Editor to lead key aspects of its NFL coverage across CBSSports.com and CBS Sports platforms.The Senior Editor will play a central leadership role within the NFL editorial team, helping set the coverage strategy and oversee its execution across breaking news, live games, analysis, features, rankings, previews, reactions and enterprise storytelling. This role requires more than strong editing skills: We are looking for an ambitious editorial leader who can establish a clear vision, generate distinctive coverage ideas, manage and develop writers, and bring structure and accountability to a fast-moving newsroom operation. The NFL Draft will receive special attention in this role.
The ideal candidate has exceptional news judgment, deep NFL knowledge and a proven ability to make confident editorial decisions under pressure. This person should be equally comfortable directing coverage during a major breaking-news event, developing an ambitious long-term editorial franchise and coaching an individual writer toward stronger work. The Senior Editor will directly manage a team of writers, with responsibility for setting expectations, assigning coverage, providing regular feedback and supporting each employee’s professional development. They will also help establish team priorities, evaluate performance and foster a collaborative, creative and accountable culture. This position is based in New York and requires schedule flexibility, including nights, weekends and holidays as NFL games, news cycles and editorial needs warrant.


Responsibilities:
• Help define and execute the overall editorial strategy for CBS Sports’ NFL coverage across daily, seasonal and long-term priorities
• Directly manage, mentor and develop a team of writers, setting clear expectations and providing consistent editorial and performance feedback
• Lead regular one-on-one meetings, contribute to formal performance evaluations and create development plans that help employees grow
• Hold writers accountable for productivity, quality, collaboration, audience performance and established editorial standard
• Establish clear daily and long-term coverage priorities, delegate assignments appropriately and ensure deadlines and deliverables are met
• Generate and develop original coverage ideas, franchises and enterprise projects that distinguish CBS Sports in a competitive NFL media landscape
• Assign and edit breaking news, analysis, features, rankings, previews, reactions and other stories that meet CBS Sports’ editorial, legal and ethical standards
• Lead coverage surrounding NFL games, trades, injuries, coaching changes, free agency, the NFL Draft and other major league events
• Make decisive editorial calls during breaking news, live games and other high-volume coverage periods
• Work closely with writers to strengthen reporting, sharpen analysis, improve story structure and develop more compelling headlines and presentation
• Evaluate the strengths, opportunities and workloads of individual team members and deploy staff strategically across the coverage operation
• Identify gaps in coverage or team capabilities and recommend solutions, including new assignments, developmental opportunities and potential staffing needs
• Create efficient workflows and communication systems that keep writers aligned and the broader NFL operation organized
• Use audience insights, SEO principles and performance data to evaluate coverage, identify opportunities and inform future editorial decisions
• Coordinate with leaders across fantasy, betting, social, video, newsletters, programming and other editorial teams to develop cohesive, multiplatform coverage plans
• Balance immediate audience opportunities with original work designed to build authority and long-term loyalty for CBS Sports
• Represent the NFL team in broader editorial planning conversations and communicate priorities clearly to senior newsroom leadership
• Foster an environment that values creativity, urgency, accuracy, collaboration and continuous improvement

Basic Qualifications
• At least three years of professional experience in a digital editorial or newsroom environment
• Meaningful experience directly managing writers or editors, including setting goals, delivering feedback and evaluating performance
• A demonstrated record of leading editorial coverage and making high-level decisions during major news or live-event windows
• Exceptional editorial judgment and the ability to prioritize coverage in a fast-moving, high-pressure environment
• A proven ability to generate original ideas and turn them into successful stories, franchises or multiplatform coverage plans
• Excellent editing, headline-writing and story-packaging skills
• Strong organizational and operational skills, with the ability to manage people, deadlines and multiple concurrent workstreams
• Deep knowledge of the NFL, its teams and players, and the major issues and trends shaping the league
• A comprehensive understanding of the NFL calendar and news cycle, including games, roster movement, injuries, transactions, coaching changes, free agency and the NFL Draft
• Experience using SEO, audience analytics and other acquisition and engagement tools to inform editorial strategy
• Strong leadership, communication and relationship-management skills
• An undergraduate degree, preferably in journalism, communications or a related field
• Ability to work from New York
• Schedule flexibility, including nights, weekends and holidays as games, news developments and editorial shifts warrant


Additional Qualifications:
• A track record of improving employee performance and helping writers produce more ambitious, distinctive work
• Experience leading a team through organizational changes, evolving priorities or demanding coverage periods
• Experience developing major editorial franchises, special packages or enterprise projects
• Demonstrated success collaborating across editorial departments and platforms
• Familiarity with NFL Draft, fantasy football, sports betting, social media and emerging audience trends
• Experience working with content-management, analytics and editorial-planning systems
• Working knowledge of Photoshop or similar visual-editing tools


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.
