job.title: Sr Live Event Technology Engineer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Sr Live Event Technology Specialist (Streaming Operations Specialist)

Location:
Flexible / Global (based on operational needs)

Role Overview

As a Sr. Live Event Technology Specialist, you will serve as the primary technical escalation point for Paramount+’s global Live Event Operations team, providing technical support for Tier-1 live streaming events. This role focuses on diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical issues across the end-to-end live streaming ecosystem while minimizing customer impact during high-profile live broadcasts.

Working alongside Live Event Operators, Engineering, Product, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and distribution partners, you will lead technical investigations, coordinate cross-functional incident response, and drive root cause analysis for issues affecting acquisition, encoding, packaging, delivery, playback, advertising, and platform integrations.

Your expertise will ensure rapid issue mitigation, operational excellence, and continuous improvements across Paramount’s live streaming platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical escalation point for the Live Event Operations team during live events.
  • Support global Tier-1 live streaming events by troubleshooting complex issues across the complete video delivery chain.
  • Investigate service-impacting issues involving contribution feeds, cloud encoding, packaging, DRM, origin, CDN delivery, playback, and client applications.
  • Perform detailed technical analysis using streaming manifests, player logs, encoder metrics, QoS/QoE analytics, SCTE-35 signaling, transport stream analysis, and cloud monitoring tools.
  • Coordinate technical response across Engineering, Platform, Network Operations, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and third-party partners to restore service quickly.
  • Lead technical bridge calls during critical incidents, providing real-time updates, impact assessments, mitigation strategies, and recovery coordination.
  • Support Live Event Operators by providing technical guidance during event execution, validating mitigation actions, and assisting with operational decision-making.
  • Perform pre-event technical validation, redundancy verification, workflow testing, and production readiness reviews.
  • Conduct post-event root cause analysis (RCA), identify systemic issues, and drive corrective actions to improve platform reliability.
  • Develop and maintain troubleshooting documentation, operational runbooks, monitoring procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Support certification, onboarding, and production rollout of new streaming technologies, cloud workflows, monitoring tools, and vendor integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotations supporting global live streaming operations and high-severity production incidents.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years supporting large-scale live streaming, OTT platforms, broadcast technology, or video delivery systems.
  • Experience serving as a technical escalation resource supporting live operations teams during Tier-1 live events.
  • Strong troubleshooting experience across end-to-end streaming architectures including:
    • Contribution and video transport
    • Cloud encoding and transcoding
    • Packaging and origin services
    • DRM
    • SSAI/DAI
    • CDN distribution
    • Player playback
  • Deep understanding of HLS, DASH, CMAF/fMP4, MPEG-TS, SCTE-35, timed metadata, and adaptive bitrate streaming.
  • Experience analyzing manifests, transport streams, encoder logs, player telemetry, QoS/QoE metrics, and cloud infrastructure metrics.
  • Familiarity with AWS Media Services, CDN technologies, cloud networking, and streaming observability platforms.
  • Working knowledge of contribution protocols including SRT, Zixi, RIST, RTP, UDP, and multicast workflows.
  • Strong understanding of DRM, SSAI, client playback behavior, redundancy architectures, and failover strategies.
  • Excellent incident management, root cause analysis, and cross-functional communication skills in high-pressure live production environments.

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

The Senior Manager translates management's technical direction into executable engineering plans and owns day-to-day delivery, implementation quality, and production readiness. The role stays hands-on in solution design, code review, and high-risk work, and serves as a senior day-to-day technical lead, maintaining continuity of execution and technical direction. 

 


Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years hands-on software engineering experience building enterprise applications, APIs, or distributed systems.
  • 4+ years managing project-based engineering teams.
  • Strong development experience in Python or a comparable modern language.
  • Experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS and/or GCP.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, security, and observability.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent engineering workstreams in a production environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to select, lead, and maintain continuity across contract engineering teams.
  • Strong communication skills, able to translate technical risk and trade-offs for nontechnical stakeholders, with sound judgment under strain and the ability to influence across teams and vendors without direct authority. 

 


Core Responsibilities
Engineering & People Leadership

  • Select, onboard, direct, and evaluate consultant resources; manage vendor performance, project capacity, deliverables, and structured knowledge transfer as assignments change.
  • Build team depth so delivery and technical knowledge don't sit with one individual.
  • Stay hands-on in solution design, code review, troubleshooting, and high-risk work. 


Engineering Delivery

  • Translate architecture direction into technical plans, milestones, staffing, and releases.
  • Own backlog management, estimation, dependencies, scope, delivery risk, and release readiness.
  • Balance strategic projects, platform improvements, technical debt, and production needs.
  • Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify requirements, define technical scope and acceptance criteria, and identify delivery risks before work begins.


Technical Leadership

  • Provide day-to-day technical direction within architecture standards set by leadership.
  • Set expectations for code quality, testing, APIs, documentation, security, and deployment automation.
  • Promote reusable services and integrations over one-off solutions.
  • Escalate significant architecture, platform, and vendor decisions to leadership.
  • Maintain enough architectural depth and institutional knowledge to represent the team's technical direction independently when leadership is unavailable. 


AI Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Lead delivery of cloud-native services, media workflow integrations, metadata platforms, archive modernization, and content migration initiatives.
  • Oversee delivery of AI-enabled capabilities for metadata enrichment, content discovery, and workflow automation, including model integration, retrieval systems, data quality, and evaluation, in partnership with architects and AI engineers.
  • Set standards for responsible use of AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent); ensure AI-generated code is reviewed, tested, and documented to normal engineering and security standards.
  • Ensure appropriate attention to security, identity, cost, monitoring, and supportability across cloud and AI services. 


Production Ownership

  • Own production readiness and engineering support for services built by the team.
  • Ensure monitoring, runbooks, deployment procedures, rollback plans, and escalation paths are in place.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring defects and reliability issues.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between frontline operational support and engineering escalation.


Additional Desired Experience

  • Experience with MAM/PAM platforms, metadata management, transcoding, workflow orchestration, or archive systems.
  • Familiarity with broadcast or enterprise media asset management platforms.
  • Experience with large-scale content migration and enterprise system integration.
  • Experience supporting software platforms in a 24/7 broadcast, media, or other mission-critical environment.

#LI-PV1

Senior Web Software Engineer (New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale)


In This Role You’ll:


Paramount is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Web Architecture team, responsible for building and maintaining the foundational frontend platform that powers Paramount+ and other supported brands. In this role, you’ll serve as a technical authority across frontend teams by defining patterns, reviewing architectural decisions, and helping teams navigate complex challenges. The position involves designing, extending, and evolving a shared framework in a fast-paced, collaborative environment that values agility, innovation, and high technical standards.


We are seeking an engineer who can work independently in large codebases, write clear and maintainable code, and balance correctness, performance, and user impact. The ideal candidate contributes beyond their immediate team, communicates tradeoffs effectively, advocates sound architecture with pragmatism, and documents decisions through scalable, asynchronous channels. CI/CD, observability, and code quality are treated as core responsibilities, not afterthoughts.


Responsibilities:


● Build and maintain Next.js micro-frontend applications orchestrated via Module Federation which powers Paramount+ and Pluto.tv Web applications

● Develop and evolve a GraphQL API layer (Apollo Server) consumed by multiple federated frontends

● Contribute to shared packages across a monorepo

● Demonstrate strong communication skills to lead through all aspects of the web platform development cycle, as well as to collaborate with other teams on creating features

● Monitor and improve application performance and observability

● Collaborate, document and coach colleagues in a respectable manner, ensuring established architectural patterns are applied across the codebase

● Partner with our frontend, backend engineering, and DevOps/SRE teams to build and deploy high-performing services

● Help build a culture of socializing architectural standards across frontend teams

● Manage and optimize application dependencies

● Continuously enhance our CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins, optimize processes and tests

● Perform experiments and analyze results

 

Basic Qualifications You Bring:


● 5+ years of experience with web application development

● BS degree in Computer Science, similar technical field of study or equivalent practical experience

● Deep understanding of web application development and best practices

● Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Design, data structures, and algorithms

● Experience developing responsive websites

● Solid JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS, Sass, HTML

● Solid experience developing apps with React (preferably with SSR) ● Experience with Next.js or similar frameworks

● Solid understanding of GraphQL — schema design, resolvers, federation

● Familiarity with monorepo tooling (pnpm workspaces, Turborepo or equivalent)

● Strong testing discipline — Jest, Cypress

● Good understanding of HTTP protocol and caching layers

● Solid knowledge of HTML DOM and Event APIs

● Solid knowledge of web ecosystem tooling — Webpack, Git

● Demonstrated ability to communicate architectural design concepts cleary— in writing, design reviews, and real-time discussions with engineers at all levels

 

Bonus Skills (nice-to-haves):


● Experience using Module Federation and/or other micro frontend tools/frameworks

● Passionate about delivering without compromising standards

● Experience with microservices, design systems

● Experience with GraphQL, PHP

● Experience with E2E frameworks - with familiarity with Cypress and Synergy

● Working knowledge of Docker and CI tools

● Observability experience (New Relic, Datadog or similar)

● Understanding or experience with Atomic Design Concepts

● Eagerness to collaborate with Product and Design to ensure high standard of UX

● Humility to speak up when lacking knowledge or experience in an area

● Experience working asynchronously across time zones.

 Apply to join our new platform initiative and take ownership of building a centralized performance testing automation platform for games development. In this role, you will collaborate with developers, designers, and QA teams to design and deliver a unified system that aggregates performance data from multiple game engines, processes results, and clearly highlights performance issues.

Technical/Engineering.

loops.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

 

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

  • Shape the Product: You’ll trade honest, real-time feedback with engineers and PMs. We don't just "deliver" designs; we shape products in the build.

 

Core Capabilities

  • Visual Design: You have a refined eye for type hierarchy, layouts, and intuitive UI/UX. You deliver high-impact, immersive designs for complex app systems that capture the intensity of game day and live sports.

  • Motion & Interactivity: You understand motion as a logical system. Your designs feel tactile, precise, and alive.

  • Fluency in Native Design: You have deep experience with mobile paradigms (iOS/Android). You know how to leverage native capabilities to elevate the user experience.

  • Owner Mindset: You treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. You use your intuition, analytics, and direct fan feedback to make smart product decisions quickly.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of end-to-end product design experience.

  • A portfolio showing shipped consumer work on mobile apps or web (required).

  • Comfort moving across prototyping, production, and interaction design without handoffs.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows.

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. job.title: Sr. Software Engineer Cloud infrastructure
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview

The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Cloud Infrastructure. This is a hybrid role that blends deep software engineering with hands-on ownership of cloud infrastructure. It is purpose-built for engineers who are equally writing production Java services and designing multi-cloud platform architecture.

In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of cloud-native systems. You will build high-performance streaming applications and architect the infrastructure they run on. You will also ensure both are production-grade, observable, and secure. You will bridge application and platform engineering, reducing the gap between what software teams need and what the cloud platform delivers.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, Kubernetes, and software engineering best practices. You should have a track record of operating at both the application and infrastructure layers.

 

Key Responsibilities

Optimize Data Streaming Applications on Cloud

  • Own end-to-end performance of data streaming applications running on cloud infrastructure — from Kafka topic configuration through consumer processing and downstream delivery.
  • Profile and tune streaming pipelines to maximize throughput and minimize latency, leveraging cloud-native compute, storage, and networking resources.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks at the intersection of application code and cloud resource constraints, including CPU throttling, network saturation, I/O limits, and memory constraints.
  • Design and implement cloud resource utilization strategies. This includes spot/preemptible instances, managed streaming services, and dynamic node pool scaling to balance performance with cost efficiency.
  • Benchmark streaming pipelines end-to-end and translate findings into actionable infrastructure and code improvements.
  • Collaborate with Data and AI/ML engineering teams to ensure streaming pipelines are optimally provisioned for real-time feature engineering, inference, and analytics workloads.


Design & Build Cloud-Native Applications

  • Develop high-throughput, low-latency streaming applications using Java and Kafka.
  • Design event-driven microservices that process, enrich, and route real-time data at scale.
  • Implement reactive, non-blocking architectures to support high concurrency and resilience.
  • Develop reusable streaming frameworks, libraries, and platform capabilities to improve engineering velocity and standardization.


Architect & Operate Multi-Cloud Infrastructure

  • Architect, implement, and optimize multi-cloud infrastructure across GCP and OCI to support large-scale data and streaming workloads.
  • Design and implement advanced networking architectures, including VPC peering, VPNs, load balancers, and cross-region failover strategies.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code frameworks to standardize deployments and enable developer self-service.
  • Define autoscaling, deployment, failover, and resource optimization strategies for high-volume production systems.
  • Contribute to platform-wide architecture decisions related to scalability, resiliency, high availability, and disaster recovery.


Kubernetes & Container Engineering

  • Deploy and manage containerized microservices within Kubernetes environments (GKE, OKE) across cloud platforms.
  • Implement container orchestration best practices, service-mesh configurations, and rolling-deployment strategies.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to improve developer tooling, deployment automation, and runtime reliability.

 

Production Reliability & Performance

  • Ensure production-grade reliability, observability, and operational maturity across streaming platforms and infrastructure.
  • Implement comprehensive observability using Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging, distributed tracing, and health monitoring.
  • Optimize systems for throughput, latency, resiliency, resource efficiency, and cloud cost governance.
  • Build automated testing strategies for streaming and infrastructure workflows, including unit, integration, contract, chaos, and performance testing.
  • Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortems to improve uptime and reduce operational risk.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to integrate streaming architectures with batch processing, data lakes, and analytical platforms.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and API teams to enable real-time services and data-driven applications.
  • Work closely with AI/ML engineering teams to support real-time feature engineering, inference pipelines, and operational AI workload.
  • Clearly communicate technical tradeoffs to engineering stakeholders. Also, discuss scalability considerations and operational risks.

 

Technical Management

  • Lead architectural discussions, design reviews, and technical deep dives across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure.
  • Drive engineering standards across code quality, documentation, observability, security, and platform maintainability.
  • Influence long-term technical strategy and modernization initiatives for real-time data infrastructure and cloud platforms.

 

Required Technical Skills

Streaming Optimization & Cloud Resource Utilization

  • Deep expertise in optimizing data streaming applications for throughput, latency, and cost-efficiency across cloud environments.
  • Proficient in tuning Kafka producers, consumers, and brokers — including batch sizing, compression, partition strategies, and consumer lag management — within cloud-hosted deployments.
  • Experience leveraging cloud-native managed services (e.g., Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub, BigQuery Streaming; OCI Streaming) to complement or extend Kafka-based pipelines.
  • Skilled at right-sizing and dynamically allocating cloud compute resources (VMs, node pools, spot/preemptible instances) to match streaming workload profiles and reduce infrastructure spend.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native autoscaling patterns for streaming consumers, including KEDA, HPA, and custom metrics-based scaling in Kubernetes.
  • Ability to identify and address performance bottlenecks at the intersection of application code and cloud resource limits
  • You should have experience benchmarking and profiling streaming pipelines from start to finish. You also need to turn your findings into improvements for infrastructure and code.

 

Basic Qualifications

This is a hybrid role. Candidates must have hands-on experience in both software engineering and cloud infrastructure.

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering and cloud infrastructure, with at least 3+ years in each area.
  • Demonstrated expertise in optimizing data streaming applications on cloud infrastructure.
  • Proven track record building and operating production-grade real-time data platforms.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and collaborating across teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

#LI-PV1

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

This role will design and build high-performance, fault-tolerant streaming applications that power real-time analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and mission-critical data services across the organization.   • Build automated testing strategies for streaming workflows, including unit, integration, contract, chaos, and performance testing.
  • Participate in production support. Help with incident response and root-cause analysis. Work on initiatives to improve reliability continuously.

 

Cloud-Native & Kubernetes Engineering

  • Deploy and manage containerized microservices within Kubernetes environments across GCP, AWS, or similar cloud platforms.
  • Define strategies for autoscaling, deployment, failover, and resource optimization. These strategies will focus on high-volume production systems.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and API teams to enable real-time services and data-driven applications.
  • Work closely with AI/ML engineering teams to support real-time feature engineering, inference pipelines, and operational AI workloads.
  • Clearly explain the tradeoffs of different technical options. Discuss scalability considerations and operational risks with engineering stakeholders.

 

Required Technical Skills 

Java & Reactive Programming

  • Advanced proficiency in Java, including concurrency, multithreading, and JVM performance tuning.
  • Strong experience with reactive frameworks such as Spring WebFlux, Project Reactor, or similar.
  • Deep knowledge of asynchronous, non-blocking system design. Kafka & Event-Driven Architecture
  • Extensive experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, streams, schema registry).
  • Strong knowledge of partitioning strategies, offset management, rebalancing, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing event schemas and managing schema evolution.
  • Familiarity with Kafka Streams, Flink, or similar stream-processing frameworks.

Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Systems

  • Strong hands-on experience deploying and operating applications in Kubernetes. You should have experience using Docker for containerization. It's also important to have knowledge of microservices architecture. You should understand how autoscaling functions. You also need to learn about rolling deployments. It's important to know patterns that ensure reliable production.

 

Basic Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years working on streaming or distributed systems. You should have experience in designing, building, and running production-grade real-time systems. This includes event-driven systems. You should be comfortable working in cloud-based systems that use microservices. This includes engineering environments that focus on these technologies.
  • Ability to take ownership of complex technical work and deliver reliable solutions autonomously.

job.title: SVP, Finance Innovation
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview: 

The Senior Vice President, Finance Innovation is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role responsible for reimagining how the Finance organization operates through the application of artificial intelligence and agentic automation. This role will identify, champion, and implement AI-driven opportunities across the Finance function, with a particular focus on building agentic workflows and AI systems capable of autonomously executing multi-step financial processes with human oversight, across Accounting, Forecasting & FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and operational finance areas unique to a media and entertainment enterprise, including Production Finance and Participations & Residuals. This leader will serve as the bridge between Finance, Technology, and Data/AI teams, translating complex financial processes into scalable, intelligent automation while maintaining rigorous controls, auditability, and compliance standards appropriate for a large public company. The successful candidate will combine deep finance domain expertise with a strong point of view on emerging AI capabilities, and the organizational influence to drive adoption across a broad and often decentralized finance ecosystem. As Finance advances its Fusion systems integration, this leader will be a key voice in shaping how that effort intersects with Finance's broader innovation and automation agenda.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Define and lead the enterprise Finance Innovation strategy and multi-year roadmap for AI and agentic workflow adoption across all Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with the CFO organization and Finance leadership to identify, prioritize, and business-case AI opportunities based on value creation, risk profile, and feasibility. 
  • Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of use cases spanning close and consolidation, reconciliations, forecasting and variance analysis, cash and liquidity management, tax provision and compliance, and production finance/participations & residuals calculations and reporting.
  • Stay ahead of the external AI and finance-technology landscape (agentic frameworks, LLM-based finance copilots, RPA-to-agentic evolution) and translate relevant developments into actionable internal opportunities.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data & Analytics, and external delivery partners on agentic workflow and AI-tool initiatives as the Finance domain voice, defining use cases, finance requirements, and success criteria, and providing continuous feedback through design, build, and deployment. Product and Technology direct solution design, engineering, and production deployment; this role ensures what gets built reflects finance process reality and business need.
  • Own finance-side accountability across the delivery lifecycle: opportunity identification and prioritization, requirements definition, controls and change management within Finance, driving adoption, and validating realized value while Product and Technology own solution design, build, and rollout execution.
  • Specify the finance control requirements agentic systems must meet: human-in-the-loop oversight, exception handling, and escalation, and validate that the frameworks Product and Technology implement keep those systems within Finance's risk, controls, and SOX/regulatory boundaries. 
  • Convene Internal Audit, SOX, and Compliance to define the control and documentation standards AI-driven finance processes must satisfy, and carry those requirements into the Product and Technology build so solutions meet public-company standards.
  • Partner closely with the EVP of Integration on systems integration work related to Fusion, ensuring Finance requirements, controls, and adoption considerations are represented as Fusion capabilities are integrated into Finance systems and processes.
  • Accounting & Close: Identify opportunities for agentic automation in journal entries, reconciliations, close checklists, and financial reporting. 
  • Forecasting & FP&A: Champion AI-augmented forecasting, scenario modeling, and variance analysis to improve speed and accuracy of business planning.
  • Treasury: Explore agentic support for cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliations, and risk monitoring.
  • Tax: Identify AI applications in tax provision, compliance documentation, and regulatory research and monitoring. 
  • Production Finance: Drive automation of production cost tracking, budget-to-actual analysis, and studio/content cost reporting specific to media production.
  • Participations & Residuals: Champion agentic solutions for the complex, high-volume calculations, contract interpretation, and reporting inherent to participations and residuals processing. 
  • Serve as a visible champion and educator for AI adoption, building Finance-wide fluency and comfort with agentic tools through training, communication, and hands-on enablement.
  • Develop governance structures, including an AI use-case intake process and a Finance Innovation council or working group with representation across Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with HR and Finance leadership to evolve talent, role design, and ways of working as agentic workflows shift the nature of finance work.
  • Manage change resistance thoughtfully, ensuring adoption is durable and supported by the broader finance organization rather than imposed top-down. Stakeholder Management & Reporting
  • Regularly report progress, value delivered, and roadmap updates to executive leadership, including the CFO and relevant Audit/Risk committees as appropriate.
  • Build strong relationships with Technology, Data/AI, Legal, business-unit finance leaders, and the EVP of Integration to ensure alignment and shared ownership of innovation initiatives, including Fusion-related systems integration work. 
  • Represent the company's Finance Innovation agenda in relevant internal forums and, where appropriate, external industry settings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced credential preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive finance, accounting, or FP&A experience, ideally within a large, complex, public media, entertainment, or content organization. 
  • Demonstrated track record leading finance transformation, process automation, or technology-enabled change initiatives at scale. 
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and agentic or RPA-based automation, and how they apply to financial processes; direct experience implementing such tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience with production finance and/or participations and residuals processes is a plus given the specialized nature of these areas in media and entertainment.
  • Prior exposure to SOX controls, internal audit requirements, and the governance considerations of deploying automation in a public-company financial environment. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong finance and accounting fundamentals combined with genuine curiosity about, and fluency in, emerging AI capabilities.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and business units without direct authority over all of them.
  • Proven ability to translate technical AI/automation concepts into business terms finance professionals can act on, and vice versa.
  • Strong program and change management skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity and building new organizational muscle from scratch.
  • Sound judgment regarding risk, controls, and the appropriate pace and boundaries of automation in regulated financial processes.

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. job.title: TOC/Editor
job.description:
The Ingest/Transmission Operator and Editor oversees all inbound and outbound media, content distribution, and news-gathering operations. Responsibilities include monitoring on-air product quality, ensuring compliance with government regulations, troubleshooting technical equipment, editing news content, and preparing programming for broadcast. This position is governed by the National IBEW Broadcast Agreement for CBS television stations.

 

Duties & Responsibilities


• Monitor and manage inbound and outbound media using various transmission methods, including fiber, Skype, and LiveU.
• Ensure timely response to breaking news events and oversee broadcast delivery.
• Collaborate with team members and network staff, providing operational support as needed.
• Identify, edit, and insert broadcast-quality video and audio into news bulletins on short notice.
• Handle broadcast media and feeds, manage video and audio switching, and operate recording equipment.
• Utilize servers and monitoring systems to manage media acquisition and delivery.
• Ingest media into servers and prepare files for editing and broadcast.
• Perform basic troubleshooting and escalate technical issues when necessary.
• Support live studio production requirements and provide excellent service to internal and external media operations clients.
• Monitor and control video encoding and decoding systems and troubleshoot incoming and outgoing transmission paths.
• Develop and implement backup plans for equipment or transmission failures.
• Edit news content using non-linear editing systems.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Skills & Qualifications


• Strong knowledge of server-based news environments, broadcast hardware, and software systems.
• Understanding of news operations, current events, and the importance of attention to detail.
• Proficiency in quality control (QC) tools and processes.
• Familiarity with digital video formats, ingest workflows, media servers, and broadcast production environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.
• Understanding of broadcast production workflows and technical standards.
• Working knowledge of broadcast formats, server systems, and diagnostic tools.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced news environment.
• Strong organizational skills, reliability, and punctuality.
• Experience with Grass Valley Edius editing systems preferred.

 

Education & Experience


• Bachelor's degree in a technical field preferred.
• Minimum of 1–2 years of experience working in a fast-paced television news environment.
• Experience using non-linear editing systems required.
• Must be detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and able to work with minimal supervision.
• Must be a creative and adaptable team player capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
• Flexibility to work nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

job.title: TV Media Finance Intern
job.description:
🎬 Finance Intern (FP&A) – TV Media

Location: [City / Hybrid] | Duration: 12-Month Contract | Commitment: Full-time

 

The Vibe

Ever wondered how major TV shows, streaming deals, and media networks actually make money?

We’re looking for a Finance Intern to join our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team. If you’re sharp with numbers, obsessed with media, and eager to see how modern finance works behind the scenes, this is your launchpad.

You won't just be doing coffee runs—you’ll be working directly on budget modeling, stream-lining workflows, and helping us roll out a massive new ERP system transformation.

 

What You’ll Be Doing (The Real Deal)

  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Help build and maintain annual budgets and forecasts. You’ll pull inputs from different media departments and keep our financial models clean and tight.

  • Reporting & Analytics: Build financial reports and presentations that help senior leaders make real-time decisions about media operations.

  • Hands-On Operations: Keep our financial trackers up to date. You’ll get a front-row seat to how corporate finance operates from end-to-end.

  • Process & Documentation Support: Support the team in documenting existing processes and help identify simple opportunities for automation and simplification (e.g. cleaning up templates, reducing repetitive manual steps).

  • ERP System Transformation: Get direct experience on a major tech implementation—participating in testing, data validation, and rollout alongside senior team members.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Connect with teams across the business to gather insights, answer questions, and keep projects moving forward.

 

What You Bring

  • Education: Currently pursuing a BSc or MSc in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related quantitative field.

  • Spreadsheet Savvy: Strong Excel skills (you know your way around formulas, pivot tables, and clean data structures).

  • Communication: Confident, clear English (written & spoken). You’re comfortable talking to people across different levels and teams.

  • Curiosity & Mindset: Quick to pick up new tools, eager to solve problems, and comfortable asking questions when something doesn't make sense.

  • Please note: This position is based in Budapest and requires active student status in Hungary with full current eligibility to work (no visa, work permit, or relocation sponsorship is provided).

 

What’s In It For You?

  • Real Impact: No busywork. You’ll be working on active financial models and major tech projects from week one.

  • Modern Tech Stack Experience: Gain resume-defining exposure to enterprise ERP systems and financial automation.

  • Mentorship: Work directly with experienced finance professionals who care about your growth and career trajectory.

  • Industry Insights: Deep-dive into the TV and media industry, learning how creative projects translate into commercial strategy.

 

Ready to apply?

Send us your resume and a quick note on why you're interested in the media finance space. Let’s build something great together.

 

Paramount Networks International, is comprised of many of the world's most popular multimedia entertainment brands, including MTV, MTV LIVE HD, Nickelodeon, Nick Jr., Comedy Central, Paramount Channel, BET and more. Paramount brands reach more than 3.8 billion cumulative subscribers in 180+ countries and territories via more than 200 locally programmed and operated TV channels and more than 550 digital media and mobile TV properties, in 40 languages.

job.title: Vice President, Paramount TV Marketing, BET
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview: 

This role is a part of the broader Paramount TV Marketing Organization with specific focus on the BET brand. As a Vice President of 360 Consumer Marketing & Brand Strategy at PTV/BET Networks, the ideal candidate will be responsible for the development and execution of marketing strategies to drive awareness of and engagement for BET programming and Brand initiatives. The main objective of the marketing strategy and in-market plans will be to drive viewership, consumer engagement, while delivering unprecedented brand love for the BET brand. 

Key focus areas for the role include developing show launch strategies, leading brief development, and building winning cross functional launch plans that include partnerships with insights, paid media, brand creative studio, digital/social marketing, show experiential, and performance research. The role will also be integral to developing bold and disruptive ideas to further build the BET brand on a local, national, and global basis.

job.title: VP, Commissioning Editor - Drama
job.description:
#WeAreSkydance on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Skydance means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

5 is one of the UK’s biggest public service broadcasters and is growing its drama slate across linear and 5’s streaming service. We're now part of Skydance, which gives us new creative ambition, bigger global reach and the backing to take bolder swings. We’re looking for a VP to own drama commissioning at 5 and shape what comes next.

The role

You’ll work closely with the Head of Scripted to find, develop and commission series and pilots from independent producers, then see them through development, production and post, representing 5’s creative interests throughout. The Commissioning team is responsible, editorially, for original programming for 5. The team receive pitches from independent production companies and select projects to develop and commission to pilot and series. They oversee the editorial elements of the commissioned programmes as they go through development, preproduction, production and post, representing 5’s creative interests.

What you’ll do

  • Find and generate ideas for 5’s drama slate. 
  • Review and respond to programming proposals.
  • Read submissions and provide clear insight on their suitability
  • Oversee all aspects of productions, including feeding back on scripts, casting, watching rushes, providing RC and FC
    notes, feeding back on grade, mixes, VFX.
  • Focus on editorial concerns during both production and post-production
  • Identify projects that will drive viewership and hit ratings targets on 5
  • Communicate the drama brief to independent production companies and inspire them to bring their best ideas to 5.
  • Keep up to date with what other broadcasters are doing and ensure that 5 is seen to push the boundaries
    of scripted genres.
  • Nurture and maintain relationships to ensure that Skydance attracts the brightest talent both on and of screen
  • Demonstrate an ability to get on with major talent, both onscreen talent and writers/directors/creatives.
  • Drive ratings, revenue and reputation through commissions
  • Build relationships with distributors and financiers that will help independent producers finance their shows for 5.
  • Be alert to and suggest alternative sources of funding, whether co-production or governmental.
  • Resolve business affairs and legal issues
  • Develop new areas of scripted programming
  • Work with Marketing on on-air and off-air promotions
  • Regular liaison with production companies and talent to develop new ideas and areas of programming
  • Awareness of diversity issues and making appropriate commissioning decisions
  • Help to create the greatest possible workplace experience for employees.
  • Drive the ‘One ViacomCBS’ approach, role modelling great teamwork and collaboration.
  • Be an ambassador for all VCNI channels, internally and externally
  • Help to embed the ViacomCBS values and foster a culture of inclusion

What you bring

  • Experience of working within a broadcaster, with independent production companies, as a producer, Executive
    Producer or Creative Director
  • Strong editorial judgment
  • Experience of working with writers and other key creative talent, giving editorial notes at all stages of production.
  • Good understanding of TV audiences and the TV landscape and how it’s evolving, as well as the TV/streaming
    landscape generally.
  • Must be able to manage multiple projects at once in varying stages from development to production
  • Strong capacity for creative problem solving
  • Knowledge of drama funding both domestically and internationally
  • Understanding of viewing targets, both linear and streaming

Why join us

  • Real influence over a high-profile slate at a broadcaster that moves quickly
  • Access to Paramount Skydance’s international network and resources

job.description:

Overview:

Paramount is creating a new senior role to build and lead its global fashion and cultural partnerships capability. Reporting to the Head of Creative, the VP will serve as a strategic creative partner to Commercial, Franchise, Studio, and other key teams.

The role will use fashion, design, and cultural partnerships to elevate Paramount’s global consumer products, experiences, and brand value, with opportunities spanning fashion, design, food, hospitality, music, and experiential. This is a highly relationship-driven, culturally fluent, editorially minded role for an executive who understands both the fashion industry and entertainment—and can credibly operate at the intersection of the two.

The role is focused on selective, strategic, fashion-forward and culturally meaningful partnerships that elevate Paramount’s creative reputation and generate earned reach and strategic business value. Softlines licensing, retailer/category management, style guide production, and high-volume licensee administration are outside the scope of this role and sit within other areas of the organization. The ideal partnerships may be fashion, design, food, hospitality, or experience-led, but all should share a common standard: taste, cultural credibility, creative integrity, strategic intent, and meaningful impact.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Build Paramount’s Cultural Partnership Platform

    • Develop and lead a high-profile cultural partnership strategy across Paramount’s iconic catalog and current/upcoming slate

    • Create selective, high-taste partnerships that generate earned media, cultural relevance, and long-term brand value

    • Identify and cultivate relationships with leading fashion designers, brands, cultural institutions, culinary partners, and experiential collaborators

    • Establish the creative framework and standards that ensure partnerships are coherent, intentional, and distinctly Paramount

  • Lead Partnerships Across the Slate

    • Embed fashion and cultural partnership thinking early in the development and marketing process—not after launch

    • Develop partnership strategies by title in collaboration with Commercial, Franchise Marketing, Studio, and other stakeholders

    • Build and manage a global pipeline of culturally relevant partners across fashion, design, food, hospitality, music, and experiences

    • Lead creative outreach, partnership development, creative direction, and launch execution

    • Ensure partnerships protect and enhance the creative integrity and ambition of Paramount’s IP

  • Cross-Functional & External Leadership

    • Serve as the senior creative advisor on cultural positioning and partnership strategy

    • Partner closely with Commercial, Franchise Marketing, Studio, Business Affairs, and IP owners to move opportunities forward effectively

    • Represent Paramount with senior leaders across fashion, design, luxury, entertainment, and culture

    • Bring a sophisticated point of view on emerging cultural trends, shifting luxury dynamics, and where authentic influence and credibility live today

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience collaborating with high-end brands  

  • Senior executive with deep credibility and relationships across fashion, luxury, design, culture, and/or entertainment

  • Proven track record creating high-profile brand partnerships that drive cultural relevance and earned media

  • Strong creative instincts combined with commercial sophistication

  • Exceptional relationship builder and negotiator who can operate comfortably with designers, founders, creatives, studio executives, and business leaders

  • Deep understanding of global cultural trends and the evolving intersection of fashion, entertainment, and consumer culture

  • Able to balance ambition and taste with business objectives, operational realities, and brand protection

Overview:

CBS News is seeking a WGA Planning Producer to help direct and manage our streaming network’s daily coverage line-up. From scheduling correspondents and camera positions to coordinating live interviews and future-event logistics, and jumping in during breaking news, this role is a key part of our live programming team and reports to the Editorial Director. This is a New York-based position that is covered under the Collective Bargaining Agreement with the WGA-E.   The ideal candidate has a demonstrated ability to coordinate with editorial leaders and live-show producers, as well as newsgathering stakeholders, field producers and correspondents, to ideate, plan and bring to air same-day and future coverage. The planning producer will collaborate with production and publishing units across streaming, network news and digital, and will also be a point of contact working with partners as well as Paramount Global properties.   As a hardworking journalist, the producer is equally interested in domestic and international news, and thrives on organization and attention to detail. You enjoy working in a fast-paced news environment, pitching original ideas daily, researching segments and pre-producing special coverage, and rising to the occasion during breaking news events.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Coordinate with assignment desk, booking team, show producers, domestic and international bureau editors on the planning of day-to-day programming and major news events
  • Identify and pitch stories with high potential for compelling and comprehensive live video storytelling, including day-of-air, special and feature segments
  • Identify key events for future coverage planning
  • Collaborate with digital reporters to develop original segments based on their reporting
  • Gather and flag elements during breaking news as needed
  • Contribute to the streaming network’s news event and coverage calendar
  • Communicate coverage plans to streaming-network and broadcast stakeholders
  • Work closely with the Editorial Director and Senior leadership team to plan coverage for live events & specials

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years work experience in either a broadcast or streaming television newsroom, ideally at the national level with some segment producing experience
  • Hands on newsroom experience scheduling correspondents, booking studios, and gathering elements during breaking news
  • Fluent and knowledge of current events, politics and pop culture
  • Availability to work all shifts, including early morning, nights, weekends and holidays, on short notice and as coverage needs require, as this is a 24-hour news operation

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Basic understanding of control room operations
  • Ability to communicate with anchors, correspondents and producers in the field
  • Familiarity and working knowledge of digital video production-related techniques and online content management
  • Knowledge about social media and the competitive digital news environment
  • Familiarity with ENPS & iNews

CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. job.description:

Overview:

The CBS Evening News with Tony Dokoupil and CBS Weekend News with Jericka Duncan are seeking a full-time experienced and exceptional News Writer for our live national broadcasts. You must possess exemplary news judgement, thrive under deadline pressure, and translate complex stories into clear, accurate, and viewer-engaging language.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Write sharp, active, and compelling anchor copy for live newscasts, breaking news, and special reports (including intros, tags, VOs and teases).
  • Research stories and verify facts using reliable sources. 
  • Maintain accuracy, fairness, and balance while meeting tight deadlines. 
  • Monitor news wires, social media, and other sources for breaking developments. 
  • Ensure all copy meets journalistic, legal, and CBS News editorial standards.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Membership in the Writers Guild of America.
  • 5+ years of TV news writing experience in a network or major-market newsroom.
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Write in accordance with AP Style.
  • Well-developed news judgment and passion for current events. 
  • Ability to work under deadline pressure and adapt quickly. 
  • Experience with newsroom computer systems (ENPS, iNews, Slack). 
  • Exemplary collaboration and communication skills. 
  • Flexible schedule, including regular weekday and weekend hours, and as news demands. 
  • Ability to work on-site at our NY Broadcast Center.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Broadcast news writing. 
  • Factchecking and research.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

Does the task of optimizing the revenue potential of one of the largest media organizations in the world excite you? Do you possess the self-belief to make hard decisions? If so, please consider applying for the Yield Manager position in Paramount’s Yield Management group. The goal of the Yield group is simple: grow revenue not simply by selling more, but rather by selling more productively. The Yield Team reports into the Head of Programmatic and Yield.   Yield brings analyses and insights to people at all levels of the Paramount organization, but its core responsibilities revolve around how inventory is measured, packaged, and priced. The Yield team helps the sales team shape individual proposals and keeps track of how those proposals collectively consume inventory. Every month this translates into an inventory puzzle with billions of individual pieces, and by guiding how these pieces are assembled, the Yield team contributes to the overall revenue growth of Paramount.   To the applicant, the role offers the following: The Yield Manager works with a diverse group within the company and has the opportunity to work on projects that cross departments and functions. Yield Managers are relied on as subject matter experts, and contribute to projects with significant visibility.  

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Help shape sales proposals by providing input on product mix, inventory availability, and pricing.
  • Monitor and optimize active campaigns.
  • Provide ad hoc reporting to senior management. This involves writing SQL queries for large data sets to identify business critical KPIs and building reports and dashboards directly from the data warehouse.
  • Work with client services, integrated marketing, and ad operations to inform product strategy.
  • Streamline business processes to mitigate problems that lead to revenue losses.
  • Develop go-to-market pricing and inventory strategy for tentpoles such as March Madness, VMAs, Grammy’s, Paramount+ Originals and many others.
  • Stay informed of marketplace trends (streaming, DTC, measurement, CCPA) and apply learnings to strategy for emerging lines of business
  • Involvement in Paramount vast array of products - Paramount+, Pluto, CBS News Digital, Sports HQ, and ETLive
  • Develop new and effective ways to monitor and report on highly complex digital media inventory.
  • Test and implement creative strategies to optimize the performance of client-specific campaigns.
  • Dive deep into our data to discover potential revenue opportunities, diagnose revenue-impacting issues and provide recommendations to senior leaders.
  • Partner with teams across the company to provide analysis that will impact the way our key brands look, function, and generate revenue.
  • Build, maintain and enhance our ad sales financial models as our business evolves.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 2+ years related work experience. Extraordinary candidates with less experience will be considered.
  • BS/BA degree in a quantitative/problem solving field, or equivalent training and experience

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Solid Excel/Google Sheets & PowerPoint/Google Slides skills
  • SQL experience
  • Experience with DoubleClick/GAM, YieldEx, Operative, Omniture, Google Analytics, Freewheel, Data Studio, Tableau, Nielsen, or Comscore
  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • The ability to collaborate successfully within the Yield Team as well as engage seamlessly with stakeholders across all of Paramount is essential to success
  • Candidates should display both a natural curiosity and a talent for finding the signal through the noise

Position Overview

PBS Business Intelligence supports the mission of PBS and its member stations by providing insight into audience and member behavior and the trends that inform decision-making across the organization. The Manager, Audience Insights is a research generalist supporting PBS’s general audience content and marketing teams. The role conducts primary research — qualitative and quantitative — into attitudes toward public television, motivations to donate, and perceptions of the PBS brand, and pairs that work with analysis of Nielsen, Google Analytics, and syndicated sources to build a complete picture of audience behavior across platforms. The Manager works independently on most assignments and is the person stakeholders come to with a question about the audience.

will include, but are not limited to: Primary Research Design, program, and field primary research studies — surveys, focus groups, discussion guides, and other qualitative and quantitative instruments — in partnership with internal clients across corporate areas. Advise colleagues across PBS on research needs, recommending the methodology, instrument, or data source that actually answers the question at hand. Run day-to-day execution with research vendors on assigned studies, escalating scope, contract, and budget matters to the Senior Director. Data Analysis & Reporting Analyze and report on Nielsen national and local data, Google Analytics, and syndicated sources such as MRI and YouGov to build an understanding of audience behavior, attitudes, and PBS’s position in the marketplace. job.title: Sr. Director, Data Strategy & Operations
job.description:
Position Title: Sr. Director, Data Strategy & Operations Department: Business Intelligence Group Corporate Area: Digital & Marketing Status: Regular, Full time Exempt Manager Title: VP, Business Intelligence

Position Overview

The Sr. Director, Data Strategy & Operations leads the data function within PBS Business Intelligence, owning how PBS collects, governs, and delivers audience and content performance data. The role directs Nielsen Operations, digital analytics implementation, and the Domo business intelligence platform, ensuring that internal stakeholders, member stations, and producers work from data that is accurate, consistent, and available when they need it. The Sr. Director is the technical counterpart to the Senior Director, Audience Insights & Analytics, and represents Business Intelligence in enterprise-wide data initiatives.

Key responsibilities

will include, but are not limited to: Data Strategy & Governance Own the data strategy and roadmap for Business Intelligence, setting priorities for collection, architecture, and delivery that scale with PBS’s needs. Establish and maintain the governance framework — metric definitions, data lineage, quality standards, and stewardship — so that PBS and member stations measure performance consistently. Ensure data collection and use meet privacy obligations, including regulations governing consumer data and data about children and families. Represent Business Intelligence in enterprise data initiatives, translating business needs into technical requirements with PBS technology teams. Measurement Operations Serve as PBS’s internal authority on measurement systems and implementation, from Nielsen operations to the adoption of next-generation measurement as it becomes available. Direct Google Analytics implementation across PBS.org, PBSKIDS.org, and mobile and OTT apps, including tagging, data layer, and reporting configuration, so digital measurement is complete and trustworthy. Own the Domo platform and the analytics data models built on it, partnering with PBS technology teams on upstream ingestion and infrastructure. Manage relationships, contracts, and service levels with measurement and platform vendors, including Nielsen, Comscore, Google, and Domo. Data Products & Distribution Lead development of the data products and dashboards that put content performance data in the hands of internal stakeholders, member stations, and producers. Drive adoption through stakeholder engagement, training, documentation, and process change where needed — measuring success by use, not by delivery. Partner with the Audience Insights & Analytics team to ensure the data foundation supports the analysis and recommendations that team delivers. Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop the Nielsen Operations, Digital Analytics, and Data Distribution teams, setting priorities and standards for data quality and operational reliability. Build a team culture in which analysts raise data quality concerns early and document their work for others to use. undefined Requirements for success: Required 10+ years in data strategy, data operations, or analytics engineering within a complex organization, including work that directly supported senior management decisions. 5+ years leading and developing a technical or operations team.

Experience

owning a business intelligence platform — Domo, Tableau, Power BI, or comparable — and the data models behind it, with strong SQL skills. Hands-on

experience

with digital analytics implementation (Google Analytics 4 or comparable) and with media measurement data such as Nielsen or Comscore. Working knowledge of data governance practices and of privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and requirements governing children’s data. Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of

education

and experience, ideally including computer science, statistics, or data science coursework. Preferred

Experience

in media, public media, or another large-scale content organization. Familiarity with cloud data platforms and concepts such as data lakes, ingestion, and virtualization. Skills & Competencies: Translates between business questions and technical architecture in both directions. Builds trust in data — and repairs it quickly when the numbers are questioned. Communicates for the audience at hand — a five-minute executive brief or a working session with engineers. Brings clarity and sequencing to long-horizon technical work that stakeholders

experience

as slow. The base pay range for this position at the beginning of employment is expected to be between $145,000/year to $155,000/year. job.title: Career Consultant
job.description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The Career Consultant for this role supports South Florida Section and must reside in this section.


RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):


Service to PGA Professionals:

  • Provide insightful and meaningful career counseling and career coaching to PGA Professionals throughout their career life cycle from job search and membership to retirement.
  • Provide career services to include job search strategies, resume development, interviewing skills, offer negotiation, and exit and retirement strategies.
  • Promote the benefits and grow the utilization of PGA ExecuSearch, Job Seeker Profiles, the PGA Job Board and other employment tools across PGA platforms (e.g. - PGA.org, PGA.com, PGA member app, etc.).
  • Provide education programs to PGA Professionals through all available venues (national, sections and chapters).
  • Assist PGA Professionals in gathering and utilizing information from PGA and industry data resources.
  • Promote the benefits of the PGA Compensation Survey and other related Association surveys.
  • Promote and generate participation in PGA Player Development programs and strategies and document the value it brings to facilities and PGA Members.

Service to Employers:

  • Provide exceptional hiring services and resources, and assistance to employers to enhance relationships with industry stakeholders. Services and resources include PGA ExecuSearch, hiring process planning, resume review, interview planning, compensation and benefit packages, correspondence, and PGA preferred background check provider.
  • Provide compensation reports within department guidelines.
  • Market the value of PGA Professionals to non-PGA facilities and the industry.
  • Assist in creating awareness of PGA Player Development strategies and programming.

Service to PGA Sections:

  • Manage and maintain relationships with Section leadership, staff, and Section Education and Employment Committees.
  • Partner with Sections to develop employment strategies, and deliver employment presentations and education seminars to industry employers and organizations.
  • Support Section and Chapter membership meetings, Board meetings and special events as needed.
  • Communicate with Section Executive Directors and leadership quarterly (at a minimum) and provide golf industry updates on Employment.
  • Attend Section tournaments/events to cultivate relationships, foster goodwill, and support PGA Section staff.

Association/Departmental Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the development and improvement of PGA Career Services programs, projects, systems, publications and information.
  • Assist in the marketing and promotion of Association and PGA Career Services programs and initiatives.
  • Engage in proactive outreach and collaborate with other Career Consultants to identify candidates for available opportunities.
  • Provide support as needed to non-industry candidates and search support for nontraditional PGA Member roles such as General Managers, Golf Course Superintendents, etc.
  • Provide editorial content and articles for Section newsletters, PGA magazine, and other industry publications.

Contributions to the Game and Business of Golf:

Talent Development

  • Educate and inform the marketplace about the impact PGA Professionals have on the community, golf business, and local economy.
  • Provide field support and collaborate with PGA of America Diversity and Inclusion efforts.
  • Active participant in PGA of America recruiting efforts as needed.

Allied Associations & Partners

  • Establish effective working relationships with the Amateur body, including state and local golf associations. 
  • Engage with local chapters of GCSAA, CMAA, and NGCOA. 
  • Assist department leaders in improving working relationships with golf management companies.

Golfer Development

  • Participate in player development programs hosted by PGA Professionals, working in conjunction with fellow field staff.
  • Attend community/Section programs providing instruction or programming targeting new and existing golfers as available.

SHARED VALUES: 

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values, challenges and opportunities you are experiencing.


SUPERVISION:

No supervisory responsibilities.  


FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

No financial responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree: (B.A.) or equivalent in Business Administration, Human Resources, Professional Golf Management (Executive Management preferred) or related field.
  • Five (5) years of experience in golf operations or golf industry management/leadership.
  • Employment/club relations experience, career counseling and Human Resources management training preferred.
  • PGA Member preferred.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:


Job Knowledge/Technology: Must have knowledge of the golf industry and/or golf facility operations, employment and/or recruiting. Knowledge of the PGA of America and Section operations are preferred. Must have knowledge of managing multiple priorities, in a multi-functional work environment. Demonstrated leadership skills and a proven ability to motivate and manage professionals to achieve results. Skilled in customer service and/or sales. Must have a thorough knowledge of administrative principles and procedures with the ability to lead various projects and programs. A knowledge of the organizational functions of a business operation. Must possess a high degree of trust and confidentiality. Basic fluency in artificial intelligence (AI) tools and concepts. This includes using AI to enhance business operations and drive innovation, enabling us to better serve our Members and stakeholders. Working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs.


Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.


Ability to travel approximately 50% per year.


Deadline to apply is November 2, 2026.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

job.title: Audio/Video Intern, HQ (Spring 2027)
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking an exceptional college student or recent graduate for its Spring 2027 audio/video internship. This role offers hands-on experience in editorial production, content distribution and multimedia storytelling. You’ll work closely with producers and editors to support daily production needs while learning how a fast-paced newsroom creates and distributes journalism across platforms. 


Who You Are: 

  • You’re excited about audio, video, podcasting, or digital storytelling 
  • You enjoy both creative and technical aspects of media production 
  • You’re eager to contribute to projects from pre- to post-production 

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Support daily audio and video production workflows across the team 
  • Conduct research on various topics, individuals and current events to support show editorial process 
  • Source archival footage, soundbites, and relevant assets for audio and video 
  • Assist with clipping interviews and live events 
  • Assist with recording sessions, live transcripts and provide production support in real time 
  • Help maintain organized production files, metadata, and documentation 
  • Upload and manage content across CMS, YouTube, podcast, and social platforms

POLITICO is looking for a Business Development Associate to join our team.
