job.title: Master Control Hub Maintenance Tech
job.description:
Are you a broadcast technology expert who thrives on solving complex problems and keeping critical systems running at their best? Scripps is looking for a seasoned technical professional to join our Master Control Hub team in Indianapolis, Indiana. In this pivotal role, you'll serve as the go-to technical expert supporting Scripps television broadcasting entities across the country, leveraging deep knowledge of computers, IP networks, and master control operations to troubleshoot, diagnose, and implement solutions that keep our stations on air. The Scripps Master Control Hub is the backbone of centralized, remote control and monitoring of commercial and programming sources for Scripps stations, and your work will directly shape its performance and reliability.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Serve as liaison to the IT group for Master Control.
  • Report to the master control hub manager but consult with Scripps local station engineering directors and other senior leadership, including the senior director of Scripps engineering.
  • Install, maintain, and repair critical broadcasting components to ensure all systems are functioning at peak efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot and repair a variety of issues with broadcast and IT equipment.
  • Rely on extensive knowledge and professional discretion to perform efficiently and successfully.
  • Make recommendations for products and service enhancements.
  • Significant technical ingenuity and flexibility are expected.
  • Collaborate with technology suppliers regarding set-up, upgrades, enhancements, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Program/customize master control software functionality.
  • Track and assist master control users with desktop computer and server issues.
  • When resolving open issues, seek multiple perspectives, gather more information when necessary, close or escalate issues, and monitor resolution so that hub operation is optimized.
  • Work with the hub leadership team to address operational issues and facilitate decision-making with regard to technical matters.
  • Provide input and make recommendations to assist in disaster recovery and system planning.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • May require working overtime, holidays, and weekends with short notice when necessary.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Associate's degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Very strong analysis and problem-solving skills: The ability to assess a situation, seek multiple perspectives, gather information, and identify key issues is critically important in this role
  • Solid knowledge of computer hardware, software, LAN environment, configuration, and operation
  • A very high sense of responsibility and urgency regarding corrective action and customer service
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Composure: Demonstrated ability to multitask in a fast, deadline-driven environment, and maintain calmness and accuracy of work
  • Strong organization skills
  • Highly detail-oriented
  • Working knowledge of video servers, routing processes, and related equipment
  • Working knowledge of television RF transmitter parameters and operations
  • Good communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Working knowledge of all functions and responsibilities of television Master Control
  • This position may require working overtime, holidays, and weekends with short notice when necessary

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Indianapolis is a world-class city that punches well above its weight in sports, culture, and livability. Known as the "Racing Capital of the World," it is home to the iconic Indianapolis Motor Speedway and the legendary Indy 500, one of the most celebrated motorsports events on the planet. The city is also a major hub for professional sports, boasting the NFL's Indianapolis Colts and the NBA's Indiana Pacers, along with a well-earned reputation as one of America's premier hosts for NCAA championships, the Big Ten Championship Game, and other marquee sporting events.


Beyond the excitement of game day, Indianapolis offers a rich cultural landscape that surprises and delights. The Children's Museum of Indianapolis, the largest of its kind in the world, sits alongside gems like the Eiteljorg Museum, the Indiana State Museum, and the stunning Newfields campus, home to the Indianapolis Museum of Art and a beloved outdoor art and nature park. The city's vibrant neighborhoods, from the galleries and restaurants along Massachusetts Avenue to the eclectic energy of Fountain Square and Broad Ripple, give residents a thriving local food, arts, and nightlife scene to explore.


For outdoor enthusiasts, Indianapolis delivers with Eagle Creek Park, one of the largest municipal parks in the United States, offering boating, hiking, birdwatching, and sailing year-round. White River State Park sits right in the heart of downtown, connecting you to green space, the Indianapolis Zoo and the scenic Central Canal Walk. Add a cost of living that remains well below the national average for a major metro, and you'll quickly discover that Indianapolis is a genuinely great place to plant roots, grow a career, and enjoy everything a thriving Midwestern city has to offer.

job.title: Meteorologist (Part Time, Temporary), WMAR
job.description:
WMAR, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Baltimore, Maryland, is seeking a Part Time, Temporary Meteorologist to join our weather team. This is an exciting opportunity to deliver critical weather information to one of the Mid-Atlantic's most dynamic markets. You'll analyze meteorological data and prepare forecasts that help our community stay informed and safe, whether it's tracking severe weather or planning their week ahead.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.
  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.
  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, Radio, Internet.
  • Assist management in evaluations of potential new weather data gathering and presentation computers.
  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Report live from event sites or mobile broadcast unit.
  • May write and produce quality news and weather stories for multiple media platforms.
  • May report, write, capture visual content, edit and produce stories for multiple platforms on deadline, such as Internet and digital channels.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelors degree in Meteorology preferred
  • Generally 3+ years experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including weather and newsroom computer systems
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Knowledge of editing systems
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Baltimore, Maryland, is a vibrant city rich in history and culture, offering an exceptional quality of life on the Chesapeake Bay. Known as "Charm City," Baltimore boasts world-class attractions including the National Aquarium, historic Fort McHenry, and the iconic Inner Harbor. The city's diverse neighborhoods each have their own character, from the cobblestone streets of Fells Point to the artistic energy of Station North. Food lovers will appreciate Baltimore's famous crab cakes and thriving restaurant scene, while sports fans can cheer on the Orioles at Camden Yards or the Ravens at M&T Bank Stadium. With easy access to Washington, D.C., Philadelphia, and the beaches of the Eastern Shore, Baltimore offers the perfect blend of urban excitement and coastal living. The city's affordable cost of living compared to other major East Coast metros, combined with its strong sense of community and rich cultural heritage, makes it an ideal place to call home.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WKBW
job.description:
WKBW, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Buffalo, NY, is looking for a passionate Multimedia Journalist to join our team. In this role, you'll research, write, capture visual content, and edit stories that inform and engage our community — from the field to the digital screen. If you thrive in a fast-paced newsroom and are ready to make a real impact on the audience we serve, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration.
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Buffalo, NY, is a city with serious heart — a place where gritty determination meets genuine community pride. Situated on the eastern shore of Lake Erie in western New York, Buffalo has undergone a remarkable revitalization, with a booming culinary scene, a thriving arts community, and a waterfront that draws visitors and residents alike. The city is, of course, the birthplace of the Buffalo wing, and its food culture runs deep — from beef on weck at neighborhood taverns to sponge candy from beloved local chocolatiers. The rejuvenated Canalside district pulses with concerts, festivals, and waterfront activities year-round.


Culture runs deep in Buffalo, too. The Buffalo AKG Art Museum (formerly the Albright-Knox) is one of the oldest public art institutions in the country and houses one of the most significant modern art collections in the world. Frank Lloyd Wright's Darwin Martin House and the city's magnificent Olmsted-designed park system — one of the most intact in North America — speak to Buffalo's extraordinary architectural heritage. Shea's Performing Arts Center brings Broadway touring productions and world-class performances to a stunning Rococo Revival theater right in the heart of downtown.


And if you love sports, Buffalo is your town. The beloved Buffalo Bills (NFL) and the Buffalo Sabres (NHL) inspire some of the most passionate fan bases in professional sports. Beyond the games, outdoor adventure is always close at hand — Niagara Falls is just 20 miles away, and the surrounding region offers hiking, skiing, boating, and state parks in every season. Buffalo is a city that rewards those who put down roots, offering an affordable cost of living, a welcoming spirit, and a community proud of its comeback story.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WMAR (Annapolis/Anne Arundel County)
job.description:
WMAR, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Baltimore, MD, is looking for a passionate, versatile journalist to research, write, capture visual content, and edit compelling stories across multiple platforms. You'll be the voice for the Annapolis/Anne Arundel County community, bringing important local stories to life while connecting with the diverse audiences that make this region unique. If you thrive in fast-moving environments and love bringing important stories to life for your community, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine angle or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration.
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Baltimore is a city with deep roots and a vibrant present. Anchored by the iconic Inner Harbor, the city offers a stunning waterfront experience featuring the National Aquarium, the Maryland Science Center, and the historic USS Constellation. Just a short drive away, Fort McHenry — the birthplace of the Star-Spangled Banner — stands as a testament to the city's storied past. Historic neighborhoods like Fells Point and Federal Hill blend cobblestone charm with lively restaurants, bars, and boutiques that draw residents and visitors alike.


Baltimore is a proud sports town, home to the NFL's Baltimore Ravens and MLB's Baltimore Orioles, whose games at Oriole Park at Camden Yards — widely regarded as one of the most beautiful ballparks in the country — are a beloved community tradition. The city's food scene is legendary, anchored by the Chesapeake Bay's famous blue crabs, steamed and seasoned with Old Bay — a Maryland institution. From seafood shacks to James Beard Award-winning restaurants, the culinary landscape here is as rich and diverse as the city itself.


Beyond the food and sports, Baltimore boasts a thriving arts scene anchored by the Baltimore Museum of Art, home to the world's largest collection of Henri Matisse works, and the one-of-a-kind American Visionary Art Museum. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate Patapsco Valley State Park and the nearby Chesapeake Bay for hiking, kayaking, and sailing. And Baltimore's location is unbeatable — situated between Washington, D.C. (about 40 miles south) and Philadelphia, residents enjoy easy access to world-class destinations while calling a truly authentic, dynamic city home.

job.title: Pricing, Planning & Inventory Manager
job.description:
Are you a strategic thinker who thrives on maximizing revenue through data-driven insights? Scripps Networks is seeking a Pricing, Planning, and Inventory Manager who will lead the strategic optimization of all ad sales inventory, architect deal approval processes and systems, and drive revenue growth through advanced analytics and strategic leadership. This is your opportunity to shape business strategy at one of the nation's leading media companies.
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Lead strategic initiatives to maximize inventory value and revenue, guiding traffic, sales, and planning teams on prioritization for all revenue streams including cash, Audience Deficiency Unit (ADU), and Direct Response.
  • Collaborate on the development of and implement strategies for mitigating liability and risk, driving cross-functional alignment to ensure revenue goals and operational excellence.
  • Serve as authority on Wide Orbit Sales & P&I functionalities, setting process workflows, testing and managing Wide Orbit or other leading software solution system enhancements and documentation to drive efficiency.
  • Conceptualize advanced analytical tools and models for the sales support team, mentor Sales Assistants and Planners on inventory maximization and strategic flighting.
  • Deliver strategic insights and recommendations to senior management based on comprehensive analysis (inventory, Direct Response (DR) rates, liability, etc.) to shape revenue forecasting, pricing, and long-term budgeting strategies.
  • Build and oversee the creation, compilation, and dissemination of all Sales rate cards and associated analysis.
  • Manage post-analysis reports Management Science Associates, Inc. (MSA).
  • Participate in training and development for sales assistants and planners, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of analytical excellence.
  • Identify revenue optimization opportunities, presenting business cases to leadership and directing their implementation.
     

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 8+ years of experience in related field preferred
     

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Deep understanding of advertising and media sales industry, specifically linear TV media planning and inventory management
  • Advanced Excel proficiency and experience with Ad Sales systems
  • Experience working with sales teams and cross-functional partners
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Detail oriented with ability to meet deadlines
     

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


New York City is the epicenter of media, culture, and innovation. As the nation's largest city, NYC offers unparalleled professional opportunities alongside world-class dining, arts, entertainment, and nightlife. From Broadway shows to cutting-edge museums, iconic landmarks to hidden neighborhood gems, the city provides endless ways to explore and be inspired.


The five boroughs offer diverse communities and lifestyles, whether you prefer the energy of Manhattan, the creative spirit of Brooklyn, the cultural richness of Queens, the green spaces of the Bronx, or the waterfront charm of Staten Island. With an extensive public transportation system, you can navigate the city without a car while enjoying access to beaches, parks, and weekend getaways to the Hamptons, Hudson Valley, or beyond.


New York City is where ambitious professionals come to make their mark, surrounded by the best talent in every industry and a vibrant community that never stops moving forward.

job.title: Senior Counsel, Regulatory Affairs & Corp Transactions
job.description:
The E.W. Scripps Company is seeking a Senior Counsel, Regulatory Affairs & Corporate Transactions to provide legal counsel on matters related to the distribution of the Company’s local stations, networks, and programming across multiple platforms, including over-the-air, MVPD, streaming, and digital.


This role will structure, negotiate, and draft a variety of commercial agreements; prepare regulatory filings; and oversee compliance with FCC regulations in partnership with internal teams. The Senior Counsel will also support the Company’s mergers and acquisitions activity and advise business leaders on regulatory and transactional matters, with a focus on operational effectiveness, risk management, and alignment across the enterprise.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Advise on regulatory and contractual rights, obligations, most-favored-nation provisions, and transactional standards related to retransmission consent, network, and program distribution.
  • Draft offers and contracts based on approved deal terms; coordinate with Distribution in negotiations.
  • Review and negotiate inbound contract requests from outside parties, including retransmission consent, network distribution, non-disclosure, master services, and related agreements.
  • Create new contract forms as needed to accommodate evolving business models.
  • Evaluate standard terms and template agreements to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
  • Coordinate with business units to manage deal flow and contract execution.
  • Manage outside counsel when appropriate and oversee contract management system.
  • Monitor FCC regulatory requirements and compliance obligations relevant to the Company’s operations.
  • Draft and coordinate FCC compliance materials in collaboration with internal teams.
  • Work closely with the VP of Government Affairs on compliance-related matters, with advocacy retained by that office.
  • Assist, as needed, with preparation and submission of monthly, quarterly, and annual FCC filings and reports.
  • Maintain accurate compliance records and ensure timely submission of required reports to federal agencies.
  • Provide guidance to internal stakeholders to uphold compliance standards across business units.
  • Support Company M&A activity, i.e., securing regulatory approvals.
  • Prepare required regulatory filings and notices including but not limited to FCC license transfer applications (incl. waiver requests).
  • Coordinate with Company’s corporate development and M&A counsel on strategy regarding regulatory approval.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school and active license to practice law in good standing with at least one state bar: OH, NY, NJ, or GA preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience at a law firm, as a house counsel in technology, regulatory, or intellectual property law, and/or in a business role focusing on program licensing and distribution

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Strong contract drafting skills with experience in licensing, production, and local media distribution
  • Familiarity with FCC regulations applicable to broadcast and digital platforms
  • Accuracy and disciplined approach to compliance and risk management
  • Skilled in counseling creative and business partners, balancing legal and business considerations
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Proficiency with Word, Excel, and related tools
  • Demonstrated experience in federal regulatory compliance requirements, including FCC rules and reporting processes
  • Demonstrated experience in retransmission consent, corporate governance processes, and related compliance requirements

job.title: Audience Booker - Private Roundtables (Contract)
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About this Role

Semafor is seeking an experienced Contract Audience Booker to lead audience curation, recruitment, and booking for a portfolio of invitation-only executive roundtables.

This role requires a combination of editorial judgment, audience development expertise, and strong operational discipline. The successful candidate will be responsible for assembling high-quality, relevant groups of senior executives aligned with each roundtable's editorial theme and the objectives of its underwriting partner.

The role requires independent ownership of the booking process, close cross-functional coordination, and the ability to deliver a carefully curated audience against defined participation targets.

Key Responsibilities

Audience Strategy & Curation

  • Develop targeted invitation lists for private executive roundtables based on editorial themes, audience briefs, and partner objectives.
  • Identify and prioritize relevant senior executives, decision-makers, and industry leaders.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to ensure the proposed audience meets both editorial standards and partner expectations.
  • Maintain a balanced, high-quality audience mix that supports meaningful discussion and engagement.

Audience Recruitment & Booking

  • Own the invitation and booking process from initial outreach through confirmed attendance.
  • Draft and execute personalized invitations and follow-up communications.
  • Track outreach, responses, confirmed attendees, and declines, maintaining accurate booking records.
  • Proactively manage the recruitment pipeline to meet audience targets and address gaps in representation.
  • Manage substitutions, cancellations, and last-minute changes.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as a key audience contact for internal editorial, events, and partner management teams.
  • Work closely with Partner Management Leads to understand partner priorities, provide booking updates, and manage expectations.
  • Maintain clear, timely communication on booking progress, audience composition, and potential challenges.
  • Ensure all stakeholders have accurate and up-to-date information ahead of each event.

Event Readiness & On-Site Handoff

  • Prepare and finalize attendee lists, briefing documents, and relevant participant information.
  • Coordinate with event operations teams on check-in, seating, and attendee management requirements.
  • Ensure a clear and accurate handoff to on-site teams, including last-minute updates and special considerations.
  • Support final attendance reconciliation and post-event reporting.

What makes you qualified

  • Demonstrated experience in senior-level audience recruitment, executive event booking, or high-touch invitation-only events.
  • Strong research skills and sound judgment in identifying relevant executives and organizations.
  • Excellent written communication and professional outreach skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple booking pipelines and deadlines.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience working across editorial, commercial, and events teams.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain tight operational processes.
  • Comfort engaging with senior executives and their offices.

Additional Job Details

This position is ideally based out of either our New York, NY or Washington, DC or Fully Remote.


Salary Range: $1,700 per week flat project rate. 

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

job.title: Audience Development - Events (Contract)
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About this Role 

Semafor is seeking an experienced Contract Audience Developer to support audience development and event execution for Semafor World Economy, our flagship global convening in Washington, D.C.

This role will take end-to-end responsibility for audience development across assigned events and programming, from initial audience strategy and list building through invitations, registration, attendee communications, and on-site readiness.

The successful candidate will combine strong audience judgment with hands-on operational capabilities, ensuring that each event attracts the right mix of attendees, meets its participation targets, and delivers a seamless attendee experience.

Key Responsibilities

Audience Strategy & Curation

  • Develop and execute audience acquisition plans for assigned Semafor World Economy events.
  • Build and curate targeted invitation lists using Semafor's internal databases and other relevant sources.
  • Translate event briefs into clear audience criteria, including seniority, industry, organizational relevance, and desired audience composition.

job.title: Manager, Direct to Consumer Operations- MNRK (NYC or Nashville)
job.description:
MNRK Music Group is looking for a Manager, Direct to Consumer Operations to join our team. Reporting to the VP, Direct to Consumer, this role leads the management and optimization of MNRK's direct-to-consumer business across e-commerce storefronts, product launches, merchandising, inventory, and fulfillment operations.


The ideal candidate combines strong e-commerce expertise with operational excellence, using data-driven insights to enhance customer experience, drive revenue growth, and support successful physical and digital product releases. As a key cross-functional partner, this individual will collaborate with marketing, retail, production, and external vendors to deliver a seamless consumer journey from product launch through delivery. The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing strategy and execution while helping shape the continued growth of MNRK's direct-to-consumer business and fan experience. Candidates should be based in either New York or Tennessee; consideration will also be given to highly qualified candidates outside of these areas.

 


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Own and optimize the direct-to-consumer storefront experience across e-commerce platforms, marketplaces, and social commerce channels, ensuring a seamless customer journey and strong conversion performance.
  • Manage digital merchandising, product catalog updates, pricing, promotions, and launch execution to maximize visibility, engagement, and revenue.
  • Monitor storefront performance and customer behavior, leveraging analytics, testing, and reporting to identify opportunities for optimization and growth.
  • Partner with marketing teams to support email, retention, paid media, and promotional initiatives that drive traffic and sales across DTC channels.
  • Lead inventory planning and coordination with fulfillment partners, ensuring product availability, accurate inventory visibility, and efficient order fulfillment.
  • Oversee physical product operations for vinyl, CDs, and other formats by coordinating production timelines, vendor relationships, and release schedules in partnership with internal stakeholders and external manufacturing partners.
  • Partner cross-functionally with marketing, retail, finance, operations, and external vendors to execute product launches, improve operational processes, and support continued growth of the DTC business.


What Makes You Qualified:

  • 5+ years of experience in direct-to-consumer operations, e-commerce, digital merchandising, or related functions, preferably within music, entertainment, media, or consumer products.
  • Proven experience managing e-commerce storefronts, product launches, merchandising, and customer experience initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using performance data and reporting tools to drive business decisions and revenue growth.
  • Experience with Shopify, Shopify Plus, or similar e-commerce platforms, including marketplace and fulfillment integrations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and product launches simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, operations, finance, retail, and external vendor partners.
  • Knowledge of inventory planning, fulfillment operations, and physical product supply chains.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


What Would Be Music to Our Ears:

  • Music industry, entertainment, or media experience.
  • Experience with Klaviyo or similar CRM and retention marketing platforms.
  • Familiarity with paid media channels, including Meta and Google.
  • Knowledge of physical music production, distribution, and fulfillment processes.
  • Experience with Luminate reporting, chart strategy, or related music industry tools.
  • Passion for physical music and the independent music landscape.



MNRK Music is a global music company that includes several historic and groundbreaking record labels including Dualtone Records, Last Gang Records, and deep catalog repertoire. We are committed to fostering creativity, diversity, and innovation in the music industry.


This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our New York City or Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

job.title: AI Solutions Engineer
job.description:
The AI Solutions Engineer is a key role within the AI team that partners with business teams to turn real operational challenges into practical AI-enabled solutions. This person combines strong business curiosity, consultative problem-solving, and hands-on AI capability in designing, building, testing, and improving sophisticated AI agents and workflows.

They will help teams identify where AI can create meaningful value, translate needs into clear solution designs, and build usable prototypes and production-ready solutions in collaboration with business stakeholders and technical partners.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the business

  • Partner with business units to understand their goals, processes, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Participate in discovery sessions that translate ambiguous business problems into well-defined AI solution requirements.
  • Collaborate with the broader AI team to shape solution designs, provide practical feedback on feasibility and user needs, and help prioritize the AI opportunity pipeline based on business value, complexity, risk, and strategic alignment.
  • Work with data, technology, security, legal, and risk partners to ensure solutions are reliable, responsible, and appropriate for the business context.

Build and integrate

  • Design, build, and iterate AI agents, copilots, automations, and workflow integrations using modern AI platforms and tools.
  • Develop agent instructions, tools, knowledge sources, guardrails, and human-review workflows.
  • Create prototypes that demonstrate value quickly, then help evolve successful concepts into durable solutions.

Test and improve

  • Define success metrics and evaluation approaches before build, so each solution has a clear bar for what good looks like.
  • Test AI solutions for accuracy, usefulness, safety, consistency, and user experience; continuously improve them based on feedback and performance data.
  • Monitor solutions in production for adoption and accuracy drift; retire or rework anything that no longer meets its success bar.

Enable and share

  • Explain AI capabilities, limitations, tradeoffs, and recommended practices in clear, non-technical language.
  • Build adoption through training, documentation, office hours, and hands-on support for business users.
  • Stay current on AI tools, agent patterns, governance practices, and emerging opportunities; bring relevant ideas back to the organization.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building AI agents, copilots, or automations using generative AI platforms, APIs, low-code tools, or development frameworks, including work with structured and unstructured data, knowledge bases, and retrieval-augmented generation.
  • 5-7+ years experience solving business problems through process improvement, consulting, business analysis, operations, or a similar role, with demonstrated ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and build trust across business functions
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents, copilots, or automations using generative AI platforms, APIs, low-code tools, or development frameworks, including work with structured and unstructured data, knowledge bases, and retrieval-augmented generation.
  • Experience solving business problems through process improvement, consulting, business analysis, operations, or a similar role, with demonstrated ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and build trust across business functions.
  • Basic programming or scripting capability, such as Python, JavaScript, SQL, or API integration, with experience in workflow automation, systems integration, or service design.
  • Experience evaluating AI systems (test cases, quality measurement, prompt iteration, monitoring) and applying responsible AI practices (privacy, security, model risk, change management).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make technical topics understandable and actionable.
  • Sound judgment about when AI is appropriate versus a simpler solution, and comfort experimenting, learning quickly, and moving concepts to usable solutions.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to translate business requirements into solution designs, user journeys, and measurable success criteria.
  • Product management experience, including working with product roadmaps and stakeholder prioritization.
  • Media or broadcast industry experience, including familiarity with newsroom, sales, or traffic operations, or systems such as WideOrbit or OSI.
  • Experience with modern agent frameworks and evaluation tooling, such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Model Context Protocol, LangSmith, or Braintrust.
  • Data analysis and enterprise data platform experience, such as Snowflake, Power BI, or dbt, and SQL beyond basics.
  • Prior experience on an internal AI enablement, digital transformation, or innovation team.

 

What Success Looks Like

The AI Solutions Engineer is a constructive, trusted contributor to the broader AI team, bringing business-unit insight into solution design and helping the organization focus its AI investment on the highest-value opportunities. Within the first year, the AI Solutions Engineer will have delivered several solutions that improve productivity, quality, speed, or customer and employee experience. They will be known as a practical business partner who can turn AI potential into responsible, measurable results.

Core Competencies

  • Business problem framing
  • Consultative stakeholder partnership
  • AI agent and workflow design
  • Rapid prototyping and iterative delivery
  • Clear communication and enablement
  • Responsible AI judgment
  • Analytical thinking and prioritization
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and ownership

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $140,000 to $175,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Audience Engagement and Community Activation Manager, Criminally Obsessed
job.description:
Criminally Obsessed is Sinclair’s always-on true crime brand. By aggregating the depth of our local stations’ reporting from the crime scene to the courtroom under one umbrella we have created a gathering spot for more than 2 million passionate fans of the genre and are growing every day. With a dynamic mix of short-form social posts, trial livestreams, topical podcasts, and narrative documentaries we are delivering a steady stream of scroll stopping content to our followers every day and are looking for someone to join our team who can engage with fandom in a meaningful way both online and in real life. The ideal candidate is passionate about true crime, has experience leading community management for editorial brands or fan based communities, is ahead of the curve on internet culture and social media trends, and is an excellent communicator who understands brand voice.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Audience Engagement (60%)

  • Manage day-to-day audience engagement and moderation of comment sections, live chats and direct messages across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Snapchat and Threads, using sound editorial judgment when navigating sensitive conversations.
  • Represent Criminally Obsessed within relevant online communities, including Reddit and Facebook groups.
  • Stay on top of trending true crime stories to effectively engage with our audience.
  • Develop and publish daily audience questions and prompts to help foster a sense of community.
  • Manage scheduling and publishing of content being released after standard East Coast office hours
  • Share actionable insights from our audience engagements with the Criminally Obsessed leadership team to help inform content and publishing strategy.

 

Publicity and Marketing (15%)

  • Identify creator collaborations, conduct press outreach, and build relationships that expand Criminally Obsessed’s reach.
  • Identify and coordinate strategic awards submissions for our documentaries, podcasts and overall brand.
  • Track earned media for the brand to measure effectiveness of promotion efforts.


Events and Activations (15%)

  • Develop and execute promotional campaigns for tentpole content, including original documentaries and exclusive interviews, to increase viewership and engagement.
  • Collaborate on the development of programming and creative for live events and other audience activations, coordinating with marketing, editorial, sales and external partners to drive attendance, participation and merchandise sales.
  • Represent Criminally Obsessed at live events.


Competitive Analysis (10%)

  • Track relevant creators, podcasts, media outlets and social accounts to understand what interests the broader true crime community.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in social media community management, preferably with an editorial brand or media organization operating on a high-volume daily publishing schedule.
  • Excellent writing and communication skills, with a clear understanding of brand voice.
  • Strong knowledge of and connections within the true crime media landscape.
  • Proficiency with social media management tools such as Hootsuite or Sprout Social, as well as media monitoring platforms such as Meltwater/
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally for events throughout the year.
  • Experience with media outreach and creator partnerships is a plus.
  • Experience in event planning, marketing, public relations and/or creator partnerships is a plus.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $81,750 to $109,000. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary quarterly bonus, which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Broadcast Engineer
job.description:
WLFL/WRDC is looking for a full-time Broadcast Engineer! This individual will be responsible for installing and maintaining video, audio, and other equipment associated with television broadcasting. This includes server-based record and play-out systems, non-linear editors, master control, production, and routing switchers, Satellite IRDs, encoders, automation, data networks, and broadcast transmission equipment. 

Job responsibilities will include:

  • Maintenance and repair of transmitters (UHF TV, Microwave, Fiber, satellite, etc.), receivers, cameras, switchers, graphic systems, audio equipment, video tape systems, routers, automation/editing systems, intercoms, two-way radios, monitors, and display systems
  • Provide technical and operational support to users
  • Consult and communicate with engineering management and other engineers on technical issues as required
  • Provide specific engineering signal flow diagrams for CAD documentation on all work performed on technical systems
  • Perform all technical work to engineering standards and practices
     

What skills do you need to be successful in our role?

  • Solid understanding of core hardware, computer systems, electrical and electronic systems
  • Ability to read and understand electronic schematics, system diagrams, and follow written troubleshooting instructions
  • Experience working with RF equipment: UHF high power and microwave
  • Self-motivated and the ability to work efficiently without direct supervision
  • Confidence in troubleshooting problems and effectively communicating solutions to the engineering team
  • Hold a valid driver's license
  • Must be capable of taking on-call duties in rotation with the rest of the engineering department
  • Ability to work on ladders, stand for long periods of time, and lift equipment up to 50 lbs.

job.title: Client Marketing Manager
job.description:
We are seeking a Client Marketing Manager who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and can drive strategy while managing revenue-focused marketing initiatives. This role will serve as a key liaison between Tennis Channel and the National Sales team, ensuring seamless communication and execution across sponsored content, branded integrations, and client deliverables. The ideal candidate brings experience supporting end-to-end sales marketing programs, developing compelling storytelling and brand solutions, and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver polished, high-value client experiences. This role is based in our New York, NY office with a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales leaders to develop strategic sales packages, custom sponsorship opportunities, RFP responses, and integrated marketing solutions that support revenue growth.
  • Serve as a liaison between Tennis Channel and the National Sales team to ensure alignment on sponsored content, integrations, and executional needs.
  • Manage sponsorship documentation and sold-elements trackers, ensuring accurate alignment of client commitments, deliverables, timelines, and executional details across teams.
  • Collaborate with Sales and internal teams to create compelling storylines and packages that showcase the value of programming.
  • Attend client meetings with Sales leaders to build strong client relationships and collaborate on partnership ideas, sponsorship opportunities, and future revenue-driving solutions.
  • Support the development of sold integrations, including writing scripts, editing copy, creating lower-third verbiage, and developing production-aligned deliverables.
  • Manage post-sale reporting, recap decks, and client-facing materials to ensure strong communication and visibility into campaign performance.
  • Assist with branded content shoots and post-sale activations in partnership with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Oversee premium inventory, design, delivery, and fulfillment for national sales initiatives.
  • Support hospitality execution for key tentpole events, including onsite client experience management during the US Open.
  • Support corporate special projects and B2B initiatives that advance brand positioning and revenue goals.
  • Partner with the creative team to develop polished sales materials and maintain strong brand consistency across deliverables.
  • Provide guidance, training, and support to junior teammates as needed.
     

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in digital media, sports marketing, or sales marketing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field.
  • Interest in or working knowledge of professional Tennis.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft persuasive sports narratives.
  • Experience creating sales materials, branded content, and client-facing presentations.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint and related design tools; Excel proficiency required.
  • Strong understanding of the sports industry, sponsorship, or partnership development preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate across teams, and support high-visibility events.
  • AI proficiency or foundational understanding preferred.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $66,500 to $71,750. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary quarterly bonus, which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. job.title: Client Services Senior Content Creator
job.description:
Are you an experienced creative storyteller who can lead high-quality production from idea through final delivery? Do you strive for “Excellence in Everything” while helping shape stronger creative, support teammates, and keep production moving?

Join Sinclair, Inc. and the Agile Creative Content Engagement Team (ACCET) as a Senior Content Creator based in our Pittsburgh, PA TV station group. This senior hands-on production role is focused on writing, producing, shooting, editing, and delivering high-impact creative content across multiple markets and platforms.

As a Senior Content Creator, you will own complex client, market, regional, and national creative projects while helping guide creative execution, strengthen production quality, and support the development of other Content Creators. This role is ideal for someone with strong production judgment, advanced hands-on skills, and the ability to lead by example without losing connection to the work.

This is a senior creative role for someone who can step into the most important projects, shape scripts and concepts, produce shoots, solve edits, protect quality standards, and help bring priority work across the finish line.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As an ACCET Senior Content Creator, you will create and help lead commercial, branded, digital, promotional, and multi-platform content for assigned markets while supporting strong creative quality, clear communication, and reliable delivery.

Lead High-Quality Creative Production

  • Write, produce, shoot, edit, and deliver commercial spots, branded content, digital campaigns, promotional creative, and other client deliverables.

  • Own high-profile, complex, or priority projects from concept through final delivery, including scripting, pre-production, field production, editing, graphics, audio, revisions, approvals, and exports.

  • Develop creative that is clear, compelling, strategically aligned, and appropriate for the audience, platform, client, and market need.

  • Maintain high standards for storytelling, visual quality, brand consistency, pacing, sound, graphics, and overall production value.

  • Use strong creative judgment to solve production challenges, improve creative outcomes, and protect the quality of the final product.

 

Support Market, Regional, and National Production Needs

  • Produce creative work for multiple assigned markets while balancing deadlines, priorities, revisions, and client expectations.

  • Support high-profile, priority, multi-market, regional, or national productions as business needs require.

  • Coordinate production details with Client Services Managers, Strategists, Project Managers, Sales teams, clients, and market stakeholders.

  • Help keep production moving during urgent deadlines, high-volume periods, priority campaigns, or complex client deliverables.

  • Adapt quickly to changing production needs, shifting priorities, production constraints, and time-sensitive requests.

 

Provide Creative Leadership and Team Support

  • Serve as a senior creative resource for Content Creators, helping support quality, clarity, creative direction, and production problem-solving.

  • Provide constructive feedback, practical guidance, and creative support to help teammates strengthen scripts, shoots, edits, graphics, audio, and final delivery.

  • Mentor and support Content Creators through knowledge sharing, production best practices, and feedback that helps raise the overall quality of the team.

  • Help translate client, Sales, and market needs into clear creative direction that can be executed effectively.

  • Model strong professionalism, accountability, collaboration, and creative ownership across ACCET.

 

Collaborate Across Teams and Maintain Workflow Standards

  • Partner with Sales, Client Services, Brand, Digital, Project Managers, and market leadership to understand goals and expectations.

  • Participate in creative discussions, campaign planning, production conversations, and feedback exchanges as needed.

  • Communicate clearly about project status, creative needs, production challenges, asset requirements, and delivery timelines.

  • Use Adobe Workfront and other Sinclair systems to track assignments, respond to requests, update project status, and support workflow accuracy.

  • Follow ACCET production standards, file management expectations, brand guidelines, quality-control steps, and approval processes.

 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE SPECIAL

  • A senior hands-on creative role with impact across multiple television markets.

  • Opportunity to lead and produce high-profile commercial, branded, digital, and promotional content.

  • A chance to support local, regional, and national creative work inside ACCET.

  • A role that combines advanced production skill with mentorship, creative judgment, and team support.

  • A fast-moving environment where storytelling, craft, collaboration, problem-solving, and creative ownership matter.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Advanced writing, producing, shooting, editing, storytelling, communication, and organizational skills.

  • 3+ years of experience in commercial production, broadcast television, creative services, video production, post-production, digital content, agency work, or a related field preferred.

  • Experience with cameras and understanding of lighting set-ups

  • Ability to independently lead polished commercial, branded, digital, or promotional content from concept through delivery.

  • Strong understanding of video production workflows, including concept development, scripting, shooting, editing, graphics, audio, client approvals, revisions, and final export.

  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro; experience with After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Audition, or similar tools is a plus.

  • Familiarity with digital video, social media content, OTT/CTV advertising, branded content, and multi-platform campaign production preferred.

  • Experience providing creative feedback, mentoring teammates, or helping guide production quality is preferred.

  • Comfort working in project management systems; Adobe Workfront experience is a plus.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to lift, carry, and move production equipment as needed; valid driver license and good driving record may be required for production-related needs.

  • A proactive mindset focused on creativity, collaboration, accountability, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

 

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF

  • You are an experienced creator who wants to lead by example while still staying hands-on in the work.

  • You can write, shoot, produce, edit, shape creative, and solve production challenges at a high level.

  • You enjoy helping teammates grow while maintaining strong standards for creative quality and delivery.

  • You can manage several projects at once while keeping priorities clear, quality high, and deadlines on track.

  • You communicate clearly, take feedback well, and work effectively with creative, Sales, client, and leadership partners.

  • You want to help ACCET deliver meaningful, high-quality creative work across multiple markets and platforms.

 

WORKING HOURS AND TRAVEL

  • Typical schedule is Monday to Friday during standard business hours.

  • Schedule flexibility may be required based on production needs, client deliverables, station events, regional or national productions, or other time-sensitive projects.

  • Some longer days, nights, weekends, or holidays may be required based on business needs.

  • Travel may be required but is expected to be infrequent.

 

If you are ready to lead high-quality creative execution, stay hands-on in the production process, support a strong creative team, and help ACCET deliver impactful work across multiple markets, we want to hear from you.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

We’re a fast-moving, idea-sparking, deadline-crushing content team embedded inside one of the most dynamic entertainment companies in the country. On the Agile Content Creation Engagement Team (ACCET), we develop branded content, commercial creative, and social-first video that connects — emotionally and instantly. We are looking for a Content Creator to join our group!

Our mission? Bring bold ideas to life across every screen. Whether we’re building campaigns for clients, developing killer creative for digital platforms, or producing memorable branded moments, our content doesn’t just fill space — it makes noise.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

As a Content Creator, you’ll concept, write, shoot, and edit creative that stops thumbs, turns heads, and drives action. You’ll collaborate with a passionate crew of makers who understand that great storytelling is part emotion, part strategy, and all hustle.

 

YOUR DAILY PLAYLIST:

• Produce scroll-stopping, channel-agnostic content for TV, social, web, and wherever audiences are paying attention.

• Partner with digital strategists and creative leads to develop work that aligns with brand goals and audience needs.

• Write scripts, shoot footage, and edit everything from fast-turn social reels to longer-form branded videos.

• Work directly with internal teams and external clients to bring visions to life.

• Manage asset distribution across the network and track deliverables through Adobe Workfront.

 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE STAGE:

• A passion for visual storytelling with a marketing mindset.

• Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud — especially Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

• Camera skills and lighting savvy that make your footage shine.

• A collaborative spirit with the confidence to lead a concept or run a solo shoot.

• A portfolio that proves you can do the job — and push it further.

job.title: Content Creator - Freelance
job.description:
Our freelance Content Creator develops, produces, captures, and edits original content across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube. The role serves as the team's end-to-end creator, bringing ideas from concept to publication with speed, creativity, and a strong understanding of platform-native storytelling. The freelance Content Creator identifies content opportunities, responds to emerging trends, and produces engaging content designed to drive audience growth and engagement across channels.

The freelance Content Creator is equally comfortable creating fast-turn, mobile-first content and producing higher-polish branded, original, and tentpole projects. The role captures content using both smartphone and professional camera equipment, including DSLR and mirrorless systems, while also managing audio and production elements as needed. Working across multiple teams, the freelance Content Creator collaborates with the Senior Social Media Manager on social content initiatives and partners with the Director of Video Content on video production planning and coordination. The role works closely with the Social Media Specialist on trend-driven and user-generated content executions, the Social Graphics Content Specialist on visual packaging, the Short-Form Video Producer Lead on video development, and the on-shift coordinator to align content delivery with publishing priorities. Through strong creative instincts and hands-on production expertise, the freelance Content Creator helps deliver timely, engaging, and platform-optimized content across the brand's digital ecosystem.

This freelance role is expected to be approximately 40 hours per week, with schedules aligned to tournament coverage needs. Flexibility to work weekends may be required during key tournaments and high-volume event periods. This freelance engagement is anticipated to run through December 2026, with the potential to be extended through the end of 2027 based on business needs and performance.

This is a freelance position and onsite in Santa Monica, CA. 

In this freelance role, you will... 

Lead Content & Creative Direction  (primary lane — concept, produce, capture, edit) 

  • Concept content end-to-end across the five social platforms — trend-driven pieces, branded content, recurring serialized formats, tentpole moments, original creator concepts, and one-off campaign creative. 
  • Produce shoots from concept to set — define the shot list, coordinate talent, locations, props, and timing; manage logistics on the day. 
  • Capture content using both production modes: 
  •   • Phone-first capture — vertical video, BTS moments, court-side reactions, trend executions, fast-turn pieces. 
  •   • DSLR / mirrorless + audio capture — interviews, branded content, original series segments, higher-polish tentpole pieces. Comfortable running camera, lenses, lavalier and shotgun microphones, basic lighting. 
  • Edit captured content end-to-end — phone or CapCut for fastest-turn pieces, Premiere Pro for polished and longer-form work. 
  • Bring on-camera presence and voice-over capability where the piece calls for it. 
  • Operate under the Tennis Channel brand voice and visual standard set by the Senior Social Media Manager and the Director of Video Content; flag content-quality concerns up before publish. 

Bring Production Expertise  (what this role brings to the team) 

  • Phone-first production: fluent shooting vertical content directly on phone, with on-the-go lighting and audio when needed. 
  • DSLR / mirrorless production: owns end-to-end setup — camera body and lenses, monitor, lighting basics, lavalier and shotgun mics, on-camera and ambient audio. 
  • Audio capture: comfortable running lavs, shotguns, and USB mic setups for podcast-style or interview-style content. 
  • Self-editing in CapCut Pro (fast-turn vertical) and Premiere Pro (polished horizontal and vertical). 
  • Color and audio finishing competence for finished pieces; comfort handing off to a specialist editor when the piece warrants deeper finishing. 

Lead Campaign Execution

  • Lead end-to-end content creation for assigned tournament tentpoles, brand campaigns, sponsor activations, and serialized formats — concept, produce, capture, edit, and publish. 
  • Coordinate with the Senior Social Media Manager and Director of Video Content on which campaigns the Content Creator owns end-to-end vs. supports. 
  • Contribute the Content Creator's owned content slots to the Master Cross-Platform Content Calendar and the video team's 90-day pipeline view. 
  • Travel to select tournaments and shoots to capture on-the-ground content — typically 8-15 weeks per year on the road. 

Stay Ahead of Platform Expertise & Trends 

  • Live inside platform trend cycles on TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Instagram, and YouTube — sound choices, edit timing, format awareness, creator-economy moves. 
  • Bring concepts to the Weekly Trending Content Meeting (chaired by the Senior Social Media Manager) — daily and tournament concepts built on emerging trends — and own follow-through on what gets approved. 
  • Run a tight reactive-content loop: when a trend or moment breaks between meetings, ship a creator response fast under brand-voice guardrails. 
  • Run platform-feature tests on creator output (new format, new placement, new edit style); document what works and surface to the Senior Social Media Manager and Director of Video Content. 

Drive Strategy & Planning 

  • Maintain a 90-day forward view of creator-content opportunities aligned with the team's tournament tentpoles, brand campaigns, and serialized programming. 
  • Identify creator-content growth opportunities (new format, new on-camera concept, new platform-native execution) and bring them to the Senior Social Media Manager and Director of Video Content with a recommended action and a resource ask. 

Analyze Performance & Report Insights 

  • Surface content performance insights — which pieces performed, which formats are tired, what to test next — to the Senior Social Media Manager and Director of Video Content. 
  • Provide qualitative content read-back weekly to feed the cross-platform executive narrative. 
  • Track personal output volume and cycle time against targets set by the Senior Social Media Manager. 

Partner Cross-Functionally

  • Partner with the Senior Social Media Manager on social-side content concepting, brand voice, and the Master Cross-Platform Content Calendar. 
  • Partner with the Director of Video Content on video-pipeline coordination — when a creator piece needs production support, an editor pairing, or longer-form finish. 
  • Partner with the Social Media Specialist on UGC, trending executions, and on-the-ground tournament capture. 
  • Partner with the Social Graphics Content Specialist when a creator piece needs custom graphics (titles, lower-thirds, end cards). 
  • Partner with the Short-Form Video Producer Lead, Video Editor (short-form), and YouTube Editor when a piece needs polished editing beyond fast-turn self-edit. 
  • Coordinate with the on-shift coordinator on publish-window timing for creator-owned content. 

Key Performance Indicators 

  • Creator content output volume per tournament week and per non-tournament week. 
  • Engagement and reach on creator-owned content across the five platforms. 
  • Trend response time: trend identified to published content (target: under 24 hours, often under 6 hours during active tournaments). 
  • New creator format pilots launched per year — and percent that get repeated as serialized programming. 
  • Contribution to YoY platform growth: IG (+50%), FB (+50%), TikTok (+100%), and YouTube (+100% via Shorts and creator-led long-form). 
  • On-camera content performance vs. brand baseline (where on-camera is the format). 
  • Quality bar across creator output (qualitative review by Senior Social Media Manager and Director of Video Content). 
  • Production reliability: shoots executed on plan, deliverables hit on time, on-set issues resolved without surfacing as blockers. 

 

Key Qualifications 

  • 3-5 years as a creator in social media, brand, or creator-economy environment — ideally in sports, live events, news, or entertainment. 
  • Demonstrable portfolio across multiple platforms (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Instagram, YouTube). 
  • Hands-on capture experience with BOTH phone-first production AND DSLR / mirrorless + audio production — required, not preferred. 
  • Owned or willing-to-own production kit: camera body and lenses, lavalier and shotgun microphones, basic lighting. 
  • Self-editing fluency in CapCut Pro and Premiere Pro. 
  • On-camera and voice-over comfort. 
  • Strong concept instincts and brand-voice sensibility — able to translate a brand into native-feeling content for each platform. 
  • Comfort traveling for tournaments and shoots (8-15 weeks per year on the road). 
  • Strong organizational skills under live-event pressure and creator-cycle pace. 
  • Tennis or live sports knowledge a strong plus.

job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales and marketing strategy. Your main mission will be to amplify our market presence while ensuring we hit our ambitious sales targets. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!


o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by leading the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.


o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement innovative sales and marketing strategies that will amplify our sales performance. You'll be the mastermind behind tactics that not only meet but exceed our sales goals.


o Team Development:  Leading, mentoring, and inspiring a team of sales professionals is no small feat! Your ability to motivate and enhance their skills will be crucial in driving performance and achieving success together.


o Market Analysis: Dive deep into market trends, data, and customer needs. By understanding what drives our clients, you'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.


o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients and stakeholders is crucial. You'll be the driving force behind our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.


What We're Looking For 

o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience as a Sales Director or other sales management and leadership roles, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 


o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.


o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.


o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 


o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.


o A Willingness to Grow:  Do you thrive in unified environments? The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.


The Practical Stuff 

o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 


Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.


o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.


o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)


o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.


AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.
