job.title: Editor, Criminally Obsessed
job.description:
Criminally Obsessed is seeking a creative, story-driven Editor to produce daily true-crime news and analysis content for the Criminally Obsessed Daily Show. This role combines strong editorial judgment, advanced video editing, and a deep understanding of digital audience behavior to turn raw footage and scripts into compelling, platform-ready episodes.

The Editor partners closely with producers, talent, and the broader production team to deliver accurate, visually engaging content for video, audio, social, and broadcast platforms. The ideal candidate works quickly without sacrificing quality, understands pacing and retention, and brings strong instincts for visual storytelling.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Participate in content strategy sessions, pitch social-first true-crime ideas, and stay current on relevant cases, creators, trends, and platform updates.
  • Research assigned stories and organize editorial, archival, video, audio, and graphic assets for production.
  • Edit scripts, interviews, A-roll, B-roll, and supporting materials into polished Daily Show segments for digital, social, and broadcast platforms.
  • Shape each episode’s pacing, visual storytelling, sound, graphics, and overall flow to maximize audience engagement and retention.
  • Create motion graphics, lower thirds, full screens, thumbnails, captions, and other branded social assets using Adobe Creative Suite and related tools.
  • Review recordings and technical setups; identify, correct, or escalate video, audio, lighting, framing, and other production issues.
  • Ensure all content is accurate, properly attributed, visually consistent, and compliant with editorial, legal, and technical standards.
  • Deliver clean first cuts, incorporate feedback efficiently, and complete final episodes, time codes, uploads, and other deliverables on deadline.
  • Maintain organized project files and archives, and support sponsored, promotional, and other assigned content projects.
  • Collaborate closely with producers, talent, and production partners; communicate proactively about creative opportunities, workflow improvements, challenges, and timing.
  • Work a flexible schedule, including occasional nights, weekends, and breaking-news coverage; travel up to 10–20% and safely handle production equipment up to 25 pounds.

 

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years hands-on experience in all aspects of video production and postproduction including shooting, lighting, sound recording & editing, and ability to operate and troubleshoot all associated equipment
  • Highly skilled across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Premiere Rush, Photoshop, After Effects, etc), and other creative software
  • Strong understanding of video editing techniques and storytelling
  • Demonstrated experience in motion graphics and creating social media video content
  • Strong knowledge of YouTube and its best practices
  • Proficiency in designing graphics, including thumbnails and infographics
  • An eye for quality content, with an understanding of what plays well across various channels
  • This position requires impeccable spelling and grammar, a deep understanding of social media trends and what works on each platform, vertical video editing skills, and the ability to capture well-composed videos on a phone
  • Must be highly motivated, extremely organized, and come to the position with a uniquely creative mind
  • Flexibility to travel and work nights and/or weekends, as projects call for
  • Only applicants with portfolios, sites, or reels of their work will be considered

 

About Criminally Obsessed

Criminally Obsessed is Sinclair’s true crime media brand, and it is focused on the cases, investigations and stories that capture the public’s attention. Criminally Obsessed brings together compelling crime news and journalism, expert analysis, exclusive interviews and original storytelling and content across digital platforms.

The Criminally Obsessed Daily Show is a daily crime news and analysis program covering the biggest and most compelling criminal stories making headlines across the country. It goes beyond simply recapping the day’s news. Each episode is built around the most interesting development, question, detail or perspective surrounding a case and is led by an interview that drives the conversation. It is a vodcast and podcast, so the production team constructs each episode keeping in mind that the audience will need to be interested visually and audibly.

job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 
At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 
Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat.    Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 
o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales strategies and elevate our market presence. Your main mission will be to lead our sales team to new heights while fostering a culture of success and motivation. We believe that with the right guidance, our team can achieve remarkable results, and that's where you come in. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

o Team Leadership:  Leading a team of sales professionals is no small feat! You'll mentor and inspire them to hit and exceed their targets while cultivating a collaborative environment.
o Market Analysis: Keeping an eye on market trends and customer needs is essential. You'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.
o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients is crucial. You'll be the face of our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.
o Dynamic Oversight: You'll track sales performance metrics and provide insightful reports to senior management, helping us make data-driven decisions.
What We're Looking For 
o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience in sales management or someone fully ready to take their next career step in sales leadership, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 
o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.
o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 
o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, and make a difference.
o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in transformative environments? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.
The Practical Stuff 
o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 
Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 
o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of an agile team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.
o The Compensation Package: Enjoy a competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.
o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)
o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.
AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.       EEO AND INCLUSIVITY  Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
Sinclair’s content technology is at the core of our operational excellence. We thrive on innovation and a passion for connecting people with the best local news and sports content. As we grow our content offerings and expand our broadcast, cable, and digital distribution channels, we are embracing modern technologies to fuel that growth. We are excited by the promise of cloud-first approaches and artificial intelligence in media systems. Sinclair believes that flexibility and agility will address rapidly changing media environments and we are confident that great people and great technology equal great solutions.

The role of Master Control Operator is responsible for operating the multi-channel and multi-brand control point for Sinclair Television Stations located in Bristol, VA. Duties include, but are not limited to, Live event operations, graphics insertion, playlist manipulation, and monitoring on-air quality of the TV Station to ensure all content airs accurately and reflects the traffic and programming schedules.

Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Understand and follow standard operating procedures for various networks, including high profile live events and disaster recovery.
  • Modification and verification of playlists for current and future broadcast times.
  • Manipulate playlist for the different “join in progress” scenarios.
  • Consistently monitor on-air material and communicate any discrepancies to Managers.
  • Consistently ensure that playlist information and media content are accurate, which may include but is not limited to:
  • SOM/EOM of segments
  • Database Information
  • Audio specifications
  • Video specifications
  • Secondary events (GPI,SCTE104 and Graphic Insertion)
  • Content
  • Closed Captioning
  • Active Format Descriptor.
  • Ensure proper video routing.
  • Record, Ingest and Prepare content for playout.
  • Monitor equipment for performance / device failures.
  • Capture and document network processes such as timing of log elements, program run times and on air discrepancies.
  • Setup and review content prior to scheduled airtime.
  • Communicate effectively with Managers and Operators to ensure a smooth transition between shifts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Understand and follow departmental policies.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 1 Year experience in Master Control Operations functions.
  • Experience in Local TV Station Operations. (A PLUS)
  • Experience in Switching Live Local News and Sporting Events. (A PLUS)
  • Must have great attention to detail and ability to multitask, monitoring multiple playlists and video monitors simultaneously.
  • General understanding of industry regulations and standards for video, audio, captioning and loudness.
  • Understanding of broadcast technology such as switchers, server playout, automation systems, waveform monitors and rasterizers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, work under stress and perform as part of a team.
  • Aptitude for operating electronic equipment and the capability to learn specialized applications.
  • Experience with Systems and Hardware for Content Ingest, Playout and Distribution.
  • Knowledge of Amagi CLOUDPORT Automation system. (A PLUS)  
  • Available to work any shift in a 24/7 Operation as well as holidays and weekends.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. 

 

 

The hourly compensation range for this role is $16.75 per hour. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Assistant
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: Amplify our media sales efforts by supporting our sales operations. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!


o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression!


o Build Relationships: Connect with internal and external clients, understanding their needs to provide support. 


o Innovate and Inspire: We value creativity at all levels of our organization and encourage you to think outside the box to find new ways to support our business and elevate our brand.


o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams to ensure a top-notch customer experience. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results!


o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace.


What We're Looking For 

o Proven Business Support Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn): Whether you're a seasoned administrative or business support specialist or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.  


o Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.  


o A Passion for Helping Others: You are committed to understanding our teams' needs, providing top-notch administrative and business support, and making a difference.


o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Senior Manager, Social Media
job.description:
The Senior Social Media Manager for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and X — accountable for whether those channels hit their annual growth targets and for the quality, consistency, and premium feel of Tennis Channel's presence on them. Translates the Head of Social's overarching strategy into platform-specific organic and paid plans, content pillars, and campaign calendars; oversees content creative direction; leads campaign execution; produces the weekly and monthly executive reporting narrative; owns the community management program and UGC; and serves as the resident expert on platform changes and emerging trends. Operates in close partnership with the Director of Video Content on shared channel ownership across the cross-platform content calendar and tournament coverage. Provides the Head of Social with proactive strategic counsel on channel performance, risks, and recommended actions.

This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

In this role, you will…

Develop Strategy and Plans

  • Translate the Head of Social's overarching social strategy into platform-specific quarterly plans for IG, FB, TikTok, and X — content pillars, posting cadence, growth tactics, and organic-plus-paid mix calibrated to each platform's audience and the 2026 growth targets.
  • Own the editorial point of view across IG, FB, TikTok, and X day-to-day; partner with the Director of Video Content on shared channel ownership where formats overlap (e.g., short-form cross-publishing, IG/FB long-form pieces, tournament coverage).
  • Maintain a forward-looking 90-day view: anticipate tournament tentpoles, brand campaigns, influencer pushes, and platform tests far enough in advance that the team is briefed and resourced — not reacting.
  • Identify platform-building opportunities and bring them to the Head of Social with a recommended action and a resource ask, not just an idea.

 

Guide Content & Creative Direction

  • Oversee content production and publishing across IG, FB, TikTok, and X — uphold a premium, consistent brand voice and visual standard regardless of who in the pod is producing the post.
  • Approve daily editorial calls across the four owned channels; serve as the final voice on tone, framing, and brand fit before posts go live (with manager handling fact-check, score-accuracy, and grammar QA).
  • Partner with the Director of Video Content on cross-functional content quality — ensure short-form, highlights, and long-form pieces meet the same brand standard whether they originate in the social pod or the video pod.
  • Hold producers, editors, and coordinators to a clear content quality bar; create documentation for asset/platform creative best practices, including specific & timely feedback when output drops below it.

 

Lead Campaigns

  • Lead social campaigns from concept to execution across IG, FB, TikTok, and X — tournament tentpoles, brand pushes, sponsor activations, and platform-specific programs.
  • Own and maintain the Master Cross-Platform Content Calendar (IG, FB, TikTok, X), and partner with the Director of Video Content on the integrated view that includes YouTube and long-form.
  • Build and publish the weekly Tournament Coverage Plan T-1 week ahead of each tournament — coordinator block coverage, tentpole moments, partner deliverables, and paid flags.
  • Update and manage Weekly Coordinator Coverage Schedule — published Friday EOD for the following week. Names which coordinator is on AM, PM, and Overnight each day, with overnight rotation honored.
  • Coordinate with PR and integrated marketing to align campaign timing, messaging, and asset hand-offs.
  • Partner with the Paid Media team on day-to-day coordination: uphold the per-tournament paid strategy set by the Paid Team, surface organic posts that are strong boost candidates, and manage asset delivery to the Paid Team. 

 

Analyze Performance & Report Results

  • Author the Weekly CEO Report and Monthly Executive Report, translating engagement, reach, growth, and conversion data into an executive narrative with a clear point of view and a channel-strategy view across IG, FB, TikTok, and X (what's working, what isn't, recommended actions for the next period).
  • Use analytics inputs (native platform analytics, third-party tools) and tournament reporting as the data foundation; layer in strategic interpretation and recommended actions based on KPI metrics (audience growth, engagement volume and rates, etc.) against weekly, monthly and annual pacing targets.
  • Surface ROI-meaningful insights to leadership on a continuous basis — where to invest more, where to pull back, what to test next — and own the recommendation, not just the observation.
  • Provide the Head of Social with proactive, real-time updates on channel health, risks, and decisions as they emerge between reporting cycles.

 

Manage Community Engagement & UGC

  • Own community management as a named program — defined as proactive owned outreach to grow Tennis Channel's organic presence, not reactive comment moderation: identify trending and topical tennis-adjacent conversations across IG, FB, TikTok, and X (other brands' posts, athlete posts, fan threads, breaking-news threads, viral moments) and direct the team to jump in with on-brand commentary, replies, and quote-posts that put Tennis Channel in front of new audiences. 
  • Define the target communities and conversation types, set the voice and tone for outbound engagement, decide what counts as a high-signal opportunity to jump on, and oversee daily execution by the on-shift coordinator and the video team.
  • Monitor sentiment and audience signal across the four owned channels; flag rising issues to the Head of Social before they become crises.
  • Own the UGC sourcing program: define the rights-and-usage process, oversee the Trending Content Creator's UGC pipeline, and sign off on rights/usage approval before any UGC publishes.

 

Apply Platform Expertise & Stay Ahead of Trends

  • Act as the resident expert on IG, FB, TikTok, and X — emerging formats, algorithm shifts, native feature releases, and platform-specific best practices. Translate platform changes into actionable tactics for the team within days, not weeks.
  • Chair the Weekly Trending Content Meeting across social and video teams. The social pod and the video pod bring proposed content ideas (daily and tournament) built on the week's emerging trends. Evaluate each idea against the social strategy and brand voice, decide which to ship, assign ownership and timing, and route execution to the right pod. 
  • Oversee trend-spotting between meetings: review trends being surfaced by the broader team, decide which to lean into in real time, and route execution to the right pod.
  • Run platform-feature tests on owned channels (new format, new placement, new cadence); document what works and roll learnings into the strategy.
  • Brief the Head of Social monthly on the platform landscape — what's changing, what it means for the 2026 plan, and where to invest.

 

Lead the Team & Oversee Operations

  • Manage junior team: set clear weekly priorities, run 1:1s, give direct performance feedback, name underperformance early, and own each direct report's development plan.
  • Own the Weekly Coordinator Coverage Schedule: assign the team to blocks each week, balance tournament load, and rotate the Overnight block monthly so no coordinator is on overnights more than four consecutive weeks.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Head of Social. Provide proactive counsel on channel performance, risks, and decisions — through the weekly and monthly executive reports and in real time as situations emerge. 
  • Partner with the Head of Social on hiring across the social pod (sourcing input, interviewing, recommendations).

 

Key Qualifications:

  • 5-7 years in social media management with at least 2 years managing direct reports
  • Demonstrated track record of driving channel growth — not just running publishing operations
  • Strong analytical and writing skills — must be able to compile data from multiple sources into an executive narrative weekly with a clear point of view
  • Hands-on experience coordinating with paid social teams or agencies, and partnering with PR or influencer programs
  • Demonstrated ability to lead live crisis response on social and to manage to deadlines under live event pressure
  • Sports, live news, or entertainment social experience strongly preferred

 

Tennis Channel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Senior Producer, Editorial Video, Amazing America
job.description:
Sinclair, Inc. is seeking a highly creative and experienced Senior Producer, Editorial Video to join Amazing America, our digital-first lifestyle brand that spotlights what makes America amazing. Our mission is to celebrate our country’s unique culture, adventurous spirit, and extraordinary stories hiding in ordinary places. Through entertaining, informative, and personality-driven storytelling, we inspire audiences to explore the country, experience its traditions, and connect with the people who make it special.

As a senior member of our creative production team, this individual will play a key role in developing original editorial concepts, building repeatable content franchises, identifying and cultivating on-camera talent, and establishing a distinctive visual and storytelling style across our platforms.

This is a hands-on creative position requiring strong editorial instincts, exceptional storytelling skills, and the technical ability to execute productions from concept through delivery.

The Senior Producer will work across short-form vertical video, mid-length digital programming, and longer-form original series distributed across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and other digital platforms.

The successful candidate will understand how to balance journalistic curiosity with entertaining storytelling, creating content that is informative, visually compelling, authentic, and optimized for digital audiences.

Responsibilities

Ideation & Development

  • Develop and pitch original editorial video concepts, standalone stories, repeatable formats, and recurring series that align with Amazing America’s brand identity and audience development objectives.
  • Monitor assigned geographic markets to identify interesting events, unique destinations, regional traditions, and fascinating personalities that define our country’s culture
  • Create comprehensive pitches that clearly articulate the editorial premise, audience hook, narrative structure, visual approach, production requirements, editing strategy, and intended distribution.
  • Identify opportunities to connect individual stories to larger seasonal initiatives, editorial campaigns, and brand programming priorities.

Writing & Research

  • Lead research and story development for approved projects, ensuring accuracy, originality, and a compelling narrative approach.
  • Develop creative treatments, scripts, outlines, interview questions, and production plans for a wide range of digital video formats.
  • Source archival photographs, video footage, historical materials, and supplemental B-roll to support editorial storytelling.
  • Work collaboratively with on-camera talent to develop scripts and storytelling approaches that complement their individual personalities and presentation styles.

Production

  • Serve as lead producer and creative director for original video productions in studio and field environments.
  • Direct hosts, creators, interview subjects, and other on-camera talent to deliver authentic, engaging performances to deliver compelling, character-driven storytelling.
  • Independently shoot high-quality video using DSLR/mirrorless cameras, DJI Osmo cameras, smartphones, and other professional production equipment.
  • Manage creative decision-making during field productions, adapting to changing circumstances and recognizing opportunities for spontaneous storytelling.
  • Travel as needed to produce original content in markets throughout the United States.

Post-Production

  • Lead the editorial and creative execution of post-production, ensuring finished content meets Amazing America’s storytelling and visual standards.
  • Independently edit original video content using Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Provide creative direction, feedback, and editorial notes to internal or freelance editors when projects require additional post-production support.
  • Shape compelling narratives through pacing, interview selection, music, sound design, archival footage, graphics, and visual sequencing.
  • Utilize Adobe Photoshop and other Adobe Creative Suite applications to create or enhance graphics, static social content, and visual storytelling elements.
  • Develop platform-specific edits that reflect the distinct audience behaviors and storytelling conventions of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook.
  • Maintain consistency in visual style, tone, and production quality across Amazing America’s content portfolio.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 5-7+ years of professional experience developing, producing, shooting, and editing editorial or entertainment-focused digital video content.
  • Strong editorial judgment and an ability to identify stories and characters that resonate with digital audiences.
  • Exceptional research, writing, and narrative storytelling skills.
  • Hands-on experience directing studio and field productions.
  • Advanced proficiency operating DSLR/mirrorless cameras, DJI Osmo cameras, smartphones, and associated production equipment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Deep understanding of short-form and longer-form digital video storytelling across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple projects while meeting creative, editorial, and production deadlines.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and collaborative skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a cross-functional creative team.
  • Willingness and ability to travel for productions.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience producing lifestyle, travel, food, culture, entertainment, adventure, or human-interest programming.
  • Experience developing successful social-first content franchises and recurring editorial series.
  • Background in digital journalism, documentary production, or character-driven nonfiction storytelling.
  • Experience working across both premium digital productions and fast-turnaround social content.

job.title: Social Media Manager - Pickleball TV
job.description:
Pickleball TV is looking for a Social Media Manager to own its Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube channels, with YouTube a key priority across both long-form and Shorts. This is a hands-on role: you'll set the strategy for each platform, concept and create the content, run day-to-day publishing, and lead a production coordinator supports video edits. You'll also travel to select pickleball events to capture content on site and build relationships across the pickleball community.

This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

In this role, you will…

Develop Strategy

  • Build and own a distinct strategy for each channel — audience, content pillars, formats, cadence, and growth tactics.
  • Set quarterly plans for each platform and plan for events, programming moments, campaigns, and sponsor deliverables.
  • Identify growth opportunities, such as new series, formats, and creator collaborations, and bring recommendations to the Head of Social.
  • Track performance, report weekly and monthly to the Head of Social, and adjust based on what's working.

 

Create & Publish Content

  • Concept and create social-first content and series: player features, highlights, skills content, trends, and behind-the-scenes.
  • Shoot, write, and edit short-form video; turn Pickleball TV programming into platform-native clips.
  • Own the content calendar across all three channels and publish daily, including captions, sound, hashtags, and platform-native styling.
  • Run live publishing during key events and QA every post for accuracy and brand voice.

 

Manage & Grow YouTube

  • Own Pickleball TV's YouTube strategy across long-form and Shorts, growing subscribers, views, and watch time.
  • Concept and produce long-form YouTube content, such as event recaps, player profiles, instructional series, and behind-the-scenes features.
  • Repurpose Pickleball TV programming and match footage into long-form videos built for YouTube audiences.
  • Own packaging and optimization: titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, playlists, and upload cadence.
  • Use YouTube analytics (retention, click-through rate, traffic sources) to shape what gets made next.

 

Cover Events, Engage the Community & Stay Ahead of Trends

  • Travel to select events to plan and capture on-site content and publish from the ground.
  • Manage community engagement across all channels, including responding to comments and DMs and joining trending pickleball conversations.
  • Run UGC sourcing, including securing rights and credit.
  • Build relationships with players, creators, and event partners.
  • Stay ahead of trends and platform changes on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts, and move quickly on the right ones.

 

Lead the Team 

  • Manage and develop the production coordinator; brief and review video edits for short- and long-form content.
  • Set up workflows so editing and publishing keep moving while you're traveling.
  • Partner with the wider social, video, programming, marketing, and sales teams.

 

Key Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years in social media, ideally in sports, live events, or entertainment, with a track record of growing channels
  • A portfolio of content you've concepted and created for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
  • Strong shooting and editing skills (phone-first; CapCut, Premiere, or similar)
  • Experience growing a YouTube channel, including long-form content, packaging, and YouTube analytics
  • Experience managing or directing others, such as a coordinator, freelancers, or interns
  • Fluency with trend cycles and platform best practices
  • Strong writing and analytical skills
  • Comfort under live-event pressure and willingness to travel, including weekends
  • Knowledge of pickleball a strong plus

job.title: Social Media Producer
job.description:
We are looking for a soccer-obsessed, social-first Social Media Producer to help drive audience growth and content strategy across AMP Media’s soccer portfolio, including Unfiltered Soccer and Style of Play.

This role is designed for someone who lives at the intersection of soccer culture, social media, and content creation. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of the global game and stays constantly plugged into the news, players, clubs, leagues, tournaments, memes, fan conversations, and cultural moments shaping soccer around the world.

Beyond being a soccer expert, this person should be a highly capable social producer and editor who can independently take an idea from concept through execution. They will identify and source compelling UGC, create memes and highly shareable content, produce and edit original social-first video, and capture behind-the-scenes content with talent at live shows, shoots, matches, and other on-site activations.

This role will work closely with producers, editors, social leads, and high-profile talent to help make our soccer brands part of the daily conversation around the sport — not just when a new podcast episode drops.

What You’ll Do

  • Live and breathe the global soccer conversation, staying ahead of breaking news, emerging storylines, viral moments, players, clubs, leagues, tournaments, and broader soccer culture.
  • Ideate, produce, edit, and publish original social-first content for Unfiltered Soccer and Style of Play across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, Threads, and emerging platforms.
  • Identify, source, and package high-potential UGC from across the soccer ecosystem, using fan moments, player content, matchday culture, and internet trends to drive reach, engagement, and follower growth.
  • Create memes, reactive content, trend-driven videos, graphics, and other highly shareable formats that allow our brands and talent to participate organically in the soccer conversation.
  • Develop content that extends beyond traditional podcast cutdowns, leveraging talent voices and expertise to create original social franchises, reactions, explainers, rankings, debates, and culturally relevant moments designed specifically for social audiences.
  • Independently edit polished, platform-native short-form video with a strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, sound, storytelling, and retention, with minimal oversight required from concept through final delivery.
  • Monitor soccer news and social conversation in real time and proactively identify opportunities where our shows, talent, and channels should participate.
  • Understand the nuances of different soccer audiences — from USMNT and USWNT supporters to Premier League, Champions League, MLS, NWSL, international soccer, and the broader global game — and tailor content accordingly.
  • Support real-time matchday and breaking-news coverage, quickly turning developments into compelling social content while maintaining editorial accuracy.
  • Capture point-and-shoot behind-the-scenes content at live shows, production shoots, matches, events, and other on-site activations, with an instinct for identifying candid and personality-driven moments that will perform on social.
  • Work directly with talent on-site to capture original vertical video, social concepts, reactions, interviews, and other platform-specific content.
  • Support organic audience-growth strategies, including collaborations, UGC, community engagement, cross-promotion, talent amplification, and other opportunities to expand reach and attract new followers.
  • Optimize content for searchability, discoverability, and platform performance, incorporating relevant keywords, metadata, SEO principles, and platform best practices.
  • Execute sponsored and branded social content while ensuring deliverables meet creative, editorial, and contractual requirements.
  • Analyze content performance to understand what is driving views, retention, engagement, shares, and follower growth, and translate those insights into future programming decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with Social, Production, Editorial, Marketing, Design, and Sales while maintaining the ability to work independently and move quickly when opportunities arise.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in social media, digital content creation, video production, editing, or a related role, preferably within sports, media, or entertainment.
  • Deep knowledge of and passion for soccer is essential. Candidates should have a strong understanding of the global soccer landscape and be able to confidently
  • identify the players, clubs, leagues, storylines, and cultural conversations that matter to fans.
  • A demonstrated understanding of soccer internet culture, including memes, fan communities, UGC, trends, creator content, and the types of moments soccer audiences are likely to share.
  • Strong social-first creative instincts with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to create engaging, timely, and highly shareable sports content.
  • Advanced video editing and production skills, with experience using Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and/or other professional social editing tools.
  • Ability to independently take content from idea → production → edit → publish without requiring significant creative oversight.
  • Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, and Threads, including platform-specific formats, algorithms, audience behaviors, and growth strategies.
  • Comfortable shooting high-quality social content using a phone or lightweight camera setup in fast-moving, on-location environments.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to move quickly around breaking news without sacrificing accuracy.
  • An eye for viral content and an understanding of why people stop scrolling, watch, comment, and share.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and operate effectively within the fast-moving, 24/7 news cycle of soccer and social media.
  • A proactive self-starter who identifies opportunities rather than waiting for assignments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience working directly with producers, editors, executives, and high-profile talent.
  • Experience working with high-profile talent while maintaining professionalism and sound judgment.
  • A calculated risk-taker who is comfortable experimenting with new formats, trends, and creative approaches while protecting the voice and reputation of each brand.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed, particularly around major matches, tournaments, live events, and breaking news.

job.title: Sr. Content Creator (Client Services)
job.description:
As a Senior Content Creator, you’ll be the primary videographer for all kinds of marketing projects, including promos, commercials, and lifestyle segments. You’ll edit content that stops thumbs, turns heads, and moves audiences to action. You’ll serve as a creative partner to internal and external clients, translating their goals into compelling visual stories while acting as an ACCET representative at the station.

We’re a fast-moving, idea-sparking, deadline-crushing content team embedded inside one of the most dynamic media companies in the country. As part of the Agile Creative Content Engagement Team (ACCET), you’ll lead the creation of branded, promotional, and social-first content that connects brands to audiences in meaningful ways.

This role goes beyond production - it’s about owning creative execution for clients while serving as the local ACCET content lead for the station. You’ll work directly with internal stakeholders and external clients to concept, produce, and deliver high-impact creative that runs across broadcast, digital, and social platforms.

Our mission? Bring bold ideas to life across every screen. Whether you’re producing branded campaigns for advertisers, promotional creative for station initiatives, or community-focused storytelling, your work won’t just fill airtime - it will represent ACCET at the market level and drive real results for clients.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

As a Senior Content Creator, you’ll be the primary videographer for all kinds of marketing projects, including promos, commercials, and lifestyle segments. You’ll edit content that stops thumbs, turns heads, and moves audiences to action. You’ll serve as a creative partner to internal and external clients, translating their goals into compelling visual stories while acting as an ACCET representative at the station.

You’ll collaborate with sales teams, marketers, and clients to deliver strategic storytelling that balances emotion, brand objectives, and performance - all while maintaining ACCET creative standards.

YOUR DAILY PLAYLIST:

  • Create high-quality, scroll-stopping content for client campaigns across TV, social, web, and streaming platforms 
  • Lead creative execution for branded content, commercials, promotional spots, and social-first video 
  • Serve as the station-level creative lead for ACCET, working closely with internal teams and external clients 
  • Shoot footage, edit, and occasionally write projects ranging from quick-turn social content to longer-form branded pieces 
  • Collaborate directly with clients to develop concepts, manage expectations, and deliver polished creative solutions 
  • Manage asset distribution across the network and track deliverables through Adobe Workfront 

 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE STAGE:

  • A passion for visual storytelling with a client-focused, marketing-driven mindset
  • Strong camera, lighting, and production skills that elevate brand storytelling 
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator 
  • Confidence working directly with clients and internal stakeholders as a creative lead 
  • The ability to run a solo shoot or collaborate seamlessly as part of a team 
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong branded content, commercial, or promotional work 

 

WHY IT MATTERS:

In a crowded content landscape, brands need more than noise - they need connection. This role plays a key part in helping advertisers and partners tell stories that resonate locally while maintaining the creative excellence of ACCET across the network. You won’t just create content - you’ll help shape how brands show up in the community.

 

What skills do you need to be successful in this role?

  • Extensive video shooting experience with broadcast and DSLR cameras 
  • Ability to shoot, edit, and write content that tells a compelling story 
  • A strong understanding of fundamental design principles, color theory, typography, and composition 
  • Non-linear editing experience using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator 
  • Advanced knowledge of the post-production process, including media management and encoding video into various formats 
  • Ability to manage a variety of projects and work with varying production styles while employing strong communication skills 
  • Advanced knowledge of high-definition (HD) cameras, videography, motion graphics, and creative lighting techniques 
  • Strong interpersonal skills to navigate internal and external employee and client relationships 
  • Must maintain a valid driver’s license and good driving record 
  • Ability to routinely lift, carry, and move equipment in excess of 40 lbs. 
  • A college degree is preferred

job.title: VP, General Manager
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, building a culture where people feel connected, inspired, and proud of the work they do.  We grow here, and we enjoy it here.

We're searching for a visionary leader — a driven, talented VP, General Manager to lead one or more of our local content centers and monetization and marketing teams. In this role, you'll be the architect of strategy, the champion of growth, a steward of culture and the heartbeat of operational excellence. If you're energized by leading high-performing teams, driving revenue, and making a lasting impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Sounds Like the Right Fit? Check Out the Checklist Below and if it sounds like you, hit “Apply Now” and let’s chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook)

Help Us Thrive
You’ll lead the charge in amplifying our market presence, ensuring every team — from content creation to sales — is aligned with our strategic goals and delivering results.

Results-Driven
Maximize share of wallet across all media platforms in your marketplace. You’ll guide sales and marketing teams to hit revenue targets, grow audience engagement, and build lasting client relationships.

Strategic Planning
Develop and implement innovative business plans across departments. You’ll identify growth opportunities, analyze market trends, and ensure every team is set up for success.

Team Development
Mentor and inspire cross-functional teams while actively shaping a positive, inclusive, and high-performance culture. You’ll model our values, foster collaboration, reinforce accountability, and create an environment where people feel engaged, supported, and motivated to do their best work. Your leadership will develop future leaders and strengthen team cohesion. 

Market Analysis
Dive deep into competitive landscapes and audience data. Your insights will fuel expansion strategies and keep us ahead of the curve.

Authentic Relationships
Build strong relationships with clients, advertisers, community leaders, and industry partners. Internally and externally, you’ll be a visible culture carrier and the  face of AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions in your market, amplifying our reputation and impact.

What We're Looking For

✔ Proven Leadership
Experience in senior management level roles, ideally in media, digital or broadcasting. You’ve led diverse teams and driven measurable success.

✔ Strategic Visionary
You see the big picture and know how to get there. You’re comfortable with P&L ownership, financial planning, and operational excellence.

✔ Regulatory Savvy
You understand broadcasting regulations, content guidelines, and compliance standards — and you know how to navigate them with confidence.

✔ Financial Acumen
You’re skilled in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis. You know how to drive profitability while managing expenses.

✔ Relationship Builder
You’re a natural communicator and connector. You build trust, foster loyalty, and amplify client satisfaction. You inspire and motivate your team.

✔ Digital First
You bring strong digital acumen and understand how to leverage emerging technologies — including AI — to drive innovation and revenue growth. You’re not just tech-aware; you’re tech-forward.

✔ Growth Mindset
You thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change, and believe culture is a leadership responsibility. You’re always learning, adapting, and pushing boundaries – for yourself and your team.

The Practical Stuff

  • A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients and teams in your community.
  • Willingness and ability to travel when necessary.

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions?

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People
Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun. We celebrate wins and support each other every step of the way.

The Compensation Package
Competitive base salary + results-based bonus structure. Plus, a benefits package our people love.

We Make a Real Difference
We help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our team isn’t just selling ads — we’re building communities.

Career Growth Opportunities
We invest in you. Training, mentorship, and advancement opportunities are all part of the package. Whether you grow locally or join another AMP team, your future is bright.

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: YouTube Editor - Freelance
job.description:
The dedicated freelance YouTube Editor creates and refines long-form and short-form video content for YouTube and social platforms, playing a key role in the brand's video content strategy. The role owns the editing process for YouTube-bound content, transforming linear segments into YouTube-optimized long-form videos and editing YouTube-native programming with a focus on audience retention, strong hooks, pacing, and effective chaptering. The freelance YouTube Editor brings a deep understanding of YouTube and YouTube Shorts best practices, applying platform-specific storytelling techniques to maximize engagement and performance.

As a member of the Long-Form Pod, the freelance YouTube Editor partners closely with the Long-Form Video Producer Lead to develop and deliver long-form content for the channel. The role also creates weekly podcast cutdowns for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram, turning recurring podcast episodes into compelling short-form content that extends audience reach across platforms. Working within the Director of Video Content's YouTube strategy and the Head of Social's broader social media strategy, the freelance YouTube Editor helps drive content performance through strong editorial judgment, creative storytelling, and platform-native execution.

This freelance role is expected to be approximately 40 hours per week, with schedules aligned to tournament coverage needs. Flexibility to work weekends may be required during key tournaments and high-volume event periods. This freelance engagement is anticipated to run through December 2026, with the potential to be extended through the end of 2027 based on business needs and performance.

This is a freelance role and onsite located in Santa Monica, CA. 

In this freelance role, you will... 

Lead YouTube Editing & Production  (primary lane) 

  • Re-edit linear segments into YouTube-optimized long-form pieces (typically 8-25 minute range), with attention to retention pacing, hook structure, and chaptering. 
  • Produce and edit YouTube-native long-form content from scratch, in partnership with the Long-Form Video Producer Lead and the Director of Video Content. 
  • Maintain the YouTube content calendar in partnership with the Director of Video Content. 
  • Identify which linear content is best suited for YouTube re-editing; build relationships with the linear content team to access source material. 
  • Stage every YouTube upload for the Director of Video Content's pre-publish approval on brand-sensitive pieces; route SEO and thumbnail tests under the same approval flow. 

 

Create Podcast Weekly Cutdowns  (secondary lane) 

  • Cut the team's weekly podcast episodes down into platform-native short-form pieces for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram — the standing recurring deliverable for this lane. 
  • Identify the strongest moments in each weekly episode — clean takes, sharp quotes, debate beats, reactions — and cut them into 30-90 second vertical pieces with platform-native styling (captions, sound, hooks, aspect ratio). 
  • Adapt each cutdown across the three target platforms — Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels — with platform-appropriate length, pacing, captioning, and thumbnail/cover styling. 
  • Maintain a weekly cutdown publish cadence — typically 3-6 cuts per episode across the three platforms — coordinated with the Short-Form Pod and the on-shift coordinator on publish-window timing. 
  • Add platform-native styling to every cutdown (captions, sound mix, end cards) and a thumbnail/cover frame that holds up in feed. 
  • Partner with the Short-Form Video Producer Lead, the Social Media Specialist, and the on-shift coordinator on which cutdowns publish, when, and on which platforms. 

 

Drive Content & Creative Direction 

  • Apply Tennis Channel brand voice and visual standards on every YouTube piece and every podcast cutdown. 
  • Partner with the Tournament Highlights Editor and the Original/Long-Form Editor on occasional YouTube edits when their formats are a better fit. 
  • Pitch new YouTube formats and serialized programming ideas to the Director of Video Content. 

 

Stay Ahead of Platform Expertise & Trends 

  • Stay current on Shorts, TikTok, and Reels for the podcast cutdown lane — sound choices, edit timing, hook structures that work for podcast-derived clips. 
  • Run platform-feature tests on YouTube (Shorts placements, Premieres, chapter strategy, format experiments); document what works and roll learnings into the strategy. 
  • Bring YouTube-driven and podcast-cutdown ideas to the Weekly Trending Content Meeting (chaired by the Senior Social Media Manager). 

 

Partner Cross-Functionally 

  • Pair daily with the Long-Form Video Producer Lead in the Long-Form Pod on YouTube-bound long-form content — concept fit, on-site capture priorities, hand-off, finish. 
  • Partner with the Short-Form Pod and the Social Media Specialist on the podcast cutdown lane — what gets cut, what publishes, when, and on which platforms. 
  • Partner with Programming/Linear to identify which linear segments are candidates for YouTube re-editing; own the actual re-editing under the Director of Video Content's strategic direction. 
  • Coordinate with the Social Graphics Content Specialist on YouTube thumbnails, end cards, lower-thirds, and series art that wraps the channel. 
  • Coordinate with the on-shift coordinator on Shorts publish-window timing and cross-platform asset distribution. 

 

Key Performance Indicators 

  • YouTube subscriber growth (+100% YoY) — primary KPI. 
  • Average view duration trend on YouTube. 
  • Click-through rate on uploads (target: 6%+ on most uploads, 8%+ on linear re-edits). 
  • Number of linear-to-YouTube re-edits published per month vs. plan. 
  • Audience retention curve quality (qualitative review of retention graphs). 

 

Key Qualifications 

  • 3-5 years editing and/or producing YouTube content with documented growth results
  • Demonstrable track record on a brand or creator channel — must show analytics from prior work, not just edits
  • Strong understanding of YouTube algorithm fundamentals: retention, click-through rate, session time, watch time
  • Hands-on thumbnail design ability or strong art-direction skills with a designer
  • Hands-on short-form vertical editing for Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels — the podcast cutdown lane requires the same craft as a dedicated short-form editor
  • Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve fluency; CapCut Pro for fastest-turn cutdowns
  • Comfort writing — titles, descriptions, occasional voice-over scripts, podcast cutdown captions
  • Comfort working at high volume across two distinct cadences — multi-day YouTube production cycles and weekly podcast cutdown turnaround
  • Prior experience adapting linear/broadcast content for YouTube
  • Sports, news, or entertainment YouTube channel experience
  • Podcast or talk-show editing experience — knowing how to find the clip moment inside a long conversation
  • Familiarity with YouTube Studio, vidIQ or TubeBuddy, and basic SEO research tools

job.title: Lead Broadcast Infrastructure Technician
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.




How you’ll make an impact:

As Broadcast Infrastructure Technician at SiriusXM, you are in a front-facing role where you provide first line technical support for SiriusXM’s Broadcast and IT Systems, Studio personnel and Remote Users.

You will be a key player contributing to our 100% On-Air uptime goal by utilizing your troubleshooting skills, knowledge, and experience to support the Broadcast facility and studios of the Sirius XM

Project work is an important aspect of the role, helping to improve workflows and increase our level of technology. You will be an active contributor and implementer of Sirius XM Broadcast Projects and will be expected to lead projects and resolve complex issues.


What you’ll do:

This is a shift work position in a 24/7 facility. During your shift you will review systems operations logs, install software and firmware updates to a range of broadcast specific hardware and IT based workstations and servers- both physical and virtual. You will assist and troubleshoot technical issues for both in-house and remote studio users. You will address networking issues that are local or across sites.   Using your troubleshooting abilities, you will isolate and resolve the issues or escalate to subject Matter Experts (SMEs) via escalation procedures. In addition to troubleshooting, you will ticket issues and communicate status to management and affected teams.


What you’ll need:

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on & remote technical experience in broadcast or media content creation facility
  • Minimum 0-2 years of leading technical projects and supervising technicians
  • Proficiency in a wide range of broadcasting or IT equipment and systems
  • Moderate decision-making authority, may make recommendations and implement solutions
  • College degree in a technical discipline or equivalent military or industry experience
  • Knowledge of standard MS office suite, Visio and AutoCad
  • Willingness to take initiative and to follow through on projects
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Work independently and in a team environment
  • Project professionalism in all forms of communication
  • Ability to multi-task and shift priorities
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs and be comfortable on a ladder  
  • Must be able to work on-site and all shifts required in a 24x7x365 broadcast and production facility (i.e., days, nights, weekends, holidays)
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S

Technical Experience

  • Extensive IT experience in the provisioning, supporting, and maintaining of endpoint and server hardware and software
  • Problem-solving and diagnosis of endpoint issues for users that are both remote and local.
  • Incident ticketing and management using ServiceNow (or similar)
  • Configuration and support of Windows and Linux server operating systems
  • Virtual infrastructure/computing support at the direction of Tier 3 staff
  • Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving experience within a data center environment
  • In depth knowledge of Windows and Apple OS, including MS Office, Office 365, and Adobe Creative Cloud products
  • Understanding and troubleshooting of data network routers, switches, firewalls, and circuits using Splunk, ELK, Solarwinds, Wireshark or similar tools
  • CLI management and scripting experience a plus
  • Installation, configuration, and support of varied broadcast/production software
  • Digital and IP-based audio/video routing, playout and recording systems
  • Installation and deployment of systems, networks, and structured cabling within a broadcast facility
  • Demonstrated experience with broadcast consoles and related studio equipment
  • Familiarity with satellite downlink operations and hardware support
  • Ability to diagnose, detect and isolate equipment faults by equipment log review and analysis of signal flow documentation
  • Ability to read and create schematics and data flow documents (AutoCAD/Visio)
  • Knowledge of configuration of Telos, LAWO, Evertz, and other media encoding devices is a plus
  • This position requires the use of information or access to hardware which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). As required by ITAR, to perform this position you must be a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e., ‘Green Card Holder’), Political Asylee, or Refugee.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you'll make an impact:

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SiriusXM, you will bring machine learning models from development and experimentation to reliable, scalable production systems. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, and Services teams to productionize models, build robust feature pipelines, and ensure models operate reliably in live environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with ownership across deployment, serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management of ML systems.

Model Productionization and Deployment

Model Lifecycle Management

  • Support model registration, versioning, publishing, and promotion.

  • Implement retraining pipelines and redeploy improved models as data and algorithms evolve.

  • Participate in the decommissioning and retirement of models.

Problem Resolution

  • Identify and resolve complex issues in ML model performance, deployment, and operational workflows.

SiriusXM Media is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America, spanning owned and operated platforms, innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz, and an extended content network reaching more than 150 million listeners each month. 

 

AdsWizz

AdsWizz, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions, operating in over 40 countries and connecting buyers and sellers through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats. 

 

How you’ll make an impact:

As a strategic and adaptable Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the strategy and delivery of large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives across Ads Engineering. This role is critical to driving execution of high-impact programs spanning ad-serving systems, data platforms, monetization workflows, and cross-program integrations with Pandora and broader SiriusXM systems. 

 

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep architectural literacy, systems thinking, and the ability to define program strategy — not simply execute against it. You will partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape multi-year roadmaps, co-own program strategy, streamline org-wide governance, and deliver outcomes that materially impact platform scalability, monetization performance, and global platform capabilities to deliver outcomes that make an unmistakable enterprise-level impact across: scalability targets, RTB latency/SLA, fill rate, yield/monetization lift, reliability, and global rollout readiness. This includes leading multi-year, cross-functional programs such as global ad-serving modernization, real-time bidding (RTB) latency/scale programs, and technical consolidation across the Pandora and SiriusXM ad technology stacks.

 

What you’ll do:

Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery

  • Establish and own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-organizational Ads Engineering initiatives (eg: broadcast ads digitization and modernization, ad insertion, consolidation across SiriusXM and Pandora tech stacks), from intake through launch.
  • Function as Workstream lead for select cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams - from planning through launch.
  • Maintain roadmap and delivery commitments for multiple teams within the Ad Technology organization, aligning Product, Engineering and GTM on execution plans, ROIs and outcomes (e.g., latency/SLAs, yield/monetization lift, reliability, rollout readiness).
  • Coordinate program structure, milestones, sequencing, interdependencies, and success metrics in close partnership with engineering and product leadership. 
  • Proactively identify, forecast, and mitigate delivery risks and issues, communicating mitigation plans and status clearly to stakeholders.
  • Use data to drive sustainable planning and transparent tradeoff discussions for new work or conflicting priorities.
  • Provide portfolio-level visibility and structured analysis to advise on prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
  • Drive high-stakes tradeoff decisions (scope, sequencing, resourcing, risk) with Director/VP level engineering and product leadership and be directly accountable for program-level outcomes and delivery across multiple teams.

Technical Leadership & Systems Thinking

  • Apply proficient architectural literacy across ad-serving, real-time bidding, data pipelines, monetization platforms, and distributed infrastructure.
  • Guide teams toward scalable, aligned technical solutions by deeply understanding platform constraints and cross-program tradeoffs.
  • Review system designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively solve downstream impacts across tightly coupled Ads and platform integrations.
  • Manage capacity, risks, technical debt, velocity, and operational readiness.
  • Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints, including across globally distributed systems.
  • Serve as the go-to Technical Program Manager and subject matter expert for complex cross-program integrations, major platform constraints, and critical cross-domain dependency resolution.

Roadmap Alignment & Program Strategy

  • Influence roadmap alignment across Ads, Pandora, and related programs.
  • Own program-level strategy across multiple teams, including dependency mapping, sequencing, and integration planning for complex, ambiguous initiatives where outcomes and constraints evolve.
  • Co-own Ads Technology program strategy, shaping roadmap prioritization based on business impact, technical feasibility, and cross-program dependencies.
  • Advocate for program(s) health and long-term strategy.

Organizational Effectiveness & Governance

  • Define and institutionalize Ads TPM org-wide program governance standards, operating models, and best practices, elevating execution rigor across the entire Ads Engineering organization.
  • Mentor and uplevel other TPMs, and cross-functional partners by creating playbooks, templates, and coaching that improve execution quality beyond your immediate scope.
  • Continuously improve governance and delivery processes to increase predictability, execution quality, and program health over time.

  • Partner with TPM leadership to run program level ceremonies like intake and refinement if required.
