job.title: A&R Analyst - Sony Music Nashville
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As an A&R Analyst with Sony Music Nashville, you will have a central role in supporting our A&R team by providing important insights and data-driven evaluations on both rostered and undiscovered artists. 

In this role, you will implement and manage data-driven methods to discover new artists, run daily reports to aid in artist discovery and analysis, construct statistical insights and predictive metrics, conduct research on artists and analyze new music – both signed and unsigned. This role is a unique opportunity to help the company discover our next superstars and help drive data-assisted decision making within the A&R team.

What you'll do:

  • Conduct research to evaluate new music and improve the A&R team’s understanding of new music metrics including social networking sites, data and analytics
  • Extract, prepare, analyze and present relevant music and social activity data to help identify new potential talent while also monitoring the marketplace and constructing new methods to draw insights from this data
  • Develop and implement new analytical processes, technologies and tools for use by the A&R team and other departments in support of trend identification, etc.
  • Regularly meet with A&R team to provide updates on activity and marketplace
  • Generate weekly reports and lead meetings to brief team on artists of interest
  • Work with internal teams as needed to create and troubleshoot queries, dashboards and other identification tools
  • Create artist-specific reports detailing audience growth and consumption relative to similar artists
  • Compile and monitor stream count and social media metrics for unsigned, undiscovered artists
  • Identify and interpret relevant data in the context of the current music landscape
  • Assess and summarize tendencies in consumption source across genres/subgenres
  • Proactively identify additional areas for analysis and identification of new artists
  • Deliver and present large data sets in a useful and meaningful way, by presenting key information across several methods and platforms to the broader Sony leadership team

Who you are:

  • At least two years of music or entertainment industry experience, with a demonstrated track record of using data to find new and emerging talent
  • A passionate new music listener with a strong knowledge of various genres of music with an emphasis on country format and ability to separate/identify commercially viable talent
  • A team player with an understanding of current tastes and trends of the market, preferably with prior experience interacting with recording artists and an understanding of artist lifestyle
  • A self-starter with exceptional communication skills, time management skills and an ability to prioritize and multi-task, work independently and with teammates
  • An independent thinker with strong computer skills including MS Office (Word, Excel & Outlook) and proven internet and data analytics capabilities, as well as a working knowledge of digital music space and social media
  • Available to attend evening showcases as well as ability to travel as needed
  • Knowledge of music monitoring platforms such as Music Connect, Mediabase and Indify
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans

job.title: A&R Director - RCA China
job.description:
As A&R Director, you will play a pivotal role in initiating, supporting and implementing A&R strategy that incorporates facilitating cooperation with established and new artists who are already or have the chance to be commercially successful, finding the right songs and projects for new and current priority artists and overseeing the ongoing development and recording of all assigned artists. All of the above is not limited to only artists, seeking label partnerships are also a key priority.

 

What you'll do:

  • Identify developing and established artists for RCA Greater China review and signing, using existing network or resources. 
  • Identify developing and established label partners for RCA Greater China cooperation, using existing network or resources. 
  • Work closely with MD to manage the short and long term goals of the label. 
  • Project Management: Overseeing A&R process and artist engagements, working with the team to cooperate and communicate between artists, producers, teams, suppliers, etc. 
  • Responsible A&R daily management including tracking and coordinating the progress and timeline of production projects with the team, integrates the relevant admin works, regularly updates the Release Schedule of RCA label, deliver various reports, updates, and other relevant presentation materials on behalf of the team. 
  • Budget tracking and management of procurement, Purchase Order, and invoicing processes 
  • Liaising, “brainstorming” and meeting with internal teams to discuss A&R’s strategy. 
  • Demonstrate a good ear for music that will help the artist(s) success and be able to identify the singles that will be hits and provide creative feedback. 
  • Attend shows and showcases of both signed and unsigned artists on a regular basis. 
  • Manage the administrative and deal making process for prospective clients. 
  • Work closely with Finance and BLA to formulate deal prospects. 
  • Work with MD to set out company priorities and release timelines. 
  • Work closely with other label departments/employees including Copyright, Royalty, Artist Management, Marketing & Promotion, Data Analytics, Commercial & Sales, Creative Services, etc. 
  • Provide Artist Management support. 
  • Special projects (e.g., TFT, SMP interpolation, writing camps, Virtual Artists, Soundtracks etc.).
 

Who you are:

  • Undergraduate degree required. 
  • Minimum 8 years’ experience in the music industry.   
  • Strong relationships with artists, songwriters, producers, companies/industry resources are required. 
  • Expertise in songwriting and production is a plus. 
  • Knowledge and experience in the music industry, with strong understanding of recording, production, creative, legal, copyright, music publishing, and general knowledge of digital marketing, social media, content, streaming landscape, and key industry players. 
  • Open-minded; avid music fan across all genres.  Strong desire to make a difference and contribute to successful outcomes. 
  • A proactive self-starter. A collaborative team player, able to form good relationships with internal and external stakeholders.  
  • Able to handle confidential matters appropriately and with discretion. Good time management and organizational skills 
  • Ability to travel and attend showcases as required. 
  • Great verbal and written communications skills combined with interpersonal skills working across multiple cultures. 
  • Passion for music, digital media and innovation is a (big) plus. 
  • Fluent in both English and Mandarin.

 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey.
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork.
  • We invest in your professional growth & development.

job.title: Analyst, Marketing Financial Planning
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and music-passionate Analyst to join our centralized finance team supporting the Sony Music US Front Line Label Group, which includes Columbia Records, RCA Records, Epic Records, Arista Records, Sony Music Nashville, Provident Entertainment, and Ultra Records.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Marketing Financial Planning, this position will support the planning, tracking, and analysis of marketing expenses across artist campaigns for assigned labels. The Analyst will work closely with finance, marketing, and media teams to help maintain accurate budgets, process purchase orders, reconcile expenses, and provide visibility into campaign spending. The ideal candidate is organized, curious, comfortable working with financial data, and able to manage multiple priorities in a collaborative environment.

What you'll do:

  • Budgeting and Forecasting: Assist with maintaining artist marketing budgets that support release strategies and commercial plans. Update marketing budgets in the company’s planning system and help ensure information remains accurate as campaign plans change. Support the monthly forecast process by gathering campaign updates and entering revised spending assumptions.
  • Purchase Order Administration: Coordinate with label teams to create and submit marketing-related purchase orders in line with approved campaign budgets and internal requirements. Work with Accounts Payable and label partners to research discrepancies and support timely vendor payments.
  • Expense Reconciliation and Analysis: Complete monthly and quarterly reconciliations of marketing expenses. Support the preparation of accruals and journal entries. Review spending activity, identify potential variances, and share findings with the manager. Assist with reviewing marketing recoupment calculations and tracking third-party sponsorships, invoices, and payments.
  • Financial Reporting and Spend Visibility: Maintain marketing expense reports and dashboards that provide visibility into actual spending and remaining budgets by artist, project, and campaign. Assist with tracking contractual marketing commitments across artists, projects, spending categories, and release phases.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with marketing, media, promotion, and finance teams across assigned labels to gather information and resolve questions. Participate in marketing financial planning meetings and provide updates on budgets, spending, and purchase orders.
  • Compliance and Process Support: Help ensure marketing expenses are supported by the appropriate documentation and follow company finance policies, approval requirements, and established controls. Assist with audit requests and support updates to budgeting, reporting, and purchase order processes.
  • Special Projects: Assist with campaign analyses, vendor comparisons, label-wide marketing expense reviews, and other projects as assigned.

Who you are:

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • You have up to two years of experience in accounting, financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, or a related area. Internship or entry-level experience in music, entertainment, or media is a plus.
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and are comfortable learning new systems and applications.
  • Experience with SAP, Power BI, Tableau, or other financial reporting tools is a plus, but not required.
  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail and accuracy.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally and are comfortable working with colleagues across different teams and levels.
  • You are organized, able to manage multiple assignments, and comfortable adjusting to changing priorities and deadlines.

  • You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and raise issues when additional guidance is needed.

job.title: Artist Campaign Manager
job.description:
The Artist Campaign Manager is responsible for developing and executing impactful marketing campaigns that maximise the visibility, cultural relevance, and commercial performance of Sony Music’s repertoire. Working across local and international priorities, the role partners closely with artists, management, international teams and internal departments to drive audience engagement, streaming growth and long-term value across digital, physical and emerging platforms.

 

This role plays a key part in bringing campaigns to life - balancing creative storytelling, audience development, digital innovation and commercial thinking to ensure Sony Music’s catalogue continues to connect with both existing and new generations of fans.

 

What you'll do:

  • Manage a roster of international and domestic projects, acting as the day-to-day marketing lead and key internal point of contact.
  • Develop and execute innovative marketing campaigns that drive revenue, audience growth and long-term artist value.
  • Leverage data to identify opportunities within Sony’s long-tail of repertoire and trending tracks to drive campaigns that generate growth across D2C, CRM and streaming marketshare.
  • Collaborate closely with Domestic roster artist teams, International label affiliates and global teams on campaign strategy and execution.
  • Work cross-functionally with Digital, Audience Development, Legal, Publicity & Radio, Licensing and Analytics teams and act as the evangelist for your priorities across these divisions.
  • Work in partnership with digital, audience and analytics teams to leverage data, audience insights and cultural trends to optimise digital marketing and creator campaign performance.
  • Contribute to the development of creative campaign ideas, digital activations and strategic marketing opportunities across the business.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with artists, management teams and international label affiliates, representing Sony Music Australia with passion and professionalism.
  • Create insightful campaign reporting that educates the broader departments on where collaborative opportunities lie.
  • Monitor changes in the market, with an emphasis on the industry, competitors and campaigns. Identify emerging trends and social media patterns and educate the wider team on how to infuse them into artist campaigns.
  • Bring an innovative, collaborative and solutions-focused mindset to the role, with a willingness to experiment, adapt and learn in a fast-moving environment.

 

Who you are:

  • You are a highly motivated, curious thinker with 3+ years’ experience in music, entertainment or a related marketing environment.
  • You are passionate about music, culture, audience behaviour and digital marketing; immersed in internet culture and aware of how culture intersects with life online.
  • You have a strong understanding of how fans engage with artists, songs, and content across platforms from digital to physical.
  • You are a committed project manager who can organise a varied and full workload, prioritise, work under pressure and problem solve to see an idea through to completion.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills across artists, management and internal stakeholders, locally or internationally.
  • Creative thinker with an instinct for storytelling, audience engagement and culturally relevant marketing.
  • Comfortable working collaboratively across departments and contributing to a team-first environment.
  • Strong understanding of digital and social platforms, audience growth and modern music marketing ecosystems.

 

What we give you:

  • You join a global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day.
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next. We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives.
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private health benefits, life insurances, inclusive paid parental leave, emergency back-up childcare, LinkedIn Learning, Novated car leasing options plus loads of industry discounts & perks!

job.title: Assistant Creative Manager
job.description:
The Assistant Creative Manager will be primarily responsible for leading local creative marketing, content production, and artist campaign execution for Sony Music's international repertoire in Hong Kong. In addition to driving the Hong Kong market, this position will provide expanded creative support for campaign initiatives across Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA).

This position will play a key role in various creative marketing functions — assisting with pitch development, coordinating agency deliverables, maintaining release timelines, supporting in-market promotional visits, and creating assets (social media, short-form video, photo, and digital marketing materials) to craft engaging fan experiences on behalf of some of the biggest international artists in the world. 

The role is based in Hong Kong and covers Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA). You will sit within Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA) International Marketing community, reporting to the Director, International Marketing in Hong Kong and working closely with the Head of Creative, Southeast Asia, ensuring regional creative alignment while executing tailored campaigns locally.

What you'll do:

  • Campaign Ideation & Execution: Be a creative visionary, developing and implementing innovative marketing and superfan campaigns that enhance Sony Music artists’ presence and engage fans across Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia.
  • Vendor & Agency Coordination: Manage relationships with external creative partners such as agencies, photographers, and production teams to deliver high-quality content and assets on time and within budget.
  • Workflow & Asset Management: Assist with the end-to-end creative workflow—from routing concepts for approval to monitoring production schedules—ensuring asset alignment with artist and company brand guidelines.
  • Trend & Platform Research: Monitor music, pop culture, events, TikTok, digital marketing, and emerging tech trends to provide actionable ideas for creative asset production.
  • Data & Insights Application: Collaborate with the data and insights team to pull audience analytics, assisting in applying performance metrics to optimize asset design and content formats.
  • Content Calendar & Delivery: Build and maintain the master content calendar for campaign launches, promotional schedules, and artist activities across the company’s international releases.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Support cross-functional integration across digital, audience development, catalogue, local PR, and content teams to ensure messaging alignment.
  • Post-Campaign Reporting: Gather feedback, compile post-campaign performance data, and draft summary reports to help refine future creative strategies.
  • Asset Production & Collaboration: Develop and produce engaging creative outputs that reflect the artist's unique identity, story, and vision across multiple platforms. Coordinate with graphic designers, videographers, and editors to produce visually compelling content. while remaining adaptable to artist management feedback.

Who you are:

Technical capabilities

  • 3–5 years of experience executing creative marketing campaigns within music, entertainment, media, or agency environments.
  • Passionate about the music and entertainment industry with a strong desire to grow your creative career.
  • Highly organized multi-taskers with strong communication skills and experience supporting cross-functional teams.
  • Curious, proactive, eager to learn, and attuned to the unique cultural trends across Hong Kong, Taiwan, Southeast Asian markets.
  • Skilled at translating artistic concepts into practical, engaging digital and social assets.
  • Solid understanding of modern digital platforms, music streaming mechanics, and short-form video creation.
  • Analytical mindset with basic proficiency in reviewing campaign analytics and key performance metrics.
  • Excellent written English and Chinese, with fluent spoken English & Cantonese. Fluent spoken Mandarin is an advantage.

Behavioural capabilities

  • Ownership and agility: takes complete responsibility for assigned artists and markets, and adapts quickly to shifting timelines, artist priorities and market trends.
  • Execution excellence: delivers high-quality work with meticulous attention to detail, timing and cross-functional coordination.
  • Curiosity and innovation: proactively explores new creator trends, media hooks, platform features and commercial opportunities beyond assigned tasks.
  • Collaboration and problem solving: works effectively with cross-border teams and external partners across different markets, time zones and working cultures, bringing practical solutions to complex challenges

What we give you:

  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best

job.title: Assistant Manager - Video Partnerships
job.description:
We are looking for a Assistant Manager – Video Partnerships to drive the growth and monetization of our Catalogue across YouTube, Meta, Snapchat and other video platforms. The role will focus on identifying opportunities to extend the life of existing content through new video formats, recreations and content-led initiatives, while working closely with internal teams, artists, creators and vendors to drive audience growth and consumption.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Digital Business
job.description:
As the Associate Manager, Digital Business  you will be managing accounts of digital service providers (music streaming platforms) and digital retail relationships in Hong Kong, and you will develop projects and initiatives that optimize revenue / opportunities for Sony Music’s artists under these accounts.

Essential to this role is a solid understanding of the digital retail landscape as well as a core understanding of the digital services. Equally important is a strong grasp of various different types of repertoires.

You will boast strong business relationships with current digital partners in Hong Kong and will play an integral role in developing partners, gathering, and synthesizing deal requirements to drive win-win outcomes in negotiations and partner development to grow digital revenue, streaming and market share for Hong Kong.

This role also supports physical product management and oversees sales channel coordination to maximize revenue and market presence.

 

What you will do:

DSP Account Management

•    Manage relationships with key DSPs in Hong Kong (e.g. Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, local/regional platforms).
•    Execute release strategies in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
•    Negotiate and secure promotional opportunities, playlist placement, and marketing support.
•    Monitor platform updates, trends, and algorithmic changes to optimize performance.

Strategy & Partnership Development

•    Define partnership strategies, build a robust new digital business pipeline, and execute go-to-market plans to achieve market share, revenue, and chart KPI’s in line with company priorities.
•    Represent Sony Music’s interests to partners and cultivate strong, meaningful relationships, setting long-term strategies to optimize existing results and revenue/opportunities for Sony Music artists on these accounts.
•    Source requirements, design deal parameters, plan the negotiation strategy and execute negotiations with key digital partners in Hong Kong, encompassing both new local partner deals and renewals.
•    Manager projects across various activities related to the partner and their platforms. This could include collaboration on content strategies, reporting integration, ongoing analysis of partner performance, problem solving, or driving marketing & promotional initiatives with large streaming accounts to maximize revenue. 

Streaming Performance & Analytics

•    Track, analyze, and report streaming performance across all platforms.
•    Identify growth opportunities and recommend data-driven strategies to improve engagement and revenue.
•    Work closely with marketing and A&R teams to optimize campaign execution.

Physical Product & Production Coordination

•    Support planning and execution of physical product releases (e.g., CDs, vinyl).
•    Coordinate with production vendors and internal teams to ensure timely delivery.
•    Updating the inventory levels and support forecasting.
•    Collaborate with retail partners, e-commerce platforms, and distributors.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

•    Work closely with Marketing, A&R, Finance, and Supply Chain teams.
•    Align digital and physical strategies to maximize overall commercial impact.
•    Support regional/global initiatives as required.

Others

•    Weekly, Bi-weekly & Monthly reports/Updates/calls.
•    DSP performance, industry/competitor release update and marketing campaign idea sharing.
•    Regional office affairs and coordination, including HK digital market update and revenue/market share/subscribers update, as well as digital strategy plan/result summary.

 

Who you are:

•    University graduate in any disciplines but degrees of relevant subjects are preferred
•    Passionate with track records of success in business development and driving sales
•    A minimum of 3-5 years of relevant working experience, with passion in music & entertainment will also be considered
•    Experience working with digital industry or digital agencies will be advantageous
•    Strong familiarity with the business applications of digital music and social media platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, KKBox, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, etc.)
•    Strong analytical skills and data driven thinking
•    Strong understanding of technology trends, market best practice and digital marketing tools
•    Creative, bright, pragmatic and dedicated, with strong relationship management and consulting skills
•    A team player, happy working independently but also collaborating with colleagues in a matrixed organization.
•    Well-versed in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
•    Creative pitching skills.
•    Proficient in English (written and spoken) 
•    Proven stakeholder management skills across all levels with the ability to build strong, successful relationships founded on collaboration.
•    Solid overall understanding of the value chain and touchpoints across streaming platforms and other labels.
•    Strong knowledge of key digital formats, digital distribution systems in the music business landscape and media industries.

job.title: Assistant.e chef de projet marketing F/H/NB - The Orchard - stage
job.description:
The Orchard recherche un.e assistant.e chef de projet marketing F/H/NB au sein de son équipe marketing.

The Orchard distribue la musique d’artistes indépendants tels que Bad Bunny, Raye, Gorillaz, TKS 2G, Yorssy, Marwa Loud et collabore avec des labels et des artistes de toutes tailles pour rendre leurs créations disponibles en digital comme en physique dans le monde entier.

Dans le cadre de votre stage, vous participez aux missions suivantes :

  • Assister le chef de projet dans l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre des stratégies marketing. Approfondir les réflexions sur les plans marketing, les plannings de sortie, les timelines et les budgets des projets travaillés, sur le catalogue français et international.
  • Participer à la mise en place, à la coordination des campagnes marketing (digital, OOH, médias, événements) ainsi qu’à leur optimisation.
  • Suivre et analyser les performances des campagnes et proposer des recommandations.
  • Gestion et suivi des performances des chaînes YouTube des artistes.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes internes et externes (distribution, marketing digital, influence, relations presse…) pour apporter aux labels et aux artistes les solutions adaptées à leur développement.
  • Proposer des recommandations sur la gestion des réseaux sociaux des artistes et à la création de contenus.
  • Analyser les recommandations des agences et proposer des profils pour les campagnes d’influences
  • Participer à la rédaction de communiqués, de pitch et création d’outils de communications adaptés à chaque campagne (textes, visuels, vidéos…). Adapter et créer des éléments visuels statiques et dynamiques pour les artistes et leurs équipes (bannière, teaser, ecards, photos composites…)
  • Participer à la gestion des plannings promo.
  • Aider le chef de projet dans le suivi administratif et logistique des projets.
  • Aider à la gestion du compte Instagram de l'entreprise (planning, création de contenus…)
  • Réaliser une veille concurrentielle et suivre les tendances du marché musical.

Profil recherché :

  • Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, communication, marketing ou université équivalente (Bac+3 à Bac+5).
  • Passionné(e) de musique, avec un fort intérêt pour les stratégies de marketing et de marketing digital.
  • Excellentes compétences en organisation, rigueur et capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément.
  • Créativité, esprit d’initiative et force de proposition.
  • Bonne maîtrise des outils digitaux, des réseaux sociaux et des plateformes de streaming.

job.title: Associate Director, Creative - Alamo
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

What you'll do:

  • Be able to create and manage budgets for productions top to bottom

Who you are:

job.title: Audience Development Executive
job.description:
The Audience Development Executive grows and deepens the audience for Sony Music's C-POP and J-POP repertoire across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. You will own how fans find our artists, how they move from a first stream to a committed fan, and how we understand and act on what those audiences tell us. 

C-POP and J-POP are two of the fastest-moving parts of our regional business, with releases and campaigns increasingly running across several markets at once and audience behaviour that differs sharply between the two. This role is the connective tissue: setting audience strategy per artist and per release, coordinating rollout across markets, and turning streaming, social and first-party data into decisions the marketing teams can act on. Success looks like measurable audience growth market by market, a healthier conversion from casual listener to superfan, and a release calendar for both repertoires that runs as one regional plan rather than several disconnected ones. 

The role is based in Taiwan, and covers Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA). You will sit within Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA) International Marketing community, reporting to the Director, International Marketing in Hong Kong and working closely with the Head of Creative, Southeast Asia, ensuring regional creative alignment while executing tailored campaigns locally. 

 

What you'll do:

Own audience strategy for C-POP and J-POP repertoire 

  • Develop and deliver audience development plans for priority C-POP and J-POP artists, releases and catalogue across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia, with clear objectives for audience growth, retention and conversion. 
  • Segment and size audiences by market, identifying where an artist is over- or under-indexed and where the realistic growth is, then shape campaign priorities and budget recommendations around that. 
  • Build the discovery-to-superfan funnel for each project: map how listeners enter, what moves them deeper, and where they drop out, and design interventions at each stage. 
  • Own the audience narrative for both repertoires in regional planning sessions, bringing a clear point of view backed by data to marketing, creative, commercial and repertoire centre stakeholders. 
  • Recognise where C-POP and J-POP audiences behave differently, in discovery route, fandom structure, spending patterns and platform preference, and build strategies that reflect those differences rather than applying one regional template to both. 

Grow audiences on DSPs and across the streaming ecosystem 

  • Work with digital service partners including Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, LINE MUSIC, JOOX, KKBOX and regional platforms on pitching, editorial support, on-platform programming and audience-growth opportunities across both repertoires. 
  • Drive playlist strategy across owned, editorial and algorithmic surfaces, including Filtr and other in-house playlist brands, and track how placement translates into sustained audience rather than a single-week spike. 
  • Partner with the digital marketing and media buying teams to align paid audience targeting with organic audience strategy, so spend is directed where it compounds. 
  • Monitor the creator and short-form ecosystem, identifying tracks and moments gaining traction and working with creative and digital teams to amplify them quickly. 
  • Track and act on the discovery routes specific to J-POP in this region, including anime, film and game sync, tour and event moments, and catalogue resurgence, and convert those spikes into retained audience. 

Build first-party data and superfan capability 

  • Grow first-party data capture across C-POP and J-POP campaigns, working with local teams to embed sign-up and data collection into releases, tours, fan events and D2C moments. 
  • Turn first-party data into usable audience segments for CRM, direct-to-consumer and superfan activity, and support markets in activating those segments responsibly. 
  • Identify and develop superfan opportunities that deepen the relationship with the most engaged part of each artist's audience, and support the commercial cases that sit behind them. 
  • Partner with Sony Music Japan and Greater China repertoire centre teams on first-party data and superfan initiatives, feeding regional audience insight back to them and translating their priorities into market-level plans. 
  • Work within local data protection and privacy requirements across each market, in partnership with legal and the relevant local teams. 

Coordinate across markets and repertoire centres 

  • Act as the regional coordination point for C-POP and J-POP releases and activities, aligning timelines, asset delivery and campaign moments across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. 
  • Consolidate requirements from local marketing teams into workable regional plans that scale while still allowing for hyper-local adaptation. 
  • Maintain visibility of the release calendar and audience plans across both repertoires so markets and the repertoire centres know what is coming and what is expected of them. 
  • Flag risks, clashes and gaps early, and keep regional stakeholders informed of progress and performance. 

Measure, report and improve 

  • Track and report on audience KPIs including listener growth, retention, market share, playlist performance, and first-party data capture, and communicate results clearly to senior stakeholders. 
  • Lead post-campaign reviews, identifying what drove audience growth and feeding those learnings into the next cycle. 
  • Work with the insights, data and analytics team to develop reporting that markets will actually use, and build data literacy across the regional teams. 
  • Stay ahead of platform, format and consumption changes across Greater China and Southeast Asia, and advise the business on what they mean for how we grow audiences.

 

Who you are:

  • 2+ years' experience in audience development, digital marketing, streaming or artist marketing at a label, DSP, artist management company or comparable media business. 
  • Demonstrable track record of growing an artist, catalogue or content audience, with the numbers to show it. 
  • Strong working knowledge of the streaming landscape across Greater China and Southeast Asia, including DSP editorial and algorithmic mechanics, playlist strategy, and platform-specific audience behaviour. 
  • Genuine fluency in C-POP and J-POP: the artists, the fandoms, the platforms they live on, and how audience behaviour differs between Taiwan, Hong Kong and the Southeast Asian markets. 
  • Comfortable with data. Able to work with streaming, social and first-party data, draw a defensible conclusion from it, and explain that conclusion to people who are not analysts. 
  • Experience with first-party data capture, CRM or direct-to-consumer fan initiatives is a strong advantage. 
  • Fluent in Mandarin (Traditional Chinese) and English. Japanese is a strong advantage given the J-POP scope, and Cantonese an advantage given the Hong Kong scope. 
  • Strong coordination skills across multiple markets, time zones and stakeholders, with the ability to keep several campaigns moving at once. 
  • Ability to articulate an idea or point of view succinctly, with clarity and confidence, adapting the message to different audiences, seniority levels and cultures. 
  • Responds and adapts quickly to change, maintaining a flexible attitude and using new conditions to evolve their thinking. 
  • A thorough understanding of lifestyle and cultural trends across Greater China and Southeast Asia.

 

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives

job.title: Business Analyst (Year in Industry)
job.description:
The Global Business Development & Digital Strategy team, split evenly between New York and London, focuses on executing and renewing revenue-generating commercial deals monetizing Sony Music’s vast catalogue with a broad range of companies globally, from major streaming partners such as Spotify, Amazon, Apple, YouTube and TikTok to the next generation of music and technology start-ups. You will join an international team of data-savvy negotiators and business analysts, who operate on the front lines with strong work ethic and genuine team spirit. If you're a penultimate-year undergraduate looking for a placement year, this is an opportunity to spend 12 months at the centre of the global music industry's digital transformation.
 
During your Year in Industry as Business Analyst, you will be trained and exposed to digital distribution deal structures and strategies. You will gain an understanding of how music copyrights are licensed, of the general structure of our industry, and of how commercial agreements with global and multi-territory digital partners are negotiated and executed. You will grow your ability to summarise complex thoughts, crystallise situations and potential options, isolate action points and communicate them effectively in writing to stakeholders. What makes this role unusual is the level of exposure. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with analysts, dealmakers and senior leaders in London and New York, gaining insight into commercial decision-making that most students only encounter years into their careers.
 
You will prepare and maintain benchmarking analysis tools and contribute to ad hoc projects including researching markets and business opportunities, documenting and comparing commercial agreements, building revenue forecasts and conducting in depth business analysis while working closely with negotiators and senior business analysts. You will establish yourself as a point of contact for queries relating to these areas by forging strong relationships across the business and with external contacts.

Please note: This application form cannot be saved part-way through. We recommend preparing your answers in a separate document and then copying them into the form when you’re ready to submit. If you’d like to take additional time to complete your application, please ensure you gather your responses externally before submitting in one go. 

If you have any reasonable adjustment requests, please reach out to recruitment.support@sonymusic.com.

Role Overview:

Ways of Working

  • Office attendance: Monday to Thursday
  • Flexibility: Working from home on Fridays

What you'll do:

  • Run actionable business analysis from large datasets (not just numbers, but also contracts, research etc.), pulling, visualizing, and presenting insights to instruct deal negotiations.
  • Maintain internal KPI trackers and tools (macro streaming market landscape, status on licensing, availability and pricing of hundreds of partners) using first-party partner reporting data.
  • Track and benchmark key commercial terms across our different commercial partners.
  • Assess performance, build revenue models and prepare business reviews and development activities with key partners.
  • Research and monitor the digital marketplace to identify and assess new revenue opportunities.
  • Take minutes and isolate action points in department meetings and international conference calls.
  • Gather information from local operating companies and share learnings regularly and effectively. 

Who you are:

  • This role is aimed at penultimate-year undergraduate students seeking a placement year in industry as part of their degree.
  • Although it is welcome, you do not need previous experience in music, banking, consulting or corporate finance. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, think critically and approach unfamiliar problems and ambiguity with rigour and enthusiasm.
  • You are intellectually curious, analytical and motivated by the opportunity to learn, contribute and make an impact.
  • You have a strong interest in media, entertainment, technology and digital business, and enjoy understanding how innovation creates new opportunities, changes consumer behaviour and transforms industries. A passion for music is a plus.
  • You are excited by the potential of AI and emerging technologies and interested in how they can be applied to solve business problems, improve decision-making and create concrete opportunities for growth.
  • You are comfortable working with data, numbers and technology. You have strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, an interest in data visualisation tools such as Sigma, Power BI, Tableau or Alteryx, and some exposure to quantitative analysis, financial modelling or data-driven problem solving. SQL skills are a plus.
  • You take ownership of your work, pay close attention to detail and are committed to producing high-quality output.
  • You are organised and dependable, able to balance multiple priorities and deliver against deadlines while working both independently and as part of a team.
  • You enjoy gathering information, understanding complex issues and turning analysis into clear, practical recommendations.
  • You value collaboration, act with integrity and actively seek, receive and apply feedback as part of your continued development.

What you'll gain:

  • Exposure to high-profile digital deals and strategic projects.
  • Opportunities to learn directly from experienced commercial and business development leaders.
  • Hands-on experience applying data analysis, automation and AI in a real business environment.
  • A deeper understanding of the global music industry and digital media ecosystem.
  • Experience that will accelerate your development, regardless of the career path you choose after university.

What we give you:

  • An annual salary of £28,480 (London Living Wage)
  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development such as focused workshops and a dedicated mentor, enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next 
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives 
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There’s also time off over winter break 

Process Overview

  • Applications open October 16th at 10:00 and close November 13th at 10:00. Candidates whose applications are selected will be invited to complete a task between February 1st and February 7th. 
  • Candidates who pass this stage will then be invited to the final stage of the process, an in-person interview mid February. We will send further information on this stage before the date arrives.
  • Offers will be issued for this role in March.
  • Successful applicants will start in late August/Early September.

We are committed to providing an accessible recruitment process and encourage you to let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the process by contacting this email: recruitment.support@sonymusic.com.

job.title: Business and Legal Affairs Manager, The Orchard
job.description:
Bei The Orchard ist ab sofort eine Position im Bereich Business and Legal Affairs zu besetzen – an unserem Standort Berlin. Als Volljurist:in unterstützt Du das Tagesgeschäft und die rechtlichen Anforderungen unseres Business- und Legal-Affairs-Teams.

The Orchard ist ein führendes Unternehmen für Musikvertrieb und Artist Services mit Sitz in New York und in 45 Märkten weltweit tätig – im Vertrieb unabhängiger Künstler:innen wie Bad Bunny, Gorillaz und Raye. Mit modernsten Abläufen und einem einzigartigen globalen Team arbeiten wir mit Labels jeder Größe zusammen und machen deren Musik und Videos bei Hunderten von digitalen und physischen Händlern rund um den Globus verfügbar.

Leidenschaft für Musik und die Musikbranche ist ein Muss. Mit Deinem professionellen und souveränen Auftreten baust Du starke Beziehungen zu Kolleg:innen und externen Kund:innen auf und pflegst diese. Dafür schaffen wir ein angenehmes, offenes und inspirierendes Umfeld, das Produktivität und Kreativität fördert.

Das Team von The Orchard trifft sich von Montag bis Donnerstag im Büro. Freitags wird in der Regel im Homeoffice gearbeitet.

Was du tun wirst:

  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Vertriebsverträgen mit Labels und Künstler:innen.
  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Musikverlags- und Merchandising-Verträgen.
  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Vertragsänderungen, Abtretungen und Kündigungen nach Bedarf.
  • Unterstützung bei Mergers & Acquisitions im deutschen Markt.
  • Beratung der Business- und globalen Legal-Teams zu Fragestellungen des deutschen Rechts und der hiesigen Praxis.
  • Mitarbeit im globalen Legal-Team, um Stakeholder:innen vor Ort rechtlich zu beraten.
  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung, Optimierung und Aktualisierung von Standardvertragsmustern.
  • Mitverantwortung für die Bearbeitung und Beilegung rechtlicher Ansprüche.

 Wer du bist:

  • Juristischer Abschluss und 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position und Branche.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Musikrechts.
  • Erfahrung mit Vertriebsverträgen.
  • Ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
  • Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in der Vertragsgestaltung.
  • Fundiertes Fachwissen in allen Facetten des Musikgeschäfts.
  • Ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent mit der Fähigkeit, eine Vielzahl von Projekten im Blick zu behalten, zu priorisieren und sich auf wechselnde Prioritäten einzustellen.
  • Ausgeprägt selbstständige Arbeitsweise und nachweisliche Erfahrung im erfolgreichen Abschluss von Deals.

  

English Translation:

The Orchard has an immediate opening in Business and Legal Affairs at our Berlin office. As a qualified lawyer, you will support the day-to-day legal needs and requirements of our Business and Legal Affairs team.

The Orchard is a leading music distribution and artist services company headquartered in New York and operating in 45 markets worldwide – distributing music from independent artists including Bad Bunny, Gorillaz, and Raye. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, we partner with labels of all sizes to make their music and video available across hundreds of digital and physical retailers around the world.

A passion for music and the music industry is a must. Your professional and confident approach will enable you to build and maintain strong relationships with your colleagues and external clients. In turn, we provide a comfortable, social, and engaging environment that encourages productivity and creativity.

What You’ll Do:

  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising label and artist distribution agreements.
  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising music publishing and merchandising agreements.
  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising amendments, assignments, and terminations as needed.
  • Assistance with mergers and acquisitions in the German market.
  • Advising the business and global legal teams on issues particular to German law and practice.
  • Working within the global legal team to provide in-territory legal advice to stakeholders.
  • Assisting to create, refine, and update standard contract forms.
  • Co-managing legal claim resolution processes.

Who You Are:

  • Law Degree and 2-4 years of experience in a similar position and industry.
  • Thorough knowledge of German music law.
  • Experience with distribution contracts.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent drafting skills.
  • Specialised knowledge throughout all facets of the music business.
  • Highly organised with an ability to track and prioritise a high volume of projects and adjust to changing priorities.
  • Strong autonomous working style with a proven ability to close deals.

job.title: Business Solutions Architect - PDEGO
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Business Solutions partners with our label, marketing, and release planning teams to build the tools and workflows that help them run more effectively. We operate as a trusted internal partner, not an order-taking function. Our work is guided by three principles: Fail Fast: test ideas quickly, and don't let perfection get in the way of progress; Learn Quickly: treat every iteration as a chance to learn, document, and adapt; and Move Forward: keep the work, and the people we support, moving.

The Architect is our platform strategist and systems thinker: the person who ensures our business systems ecosystem scales cleanly as it grows, while staying close enough to the business to know why it needs to. This role owns the center of excellence: defining the guardrails, patterns, and integration standards that every Business Solutions Specialist builds on, while remaining hands-on and business-facing rather than operating purely as a back-office architect.

What you'll do:

  • Define and evolve platform architecture standards and development guardrails across our core business systems
  • Partner closely with the SVP, Engineering and backend engineering on API and integration architecture
  • Evaluate and help the team adopt adjacent tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Pipedream, Salesforce, Zendesk, etc.) as workflows expand
  • Provide architectural guidance and escalation support to the Business Solutions Specialists across business units
  • Engage directly with senior stakeholders to understand cross-business-unit operations and the broader ecosystem
  • Own the technical roadmap for platform scalability and maintainability
  • Lead complex data migrations across multiple business units
  • Contribute hands-on scripting/development work (integration scripts, workflow extensions) as needed
  • Support scoping and discovery for complex, multi-BU initiatives
  • Document standards, patterns, and best practices for the team
  • Define the team's AI enablement strategy — the standards, playbooks, and success metrics Specialists use to drive sustained AI adoption within business units, including tools like Claude Cowork
  • Own governance guardrails for AI-enabled workflows in partnership with Legal, InfoSec, and Privacy, ensuring new automation and AI use cases meet enterprise compliance requirements
  • Define measures of success for the Business Solutions platform and AI enablement program; use adoption and usage data to evaluate outcomes and inform roadmap priorities

Who you are:

  • 8-12 years in solutions architecture, business systems architecture, or platform engineering, with substantial experience designing and scaling enterprise-grade no-code/low-code business systems, built to be secure, scalable, and well-governed, not just functional
  • Track record designing and scaling automation/workflow architecture across multiple business units or departments
  • Working proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., JavaScript, Python) for automation and integration work
  • Experience integrating no-code platforms with enterprise systems (CRM, ticketing, ERP) via APIs or middleware
  • Strong business acumen, able to translate business needs into technical architecture and back
  • Excellent stakeholder management; equally credible with engineers and business executives
  • A systems thinker and tool-agnostic problem solver, comfortable picking up new platforms as our stack evolves
  • Extensive A.I. experience implementing or using tools such as Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Work, Google Gemini
  • Experience building or leading a center of excellence, AI governance body, or platform governance function
  • Demonstrated ability to define measures of success and use data to evaluate outcomes and drive accountability
  • Experience working within enterprise environments with established governance, privacy, security, and compliance expectations
Nice to Have (not required)
  • Experience in music, media, or entertainment, particularly around rights, royalties, or metadata
  • Deep, hands-on Airtable expertise (our current core platform), including advanced automations and scripting extensions
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

The anticipated annual base salary does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for.  The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.New York Pay Range$165,000—$180,000 USD

job.title: Catalog Marketing Manager
job.description:
As the Manager, Catalog Marketing, you will be focused on growing SMET catalog to maximize our revenue and market share in the Taiwan market. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate music-lover to create and deliver novel and innovative digital marketing campaigns for some of the Mandopop world’s best-known catalog, deepening catalog music’s connection with existing fans and winning over new audiences.

 

What you'll do:

Campaign Creation  

  • Develop and deliver stand-out, extensive reach campaigns around local catalog 
  • Create campaigns celebrating artist milestones, album anniversaries, birthdays etc.  
  • Create cultural and seasonal campaign ideas encompassing a variety of artists and their music.  
  • Collaborate with frontline marketing teams to warm up audiences and/or promote artist catalogs around their new releases.  
  • Identify new opportunities in alignment with the business to ensure key calendar moments or festive seasons are leveraged to deliver the best return for SMET’s local catalog music in markets outside Taiwan. 

Campaign Optimization  

  • Managing regular flow of campaigns to increase market share and revenue for SMET catalog. 
  • Develop pitch presentations for all campaigns, ensuring all campaigns are delivered to life and according to budget.  
  • Use streaming and market data to identify audience targets.  
  • Liaise and collaborate with local teams for catalog artists to get broader buy-in and access where required.  
  • Track and record all coverage for executed campaigns.   
  • Design and collaborate with internal stakeholders on post campaign reporting 

Digital Optimization 

  • Grow monthly listeners for SMET overall via catalog music through optimizing performance on music streaming partners & different channels. 
  • Identifying opportunities on streaming services to grow artists, music, and playlist streams including but not limited to SEO campaigns. 
  • Maintaining and updating catalog/product listings,descriptions and metadata from time to time. 
  • Reviewing and resolving all catalog/product related issues and discrepancies resolved.  
  • Analyzing catalog performance and making recommendations for improvement. 
  • Overseeing all SMET catalogs ensuring the catalog listing is updated. 
  • Collaborating with various departments to update the catalog information.  
  • Ensuring compliance with SME’s catalog standards and guidelines. 
  • Collaborating closely with physical sales team, any vinyl and CDs revenue opportunities. 

 

Who you are:

Experience:  

  • Strong track record of launching end-to-end artists and/or music-related marketing and communication campaigns in Taiwan.  
  • Experience in successfully delivering on quantifiable business outcomes through the execution of multiplatform and omnichannel marketing initiatives in the creative industries. 
  • Deep understanding of Taiwanese music culture, trend, consumer tastes, trends & behaviors. 
  • Demonstrable experience in crafting innovative campaigns grounded in data and tied to business objectives. 

Technical capabilities:  

  • Deep passion and knowledge of music, artists, technology and a strong understanding of how & where fans engage with songs, albums, playlists, and artists. 
  • Good understanding of the music industry and all areas of the music. 
  • Adept at interpreting and analysing large volumes of data to derive actionable business insights. 
  • Ability to ideate on and edit short-form content for social media is a plus. 

Behavioral skills:  

  • Collaborative, while possessing a hunger to learn and experiment. 
  • Ability to think independently, create and develop ideas that lead to positive change/improvements. 
  • Strong creative sensibilities. 
  • Well organized with exceptionally strong communications skills that are adaptable to different personality styles and situations. 
  • Cultural awareness: Understand popular culture and the underlying cultural patterns and factors that influence behaviors in different teams and countries. 

Others: 

  • Not a status quo person, unafraid to reasonably challenge convention. 
  • Strong desire to make a difference to the music industry and contribute to successful outcomes for artists and the company. 
  • A proactive self-starter.  
  • A team player, able to form good relationships with internal and external stakeholders.  
  • Good time management and organizational skills, able to perform under pressure. 
  • Great verbal and written communications skills combined with interpersonal skills working across multiple cultures. 
  • Passion for music, digital media and innovation is a MUST. 
  • Fluent in both English and Mandarin. 

 

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day

job.title: Catalogue Growth & Commercial Manager
job.description:
The Senior Executive / Manager, Catalogue Growth & Commercialization plays a hybrid role across catalogue operations and commercial growth for Sony Music Entertainment Malaysia. This role is responsible for backend catalogue ingestion, optimization and M&A-related due diligence support, while also driving opportunities across D2C, website, AVOD monetization, SEO, analytics and DSP/platform optimization. Success in this role means ensuring catalogue assets are operationally ready, commercially optimized and positioned to maximize long-tail audience growth and revenue.   

What you'll do:

  • Works independently as well as closely with various departments within Malaysia, the Asia Pacific region and external partners to support both Catalogue/Ops and Commercial Growth priorities.  
  • Manages backend catalogue ingestion, optimization and digital supply chain workflows for acquired, legacy and M&A-related assets, covering product registration, metadata validation, delivery, scheduling, quality control, digitisation and operational readiness across DSPs, video platforms and partner services.  
  • Supports M&A evaluation and due diligence by reviewing sales and performance reports, validating catalogue data and coordinating asset submission requirements for potential acquisition opportunities, including audio, video, metadata, artwork, rights documentation and related historical materials where applicable.  
  • Supports Sony Music Malaysia’s commercial growth initiatives across D2C and e-commerce for artist merchandise and physical products, website upkeep and optimisation, AVOD and channel monetisation, and wider catalogue commercialisation opportunities.  
  • Analyses and optimizes performance across Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, AVOD and other partner services by improving metadata, release setup, content packaging, channel hygiene, discoverability and audience signals to strengthen algorithmic performance, engagement and revenue.  
  • Tracks and reports catalogue, website, D2C and partner platform performance, supports SEO and discoverability improvements, and identifies actionable optimization opportunities to improve long-tail catalogue value and monetisation outcomes.  
  • Assists the team in solving operational and platform issues when required, including metadata mismatches, DSP mapping issues, delivery issues, rights conflicts, YouTube blockage issues and other backend or optimization-related matters.  

 

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in music business, digital business, marketing, e-commerce, media, analytics, business management or any related field is preferred.  
  • At least 4-6 years of relevant work experience for Senior Executive level, or stronger experience for Manager level, across digital operations, catalogue management, digital marketing, e-commerce, analytics, SEO, AVOD or related commercial digital functions.  
  • Strong understanding of digital music and video ecosystems, DSP servicing, metadata, platform workflows and catalogue optimization; familiarity with D2C, website management, SEO and analytics is an added advantage.  
  • Able to review and interpret sales and performance data, with an understanding of discoverability drivers, partner platform best practices and optimization levers across Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, AVOD and similar services.  
  • Extremely detail-oriented and organized, capable of managing multiple workflows and timelines, while being proactive, commercially aware, adaptable and confident working cross-functionally in a fast-moving environment.

 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey 
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork 
  • Industry leading benefits across the board to all employees – from discounts on private health insurance and Sony products, to progressive wellbeing services including an award winning EAP and complimentary subscriptions to apps, telehealth, salary packaging for novated car leases, and life insurance and income protection… and of course, many music biz perks 
  • We invest in your professional growth & development

job.title: Chef de Projet VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) F/H/NB
job.description:
Rattaché(e) à la Direction des Opérations et du Commercial Physique, le/la Cheffe de projet V.M.I. est responsable du pilotage, du déploiement et de l'optimisation du dispositif de Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) auprès des enseignes partenaires.

À ce titre, il/elle assure la gestion des stocks confiés, garantit la disponibilité des produits tout en optimisant les niveaux de stock, coordonne les différents intervenants internes et externes, et contribue au développement ainsi qu'à l'amélioration continue du modèle VMI afin d'en assurer la performance opérationnelle et économique.

Vos missions: 

Optimiser les stocks et les approvisionnements

  • Administrer les stocks clients et organiser le réapprovisionnement afin de garantir la disponibilité produit sans surstock
  • Définir et ajuster les paramètres de réapprovisionnement (seuils, quantités, fréquences) en fonction des ventes et de la saisonnalité

Piloter la performance

  • Développer le chiffre d’affaires en analysant les indicateurs clés (taux de service, rotation, référencement)
  • Identifier et corriger les écarts de stock ou de facturation en lien avec les équipes finance et logistique

Amélioration continue

  • Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue du système VMI (outils, process, indicateurs, I.A.)
  • Proposer et mettre en œuvre des actions correctives ou d'optimisation en concertation avec les équipes internes et les partenaires

 

Le profil que nous recherchons : 

  • Vous avez une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en commerce, gestion, logistique ou supply chain
  • Vous maîtrisez Excel ainsi que les outils de gestion de stocks et de réapprovisionnement
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les mécanismes de facturation et de dépôt-vente en grande distribution
  • Vous avez le sens du contact et savez travailler en transversal avec des interlocuteurs variés (magasins, équipes commerciales, logistiques et financières)
  • Vous avez l’esprit d'analyse et êtes force de proposition pour l'amélioration continue
  • Vous avez la capacité à gérer les priorités sur un périmètre multi-enseignes

 

En intégrant Sony Music vous pourrez profiter de plusieurs avantages :

  • 13 jours de RTT par an
  • 1 jour de télétravail possible par semaine et 10 jours supplémentaires par an
  • 13ème mois
  • Prime d’intéressement
  • Une carte restaurant prise en charge à 60 %
  • Une mutuelle avantageuse
  • Un forfait mobilité durable à hauteur 500 €/année complète
  • Un parking pour votre vélo tout au long de l’année
  • Accès à une plateforme de santé mentale et de bien-être qui permet de parler à un psychologue expérimenté​
  • Un programme de bien-être « massage ou Ostéo »
  • Des fruits frais mis à disposition chaque semaine et des boissons chaudes gratuites
  • Town hall avec petits déjeuners
  • De remises exceptionnelles sur une large sélection de produits Sony Electronics
  • Des Chèques vacances et carte cadeau Noël offerts par le CSE
  • Rejoindre Sony Music c’est également l’opportunité de participer à des events tel que la Summer et la Christmas Party

Vous vous reconnaissez à travers ce profil et l’aventure Sony Music Entertainment France vous tente ? Nous avons déjà hâte de faire votre connaissance.

job.title: College Marketing Representative, Atlanta - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 48 markets worldwide and servicing top global independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with clients to provide full scale solutions across a variety of verticals. Championed by an exceptional community of music lovers and experts, The Orchard empowers creators to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global industry.  

  

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity. 

As a paid part‑time employee of The Orchard, you’ll serve as a key advocate for the artists we distribute. Each month, you’ll promote 10–20 artists through a mix of digital and in‑person marketing across your campus and college town. You’ll be a tastemaker in your community, collaborating with student organizations, local businesses, record stores, DJs, promoters, and more to build meaningful visibility for new releases and touring artists across a wide range of genres.

In this role, you’ll lead listening events, organize campus activations, and create social media content that directly supports our artists. You’ll gain hands-on experience in music marketing while staying ahead of the curve on emerging talent and new music, all while shaping how students in your market discover and engage with The Orchard’s roster.

What you'll do:

  • Organically create awareness of The Orchard’s artists by cultivating authentic relationships with key campus and local influencers including college radio, student organizations, newspapers, and community media to unlock opportunities for reviews, radio plays, interviews, and standout exposure.
  • Maintain a local social media presence that promotes the artists you’ll be working with, utilizing a mix of digital assets that are supplied to you and creating your own content to support The Orchard’s artists
  • Implement in-person marketing initiatives at record stores, lifestyle shops, and on campus
  • Research appropriate online sites, forums, and networks for the key 18-24yr old demographic for each artist
  • Research & attend local and campus events that will best facilitate the promotion of our artists
  • Attend our artists' shows to hand out promotional tools and get feedback from fans
  • Submit a detailed report on your marketing successes and initiatives for each campaign you run

Perks:

  • You will gain real world music industry experience that will be a great addition to your resume
  • You have the opportunity to express your creativity through your locally run social channels, in our team brainstorms, and in your concert/album reviews
  • You’ll have access to inside information that will improve your marketing outreach
  • You’ll receive free ticket(s) into our artists’ shows & possible meet and greet passes
  • You’ll build valuable relationships within your local music industry
  • + many more!

Who you are:

  • You are an Undergraduate Student currently enrolled in a 4 year university in Atlanta with a minimum of 2 years left prior to graduation
  • You are able to manage your own hours and be accountable for the work assigned to you
  • You have a passion for music, an understanding of how your peers discover and consume music, and a deep interest in music business & marketing
  • You have an understanding of social media marketing, you stay current on trends, and you have an active presence creating content on TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube
  • You have availability of 20 hours per week
  • You’re well-written, well-spoken, a team player, and an excellent communicator
  • You have transportation methods and live within 30 minutes of Atlanta
  • You have a flexible schedule for team conference calls and tour coverage

What We Give You

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • Opportunities to connect with our valuable resources, such as our Counsel of Equity & Progressive Action (CEPA), a group created by our employees tasked with developing and implementing innovative solutions to advance a globally-shared goal of ensuring fair and inclusive spaces for all
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess 

 

The Orchard is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
