job.title: Coordinator, Production - The Merch Collective
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As Production Coordinator, you will be responsible for assisting the Production Department with managing the day-to-day workflow, ensuring that projects run smoothly and deadlines are met. Your role will encompass working with all internal departments and numerous screen printers, embroiderers, and various ancillary vendors to help improve workflow and streamline production systems for efficiency and consistency.

What you'll do:

  • Manage the data entry of new garment SKUs, new client item SKU requests from the Account Management team, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timely completion.
  • Manage the data entry of Purchase Orders into Quickbooks or other current purchasing tool. Match incoming Vendor invoices to POs in system for payment approval.
  • Support the Production team by maintaining accurate updates in internal systems (Asana) and providing internal teams with order updates, packing lists, and tracking information upon order fulfillment.
  • Coordinate the vendor onboarding process. Organize required paperwork and system uploads. Maintain the vendor catalogue.
  • Track and communicate PO adjustments, including design changes, across internal systems and tools. Ensure changes are communicated (via Asana) to other teams.
  • Assist the Production team in reviewing samples, strike-offs and pre-production proofs to ensure accuracy in order quantity, ship date, artwork, sizing, garments, and client guidelines before full production begins. 

Who you are:

  • 1-3 years of experience in production coordination, merchandising, apparel, or related fields (music or entertainment industry experience a plus).
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail and a sharp eye for consistency.
  • Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) with a problem-solving mindset and the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
  • Proficiency in project management and collaboration platforms and tools (e.g. Asana, Monday).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
  • Proficiency in Quickbooks is preferred, but not required.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

job.title: Corporate Development Manager
job.description:
Established in 1997, Sony Music Entertainment is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, Japan, with a presence in over 100 countries through our affiliates. We have nurtured some of music's most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Sony Music's Corporate Development team for Asia & the Middle East works across some of the highest-growth music markets in the world, and has been behind many of the region's most significant transactions. Our work spans M&A and minority investments in music and entertainment businesses, music IP catalogue acquisitions, and strategic joint ventures.

We're seeking a highly analytical Manager to join us, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development, Asia & Middle East. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in financial modeling, commercial analysis, and deal execution, with a genuine interest in music, entertainment, and media.

 

What you will do:

  • Financial Modeling: Build and own the financial models underpinning valuation and deal structuring.
  • Commercial Analysis: Conduct industry and competitor analysis to evaluate potential acquisition and investment targets, joint ventures, and strategic initiatives.
  • Due Diligence: Participate in all aspects of due diligence, including financial, tax, legal, and operational; coordinate with external advisors and cross-functional teams across Asia, London, and New York.
  • Deal Execution: Support the end-to-end deal process from initial assessment through closing.
  • Presentation: Draft investment memos to communicate with senior management, crafting compelling stories and presentations that convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
  • Internal Reporting: Maintain the regional deal pipeline and report on the performance of completed investments against the original investment thesis.

 

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business, economics, engineering, or a quantitative discipline. MBA, CFA, or an equivalent advanced credential is a plus.
  • Minimum of five years' experience in corporate development, deal advisory, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or a similar analytical role.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, with strong proficiency in financial modeling and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with large datasets, such as digital sales and streaming reports, to support deal analysis. Advanced Excel is essential; Python, SQL, or experience using AI/LLM tools to accelerate analysis is a plus.
  • Ability to craft compelling stories and presentations to convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
  • Fluency in English; another Southeast Asian language is a bonus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Passionate about the music, entertainment, and media sector.

 

What we give you:

•   You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey

job.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
The Digital Marketing Coordinator is a key support role within the Digital Marketing & Audience Development team, providing hands-on assistance across artist and label campaigns. The role will work closely with Digital, Marketing, Social & Content, Influencer and wider label teams to support domestic and international artist campaigns across paid, owned and earned digital channels. The Coordinator will build and deliver email communications, support database growth and segmentation, and maintain CRM best practice. Alongside this, they will gain broad experience across digital marketing, including social media, content, creator campaigns, digital platforms, reporting and campaign coordination.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is highly organised, digitally savvy, creative and passionate about music and internet culture, and who is looking to develop a broad career in digital marketing.

What you'll do:

Digital Campaign Support

  • Serve as a key contact for the digital marketing team, collaborating with internal managers, artists, labels, and external partners to deliver domestic and international campaigns.
  • Manage day-to-day project workflows, including campaign timelines, tracking documents, asset folders, release links, and general digital housekeeping.
  • Support paid media execution, creator and influencer activations, fan acquisition pages, competitions, and pre-save campaigns

Social, Content & Owned Channels

  • Support the delivery and scheduling of social media plans across label-owned platforms, including TikTok and Instagram, while contributing to overall channel strategy.
  • Capture mobile-first content at live shows, events, and artist shoots, performing basic short-form video editing like cutting clips, subtitling, and adding trending audio.
  • Identify strategic opportunities across social channels and campaign touchpoints to convert social followers into owned channel audiences.

CRM & Audience Development

  • Build, schedule, and execute targeted email and SMS CRM campaigns for artist and label accounts, maintaining the master CRM calendar.
  • Grow first-party fan databases by managing data capture across websites, pre-saves, and competitions while maintaining CRM data hygiene and privacy compliance.
  • Develop, test, and optimise automated fan journeys, sign-up flows, and lifecycle messaging to improve overall campaign conversion.

Reporting & Insights

  • Collect and analyse campaign metrics across social, CRM, paid media, and UGC activity using internal and external reporting tools.
  • Consolidate performance data into regular reports and share actionable insights to inform future marketing strategy and campaign optimization.

Trends, Innovation & Team Development

  • Monitor emerging digital trends, platform updates, streaming features, and internet culture to identify creative opportunities for artists.
  • Prepare internal presentations, case studies, and educational updates for the broader marketing team and assist in key digital partner meetings

Who you are:

  • Passionate about music, digital culture, and how audiences engage with artists across social, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Creative, curious, and proactive, with an interest in audience development, CRM, and content strategy.
  • Data-literate, able to interpret campaign performance and turn insights into action.
  • Highly organised, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong communicator and collaborative team player who enjoys working with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience in digital marketing, CRM, social media, content, or the wider entertainment industry.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, reporting tools, and the ability to quickly learn new platforms and technologies.
  • Experience working within a record label, music company, creative agency, or similar environment.
  • Hands-on experience delivering social media campaigns, CRM communications, or short-form video content.
  • Familiarity with creative tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, website CMS platforms, fan capture tools, and digital music marketing workflows

job.title: Digital Marketing Manager, Catalogue
job.description:
The Digital Marketing Catalogue Manager is responsible for developing and executing digital marketing strategies to maximize the visibility, engagement, and revenue of the company’s catalogue repertoire across digital platforms. This role focuses on promoting existing catalogue content, driving audience growth, and optimizing digital campaigns through data-driven insights.

What you'll do:

  • Manage and optimize catalogue campaigns to increase streams, engagement, and digital revenue.
  • Work closely with artists, label teams, and external partners to identify opportunities for catalogue promotion.
  • Plan and implement digital advertising campaigns including social media, display, and platform marketing.

  • Coordinate with creative teams for the development of digital assets, content, and promotional materials.
  • Manage digital marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of resources.

Who you are:

  • Minimum 4-6 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in music, media, entertainment, advertising agencies, radio, content, publishing, or other consumer-facing industries.
  • Strong understanding of digital platforms, streaming services, social media marketing, and audience engagement.

As Director, Digital Media Planning with AWAL, you will support paid media strategy and campaign execution across multiple markets. This role will work closely with global artist marketing and audience development teams to plan, optimize, and analyze digital advertising campaigns that drive audience growth, engagement, and consumption for priority artists and releases. You will challenge traditional music marketing frameworks, blending data-driven insights with creative curiosity to ensure our artists consistently cut through the noise of a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

What you'll do:

  • Media Planning & Strategy
    • Develop paid media plans aligned with marketing priorities for artist campaigns, releases, and project initiatives.
    • Identify optimal platform mix, audience segment & targeting strategies, and budget allocation across digital channels.
    • Translate marketing objectives into performance-driven media strategies.
    • Design and analyze experiments using platform features (Spotify Marquee, YouTube Shorts, etc) to determine the most cost-effective ways to drive revenue and engagement.
  • Campaign Execution & Optimization
    • Collaborate with internal and external teams to identify and create campaign assets
    • Work with internal teams and agency partners to launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across platforms such as:
      • Meta (Instagram / Facebook)
      • TikTok
      • YouTube / Google
      • Snapchat

    • Analyze the "full-funnel" fan experience and track how a fan moves from a TikTok discovery through a link click to a Spotify save to a merch or ticket purchase. Identify friction points and drop-offs in the conversion chain.
    • Track campaign performance and deliver actionable insights and reporting.
    • Analyze audience and platform data to refine targeting strategies and improve ROI.
    • Build performance dashboards and post-campaign recaps for key stakeholders.
  • Global Collaboration
    • Work with artist marketing teams in the US, UK and international to align media strategy with campaign goals including audience segmentation and targeting.
    • Coordinate with creative and audience development teams to ensure campaign cohesion.

What you'll do:

job.title: Finance Accountant
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is currently looking for an experienced Financial Accountant to join our Finance team. You will be looking after our Malaysia and Singapore entities. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will be an integral member of the Sony Music Finance team and will be responsible for ensuring all reporting completed accurately and on time. 

What you'll do 

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

  • Manage end-to-end accounts payable processes, including purchase requests, purchase orders, supplier invoice verification, three-way matching, invoice processing, and payment workflows in accordance with company policies and approval requirements.
  • Review payment proposals prepared by shared services teams and ensure payment instructions are accurate and properly approved.
  • Manage accounts receivable activities including client invoicing, collections follow-up, cash application, receipting, and resolution of billing discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate supplier and customer master data, supporting documentation, and respond to internal and external stakeholder enquiries in a timely manner.

General Ledger, Financial Close & Reporting

  • Prepare and post month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, provisions, and other accounting adjustments.
  • Perform monthly balance sheet and general ledger reconciliations, including bank accounts, accounts payable, receivables, accruals, provisions, and other assigned accounts, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.
  • Prepare management accounts and support the interface between local statutory ledgers and corporate reporting ledgers, including US GAAP reporting requirements.
  • Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial closing activities, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded within reporting deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation to support financial integrity, audit readiness, and compliance with US GAAP, IFRS, and company accounting policies.

Financial Planning & Business Support

  • Support monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes using global reporting and planning tools.
  • Assist in financial analysis and provide insights to support business decision-making and operational planning.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, highlighting key variances and trends to stakeholders.

Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Assist with tax compliance activities across Singapore and Malaysia, ensuring timely and accurate submission of required tax filings and reporting obligations.
  • Support periodic withholding tax filings, VAT/GST filings, annual corporate income tax returns, and other statutory tax submissions in accordance with local regulations.
  • Prepare and coordinate group tax reporting packages, including information required for corporate tax consolidation and global reporting requirements.
  • Assist with non-resident withholding tax (NRWT) compliance, including review of applicable requirements, supporting documentation, and timely submission of filings.
  • Maintain accurate tax records and supporting documentation while liaising with internal stakeholders, external tax advisors, and tax authorities to resolve queries and ensure compliance.

Audit, Governance & Internal Controls

  • Support year-end statutory audits by preparing audit schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for external auditors.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, tax requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency.

Royalty & Special Projects

  • Prepare royalty statements and financial reporting for joint venture deals, licensing arrangements, and other commercial agreements.
  • Support finance transformation initiatives, process improvement projects, and other ad hoc assignments as required.

Who you are

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of accounts payable, general ledger, reconciliation processes, and financial close activities.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies and maintain financial accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple entities, currencies, and deadlines while working effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and finance teams.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative finance team environment.

Education and Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related discipline, with CA/CPA qualification or progress towards professional qualification preferred.
  • 5 years of experience in accounts payable, general ledger accounting, financial accounting, or a similar finance operations role within a multinational or fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on experience in invoice processing, purchase order workflows, payment runs, journal entries, month-end closing, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Experience with SAP ERP, Business Warehouse (BW), or other financial systems is preferred, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting processes, and internal controls, with experience managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

What we give you

 

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community

job.title: Finance Analyst
job.description:
At Sony Music Entertainment Canada Inc., we fuel the creative journey. We have played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We have nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time. Today, we work in more than 60 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we are committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.  Sony Music Entertainment Canada Inc. is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Reports to: Senior Manager, Finance

Work Location: Liberty Village, Toronto

Salary Grade: 29

Salary Range: $56,000 to 60,000 CAD

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

Work Arrangement: At least four (4) days/week onsite, 37.5 hours a week

The Finance Analyst supports the Finance team through joint venture and hybrid deal reporting, account reconciliations, physical sales reporting, month-end support, tax fillings and recurring financial analyses. The role is responsible for accurate and timely preparation of partner reporting, supporting schedules, and reconciliations, while maintaining clear documentation and escalating irregular items to the Senior Manager, Finance.

The Role

The Finance Analyst will:

  • Prepare third-party label reporting, statements, and supporting schedules in accordance with contractual agreements.
  • Monitor reporting and filing deadlines to ensure timely, accurate submissions and compliance with agreement requirements.
  • Prepare journal entries, recurring billing and allocation schedules, and support month-end close activities.
  • Perform monthly account reconciliations, investigate variances, and resolve outstanding reconciling items.
  • Maintain complete and accurate supporting documentation for audit, compliance, and review purposes.
  • Produce recurring sales, product mix, and financial reporting to support business planning and accounting processes.
  • Generate periodic reports using finance systems and provide ad hoc analysis and reporting support to Finance leadership.
  • Prepare and submit indirect tax filings, supporting reconciliations, and corporate tax reporting schedules.
  • Support statutory reporting requirements and maintain documentation related to filing obligations, assumptions, exceptions, and supporting evidence.
  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for process improvement.

Qualifications:

  • 2-4 years of experience in accounting, financial reporting, reconciliations, or financial analysis
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, commerce, business administration, or related field
  • CPA designation, active progress towards CPA, or active pursuit of another internationally recognized accounting designation such as ACCA, ACA, CA, CMA, or an equivalent designation is an asset.
  • Advanced Excel skills and ability to analyze large volumes of financial data.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet recurring deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy when working independently.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present financial information clearly to a variety of stakeholders.
  • Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is an asset.
  • Experience with joint ventures, distribution arrangements and royalty accounting is an asset.
  • Experience in the media, music, entertainment, or content distribution industry is an asset.

What We Give You:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development, enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next 
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives 

Sony Music Entertainment Canada Inc., is committed to Employment Equity and maintaining a diverse workforce. Job applicants with a disability who require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process can contact our People Experience team. Reasonable accommodation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and your request will be responded to as soon as possible.

job.title: Finance Director
job.description:
The Finance Director is the strategic finance business partner to the Country General Manager and regional leadership, providing commercial and financial leadership to drive sustainable business growth and value creation. The role is responsible for leading the country's financial planning and analysis, business partnering, commercial deal evaluation, financial reporting, governance, and compliance, while ensuring strong financial controls and operational excellence.

Working closely with commercial, marketing, A&R, business development, legal, and regional finance teams, the Finance Director provides financial insights to support strategic initiatives, artist investments, licensing and distribution agreements, and other commercial opportunities. The role leads budgeting, forecasting, business case development, and performance management to support informed decision-making and deliver business objectives.

In addition to its strategic focus, the role oversees all aspects of the country finance function, including accounting, treasury, cash flow management, financial reporting, tax, audit, internal controls, and statutory compliance, ensuring adherence to company policies, IFRS, and local regulatory requirements. The Finance Director also drives process improvements, cost optimisation, and effective risk management while partnering with regional finance and shared service teams to deliver a high-performing finance function.

 

What you'll do 

Business Partnering, Commercial Finance & Strategic Planning

  • Partner with the Country General Manager (GM), Regional Managing Director, and cross-functional teams including Commercial, Marketing, A&R, Business Development, Legal, and Business Affairs to evaluate business opportunities and strategic initiatives.
  • Act as the trusted finance business partner, providing commercial and financial insights to support strategic decision-making and sustainable business growth.
  • Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, investments, partnerships, and commercial transactions by developing financial models, business cases, and scenario analyses.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes for the country, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives.
  • Deliver insightful management reporting, financial analysis, and performance scorecards to country and regional leadership, providing recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.

Commercial Transactions, Artist Deals & Strategic Investments

  • Provide financial leadership and commercial support for artist signings, licensing agreements, royalty arrangements, publishing, distribution, and other commercial transactions.
  • Evaluate deal economics, profitability, recoupment structures, investment returns, and financial risks associated with artist contracts and commercial agreements.
  • Partner with Legal and Business Affairs during contract negotiations and deal execution.
  • Support strategic investment initiatives and M&A activities by performing financial analysis, due diligence, valuation, and post-investment performance monitoring where applicable.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Performance Management

  • Drive budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and financial planning in accordance with global finance processes.
  • Ensure accurate revenue, cost, and cash flow forecasting while monitoring performance against financial targets and key business metrics.
  • Prepare monthly management reports, financial dashboards, variance analyses, and forecasts for country management and regional finance.
  • Manage affiliate performance reporting and maintain a single source of financial data for business decision-making.

Finance Operations & Financial Control

  • Lead the country finance function, overseeing accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury, payroll, royalty processing, cash flow management, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.
  • Ensure accurate preparation of financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow) in accordance with IFRS, company policies, and local statutory requirements.
  • Drive operational excellence, finance process improvements, and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency and strengthen financial controls.
  • Maintain effective governance frameworks, finance policies, and internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure compliance.

Risk Management, Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, IFRS, local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and internal control standards.
  • Manage statutory audits and maintain relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory authorities.
  • Oversee corporate income tax, GST/VAT, withholding tax, transfer pricing, and statutory reporting obligations.
  • Monitor cash flow, liquidity, and financial risks while safeguarding company assets and investments.
  • Drive cost control initiatives, manage operating expenses and headcount budgets, and ensure efficient use of financial resources.
  • Ensure timely royalty processing, financial reconciliations, and resolution of operational backlogs.

 

 

Who you are

Experience

  • 10–15 years of progressive finance experience spanning commercial finance, FP&A, financial control, and business partnering, with a proven track record in multinational organisations. Experience in the media, entertainment, consumer, or other fast-paced industries is an advantage.
  • Solid experience within a medium-sized to large international organisation, partnering closely with regional finance teams while serving as the finance lead for an in-country business.
  • Proven ability to act as a strategic finance business partner within a matrix organisation, influencing senior stakeholders and supporting commercial decision-making.
  • Demonstrated track record of combining strong financial and commercial acumen to identify business risks and opportunities, drive FP&A initiatives, and support sustainable business growth.

Capabilities

  • Strategic Finance & Business Partnering: Strong expertise in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, business case development, performance reporting, and commercial decision support.
  • Finance Leadership & Operational Excellence: Proven ability to lead finance operations, strengthen governance and internal controls, optimise finance processes, and drive continuous improvement through automation and operational excellence.
  • People & Stakeholder Leadership: Effective leader with experience developing high-performing teams and building trusted relationships with business leaders, regional finance, artists and their ecosystem, and internal and external stakeholders across a matrix organisation.
  • Commercial & Analytical Acumen: Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate financial insights into actionable recommendations, balancing commercial objectives with financial discipline and risk management.

Education and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, or a related discipline; an MBA in Finance or Accounting is an advantage.
  • Professional accounting qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent preferred, with strong knowledge of IFRS, financial reporting, tax, statutory compliance, ERP systems, and advanced financial analysis tools.
  • Fluent in both English and Vietnamese.

 

What we give you

  • An opportunity to influence the strategic direction of our Southeast Asia business 
  • The ability to foster innovation and make a significant impact on the domestic music industry in Southeast Asia
  • You join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community that empowers you to drive the creative journey
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork
  • We are committed to investing in your personal growth and development.

 

 

Equal Opportunities:

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.
We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.

job.title: Finance Manager - The Merch Collective
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Merch Collective is a strategic merchandise partner connecting our clients to their fans. We are an agile creative practice built to solve the commercial and creative challenges of the world’s top artists. As Sony Music’s merchandise partner, we serve a roster of global talented—both within and beyond the Sony ecosystem. We’re defined by our commitment to product excellence, delivering products that are made to be kept, worn, and loved for years to come. Our best-in-class creative team delivers culture-leading, artist-specific collections that build artist brands beyond their music. Most importantly, we deliver customer excellence, embedding ourselves as an extension of each client’s team, bringing transparency, accountability, and tailored support to every partnership.

As a Finance Manager at The Merch Collective you’ll work closely with the Assistant Controller overseeing financial operations, with a concentration on Artist Royalties and Accounts Receivable. Your role will encompass assisting with providing variance analysis and recommended corrective actions to improve financial performance. Success in the role will be dependent on strong analytical skills. 

What you'll do:

  • Assistance with the ownership of all Royalty Statements, including coordination across departments to reconcile all associated revenue, COGS and other expenses summarized in a completed settlement at the end of each Tour. Oversite and management of data calculations to confirm accuracy before final approvals for settlements and payment submissions.
  • Conduct Quickbooks general ledger activity research in analyzing account balance and transaction details and preparing journal entries as needed. Prepare and analyze monthly financial reporting. Daily banking and QuickBooks reconciliations.
  • Assist with Month end close: monthly reporting of actual performance, reconciling financial statements. Research and collection of Accounts Receivable open invoicing.
  • Communications across multiple departments to resolve discrepancies and process outlying data exceptions.
  • Research and special projects as assigned.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • 2 - 3 years of proven accounting experience in a fast-paced environment managing month-end close processes
  • Proficiency with financial systems and tools (SAP Business Objects/BPC experience preferred)
  • Highly skilled in Microsoft Excel (index/match, lookups, pivot tables, etc.) and proficient in other Microsoft Office suite applications
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.

job.title: Global Artist Accounting Analyst - Ceremony Of Roses
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As the Analyst, Global Artist Accounting at Ceremony of Roses, you will support artist accounting, royalty reporting, and financial operations across the Ceremony of Roses group of companies, which are part of Sony Music Entertainment. This role serves as a flexible shared resource across COR's affiliated businesses, providing support on a need-based basis as priorities and workloads shift across the group. You will partner with finance and operating teams across affiliates to help deliver timely and accurate artist settlements, interpret contractual economics, reconcile underlying financial activity, and support accurate financial reporting. Success in this role requires strong accounting and analytical skills, attention to detail, comfort working across multiple businesses and systems, and the ability to prioritize effectively in a dynamic environment. This is an office-first role located in Culver City, CA and requires working 4 days in office per week.

What you'll do:

Artist Accounting & Royalty Settlements

  • Prepare and maintain artist royalty statements and settlement schedules across multiple revenue channels, including Tour, Ecommerce, Retail, and Licensing, for affiliates across the Ceremony of Roses group.
  • Review artist contracts and related agreements to ensure accurate interpretation and application of royalty rates, profit splits, recoupable costs, advances, and other settlement terms.
  • Reconcile revenue, costs, cash activity, and other settlement inputs to underlying operational and accounting records.
  • Identify settlement discrepancies, investigate variances, and coordinate with affiliate finance and operating teams to resolve issues on a timely basis.

Affiliate Support & Workload Triage

  • Provide artist accounting and finance support across Ceremony of Roses affiliated companies based on business needs, settlement calendars, and workload priorities.
  • Partner with finance leads across the group to assess open deliverables, prioritize work, and provide additional capacity where it is most needed.
  • Adapt to different affiliate processes, systems, and business models while helping drive consistency in artist accounting practices across the group.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Support analysis of artist and project economics, including revenue, costs, margins, royalties, and settlement performance across revenue channels.
  • Assist with variance analysis and other financial reporting needed to explain artist, project, or affiliate performance.
  • Prepare schedules, analyses, and reporting materials for affiliate finance teams and Ceremony of Roses leadership as needed.

Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Support month-end close activities across affiliates, including preparation and review of artist royalty, revenue, cost, and tour-related accruals.
  • Reconcile artist accounting and operational data to the general ledger and investigate differences across systems or reporting sources.
  • Partner with affiliate Accounting and Finance teams to support complete, accurate, and timely financial reporting.

Process Improvement & Special Projects

  • Help standardize artist accounting, settlement, and reconciliation processes across the Ceremony of Roses group while respecting affiliate-specific business requirements.
  • Assist with process improvements, documentation, and automation initiatives that improve the timeliness and accuracy of artist accounting and reporting.
  • Support ad hoc finance, accounting, and cross-functional projects across affiliates as priorities evolve.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • 1 – 2 years of experience in accounting, artist/royalty accounting, financial analysis, or related roles.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to reconcile and analyze large or detailed financial datasets.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to interpret contracts and translate financial terms into accurate royalty and settlement calculations.
  • Experience with royalty reporting, artist accounting, revenue-share arrangements, or similar contractual accounting models.
  • Experience working with merchandise, Ecommerce, retail, touring, licensing, music, entertainment, or consumer product revenue streams is preferred.
  • Familiarity with SAP, ERP systems, royalty platforms, or other financial reporting tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across different teams, affiliates, and operating environments.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

job.title: IT Manager
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment är ett av världens ledande musikbolag med drygt 5 000 medarbetare globalt. På Sony Music Sverige arbetar ca 80 medarbetare med att dagligen skapa, utveckla, marknadsföra och distribuera våra artisters musik ur vårt breda urval av svensk och internationell repertoar. Vår vision är att vara Sveriges bästa musikbolag och arbetsplats inom branschen, kända för vår innovation, kreativitet och framgång, präglat av mångfald och passion för musik.

Sammanfattning av rollen
Just nu söker vi en IT Manager till Sony Music Sverige. I rollen som IT Manager ansvarar du för att våra medarbetare har en stabil, säker och välfungerande digital arbetsmiljö. Rollen kombinerar verksamhetsnära och praktiskt IT-arbete med samordning av support, Microsoft 365, lokala system, externa leverantörer och vår globala IT-organisation. Du driver även förbättringar, dokumentation och uppföljning av IT- och säkerhetskrav. Rollen är baserad i Stockholm och innebär arbete från kontoret fem dagar i veckan.

Vad kommer du att göra?

  • Ansvara för att den lokala IT-miljön är stabil, säker och användarvänlig.
  • Leda och följa upp den dagliga IT-supporten, samt hantera eskaleringar och säkerställa att medarbetarna får rätt hjälp.
  • Ansvara för datorer, nätverk, mötesrum, IT-utrustning, konton och behörigheter.
  • Säkerställa välfungerande IT-processer vid onboarding/offboarding.
  • Förvalta Microsoft 365 och utvalda verksamhetskritiska system samt samordna frågor mellan verksamheten, globala IT-team, utvecklare och externa leverantörer.
  • Säkerställa att dokumentation, rutiner och behörighetshantering är aktuella och fungerar samt samordna återkommande kontroller och aktiviteter inom compliance och IT-säkerhet.
  • Följa upp kostnader, återkommande problem och förbättringsbehov samt driva relevanta åtgärder.

Vem är du?

  • Du har relevant erfarenhet av operativ IT, IT Operations, Digital Workplace, IT-förvaltning eller liknande ansvar och är bekväm med både praktiska och samordnande uppgifter.
  • Du har god kunskap om Microsoft 365, Windows och macOS samt erfarenhet av nätverk, klienthantering, mötesrum och AV.
  • Du har erfarenhet av användarsupport, leverantörsstyrning samt processer för onboarding, offboarding, behörigheter, licenser och IT-utrustning.
  • Du arbetar strukturerat med dokumentation, processer och uppföljning och har förståelse för informationssäkerhet, behörighetsmodeller, compliance och intern kontroll.
  • Du är lösningsorienterad, serviceinriktad och trygg i att prioritera, samordna och driva frågor till avslut.
  • Du är pedagogisk och kan kommunicera tydligt på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.
  • Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Entra ID, Intune, ITIL-baserade arbetssätt, asset management, systemintegrationer eller arbete i en global organisation.

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • En central och verksamhetsnära roll med helhetsansvar för den lokala IT-leveransen.
  • Möjlighet att skapa struktur, utveckla arbetssätt och förbättra den digitala vardagen i ett kreativt och internationellt musikbolag.
  • Möjlighet att arbeta i en internationell miljö med nära kontaktytor till vår globala IT-organisation och externa specialister.
  • Konkurrenskraftig lön, förmåner och goda möjligheter till professionell utveckling.

Ansökan

Är detta rollen för dig? Skicka in din ansökan senast den 23 oktober 2026. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Som en aktiv del i ett samhälle med kulturell och social mångfald är Sony Musics ambition att präglas av inkludering och bred representation, samt vara en arbetsplats med lika möjligheter för alla. Sony Music anställer, bibehåller, befordrar och i övrigt behandlar alla medarbetare och kandidater efter erfarenhet, kvalifikationer och kompetens, oavsett kön, religion, ursprung, ålder, sexuell läggning, könsidentitet eller funktionsvariationer.

job.title: Jr. Manager, Marketing Strategy, Argentina - The Orchard
job.description:
ABOUT THE ORCHARD

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global music industry. We specialize in being Artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

As a Jr. Manager, Marketing Strategy, your role is crucial in driving the success of our clients' releases through innovative marketing plans and strategies, and data-driven campaigns. You will serve as a key point of contact, keeping labels and artists ahead of industry trends, platform tools, and audience engagement with plans and best practices. Owning and nurturing strong relationships with clients and internal teams is essential to creating impactful activations, building fanbases, and achieving overall release objectives.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as the marketing point of contact for labels and artists leading discussions around marketing strategies, campaign planning, data collection, and ongoing performance evaluation.
  • Conceptualize and execute creative marketing campaigns in order to remain at the forefront of marketing and audience development.
  • Oversee and manage marketing campaigns for high-priority releases, focusing on specific artist and label initiatives within a given team. Drive informed decisions based on data and performance metrics.
  • Analyze the impact of campaigns and the value of various fan and audience segments, identifying trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to optimize both pre- and post-release strategies.
  • Utilize in-depth knowledge of platforms and tools to build audiences, engage fanbases, and drive demand.
  • Provide regular reports and key insights to team and regional leads regarding campaign success and areas for improvement.
  • Seek out opportunities for the development of the artist and label roster through internal resources and external tools or services that could enhance campaign efforts.
  • Work with multiple departments and teams to bring innovative marketing activations to life, both digitally and in the real world. Foster fan community relationships to amplify campaign reach and effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with different The Orchard teams across the globe to identify and leverage cultural touchpoints for audience acquisition, engagement, and other label objectives.
  • Be proactive in identifying challenges and providing solutions to keep release campaigns on track. Demonstrate flexibility and balance in supporting label needs. Be nimble as priorities arise outside of standard processes, with the ability to act with urgency and strategic vision.

Who you are:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in strategy marketing
  • Experience in music marketing is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Passionate about music, a regular attendee of live shows, interested in discovering new music, trend-savvy, and curious.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines
  • A strong passion for music, creativity and marketing trends
  • Proven track record of success in developing marketing plans and strategies
  • Proficiency in Spanish and English is required
  • Extensive knowledge of the music industry, including trends, challenges, and opportunities
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with artists, labels, and other key partners
  • Creative thinker with the ability to develop and execute innovative marketing and promotional campaigns

What we give you:

  • An opportunity to influence music on a global stage.
  • A modern, diverse and creative work environment.
  • An investment in your learning & development.
  • A comprehensive and attractive benefits package including healthcare coverage, voluntary benefits, and family resources.

The Orchard is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Junior Manager, Music Content & Marketing - Liquid State
job.description:
This hybrid role combines content production and marketing promotion and is directly responsible for leading the planning and execution of commercial music release projects. You will bridge creative vision and commercial objectives, independently managing end-to-end core music projects - from early-stage planning, A&R and content creation to full campaign rollout amid growing project scale and complexity that demand strong cross-team collaboration and resource coordination. Join us to lead landmark music initiatives and fuel commercial growth through creative content and innovative marketing.

 

What you'll do:

  • Market & Competitive Analysis: Conduct competitive research on music genres, major streaming platforms and user music consumption behaviours; propose and pitch new content projects based on data insights and market trends.
  • Content Planning & A&R: Scout songwriters, producers and artists for projects; oversee quality control of mixes, masters and final deliverables; identify commercially valuable music content aligned with market trends.
  • Marketing & Release Strategy: Formulate release strategies and marketing plans, refine core selling points, product positioning and narrative promotion angles with key marketing hooks and storytelling angles.
  • Project Management: Oversee timelines, deliverables and budget control for all content projects; coordinate cross-functional teams and resources to ensure smooth execution of both in-house and co-produced projects.
  • Rights & Compliance: Manage copyright licensing and compliance clearance for co-produced content.
  • Partnership & Execution: Independently communicate, execute and advance cooperation matters; follow up contracts and maintain partner relationships.
  • Performance Tracking: Track core KPIs including streaming volumes, revenue and ROI, and optimize campaigns based on performance data.
  • Complete other temporary work assigned by the supervisor and the company.

 

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree or above; majors in Music, Communication, Marketing and related disciplines are preferred.
  • 3-5 years of working experience in the music industry, with proven full-cycle song promotion experience from zero to one; proficient in the complete music production workflow and marketing logic.
  • Possess dual A&R and marketing capabilities; capable of independently managing end-to-end music projects with a track record of successful hit song releases.
  • Familiar with promotion logics and algorithm mechanisms of mainstream music & short-video platforms, including QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Douyin, Kuaishou and Bilibili.
  • Excellent content planning acumen, able to spot commercially valuable music content by capturing market trends timely.
  • Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with outstanding time management and cross-department communication & coordination skills; resilient and able to thrive under heavy work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong English proficiency. 
  • Established personal network of artists, producers and songwriters; able to integrate industry resources to facilitate project delivery. 
  • In-depth professional insight into specific music genres especially electronic dance music (e.g., hip-hop, folk, pop). 
  • Previous employment experience at record labels, hit-song indie labels or content studios of music streaming platforms. 
  • Show/Performance industry experiences/resources.

 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey.
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork.
  • We invest in your professional growth & development.

 

Equal Opportunities

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.

We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. job.title: Junior Manager, Public Performance & Finance Support - Colombia
job.description:
Sobre Sony Music Entertainment

En Sony Music Entertainment, impulsamos el viaje creativo. Hemos desempeñado un papel pionero en la historia de la música, desde la creación del primer sello discográfico hasta la invención del disco plano. Hemos apoyado a algunos de los artistas más icónicos de la música y producido algunas de las grabaciones más influyentes de todos los tiempos.

Hoy trabajamos en más de 70 países, apoyando un diverso roster de superestrellas internacionales, artistas en desarrollo e independientes, y creadores visionarios. Desde nuestra posición en la intersección de la música, el entretenimiento y la tecnología, aportamos imaginación y experiencia a los productos y plataformas más recientes, adoptamos nuevos modelos de negocio, empleamos herramientas innovadoras y brindamos información poderosa que ayuda a nuestros artistas a expandir sus límites creativos y llegar a nuevas audiencias.
En todo lo que hacemos, estamos comprometidos con la integridad artística, la transparencia y el espíritu emprendedor.

Sony Music Entertainment forma parte de la familia de compañías globales Sony.

Asegurar que todos los lanzamientos de fonogramas de SONY MUSIC sean acreditados dentro de las sociedades de gestión colectiva para garantizar el recaudo de estos usos en los establecimientos públicos y apoyar la operación del área financiera en ciertas actividades puntuales.

Qué harás:

  • Desde el modelo de la Promesa Global de las Personas, GPP, los Valores y los Comportamientos de SMG en todo lo que hace, ayudando a impulsar una cultura sostenible de alto rendimiento dentro de nuestro negocio
  • Acreditar los fonogramas en todos los formatos disponibles, tanto digitales como análogos, garantizando su correcta identificación y registro en las plataformas y sistemas correspondientes, con el fin de asegurar su adecuada gestión y el cumplimiento de los estándares de la industria.
  • Coordinar y ejecutar el retiro de fonogramas de todas las plataformas y formatos disponibles cuando los derechos correspondientes hayan expirado o ya no estén vigentes, asegurando el cumplimiento de las normativas legales y las políticas internas de la compañía.
  • Gestionar y resolver conflictos relacionados con la acreditación de fonogramas cuando dos o más productores, hayan registrado el mismo fonograma, asegurando una revisión objetiva, la correcta asignación de derechos y el cumplimiento de los lineamientos establecidos por la compañía y las entidades de gestión colectiva.
  • Gestionar la elaboración y seguimiento de facturas manuales en coordinación con Shared Services, relacionadas con acuerdos de sincronización, nuevos negocios y broadcasting, asegurando la correcta emisión de los documentos, el cumplimiento de los procesos financieros establecidos que permitan su adecuada contabilización.
  • Crear y administrar familias de fonogramas en los sistemas corporativos, garantizando la disponibilidad y confiabilidad de la información necesaria para el monitoreo de gastos, la generación de reportes y el análisis financiero por parte de las diferentes áreas involucradas.
  • Realizar la validación y seguimiento de las cuentas de balance de Marketing generadas por el equipo de Contabilidad, asegurando la razonabilidad de los registros, la identificación oportuna de inconsistencias y el adecuado soporte de las cifras financieras.
  • Consolidar, analizar y validar la información requerida para la construcción del indicador de Market Share, garantizando la confiabilidad de los datos y la elaboración oportuna de los reportes para su presentación, revisión y análisis junto con el Finance Sr. Manager.

  • Gestionar la elaboración y presentación de reportes financieros y de gestión relacionados con Marketing, Talento y Overheads, incluyendo informes de cierre, cargue de Forecast y Budget de la región Andes, asegurando la precisión de la información, el cumplimiento de los cronogramas establecidos y el soporte a la toma de decisiones del negocio

Quién eres:

  • Profesional en Administración de Empresas y/o Finanzas.
  • Conocimientos solidos en manejo Excel y SAP.
  • Experiencia de mínimo de 3 años en cargos de similar responsabilidad, deseable en compañías multinacionales.
  • Inglés B1.
  • Persona con gran habilidad para conectar con otros, construyendo relaciones de confianza y colaboración. Se comunica con claridad, respeto y seguridad, lo que le permite influir positivamente en su entorno. Es proactiva, toma la iniciativa y actúa con responsabilidad, siempre enfocada en encontrar soluciones. Tiene una mentalidad analítica que le permite entender contextos complejos y tomar decisiones acertadas. Su capacidad para unir personas, ideas y procesos lo convierte en un verdadero conector dentro del equipo y la organización. (relaciones interpersonales - comunicación asertiva - proactividad – responsabilidad – acción - análisis – conexión).

Lo que te damos:

  • Te unes a una comunidad inclusiva, colaborativa y global donde tienes la oportunidad de canalizar tu pasión cada día
  • Un entorno de oficina moderno diseñado para fomentar la productividad, la creatividad y el trabajo en equipo que te permite aportar lo mejor de ti mismo
  • Inversión en tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional que te permita prosperar en nuestra vibrante comunidad.
  • El espacio para acelerar el progreso, perturbar positivamente y crear lo que suceda a continuación.
  • Te damos la plataforma para liderar el cambio positivo, con la oportunidad de contribuir a nuestras iniciativas de impacto social, diversidad, equidad e inclusión.
  • Una cartera de prestaciones que responde a sus necesidades y las de su familia, desde ayudas al bienestar y prestaciones familiares hasta tiempo libre remunerado para ayudarle a conciliar la vida laboral y personal.
  • Tiempo libre para las vacaciones de fin de año.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we're committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music's Product, Design, Engineering & Global Operations (PDEGO) team is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to join our engineering team in our London office. Our PDEGO suite powers all of Sony Music's most critical business capabilities—ensuring monetization, data and analytics depth, marketing and music release at scale for artists across the globe.

As a technical lead, you'll help shape the architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technical direction of one of our product spaces at global scale. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to modernize systems while mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence across the team.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of scalable software solutions supporting Sony Music's critical global B2B2C platforms.
  • Drive architecture decisions across distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, and platform services.
  • Partner closely with Product, Operations, and teams of stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code while establishing engineering best practices across the team
  • Lead technical design sessions, architecture reviews, and modernization initiatives
  • Design resilient services and integrations with internal and third-party platforms
  • Champion application reliability, performance, observability, and operational excellence
  • Mentor engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, and architectural guidance
  • Identify technical debt and lead initiatives to improve scalability, maintainability, and developer productivity
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root cause analysis across distributed systems
  • Collaborate with engineering leadership to define the long-term technical roadmap for the platform you are focused on

Who you are:

Seeking 10+ years of software engineering experience in the following areas:

  • Experience implementing distributed systems
  • Strong experience with Python and JavaScript
  • Experience building frontend applications using TypeScript and React
  • Experience with various database technologies and query languages (we use Snowflake, MySQL, Neo4j, Kafka, OpenSearch, and more)
  • Experience designing microservices and APIs using REST, HTTP, and OAuth
  • Comfortable with AWS cloud technologies
  • Experience using log analysis and monitoring tools to investigate production issues and improve reliability
  • Experience writing unit, integration, and automated tests
  • Experience working within Agile development teams
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence engineering and business stakeholders
  • Passion for solving complex technical problems and mentoring engineers

The ideal candidate

  • Deep understanding of software architecture, domain modeling, and scalable system design
  • Experience designing data models and optimizing schemas for complex business domains
  • Experience working with large datasets and high-volume systems
  • Can mobilize engineering teams around a technical vision and lead execution across multiple initiatives
  • Establishes engineering best practices, coding standards, and development processes that improve quality and delivery
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to balance immediate business needs against long-term platform investments
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives without direct people management responsibility
  • Passionate about mentoring engineers and fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Interest in music, technology, and building systems that directly support artists and creators

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Hybrid work environment: Our London office is designed for collaboration, offering a balanced hybrid setup (3 days in office / 2 days remote)
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next 
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives 
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There’s also time off over winter break

job.title: Manager - Retail Marketing & DSP Relations
job.description:
The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global music industry. We specialize in being Artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more. 

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity. 

This role leads our retail marketing strategy, tasked with moving beyond transactional release management to drive long-term growth and market influence. As a key strategic partner, you will cultivate high-level relationships with DSPs, translating data-driven insights into comprehensive, forward-looking marketing plans. You are a champion for independent music, possessing the creative flair to support our artists through intentional, high-impact activations, placements, and strategic partnerships that elevate content and expand our reach across India & global platforms. Your focus is on scaling our influence, shaping the retail landscape, and ensuring our repertoire remains at the forefront of the music industry.

What you'll do:

  • Find opportunities with DSPs to activate our catalogue and frontline through partnerships, IPs, and activations.

  • Experience working within a label, artist management or distribution system managing releases, projects or relationships
  • Established relationships with key contacts at major DSP is a significant advantage.

job.title: Manager, A&R - AWAL
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Manager, A&R with AWAL will be responsible for finding and acquiring recording artists, songs and producers as well as leading artist development efforts for artists in all genres. This role will report directly to the President and Head of A&R, AWAL North America.

What you'll do:

  • Attend live shows at clubs, showcases, concerts, and other venues.
  • Provide comprehensive feedback on new music to the Head of A&R and/or other requesting senior A&R executives.
  • Propose new artists for AWAL.
  • Visit artist/band websites and social networking sites.
  • Search for new songs for existing talent on AWAL.
  • Coordinate label relationships for an artist once they are signed to AWAL.
  • Provide creative input and direction on artist’s material.
  • Find suitable producers and recording studios
  • Coordinate pre-production and production, mixing, mastering
  • Plan recording budgets for assigned projects.
  • Keep projects within agreed budget and schedule/timeline.
  • Evaluate recording and mixing progress for AWAL artists.
  • Coordinate all asset deliverables to appropriate production department/areas in timely manner.
  • Maintain files/records on all shows attended.
  • Work closely with other label departments/employees including marketing, publicity, sales to determine follow up steps once the record has been completed.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with industry insiders (managers, agents, attorneys, concert promoters, radio promo reps, retail contacts, trade and consumer press, tastemakers, etc.).

Who you are:

  • Passionate about all things music.
  • Have three (3) + years of music or entertainment industry experience, with a demonstrated track record of finding new and emerging artists/talent.
  • Have knowledge of the different steps in the making of and release of a record required.
  • Must have prior experience working with artists from a variety of genres.
  • A proactive, self-starter who has strong problem solving, social, and interpersonal skills.
  • Exceptional communication and time management skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while still paying attention to detail and spotting potential issues is absolutely key.

 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
