job.title: Manager, Campaign Operations - RCA Records
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

We are seeking a Manager, Campaign Operations to join a newly established function at RCA Records. Campaign Operations is the connective tissue between departments — tracking, surfacing, and flagging cross-departmental activity across the full roster to ensure that when a decision gets made in one room, every other team knows what it means for them.

Reporting to the Campaign Operations Lead and sitting within the SVP Commercial Partnerships organization, this role will own the day-to-day operational relationship with a cluster of departments, monitoring their workflows, lead times, and deliverables across every active artist campaign. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of how to work cross-functionally between departments, thrives in ambiguity, and brings the kind of diplomatic, low-ego energy that builds trust without creating friction.

What you'll do:

  • Department Relationship Management: Own the day-to-day operational relationship with an assigned cluster of departments. Learn their workflows, lead times, tools, and pain points. Become the person they trust to represent their status accurately.
  • Release Readiness Monitoring: Track workability status across all active releases. Surface gaps in clearances, masters, artwork, agreements, and delivery timelines before they become blockers.
  • Budget Visibility & Tracking: Monitor campaign spend against approved budgets across the roster. Surface divergence, flag overages, and track budget status in real time so that the people who own those decisions have full information. Campaign Ops does not approve or deny spend — it ensures the numbers are visible and accurate.
  • Cross-Department Flagging: Identify when an issue in one department affects another. Surface the connection, prompt the teams involved, and track resolution.
  • Meeting Support: Contribute to cross-department meeting preparation, transcript processing, and action item tracking. Help produce Goal Briefs and meeting notes for distribution.
  • Artist Briefing Support: Assist in producing artist briefings and prep packages for new signings and key roster moments. Compile information from multiple departments into a single, clear picture.
  • Data Layer Maintenance: Keep shared operational data current and accurate across Airtable and internal dashboards. Ensure department status is reflected in real time.
  • Escalation: When an issue cannot be resolved at the department level, route to the Campaign Operations Lead for consolidation. The team speaks as a unit.
  • Tool & System Awareness: Stay current on internal tools, Sony enterprise systems, and department-specific platforms. Surface what exists, who uses it, and where there are gaps or duplication.

Who you are:

  • Minimum of 3 years in the music industry, entertainment, media, or a similar field, with previous experience working collaboratively across various teams and departments.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and competing priorities across a large roster.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across teams. You can translate technical or operational information into clear, concise language for varied audiences.
  • Familiarity with project management or operational tracking tools (Airtable, Asana, Monday, or similar). Willingness to learn new systems quickly.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records. Comfortable tracking dozens of open items across multiple workstreams without losing threads.
  • Diplomatic and low-ego. This role requires navigating departmental sensitivities without creating friction. You amplify other teams’ work — you don’t add oversight.
  • Curiosity about how systems work and why they break. Interest in process improvement, data visibility, and operational design.
  • You are a motivated self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans

Working closely with senior management throughout The Orchard and Sony Music puts the Manager in a unique position to directly influence high-level strategic decision-making and deliver impactful business analysis across the organization.

What You'll Do:

  • Office- first role, in office 4 days a week.
  • Deal Execution: Lead transactions from start to finish, including preliminary evaluation, deal structuring, due diligence coordination, valuation and cross-functional execution for potential M&A, investments and strategic partnerships
  • Relationship & Industry Network: Develop, cultivate, and maintain strong relationships with key internal and external partners, investors, industry experts, and founders across the media, music, and startup ecosystems
  • Financial Modeling & Strategic Analysis: Build sophisticated financial models and conduct macro-level analyses on The Orchard’s M&A strategy to support transaction decision-making
  • Executive Communication: Synthesize complex financial and strategic analysis into clear, compelling decks and memos to effectively present investment recommendations directly to senior executive leadership
  • Market Intelligence: Understand and monitor regional markets, industry trends, competitive landscapes, and internal product development efforts to proactively evaluate business opportunities

Who You Are:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Work Experience: 5+ years of experience working in a corporate development role at a media & entertainment company or in an investment banking or management consulting role focused on the media & entertainment industry.
  • Technical Expertise: Advanced financial modeling, valuation, and Excel skills, with demonstrated experience analyzing and drawing actionable conclusions from large, complex data sets
  • Advanced Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of successfully influencing key stakeholders and communicating a vision and roadmap along with the resourcing needs to achieve it
  • Project Management: Strong project management skills, including the ability to independently think end-to-end, manage long-term projects, manage multiple projects simultaneously and produce high quality deliverables
  • Industry Passion: Strong understanding of and passion for the evolving music, digital media and technology landscape

What We Give You:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best

job.description:

In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

You’ll be the operational lead between label teams and these partners to activate campaigns, scale artist-first opportunities, and drive measurable engagement and revenue.

What you'll do:

  • Manage partner relationships by pitching label priorities, coordinating calls and meetings and escalating issues.
  • Execute social-first campaign activations (launches, trends, challenges, AR lenses, sound placements, creator programs) from brief to delivery and post-campaign analysis.

  • Collaborate on gaming partner strategy by overseeing channel integrations and extensions, manage co-marketing and sponsorship activations, monitor engagement/monetization KPIs, and coordinate technical/support escalations.
  • Manage all deliverables for marketing credits and ad credits.
  • Spearhead claims and takedowns.
  • Serve as project manager for platform-led opportunities (early access programs, beta testing, sponsored content, exclusive formats).
  • Develop campaign measurement frameworks, compile competitive performance reports and actionable insights; present learnings to internal teams for future iterations.
  • Stay informed of platform product changes, trends, ad formats, and content behaviors to inform strategy across label rosters.

Who you are:

  • 3–5+ years’ experience in digital marketing, account management, partnership management, or label/agency role focused on social platforms; experience specifically with any of the partners mentioned above strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record managing multi-stakeholder campaigns and delivering measurable results on social-first activations.
  • Strong project management skills; able to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
  • Analytical mindset; comfortable working with campaign metrics (engagement, views, CTR, conversion, revenue attribution) and translating data into recommendations.
  • Deep understanding of short-form social content, creator ecosystems, platform mechanics, and trends.
  • Collaborative, proactive, and solution-oriented with a high attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with music industry workflows, release cycles, and label organizational structure is a plus.

job.title: Manager, Frontline Business & Media PR
job.description:
Sony Music Korea’s International Repertoire department is looking for a strategic and highly connected leader to help drive the success of our global artists in Korea. 

As Frontline Business & Media PR Manager, you will lead the frontline repertoire business while serving as the primary media and PR lead across Frontline, J-Pop, and Catalog. Working closely with global labels, artist management, media partners, and cultural stakeholders, you will help shape how Sony Music’s international repertoire is positioned, amplified, and experienced in one of the world’s most influential music markets. 

Success in this role means delivering high-impact campaigns, building strong industry influence, creating meaningful media opportunities, and increasing the visibility and cultural relevance of Sony Music artists in Korea.

 

What you will do:

  • Lead Korea-market planning and execution for priority international frontline releases 
  • Serve as the primary media and PR lead for International Repertoire, supporting Frontline, J-Pop, and Catalog teams 
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with media, editors, producers, broadcasters, cultural partners, and industry stakeholders 
  • Develop and activate media opportunities, artist moments, collaborations, interviews, and market-facing initiatives across repertoire 
  • Align closely with global labels, artist management, and regional Sony Music teams to localize priorities and maximize market impact 
  • Manage and develop Frontline Associate Managers and contribute to the growth of future repertoire owners 
  • Partner with DSP, Business Development, agencies, and cross-functional teams to integrate earned media into broader commercial and marketing plans 
  • Monitor performance and identify new opportunities to strengthen visibility, awareness, and market engagement

 

Who you are:

Technical Capabilities:  

  • 7+ years of experience in music marketing, artist marketing, media relations, PR, entertainment, label operations, or related fields 
  • Strong understanding of Korea’s music, media, entertainment, and digital culture landscape 
  • Proven ability to develop relationships across media outlets, broadcasters, publishers, labels, agencies, and industry stakeholders 
  • Experience managing large-scale artist campaigns and working with global and regional stakeholders 
  • Strong commercial awareness and understanding of how media influence translates into audience growth and business outcomes 
  • Experience balancing multiple stakeholders, priorities, and campaigns simultaneously 
  • Excellent written and spoken Korean and English 

Behavioral Capabilities:  

  • Relationship Building: Creates and sustains trusted relationships that generate long-term value for artists and the business 
  • Strategic Communication: Communicates effectively across media, management, labels, and internal stakeholders 
  • Influence: Uses credibility and industry knowledge to unlock opportunities and gain alignment 
  • Leadership: Develops others and creates a culture of ownership, accountability, and collaboration 
  • Proactiveness: Consistently identifies opportunities before they become requests 
  • Agility: Adapts quickly to changing artist priorities, media environments, and market developments 
  • Problem Solving: Navigates ambiguity and complexity with practical, business-oriented solutions 

 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey 
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork 
  • We invest in your professional growth & development

job.title: Manager, Marketing Strategy, Mexico - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global music industry. We specialize in being Artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

We are looking for a Marketing Strategy Manager to support the development and execution of digital marketing campaigns for artists, labels, releases, catalog, tours, and other priority projects.

This role will work across digital strategy, social media, audience development, first-party data, CRM, campaign analytics, and fan engagement. We are looking for someone who is curious about music and digital culture, comfortable working with data, and able to turn trends and campaign results into useful recommendations.

What you'll do:

  • Support the development and execution of integrated digital marketing strategies across social media, streaming platforms, CRM, websites, paid media, and fan engagement initiatives.
  • Stay up to date on social media, music, creator, and cultural trends, identifying relevant opportunities for artists and campaigns.
  • Support first-party data acquisition and audience development initiatives, including fan registration, pre-save campaigns, audience segmentation, and other fan engagement activations.
  • Build, test, and send newsletters and targeted email communications to help strengthen ongoing fan relationships.
  • Review analytics across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, streaming, CRM, websites, and paid media to identify trends, learnings, and opportunities.
  • Translate campaign performance and audience insights into clear recommendations for ongoing and future campaigns.
  • Build and customize basic template-based landing pages, including forms, buttons, links, redirects, and basic HTML/CSS adjustments.
  • Contribute to campaign recaps, reporting, and recommendations for artists, labels, and internal stakeholders.

Who you are:

  • 3-5 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably within music, entertainment, media, or a related field.
  • Good understanding of platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and streaming services.
  • Strong interest in social media trends, music, pop culture, and fan behavior.
  • Comfortable reviewing digital platform analytics and identifying basic performance trends.
  • Ability to turn data and campaign learnings into clear, practical recommendations.
  • Familiarity with email marketing, audience segmentation, CRM, or first-party data collection.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • High attention to detail and a hands-on approach to campaign execution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the music or entertainment industry.
  • Familiarity with streaming analytics.
  • Experience with audience development or fan engagement campaigns.
  • Comfortable working with template-based landing pages and basic HTML/CSS. Advanced web development experience is not required.

What we give you:

  • An opportunity to influence music on a global stage.
  • A modern, diverse and creative work environment.
  • An investment in your learning & development.
  • A comprehensive and attractive benefits package including healthcare coverage, voluntary benefits, and family resources.

The Orchard is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Marketing Manager
job.description:
As Marketing Manager within Sony Music Entertainment Vietnam, you will be the project lead on your assigned roster of domestic artists, responsible for building campaign plans in line with the artists vision and Sony Music. Within the role you will be working closely with the artists, guiding them on social media, marketing planning and executing marketing and paid advertising strategies for the project, as well as commissioning creative and the marketing tools needed.

You will report to the General Manager, Sony Music Vietnam and be joining a passionate group of like-minded and collaborative music fanatics.

Disclaimer: This role is offered as a one-year fixed-term employment contract. Any extension, renewal, or conversion to an indefinite-term (permanent) employment contract will be subject to individual performance, business needs, organizational requirements, and mutual agreement at the time of review. Nothing in this offer should be construed as a guarantee or commitment to future employment beyond the fixed-term contract period.

What you'll do:

  • Driving end-to-end marketing strategy across all projects. Own the full campaign lifecycle for assigned releases: positioning, audience definition, channel strategy, launch planning, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Leading the team with clear direction, planning, and accountability. Set campaign standards (brief quality, approvals, asset readiness, measurement approach) and keep the team aligned through structured check-ins and progress tracking.
  • Develop creative and audience-centric campaign concepts tailored to each artist’s identity, local culture, and fan behaviours.
  • Elevating campaign quality and creative output to stay competitive. Monitor and interpret platform performance signals (content performance, audience response, and campaign outcomes) to optimize in-flight and future campaigns.
  • Strengthening digital performance through data-driven execution
  • Ensuring scalability as our release volume continues to grow
  • Design audience growth plans that expand beyond core fans—balancing acquisition, engagement, retention, and conversion objectives for each release cycle.
  • Develop creative and audience centric marketing campaigns for your roster of artists.
  • Create and build all local marketing tools, including artist imagery, press images, release artwork, advertising assets and videos
  • Deliver on Artist DNAs, Marketing Plans, and artist updates for all assigned artists. These will outline core marketing objectives that drive streaming, sales, fan acquisition and revenue.
  • Building an artist brand, core pillars and identity in line with the artist vision and Sony Music
  • Forecast project-based marketing and sales budgets
  • Be the day-to-day point person for artist team, Label partner or management on your roster of artists
  • Collaborate with Digital Business lead to develop and deliver pitches to DSPs.

Who you are:

  • Solid experience running multi-faceted and innovative marketing campaigns, with particular focus on content marketing, artist development and audience growth.
  • Strong creative skills to craft compelling content and messaging that reflects the artist identity, and brand and engages their audience.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced and ever-changing digital environment. Being open to learning new technologies, industry trends, and adjusting strategies accordingly.
  • Love and passion for music and supporting local talent.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, social media, content, and streaming landscape.
  • Creative thinker, confident and proactive in your approach, able to work autonomously and be a team player.
  • Great communicator and an ability to take on and utilise diverse opinions.
  • Be a relationship driven person.

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next

job.title: Marketing Manager
job.description:
As a Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for delivering custom and creative digital marketing ideas for our releases, while also managing multiple social media accounts for artists and the company. Ensuring the efforts of the label to ensure the consistency of messaging and imaging between artists and their music.  

You are responsible the planning, development, pitching and execution of innovative marketing strategies to launch, brand and develop artists throughout the product lifecycle for assigned artist projects. This position supports the Sony Music label domestic artists. 

 

What you will do:

Marketing cycle & Creativity 

  • Deliver the creation, development, and execution of marketing strategies, packaging design, ad campaigns, and tour planning for assigned projects. 
  • Participate in current and long-term creative planning to ensure a clear and consistent message for assigned projects while acting as a central point of contact and lead for all assigned projects. Work with all departments, aligning the deadlines and keeping a creative thread running throughout the projects. 
  • Develop and execute creative imaging for marketing campaigns in conjunction with internal creative services or external vendors. Select and approve visual imagery and creative direction of marketing tools while also overseeing the timely production of commercial and promotional products, including promotion materials, album packaging, videos, retail displays and posters. 
  • Responsible of all digital marketing initiatives including the development of digital marketing concepts, design, implementation, and maintenance of social media presence. 

Optimise campaign operations and marketing processes. 

  • Actively participate in campaign planning activities, including but not limited to defining the marketing objectives for each campaign, creating, and managing project plans with clearly defined deliverables and resources, defining success criteria and KPIs and providing insights to inform campaign activities. 
  • Coordinate workstreams and dependencies, track and communicate progress, identify obstacles, and ensure they’re addressed. 
  • Ensure marketing campaigns are executed according to the agreed plan and budget, and flag potential risks and issues on time.  
  • Optimize frontline marketing domestic processes in the region to enable the team to grow, scale and deliver the expected revenue. 
  • Partner closely and cultivate close, trusted relationships with artist management as well as other members of the artist team (touring, merch, publicists, etc). 
  • Partner closely with internal teams (Digital, AM, A&R, etc) to ensure each campaign is creatively ‘best-in-class’, authentic to the artist’s voice, relevant to the fan base and reflective of the evolving marketplace. 
  • Manage marketing budgets for each campaign. 
  • Spot digital trends, understand new technologies and social media behavior and align these with business objectives to create new and innovative marketing opportunities and solutions. 
  • Lead and coordinate social media, content development, streaming marketing, digital advertising & CRM campaigns for assigned artists. 
  • Work closely with Digital Team, understand the streaming performance, patterns, and craft tailor made campaigns to maximize music consumption 
  • Provide in-depth analysis measuring the success of campaigns/tools and communicate the results to all relevant stakeholders. 
  • Any other duties assigned by the Company and/or Marketing Director from time to time. 

 

Who you are:

  • Undergraduate degree required 
  • A minimum of 8-10 years’ experience working in content licensing, digital media, entertainment or technology companies; international experience is a plus 
  • Very good negotiator with strong business acumen, strategic thinking, great attention to detail with a keen eye for data 
  • Excellent problem-solving, combined with outstanding analytical skills, creativity and efficiency 
  • Great verbal and written communications skills combined with interpersonal skills working across multiple cultures 
  • Passion for music, digital media and innovation is a (big) plus 
  • Experience in understanding and interpreting industry situations and translating this into actionable marketing strategies. 
  • Strong understanding and ability to grow and train local workforces (ideally with strong experience in moderating and running workshops)

job.title: Marketing Manager - Frontline & Artist Development
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is one of the leading record labels in the world and Philippines, dedicated to promoting and supporting both international and local artists and music. In this rapidly evolving streaming era, we are actively seeking a talented Marketing Pop Hub. Manager to drive our extensive, hit-laden local catalogue's success in the digital landscape.    As a Marketing Manager - Frontline & Artist Development, you will play a pivotal role in expanding our reach, connecting with our target audience, and maximizing the visibility of our local music catalogue. We are looking for someone who is not only clued in to the latest trends in local Gen Z pop culture but also appreciates the rich heritage of older OPM tracks. You will be responsible for developing and executing innovative marketing strategies that resonate with our target audience and drive engagement

What you'll do:

ARTIST DEVELOPMENT & BRAND STRATEGY

  • Lead the marketing-led development and growth of new, emerging, and established frontline artists.
  • Develop clear artist positioning, brand identity, audience strategy, and long-term growth plans in collaboration with A&R and other relevant teams.
  • Partner with A&R on sonic positioning and ensure each artist’s music, visual identity, storytelling, and marketing direction are aligned.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen artist relevance, fan engagement, platform growth, and overall market positioning.
  • Develop artist development plans that go beyond individual releases, building sustainable audiences and long-term artist careers.
  • Use performance data, audience insights, and market trends to identify growth opportunities and recommend strategies for each artist.
  • Work closely with Business Development to identify brand partnerships, live opportunities, collaborations, and other commercial opportunities that support artist growth.
  • Ensure all release-related assets and marketing materials are complete, compliant, and delivered according to agreed timelines.

FRONTLINE MARKETING STRATEGY & CAMPAIGN EXECUTION

  • Lead the end-to-end marketing strategy and execution for assigned SMEP frontline artists and releases.
  • Develop integrated marketing plans covering audience development, digital, social media, content, publicity, partnerships, activations, and fan engagement.
  • Create campaign strategies, concepts, and content plans informed by data and insights from the Digital and Data teams.
  • Build clear campaign objectives, KPIs, timelines, and measurement frameworks for each priority release.
  • Monitor campaign performance and adjust strategies based on results, audience response, and market developments.
  • Stay current on music, entertainment, digital, social, and cultural trends to identify opportunities for artists and releases.
  • Collaborate closely with A&R, Digital, AdProm, Creatives, Business Development, and other teams to ensure aligned and effective campaign execution.

INTERNATIONAL MARKETING & AUDIENCE DEVELOPMENT

  • Analyze frontline roster performance to identify artists and releases with potential for regional and international growth.
  • Work with Sony Music teams across territories to develop market-specific strategies for priority artists and releases.
  • Identify opportunities for international collaborations, promotional activities, content, media, and audience development.
  • Coordinate with international Sony Music teams, agencies, partners, and third-party vendors for campaigns and artist promotional visits.
  • Track international performance and audience growth to identify markets where further investment or activity may be appropriate.

DIRECT-TO-CONSUMER (D2C), FAN DEVELOPMENT & CRM

  • Develop and execute D2C strategies that deepen the relationship between artists and their fans.
  • Work with relevant teams on physical products, merchandise, bundles, and other artist-led D2C opportunities.
  • Build and grow first-party fan databases within the SMEP ecosystem through CRM initiatives, newsletters, registrations, giveaways, fan activations, and other direct engagement programs.
  • Develop fan segmentation and engagement strategies to improve retention, conversion, and long-term fan value.
  • Monitor consumer behavior and market trends related to physical music, merchandise, collectibles, and other fan products.
  • Use D2C and CRM insights to support broader artist development and marketing strategies.

PROJECT, BUDGET & ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGEMENT

  • Manage marketing projects from planning through execution, ensuring timelines, budgets, deliverables, and internal approvals are properly managed.
  • Ensure marketing plans, project documentation, budgets, and approval requirements are completed before campaign execution.
  • Manage external agencies, production partners, suppliers, and vendors required for marketing campaigns.
  • Monitor marketing spend against approved budgets and evaluate campaign effectiveness and cost efficiency.
  • Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal teams to ensure timely processing of POs, invoices, vendor payments, and financial liquidation requirements.
  • Maintain clear reporting on campaign performance, budgets, key learnings, risks, and issues affecting artists or releases.
  • Conduct post-campaign reviews and translate learnings into recommendations for future artist and release strategies.

Who you are:

  • A genuine passion for music, particularly local Filipino artists and OPM tracks, with a deep understanding of local Gen Z pop culture.
  • Proven experience (2+ years) in marketing, preferably within the digital/streaming/entertainment landscape, with a track record of successfully promoting content.
  • Excellent knowledge of social media platforms, content marketing, and digital advertising tools to effectively engage audiences and drive conversions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling and concise content tailored to different platforms and target audiences.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage multiple projects simultaneously, while also collaborating effectively within a team environment.
  • Analytical mindset, comfortable with data, utilizing insights to optimize marketing strategies for maximum impact.
  • Familiarity with digital platforms, in particular TikTok, Meta, and YouTube, is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field is preferred 

What we give you:

job.title: Onestream Application Admin
job.description:

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is seeking a OneStream Application Administrator / Support Analyst to support and enhance our OneStream compensation and payroll integration platform. This role will serve as the primary operational owner of the OneStream environment, providing application administration, user support, troubleshooting, security administration, reporting support, and issue triage.

The ideal candidate will possess practical OneStream experience, strong troubleshooting abilities, and an understanding of financial systems and business processes. The role will work closely with Finance, Payroll, HR, SAP support teams, and external implementation partners to ensure the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of the OneStream application.

What you'll do:

  • Role model SMG’s Global People Promise, Values and Behaviors in all that you do, helping to drive a sustainable high-performance culture within our business
  • Serve as the primary administrator and support contact for the OneStream application, including user access, security, and configuration management.  Support business users by responding to questions, resolving issues, and providing guidance on system functionality.
  • Troubleshoot and triage production issues, building the skillset to determine whether problems originate in OneStream, SAP, integrations, master data, or user processes.
  • Manage and support monthly operational processes, data loads, payroll-related processes, and system monitoring activities.
  • Maintain and enhance financial reports, calculations, business rules, and data processing workflows.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Payroll, HR, SAP teams, and external support partners to resolve application and integration issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation, user guides, training materials, and operational procedures.

Who you are:

  • 1-3+ years of hands-on OneStream administration, support, troubleshooting, or development experience. Familiarity with OneStream business rules and a working knowledge of VB.NET.
  • Ability to investigate application issues, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolutions across multiple teams.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to troubleshoot data and integration-related issues.
  • Understanding of financial systems concepts, including general ledger, cost centers, company codes, balance sheets, and income statements.
  • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors—delivering excellent customer service in a production environment, along with clear documentation and knowledge-sharing.

 

What we give you:

job.title: Physical Sales & E-Commerce Executive, SEA
job.description:

The role will support the development and operation of physical sales channels for Vinyl, CDs and other physical products, working across both wholesale/distribution and D2C channels.

The role focuses on developing and operating sales channels, ensuring products are priced appropriately, inventory is forecasted and managed effectively, order are fulfilled and collected, and sales channels are maintained and optimised. This includes supporting the development of D2C infrastructure and storefronts using Shopify.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and grow physical sales channels across Southeast Asian territories, supporting the sale of Vinyl, CDs and other physical products.

job.title: Principal Software Engineer, Pub Admin
job.description:
Principal Software Engineer, Pub Admin

UK & Ireland, United Kingdom, London

Sony Music’s Product, Design, Engineering & Global Operations (PDEGO) organisation is seeking a Principal Software Engineer within our Pub Admin product team in our London King’s Cross office (hybrid/three days a week).

Pub Admin (Publishing Administration) is our future product for a unified, modern rights platform - where our engineers help transform the complex domain of music publishing administration into simple, scalable, high-performance product solutions for Sony Music’s global creator community. You’ll shape what we build as well as how we build it, working directly with product and design on problems where the right answer isn’t yet known.

What you'll do:

  • Work cross-functionally across multiple teams in our Royalty Accounting organisation to build and own a new business vertical that will help rights holders register, manage, and monetize their catalogues worldwide
  • Lead design, implementation, and scaling of complex distributed systems end-to-end from early-stage ideation to market
  • Partner with product management and design to understand client and stakeholder needs, challenge requirements where necessary, help decide what not to build, and turn the decisions into clear technical direction
  • Design, communicate and execute a vision in collaboration with the wider organisation
  • Contribute to all tiers of our architecture to produce high-quality and robust user experiences
  • Mentor engineers across all levels and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and engineering best practices

The ideal candidate has:

  • Driven technical strategy and alignment across multiple teams as a principal engineer or equivalent
  • Measured success by user and business outcomes, not only uptime and latency
  • Designed systems to ensure testability, reliability, and observability at cloud scale
  • Shaped a product roadmap or influenced prioritisation, not just delivered against one
  • Led data modelling decisions for complex domains, grounded in user and business impact, that adapted as requirements changed
  • Deep expertise in at least one database technology (we use Neo4j, MySQL, Snowflake, and OpenSearch)
  • Worked extensively with microservices, APIs, and related standards such as REST, HTTP, and OAuth
  • Built production systems across the full stack (we use React, TypeScript, Python, and GraphQL)

 

What we give you:

job.title: Retail & Licensing Coordinator - Ceremony Of Roses
job.description:

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Ceremony of Roses is an agile creative practice built to solve the commercial and creative challenges of the world’s top artists. As Sony Music’s merchandise partner, we serve a roster of global talent—both within and beyond the Sony ecosystem. We’re defined by our commitment to product excellence, delivering products that are made to be kept, worn, and loved for years to come. Our best-in-class creative team delivers culture-leading, artist-specific collections that build artist brands beyond their music. Most importantly, we deliver customer excellence, embedding ourselves as an extension of each client’s team, bringing transparency, accountability, and tailored support to every partnership

The Licensing and Retail Coordinator sits at the center of CoR's licensing and retail program, driving the product development process from submission through approval while building the pitch materials that bring new opportunities to life.

What you'll do:

  • Supports the business development function of CoR Artists Licensed Merchandise + Retail program with administrative and sales support.

Product Development:

  • Coordinate product submissions for the Commercial retail & licensing team, ensuring projects are tracked, coordinated, and delivered on time to meet the deadlines of both Ceremony of Roses (CoR) and our partners.

Administrative Support:

Sample Tracking:

Asset Management:

  • Support the organization, management, and distribution of artist artwork and creative assets to external partners, ensuring all file links are current, accessible, and shared securely.

Selling:

  • You have strong organizational and project management skills with a keen eye for detail. Asana experience is a plus. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and pick up new software is a plus.
  • You're an exceptional communicator who manages time and competing priorities without dropping the ball.
  • You're enthusiastic — proactive, self-motivated, and always looking for ways to grow and performs in a fast-paced environment.
  • You’re a team player who works well in an open office environment.
  • You're plugged into culture. You know what's trending, what's resonating, and why, and you bring that lens to everything from brand pitches to partner evaluation.

What we give you:

job.title: Royalties - Open Talent Pool
job.description:

This allows us to stay connected and reach out when suitable Royalties roles become available within our Global Finance Shared Services (GFSS) team in Warsaw.

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. From being home to the world’s first music label to shaping the future of music, entertainment, and technology, we’ve played a pioneering role in music history. Today, we operate in more than 60 countries, supporting a diverse roster of global superstars, independent artists, and visionary creators. Across everything we do, we are driven by creativity, collaboration, transparency, and entrepreneurial thinking.

Our Global Finance Shared Services Centre plays a vital role in supporting Sony Music’s core business worldwide. The team delivers end‑to‑end finance services across a wide scope of activities, ensuring suppliers and artists are paid accurately and on time for the incredible work they create. By partnering closely with local finance teams across the globe, GFSS has a strong understanding of how the business operates and contributes directly to Sony Music achieving its annual goals.

As part of the Royalties talent pool, you may be considered for future opportunities in one of our two Royalty teams; Royalty Operations or Royalty Accounting. In our Royalty Operations team, you will be a key contributor to the day-to-day operations within Royalties and will be involved in all aspects of artist royalties, managing and delivering accurate and timely royalty statements, performing reviews, analysis and reconciliations, managing and prioritizing clearing of suspense items, responding to internal and external inquiries, contract interpretation, coding and special projects. In Royalty Accounting, you will be responsible for all aspects of royalty accounting for designated affiliates, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of accounting closes, performing account analysis and reconciliation, and royalty reporting.  You will work closely with all areas of the royalty department, corporate, global reporting and planning and external auditors.

The GFSS team is based in our modern workspace at the Elektrownia Powiśle centre in Warsaw.

If you’re looking to grow your career in finance within a global, creative, and fast‑paced organisation, we’d love to hear from you.

 

What you'll do as a Royalties Accountant:

  • Prepare, review and analyze capitalized balances, associated royalty payables, recoupable recording and marketing costs, for reasonableness and proper accounting treatment.  Prepare label talent provision and marketing recovery journal entries
  • Review foreign royalty expense and prepare monthly accrual vs. actual analysis, intercompany reconciliations and associated journal entries
  • Perform various balance sheet account analysis related to artist, copyright, union and foreign royalties to substantiate balances and clear reconciling items.  This includes any royalty system to general ledger reconciliations
  • Monitor, review and analyze artist/copyright/union expense for reasonableness and proper accounting treatment.  Prepare manual journal entries to adjust royalty expense
  • Special projects/other duties as assigned by management
  • Review and improve internal controls where applicable

What you'll do as a Royalties Operations Analyst:

Royalty Contract Interpretation and Coding:

  • Read the artist, producer, and/or third-party contract to obtain relevant information.
  • Interpret contractual clauses related to the royalty obligation, including understanding the legal definitions of terms used within the contracts or related documents.
  • Coordinate with Label’s legal and business affairs staff to obtain missing information.
  • Set up and maintain accurate contractual information within the royalty system

Royalty Statement Review:

  • Prepare the appropriate accounting statements as contractually required,
  • Review sales and costs to ensure they are accurately stated.
  • Update and analyze unrecouped balance analysis at account level.
  • Prepare and research variance-reporting analysis to understand fluctuations with balances and payments.

Sales & Suspense Management:

  • Review the new release schedule and work with the affiliate personal to ensure new releases are coded within the appropriate timeframe.
  • Run sales query and reviewing results with Manager.
  • Prepare and review suspense reports and provide reports to affiliate on a weekly basis.

Inquiries & Special Projects:

  • Serve as Point of Contact for various internal and external inquiries related to assigned accounts.
  • Provide Manager with status reports regarding the assigned artist accounts.
  • Provide guidance to the entry-level staff members including providing an overview of tools available to assist in the completion of the assigned tasks.
  • Assist in process design improvements focused on enhancing quality while reducing resource requirements.

Who you are: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting or Finance
  • Relevant work experience
  • Strong proficiency in Word, Excel (Pivot tables & VLOOKUP) and Outlook; SAP, EROS, and JIRA experience a plus
  • Detail oriented individual with strong organizational and leadership skills that can handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to interact well with different levels within the organization.
  • Ability to analyze and review information from several different sources (corporate systems).

job.description:

This allows us to stay connected and reach out when suitable RTR roles become available within our Global Finance Shared Services (GFSS) team in Warsaw.

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. From being home to the world’s first music label to shaping the future of music, entertainment, and technology, we’ve played a pioneering role in music history. Today, we operate in more than 60 countries, supporting a diverse roster of global superstars, independent artists, and visionary creators. Across everything we do, we are driven by creativity, collaboration, transparency, and entrepreneurial thinking.

By partnering closely with local finance teams across the globe, GFSS has a strong understanding of how the business operates and contributes directly to Sony Music achieving its annual goals.

As part of the RTR talent pool, you may be considered for future RTR Analyst opportunities. In these roles, you will be responsible for providing & ensuring the accuracy & completeness of transactional financial accounting services to regional Sony Music entities.

The GFSS team is based in our modern workspace at the Elektrownia Powiśle centre in Warsaw.

If you’re looking to grow your career in finance within a global, creative, and fast‑paced organisation, we’d love to hear from you.

job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 48 markets worldwide and servicing top global independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with clients to provide full scale solutions across a variety of verticals. Championed by an exceptional community of music lovers and experts, The Orchard empowers creators to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global industry. 

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

This position will manage the day to day activities for key distributed labels, working alongside label clients to develop artists and promote content at the industry's leading independent music distributor and label services company.  The candidate must be Dubai based and have strong passion for and knowledge of the music distribution scene and the independent cross-genre music market, an understanding of digital retail platforms, release requirements and opportunities, a creative spirit, and solid technical capabilities.

What you'll do:

DSP Strategy & Campaign Management:

  • Develop, implement, and manage end-to-end digital marketing campaigns for new releases, with a core focus on DSP performance.
  • Secure and optimize key promotional placements across all DSPs, including playlist adds (editorial and algorithmic), homepage features, new release banners, and programmatic advertising.
  • Serve as the primary internal and external point of contact for all DSP partners, building and maintaining strong, productive relationships.
  • Lead catalog optimization initiatives to maximize the long-term performance, discoverability, and consumption of both frontline and catalog releases across all DSPs

Marketing Initiatives Development

  • Propose and pilot innovative marketing tactics to optimize the exposure of our new releases and maximize catalog potential.
  • Stay ahead of the latest trends, tools, and best practices in the digital music landscape, especially new features and promotional opportunities on DSPs.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Lead the digital marketing planning process for assigned projects, presenting strategies and results to the relevant stakeholders.
  • Work closely with the Label Management Team to enhance the visibility and impact of priority releases across all DSPs.

Team Development

  • Provide active support and guidance to direct team members, facilitating problem resolution and implementing processes that enhance productivity and efficiency.
  • Act as a role model by demonstrating best practices for effective communication and pitching approaches with DSPs.

Who you are:

  • 5-7 years of experience in digital marketing, with a minimum of 3+ years focused specifically on music marketing at a label, distributor, or DSP.
  • Proven, demonstrable track record of successfully launching and managing music campaigns that resulted in significant growth in streams or playlist placements.
  • Experience working within a label, artist management or distribution system managing releases, projects or relationships
  • Established relationships with key contacts at major DSP is a significant advantage.
  • Deep understanding of the pitching tools, editorial workflows, algorithmic levers, and promotional opportunities across all major DSPs.
  • ⁠Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret streaming data and performance insights to optimize campaign execution and support strategic decision-making.
  • Knowledge of social marketing, online video platforms, digital advertising, and online
  • promotional outlets
  • High level of awareness and passion for local independent labels, artists and the Arabic music scene
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, fluent in Arabic and English
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and drive results through coaching and mentorship.

The Global Finance Shared Service Centre supports the core business with finance related matters, covering a wide scope of activities across the globe. We work closely with the local finance teams around the world which means we have an excellent understanding of how the company operates and are kept up to date with key developments in this exciting and fast paced industry. job.title: Senior Accountant – Finanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d)
job.description:
Location: Berlin, Hamburg,

 

Wir suchen kurzfristig einen erfahrenen Finanzbuchhalter

Die Kings Road Merch GmbH ist ein weltweit etablierter Full-Service Anbieter von Merchandise-Produkten und -Dienstleistungen.

Als eigenständige deutsche Tochter eines weltweiten Musikkonzerns bieten wir individuelle Webshops für Bands oder Künstler an. Auf ihren Touren betreuen wir das Merchandising in Spielstätten in ganz Europa.

Unsere Services reichen dabei von der Herstellung der Merch-Produkte über die Lagerung und Logistik in unserem Logistikzentrum in Dortmund, die europaweite Tourbetreuung sowie den Betrieb individualisierter Webshops.

Wir suchen dich, wenn du Spaß daran hast, in der Musikindustrie rund um bedruckte T-Shirts und Fanartikel zu arbeiten. Europäische Umsatzsteuern, OSS und Quellensteuern schrecken dich nicht ab? Du möchtest mit unserem ERP-System NetSuite und eng mit internationalen Finance-Partnern arbeiten?

Als Senior Accountant übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Steuerung, Überwachung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Finance- und Accounting-Prozesse für das europäische Geschäft von Kings Road Merch. In enger Abstimmung mit dem europäischen Management und der globalen Finance-Organisation stellst du sicher, dass Abschlüsse, Reporting, Compliance und interne Kontrollen verlässlich, fristgerecht und nach einheitlichen Standards umgesetzt werden.

Aufgaben

  • Zentrale Steuerung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Accounting-Prozesse für das europäische Geschäft von KRM
  • Eigenständige Betreuung der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung
  • Prüfung von Rechnungen und Abwicklung des Zahlungsverkehrs
  • Forderungsmanagement
  • Erstellung der Umsatzsteuermeldungen in allen europäischen Ländern in Zusammenarbeit mit unserem internationalen Compliance Partner
  • Vorbereitung und Koordination der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB sowie des Reportings
  • Erstellung und Qualitätssicherung des monatlichen Finanzreportings an die US-Muttergesellschaft
  • Funktion als zentrale Finance-Schnittstelle zwischen KRM EU, dem europäischen Management und der globalen Finance-Organisation
  • Sicherstellung verlässlicher interner Kontrollen, Dokumentationen und einheitlicher Accounting-Standards
  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen und Automatisierungen innerhalb der Finance-Prozesse
  • Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und effizienten Nutzung von NetSuite

 

Profil

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Steuerfachangestellte:r oder Finanzbuchhalter:in; alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer eigenverantwortlichen Accounting-Funktion
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Finanzbuchhaltung und Abschlusserstellung nach HGB
  • Erfahrung mit Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen sowie Finanz- und Konzernreporting; IFRS-Kenntnisse sind wünschenswert
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Verbesserung von Accounting-Prozessen, idealerweise in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld
  • Fähigkeit, eigenständig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig eng mit internationalen Finance- und Managementteams zusammenzuarbeiten
  • Erfahrung mit NetSuite oder die Bereitschaft, sich einzuarbeiten
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse für die regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit mit der globalen Finance-Organisation

Unser Angebot

  • Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten im Musikbusiness
  • Sicherheit und Möglichkeiten eines internationalen Konzerns
  • Modernes, digitalisiertes Accounting im weltweiten Umfeld
  • Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Mo-Fr) mit der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten
  • Vielfältiges Team
  • Moderne Altersvorsorge
  • Fahrkostenzuschuss oder Jobrad

 

English Translation:

Location: Berlin, Hamburg, 


We are currently seeking a Senior Accountant.

Kings Road Merch GmbH is a globally established full-service provider of merchandise products and services. As an independent German subsidiary of a global music group, we offer customized online shops for bands and artists. We manage merchandising at venues throughout Europe during their tours.

Our services range from the production of merchandise products to storage and logistics in our logistics center in Dortmund, Europe-wide tour support, and the operation of customized online shops.

We are looking for you if you enjoy working in the music industry with printed T-shirts and merchandise. European VAT, OSS and withholding tax requirements do not intimidate you, and you are keen to work with NetSuite and collaborate closely with international Finance partners.

As Senior Accountant, you will play a key role in overseeing and continuously improving the finance and accounting processes supporting KRM's European business. Working closely with the European management team and the global Finance organization, you will ensure that financial close, reporting, compliance and internal controls are accurate, timely and consistently applied.

 

What you will do:

  • Central oversight and continuous improvement of the accounting processes supporting KRM’s European business
    Independent management of accounts receivable and accounts payable processes
  • Invoice review and payment processing
  • Accounts receivable management
  • Preparation of VAT returns in all European countries in collaboration with our international compliance partner
  • Preparation and coordination of monthly and annual financial statements in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB), as well as reporting
  • Preparation and quality assurance of monthly financial reporting to the US parent company
  • Act as the central Finance interface between KRM EU, the European management team and the global Finance organization
  • Ensure reliable internal controls, documentation and consistently applied accounting standards
  • Identify and implement improvements and automation opportunities across Finance processes
  • Support the continued development and effective use of NetSuite

 

Who you are:

  • Completed commercial training, ideally as a tax clerk or financial accountant, or an equivalent qualification
  • Several years of professional experience in an accounting role with a high level of ownership
  • Strong knowledge of financial accounting and financial statement preparation under the German Commercial Code (HGB)
  • Experience with monthly and annual financial statements as well as financial and group reporting; IFRS knowledge is desirable
  • Experience in overseeing and improving accounting processes, ideally within an international business environment
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with international Finance and management teams
  • Proficiency in Oracle NetSuite and Microsoft Excel is highly desirable.
  • Good English skills for regular collaboration with the global Finance organization

 

What we offer

  • Exciting and varied activities in the music business
  • Security and opportunities of an international corporation
  • Modern, digitalized accounting in a global environment
  • Personal responsibility and development opportunities
  • Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes
  • Flexible working hours (Mon-Fri) with the option of remote working
  • Diverse team
  • Modern pension plan
  • Travel allowance or company bike

job.title: Senior Business Solutions Specialist - PDEGO
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

About Business Solutions

Business Solutions partners with our label, marketing, and release planning teams to build the tools and workflows that help them run more effectively. We operate as a trusted internal partner, not an order-taking function. Our work is guided by three principles: Fail Fast: test ideas quickly, and don't let perfection get in the way of progress; Learn Quickly: treat every iteration as a chance to learn, document, and adapt; and Move Forward: keep the work, and the people we support, moving.

Role Summary

The Senior Business Solutions Specialist is the trusted day-to-day partner for a dedicated portfolio of business units spanning US and international markets, owning the full solution lifecycle from discovery through delivery, while mentoring the broader NYC Specialist team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned business units
  • Run discovery, scoping, and requirements-gathering sessions independently
  • Build and maintain business systems, automations, and workflows supporting label, marketing, and release operations
  • Write specs and requirements for integrations with internal Sony Music systems
  • Lead data migrations for assigned business units
  • Test solutions with end users and incorporate feedback quickly
  • Share best practices with the broader team, contributing repeatable patterns and playbook content to support other junior Specialists
  • Escalate architecture/platform-level questions to the Architect
  • Identify opportunities to centralize and standardize workflows across assigned BUs
  • Lead enablement and change-adoption efforts within your portfolio – training business users to use AI tools (e.g., Claude Cowork) to solve their own recurring problems, not just handing off finished solutions
  • Define success metrics for initiatives in your portfolio and use adoption/usage data to evaluate outcomes and guide iteration
  • Ensure initiatives align with governance, privacy, security, and compliance requirements, partnering with the Architect and relevant stakeholders (Legal, InfoSec) as needed


Required Qualifications

  • 5-8+ years in business/systems analysis, solutions consulting, or enterprise no-code/low-code platform administration, with the judgment to build solutions that are secure, scalable, and well-governed
  • Demonstrated ability to run point independently with senior business stakeholders
  • Strong requirements-gathering, process-mapping, and documentation skills
  • Experience with data migrations
  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects and business units
  • Extensive A.I. experience using tools such as Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Work, Google Gemini
  • Basic scripting, SQL, or automation-logic familiarity
  • Tool-agnostic and adaptable to learning new platforms as workflows expand
  • Experience leading change adoption or user enablement efforts within a business function
  • Comfortable defining measures of success and using data to evaluate outcomes


Nice to Have (not required)

  • Music industry experience; media & entertainment adjacency (rights, royalties, metadata) a plus
  • Airtable certification or deep hands-on Airtable expertise (our current core platform)

A Note on Applying

  • We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.

job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Alamo Records, Santa Anna Label Group, Foundation Media, and OVO Sound operate across a fast-moving, rapidly growing portfolio of labels, joint ventures, distribution partners, and artist deals. We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded Senior Director of Finance & Accounting who understands the broader label business and can support decisions around artists, joint ventures, acquisitions, catalog, cash flow, and profitability with insightful analysis. The ideal candidate will bring deep accounting expertise, strong operational discipline, and exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills.

In the near term, this person, in coordination with SME central teams, will provide hands-on leadership to strengthen accounting practices, including intercompany accounting, financial operations, and metadata management, to ensure accurate and comprehensive reporting. The Senior Director of Finance & Accounting will also be responsible for the monthly close and forecast, as well as the annual budgeting process. As part of a small, flat team supported by the wider Sony Music Finance, Accounting, and IT infrastructure, this person will touch virtually every aspect of label finance and accounting. The role requires someone who navigate a complex organizational structure and bring the technical accounting expertise the group needs.  This will require taking ownership of detailed project management and process design and execution.  Through this work, the Senior Director of Finance will build the experience and perspective needed to grow into a future CFO-level leader for the organization.

What you'll do:

  • Lead accounting setup, cleanup, and ongoing financial control processes across Alamo, Santa Anna, Foundation, OVO, and related ventures, with particular focus on entity structure, intercompany accounting, eliminations, reconciliations, and balance sheet integrity.
  • Strengthen accounting controls, workflows, and ownership across recurring close, reporting, intercompany, and operational finance processes.
  • Oversee monthly close, management reporting, variance analysis, balance sheet reviews, and corporate deliverables, ensuring results are accurate, timely, and clearly explained to senior management and SME stakeholders.
  • Manage annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and long-range planning across labels, joint ventures, acquisitions, and new business initiatives, connecting financial plans to operating priorities, deal terms, and profitability targets.
  • Partner with SME central teams, including Accounting, Global Finance, Tax, Royalties, JV Accounting, Metadata, and technology partners, to improve financial operations, data quality, metadata workflows, systems integration, and reporting consistency across a complex organizational structure.
  • Support deal analysis, artist and label investment decisions, catalog and acquisition opportunities, royalty and recoupment analysis, and new venture business plans, ensuring financial assumptions align with contractual terms and operational realities.
  • Act as a senior finance business partner to label leadership and department team members across business units to help drive revenue growth, profitability, cash discipline, and operating efficiency all the business.
  • Serve as a reliable #2 to the CFO, leading detailed project management, integration efforts, process improvement initiatives, and other high-priority finance projects as a hands-on operator and strategic finance leader.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance required.
  • 10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, ideally within music, media, entertainment, or another complex multi-entity environment.
  • CPA strongly preferred; MBA a plus.
  • Passionate about music, media, and entertainment.
  • Deep technical accounting foundation, including a strong understanding of month-end close processes, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, eliminations, and intercompany accounting across multiple legal entities.
  • Strong financial planning, forecasting, modeling, and analysis skills, with the ability to translate detailed financial data and analysis into clear recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Sophisticated Excel skills, with the ability to analyze and interpret large data sets.
  • Analytical mindset with a natural desire to ask “why,” coupled with the initiative to reimagine and reinvent processes and improve the accuracy of reporting and analysis.
  • Experience working with corporate accounting, tax, royalties, metadata, systems, and shared service teams to resolve cross-functional issues and improve end-to-end financial operations.
  • Hands-on leader with a roll-up-your-sleeves attitude, high attention to detail, and the ability to manage complex projects at a granular level.

This people strategy guides how we attract, on-board, develop, motivate, excite, challenge, reward and retain employees.

The ideal candidate will contribute at both hands-on and strategic levels to cultivate an innovative, progressive, and diverse culture practices across the employee lifecycle. You will bring thought leadership and creative solutions, as well as exceptional relationship building skills and the ability to adapt, lead and drive change.

Working closely with business unit leadership teams and other Sony entities, the role will define priorities across all critical employee experiences, including organization design, onboarding, engagement, compensation, talent management, career mobility, and initiatives to build a diverse and inclusive culture. 

Reporting directly to the VP of People Experience, Latin-Iberia, this role will serve on the Latin-Iberia PX leadership team and have a dotted-line reporting relationship to the General Manager of Iberia Region. 

The person will lead a team of 2 direct reports and be responsible for partnering with all the PX SMEs: Talent Acquisition team, PX Business Partners, PX Ops, PX Systems, Total Reward, Org Success, The Learning Collective, and DE&I on strategic initiatives that improve the overall employee experience across the employee journey in both territories.

  • Oversee strategic workforce planning, talent management, talent acquisition, total rewards, budgeting, people metrics, culture evolution, and organizational design to ensure we have the right people in place in Iberia.
  • Trust advisor to the Iberia executive team, shaping policies and initiatives that foster a high-performance organization, inclusive teams, and a values-driven culture based on our Global People Promise.
  • Coach, consult, and create trusted partnerships across business leaders and their teams, influencing employee engagement, retention, and the overall organizational culture.
  • Support PX Latin Iberia and Global PX strategy focusing on the strategic initiatives to improve the overall employee experience across key pillars:  
  • Attraction, Hiring & Onboarding Experience (in partnership with TA and PX Operations)
  • Build best industry-defining capabilities with our current and future workforce through Leadership Development, Career Growth, Mobility Experiences and Talent Management
  • Place wellbeing at the heart of everything we do through work-life harmony, access to impactful support
  • Cultivate and inspire our unique culture through SME’s Employee Value Proposition, Employee Engagement, Inclusion, People Partnering, Employee Experiences.
  • Identify themes, trends, and latest thinking to feed into developing the best strategies and approaches for each of the pillars and drive engagement and retention.
  • Develop a general understanding of how business works.  Stay current on industry challenges, changes, and practices to provide timely and relevant support, guidance, and solutions to business leaders.
  • Partner with the DEI Office and regional leadership teams to champion the ongoing actions and efforts of the DEI plans across the region, embedding these principles into every stage of the employee lifecycle.
  • Manage and advise on day-to-day Iberia employment law and employee relations issues in consultation with People Labor Relations and legal counsel.  
  • Direct engagement with works councils, trade unions, and employee representatives.

  • Lead compensation process for the Iberia business (salary reviews, benchmarking, internal equity, payroll coordination, others), to guarantee the Total Reward Strategy is in place.  
  • Responsible for the development of leaders, middle managers, and the entire organization, working in partnership with The Learning Collective to establish a local plan that builds new capabilities and provides growth opportunities to all the employees.
  • Develop a rich business acumen and a deep understanding of creative and music industry drivers with a high level of commercial acumen.
  • Use data and analytics to support strategies, gain insights, and build a strong business case for change.
  • Champion change programs and initiatives that lead to improved employee experience as well as impact the business results.
  • Contribute to a highly collaborative Latin Iberia People Experience team on cross-functional projects and initiatives. 
  • Lead organizational changes (reorganizations, integrations, termination processes), both individual and collective.
  • Oversight of occupational health and safety, employee well-being, and coordination with external prevention services to build an environment where wellbeing is fully integrated in all areas of the business.
  • Management of internal investigations, compliance matters, data protection, and other confidential situations. 

Who you are:

  • Senior leadership experience and impact as a trusted advisor and business partner, ideally with more than 12+ years of experience.
