job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Anti-Abuse
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

SoundCloud is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Anti-Abuse Team, with a mission to keep connections between fans and creators safe and authentic, while building and operating an abuse prevention platform at global scale. The role can be based in either our Berlin or London office.

Our services are at the heart of SoundCloud’s user journeys. We operate a substantial suite of event-based services, combining specialised and generalised detection approaches to tackle complex architectural problems where scale, adaptability and fast decision-making are critical.

You’ll join a self-sufficient team passionate about abuse prevention, building scalable and adaptable solutions that stay ahead of emerging risks. The role combines long-term platform and architecture work with rapid response to new abuse vectors, giving you the opportunity to solve both strategic and time-sensitive engineering problems.

You’ll have significant end-to-end ownership to identify problems, shape solutions and drive projects from the ground up, working directly with engineering and T&S Professionals. If you’re creative, proactive and enjoy being the expert who turns complex problems into effective solutions, you’ll have plenty of room to make an impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve reusable platform capabilities and services that enable other teams to detect and respond to emerging abuse patterns at scale
  • Shape the platform architecture and technical strategy, balancing long-term scalability with rapid responses to emerging challenges
  • Partner with Product, Analytics, Trust & Safety professionals, and Engineering teams to identify and address abuse patterns across the organisation, driving alignment on solutions and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.
  • Own problems end-to-end, from identifying opportunities and defining solutions to driving projects through delivery
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing cost, latency, complexity, scalability and maintainability
  • Drive architecture discussions, contribute to technical strategy, and improve engineering practices, processes and tooling.
  • Debug complex issues across data pipelines and distributed systems
  • Continuously learn and share knowledge of industry best practices in abuse prevention and detection
  • Be part of on-call rotation to ensure the reliability and availability of SoundCloud’s systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing APIs and backend services consumed by multiple client platforms
  • Strong SQL skills for massive datasets (e.g. BigQuery or similar)
  • Knowledge of different API communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL)
  • Strong professional experience with Go; experience with Scala or another language is a plus
  • Nice to have: Experience in abuse prevention, fraud detection or Trust & Safety is a plus
  • Nice to have: Experience using AI-assisted development tools and a strong intuition for their strengths, weaknesses, and emerging opportunities

Experience and Background

  • Extensive professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating distributed, event-driven backend systems at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and cloud-native environments such as AWS or GCP
  • Experience in building distributed data processing and ETL pipelines, metrics and supporting ML infrastructure 
  • Experience with microservices, SQL and NoSQL databases, container technologies
  • You care about the craft of software engineering: continuous delivery, defensive programming, automated testing, security, clean code principles
  • You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-moving environments
  • You bring a humble, collaborative, team-first mindset and an eagerness to learn and support your colleagues
  • Bonus point: You love music

About us

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

 

Benefits: The Recruiter will supply the benefit points based on the location

 

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at SoundCloud 

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.


At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: On Air Talent
job.description:
About SBS:

As a pioneer in Spanish-language media, SBS has always been at the forefront of the evolution of Hispanic entertainment in the U.S. In this era of technological advancements and media convergence, SBS is poised to capitalize on its vast array of proprietary content across multiple platforms. Our unwavering commitment is to create exceptional, high-quality branded entertainment that resonates deeply with the Hispanic consumer. Our impressive growth on the web with LaMusica.com and the promising reception of our latest venture, the podcast initiative, are testament to SBS' long-term strategy. By seamlessly delivering content through diverse channels, we not only maximize revenue but also extend the reach of our beloved brands. SBS remains steadfast in our leadership position in today's dynamic and ever-expanding U.S. Hispanic market, and we are determined to continue pushing boundaries and shaping the future of Hispanic media.

Position Summary

On-air Talent Personality is responsible for the daily broadcasting of a radio station to which is assigned, and their work focuses on engaging the listening or viewing audience in a creative and engaging manner while maintaining FCC compliance for content. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

•   Perform live broadcast show that is entertaining and informative to their audience

•   Interview personalities and guests

•   Record commercials for later broadcast.

•   Serve as a reporter as assigned, including special reports 

•   Select program content, in conjunction with producers, based on factors such as program specialties, audience tastes, or requests from the public.

•   Provide commentary and conduct interviews during “Live” transmissions, and other events

•   Develop sources and story ideas

•   Make promotional appearances at public or private events in order to represent the company.

•   Participates in regular internal meetings to review new content, topics, with Executive Producer and team

•   Have an active presence on social media that engages the audience

•   Other duties as required

Essential duties and responsibilities are those most important or most frequently performed duties.  Employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in a similar position
  • Must have engaging on-air presence.
  • Must possess impeccable diction in Spanish language, preferably fully bilingual (Spanish/English)
  • Be creative and have great story telling and writing skills in Spanish. 
  • Pleasant and well-controlled voice and good timing when speaking on air.
  • Ability to interact with audience and clients in a public setting.
  • Gather news information and prepare it for on-air delivery.
  • Familiar with current events (national and international), enjoys participating in conversational debates.
  • Must be able to work well under strict deadlines and pressure.
  • Able to work long hours, including weekends and holidays, when necessary
  • Teamwork/Cooperation with positive working relationships
  • Must be creative, have a sharp wit and able to improvise and think quickly while on air.

In addition to meeting the minimum qualifications listed above, an individual must be able to perform each of the established essential functions to perform this job successfully.

Physical Requirements

Work involves exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally or a negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. Jobs may be defined as sedentary when walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Why work for SBS?

Spanish Broadcasting Systems (SBS) offers a unique and exciting opportunity to be part of the leading Hispanic-focused media company in the industry. By joining our team, you will become an integral part of shaping and influencing the landscape of Spanish-language broadcasting. We take pride in our rich heritage and commitment to serving the vibrant Hispanic community with compelling content and innovative programming. At SBS, you will be surrounded by a diverse and talented group of professionals who share a passion for media, creativity, and cultural connectivity. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized. With access to state-of-the-art facilities and cutting-edge technologies, you will have the tools to bring your ideas to life and create impactful experiences for our audience. Additionally, SBS provides ample opportunities for personal and professional growth, with ongoing learning and development programs designed to enhance your skills and advance your career. If you are seeking a dynamic and rewarding career in the world of Spanish-language broadcasting, SBS is the place to be. Join us and be part of a team that is making a difference in the lives of millions of people every day.

job.title: Senior Account Executive
job.description:
About the Role:

The Senior Account Executive plays a pivotal role in driving revenue growth and fostering long-term client relationships within the Information and Media Services industry. This position is responsible for managing a portfolio of key accounts, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that align with their business objectives. The role requires strategic thinking to identify new business opportunities and collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery. Success in this position is measured by the ability to exceed sales targets while maintaining high client satisfaction and retention rates. Ultimately, the Senior Account Executive acts as a trusted advisor to clients, contributing to the company’s reputation and market presence across the United States.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in sales or account management within the Information and Media Services industry.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a B2B environment.
  • Strong understanding of media services, digital platforms, and industry trends.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with CRM software such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Advanced degree or professional certification in sales, marketing, or business management.
  • Familiarity with data analytics and reporting tools to assess campaign performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage large and complex accounts.
  • Experience in consultative selling and solution-based sales approaches.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients to understand their business needs and objectives.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead generation to contract negotiation and closing deals.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketing, product development, and customer support to deliver customized solutions.
  • Prepare and present detailed proposals, sales presentations, and reports to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and adjust sales strategies accordingly.
  • Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets while maintaining high levels of client satisfaction.
  • Provide regular updates and forecasts to senior management regarding account status and pipeline development.

Skills:

The Senior Account Executive utilizes strong communication and interpersonal skills daily to build and maintain client relationships, ensuring clear understanding of client needs and expectations. Negotiation and persuasion skills are essential when closing deals and securing favorable terms for both the client and the company. Strategic thinking and market analysis skills enable the executive to identify new business opportunities and adapt sales tactics to changing industry dynamics. Proficiency with CRM and data analytics tools supports effective pipeline management and performance tracking, allowing for data-driven decision-making. Collaboration skills are critical when working with internal teams to develop and deliver customized solutions that meet client objectives and drive business growth.

job.title: Art Director - Mexico
job.description:
The Marketing team in Latin America defines and evolves how Spotify shows up across the region. We shape brand experiences that feel authentic, inclusive, and deeply rooted in music culture. In Mexico, our work connects artists, fans, and communities through bold storytelling and culturally fluent creative execution.   The Art Director plays a critical role in defining and driving Spotify’s brand in the region. Working across disciplines, the Art Director ensures Spotify shows up in ways that feel authentic, inclusive, and deeply connected to music culture.

While focused on Mexico, the role sits within the broader Latin American organization and may contribute to regional projects where local creative leadership is required.

job.title: Audiobook Licensing & Partnerships Manager - Japan
job.description:
At Spotify, we are redefining the audiobook industry with our innovative Audiobooks in Premium model. Our mission is to empower creators and consumers by delivering the best audiobook content with unmatched quality and accessibility. We are building a thriving ecosystem that scales with creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology.

We’re building Spotify’s audiobook business in Japan and looking for someone to lead our relationships with Japanese publishers. You’ll help build our publisher portfolio and secure a catalogue that resonates with listeners in Japan. After launch, you’ll keep owning and growing these partnerships so they deliver lasting value for Spotify and our publishing partners.

job.title: AV Engineer - Platform
job.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

The IT Studio exists to remove the friction of work, unblocking Spotifiers anywhere, anytime, with simplicity and safety. We’re behind the technology that thousands of Spotifiers rely on every day, spanning devices, identity and access, networking, IT support, audio visual and meeting room technology, productivity platforms, work management tooling, and AI tooling.

We’re looking for an AV Engineer II to join the IT Studio in Stockholm and help create reliable, intuitive AV experiences across our office. You’ll own everything from everyday meeting-room technology to high-stakes executive meetings, partnering with our global AV team, IT Support, NetOps, other technical teams, and external vendors.

job.title: Backend Engineer - Platform Security
job.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

We are looking for a Backend Engineer II to join our Security Compliance Engineering team. You’ll help turn complex security, risk, and compliance requirements into scalable software solutions that make it easier for teams across Spotify to build and operate securely. You’ll work with engineers and partners across security to strengthen our technical Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) capabilities.

job.title: Client Partner - Emerging & Scaled (German Speaking)
job.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 

We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. 

You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

job.title: Client Partner ANZ
job.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 

Spotify is seeking a talented and dynamic individual to join the team as a Contractor - Client Partner based in Sydney. This role will be responsible for driving revenue growth and building long-term relationships with key advertising clients and agencies.

You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales, marketing, and product teams to deliver innovative advertising solutions that meet the needs of our clients while maximising revenue opportunities for Spotify.

Please note this is a fixed-term, 12 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

job.title: Client Partner, Emerging & Scaled
job.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 
We're looking for a Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled Sales team, one of the fastest-growing teams within Spotify Advertising. In this role, you'll own and grow a portfolio of strategic clients, serving as a trusted advisor who understands their business goals and delivers advertising solutions that drive measurable impact. You'll combine strategic thinking, commercial expertise, and relationship management to develop long-term partnerships while helping advertisers unlock the full value of Spotify's advertising platform.   If you're passionate about digital advertising, thrive in a consultative sales environment, and enjoy building lasting client relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Global Creative Lead, Reverb
job.description:
Spotify's in-house creative studio, Reverb, brings our brand to life through thoughtful design, visual storytelling, and creative production. Working across brand and communications, the team creates work that connects with audiences around the world.

We're looking for a Global Creative Lead to shape the visual direction of Reverb and lead a talented team of graphic designers, motion designers, and producers. You'll combine creative vision with hands-on leadership, helping the team deliver distinctive, high-quality work while building an environment where people can collaborate, experiment, and grow.

Reporting to the Director, Global Experiential & Content Production, you'll play a key role in shaping the studio's creative output and how we work together.

job.title: Growth Manager MENAT+
job.description:
We're looking for a Growth Manager to join Spotify's SAMEA Growth team within Markets and Subscriptions. You'll help more listeners discover, choose, and stay with Spotify Premium across the Middle East, North Africa, Turkey, Pakistan, and CIS markets (MENAT+).

Working closely with local market teams and colleagues across Marketing, Product, Data, and Commercial, you'll turn growth opportunities into campaigns, experiments, and measurable results. Our team combines local market knowledge, creativity, and data to build meaningful listener experiences and grow Premium subscriptions.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing ideas to life, learning through experimentation, and making things happen. You'll take ownership of growth initiatives across multiple markets, from planning and execution to performance analysis and optimisation, helping shape how Spotify Premium grows across a diverse and dynamic region.

job.title: Manager, Content Acquisition
job.description:
Spotify's Content Business team helps bring compelling audio and video content to audiences around the world. Working across Spotify Originals, The Ringer, and licensed content, the team partners with creators, production companies, and internal stakeholders to bring content opportunities to life.

We're looking for a Manager, Content Acquisition to help turn content opportunities into completed deals. You'll manage the deal process from agreed commercial terms through contract execution, working closely with Legal, Finance, Studios, and external partners. This role combines commercial judgment, contract management, and financial analysis to support Spotify's growing content business.

job.title: Performance Marketing Activation Specialist
job.description:
We’re the Markets & Subscribers business unit, a truly cross-functional team focused on finding future listeners, wherever and whoever they may be. We work collaboratively, combining marketing, insights, product development, design, and engineering expertise to grow Spotify’s subscribers and monthly active users in both new and existing markets across the globe. Join us and you’ll be part of a dynamic team taking acquisition, activation, and business growth at Spotify to the next level.

Spotify is looking for a Performance Marketing Activation Specialist to join the band and help drive direct response marketing efforts. You'll be part of the in-house Performance Marketing team - planning, launching, and optimizing global acquisition and conversion campaigns across paid search and paid social, owning every part of the campaign process. You'll work closely with cross-functional partners, analytics teams, and external platforms and agencies to deliver results. A desire to learn more about data and tech innovation is a must have for future growth in the role.

job.title: Principal Product Manager - Format Foundations
job.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening and watching feel effortless, personal, and joyful for hundreds of millions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re seeking a Principal Product Manager to help lead the consumer experience across Spotify’s formats, including books, podcasts, and music. Format Foundations partners with the business teams behind each format to lead innovation in how users discover, engage with, and build lasting relationships with content on Spotify. You’ll set the product vision and strategy for your area and shape feature portfolios across formats. This role sits within Format Foundations in Core Experience, partnering closely with these teams to grow their businesses through product innovation.

job.title: Security Engineer - Enterprise Security
job.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

At Spotify, security helps make innovation possible. Our Enterprise Security team protects the systems and technology that support our employees and the more than 700 million people who use Spotify. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help strengthen our enterprise security across identity, devices, networks, and AI-powered tools. You'll build practical solutions, work with teams across the business, and help us create a secure environment where people can do their best work.

job.title: Senior Growth Manager
job.description:
You’ll join the Premium Growth India team within the Markets & Subscriptions organisation, focused on making Spotify Premium an increasingly desirable music experience in India. Sitting at the intersection of marketing, product, music, and strategy, the team works closely with Music, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to grow Premium through cultural relevance and artist-led initiatives.

In this role, you’ll own Premium desirability and the artist and partner Premium flywheel for India, shaping how we work with artists, cultural moments, fandom, and partnerships to drive Premium consideration and measurable conversion at scale.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Personalization
job.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Growlithe is a fast-moving squad within Spotify's Conversation Product Area, focused on bringing emerging Search and agentic experiences to life. We explore, define, build, validate, and optimize new ideas to help listeners discover the content they love. Our work spans personalized Search, music video discovery and ranking, audiobook Search expansion, and the foundations of more social Search experiences.

We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help shape the next generation of Search at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of machine learning, personalization, and product development, turning complex challenges into intuitive discovery experiences for millions of listeners.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineering Manager - Content Platform
job.description:
We design Spotify's consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

You'll lead a senior-heavy group of 10–12 machine learning engineers, including Staff engineers, who team up dynamically to solve high-priority business problems while staying deep in content understanding (audio, video and text). This is a player-coach role with a strong strategic remit: you'll shape where the group goes next, grow our audio understanding expertise over the long term, and help the team scale through thoughtful, practical use of AI in everyday engineering work.

job.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer - Audiobooks
job.description:
We're looking for a strategic, detail-oriented Senior Product Manager to join the Books Vertical and lead end-to-end book experiences on Spotify: from discovery and conversion through to listening, and from the creator pipeline through to the consumer shelf. This role is about connecting the dots across our core experiences, conversion flows, content pipeline, and creator tooling to make books work seamlessly on Spotify.

Books are a major focus for Spotify, and we need someone who can look holistically across the book ecosystem to identify gaps, reduce friction, and make sure our experiences are coherent end-to-end. You'll focus on making the full books journey work better for listeners, creators, and rights-holders, not just shipping new features. You'll partner closely with Personalization, Subscriptions, Experience, and creator-facing teams to strengthen and evolve book experiences across surfaces, and help shape a product strategy that directly improves how listeners discover and enjoy books.

job.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer - Audiobooks
job.description:
We're looking for a strategic, detail-oriented Senior Product Manager to join the Books Vertical and lead end-to-end book experiences on Spotify: from discovery and conversion through to listening, and from the creator pipeline through to the consumer shelf. This role is about connecting the dots across our core experiences, conversion flows, content pipeline, and creator tooling to make books work seamlessly on Spotify.

Books are a major focus for Spotify, and we need someone who can look holistically across the book ecosystem to identify gaps, reduce friction, and make sure our experiences are coherent end-to-end. You'll focus on making the full books journey work better for listeners, creators, and rights-holders, not just shipping new features. You'll partner closely with Personalization, Subscriptions, Experience, and creator-facing teams to strengthen and evolve book experiences across surfaces, and help shape a product strategy that directly improves how listeners discover and enjoy books.

job.title: Senior Program Analyst - GTM Ops
job.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 

Our Revenue Growth team drives advertiser acquisition and retention at scale by turning data into action. We build and run scalable go-to-market programs that help advertisers succeed, through lifecycle communications and seller-facing actions. 

As a Senior Program Analyst - GTM Ops, you'll own the technical layer that makes Revenue Growth actually run. Working within Spotify's broader data infrastructure, you'll build the team-specific tools, endpoints, and pipelines our programs depend on — the reporting that helps sellers act, the data feeds that power our advertiser tools, the pipelines that keep everything moving. Your work won't be abstract; it shows up directly in what the team ships and what sellers experience.

job.title: Talent Relations Manager
job.description: The Ringer is looking for an experienced Talent Relations Manager to work with high-profile talent and book guests across our slate of shows. You’ll partner closely with our content teams, hosts, and producers to identify compelling talent opportunities and strategically book guests who connect with each show’s audience. You’ll bring strong relationships across the entertainment industry, sound judgment, and a genuine passion for podcasts and culture.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Stephens Media Group is a privately-owned company that helps to generate revenue for local businesses. We do this by communicating the right message, to the right audiences, so businesses can start seeing new customers right away.

We are looking for a skilled Account Executive to find business opportunities and manage customer relationships. You’ll be directly responsible for the preservation and expansion of our customer base. The ideal candidate will have a passion for sales and experience in media and digital advertising with exceptional customer service. The right candidate is a reliable professional able to achieve a balance between customer orientation and a results-driven approach. The goal is to find opportunities and turn them into long-term profitable relationships based on trust and mutual satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Create detailed business strategies to facilitate the attainment of goals and quotas
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from finding a client to securing a deal
  • Unearth new sales opportunities through networking & prospecting in order to develop into long term partnerships
  • Present products & capabilities to prospective clients
  • Recommend and process digital advertising campaigns
  • Provide professional post-sales support to enhance customer devotion
  • Remain in frequent contact with clients in order to uncover their additional needs
  • Respond to complaints and resolve issues aiming toward customer contentment and the preservation of the company’s reputation
  • Negotiate agreements and keep records of sales and data

Requirements

  • Proven experience as an Account Executive, or in other sales/customer service role
  • 2+ years in media &/or digital advertising sales is preferred, but not required
  • Knowledge of market research, sales and negotiating principles
  • Outstanding knowledge of MS Office; knowledge of CRM software is a plus
  • Excellent communication/presentation skills and ability to build relationships
  • Organizational and time-management skills
  • A business acumen
  • Enthusiastic and passionate

Education

  • High school diploma
  • BS or BA in business administration, sales or marketing, preferred but not required

Here are the 7 must-have qualities we look for in every Account Executive:

  1. Extremely competitive
  2. Deep need to get others to see things from his/her perspective
  3. A tenacity to open up new opportunities daily
  4. High self-esteem that doesn’t take rejection personally
  5. A willingness to use the telephone to set up face-to-face meetings
  6. The desire to creatively communicate (we’ll teach you how!)
  7. Cares as much about team success as individual success

Send materials to Laurie Hammermeister

job.title: Stingray Jobs
job.description:
Department Sales Location Toronto

Stingray is a leading global music, media and technology company, and Canada’s premier radio broadcaster.  At Stingray, creativity, collaboration and innovative technology are the pillars of our DNA.

We are currently looking for a Media Sales Strategist to join our Toronto Sales Team! This position reports to the Toronto General Sales Manager.

If you are a driven, self-starter who loves to be part of a winning team, we want to hear from you!

Your day-to-day

  • Represent a diverse range of media solutions including radio, streaming audio through TuneIn, programmatic display and video, connected TV, digital out-of-home, YouTube, search, social and our proprietary retail media platform – to help clients grow and succeed.
  • Own the end-to-end sales process, from lead generation and prospecting to performing client needs analysis, presenting solutions, negotiating and execution of closing strategies;
  • Drive revenue growth and achieve revenue targets through consultative sales and development of strategic proposals;
  • Collaborate with promotions, programming, creative, production and digital campaign managers, to build and support audience based, multi-media advertising campaigns;
  • Manage and grow existing client base while prospecting to create new business.

Your qualifications

  • Experience in Marketing, Sales or Business Management (experience in Multi-Media advertising or digital environments an asset);
  • 2+ years of in-person, consultative B2B sales or account management experience;
  • Strong track record of achieving and exceeding set targets;
  • Excellent communicator, presenter and negotiator;
  • Builds strong relationships while always maintaining a professional approach;
  • Well-organized and accountable with strong time management skills;
  • Prioritizes multiple demands in a deadline-driven, fast-paced environment;
  • Proactively embraces change; is positive, consultative, enthusiastic, and optimistic;
  • A Toronto area resident with a valid driver’s license, use of a vehicle and vehicle insurance.

Life at Stingray

  • The opportunity to work with a diverse range of companies, across sectors and markets;
  • A defined bonus structure;
  • Unlimited earning potential – no capped commissions;
  • Access to training and development – we help our teammates get better;
  • A positive, team-oriented work environment;
  • An opportunity to work with and learn from the best in the business;
  • Pension Plan and Share Purchase Plan (with a contribution from Stingray);
  • Comprehensive benefits plan and Employee and Family Assistance Plan;
  • Hybrid work policy

We leverage AI‑supported tools to assist with the initial review of applications. These tools do not replace human judgment—final decisions are made by our recruitment teams.

If you are looking for an exceptional workplace and have what it takes to fill this position:

  • Tell us what else you’re passionate about.
  • Send your resume with references.

Apply Now: https://jobs.stingray.com/job/media-sales-strategist-toronto-on/

 

Submissions deadline: Monday, October 26, 2026.

 

Stingray Radio supports the principles of Employment Equity and we are committed to ensuring our workforce is representative of the communities we serve. Women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities and members of racialized groups are encouraged to apply and to self-identify so we can work towards full representation of those groups within our company.

Stingray Radio requires all applicants to be legally eligible to work in Canada without sponsorship.

Not the job for you? Got to jobs.stingray.com to consult other available positions and learn more about Stingray. We’re always on the lookout for new talent.

job.title: Stingray Jobs
job.description:
Department Marketing Location Kelowna (BC)

Stingray is a leading global music, media and technology company, and Canada’s premier radio broadcaster.  At Stingray, creativity, collaboration and innovative technology are the pillars of our DNA.

We are currently looking for a multi-skilled talent to join our Kelowna, BC team! This position reports to the Marketing and Promotions Director in Kamloops.

Your day-to-day

  • Assist in the coordination of promotional, sales and programming campaigns for K96.3 and New Country 100.7
  • Manage and maintain promotional prizes and oversee the winner fulfillment process
  • Assist in organizing station events (i.e., trips, grand prize giveaways, movie premieres)
  • On-site activations (i.e., concerts, trade shows, on-air cut ins, live broadcasts, community events)
  • Create, maintain, and manage social and digital content
  • Support listener contests, databases, and station promotions
  • Attend and actively participate in weekly meetings and station planning.
  • Weekly production tasks
  • Oversee the hiring, coaching and supervision of brand ambassadors
  • Attend and participate in weekly meetings and brainstorms
  • Creating wrap up reports for station events, promotions and campaigns
  • Assist in the creation of graphic designs for station and promotional initiatives
  • Overseeing station vehicle maintenance
  • Other duties as assigned.

Your qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years marketing experience, remote broadcast experience is an asset
  • Experience in dealing with the public
  • Detail-oriented
  • Multi-tasker with excellent time management skills
  • Great team player – you thrive in a collaborative environment
  • You know that radio isn’t a 9-5 business, and have the flexibility to make projects happen whenever they need to happen

Life at Stingray

job.description:
Department Administration Location Montreal

Are you a positive, organized, and professional individual who thrives on being the central hub of a dynamic office? Stingray is a passionate team dedicated to music and technology, and we are currently seeking a Receptionist for a maternity leave replacement contract. This is a full-time-temporary, in-office position based at our Montreal office. In this role, you are the director of first impressions and a key player in our daily operations.

Your day-to-day

  • Be the Ambassador of Stingray: As the first point of contact for our guests, partners, and employees, you will provide a warm, professional, and memorable welcome experience. You will:
    • Welcome and greet all visitors and guests in a warm, professional, and courteous manner.
    • Notify the appropriate employee of their guest’s arrival and provide assistance as needed.
    • Maintain a professional, organized, and welcoming reception area.
    • Assist visitors and employees with general inquiries and direct them to the appropriate resources.
  • Master of Communications: You will manage our multi-line phone system with efficiency and grace, directing calls to the right people across the organization.
    • Answer, screen, and direct incoming calls.
    • Take and relay messages as required.
    • Manage general reception inquiries and requests.
  • Logistics Coordinator: You will be the go-to person for organizing the details that make our office run smoothly, including:
    • Coordinating internal and external meetings, events, and client accommodations.
    • Preparing and resetting conference rooms for meetings, lunches, presentations, and events, ensuring they are clean, organized, and properly equipped.
    • Coordinating and setting up client lunches, refreshments, and other hospitality requirements.
    • Arranging business travel, including flights, hotels, and car services.
    • Preparing and serving coffee, tea, and refreshments for meetings, internal events, and external guests.
    • Supporting the organization and execution of office events and activities.
  • Office Hospitality & Operations: You will help maintain a well-organized, welcoming, and fully stocked office environment, including:
    • Maintaining the executive kitchen and common areas, including tidying, restocking refreshments and supplies, and conducting regular inventory checks.
    • Monitoring office supply and inventory levels and placing orders as required.
    • Ensuring meeting rooms, hospitality areas, and shared spaces are properly maintained and ready for use.
  • Operational Hub: You will manage the flow of information, packages, and deliveries into and out of the office while providing administrative support across the organization.
    • Manage all incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and shipments, including FedEx and courier services.
    • Coordinate incoming and outgoing courier pickups and deliveries.
    • Distribute mail and packages to the appropriate employees or departments.
    • Provide general administrative support to various departments and assist with office-related requests as required.

Additional Administrative & Accounts Payable Support

While reception remains the primary focus of the role, periods of lower call and visitor volume provide opportunities to support the Finance team with administrative Accounts Payable activities, including:

  • Receiving and verifying supplier invoices, employee expense reports, and corporate credit card statements.
  • Entering invoices and related data into NetSuite.
  • Matching purchase orders to invoices and supporting invoice processing.
  • Creating and maintaining supplier records within the accounting system.
  • Reviewing supplier statements and assisting with account reconciliations.
  • Assisting with payment processing and cheque runs across multiple banking platforms.
  • Supporting the Finance team with general administrative and data-entry tasks as required.

Your qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of experience as a receptionist or in a client service role. Experience with corporate travel booking is a strong asset.
  • Bilingualism: You are fluent in both English and French, with excellent communication skills in both languages.
  • Poise Under Pressure: You remain calm, professional, and solution-oriented, even when the pace picks up.
  • Organizational Skills: You are highly organized, with a knack for prioritizing tasks and managing your time effectively.
  • Initiative: You are resourceful, proactive, and work well both independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility: You are available and flexible to work evenings and during holiday periods as needed.
  • Interest in Finance: Previous administrative, bookkeeping, Accounts Payable, or data-entry experience is considered an asset. This role is well-suited for individuals interested in gaining exposure to corporate finance processes.

Department Sales Location New York

Stingray Group Inc. is a leading music, media, and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. As a premium provider of curated direct-to-consumer and B2B services, we reach 400 million subscribers in 156 countries.

Stingray Advertising connects brands to passionate audiences across an expansive, multi-platform music ecosystem. Wherever consumers are watching, listening, or scrolling, Stingray is there.

Anchored by North America’s largest retail audio advertising network—reaching 800+ million monthly shoppers across 25,000+ top retail locations—we offer a seamless, full-funnel media suite across four core touchpoints:

  • In-Store Audio: Point-of-sale reach in major retail hubs like Walgreens and Albertsons.
  • In-Car Audio: Uninterrupted connection with commuters on the move.
  • In-Stream Audio: Digital audio streaming across premium music experiences.
  • In-Screen Audio (FAST/CTV): High-impact connected TV and video environments.

From home to the car to the aisle, we empower brands to connect with active audiences at every step of their journey.

We are seeking an experienced Pharmaceutical Category Sales Specialist to lead and scale our RX and OTC pharmaceutical advertising business across the US.

In this role, you will serve as the subject matter expert (SME) and category leader. Rather than managing an isolated territory silo, your primary mission is to matrix-support and enable our existing US sales team to unlock and accelerate pharmaceutical revenue within their established account bases. You will bring deep industry knowledge, regulatory expertise, and strategic insight to help our sales force articulate the power of Stingray’s entire multi-platform network—from point-of-care digital streaming and CTV video to point-of-sale in-store retail audio.

Your day-to-day

  • Enable & Scale Revenue: Partner directly with the US sales force to co-sell, strategize, and close pharmaceutical and RX business across all seller territories.
  • Category Leadership & SME: Act as the internal authority on the pharmaceutical media ecosystem, educating sales teams and clients on how multi-platform media (streaming audio, CTV, in-car, and in-store audio) drives consumer action.

job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We're looking for a Staff AI Security Engineer to secure how Suno's models are built, trained, and served, and to build the systems that keep them that way. You'll work across the full model lifecycle, from training pipelines and compute infrastructure to the products millions of people create with. You'll partner closely with ML research, platform, and product engineering, and set the technical direction for AI security as the function grows. There's a lot to build, and you'll be building it. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/JJoqlgtg8424Uq68

What You'll Do

Design and build security controls for model training and serving infrastructure, including compute clusters, pipelines, access to model artifacts, and the software supply chain behind them Engineer detection, monitoring, and guardrail systems for model inputs, outputs, and agentic tool use, as production code rather than one-off scripts Break our own systems through adversarial testing and red-teaming across models, pipelines, and products, then drive the fixes to done Partner with ML research and platform teams to make secure defaults the easy path in how models are trained, evaluated, and deployed Partner with product engineering to threat model and review customer-facing AI features before launch, and build the shared controls that let teams ship them safely by default Set technical direction for AI security at Suno, including standards, reference architectures, and the roadmap, while raising the security bar across engineering Help make creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone by keeping the platform trustworthy enough that millions of people want to create on it

What You'll Need

8–10 years in security engineering, including hands-on work securing ML systems or large-scale ML infrastructure in production A track record of designing and shipping security systems and tooling, not only assessing them Deep knowledge of cloud and infrastructure security: IAM, Kubernetes, network segmentation, secrets management, and infrastructure as code Strong understanding of ML training and serving pipelines and their attack surface, including model supply chain risks and protecting model weights and artifacts Fluency with LLM and generative AI attack vectors and frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and MITRE ATLAS Strong coding skills in Python or Go

Experience

setting technical direction and influencing senior engineers and leaders without formal authority Nice-to-Haves

job.title: Senior / Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer to secure the cloud that runs Suno. That covers our Kubernetes clusters, the GPU compute behind our AI workloads, and the network that connects them. You’ll report to our Security Lead, work closely with Platform Engineering, and partner with AppSec engineers and our Detection & Response team as they grow alongside you. This is a building job. You’ll write threat models, set hardened defaults, and create paved paths that engineers actually want to use. Some of the work is familiar cloud security. Some of it, like securing AI infrastructure, is new for everyone. Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/Utj2JDlLzR4Dvs3p

What You'll Do

Build Suno’s infrastructure threat model across cloud, Kubernetes, GPU compute platforms, and networking, and use it with the Security Lead to decide where to focus first. Harden our EKS clusters, GPU compute environments, and infrastructure-as-code pipeline, including who can change infrastructure and how. Design paved paths and secure defaults, such as trusted base images, network segmentation, and scoped access, and ship the fixes yourself rather than handing off a list of findings. job.title: Staff Security GRC Analyst
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We're looking for a Staff Security GRC Analyst to build Suno's security compliance program from the ground up. You'll report to our CISO, work alongside our AppSec and InfraSec teams, and own the control framework that ties everything together: which controls we have, how they map to SOC 2 and NIST CSF, and whether they actually work. You're as comfortable reading a cloud config as an audit standard, and you'd rather automate evidence collection with AI than chase screenshots. It's a greenfield build with real stakes and a direct line to leadership. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/8U6fbhqLEghsnRsm

What You'll Do

Build and own Suno's security control framework, mapping controls to SOC 2, NIST CSF, and future frameworks, and writing control descriptions with the teams who run them. Lead SOC 2 preparation end to end, from gap assessments and readiness tracking to driving remediation with control owners and working with our external auditor. Automate evidence collection and control monitoring with scripts, integrations, and AI tools, deciding where human review stays in the loop. Run vendor security reviews, keep our security policies current, and answer customer security questionnaires alongside Product and Legal. Partner with the CISO to give leadership and the board a clear, evidence-backed view of our security posture, and lay the foundations of GRC as part of a growing Security team. Help earn the trust of the partners and customers who bring Suno to more people, so creating music can be part of everyone's day.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves 7–9 years in GRC, security compliance, or IT audit. Hands-on, end-to-end ownership of a security compliance program as its primary owner, ideally including taking a company through its first SOC 2. Deep working knowledge of SOC 2 and NIST CSF, including control mapping, audit mechanics (design vs. operating effectiveness, sampling, evidence), and staying current as requirements evolve. Enough technical fluency to read a cloud configuration, access setup, or pipeline and judge whether it enforces what the control says. You don't need to write production code. Comfort building your own automation with scripts or AI tools. Nice-to-Haves

Experience

standing up continuous controls monitoring or automated evidence collection, including what it covered and what changed as a result.

Experience

applying LLMs to assurance work, such as control drafting, framework mapping, or evidence testing.

Experience

with cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, and with a modern GRC platform. Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, or CRISC. Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. job.title: 2027 Summer News Intern | Multiple Locations
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

2027 TEGNA Summer News Internship Program

Your Future Starts Here

At TEGNA, making news isn’t legacy — it’s leadership.

This isn’t old-school TV. We’re setting the pace for a sustainable, streaming-first future of journalism.

We’re hiring bold, creative interns who embrace cutting-edge tech to deliver high-impact journalism that makes a difference.

This 10-week paid internship runs May 31 – August 6, 2027, at select TEGNA stations nationwide.

Many interns launch full-time TEGNA careers right after the program.

What You’ll Do

  • Pitch and research stories that matter
  • Create content for streaming, digital, social, and TV
  • Work alongside reporters, producers, anchors, and meteorologists—sometimes in the field
  • Jump in on special projects that shape local coverage

How This Internship Skyrockets Your Career

  • Hands-On Work – Real assignments for your demo reel
  • Career Growth – Development sessions to fast-track your skills
  • Networking – Learn from some of the nation’s top media pros
  • Paid Opportunity – Earn money while making an impact in a fast-paced newsroom
    • The standard compensation rate is $15.00 per hour unless a higher state or local minimum wage overrides it. Notable exceptions include:
      • Denver, CO - $19.84 per hour
      • Sacramento, CA - $17.40 per hour
      • San Diego, CA - $17.75 per hour
      • Seattle, WA - $21.30 per hour
      • Spokane, WA - $17.13 per hour

What We’re Looking For

  • Current college juniors or seniors with a 3.0 GPA or higher
  • Studying journalism, communications, or a related major
  • Passion for one of these three career paths:
    • TV news producing
    • TV news reporting
    • TV meteorology
  • Experience writing, editing, fact-checking, and using digital/social tools
  • Strong communicator who never misses deadlines

This internship is not for sports or film. It’s for hard-news journalists and meteorologists ready to disrupt the industry and deliver information in new ways that meet audiences where they are.

A Final Note

Our summer internship program is highly competitive. We review every application personally, but only selected candidates will be contacted for interviews.

  • Rolling applications — most 2027 interns hired by the end of 2026
  • Decisions by email — expect updates by Jan/Feb 2027
  • Summer Only — Our internships are in the summer, not fall or spring

TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven technology or digital media sales account executive to join our team.   • Sales & Revenue Generation: Drive sales by identifying and securing new business opportunities across multiple digital channels, including streaming, online video and display, and content marketing solutions.

  • Flexible scheduling: this position includes weekends, and may also cover early mornings, nights, or holidays as needed.

job.title: Broadcast Inventory Specialist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Position:        Inventory Specialist
Department:    TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO)
Location:    Any TEGNA market 

Description:
We are hiring! The TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO) team is looking for a talented and motivated person to join our team.
A broadcast Traffic department maximizes revenue for a television station through careful consideration of spot placement and program formatting. We describe our group as “Commercial Operations” because we do more than just place spots on a log; we work hand in hand with the sales, marketing/promotions, programming, news and engineering departments to create an on-air product that generates positive results for both our stations and clients. Our daily workflow has often been described as working a puzzle; we manipulate commercial inventory to maximize an advertiser’s return on investment. 
A successful Inventory Specialist pays attention to detail, is customer-service oriented, shows initiative and can balance multiple projects and requests while meeting daily deadlines.  

Specific job requirements include:
•    Using WideOrbit Traffic software, manage commercial inventory by accurately preempting or placing spots on the broadcast log
•    Meet daily log finalization deadlines and clear oversold inventory 13 weeks out
•    Understand and follow spot placement guidelines to ensure client specifications are met
•    Verify the broadcast log is maximized for revenue and meets product and advertiser separation requirements
•    Collaborate with TCO and station teammates to identify and communicate revenue opportunities to the sales team
•    Process sales orders and assist sales team with accurate order entry
•    Various other duties as assigned


If this sounds like a great fit, we are looking for applicants with the following skills and experience:
•    High school diploma (required)
•    Undergraduate degree in marketing, communications, or a related field (preferred)
•    Broadcasting, cable or radio traffic or sales support experience (preferred)
•    WideOrbit traffic system knowledge (preferred)
•    Proficient with computer software/applications, including Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word and Excel (required)
•    Attention to detail and strong organizational skills (required)
•    Desire to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment (required)
•    If you have relevant work experience, we are willing to train the right candidate
•    Work from home flexibility, must be in a TEGNA market

KGW, and kgw.com, part of TEGNA Inc., and the #1 NBC affiliate group in the country, is looking for a Digital Sales Strategist. This position is fully functional on all digital products and manages the complex day-to-day responsibilities of assigned accounts and team members. The Digital Sales Strategist plays a critical strategic role and has primary responsibility for campaign success through management and optimization of digital media campaigns to ensure launch and successful delivery.

Main role mission:

The Digital Sales Strategist will assist and strategize with key members of the sales staff including Account Executives, Sales Activation team, and sales leaders, to develop digital solutions by leveraging ad-serving interfaces and other operational platforms. The Digital Sales Strategist’s primary responsibility is campaign success through creating and implementing comprehensive marketing solutions, pre-sales order entry, campaign management, and optimization of Digital Media campaigns to ensure launch and successful delivery.

Responsibilities:

· Work strategically with our sales team to generate marketing solutions that will deliver exceptional client results through our industry-leading digital platforms, including the leading premium CTV/OTT advertising solution, Premion. · Partner with the Account Executives and Digital Sales Manager to generate digital revenue. · Lead in retention, expansion, and development of new digital business · Identify and quantify consumer audiences that would be receptive to client advertising messages. · Identify revenue-generating opportunities by exposing gaps in current digital advertising campaigns, such as impression share deficiencies, missing platforms, etc., that will further promote the client objectives. · Efficiently process digital sales orders by receiving, understanding, and accurately inputting them into multiple systems. · Support campaign execution by trafficking creative, communicating with our internal and external vendors, and monitoring live campaigns. · Prepare ad hoc and month-end reports for all digital accounts.

· Oversee the development of digital creative materials including display ads and dynamic video ads. · Proactively monitor and analyze digital campaigns to create solutions to retain and grow our digital revenue. · Create case studies and communicate successful digital campaign results to the sales team. · Monitor competitor websites for potential new revenue opportunities. · Attend client calls, if needed, as the digital expert on our product offerings.

 

Requirements:

· 1 to 3 years of digital marketing sales support, inside or outside sales experience.

· Expert knowledge of all facets of digital sales and marketing with good grasp of OTT and targeted display/video pre-roll.

· Adept at creating new revenue opportunities from synergies between interactive sales and other mediums.

· Google AdWords and Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) certifications highly desirable.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office programs and knowledge of Salesforce or other CRM software.

· Strong presenter and communicator with internal and external customers and partners.

· Demonstrated organizational skills, and ability to multi-task.

· Demonstrate effective problem solving and decision-making skills.

job.title: Director, Product Marketing
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA is looking for a Director, Product Marketing to lead go-to-market strategy and messaging for our linear and streaming TV and advertising business, with a strong focus on Premion, TEGNA's streaming ad platform (DSP). This role reports directly to the VP of B2B and Integrated Marketing and sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing. The Director will translate platform capabilities into clear, compelling positioning that helps our sales teams win and grow streaming advertising revenue — and will build and lead a small product marketing team. They will identify and translate the needs of our key customer segments, mid-sized to large SMBs and the agencies that serve them, as well as our publisher partners, to the larger organization.

This is a high-visibility leadership role for someone energized by the pace of the CTV/streaming market who wants to shape how TEGNA tells its story to agencies and advertisers — and who is ready to develop talent alongside doing the work.

Key Responsibilities 

Product and Sales Collaboration

  • Partner deeply with Product to translate CTV/streaming and Premion DSP capabilities into positioning, messaging, and sales-ready narratives
  • Act as the voice of the customer in product conversations, advocating for solutions and features that deliver the most value to advertisers and agencies
  • Build strong working relationships across product, sales, customer success and other key stakeholders to stay ahead of roadmap changes and market shifts

Messaging and Positioning 

  • Own product marketing messaging for Premion and TEGNA's broader CTV/streaming offering, ensuring consistency with TEGNA's brand pillars and current terminology
  • Develop clear, differentiated positioning against competitors in the CTV/streaming ad tech space
  • Translate complex product and data capabilities — outcomes-based buying, first-party data, audience targeting — into messaging that resonates with agencies and advertisers

Sales Enablement 

  • Design, create and oversee sales enablement assets — pitch decks, one-pagers, talking points, objection-handling guides, case studies — that equip the sales organization to grow streaming advertising revenue
  • Partner with sales leadership to identify enablement gaps and prioritize asset development accordingly
  • Train and support sales teams on new product launches, features, and positioning updates

Revenue Growth and Market Focus 

  • Support pipeline growth for streaming advertising by arming sales with the right tools at the right moments in the sales cycle
  • Build messaging and enablement tailored to local and regional agency buyers, a key and growing segment for TEGNA
  • Partner with Marketing Strategy and Insights on packaging, upfront kits, and go-to-market campaigns tied to CTV/streaming priorities

Team Leadership 

  • Manage and develop a Product Marketing Analyst, setting clear priorities, providing regular coaching, and building their capability over time
  • Model strong cross-functional partnership and help the broader B2B Marketing team understand and use product positioning effectively
  • Build scalable processes for asset management, messaging governance, and sales enablement delivery

Qualifications 

  • 10+ years in product marketing, with meaningful experience in digital content, CTV, or streaming media (ad tech, media company, or streaming platform background preferred)
  • Demonstrated leadership experience — prior people management preferred, but strong mentorship and cross-functional leadership also considered
  • Proven track record building messaging and positioning for advertising or media products, ideally in a DSP, ad platform, or programmatic environment
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Product and Sales, including building sales enablement materials that directly drove revenue
  • Experience working with or selling to local and regional agencies is a strong plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to translate technical/product complexity into clear, persuasive messaging for both internal and external audiences
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous market and adapting messaging as the competitive and product landscape shifts
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA a plus but not required

Location and Reporting 

  • New York City or Washington, D.C. metro area preferred but not required; hybrid work model
  • Reports directly to the VP of B2B and Integrated Marketing
  • Manages: Product Marketing Analyst
  • Some travel expected for sales meetings, agency visits, and industry events #LI-MS1

The LSM manages and develops the Account Executives and Account Managers on the sales team and develops strategies to win over clients within the market.   • Lead and develop a team of direct reports consisting of Account Executives, Account Managers and manage a handful of dotted-line reports.

  • Established leadership skills and demonstrated ability to develop teams with elite sales and customer service skills.

The Motion Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating complex animated graphics and infographics, kinetic typography and video assets. They will work with a team of other artists and designers that will support all the TEGNA television stations daily. This position works closely with the Sr. Creative Director, Art Director, Production, Sr Mgr. Design & Production & Production Coordinator, as well as employees across all TEGNA stations nationwide. The Motion Graphic Designer will receive continuous feedback throughout the project lifecycle.
Grab a glimpse of what it's like to work at the Design Tank here: www.tegnadesigntank.com 

 
Responsibilities:
•    Design and animate broadcast graphics for TEGNA local news stations (including logo design, informational graphics, branding and marketing projects)
•    Communicate with stations about projects and daily graphics
•    Handle other essential tasks as assigned

•    Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred
•    Candidate must have had formal training in design/art school and preferably motion graphic curriculum at trade school or college. Please don’t apply if you are not a designer.

•    Applicants with editing experience (Adobe Premiere) will have stronger consideration
•    Broadcast experience desired

•    Excellent design and animation skills, extra points if you are an editor and designer
•    A professional portfolio demonstrating compelling and aspirational designs, we want to see your design chops!
•    Strong customer service and communication skills
•    Able to perform under very tight deadlines
•    Ability to multitask projects
•    Flexibility & experience with current design & editing AI tools.
•    Able to react to change and take direction effectively and productively
•    Strong spelling and grammar skills
•    Must be able to work a flexible schedule including days, evenings, weekends

job.title: Operations Analyst
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television.
