This Operations Analyst role is part of a team that owns the day-to-day monitoring, support, and operational stability of TEGNA's broadcast and digital platforms while providing advanced support to stakeholders and business-critical applications. You'll work closely with distributed IT teams, engineering, and vendors in a 24x7 support environment—triaging incidents, resolving tickets, and keeping services online. Automating the repetitive task with AI and workflow tools. You'll leverage intelligent ticket routing, help implement our next predictive monitoring solution, and automations. Clear ownership from intake through resolution, sharp communication, and the ability to work across technical teams.

  • Incident Support & Workflow Automation 
    Own support tickets in ServiceNow from intake through resolution, with responsibility for issues spanning PC/Mac endpoints, imaging workflows, collaborative tools (Teams/O365), and emerging AI/workstream tooling. Troubleshoot complex endpoint issues across Intune (device compliance, conditional access, app distribution), hybrid identity systems (Okta, AD, Entra), and Exchange Online. Leverage Moveworks for intelligent ticket intake, prioritization, and automated routing to reduce manual triage. Coordinate cross-functionally with remote teams, document root causes and remediation steps in ServiceNow, and drive first-contact resolution rates. Identify automation opportunities—flagging repetitive tickets for workflow automation, knowledge gaps, and tooling inefficiencies that slow resolution. The role is also responsible for monitoring and supporting patch compliance.
  • System Monitoring and Operational Support 
    Provide proactive monitoring and day-to-day operational support for critical broadcast and streaming systems by responding to PagerDuty alerts, performing routine health checks in New Relic and native monitoring platforms, identifying early warning indicators, and taking preventative action to avoid service disruption. Own operational dashboards and alert tuning to reduce noise and catch real issues early.
  • Problem Management and Documentation 
    Analyze, resolve, and document incidents and recurring problems using structured root cause analysis. Capture resolutions, workarounds, and lessons learned in ServiceNow knowledge articles and operational runbooks. Drive continuous refinement of documentation to reduce repeat tickets and improve first-contact resolution rates.
  • Knowledge Management and Operational Readiness 
    Create, maintain, and improve operational documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base content to support the Service Desk and enable effective remote handoffs across distributed teams. Build self-service resources that reduce support load and empower end users.
  • Operational Flexibility and Continuous Improvement
    Adapt to changing priorities and operational demands, take ownership of assigned work, and constructively challenge existing tools and processes. Identify automation opportunities and champion process improvements that increase reliability, efficiency, and support outcomes.
  • Team Collaboration and Remote Support 
    Collaborate effectively with a globally distributed, remote-first team, including engineers, application owners, and broadcast/streaming operations. Support handoffs across time zones and enable a follow-the-sun operating model with clear communication and documentation.

Requirements:

  • College degree, relevant certifications, or equivalent hands-on experience in IT operations, service desk, or enterprise support roles.
  • Three or more years of experience in an operations or advanced helpdesk role, supporting enterprise applications, infrastructure, and end-user environments in a production or 24x7 support setting.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting broadcast, media, or digital workflow systems, including server platforms, end-user computing orchestration, and monitoring/management toolsets. Cloud and hybrid environment experience is a plus.
  • Strong working knowledge of IT service management practices and tooling, including ITIL concepts, incident and problem management, knowledge management, and ServiceNow.
  • Hands-on experience with automation and scripting technologies, such as PowerShell, Python, or similar languages, used to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual support effort.
  • Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent tickets, incidents, or tasks, working independently while collaborating effectively with remote and globally distributed teams.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document issues and resolutions and communicate technical information to a wide range of internal customers and business partners.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and identify practical, repeatable solutions.

KGW is looking for a creative, driven and curious news reporter who can shoot and edit his or her own stories. Known in our newsroom as a “multi-skilled journalist,” MSJs are a key part of our newsroom’s coverage on both broadcast and digital platforms.

We are looking for a candidate who isn’t afraid to tackle complicated stories, who will hold the powerful accountable, and who gets excited at the prospect of creating great journalism. The ideal candidate will pitch smart stories and tell them in way that is both creative and engaging.

Most stories will be same-day turns, while other times you’ll be given more time to execute your vision. You can expect to work solo many days, although there are ample opportunities to work with a photographer, especially on breaking news or complex stories.
Please let us know if you have experience producing and anchoring weather forecasts. While not required, candidates who have weather experience will be given extra consideration.

Our ideal candidate embraces the digital future of our industry and can show examples of strong work on digital, streaming and social media platforms.

This role is a full-time, non-exempt position represented by SAG-AFTRA. The position may include weekend shifts.

•    Consistently pitch strong story ideas.
•    Maintain the highest journalistic standards in every story you cover. We expect you’ll report stories accurately and honestly, treat sources with fairness and empathy, and hold yourself accountable when you make a mistake.

job.title: Senior Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KFMB-TV San Diego, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in San Diego, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of CBS broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to San Diego's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 3-5+ years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed 

Salary: Competitive base + commission

job.title: Sports Partnership Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. The Sports Partnership Account Executive is responsible for achieving or exceeding sports revenue goals by partnering with a team of Account Executives to develop and close new and existing advertiser opportunities across 9NEWS and TEGNA’s multiplatform sports portfolio. 

You’ll join Account Executives on sales calls, build strategic sports marketing solutions, and help advertisers connect with passionate fans through premier sports properties including the Denver Broncos, Denver Nuggets, Colorado Avalanche, Colorado Rockies, NBC Sports Properties, Premion OTT Sports programming, and other sports properties connected with 9NEWS. 

Success in this role comes from strong sales collaboration, creative sports strategy, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to turn linear TV, content sponsorships, digital, streaming, and OTT opportunities, including PREMION, into compelling advertising solutions that drive revenue growth and measurable client outcomes. 

Responsibilities 

  • Partner with the team of Account Executives to identify, develop, and close sports advertising revenue from new and existing clients. 
  • Join Account Executives on client sales calls as the sports subject matter expert, helping uncover needs, shape opportunities, and advance business. 
  • Support Account Executives throughout the sales process, from targeted prospecting and pre-call planning through proposal development, presentation, negotiation, and post-sale transition. 
  • Identify market potential, category opportunities, and competitive insights that help grow sports revenue and expand advertiser participation. 
  • Develop strategic, insight-driven sports marketing solutions tied to key properties including the Denver Broncos, Denver Nuggets, Colorado Avalanche, Colorado Rockies, NBC Olympics, NBC Sunday Night Football, NBA on NBC, MLB on NBC, NBC PGA Tournaments, Premion OTT Sports programming, and additional sports programming connected with 9NEWS. 
  • Create custom campaigns and sponsorship concepts that meet client needs across broadcast, digital, streaming, OTT, and content sponsorships. 
  • Upsell current clients across the full 9NEWS sports and media product line. 
  • Collaborate with sales leadership, marketing, research, production, digital, and operations teams to build integrated campaigns. 
  • Maintain strong relationships with clients, agencies, league/team contacts, and internal stakeholders. 
  • Manage CRM activity, pipeline, forecasts, and sports revenue updates. 
  • Represent 9NEWS at client events, networking opportunities, and sports-related hospitality as needed. 

Qualifications 

  • Minimum of 5 years of sales experience in a fast-paced sports-centric media environment; local market sports, broadcast, digital, streaming, agency, or sponsorship experience preferred. 
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals and developing new business opportunities. 
  • Strong understanding of sports marketing, fan engagement, sponsorship packaging, and advertiser strategy. 
  • Ability to translate advertiser objectives into creative, actionable, and measurable sports marketing solutions. 
  • Confident presenter and consultative seller with strong written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Account Executives, sales leaders, and cross-functional teams. 
  • Strong organization, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, proposals, and active sales opportunities. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and CRM systems; experience with Wide Orbit Sales, Salesforce, Wide Orbit Analytics, Comscore, Monday.com, AdImpact, Tableau, or similar platforms preferred. 
  • Positive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented in a fast-moving sales environment. 

Supervision/Contacts 

Reports to the Director of Sales at 9NEWS and works closely with Sales Management, Account Executive Team, clients, agencies, internal marketing and production teams, and external sports partners. 

Competitive compensation includes base salary plus an incentive plan tied to sports revenue growth, sales collaboration, and overall performance. On-target compensation range of $150,000-$200,000 based on experience, qualifications, and market considerations.

job.description:

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. KIII the ABC affiliate in Corpus Christi, TX, is transforming the way we gather and present news, and we're looking for a Story Desk Editor to embrace our transition to the newsroom of the future. This hybrid role combines the skills of an assignment editor and a digital content producer to serve as the hub of the newsroom. The Story Desk Editor drives daily editorial execution, curates and produces impactful stories, and ensures our content connects authentically with audiences across streaming, digital, social and broadcast platforms.

Role Summary:

As a Story Desk Editor, you will be part of the Story Management Desk (SMD), a unified desk that replaces the legacy assignment and digital desks. The SMD model ensures a single, streamlined workflow for planning, producing and curating stories across platforms. You will lead coverage during breaking news, shape daily story planning, and curate content across platforms. This position requires decisive editorial judgment, strong writing skills, and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines. You will collaborate with MSJs, producers and photojournalists to deliver accurate, relevant and engaging stories that serve the community.

Responsibilities:

Lead and communicate newsroom coverage during breaking news, ensuring accuracy, urgency and balance
Identify and plan stories that matter most to the community, using editorial judgment and social listening
Create and edit engaging content for digital platforms: website, mobile app and streaming
Guide newsroom logistics and provide editorial support for MSJs, producers, and photojournalists
Edit reporter content for accuracy, grammar, AP style, digital best practices, fairness and ethical considerations
Enhance storytelling with creative elements (graphics, video, audience-submitted content, etc.)
Use available metrics to inform coverage and improve audience reach
Support newsroom operations and coverage planning as needed
Uphold TEGNA's journalistic standards and values across all platforms

Requirements:

3-5 years of journalism experience in a local newsroom, digital production, or related role
Strong news judgment and the ability to make fast, sound editorial decisions under pressure
Excellent writing skills, with the ability to produce accurate and compelling content quickly
Experience with newsroom systems, CMS tools
Organizational skills to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment
A collaborative, solutions-focused mindset that thrives in a team environment
Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or equivalent experience

WZZM-TV Grand Rapids, the TEGNA-owned ABC affiliate in Grand Rapids is searching for an ambitious Digital Content Producer who thrives in a fast-paced news environment and has an audience-first approach to writing, producing and distributing local news content.

Our digital producers monitor digital audience trends to identify and write engaging local news content that broadens our audience. They are responsible for curating quality content and overseeing the audience experience across all WZZM-TV Grand website, mobile, app, streaming and social media platforms. Qualified candidates should be strong writers, first, with the ability to write quickly and accurately while tracking multiple streams of information. job.title: Strategic Marketing Lead Texas
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Strategic Marketing Lead Texas

Overview
The Marketing Lead is the primary strategic partner to the Regional Marketing Director in Texas (RMD) and drives marketing execution across the full ecosystem of centralized capabilities: Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM and Lifecycle. This role translates strategy into integrated campaign plans, owns the campaign calendar, and is the day-to-day marketing contact for station leadership across the portfolio.

This person excels at navigating complexity, building stakeholder trust, and leading integrated work across multiple teams and markets.

Strategic & Campaign Leadership
•    Develop the campaign brief for each initiative — translating RMD strategy into an integrated plan with clear objectives, target audiences, key messages, channel mix and success metrics — and submit to the RMD for approval before execution begins.
•    Own the regional campaign calendar and integrated delivery timeline; ensure all campaigns are planned, resourced and launched on time and to spec.
•    Lead campaign development and execution, coordinating across Production, Paid, Social, CRM, Lifecycle and other centralized capabilities.
•    Direct Marketing Specialist to initiate campaign setup in monday.com; confirm boards are complete with the right assignments, timelines and deliverables.
•    Collaborate with Production through the creative development process — bring the audience, brand, and business context to concept development and scripting.
•    Hold creative and strategic standards across all campaign deliverables; ensure every asset is on-brand, on-message, and built to perform.
•    Drive clarity and prioritization across a complex portfolio of concurrent campaigns; make informed trade-offs and escalate strategic conflicts to the RMD as needed.

Station Partnership & Communications
•    Serve as the day-to-day marketing partner to station general managers, news directors and content leaders across the region.
•    Communicate campaign plans, status, and results clearly to station stakeholders; manage expectations, align on priorities and surface issues early.
•    Maintain the continuity and market context that allow centralized teams to move fast and with credibility in each market.

Campaign Performance & Team Development
•    Establish measurement frameworks for campaigns; track and report performance against objectives for the RMD and station leadership.
•    Apply audience data, ratings, digital analytics and market feedback to sharpen campaign strategy; translate performance patterns into recommendations that improve future planning and strengthen the team's overall approach.
•    Model campaign management discipline, strategic thinking and stakeholder communications; raise the overall capability and consistency of the marketing team.

Requirements:
•    5–7 years in marketing, integrated campaign management or brand strategy — media, broadcast or a fast-moving content environment strongly preferred.
•    Proven ability to lead integrated campaigns across multiple markets, channels and stakeholder groups simultaneously.
•    Outstanding written and verbal communications skills; comfortable translating complex strategy into clear stakeholder-ready messaging and creative briefs.
•    Strong command of campaign planning, prioritization and project management; experience with monday.com, Asana or similar platforms.
•    Demonstrated ability to coordinate across paid media, social, CRM, content and other marketing channels toward shared campaign outcomes.
•    Familiarity with audience research, ratings, digital analytics and performance measurement in a media or broadcast context.
•    Comfortable operating in a 24/7 news-driven environment with fast-moving priorities, breaking news demands and tight timelines.
•    Must be willing to travel to markets within the portfolio when needed.
•    Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

job.title: Activations Technician-Seasonal
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

Activations department at TelevisaUnivision is looking for an Activations Technician to join our team! The Activations Technician will be responsible for set up of promotional items, banners, tables, tents and sound equipment for remotes, special events and station appearances. Interface with clients, listeners, and general public during off site promotional activities. Activation Technicians must be able to collaborate creatively with the Sales & Promotions staff.   

You will report to the Activations Supervisor.

Rate range: $20.00 - $22.00

YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Set up, test, operate, and tear down promotional, broadcast, and event equipment, including audio, video, lighting, tents, banners, and branded assets;

  • Transport, inventory, maintain, and organize promotional materials, technical equipment, and station vehicles;

  • Troubleshoot basic technical issues during remote broadcasts, live events, and promotional activations to ensure seamless execution;

  • Coordinate event setup and breakdown while ensuring compliance with station safety standards and venue requirements;

  • Assist with remote broadcast operations, including connectivity, power, and equipment support for on-air talent and engineering teams;

  • Maintain accurate inventory of promotional items, prizes, signage, and activation equipment, reporting any maintenance or replacement needs;

  • Ensure all promotional displays, vehicles, and branded assets are clean, organized, and presented in accordance with company standards;

  • Capture basic event photos and videos for promotional and social media use as requested;

  • Support station marketing, community outreach, and client activation initiatives through effective event execution;

  • Represent the station in a professional manner while interacting with listeners, clients, vendors, and community partners;

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, safety procedures, and FCC regulations during remote broadcasts and station events.

YOU HAVE:

  • Valid Driver’s License and acceptable driving record

  • Ability to conduct "call-in On-Air announcements" from site locations in Spanish

  • Flexible work schedule including weekends and Holidays

  • Creative, Organized, Enthusiastic Excellent interpersonal skills

  • Computer literate Knowledge of digital social media

  • Strong social media skills and understanding of current trends.

  • Entry level video editing skills (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut) Prior experience in customer service, sales, promotions, or brand ambassador (1+ year preferred)

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

  • Knowledge of MS Word, Excel, and Outlook Slight experience with video editing software preferred (not required)

  • Bi-lingual in Spanish/English. Ability to communicate effectively in Spanish (read, write, speak)

job.title: Analyst, Privacy Operations
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:


The TU Legal team is looking for a Privacy Operations Analyst to join our team.

TelevisaUnivision is committed to embedding privacy by design into our products and building a world-class privacy team to enable our business strategy. In accordance with privacy laws and regulations internationally, TelevisaUnivision’s Privacy Team is responsible for helping to ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements, including honoring individual privacy rights requests and providing appropriate opt out or other consent mechanisms for the sale or sharing of personal data. The role will report into the Law, Policy and Integrity team and will work closely with engineering and product teams across TelevisaUnivision.


ABOUT YOU: 

A successful candidate will have proven experience supporting privacy operations, including individual privacy rights, consent management, and data requests. The role will interface directly with legal, business, product, and engineering teams, requiring strong organizational and technology skills. Experience with privacy management platforms, including but not limited to OneTrust, and translating legal requirements into operational processes is strongly preferred.


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Document and optimize the company’s Privacy Operations processes, such as individual requests, including step-by-step process flows, e-mail templates, and response timelines
  • Manage Privacy Operations platforms and tooling, including but not limited to OneTrust, that implement access, deletion, opt-out, and consent
  • Review, triage, and respond to internal and external inquiries, such as those received via email and in tickets
  • Maintain and update inventory of the company’s data partners and contracts involving the handling of personal data
  • Serve as liaison between Legal and Technical teams handling Privacy Operations, including translating legal requirements into technical classifications for data, processes, and tools
  • Ensure timely handling of all individual requests, and approving/processing or rejecting each request in accordance with laws, deadlines, and internal processes
  • Partner with business and technical owners to implement changes necessary to comply with privacy law, such as access, deletion, opt-out, and consent
  • Prepare weekly/monthly reports
  • Partner with legal resources to understand various requirements and the global privacy landscape
  • Research options for automating and/or streamlining compliance tasks, including leveraging technology tools
  • Maintain and enhance playbooks and contract templates
  • Serve as a liaison between Legal and Procurement teams, on the one hand, and external vendors and other business partners, on the other hand, to update data provisions of contracts.
  • Assist with other privacy-related tasks, such as data inventory, discovery, or mapping

 

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree or comparable experience in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field
  •  1-2 years of professional experience in data privacy, security risk management, or compliance
  • IAPP certification such CIPM or CIPT is preferred
  • Strong project management skills, project planning methodologies
  • Experience in managing digital platforms
  • Experience with Privacy Operations platforms, such as OneTrust, TrustArc, ServiceNow, Ethyca, DataGrail, Osano, or Ketch
  • General knowledge of compliance processes
  • Fluent in English/Spanish

California Salary Range: $70,500 - $75,000

Salary ranges for other locations may differ based on local market conditions and candidate qualifications

 

BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

#LI-ONSITE

job.title: Assignment Desk Editor & Producer
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision Austin and Antonio is looking for a dynamic, competitive and creative Assignment Editor/Producer to join our Austin and San Antonio newsrooms.

This role is central to shaping our daily news coverage. The Assignment Editor/Producer is responsible for identifying and developing high-impact stories, managing day-to-day coverage and field logistics, helping lead editorial decisions, and producing compelling newscasts across platforms.

The ideal candidate has a strong sense of journalistic urgency and can quickly recognize the stories that matter most to our communities and have the greatest potential to drive audience interest. This person must know how to aggressively advance those stories, deploy resources strategically, anticipate what is needed to meet deadline and continuously look for ways to make our coverage stronger and more competitive.

This role requires someone who brings a competitive mindset and strong editorial leadership to the newsroom. The Assignment Editor/Producer should come to editorial meetings informed and prepared to help establish the direction of the news day, while fostering creative discussion that strengthens story angles and differentiates our coverage from competitors.

The ideal candidate must also clearly communicate the editorial vision and priorities to reporters, photographers, producers and other newsroom teams while remaining collaborative and open to ideas that may strengthen or change the original coverage plan.

Strong visual storytelling is also essential. This person should consistently look for creative ways to showcase stories, strengthen newscast presentation and make our journalism more engaging across broadcast, digital and social platforms.

The Assignment Editor/Producer will source and verify content through traditional reporting methods, community contacts, scanners, newsroom feeds and social media platforms; coordinate breaking news and planned coverage; field produce when necessary; and perform other duties as directed by News Management.


YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Identify, research, develop, write and produce stories for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Demonstrate strong journalistic urgency, quickly recognizing high-impact and audience-relevant stories and ensuring they are aggressively pursued and advanced before deadline.
  • Help lead editorial meetings by coming prepared and informed, establishing priorities and helping define the direction of the news day and upcoming newscasts.
  • Drive creative editorial conversations that identify stronger angles, unanswered questions, follow-ups and opportunities to distinguish our coverage from competitors.
  • Clearly communicate editorial priorities, coverage goals and expectations to reporters, photographers, producers and other newsroom teams.
  • Remain flexible during the editorial process and adjust coverage plans when new information or team discussion identifies a stronger direction.
  • Maintain strong competitive awareness, monitoring other news organizations and identifying opportunities to advance stories beyond what competitors are reporting.
  • Assign stories and provide crews with the information, contacts, context and expectations necessary to successfully execute coverage.
  • Monitor scanners, newsroom feeds, wire services, social media and other breaking-news sources to quickly identify developing stories and determine when immediate newsroom action is needed.
  • Monitor breaking news and understand how local, state and federal agencies communicate information across traditional and digital platforms.
  • Make timely decisions regarding deployment of crews and newsroom resources as stories develop.
  • Coordinate interviews, breaking-news logistics, future coverage and priority events.
  • Maintain constant and clear communication with producers, field crews, newsroom managers and outside agencies while obtaining and confirming information.
  • Line produce newscasts as assigned.
  • Use strong visual creativity to showcase stories through video, graphics, live elements, sound, reporter involvement and other production tools.
  • Contribute to story placement, teases, graphics, writing, timing and other editorial and production elements.
  • Work closely with reporters to conceptualize, develop and strengthen story packages while ensuring they meet station standards and editorial expectations.
  • Source, verify and develop potential stories from social media and digital platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, X, Reddit and emerging platforms.
  • Serve as a bridge between the newsroom and digital team, ensuring timely communication of developing stories, confirmed information, key elements and available content to support digital coverage across platforms.
  • Engage with viewers and community sources to identify potential stories and develop newsroom contacts.
  • Capture incoming video feeds and assist with newsroom coordination and troubleshooting when necessary.
  • Plan ahead for developing stories and future coverage while maintaining awareness of immediate newsroom priorities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

YOU HAVE:

  • Strong news judgment and the ability to quickly identify which stories deserve priority, resources and aggressive follow-up.
  • A demonstrated sense of journalistic urgency and ability to manage breaking news and multiple deadlines simultaneously.
  • A competitive mindset and desire to advance stories, develop distinctive angles and strengthen coverage beyond what competitors are reporting.
  • Strong editorial leadership skills and the confidence to help lead a newsroom through a developing news day.
  • Ability to lead productive editorial meetings, communicate a clear vision and encourage collaborative discussion and creative thinking.
  • Strong visual storytelling instincts and the ability to identify creative ways to showcase content within a newscast.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.
  • High ethical and journalistic standards.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to make decisions quickly and calmly in a fast-paced newsroom environment.
  • Ability to receive feedback, adapt and continuously improve.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with reporters, photographers, producers, anchors, digital teams and newsroom leadership.
  • Strong understanding of the Hispanic community and the issues, interests and stories that affect our audience.
  • Ability to identify, verify and develop strong content originating from social media and digital sources.
  • Experience monitoring scanners, newsroom feeds, wire services and other breaking-news sources, with the ability to recognize developing stories and act with urgency.
  • Proficiency with newsroom computer systems and software, including iNews, Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Familiarity with video systems, incoming news feeds and non-linear editing tools.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, overnights, weekends and holidays.

 

DESIRED SKILL & EXPERIENCE:

  • BA/BS in Journalism, Mass Communications or related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum two years of newsroom experience as a producer, assignment editor or similar editorial role, preferably in a medium-to-large market.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute compelling newscasts and showcase major stories.
  • Experience helping lead editorial discussions and coordinating daily newsroom coverage.
  • Proven ability to identify and advance breaking, developing and enterprise stories.
  • Strong understanding of digital and social media strategies and audience behavior.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across broadcast and digital teams to ensure important information and content move quickly between platforms.
  • Strong communication, organizational and leadership skills.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, type, edit, reach and sit for up to (8) hours

 

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

Apply on-line at TelevisaUnivision’s career page:https://corporate.televisaunivision.com/careers/

job.title: Comprador de Calle
job.description:
Objetivo del puesto

En TelevisaUnivision buscamos un Comprador de Calle dinámico, resolutivo y con gran conocimiento del mercado local, responsable de gestionar la adquisición oportuna de materiales, productos, suministros y servicios necesarios para apoyar las operaciones y producciones de la compañía.

Esta posición requiere una persona con excelente capacidad de negociación, sentido de urgencia y habilidad para identificar proveedores, conseguir las mejores condiciones comerciales y resolver necesidades de compra de manera ágil, eficiente y dentro de los presupuestos establecidos.


Responsabilidades principales

  • Realizar compras directas en establecimientos comerciales, mercados, distribuidores y proveedores locales, atendiendo las necesidades de las diferentes áreas de la compañía.
  • Buscar, identificar y desarrollar relaciones con proveedores que ofrezcan productos de calidad a precios competitivos.
  • Negociar precios, descuentos, condiciones de pago y tiempos de entrega para optimizar los recursos de la empresa.
  • Atender solicitudes de compra urgentes, especialmente aquellas relacionadas con producciones, eventos, grabaciones y operaciones diarias.
  • Coordinar la recolección, transporte y entrega oportuna de los materiales adquiridos.
  • Comparar cotizaciones y evaluar alternativas para garantizar la mejor relación entre precio, calidad y disponibilidad.
  • Mantener un control adecuado de facturas, recibos, comprobantes y documentación de compras.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas internas de compras, controles financieros y procedimientos administrativos.
  • Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de Producción, Operaciones, Finanzas y otras áreas internas para anticipar y resolver necesidades de abastecimiento.
  • Identificar oportunidades de ahorro y mejoras en los procesos de adquisición.

Requisitos

  • Experiencia mínima de 2 a 3 años en compras operativas, abastecimiento, gestión de proveedores o funciones similares.
  • Experiencia realizando compras presenciales y negociaciones directas con comercios y proveedores.
  • Conocimiento del mercado local, zonas comerciales, distribuidores y establecimientos especializados.
  • Habilidad para comparar precios, gestionar presupuestos y negociar condiciones favorables.
  • Manejo básico de herramientas de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel.
  • Capacidad para administrar múltiples solicitudes y trabajar bajo presión.
  • Disponibilidad para realizar desplazamientos frecuentes y atender necesidades urgentes.
  • Licencia de conducir vigente, según los requerimientos de la localidad.
  • Deseable experiencia en empresas de medios de comunicación, televisión, entretenimiento, producción audiovisual o eventos.

Sobre TelevisaUnivision

TelevisaUnivision es una compañía líder de medios y contenido en español, que conecta con audiencias a través de televisión, streaming, plataformas digitales y experiencias de entretenimiento. Nuestro equipo trabaja en un entorno creativo, colaborativo y dinámico, donde la agilidad, la innovación y la excelencia operativa son fundamentales para nuestro éxito.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. job.title: Ejecutivo de Enlace Comercial
job.description:
Ejecutivo de Enlace Comercial

Ubicación: Ciudad de México


Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en medios y contenido en español, con un ecosistema que integra televisión, streaming, plataformas digitales, redes sociales, deportes, entretenimiento y contenido. Somos una compañía que conecta marcas, contenidos y audiencias a través de soluciones comerciales innovadoras, relevantes y multiplataforma.TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Ejecutivo de Enlace Comercial para formar parte del área de Ventas Publicitarias y Marketing México. El equipo de Enlace Comercial trabaja de la mano con distintas áreas de TelevisaUnivision para transformar las necesidades de nuestros clientes en propuestas comerciales creativas, estratégicas y ejecutables. Nuestro objetivo es identificar oportunidades dentro del ecosistema de TelevisaUnivision y construir soluciones que conecten de manera relevante a las marcas con nuestras audiencias, combinando medios, contenido, talento, plataformas y nuevas formas de comunicación.


Sobre ti

Buscamos una persona al inicio de su carrera profesional, con curiosidad por el mundo de los medios, publicidad, marketing, diseño, entretenimiento y tendencias digitales. No esperamos que llegues conociendo todo el negocio. Buscamos a alguien con muchas ganas de aprender, capacidad para desarrollar y estructurar ideas, sensibilidad visual, buena comunicación y organización. Tu rol será clave para apoyar en la construcción de propuestas comerciales, participar en procesos de ideación y colaborar con diferentes equipos para convertir un brief en una solución clara, atractiva y relevante para el cliente. Estarás en contacto con diferentes marcas, contenidos, plataformas y áreas del negocio, aprendiendo cómo se construyen soluciones comerciales.


Tu día a día

  • Apoyar en el análisis de briefs y necesidades de clientes.

  • Participar en el desarrollo de propuestas comerciales y estrategias multiplataforma.

  • Investigar tendencias, audiencias, categorías, marcas y casos de referencia que ayuden a fortalecer las propuestas.

  • Colaborar en la generación y aterrizaje de conceptos, ideas e integraciones comerciales.

job.title: Ingeniero de Respuesta a Incidentes SOC, Threat Hunting, CTI y Análisis
job.description:
Título: Ingeniero de Respuesta a Incidentes, Threat Hunting, CTI y Análisis Forense

Ubicación: Santa Fe, Ciudad de México

Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de Ciberseguridad de TelevisaUnivision, contribuyendo directamente a fortalecer las capacidades de ciberdefensa y la resiliencia de la organización frente a amenazas e incidentes de seguridad.

Buscamos un perfil técnico especializado en Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) y análisis forense digital, capaz de participar en incidentes de alta criticidad, investigar amenazas avanzadas y transformar los hallazgos obtenidos en mejoras concretas para las capacidades de detección y respuesta.

Esta posición tendrá interacción directa con el SOC, equipos de respuesta a incidentes, Tecnologías de la Información y usuarios internos, además de especialistas externos de seguridad.

 

Sobre ti

Serás un referente técnico dentro de la respuesta a incidentes de ciberseguridad, participando activamente en la investigación, contención, erradicación y recuperación ante amenazas.

Tu responsabilidad será ayudar a reducir el tiempo de permanencia de los atacantes, preservar evidencia digital y determinar la causa raíz y alcance de los incidentes.

Además, utilizarás inteligencia de amenazas, threat hunting y las lecciones aprendidas de cada incidente para fortalecer continuamente las capacidades de detección y respuesta de la organización.

 

Tu día a día

• Producir y difundir Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) táctica, operativa y estratégica sobre actores, campañas y TTPs relevantes para la organización.

• Diseñar y ejecutar campañas de Threat Hunting basadas en hipótesis, alineadas al framework MITRE ATT&CK, cubriendo endpoints, identidad, red, nube y correo electrónico.

• Transformar hallazgos derivados de threat hunting e inteligencia en nuevas capacidades y reglas de detección en producción.

• Ejecutar investigaciones de análisis forense digital, incluyendo adquisición y preservación de evidencia y análisis de disco, memoria, red, logs y ambientes cloud.

• Determinar causa raíz, alcance, vector inicial e impacto de incidentes de seguridad.

• Realizar análisis de malware estático y dinámico en ambientes controlados para identificar indicadores, capacidades y comportamientos maliciosos.

• Brindar soporte técnico especializado en incidentes de alta criticidad, apoyando directamente en las etapas de contención, erradicación y recuperación.

• Elaborar reportes forenses e informes de incidentes con profundidad técnica y claridad ejecutiva para Dirección, Auditoría, áreas Legales y, cuando corresponda, requerimientos regulatorios.

• Conducir revisiones de lecciones aprendidas y dar seguimiento a las acciones correctivas derivadas de los incidentes.

• Evolucionar las capacidades del SOC mediante la actualización de playbooks, automatización, ejercicios Tabletop y evaluación de nuevas herramientas, tendencias y amenazas emergentes, incluidas aquellas potenciadas por IA.

 

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos un profesional de ciberseguridad con experiencia técnica en investigación y respuesta a incidentes, con capacidad para analizar situaciones complejas y tomar decisiones técnicas bajo presión.

Conocimientos clave

• Incident Response
• Threat Hunting
• Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI)
• Digital Forensics / DFIR
• Malware Analysis
• MITRE ATT&CK
• Análisis de endpoints, redes, identidad, correo y cloud
• Análisis de logs y evidencia digital
• Desarrollo y optimización de capacidades de detección
• Manejo de indicadores de compromiso (IoCs) y TTPs
• Procesos y operación de SOC
• Desarrollo y mejora de playbooks de respuesta
• Automatización aplicada a ciberseguridad
• Investigación de amenazas y actores maliciosos

 

 

Competencias / Habilidades

• Pensamiento analítico y capacidad de investigación
• Resolución de problemas complejos
• Capacidad para tomar decisiones técnicas bajo presión
• Comunicación clara con audiencias técnicas y ejecutivas
• Organización y documentación rigurosa
• Orientación a resultados
• Trabajo colaborativo
• Capacidad de aprendizaje continuo
• Atención al detalle
• Manejo adecuado de información sensible

 

Responsabilidades críticas del rol

La posición deberá tener capacidad para intervenir directamente ante incidentes críticos y trabajar de manera coordinada con los diferentes equipos involucrados en la respuesta.

Será responsable de convertir la información obtenida durante incidentes, investigaciones forenses, análisis de malware y campañas de threat hunting en acciones concretas que fortalezcan las capacidades preventivas y de detección de la organización.

Asimismo, deberá contribuir a la evolución continua del SOC mediante inteligencia de amenazas, nuevas detecciones, automatización y actualización de procedimientos de respuesta.

 

Principales relaciones

Internas:
• Miembros del SOC
• Equipo de Respuesta a Incidentes
• Equipos de Tecnologías de la Información
• Usuarios que reporten o presenten eventos de seguridad

Externas:
• Consultores y especialistas de seguridad

 

Beneficios

Ofrecemos la oportunidad de participar en un entorno de ciberseguridad de alta complejidad, trabajando con incidentes, amenazas y tecnologías relevantes para una organización de gran escala.

La posición brinda exposición a diferentes áreas de seguridad y oportunidades de desarrollo técnico en Threat Hunting, CTI, DFIR, Incident Response y evolución de capacidades SOC.

Incluye prestaciones de ley y beneficios adicionales.

 

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión

TelevisaUnivision promueve un entorno de trabajo basado en la igualdad de oportunidades y la inclusión. Las personas candidatas serán consideradas con base en su experiencia, conocimientos y competencias para la posición.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Senior Looker Developer
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

TelevisaUnivision is the world’s leading Spanish-language media company, reaching millions of viewers across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear, and live events. As we continue expanding our content and capabilities—especially following the successful launch of our ViX streaming platform—we’re investing heavily in cutting-edge data, technology, and talent.

 

The Data & Analytics team for ViX Streaming is seeking a Senior Looker Developer to help drive the next generation of data visualization and self-service analytics. In this role, you will partner closely with internal data engineering and analytics teams, as well as cross-functional enterprise data engineering stakeholders, to design, build, and optimize high-impact dashboards and LookML models that power decision-making across the streaming organization.

 

This is a unique opportunity to blend technical expertise with user-experience design, transforming ideas from wireframes into polished, intuitive dashboards that support our fast-growing streaming business.

 

ABOUT YOU

·         Thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities

·         Able to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy and confidentiality

·         Strong collaborator with excellent relationship-building skills

·         Exceptional written and verbal communication

·         Full professional proficiency in English

 

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY (RESPONSIBILITIES)

·         Design, build, and maintain reliable, insightful, and visually compelling Looker dashboards

·         Establish and enforce coding standards and style guidelines for LookML development

·         Enhance and optimize existing Looker reports and dashboards

·         Refine and restructure LookML projects to support evolving reporting needs

·         Use LookML parameters and UX best practices to improve the end-user experience

·         Ensure ongoing project health by monitoring performance, validating content, and performing audits and unit testing

·         Implement persistent derived tables, caching strategies, and refresh policies to ensure data accuracy and performance

·         Configure and manage data security, including access filters and field/row-level permissions

·         Partner with data engineers to define optimal data structures and solutions

·         Train, mentor, and support team members in Looker best practices and components

 

YOU HAVE (REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE)

·         8+ years of experience in data visualization development (5+ years in Looker)

·         Looker LookML Developer certification is a plus

·         Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (or equivalent experience)

·         Demonstrated expert-level proficiency in Looker and LookML

·         Strong SQL expertise and solid analytical skills

·         Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and data solutions

·         Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving, and debugging skills

·         Familiarity with BigQuery

·         Experience with Git and CI/CD deployment workflows

 

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

·         Employment/education will be verified

·         Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US on a full-time basis

 

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

job.title: Associate Executive Editor
job.description:
About the Daily Beast

The Daily Beast delivers award-winning original reporting and sharp opinions from big personalities in the arenas of politics, pop culture, world news, and more. Fiercely independent and armed with irreverent intelligence, The Daily Beast now reaches more than 20 million readers per month.

Job Description

The Daily Beast is seeking a dynamic and dedicated Associate Executive Editor to join our news team.

About the Role

The Daily Beast is roaring. Now we need a news executive who can help us turn up the volume. We are recruiting a driven newsroom leader to be a key part of our breaking news operation, which is the core of our journalism.

You already have at least five years of experience as a newsroom leader in a breaking news environment. You’re used to spotting, commissioning, editing, and publishing stories in a fast-paced environment where high editorial standards matter, and where stories are told in words, pictures, video and graphics.

You have brilliant ideas, line-editing, and headline-writing skills. You know how to help reporters shape news-breaking enterprise stories, how to guide those stories to publication, and how to maximize their impact.

Crucially, you're steeped in the news agenda—and especially fluent in the political scene and its ever-shifting cast of characters.

You'll report to our Deputy Executive Editor and support her as she directs the newsroom.

This role is your chance for professional growth at a news site that is growing and investing. More and more people are subscribing to our website and app. And we're bringing our journalism to YouTube and Substack, so our vital voice can be heard wherever people get their journalism.

Pay Range Salary

The pay range for this position is $110,000 - $140,000.

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high ends of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location, experience, performance, and other factors.

Additional Information

job.title: Campaign Operations Manager
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are now looking for a Campaign Operations Manager to join our Advertising team.

 

You will be responsible for campaign management across the Guardian digital portfolio, from set up through to delivery and optimisation, ensuring campaigns are set up and delivered to reach optimal results.

 

About the role

  • Support clients and agencies in the fulfilment of digital campaigns, from campaign sign off to reporting. 
  • Act as a support to the agencies, ensuring that campaigns are tracking correctly, offering best-in-class campaign management and customer service.
  • Set up campaigns across the Guardian’s digital portfolio - trafficking, testing/uploading creative units and troubleshooting any issues to ensure that campaigns run smoothly
  • Provide insight and analytics across The Guardian’s digital properties and business units to aid in the optimisation of advertising technologies in use

 

About you

job.title: Education Officer
job.description:
The Guardian Foundation is a charitable body whose purpose is to promote global press freedom and access to liberal journalism. Our vision is a world where people have access to reliable information from a diverse range of sources, strengthening their ability to hold power to account.

Through our news and media literacy programmes, we empower children and young people with the critical skills they need to navigate and engage with news in an informed way.

Our news and media literacy programmes, NewsWise (for primary students) and Behind the Headlines (for secondary, further, and higher education), equip young people with the skills to critically analyse news, engage with journalism, and navigate an increasingly complex media landscape.
 

The Guardian Foundation is now looking for an Education Officer for a 12 month fixed term contract to work across The Guardian Foundation’s news and media literacy programmes, delivering high-quality workshops and developing engaging educational resources. 

 

This is a part time role, 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday each week. Hours are typically 8am - 4pm on workshop delivery days, and 9:30am - 5:30pm on non-delivery days, with 2 days per week required in office. 

 

About the Role

 

  • Deliver engaging news and media literacy workshops to primary and secondary students (Key Stages 2 - 5) both in-person and online. Workshops are delivered in various settings: in primary and secondary schools, in our Education Centre in the Guardian’s office, and in informal settings (eg. libraries), including occasional travel where required.
  • Lead and support the development and updating of high quality learning resources and schemes of work for teachers and students across Key Stage 2 - 5
  • Adapt sessions and resources to different age groups and educational needs, ensuring accessibility and inclusion.
  • Translate workshop content into scalable formats (e.g. lesson plans, classroom activities, digital and printable resources)
  • Maintain and develop relationships with schools, universities, teachers, and community groups.

 

About You

This is not a prescriptive list, and we do not expect applicants to meet every item outlined below. We believe that this role would suit someone looking to build on their existing experiences and skills, whilst also having an understanding of their personal and professional development goals.

 

  • Qualified teacher status (QTS), with at least 2 years' experience delivering high quality educational sessions to young people. 
  • Ability to adapt teaching and delivery across a range of age groups (eg. KS2 - 5 and / or post-16 learners).
  • Experience developing and designing high-quality educational resources or curriculum materials.
  • Good understanding of the UK curricula and current education priorities.
  • An interest in news and current affairs, with an understanding of the importance of news and media literacy.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally within London and across the UK to support programme delivery and training, including occasional overnight stays.

 

The salary band for this fixed term contract is £21,000-22,2000 based on 3 days per week (£35,000-37,000 full time equivalent).

 

This post is subject to an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. The Guardian Foundation is committed to safeguarding the children and adults at risk with whom it works. The successful candidate will be expected to adhere to our policy and code of conduct. 

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people at The Guardian Foundation. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. The Guardian Foundation actively encourages applications from candidates underrepresented within the media and not-for-profit sectors.

 All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Anna Vipers on anna.vipers@theguardian.com to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

Benefits at the The Guardian Foundation

 You'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). job.title: Head of design
job.description:
Guardian Australia is part of Guardian News & Media (GNM), publisher of theguardian.com. As a leading global media organisation, we are renowned for our pioneering independent journalism and our award-winning digital products.

 

We are seeking a head of design to creatively lead Guardian Australia’s visual and editorial design team, as a hands-on editorial designer and visual storytelling lead in an engaged, fast-paced newsroom environment.

 

This role will collaborate with editors, journalists, photographers, developers and visual creatives across Australia and the wider Guardian network to elevate the digital experience of our journalism across web, app and emerging platforms. The role will help shape and evolve Guardian Australia’s visual identity and storytelling ambitions in the context of the Guardian’s global digital products and editorial strategy.

 

This role is being offered on a full-time, permanent basis, with early starts or late finishes. This role is open to candidates based in either Sydney or Melbourne. 

 

In this role you will…
 

  • Working to tight deadlines in collaboration with editors, reporters and developers to create compelling visual storytelling and design concepts that express Guardian journalism and values, with the reader at the centre.
  • Creatively lead a multidisciplinary visual and editorial design team producing innovative and engaging storytelling across design, photography, illustration, graphics, animation and interactive formats.
  • Be a source of editorial and visual expertise for projects and initiatives from inception to implementation.
  • Ensure visual and design work consistently meets high standards in storytelling, accessibility, usability, functionality and editorial quality across all platforms and devices.
  • Use imagination, energy and flair to innovate and evolve visual storytelling formats.
  • Influence design direction and contribute to broader editorial visual strategy alongside the Creative Director and senior editorial leadership.
  • Assist in building a dynamic, collaborative and creative newsroom environment that supports ambitious journalism while motivating and mentoring team members.
  • Balance reactive daily newsroom demands with longer-term enterprise and investigative projects, ensuring priorities are clear and achievable.
  • Work closely with engineering, product and audience teams to create visually compelling experiences that are technically efficient, scalable and audience-focused.
  • Support Guardian Australia journalism through art direction, illustration, motion graphics, data visualisation, interactives and multimedia storytelling.
  • Practical application and evolution of visual and design guidelines for news and feature stories, understanding their place within the wider editorial agenda.
  • Develop an understanding of Guardian Australia audiences and how they engage with our journalism, applying these insights to the development of visual work.
  • Collaborate with editors across news, features, sport, culture, investigations and other desks to ensure visual storytelling supports editorial intent from the outset.
  • Advocate for visual journalism and greater visual literacy across the newsroom, helping colleagues understand design processes, storytelling opportunities and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across editorial, engineering, UX, product and audience teams to support broader strategic objectives and ensure effective delivery.
  • Coordinate with Guardian colleagues internationally on shared editorial and visual projects.
  • Maintain strong relationships with photographers, illustrators, animators, designers and other external creative collaborators.
  • Participate in workshops, planning sessions and editorial discussions to shape storytelling strategy and visual innovation.
  • Spread awareness of opportunities and challenges in digital visual storytelling and editorial design.

 

You’ll bring….
 

Knowledge and experience

  • Exceptional talent and skill in editorial design and visual journalism.
  • At least eight years’ experience in digital editorial design, visual storytelling and interactive formats.
  • Experience creating engaging and accessible storytelling experiences across web, app and digital platforms from concept to execution.
  • Demonstrated experience managing and giving creative direction on multiple complex editorial projects simultaneously.
  • Knowledge of capabilities and constraints of web and native platforms.
  • Experience with Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere and After Effects.
  • Knowledge of HTML, SCSS/CSS and digital production workflows.
  • Understanding of JavaScript and interactive storytelling approaches.
  • Awareness of web standards and accessibility guidelines.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced newsroom environment to strict deadlines.
  • Ability to maintain a consistent visual style and editorial approach across multiple products and platforms.
  • Demonstrable interest in Australian news, features and multimedia journalism.
  • Broad understanding of Guardian audiences and how audience behaviour informs storytelling and product development.
  • Up to date with developments in visual journalism, storytelling technologies and digital trends.
  • Up to speed on the latest trends and technologies
  • A passion for independent journalism and an understanding of our editorial code and values.
     

Skills and behaviours
 

  • Able to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines effectively.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to build collaborative working relationships across editorial, product, engineering and creative teams.
  • Ability to guide and mentor designers and visual journalists through iterative creative processes.
  • Ability to lead workshops, planning sessions and collaborative editorial discussions.
  • Ability to work with and lead a multidisciplinary team.
  • Creative, innovative and solutions-oriented.
  • Strong editorial judgement and attention to detail.
  • Highly organised, with excellent time management skills.
  • Resilient under pressure and adaptable in a fast-moving newsroom environment.
  • Proactive and self-motivated.
  • Confident in advocating for visual and creative priorities.
  • Commitment to the Guardian’s values — honesty, integrity, courage and fairness.
     

About working at Guardian Australia… 
 

  • Hybrid working 
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) to support employee wellbeing
  • Paid volunteer leave
  • Dedicated diversity and inclusion employee groups, action plans (including our Reconciliation Action Plan) and cultural competency training
  • Guardian digital subscription


For more information please view the full job description here.
 

This role is being offered on a full-time, permanent basis, with early starts or late finishes. This role is open to candidates based in either Sydney or Melbourne. 
 

To apply for this position, please apply online and upload your résumé (maximum three pages) plus covering letter. In your covering letter please outline your motivation for applying for the role and why you think you are suitable.


Closing date for applications: Monday, 26 October 2026

 

If you have application questions or if you require an adjustment to be made during the recruitment process, please email australia.hr@theguardian.com


GNM Australia Limited (Guardian Australia) is proud to be a fair and ethical employer. Australian editorial minimum rates of pay by band and grade are outlined in the Journalists (GNM Australia Pty Ltd) Enterprise Agreement 2024 for roles that fall under its coverage. 


We believe that our role in the Australian media is to give a voice to the most marginalised people in society and value and respect all differences in all people — including people of colour, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people from different social classes, people with diverse gender and sexual identities, and people with disabilities (seen and unseen). We believe that these communities must be centred in the work we do, bringing a new perspective and a diversity of thought. We also encourage flexible working and aim to create a work environment where all employees feel respected. 
 

This role may be exposed to traumatic and distressing material. Guardian Australia is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our employees, and provides targeted wellbeing plans to support news professionals covering tough stories or dealing with the cumulative impacts of difficult topics.

job.title: Live Blogger
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We’re looking for a live blogger to write daily news live blogs for our UK  and global audiences. 

 

Live blogs are an integral staple of the Guardian’s output; you could be asked to blog on a huge range of different subjects, from politics or global conflicts, to extreme weather events or even must-see TV shows.

 

This position is a 9-month fixed-term contract or internal staff secondment and works a three-day fortnight, working every Sunday and alternate Mondays.

 

About the role

  • Make sure Guardian live blogs are both fast and trustworthy, pulling together your own original reporting and analysis, contributions from Guardian colleagues, and updates from wires and other news services 
  • Monitor and verify external sources such as social media, making effective use of other relevant material including audio and video 
  • Liaise with editors about the focus and headline of a live blog throughout the day, reacting speedily to breaking news
  • Engage with readers via our community team and incorporate contributions to enrich and inform coverage 
  • Ensure live blog updates are accurate and speedy, and in keeping with Guardian style and tone
  • Show awareness of media law, and assessing accuracy and risk before publishing 
  • Keep abreast of developments in live blogging, including new techniques, tools and formats
  • Liaise with live bloggers in other offices to ensure smooth handovers.

 

About you

  • Proven experience of working on live news 
  • Strong understanding of Guardian live blogging style, format and tone 
  • Experience of using web tools 
  • Substantial experience of using social internet tools and technologies 
  • Strong understanding of the editorial value and narrative impact of audio and video in a live blog 
  • Excellent knowledge of news and current affairs 
  • Good understanding of media law 
  • You’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role.

 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.

 

We operate in a hybrid environment with both working from our offices in King's Cross in London and from home.

job.title: Motion graphics designer
job.description:
Guardian Australia is part of Guardian News & Media (GNM), publisher of theguardian.com. As a leading global media organisation, we are renowned for our pioneering independent journalism and our award-winning digital products.

 

We are seeking for a motion graphics designer to join our editorial team, to design motion graphics and animation for the Guardian Australia’s multimedia department, including onsite and off-platform videos, social carousels and explainers crafting strong motion graphics/animations which explain complex stories and ideas and engage our audience.

 

This role is being offered on a full-time, 12-month contract, with early starts and/or late finishes. This role is open to candidates based in either Sydney or Melbourne. 

 

In this role you will…
 

  • Design motion graphics and animation for use in videos on and off-platform. 
  • Create bespoke audience-focused motion graphics and explanatory animations to a consistently high standard for one-off video productions across all areas of our digital journalism.
  • Create graphics templates for video producers and editors to use in their productions, and maintain our portfolio of existing brand graphics and template assets.
  • Use imagination and flair to maintain and develop consistent high standards of design, Guardian style & brand and visual reporting, and work closely with the design department. 
  • Liaise with video producers, multimedia editors, journalists, social video producers, art directors, designers, developers and other specialists at Guardian Australia.
  • Work on interactive journalism projects  as required.
  • Undertake training as required.
     

You’ll bring….

Knowledge and experience
 

  • At least four years of professional experience of creating high quality motion graphics and animation, translating ideas into engaging, dynamic, visual storytelling with strong use of typography, colour, composition and brand.
  • Demonstrable interest in visualising data and explanatory design, and understanding of how to use animation/motion to simplify complex topics.
  • Experience developing new video formats, styles and guidelines, such as explainers, news video and documentaries.
  • Experience of working collaboratively with video producers, designers and editors.
  • Comfortable in the practical aspects of video production; from concept, to design, to animation, post-production and understanding how to incorporate sound and music.
  • Experience working in a digital newsroom is an advantage.
  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role.
     

Skills / behaviours

  • A strong understanding of Illustrator, After Effects, Photoshop and Premiere Pro is preferred.
  • Additional technical specialism, e.g. Photoshop animation, stop motion or sound design is advantageous.
  • Able to manage projects to strict deadlines.
  • Good understanding of After Effects expressions, and how to create and maintain our Motion Graphics Templates used for branding in Adobe Premiere Pro edits.
  • Good editorial judgement, with an interest in and knowledge of current affairs and world events.
  • Collaborative, open and inclusive in approach.
  • Enthusiastic about experimenting with new formats and ways of reaching audiences.
  • Understanding of audience needs and behaviour across different platforms. 
  • Comfortable engaging with analytics to take a data-informed approach to decision-making.
  • Open to learning new skills and adaptable in applying your existing expertise in new ways.
  • Keen to innovate and experiment in your daily work, seeing every outcome as a chance to learn and improve.
  • Ability to follow senior editorial and art direction.
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and manage time effectively, with attention to detail and patience.
  • Able to work independently and as part of a team, and accept constructive feedback.
  • Understanding of our values - honesty, integrity, courage, fairness, and a sense of duty to the reader and the community.
  • A passion for independent journalism and an understanding of our editorial code and values
     

About working at Guardian Australia… 
 

  • Hybrid working 
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) to support employee wellbeing
  • Paid volunteer leave
  • Dedicated diversity and inclusion employee groups, action plans (including our Reconciliation Action Plan) and cultural competency training
  • Guardian digital subscription

job.title: Multimedia support specialist
job.description:
Guardian Australia is part of Guardian News & Media (GNM), publisher of theguardian.com. As a leading global media organisation, we are renowned for our pioneering independent journalism and our award-winning digital products.

The role ensures internal multimedia facilities are technically reliable, operationally efficient, and ready to support fast-paced editorial and creative teams working across digital platforms.

 

In this role you will…

 

Technical Support

  • Be the subject matter expert for multimedia applications used at Guardian Australia, including Adobe Creative Cloud (e.g. Premiere Pro & After Effects), REAPER, Iconik and LucidLink 
  • Support a geographically distributed team through email, video/telephone calls, instant messaging, and screen sharing/remote control
  • Use a ticketing system to ensure all incidents and service requests are logged and adequately documented, resolve where possible or escalate to system owners as appropriate
  • Manage the equipment lifecycle for a sub-fleet of Apple Macs used by Multimedia staff
