And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times International desk is looking for a Video Journalist to produce and edit stories with multimedia correspondents. You will join a team tasked with creating new approaches to our international reporting in video, working with a growing group of foreign correspondents who work in video as well as text.

The goal is to help our audience understand the world through powerful video stories, reaching our core audience as well as new viewers who increasingly consume journalism in video. We will experiment with a mix of direct, immersive vertical video forms that can bring our audience with us on the ground.

You will join a multi-disciplinary team of video journalists that will shape this work. This role is based in our New York office, working remotely with correspondents in the field to produce, edit and publish stories. You should have a refined understanding of video production and storytelling, including video editing, shooting and writing for narration, with a clear sense for how to creatively use graphics and animation to illustrate complex ideas. 

Your news judgement about what makes a good story in video will be crucial, as will creative ideas for how to reenvision the basic elements of foreign correspondence, across news, features and analysis. You must be an effective collaborator and a strong communicator who can work closely with regional editors and video colleagues to shape our approach to this coverage.

This position is based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. 

Responsibilities:

  • Write, produce, edit and publish videos with hybrid correspondents, in close partnership with regional editors.
  • Devise new approaches to digital video storytelling both on and off platform.
  • Work with correspondents to create a playbook for how to cover a region or beat in video.
  • Collaborate closely with International editors, correspondents and video colleagues.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • The role reports to the Senior Producer, International in New York.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of video storytelling, video editing and production experience at a news organization.
  • A strong portfolio, preferably of inventive short-form video.
  • Excellent writing, editing and communication skills.
  • Broad knowledge of current events and news.
  • Deep curiosity about video habits and users and platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in the trenches of production, including editing, shooting and field production.
  • The ability to edit quickly and accurately with Adobe Premiere. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience covering international news. 
  • Foreign language fluency.
  • Strong experience with archival research, including sourcing and clearing user-generated video content.
  • Fluency with animation and motion graphics as an integral part of your script writing process.
  • Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage field crews and hire and manage freelancers when necessary.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines and adapt to change within an unpredictable news and production environment.
  • A record of working with teams of journalists in difficult field assignments.

job.title: Video Journalist, Reporter Video
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is an industry leader in visual journalism with reporting that includes extraordinary news coverage, investigations, and culture and lifestyle reporting. The Reporter Video team identifies compelling stories and brings the depth and breadth of our news report onto our site and other platforms through video that features the expertise of our world-class journalists.

This is a role for someone who wants to produce, edit and publish short-form vertical videos daily and is versatile enough to work on news, features, enterprise and investigative projects with colleagues across the newsroom. You have expertise in video storytelling, including video editing and writing creatively to visuals, as well as a sharp sense of the digital landscape. 

Your portfolio and work samples should reveal a strong grasp of modern mobile video storytelling, and it should show that you’re a quick learner with creative ideas and the ability to work on small or large teams. You are solid technically, ideas-oriented and have solid news judgment. Cinematography skills are an added asset. We’re looking for someone who excels on deadlines and has experience juggling multiple projects at any given time. 

This is an in-office position based in London and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Write, produce, edit and publish short-form vertical videos every day.
  • Help to identify breaking news and enterprise across our news report and create video that features the expertise of our journalists, whether working with reporters on camera or using voiceover or visual storytelling techniques including graphics and animation.
  • Write visually rich scripts with an emphasis on visual takeaways.
  • Experiment with various forms of short-form vertical video storytelling. 
  • Collaborate with visual editors to generate video formats that bring our best journalism to new audiences.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to a Senior Producer for Reporter Video in London.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Proven experience with video storytelling, video editing and production experience at a news organization.
  • Excellent news judgment and proven ability to work with colleagues and reporters to synthesize newsgathering and/or investigations into a tight, informative and engaging video.
  • Experience producing shoots and interviewing experts on camera.
  • Experience creating original videos that intelligently incorporate audio, video, still images and text.
  • Strong video editing skills with Adobe Premiere.
  • Facility in using photo, video, audio, graphics and animation in storytelling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Thorough knowledge of global current events particularly in Europe, Africa and the Middle East.
  • Able to meet deadlines and adapt to change within an unpredictable news and production environment
  • Design and animation skills including experience with design and animation software (Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop and After Effects).
  • Experience working collaboratively with members of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Available to work a flexible schedule.

In your cover letter, include links to three videos from your work that best reflect the kind of reporter video work you could see The New York Times making. For each video, briefly describe your role in producing it, what you think worked particularly well, and what you would improve or approach differently. 

Applications without links to video portfolios/work samples will not be considered.

job.title: Video Reporter, Texas
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Times is looking for a Texas-based journalist with experience telling stories in video and text. You will work as part of a team of reporters and editors working from our newly created hub in Texas — a state that plays an essential role in the national discourse when it comes to politics, culture and business.

You have experience pitching stories and developing sources to deliver original and impactful journalism rooted in on-the-ground reporting that deepens our understanding of America. We're looking for a high-energy multimedia journalist – you should have a background that includes reporting in video and the ability to craft news and enterprise articles in text. You should be comfortable working across the two mediums, and you should have good judgment about when either is appropriate.

As a reporter, you are full of ideas on how to make an impact in our coverage and find innovative ways to tell stories. You have a body of work that shows effective sourcing, broad curiosity, a sharp eye for news, and a command of complex ideas. You have a track record of reporting that has produced scoops and helped to shape the conversation.

You are a self-starter and quick-thinker who is able and eager to jump on the news of the day (or week) with fresh visual ideas that advance the story or delve deeper and create high-quality, engaging videos across a variety of coverage areas.

This is a hybrid position based in Texas and includes regular attendance in the office each week per your departmental guidance and/or This role may require extensive travel across the state.

Responsibilities:

  • Pitch, report and write news and enterprise stories in text and video formats.
  • Develop compelling and well-structured scripts, integrating engaging visuals and rigorous fact-checking.
  • Report and produce video and text for news and enterprise projects. Either on-camera or behind the screens.
  • Collaborate with cinematographers, video editors, and motion graphics editors.
  • Contribute to live coverage on breaking news stories.
  • Deliver fast, clean copy in accessible style on complicated topics.
  • Ensure accuracy and clarity.
  • Break news on developing story lines across the region.
  • Collaborate with other national and video team reporters on news and enterprise; Work collaboratively with members of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Monitor wires, local and regional outlets, social media feeds and other sources for developing storylines, keeping us ahead of national competitors.
  • Meet tight deadlines and be able to thrive in a daily, unpredictable news environment.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • This role reports to the Texas Editor and a Senior Producer in Video, based in Los Angeles.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience working for a daily news organization (preferably in a digital video or broadcast newsroom).
  • A portfolio that demonstrates you are well-versed in a range of topics, and have a growing circle of sources across storylines and includes:

    • news, enterprise and analysis.

    • video you produced, shot or appeared in.

  • Proven experience leading field productions, writing scripts and editing compelling narratives.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the video production process and creative instincts that go beyond traditional text formats.
  • Crisp, clear, evocative writing skills that also demonstrate a mastery of journalistic style and standards.
  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Ability to shoot video.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A deep understanding of the issues facing the state, from experience living or working in Texas or the Southwest.
  • Strong editorial judgment and writing skills, with a passion for finding original, visual journalism opportunities in competitive news moments.
  • A foundational knowledge of legal, ethical and usage issues for visuals.
  • A willingness to be flexible as the news demands and the newsroom's needs evolve.
  • An openness to trying new storytelling approaches.

job.description:
Descrição da Vaga (Job Description)

Você busca desenvolver sua carreira como Analista Fiscal Pleno em uma empresa global de tecnologia e informação? Junte-se à Thomson Reuters!

Na Thomson Reuters, combinamos inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam profissionais e empresas a tomar decisões com mais segurança e alcançar melhores resultados. Atuamos nos mercados Tributário, Contábil, Jurídico, Comércio Exterior e Tecnologia, apoiando milhares de clientes no Brasil e no mundo.

Como Analista Fiscal Pleno, você fará parte de um time especializado, contribuindo para o suporte e a evolução de soluções fiscais que impactam diretamente a rotina de nossos clientes. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar seus conhecimentos tributários, desenvolver habilidades técnicas e atuar em um ambiente colaborativo, inovador e focado no sucesso do cliente.

Principais Responsabilidades (Key Responsibilities)

  • Prestar atendimento aos clientes via sistema de chamados e por telefone, para esclarecimento de dúvidas funcionais/técnicas relacionadas ao produto. 
  • Realizar simulações de erros relacionados ao sistema atendido na base interna de testes para reprodução do mesmo incidente relatado pelo cliente. 
  • Fazer acompanhamento constante dos chamados para compreensão do incidente com foco na resolução. 
  • Quando necessário, realize acesso remoto ou entre em contato com o cliente via telefone, com o objetivo de identificar a causa do incidente quando não reproduzido no ambiente interno de testes. 
  • Abertura de demanda interna junto ao Tempo de Desenvolvimento para Correção do incidente identificado. 
  • Classificação de chamados identificando a causa raiz do incidente. 
  • Gerenciar múltiplas atividades.
  • Geração de conteúdo na base de conhecimento através da criação de FAQ's.
  • Trabalhar com metas estipuladas e acompanhamento de desempenho.

Qualificações Obrigatórias (Required Qualifications)

  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prática com SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições e REINF;
  • Vivência na geração, validação e entrega de arquivos TXT ao governo;
  • Conhecimento em apurações fiscais, fechamentos, emissão de guias e legislação tributária;
  • Experiência em suporte/atendimento ao cliente.

Qualificações Desejáveis (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Conhecimento na solução Tax One;
  • Conhecimento em SQL/SELECT e banco de dados;
  • Conhecimento de legislação fiscal e consulta de guias práticos;
  • Vivência ou conhecimento sobre Reforma Tributária.


#LI-RB1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: ""Flex My Way"" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa ""Grow My Way"" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.
  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.
  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? Faça parte da nossa equipe e contribua para moldar as indústrias que impulsionam o progresso da sociedade.

Como uma empresa global, confiamos no conhecimento único, perspectivas e experiências de todos os colaboradores para cumprir nossos objetivos comerciais. Para garantir que possamos fazer isso, buscamos colaboradores talentosos e qualificados em todas as nossas operações ao redor do mundo, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo/gênero, incluindo gestantes, identidade e expressão de gênero, origem nacional, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, deficiência, idade, estado civil, status de cidadania, ou outra classificação protegida pela lei aplicável.

job.title: Associate Content Specialist
job.description:
Job Description
Associate Content Specialist, Primary Law Content Operations

Do you have high attention to detail and want to explore or leverage your editing skills and be a good communicator? Then Thomson Reuters ( Great place to work certified ) brings in a great opportunity to kick start your career.
This role would involve your participation in the creation, maintenance and delivery of the company's products by working collaboratively across the organization.
This role involves your participation in a Content Operations team and your assistance in preparation of data for publishing legal and regulatory products in print and/or electronic form.
Participates in an Editorial or Content Operations team and assists in the creation and/or acquisition, preparation and delivery of assigned content and information for creating products and checking functionality in all publication media (print or electronic). The primary focus at this entry level is training with some supervision.

Key Responsibilities
In this opportunity as Associate Content Specialist, you will:

  • Production/Editorial/Support: Has a general understanding of legal system and some knowledge of an efficient production/support workflow process.  Performs duties such as analyzing, keying, converting, coding, copyreading, editing, merging, rendering, loading, or validation of data. Supports team publishing goals by meeting deadlines.  

  • Product/Process Knowledge:  Works regularly on various systems, software, databases and applications to deliver quality products. Responsible for accuracy and completeness of work product, including competence in scheduling and administrative systems as well as computer file management. All work will be checked until competent process knowledge is developed

  • Interpersonal/Team Skills: Works successfully in a team environment and understands various roles of team members.  Attends and participates in team meetings, prioritizes own work, and participates in the performance management process (e.g. peer reviews, self-evaluation).

  • Contribute to seamless implementation of process migrations by taking on new tasks ex: analyzing, keying, converting, coding, copyreading, editing, merging, rendering, loading, or validation of data.

  • Supports team publishing goals by meeting deadlines.

  • Completes tasks in support of the team’s deliverables. Focus on learning and executing existing practices and procedures.

  • Works regularly on various systems, software, databases and applications to deliver quality products. Responsible for accuracy and completeness of work product, including competence in scheduling and administrative systems as well as computer file management.

  • Works successfully in a team environment and understands various roles of team members.

  • Attends and participates in team meetings, prioritizes own work, and participates in the performance management process.

Required Qualifications
You’re a fit for the role of Associate Content Specialist if your background includes: 

  • 0 - Less then 12 Months Experience

  • Familiarity of legal terminology and court, legislative, and regulatory levels are desirable.

job.title: Campaigns Marketing Manager
job.description:
Job Description

As a Campaigns Marketing Manager, Reuters Agency, you will plan and deliver integrated, audience-led marketing campaigns across digital channels and live experiences. You will develop campaigns across email, organic and paid social, paid search, webinars, industry events, trade shows, content marketing, and Reuters Agency web pages.

You will manage global programmes across regions and throughout the marketing funnel, from audience acquisition and lead capture through nurture, conversion, retention, and advocacy. The role requires strong campaign management, analytical, project-management, and stakeholder-management capabilities, along with the ability to coordinate concurrent initiatives across global teams.

You will work closely with global Sales, Product Marketing, Editorial, Digital, and Events teams to build, activate, and measure omnichannel campaigns that strengthen engagement, generate qualified demand, and contribute to commercial goals.


Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a Campaigns Marketing Manager, Reuters Agency, you will:


  • Develop Integrated Campaigns: Develop and execute end-to-end integrated marketing campaigns aligned with audience, brand, pipeline, and revenue objectives.
  • Build Multi-Channel Campaign Plans: Create campaign plans across email, organic and paid social, paid search, webinars, content, website, and live events, ensuring consistent messaging and effective channel sequencing.
  • Lead Industry Event Marketing: Lead the marketing of Reuters participation in industry events and trade shows, including audience targeting, pre-event promotion, lead capture, on-site brand activation, and post-event nurture.
  • Promote Reuters-Owned Events: Plan and promote Reuters-owned events and webinars in partnership with internal stakeholders, supporting audience strategy, registration journeys, speaker and content promotion, attendee communications, and follow-up campaigns.
  • Develop Campaign Content: Create campaign content and creative briefs in collaboration with subject-matter experts, Editorial, Design, and external partners to produce assets for different audiences and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Manage Website and Landing Page Content: Manage campaign landing pages and relevant Reuters Agency website content. Coordinate updates, apply SEO and user-experience best practices, and improve conversion journeys.
  • Manage Marketing Funnel Activity: Manage marketing activity from lead generation through nurture and retention, using segmentation, personalization, and marketing automation to increase engagement and conversion.
  • Measure Campaign Performance: Measure campaign, webinar, content, website, and event performance. Analyze funnel metrics and translate results into recommendations for optimization.
  • Manage Campaign Delivery: Manage campaign budgets, schedules, agencies, suppliers, and third-party partners to ensure high-quality delivery on time and within budget.
  • Partner with Sales Teams: Work closely with Sales teams on audience priorities, lead follow-up, pipeline attribution, and feedback loops to improve marketing effectiveness.
  • Monitor Market Activity: Monitor industry trends and competitor activity, test new approaches, and share best practices across the wider Marketing team.

Required Qualifications

You're a fit for the role of Campaigns Marketing Manager, Reuters Agency, if you have the following required qualifications:


  • 5+ years of experience in campaign management or digital marketing roles, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in multi-channel digital marketing strategies and customer journey optimization.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to derive actionable insights from data.
  • Proficiency in marketing automation tools, CRM systems, and analytics platforms.
  • A creative mindset and interest in content creation and the media industry.
  • Excellent project-management, stakeholder-management, and communication skills, with the ability to manage concurrent campaigns, events, and deadlines across global teams.
  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and work effectively with stakeholders across regions, cultures, and time zones.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
  • Please note that this is not a people management position; it is an individual contributor role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant professional certifications.

job.title: Commissioning Editor,Korea(12 months contract)
job.description:
Commissioning Editor,Korea(12 months contract)


Are you passionate about shaping market-leading legal content and building strong partnerships within the legal and publishing ecosystem in Korea? Do you thrive in a role where you can combine editorial expertise, stakeholder management, and commercial acumen to deliver impactful, online-first content solutions for customers?


This position manages the commissioning and delivery of Legal Content for Thomson Reuters Korea, focusing on content licensing and acquisition for Korean legal content under an “Online First” strategy. The role involves identifying and maintaining content partners, validating and testing legal content, managing editorial processes, and ensuring alignment with business objectives.


About the Role
In this opportunity as a Commissioning Editor, you will:

  • Source, evaluate, and collaborate with licensors, authors, and subject-matter experts to identify, scope, and secure new legal content aligned with our "Online First" strategy.
  • Oversee commissioning, manuscript delivery, and third-party editing processes, ensuring content moves smoothly from concept through to publication.
  • Review, validate, and test Korean legal content across platforms and environments to ensure accuracy, clarity, and practical usability for customers.
  • Track legislative amendments, regulatory updates, and enforcement rules, and ensure timely internal communication and content updates.
  • Cultivate long-term relationships with authors, partners, and key stakeholders in the legal and publishing industries to secure high-value content and collaboration opportunities.
  • Contribute to financial and product targets through effective content licensing, performance tracking, and continuous enhancement of customer experience.

About You
You're a fit for the role of Commissioning Editor if you have the following qualifications:

  • Proven experience in legal content development within a legal publishing or related professional information environment.
  • Strong content management skills, including planning, commissioning, editing coordination, and delivery to schedule.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and nurture editorial and author relationships over an extended period (typically 5+ years).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an entrepreneurial, proactive mindset and the ability to work independently.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align multiple stakeholders.

job.title: Customer Success Manager
job.description:
Job Description

As a Customer Success Manager at Thomson Reuters (TR), you will be the main partner for our customers after they choose our solutions. You will help them use our products fully, reach the goals they set for themselves, and get the most value from their investment. You will build lasting relationships, create success plans shaped around each customer, and make onboarding and training smooth and simple. You will also speak up for customers inside TR, bringing their feedback to the teams that shape our products. Your success will be measured by how quickly customers see their first results, how engaged they are, and how well they adopt new features.

 

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Build Strong Customer Relationships: Develop and maintain lasting relationships with key stakeholders across your customer accounts. Serve as the main point of contact for customer questions and support needs.
  • Plan for Success: Design and carry out success plans tailored to each customer's goals. Hold regular check-ins and quarterly business reviews to measure progress and adjust plans as needed.
  • Guide Onboarding and Training: Walk new customers through onboarding so the transition is smooth and they start seeing value quickly. Plan and deliver training sessions and webinars on product features and best practices.
  • Monitor Usage and Adoption: Review how customers use our products to spot barriers to adoption, then design strategies to increase engagement. Track customer health indicators and adoption rates to keep product use strong.
  • Drive Retention and Growth: Work with the sales team on renewals and identify opportunities to expand or add solutions. Help customers refine and raise their goals so they keep finding value in our products over time.
  • Advocate for Customers: Gather customer feedback and share it to shape product development and marketing. Create customer success stories and case studies that show the value TR solutions bring.
  • Collaborate Across TR: Partner with sales, marketing, and product teams to align customer success work with business goals. Take part in strategic account planning and joint campaigns with key partners.

 

Required Qualifications

You are an ideal fit for the Customer Success Manager role if your experience includes:

  • Experience in customer success, account management, or another client-facing role.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to earn trust with a range of stakeholders, from day-to-day users to senior decision-makers.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain product value in simple terms and check that others understand.
  • Experience planning and running customer onboarding, training, or education.
  • Comfort reviewing usage or performance data and turning what you find into clear next steps.
  • Strong organization skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities at once.
  • Willingness to work closely with sales, marketing, and product teams to share insights and reach shared goals.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience renewing or expanding accounts, including spotting upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
  • Experience with customer health tracking or product usage analytics.
  • Experience creating case studies, success stories, or webinar content.
  • Familiarity with professional markets such as legal, tax, accounting, or government.
  • Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently and improve customer outcomes.

#LI-RZ1

What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

job.description:
Job Description

Ready to turn trusted professional-grade AI products into real, measurable outcomes for South Korean legal customers?

 

Thomson Reuters is hiring a Customer Success Manager to own outcomes for a portfolio of South Korean legal customers using CoCounsel and related AI solutions. You will translate business goals into measurable success plans, drive adoption from first value to scaled rollout, and build executive-level relationships that make renewals and expansion a natural next step. You will combine consultative customer leadership, strong project management, and data-driven execution to embed AI into real legal workflows.

You are a proactive, metrics-driven Customer Success manager who can operate credibly with senior legal stakeholders and confidently drive change inside complex organizations. You blend consultative relationship management with structured execution, turning onboarding into adoption, and adoption into measurable outcomes, retention, and growth.

 

This role will be based in South Korea.

 

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a Customer Success Manager, Legal, you will:

  • Relationships: Build and maintain relationships across legal, innovation, knowledge management, IT, and leadership teams. Develop internal champions and align executive stakeholders on measurable outcomes.
  • Onboarding and Adoption: Lead onboarding and implementation from start to finish, including entitlements, training, and rollout planning. Then drive ongoing adoption by building CoCounsel into priority legal workflows and practice group routines.
  • Use Cases and Return on Investment: Proactively identify, validate, and scale new use cases. Measure and communicate return on investment against agreed success metrics, including in quarterly business review-style reviews.
  • Project Coordination: Coordinate cross-functional problem-solving, keep communication and timelines on track, and maintain plans to manage risk.
  • Presentations and Reporting: Prepare and deliver project presentations and status reports for prospects and clients.
  • Sales Support: Support targeted deals by running proofs of concept and facilitated trials.
  • Voice of the Customer: Capture customer feedback and share it with the right Thomson Reuters teams, including leadership, strategy, sales, proposition, presales, customer success, marketing, and product.

 

Required Qualifications

You are an ideal fit for the Customer Success Manager, Legal role if your experience includes:

  • 7+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Implementation at a business software company (software as a service, or SaaS), or in a comparable client-facing role, owning onboarding, adoption, and retention outcomes.
  • Experience with legal software solutions.
  • Customer experience across onboarding, success planning, and retention management.
  • Cross-functional collaboration, with experience working across teams and engaging stakeholders successfully.

job.description:
Job Description

As a Customer Success Manager focused on direct tax, you will translate complex tax rules and changing regulations into practical guidance, helping clients stay ahead of change and make confident decisions in every filing season.

Customer Success is not just a function or team at Thomson Reuters, but also our reason for doing business. We measure our success based on the prioritization of our customers' needs and goals. The relationship we create with our customers determines the future benefits for them and our company. The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is assigned a book of business specific to Concierge and/or Advisory customers, responsible for the development of customers' knowledge on their suite of offerings. The CSM will manage these customers to drive performance towards Thomson Reuters' strategic objectives and retention goals. This will require the management of multiple projects with strong business acumen to remove obstacles interfering with the growth and retention of customers.

Key Responsibilities
In this opportunity as a Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Partner with customers to define success, deliver educational activities throughout their lifecycle, and track progress toward business outcomes
  • Develop and share best practices and Customer Success Plans, collaborating with internal teams like Sales and Professional Services
  • Monitor customer health by tracking usage data and escalating critical concerns, using insights to drive strategic adjustments
  • Identify and activate commercial growth opportunities, recommending improvements based on customer maturity and working closely with the commercial team
  • Ensure customers receive maximum value from their investment, driving retention and growth through tailored engagement and collaboration
  • Leverage technology tools (e.g., Gainsight, Salesforce) to manage client information, pipeline, and financial forecasts accurately
  • Build and present business plans, report on market and competitor activities, and represent Customer Success in cross-functional meetings to support business objectives


Required Qualifications
You are a fit for the role of Customer Success Manager if you have:

  • 8+ years of professional experience, with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in customer success
  • Direct Tax experience
  • 4-year college degree required
  • Experience working in and around cloud software solutions and cloud delivery models
  • Strong business acumen and communication skills; can manage a customer journey, conflict resolution, and problem-solving.

job.description:
End to End Associate Solutions Architect


Thomson Reuters is running large enterprise transformation programmes to change how Lead to Support processes work, and commercial services need to be onboarded through both digital channels and enterprise platforms as part of that change.


We need someone who can design the end-to-end architecture for that onboarding, keep it aligned with the wider technology strategy, and make sure business stakeholders and technical teams stay on the same page as it's built.
 

About the Role

What you will have achieved by the end of year one:

  • Delivered a live architecture roadmap: defined and updated the solution roadmap for at least one architecture area you own, and stakeholders are using it to plan, not just referencing it as a document.
     
  • Shipped an architectural design into a transformation programme: produced an architectural design for an enterprise transformation programme (or existing one), with technology components that fit the overall technology strategy, and can show it was actually adopted by the delivery teams.
     
  • Become the working point of contact for stakeholder issues: business teams, product owners, and project management bring you roadmap and process questions directly, and you resolve or route them without the issue stalling.
     
  • Operated inside architecture governance: participated in the Design Authority structure and Solution Review board, and can point to at least one solution that went through your governance review before being approved.
     
  • Produced usable architecture artifacts: delivered business process, data model, system, sequence, and process flow diagrams that other teams actually referenced during build.
     

About You

What we need you to have done before (and why):

  • A wide variety of solutions architecture experience across multiple business contexts, ideally with consulting experience at a leading IT consultancy or large corporate, because you'll be designing architecture for varied, high-stakes transformation programmes, not a single narrow system.
     
  • Solid experience with market-leading CRM and Self Service platforms, and integrating CRM to ERP, Middleware, and Web Content Management Systems, because the commercial services onboarding this role supports runs through exactly these integrations.

job.title: Engenheiro DevOps Pleno
job.description:
Job Description

Você busca desenvolver sua carreira e atuar como Engenheiro DevOps Pleno em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia? Junte-se a nós!

 

A Thomson Reuters combina a inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam os profissionais a tomar decisões confiantes e administrar melhor seus negócios.

Nós os ajudamos a reinventar a maneira como os profissionais trabalham, nossa equipe de especialistas reúne informação, inovação e insight para desvendar situações complexas nos mercados Tributário, Comercio Exterior, Contábil e Jurídico, respaldando nossos clientes na tomada de decisão.

Key Responsibilities


Atender as demandas de DevOps e Middleware para os ambientes baixos e ambiente de produção, das aplicações web que gerenciam a operação do negócio, operando em uma estrutura cloud (Amazon AWS), incorporando ferramentas de IA (assistentes de código, agentes e automações inteligentes) para otimizar processos de desenvolvimento, operação e resolução de incidentes.


  • Provisionar e configurar novos ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção na AWS.
  • Implantar monitorias e monitorar as aplicações web.
  • Fazer o deploy das aplicações web desenvolvidas pela empresa. Buscar automação dos processos repetitivos feitos pelos times de desenvolvimento, testes e DevOps.
  • Utilizar IA generativa e agentes autônomos para acelerar rotinas de scripting, testes e diagnósticos. Aplicar IA na análise de logs, troubleshooting e correlação de eventos para acelerar a identificação de causa raiz de incidentes.
  • Utilizar IDEs com IA integrada (ex: Cursor, GitHub Copilot) e criar/gerenciar "skills"/prompts customizados para padronizar tarefas recorrentes de infraestrutura e automação.
  • Elaboração e implantação de planos de backup, restaurações e retorno de desastres.
  • Instalação, configuração e administração de serviços Windows e Linux.
  • Cuidar/auxiliar no ciclo de patch dos servidores.

 

Required Qualifications

 

  • Formado ou cursando fases finais de Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em administração, monitoramento e instalação de servidores de aplicação – Tomcat/WildFly.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de proxy reverso/balanceamento de carga de aplicações web – Nginx, AWS ELB.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de SMTP, Postfix, Exim, AWS SES, etc.
  • Experiência em sistema operacional Linux e Windows Server.
  • Conhecimento em operações em nuvem pública (Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure). Conhecimento de automação utilizando Jenkins e Ansible.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento, desejável Datadog.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de scripts em shell script (Linux), PowerShell e/ou Python. Conhecimento de automação utilizando CloudFormation, Ansible ou Terraform.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de IA aplicadas a desenvolvimento e operações, como Cursor IDE, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/Claude ou similares, incluindo criação de prompts e "skills"/agentes para automação de tarefas. Disponibilidade para atuar em manutenções programadas fora do horário de expediente.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

  • Conhecimento em CI/CD.

job.title: Key Account Manager
job.description:
Job Description  


Buscamos un Gerente de Cuentas Clave apasionado y con experiencia para unirse a nuestro equipo en Thomson Reuters. En este rol, será responsable de desarrollar y mantener relaciones sólidas con nuestros clientes más importantes, identificando sus necesidades y ofreciendo soluciones que generen valor.

 

Key Responsibilities 

 En esta oportunidad como Key Account Manager, serás responsable de:

 

  • Crear y gestionar un pipeline de oportunidades de negocio, identificando y calificando nuevos clientes potenciales. Desarrollar y fortalecer relaciones estratégicas con clientes clave, actuando como un asesor de confianza.
  • Liderar el desarrollo de sociedades que generen crecimiento mutuo.
  • Realizar evaluaciones exhaustivas de las necesidades del cliente para comprender sus desafíos y objetivos.
  • Influir en las decisiones de compra de los clientes a través de presentaciones profesionales y propuestas de valor convincentes.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de marketing para desarrollar estrategias que impulsen el compromiso del cliente.   Gestionar el proceso de ventas de principio a fin, asegurando un flujo de trabajo eficiente y exitoso.
  • Comprender y optimizar los procesos empresariales del cliente para integrar nuestras soluciones de manera efectiva. Presentar y negociar propuestas de productos y servicios que aborden las necesidades específicas del cliente.  Utilizar tecnología de ventas y tecnología web para optimizar la gestión de cuentas y el seguimiento del rendimiento.   Demostrar y comunicar el valor de entrega de nuestras soluciones a los clientes.
  • Implementar un enfoque de venta consultiva para identificar y resolver los problemas de los clientes
     

Required Qualifications 

Eres el candidato ideal para el puesto de Key Account Manager si tu experiencia incluye:

  • Experiencia comprobada en creación de oportunidades y desarrollo de relaciones con clientes clave.
  • Habilidad para el desarrollo de sociedades estratégicas.
  • Fuertes habilidades en evaluaciones de las necesidades del cliente.
  • Capacidad demostrada de influencia en las decisiones de compra.
  • Conocimiento en estrategias de marketing.
  • Motivación por los new challenges y la mejora continua.
  • Excelentes habilidades de presentación profesional y comunicación.
  • Sólida comprensión del proceso de ventas y los procesos empresariales.
  • Experiencia en la creación y presentación de propuestas de productos.
  • Familiaridad con la tecnología de ventas y la tecnología web.
  • Capacidad para demostrar y comunicar el valor de entrega.
  • Experiencia en venta consultiva.

 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos colaborativos y con equipos multifuncionales.
  • Capacidad para adaptarse a nuevas herramientas, procesos y necesidades del negocio.
  •  Orientación al cliente y capacidad para construir relaciones profesionales a largo plazo.

#LI-AC1

 

 


¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.

Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.
  • Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.
  • Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.
  • Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.
  • Impacto Social: Genera un impacto en tu comunidad con nuestro Instituto de Impacto Social. Ofrecemos a los empleados dos días de voluntariado pagados anualmente y oportunidades para involucrarse en proyectos de consultoría pro bono e iniciativas de Medio Ambiente, Sociales y de Gobernanza (ESG).
  • Haciendo un Impacto Real en el Mundo: Somos una de las pocas compañías a nivel global que asiste a sus clientes en la búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Trabajando en conjunto con los profesionales e instituciones a los que servimos, contribuimos a sostener el estado de derecho, fomentar el comercio, detectar a los infractores, informar sobre los hechos y ofrecer información confiable e imparcial a personas en todo el mundo.

Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. job.title: Lead Applied Scientist, Document Understanding
job.description:
Lead Applied Scientist, Document Understanding


Job Description:

This role sits within the applied science function. You will own the design, development, and production deployment of document understanding systems that directly power Westlaw, PracticalLaw, and CoCounsel. The problems are real, the scale is large, and the expectation is shipped, reliable, measurable impact.You will work across semantic chunking, document enrichment, knowledge graph construction, and synthetic data generation for complex legal, tax, and accounting content. Multiple product teams depend on what this function delivers.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and deploy semantic chunking models for lengthy, non-uniformly structured legal documents with adjustable granularity across use cases
  • Build document enrichment systems using legal and customer-defined taxonomies
  • Develop LLM-based knowledge graph construction pipelines that extract and link citations, entities, and legal concepts across diverse legal content
  • Lead knowledge distillation efforts to compress large models into latency-constrained, production-ready SLMs
  • Design evaluation frameworks — component-level and end-to-end — using expert annotation and synthetic data
  • Own technical decisions on architecture, chunking strategy, classification approach, and knowledge extraction methods
  • Partner with engineering on delivery, reliability, and scale across multiple product lines
  • Provide technical input to senior leadership on AI strategy and roadmap
  • Mentor applied scientists and ML practitioners on the team

Required Qualifications:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, or a related field
  • 8+ years of industry experience building and scaling document understanding, information extraction, knowledge graph, or applied NLP solutions
  • Demonstrated expertise across the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including model development, evaluation, optimization, distillation, and production deployment
  • Strong Python programming skills with hands-on experience in PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and DeepSpeed
  • Track record of publishing research in leading conferences such as ACL, EMNLP, ICLR, NeurIPS, SIGIR, KDD, or equivalent
  • Proven ability to mentor technical talent and drive measurable business impact through production-ready AI systems
  • Experience translating advanced research into scalable, high-performing products and services
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders alike

​Hands-on production depth required in:

  • Document layout analysis and semantic chunking beyond fixed-size or paragraph-based methods
  • Hierarchical, multi-label document classification with domain-specific and customer-defined schemas
  • Entity recognition and linking, relation extraction, citation parsing, and knowledge graph construction from unstructured text
  • LLM-based information extraction, few-shot and multi-task learning, and post-training
  • Knowledge distillation, model compression, and SLM deployment under latency constraints
  • Synthetic data generation and annotation workflow design
  • End-to-end evaluation framework design for document understanding

Preferred Qualifications

  • Legal document understanding, legal IE, or legal AI experience
  • Complex document structures: nested hierarchies, cross-references, non-uniform formatting
  • Retrieval or QA systems over large document collections
  • RAG and agentic workflows in enterprise settings
  • Knowledge graph frameworks for legal or enterprise applications
  • AzureML or AWS SageMaker

#LI-SM2

 

 

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Our use of AI within the recruitment process Thomson Reuters utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support parts of our global recruitment process. Unless you opt-out, our AI system will assess the information provided by you and compare it to the requirements listed for the role, and present the result to our recruitment personnel for further review. The AI system acts as a supporting tool, but there is always a human making the decision if you will be considered for the role.

 

 

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $147,600 USD - $274,200 USD. You hold a PhD in Computer Science, Information Retrieval, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field, with 8+ years of post-degree industry experience building and deploying search and retrieval systems at scale. You have hands-on depth across indexing, retrieval, ranking, relevance evaluation, and production deployment.

You publish, you mentor, and you measure success by what ships and performs in production. You understand search beyond simply consuming vector databases or retrieval APIs. You have built, optimized, and evaluated search systems that solve real user problems.

  • Build and optimize ingestion pipelines that analyze, enrich, and prepare documents for retrieval
  • Develop ranking and re-ranking systems using both traditional IR techniques and modern LLM-based approaches

job.title: Lead Service Data Engineer
job.description:
Job Description


The Service & Operational Insights organization is seeking a Lead Service Data Engineer to join our growing Service & Operational Data team. This candidate will build, scale, and operationalize the data platform that powers service reliability, operational visibility, and data-driven decision-making across technology operations, partnering closely with the Enterprise Architect, Service & Operational Data, and other key stakeholders to translate target-state architecture, canonical data models, and governance standards into robust, production-grade pipelines and data products.


Key Responsibilities

  • Implement the target architecture: Translate the operational data architecture and roadmap (incidents, changes, problems, alerts/events, CMDB, SLOs/SLIs, capacity, cost) into concrete, well-engineered pipelines, implementing canonical schemas such as service topology, event normalization, and incident timelines.
  • Own pipeline reliability and operations: Build batch and streaming pipelines ingesting data from ITSM, observability platforms, cloud logs/metrics/traces, CI/CD, and infrastructure systems — with strong monitoring, alerting, and on-call practices.
  • Operationalize data quality and trust: Implement data contracts, validation rules, testing frameworks, and lineage tracking; enforce dataset SLAs/SLOs and drive remediation when breached.
  • Deliver operational data products: Build and maintain curated datasets, semantic layers, and metrics definitions powering dashboards, analytics, and automation use cases (AIOps, correlation, anomaly detection).
  • Drive engineering excellence and mentorship: Establish coding standards, CI/CD practices, and reference implementations; provide technical direction through design/code reviews and mentor team members.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work with the Architect and Service Reporting team to influence data model design; collaborate with SRE, IT Ops, Security, and Analytics stakeholders to prioritize high-value use cases (incident reduction, alert noise reduction, change failure rate, capacity planning).
  • Implement governance and security controls: Build RBAC/ABAC enforcement, retention policies, encryption, and auditability into pipelines and platforms.
  • Support the roadmap: Provide engineering estimates, identify technical risks, and help sequence delivery of the operational data roadmap.

Required Qualifications :


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, with 10 + years of experience as a Data Engineer working with complex, large-scale data
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with proven experience designing and delivering production-grade batch and streaming data pipelines
  • Experience building data products (curated datasets, semantic layers, metrics definitions) and applying security governance principles (RBAC/ABAC, encryption, retention, auditability)
  • Familiarity with ITSM, observability, and cloud data sources (incidents, changes, alerts/events, CMDB, logs/metrics/traces), along with data quality practices (contracts, testing, lineage)
  • Strong problem-solving skills with minimal supervision, excellent communication, and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in parallel.

Preferred Qualifications :


  • Experience supporting AIOps, correlation, or anomaly detection use cases
  • Familiarity with SLA/SLO enforcement frameworks for data platforms
  • Experience with capacity planning, cost, and reliability engineering data domains
  • Prior experience partnering with data architecture functions to shape canonical schemas and data models
  • Experience with DevOps technologies such as Jenkins, CodePipeline, CloudFormation, Terraform, Ansible

Manager, Professional Services

Are you ready to step into a leadership role and shape how our SurePrep customers experience Professional Services? This is an opportunity to lead the team of consultants and trainers who deliver SurePrep implementations, consulting engagements, and product training to our tax and accounting firm customers — and to influence the tools, processes, and product decisions that make that delivery better.

job.title: Principal Engineer
job.description:
Principal Engineer

CoCounsel is our most advanced AI offering to date — combining generative and agentic AI capabilities to help legal professionals move beyond prompting and start delegating. As a Principal Software Engineer focused on Security & Compliance, you will set the technical direction for how CoCounsel earns and maintains the trust of law firms, corporate legal departments, and government agencies that rely on us with privileged, sensitive, and regulated data every day. You will own the architecture and engineering practices behind our SOC 2, ISO 27001/42001, HIPAA, and FedRAMP programs, turning compliance requirements into resilient, well-instrumented systems rather than one-off audit exercises.


This role sits at the intersection of the CoCounsel Legal engineering organization and our security, privacy, and legal/compliance teams, partnering closely with platform, identity, and AI/ML engineering to deliver world-class, provably trustworthy legal AI experiences at scale.

About the role:

  • Own the compliance architecture: Understand and evolve the technical controls that satisfy the landscape of compliance; including but not limited to SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001/42001, HIPAA, and FedRAMP (Moderate/High) requirements across CoCounsel's infrastructure, data pipelines, and AI systems. Work to understand implications of new compliance and/or certifications.  Your decisions will shape how every product line proves trust to customers and auditors.
  • Build compliance as code: Look to help make the manual better, determine where point-in-time audit prep can be replaced with automated evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, and policy-as-code so that compliance state is observable and provable at any time, not just during an audit window.
  • Engineer for real production scale and sensitivity: Design encryption, key management, data residency, tenant isolation, and audit logging for systems handling millions of privileged legal documents and thousands of concurrent AI interactions from professionals doing time-sensitive work.
  • Technical leadership and cross-functional influence: Partner with Security, Legal, Privacy, and Product to translate regulatory and contractual requirements (customer security questionnaires, DPAs, government agency requirements) into engineering roadmaps. Mentor staff and senior engineers, raising the bar on secure-by-design development, threat modeling, and incident response across the org.
  • Reliability and assurance: Establish SLOs, observability, and incident response practices for compliance-critical systems, and build the internal tooling (dashboards, alerting, control testing) that gives engineering, security, and leadership real-time confidence in our control environment.

About You:

You are a fit for the position of Principal Software Engineer, Security & Compliance if your background includes:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Direct, hands-on experience building or operating production systems that achieved and maintained SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 (and/or 42001), and HIPAA compliance — not just reading about it in a policy document.
  • Experience supporting a FedRAMP authorization process (SSP development, control implementation, 3PAO assessments, or ConMon) at the Moderate or High baseline.
  • Deep backend engineering expertise (Python, Java, Go, or similar) and experience with production systems on a major cloud provider (AWS preferred), including how to implement controls natively in cloud infrastructure rather than bolt them on.
  • Working knowledge of security control frameworks such as NIST 800-53, NIST CSF, or CIS Benchmarks, and the ability to map technical implementation to specific control requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with identity and access management — authentication and authorization at scale (SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, RBAC/ABAC), encryption and key management, and audit logging.
  • Proven track record owning large, complex compliance or security initiatives end-to-end: architecture, execution, audit readiness, and long-term operation.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to partner with auditors, security, legal, product, and engineering teams in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • Experience achieving or maintaining a FedRAMP ATO with JAB or agency sponsorship, including direct interaction with 3PAOs and federal agency security teams.
  • Experience with GRC and compliance automation tooling (e.g., Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, or comparable platforms) and building custom evidence-collection pipelines where off-the-shelf tools fall short.
  • Experience in regulated industries handling sensitive data — legal, healthcare, financial services, or government.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or similar.
  • Experience building compliance and security controls for AI/LLM systems specifically — model access controls, prompt/response data handling, and safeguards around sensitive or privileged content.

job.title: Privacy Operations Analyst
job.description:
Privacy Operations Analyst 

 

Job Description 

The Privacy Operations Analyst drives the day-to-day execution of the company’s global privacy compliance program, spanning UK/EU, US, APAC, and other regions in which the business operates. This role goes beyond individual task execution to own program-level activities: coordinating data subject rights requests, running and reporting on privacy risk assessments, maintaining data mapping and records of processing activities (ROPA), and using work-management and privacy automation tooling (e.g., Azure DevOps/Jira, OneTrust, Power Automate) to scale the privacy program’s operational cadence and reporting. The role partners closely with the Privacy Operations Lead, Legal, Information Security, and business stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions. 

 

 Key Responsibilities 

Privacy Program Management & Reporting  

  • Structure and maintain privacy operations work in Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or similar work-management tools, including custom work item types and fields mapped to privacy concepts (jurisdiction, data type, risk tier).  
  • Build and maintain KPI dashboards and reporting (e.g., DSAR SLA compliance, assessment backlog age, incident response times) for privacy program leadership, using ADO Analytics, Power BI, or similar tools.  
  • Track cross-functional privacy work items that depend on Legal, Security, and Product teams, and proactively surface bottlenecks and at-risk items.  
  • Coordinate responses to data subject access requests (DSARs) and other data subject rights requests, ensuring timely resolution within statutory timelines across jurisdictions.  
  • Track and report on privacy program metrics and KPIs for leadership and relevant stakeholders.  

  

Privacy Risk Assessments  

  • Conduct and document privacy impact assessments (PIAs), data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), and transfer impact assessments (TIAs) for new products, features, and vendor engagements.  
  • Support automated assessment workflows that trigger and assign PIAs/DPIAs based on risk-based conditional logic (data type, processing purpose, jurisdiction, vendor risk tier), escalating high-risk triggers for senior review.  
  • Support efforts to reduce manual effort in assessment scoring and risk rating, applying sound judgment on what can be automated versus what must remain human-reviewed.  

  

Data Mapping & ROPA Maintenance  

  • Maintain and update the company’s records of processing activities (ROPA), tying outputs directly to data mapping and risk assessment findings.  
  • Support data discovery and data flow mapping efforts across the organization’s systems, environments, and third-party integrations, leveraging data discovery tooling where available.  
  • Support an ongoing ownership and maintenance model for the data map/ROPA, including monitoring for drift as systems or vendors change and reconciling against discovery tool outputs.  

  

Privacy Compliance & Risk Management  

  • Monitor and track changes in privacy regulations across jurisdictions, and support compliance with key regulations including UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable regimes.  
  • Support privacy incident response and breach notification processes, including incident documentation and breach register maintenance.  
  • Support privacy audits and assessments of internal processes and third-party vendors.  

  

Privacy-by-Design & Cross-Functional Collaboration  

  • Support the intake and triage of privacy-related inquiries from internal stakeholders and customers.  
  • Partner with Legal, Information Security, IT, Product, and Business teams to support the integration of privacy-by-design principles into the product development cycle.  
  • Assist with privacy training content delivery and tracking across the business.  
  • Support vendor and partner reviews to ensure contractual privacy obligations are met, and help identify current sub-processors for contractual documentation updates.  

  

Documentation & Governance  

  • Contribute to internal privacy policy, procedure, and operational playbook documentation.  
  • Maintain privacy metrics, dashboards, and reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders.  
  • Provide guidance and quality review to junior privacy operations team members on documentation and process adherence.  

  

Required Qualifications  

  • At least 4 years of experience in a privacy, compliance, legal operations, or similar role, supporting a global or multi-jurisdictional privacy program.  
  • Working knowledge of UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable global data subject rights frameworks.  
  • Hands-on experience with privacy management platforms (e.g., OneTrust, TrustArc) configuring or running DSAR, PIA/DPIA, and data mapping workflows.  
  • Experience using work-management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira) to structure and track privacy operations work, including building reporting dashboards and KPIs for leadership.  
  • Exposure to or experience with automation of privacy workflows (e.g., Power Automate, API integrations between privacy platforms and ticketing systems) to reduce manual effort in DSAR, assessment, and data mapping processes.  
  • Understanding of data discovery and data mapping tooling and techniques to keep ROPA records current and minimize drift.  
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across time zones.  
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief stakeholders on program status and risk.  

  

Preferred Qualifications  

  • CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM certification, or actively pursuing.  
  • Experience building ADO/Jira custom work item types, boards, and Power BI or analytics dashboards for privacy KPI reporting.  
  • Experience with data discovery/classification tools (e.g., OneTrust Data Discovery, BigID, Collibra).  
  • Prior experience in a shared services, global operations, or multinational organization.  
  • Familiarity with basic scripting or low-code automation (e.g., Power Automate) to support privacy workflow automation.  

#LI-HB1

What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

job.title: Senior Analyst, Compliance - Products
job.description:
Job Description

The Compliance team is accountable for managing compliance activities to ensure customer, employee, and third-party adherence to Thomson Reuters policies, third-party requirements, and regulatory obligations. Within Compliance, the Segment Compliance team gives each major business segment a named compliance owner — this role owns that mandate for Products — a horizontal segment spanning compliance-by-design work across TR’s product portfolio.


Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Segment Compliance & Assurance Partnership, this Senior Analyst will serve as the primary compliance point of contact for the Products segment. Given the breadth of the segment relative to current team capacity, this role is expected to prioritize the highest-risk products and use cases rather than attempt even coverage across everything in scope. The role also continues the misuse investigations and content-protection work that has always sat with this team, and contributes to the team’s growing partnership with Risk’s Assurance Hub — helping turn flagged signals into root-cause fixes with business partners rather than one-off reports.


This is a key position within the Legal, Risk & Compliance (LR&C) program, sitting alongside segment-aligned peers covering Legal Professionals (including Risk & Fraud), Corporates, Marketing & Comms, TAAP, and Operations & Technology. The ideal candidate combines strong product and business compliance instincts with comfort operating autonomously in a segment coverage model that is still being built out, and is energized by helping shape that model as it matures.


This position offers significant opportunity for growth as Segment Compliance's coverage model matures. The successful candidate will help define what strong compliance ownership of the Products segment looks like, build visibility with product and segment leadership, and be well-positioned for advancement into management as the model — and the candidate's role in it — scales. This role suits an experienced compliance professional who is motivated as much by building something new as by executing an established playbook.
