  • Own compliance strategy and execution for the Products segment, prioritizing the highest-risk products and use cases rather than attempting uniform coverage across every product in scope
  • Conduct misuse investigations, use-case vetting, and customer reviews within the Products segment, continuing the team’s existing content-protection and monitoring work
  • Partner with product, legal, sales, and segment leadership on regulatory compliance obligations, third-party requirements, and business policy adherence specific to assigned products
  • Support Compliance by Design work with product and engineering teams so compliance is considered at inception for new products and features, not retrofitted after launch — this is the core, horizontal focus of the Products segment
  • Contribute segment-level insight to the team’s partnership with Risk’s Assurance Hub — helping translate flagged signals into root-cause analysis and mitigation plans with business partners
  • Leverage AI tools, automation platforms, and analytics to strengthen monitoring, risk identification, and reporting for the segment
  • Lead execution of compliance policies and processes relevant to Products from design through implementation; take ownership of related third-party and internal audit requests and remediation
  • Support compliance training and employee communications related to product compliance obligations and policy updates
  • Provide litigation support and conduct legal/compliance research as needed; assist with document and contract analysis
  • Mentor junior compliance staff and contribute to team capability-building as the Segment Compliance model matures
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications
  • 5-7+ years of business, legal, or compliance experience, with demonstrated expertise in product or business compliance management and regulatory risk assessment
  • Solid working knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to enterprise and corporate customers, with the ability to quickly assess regulatory applicability and impact on a new or unfamiliar product area
  • Proven experience with Compliance by Design methodologies and early-stage product governance; track record of embedding compliance into product development and business processes
  • Comfort helping define a coverage model rather than only executing an established one — the Products segment is horizontal by nature and its ownership model is still taking shape
  • Advanced experience implementing and leveraging AI tools, automation platforms, and data analytics in compliance functions; comfort evaluating and adopting emerging compliance technology
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment on complex compliance issues; track record of working autonomously with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability and strategic alignment
  • Excellent analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to examine complex facts, perform thorough analysis, and reach sound determinations independently
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication abilities (written and verbal); proven ability to build credibility with executives and cross-functional partners and influence without direct authority
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills; proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities and deliver results under pressure
  • Strong PC skills and proficiency with Microsoft 365 (including Teams, SharePoint), SAP, and Salesforce; experience or strong familiarity with data visualization software (Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools)
  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Law, Business Administration, Public Policy, Regulatory Studies, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – NLP/LLM
job.description:
Job Description

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will build and deploy production machine learning and large language model (LLM) systems that extract actionable insights from complex legal documents and data. You will work on challenging natural language processing problems involving contractual language, information extraction, model-driven analysis, and comparisons across large collections of documents.

You will join a highly technical machine learning team and collaborate with machine learning engineers, legal subject matter experts, product engineers, and data and security partners. This is a hands-on role for someone who has personally built, trained, evaluated, and deployed machine learning models into production and wants to apply that expertise to sophisticated real-world products.

This role may be remote within the United States or hybrid from our New York City office.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, train, and deploy machine learning and LLM-based models and systems that solve complex natural language processing and document intelligence problems.
  • Develop production solutions for areas such as information extraction, text generation and summarization, AI agents, search, and document analysis.
  • Build scalable and reliable machine learning pipelines that support model training, evaluation, deployment, and ongoing production use.
  • Develop rigorous model evaluation frameworks and metrics to assess model quality, accuracy, reliability, drift, and potential bias.
  • Optimize model performance and resource utilization through experimentation, feature engineering, model selection, and tuning.
  • Translate complex business and product problems into practical machine learning solutions and take those solutions from experimentation through production deployment at scale.
  • Collaborate across machine learning, engineering, product, legal domain, data, and security teams to deliver reliable AI capabilities while protecting sensitive information.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative field with a focus on machine learning or artificial intelligence.
  • 5+ years of professional machine learning engineering, applied machine learning, research engineering, or closely related software engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building, training, and deploying machine learning models into production, including the ability to explain your individual contribution from model development through production deployment.
  • Strong practical experience with machine learning, natural language processing, and modern LLM architectures.
  • Experience with at least one of the following: information extraction, text generation/summarization, AI agents, or search.
  • Advanced Python programming skills and hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Experience developing or fine-tuning language models or other machine learning models for specialized use cases or domains.
  • Experience designing and applying model evaluation methods and metrics to measure the performance and reliability of production machine learning systems.
  • Ability to translate product or business problems into machine learning solutions and clearly communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and outcomes.
  • Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and ownership skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and domain-focused teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative field.
  • Experience deploying and operating ML or LLM systems at scale in production environments.
  • Experience with legal technology, legal natural language processing, legal document analysis, or other domain-specific language modeling.
  • Experience applying machine learning within financial services, economics, or other regulated or data-sensitive industries.
  • Experience serving or self-hosting large language models and optimizing model performance and computational efficiency.
  • Experience taking complex ML initiatives from experimentation or research through production and demonstrating measurable product or business impact.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer AI
job.description:
Job Description:


What if the AI agents you help build empower legal professionals to act with sharper judgment and greater leverage, using tools that are themselves AI-native and multiply what you and your team can ship?

Our agent platform team builds and ships using AI-native engineering practices: agentic coding tools that let a small, senior group move at a pace well beyond traditional engineering throughput. That's how this team builds the infrastructure, tooling, and observability our AI agents need to run reliably at scale, often several efforts at once. We're also in the middle of rethinking how we deploy and operate agents in production, pushing quality and safety checks earlier in the pipeline and raising our bar for release velocity and stability. As a Senior AI Engineer, you'll bring deep technical expertise to that portfolio of work, owning meaningful systems end-to-end alongside a highly capable, team building the next generation of legal AI agents.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Architect and deliver complex AI agent systems end-to-end, including multi-component pipelines, tool integrations, and multi-step reasoning, for the initiatives you own.
  • Build production AI agent systems on top of modern LLM APIs, agent SDKs, and orchestration/runtime infrastructure, integrating cleanly with existing platform services.
  • Contribute to agent observability and evaluation practices (tracing, automated evals, and quality/drift detection) so regressions in agent behavior get caught before they reach customers.
  • Adopt and extend progressive delivery practices, like feature-flagged rollout and earlier-stage quality signals, as the team raises its bar for release velocity and stability.
  • Participate in cross-cutting design reviews and technical decisions (RFCs/ADRs), bringing sound technical judgment to how new systems fit together.
  • Mentor other engineers on the team, sharing expertise and modeling how to use AI-native, agentic development practices effectively.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering peers to translate requirements into solid technical designs.

Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience architecting and shipping production software systems, including hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered products or agentic systems (not solely classical ML/data science).
  • Direct experience building with modern LLM APIs, agent frameworks/SDKs, or agent-to-tool integration protocols.
  • Experience owning complex technical projects end-to-end, from design through production delivery.
  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems design, service architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with production reliability and observability practices: monitoring, evaluation pipelines, incident response, and quality regression detection.
  • Ability to mentor other engineers and contribute to a strong technical culture.
  • Comfort working with high autonomy on a fast-moving, senior-heavy team that builds with AI-native/agentic engineering practices.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience with developer-facing platforms, plugin/extension systems, or integration ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with progressive delivery practices (feature flagging, phased rollout, blue/green deployment) at scale.
  • Experience with managed agent runtime infrastructure (e.g., AWS Bedrock AgentCore or similar).

job.title: Senior Software Engineer I
job.description:
Job Description

As a Senior Software Engineer, Customer Files Orchestration, you will design, build, scale, and operate the service that makes customer documents usable by CoCounsel Legal agents. You will work on the end-to-end processing of customer files, including upload, storage, extraction, embedding, indexing, and orchestration across distributed systems.

You will focus on developing reliable, scalable, and observable Python services on AWS and Kubernetes. The role requires hands-on expertise in distributed systems, asynchronous processing, queuing, flow control, consistency models, API design, and operational ownership. You will collaborate with engineering teams responsible for storage, extraction, indexing, connectors, and front-end experiences to deliver dependable customer file workflows.


Key Responsibilities:

In this opportunity as a Senior Software Engineer, Customer Files Orchestration, you will:

  • Own the Orchestration Service End-to-End: Design, implement, test, deploy, scale, and operate meaningful components of the customer files orchestration service.
  • Design Distributed Systems Solutions: Define and document technical designs, including decisions related to consistency, delivery guarantees, crash recovery, asynchronous service boundaries, and durable state management.
  • Build Queuing and Flow-Control Capabilities: Develop fair queuing, rate limiting, backpressure, circuit breaking, dead-letter handling, and autoscaling mechanisms to support high-volume, multi-tenant workloads.
  • Develop Reliable File Processing Workflows: Support the orchestration of file upload, storage, extraction, embedding, and indexing workflows across multiple services and processing stages.
  • Design APIs as Products: Build and maintain versioned APIs with documented behavior, backward compatibility, clear ownership, and deliberate change management.
  • Ensure Correctness at Scale: Anticipate concurrency, load, partial-failure, retry, and long-running processing scenarios, and design systems that prevent recurring classes of defects.
  • Operate What You Build: Participate in primary on-call rotations, lead incident response activities, and drive post-mortem actions that prevent repeated operational issues.
  • Improve Observability: Instrument and trace services to enable timely diagnosis of file-processing workflows, downstream notifications, and customer-impacting issues.
  • Reduce Operational Toil: Automate recurring manual work and convert undocumented operational processes into reliable, repeatable runbooks or system improvements.
  • Collaborate Across Engineering Teams: Partner with storage, extraction, indexing, connectors, and front-end teams to ensure integrated and effective file-processing experiences.
  • Mentor and Support Engineering Excellence: Contribute through code reviews, design reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Communicate Technical Trade-Offs: Clearly explain system design decisions, delivery risks, throughput considerations, and the cost of correctness to engineering and product partners.

Required Qualifications:

You're a fit for the role of Senior Software Engineer, Customer Files Orchestration if you have the following required qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience building production software and owning significant components within customer-facing systems.
  • Extensive experience with Python and AWS in production environments.
  • Experience developing and debugging concurrent Python applications, including asyncio-based workflows.
  • Understanding of Python concurrency concepts, including the Global Interpreter Lock, event loops, semaphores, worker pools, blocking operations, and background task behavior.
  • Experience running Kubernetes workloads in production environments, including event-driven autoscaling with KEDA, scaler tuning, resource requests, and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience building large-scale orchestration services or data pipelines that process high volumes of work across multiple service boundaries.
  • Practical understanding of eventual consistency, strongly consistent reads, durable state, retries, partial failures, and long-running processing workflows.
  • Experience with delivery guarantees, including at-least-once processing, exactly-once considerations, and idempotent processing.
  • Hands-on experience with queues, fair queuing, rate limiting, backpressure, multi-tenant fairness, and noisy-neighbor isolation.
  • Experience designing and maintaining APIs with versioned contracts, backward compatibility, and clear ownership.
  • Demonstrated operational ownership, including on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, and implementation of durable fixes.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals, including testing, code review, observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams and communicate technical trade-offs clearly.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with document processing or document management systems, including extraction, OCR, file format handling, large-file workflows, and third-party document management system integrations.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and streaming technologies, including Kafka, MSK, SQS, or similar managed queueing platforms.
  • Experience with durable workflow engines, such as Temporal, AWS Step Functions, or similar technologies.
  • Experience supporting retrieval, embedding, or indexing pipelines for LLM or agentic applications.
  • Prior exposure to the legal industry.
  • Experience working with Team Topologies concepts, including stream-aligned teams, platform teams, and service ownership boundaries.

#LI-FZ1

This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer- Rust / C++
job.description:
Job Description:


Thomson Reuters is hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the core of the document-processing platform behind our AI products. The platform turns very large volumes of documents, millions of pages a day, into clean, structured output through a queue-driven pipeline. It powers flagship products like Westlaw and CoCounsel and serves internal product teams across the company. The work is mostly Rust in DU Core, with regular work in the C#/.NET services (DU Apps) that sit in front of it. As a Senior Software Engineer II, you’ll lead high-impact projects across Core and Apps, shape how the platform evolves, and set the technical bar for the team.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Turn asks into requirements. Take requirements from product owners and consuming teams, and propose your own improvements. Turn them into clear functional and technical requirements: the problem, who is asking, how much traffic it affects, acceptance criteria, non-goals, and how we’ll know it worked
  • Design with explicit trade-offs. Write design docs and ADRs that include all the options considered and why the chosen solution won out. Cover cost, latency, quality, failure modes, operability and security, not just the happy path.
  • Define the architecture. Shape how our services are designed, deployed and run on Azure, and decide where the boundaries between services belong.
  • Find and fix bottlenecks. Use production metrics, profiling, latency distributions and traffic mix to find where the pipeline is slow or wasteful, and to set timeouts, limits, concurrency and rollout plans. Back decisions with benchmarks and load tests, and be clear about what the results do and don’t show.
  • Build and run the processing pipeline end to end. It’s a queue-driven pipeline that handles millions of pages per day. That means autoscaling, rate limiting, retries and failover across third-party vendors, very large inputs, and streaming with bounded memory while minimizing latency and maximizing throughput.
  • Work across Core and Apps. You’ll likely spend most of your time in the core backend Rust services, but be willing to pivot to C#/.NET to support the customer-facing services that sit in front of them.
  • Evolve contracts safely. Change message schemas, API surfaces and feature flags across services, and often across repos, in one coordinated change. Internal product teams depend on our output, so keep changes additive and backward compatible, ship with a rollout and rollback plan that covers every side, and return errors that consumers can act on.
  • Keep a strong engineering mindset. Prefer simple designs over convoluted ones, deliver in small reviewable steps, test at the right layers, and leave code better than you found it.
  • Work agentically. Write specs and plans that coding agents can carry out, break work into reviewable pieces, and check agent output with tests and evidence. Evaluate AI tools for specific use cases. You own the correctness every line you merge, whoever or whatever wrote it.
  • Improve how humans and agents work here. Evolve our agent instructions, skills and review automation so they capture what the team knows, and measure whether they help. Write code, docs and PRs clear enough that a new teammate and an AI agent can both understand the intent, constraints and invariants.
  • Own it in production. Instrument services so you can see how they behave, take part in the on-call rotation and incident response, write blameless postmortems, and turn what you learn into lasting fixes.
  • Lead high-impact work. Own the design and rollout of large projects from requirements through production, break
  • them into pieces the team can deliver, and keep the vision for where they’re headed.
  • Raise the team’s bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard in code and design review.
  • Influence direction. Translate business needs into technical solutions, explain hard trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, and shape product and platform decisions with consuming teams and leadership

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience building and operating backend services in production in Rust or C++. If your background is C++, you should be keen to work in Rust day to day.
  • Experience leading complex projects across teams, including architecture for multi-region or highly available systems.
  • Experience designing features with privacy and compliance requirements in mind, and building those requirements into code.
  • Deep distributed-systems expertise: message queues and at-least-once delivery, idempotency, backpressure, retries and timeouts, failure detection, and autoscaling.
  • Experience choosing between storage options (relational, NoSQL and others) for a given workload.
  • A record of performance work at scale: profiling, benchmarking, memory budgets, concurrency limits, and handling inputs that don’t fit in memory
  • A track record of written design work (design docs, ADRs or RFCs) that compared options and drove a decision, and of turning ambiguous asks into scoped, testable requirements.
  • Excellent software development fundamentals: testing strategy across unit, integration and load, security-conscious defaults, and incremental delivery through CI/CD.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers, and strong code-review and technical-writing skills.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot).
  • Ownership mindset: you follow your work into production, lead root-cause analysis, and fix what you find
  • Willingness to join the team’s on-call rotation.
  • Willingness to work in C#/.NET, and to learn it if you don’t already know it.
  • Must be located in the United States.
  • Must be a U.S. Person and legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visasponsorship.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Professional experience with Rust: async (Tokio), errors modeled as types, and performance and memory tuning.
  • Daily, critical use of AI coding agents, including knowing when not to trust their output.
  • Experience building or improving developer tooling for AI agents: prompts and skills, MCP servers, multi-agent review, or evaluation of agent output.
  • Experience with document AI, OCR or file processing, such as PDF internals, format conversion or very large inputs.
  • Experience integrating several third-party vendors behind one abstraction, with health-based routing or failover.
  • Cloud and container platform experience (Azure preferred), including Kubernetes autoscaling and multi-region deployment.
  • Professional experience with C#/.NET.
  • Experience in regulated environments, such as FedRAMP, HIPAA, CJIS, FIPS 140 cryptography, or supply-chain controls like SBOMs and dependency bans.

#LI-SM2


 

 

What’s in it For You?

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. job.title: Staff Platform Engineer - Materia AI
job.description:
Job Description


Staff Platform Engineer- Materia AI


Are you excited about building cloud-native platforms that power Agentic workloads? Join a dynamic and highly skilled team at Thomson Reuters, where we combine the agility and innovation of a startup with the stability and resources of a global leader. 
As a Platform Engineer, you will contribute to leading the design, development, and evolution of our next-generation cloud-native platforms. You will contribute to technical strategy, champion engineering excellence, and build highly scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure that empowers our product development teams. 
You will be a hands-on technical leader, influencing architectural decisions, mentoring team members, and championing best practices in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities:


In this opportunity as a Staff Platform Engineer- Materia AI you will:

  • Innovate with Startup Speed and Enterprise Scale: Be part of a team that maintains the innovation velocity of a startup while leveraging the operational maturity of a global enterprise. You'll work with top AI and software development experts, building intelligent and scalable systems for accounting professionals. This role is for the CoCounsel for Tax and Accounting team, evolved from the acquisition of Materia, now integrating best-in-class enterprise practices with rapid innovation cycles. 
  • Deliver AI-Driven Systems: Launch backend services into production that power generative AI agents and orchestration systems. This role requires both creativity and rigor to ensure our AI-driven solutions are secure, performant, reliable, and adaptable to real-world use cases. 
  • Collaborate Across Functions: Work closely with AI/ML engineers, frontend developers, product managers, and SREs to build robust services and developer experiences. Help to build out AI native products for tax, accounting, and audit professionals. 
  • Developer Enablement: Build and maintain "golden path" reference implementations for automated build, test, and deploy workflows that development teams can adopt and customize. 
  • Design, implement, and manage reference CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Playwright, and Snyk. 
  • Develop Go command-line tools and services that streamline and empower developer workflows, from local development to production deployment. 
  • Establish, measure, and continuously improve DORA metrics, for example deployment frequency, change failure rate to optimize the velocity and quality of product delivery. 
  • Production Engineering: Lead the design and implementation of scalable, resilient, secure, and cost-effective production infrastructure using Kubernetes, Vercel, AWS, GCP, and AI platforms. 
  • Establish and enforce platform security best practices using multi-cloud strategies and open-source CNCF solutions, integrating with cloud-native security tools and Thomson Reuters internal infrastructure. 
  • Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools such as DataDog and LLM observability tools. 
  • Collaboration and Leadership: Set up the necessary processes and documentation to support a team of 150+ product managers, researchers, and engineers.  Align with product, development, and operations teams on business objectives. 
  • Foster a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement, exploring new AI technologies and methodologies. 
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in cloud computing, platform engineering, and site reliability engineering, advocating for their adoption where appropriate. 

Required Qualifications:
You’re a fit for the role of Staff Platform Engineer- Materia AI ​if your background includes: 

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in backend development, platform engineering, production engineering, or site reliability engineering (SRE). 
  • Software Development: Experience developing, deploying, and maintaining a backend service and associated client interface for the benefit of other product and engineering staff developing products for customers. 
  • Problem Solving: Deep experience troubleshooting low level DNS, TCP, IP, and TLS protocols.  Creative problem solver who enjoys exploring new technologies.

  • Curiosity: Eager to explore and understand emerging agentic software paradigms. 
  • Quality: Dedicated to building high-quality, reliable platform systems. 
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, related field, or equivalent experience 


Preferred qualifications:

  • Fluent in Go, Python, Rust, or another systems level language. 
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Terraform and CUE.  
  • Experience with AI-driven systems, agent-based architectures, LLM evaluation tools, and AI APIs from providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. 
  • Experience owning SOC 2 compliant systems end to end. 
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, or search-based AI. 
  • Strong opinions on infrastructure design, end to end testing strategies, automation, middleware, and RPC/REST API designs patterns.

job.description:
Job Description


Are you passionate about transforming the future of legal research with AI? Join our Global Westlaw Engineering organization and help shape the next generation of intelligent legal research solutions.

The Global Westlaw Engineering organization builds and operates the technology that powers Westlaw, the world's leading legal research platform. Our teams develop innovative products and AI-driven solutions that help legal professionals find trusted answers, uncover insights, and make confident decisions faster. Working across engineering, AI, data, platform, and product disciplines, we deliver secure, scalable, and intelligent experiences for customers around the globe.


As an AI Staff Engineer, you will help define and build the AI foundation that powers the next generation of Westlaw experiences. You will work on cutting-edge technologies including agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI platforms, and large-scale knowledge services, enabling teams across Westlaw to deliver intelligent, trustworthy, and high-performing solutions for legal professionals worldwide.


Key Responsibilities


  • Build and architect AI-driven systems – Design and lead the implementation of enterprise-scale AI systems, including multi-component pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge graph–based architectures, and autonomous AI agents with multi-step reasoning; stay hands-on across the stack, from AI orchestration and RAG through API gateways, microservices, and modern web UIs.
  • Drive innovation and technical strategy – Evaluate and drive adoption of emerging AI techniques; run proof-of-concept work and assess technical feasibility for new AI-driven features; stay current with AI research and translate insights into technical roadmaps; represent the organization at industry conferences and events.
  • Provide technical leadership – Help make design decisions and translate business requirements into scalable technical specifications; mentor senior and junior software engineers; champion MLOps and LLMOps practices and governance for the AI model lifecycle.
  • Ensure quality, security, and operational excellence – Design and implement testing, monitoring, and observability for AI systems at scale; ensure compliance with ethical AI principles, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration and drive business value delivery – Partner with AI researchers, engineering leadership, design, and product to turn AI capabilities into customer-facing applications; set technical priorities and stay engaged through delivery so AI investments produce measurable business value; optimize performance for latency, cost, and user experience; influence product strategy through technical depth.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience (Master’s preferred).
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 3 years in senior or lead roles on AI/ML systems.
  • A track record as a software engineer with AI expertise (not primarily a data scientist or researcher), with hands-on experience in generative AI, RAG, or LLM-based systems, covering discovery, architecture, agentic tools, evaluation, deployment, and metrics.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python or another object-oriented language, with strong backend service and API design skills.
  • Solid understanding of ML principles, evaluation methodologies, and distributed systems, plus working experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Advanced experience with AWS and with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, and a record of integrating AI models into large-scale production systems through APIs, data pipelines, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong technical leadership and mentoring experience as an individual contributor, with the communication skills to influence senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience leading technical direction for teams building agent-based systems or enterprise integrations with AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).
  • Advanced knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and information retrieval.
  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs, including graph data modeling, ontologies and taxonomies, graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune), and combining graphs with LLMs through approaches such as GraphRAG and entity extraction.
  • Domain expertise in legal, tax, accounting, or other regulated industries, or in large-scale search platforms.
  • Successful AI product launches and experience scaling AI systems to enterprise customers.
  • Experience with AI governance, model risk management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Publications, patents, or speaking experience in AI/ML.Jon

Tax & Accounting Specialist Editor


Job Description:

We are seeking a passionate tax professional who thrives on the complexity and intricacy of tax advisory work. The ideal candidate is a lifelong learner with an insatiable curiosity about tax law and its practical applications to customers. They are excited about staying at the forefront of tax developments and eager to contribute to shaping the future of tax research and advisory services.


This role presents a unique opportunity for experienced CPAs and tax attorneys to join an elite team of tax specialists. Our mission is to transform the tax advisory profession and support our customers' success year-round, equipping them to be strategic business partners to their clients. As a Tax Editor, you will have the chance to create industry-leading content and make a significant impact on the tax advisory profession. You will also leverage advanced technologies such as AI and LLMs to enhance content delivery and research methodologies.


If you are a forward-thinking tax professional who combines deep technical expertise with strong communication skills and a drive for innovation, we want to hear from you. Join us in our mission to provide trusted answers, insights, and solutions to our Checkpoint customers!


Key Responsibilities: 

In this opportunity, you will:

  • Create and maintain comprehensive, value-added tax advisory and compliance content that enhances Checkpoint’s competitive edge and addresses the evolving needs of tax practitioners.
  • Monitor, analyze, and report on new tax developments, legislation, and IRS guidance, translating complex information into clear, actionable insights for tax advisors.
  • Manage relationships with industry experts, edit their contributions, and ensure the highest quality standards are met.
  • Collaborate with internal and external teams to support strategic programs and initiatives related to artificial intelligence and tax advisory solutions.  
  • Provide subject matter expertise, including in the testing and validation of technology solutions for tax advisory.  
  • Provide feedback on our tax and accounting AI solutions ongoing performance to our team of engineers and data scientists.

  • Minimum of 7 years of focused experience in tax advisory and compliance

job.description:
Job Description

As a Tech Customer Success Manager - Mid Level, Reuters Imagen, you will own the operational relationship for a portfolio of client accounts from kickoff through renewal. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, supporting platform adoption, utilization, delivery, project management, and day-to-day client communications.

You will work as part of a cross-functional account team to guide clients through implementations, training, user acceptance testing, go-live, ongoing operations, renewals, and expansion opportunities. The role requires strong project-management capabilities, technical aptitude, and the ability to build effective relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You will develop strong knowledge of the Imagen platform, including front-end user experience and administrative configuration, and collaborate with Account Management, DevOps, Delivery Engineering, Technical Pre-sales, Service Engineering, Product, Engineering, Commercial, and other internal teams to support client outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a Tech Customer Success Manager - Mid Level, Reuters Imagen, you will:

  • Own Customer Relationships: Serve as the named owner and primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of accounts, covering customer success, delivery, project management, and day-to-day client communications.
  • Drive Platform Adoption and Utilization: Support client adoption through training, enablement, proactive engagement, and guidance on platform capabilities.
  • Develop Account Success Plans: Create and maintain current success plans that document client goals, adoption status, risks, and next actions.
  • Monitor Account Health: Track account health and engagement patterns, identifying and addressing potential issues before escalation.
  • Manage Client Implementations: Own delivery execution from kickoff through go-live and ongoing operations for new client implementations, as well as expansion or upsell-related implementation work for existing accounts.
  • Plan and Coordinate Project Delivery: Define scope, goals, and deliverables using the Statement of Work as the scope-management tool. Manage timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and communications across concurrent deliveries.
  • Coordinate Cross-Functional Delivery: Track work items in Azure DevOps, coordinate with DevOps and Delivery Engineering, and manage budget and financial objectives.
  • Lead Client-Facing Delivery Activities: Run client kickoffs, user acceptance testing, training, and go-live support.
  • Build Platform Knowledge: Develop and maintain working knowledge of the Imagen platform, including front-end user experience, metadata schemas, workflows, access controls, user administration, and administrative configuration.
  • Provide Configuration Guidance: Guide customers toward configuration-based solutions that support long-term platform needs. Identify situations that require specialist support and engage Technical Pre-sales, Service Engineering, or Product as appropriate.
  • Support Retention and Commercial Opportunities: Monitor account health and usage data to identify renewal risks. Provide Account Managers with relevant context and recommended approaches ahead of renewals.
  • Identify Expansion Opportunities: Recognize expansion signals across the assigned portfolio and provide Account Managers with sufficient supporting information to act.
  • Conduct Account Audits: Complete annual account audits, documenting platform health, usage gaps, and opportunities, and routing findings to the appropriate internal team.
  • Represent Customer Feedback: Collect and share customer feedback with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams.
  • Maintain Accurate Account Records: Keep account records, success plans, and engagement history current in Salesforce.
  • Contribute to Operational Excellence: Share platform guidance, best practices, and lessons learned with the team. Use AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of research, client communications, and routine tasks.

Required Qualifications

You're a fit for the role of Tech Customer Success Manager - Mid Level, Reuters Imagen if you have the following required qualifications:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or client-facing delivery within B2B SaaS or technology environments.
  • Strong project-management skills, including stakeholder management, task coordination, dependency management, governance, risk management, and communications across concurrent deliveries.
  • Technical aptitude to understand system configuration, API integrations, and cloud-infrastructure concepts, as well as troubleshoot basic issues independently.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver training and technical enablement to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Azure DevOps or Jira, and Monday.com.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, cross-time-zone environment.
  • Fluent professional English, written and verbal.
  • Proven experience using AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot, for research, communications, and workflow efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience owning software implementation or integration projects end to end, including migrations and third-party integrations.
  • Background in sports, media, broadcast, or content management.
  • Familiarity with media asset management (MAM), digital asset management (DAM), video-workflow technologies, metadata standards, and content delivery.
  • Understanding of cloud-hosting environments, including AWS and Azure; single sign-on (SSO); access-control models; and API-integration patterns.
  • Experience working in a Microsoft 365 environment, including SharePoint, Power BI, Power Automate, and other standard business tools.

job.description:
Account Executive 

*Non-Remote, In-Person Opportunity. * 

 

The Opportunity: 

Townsquare Media is looking for a bright, confident, driven individual to join our multimedia advertising sales team in Bozeman Montana.  Townsquare Media Bozeman is an industry leader in digital advertising and an accredited marketing partner of both Google and Meta as well as home to five top radio stations.   

 

At Townsquare Media Bozeman, we are a team of ambitious individuals who work together to push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally. You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and an unlimited earning potential! 

 

If you’re ready to embark upon an exciting career that affords you the opportunity to form meaningful client relationships, develop creative advertising campaigns using our best-in-class multimedia solutions, all while having your finger on the pulse of Southwest Montana…then we want to hear from you!  

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Identify, pursue, and schedule meetings with local business owners and decision makers to discuss and uncover their marketing needs and challenges 
  • Use our proprietary data, analytics, and multimedia marketing solutions to build, present, and sell customized advertising plans to potential clients  
  • Build, maintain and develop close working relationships with your clients to identify and upsell new advertising solutions 
  • Use your influence and relationship-building skills to provide ongoing customer service, research, and market analysis 
  • You will be responsible for bringing our premier marketing and advertising solutions to local and regional businesses in the Bozeman area and beyond 
  • You will work with and sell integrated advertising solutions including broadcast radio, LIVE event sponsorships and digital including website design, SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Social, Streaming TV and much more 

 

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 1+ year of sales or marketing experience (preferred) 
  • Strong marketing and advertising acumen 
  • Effective verbal and written communications are essential 
  • Experience selling or a working knowledge of digital advertising solutions preferred 
  • Goal-oriented, strong work ethic and a desire to learn and grow a career in Sales 
  • A passion towards customer focused solution sales 
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required) 
  • BA/BS degree (preferred) 

 

What’s In It for You? 

  • Competitive compensation package with UNCAPPED earning potential  
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days) 
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community 
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance 
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
  • Company-provided laptop 
  • Casual, high-energy, supportive, and collaborative work environment 
  • 4-week long sales training program  
  • Unlimited growth opportunities!  

 

Why Townsquare Media Group? 

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions, and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing websites, search engine optimization, social platforms, and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps along with a network of national music/content brands.

job.title: Business Development Representative
job.description:
Business Development Representative

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

This Isn't Another Sales Job. It's Your Chance to Build Something Bigger.

Let's be honest—there are thousands of sales jobs.
Most ask you to sell one product. Make cold calls. Hit a quota. Repeat.
This isn't one of them.

At Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you'll help shape the success of local businesses while representing some of the most recognized brands in West Michigan. You'll have the backing of a company that combines the power of market-leading radio stations, streaming audio, live events, streaming TV, websites, social media, search marketing, programmatic advertising, SEO, websites, and cutting-edge digital solutions—all under one roof.

Every day is different. Every client is different. Every success story is yours to create.

If you're energized by competition, love solving business challenges, and want unlimited earning potential while working alongside an exceptional team, we'd love to meet you.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare Media is one of America's largest and most innovative local media companies, operating 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets nationwide.

In Grand Rapids, we're more than a media company—we're woven into the fabric of the community. Our brands entertain, inform, and connect hundreds of thousands of people every week while helping businesses grow through powerful, measurable marketing solutions.

Our clients don't hire us to buy advertising.
They partner with us to grow their businesses.
That's where you come in.

 

What You’ll Do:

You'll become a trusted marketing advisor to local business owners and decision-makers, helping them navigate today's rapidly evolving media landscape.
You'll work with entrepreneurs, CEOs, marketing directors, nonprofits, and community leaders to develop customized marketing strategies that deliver real business results.

Every day you'll:

  • Build new relationships with businesses throughout West Michigan
  • Create strategic marketing plans using radio, streaming audio, streaming TV, websites, social media, SEO, search marketing, programmatic advertising, events, and more
  • Present creative ideas that help clients grow revenue and strengthen their brands
  • Negotiate and close new business
  • Collaborate with creative, digital, programming, and leadership teams to bring campaigns to life
  • Become a respected business resource within the community

No two days look alike—and that's exactly what makes this role exciting.

 

Who Thrives Here?

Our best Account Executives are naturally curious, highly competitive, resilient, and genuinely enjoy helping people succeed.
They don't see themselves as salespeople.
They see themselves as consultants, entrepreneurs, and problem-solvers.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Love building relationships
  • Enjoy winning new business
  • Are energized by goals and competition
  • Take pride in delivering exceptional client service
  • Want to continue learning in one of the fastest-changing industries in business
  • Believe your income should reflect your performance

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
  • Confidence prospecting and developing new business opportunities
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Uncapped earning potential with a competitive compensation plan
  • Comprehensive onboarding and industry-leading sales training
  • Continuous coaching from experienced local leadership
  • Career advancement opportunities within one of America's leading media companies
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop

 

More Than a Job. Build your future. Build your community. Build something extraordinary—with Townsquare Media Grand Rapids.

When you join Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you're joining a team that celebrates big wins, supports one another, embraces innovation, and believes local businesses deserve world-class marketing.
You'll help launch new ideas, work with recognizable brands, attend exciting community events, collaborate with talented teammates, and build a career where your effort directly impacts your success.
If you're looking for a place where your ambition is rewarded, your ideas matter, and no two days are ever the same, we'd love to talk.

job.title: Digital Sales Manager
job.description:
Digital Sales Manager

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Why Townsquare Media Group & Townsquare Ignite:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets, including trusted Tuscaloosa Stations..

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

Founded in 2010, Townsquare Ignite is the fastest-growing revenue and profit driver of Townsquare Media, offering a powerful suite of digital solutions that includes owned and operated digital properties, a proprietary programmatic advertising platform, and an in-house demand and data management platform powered by first-party data. Our all-in-one 360° advertising technology and DSP-agnostic trade desk provide access to all major ad exchanges and more than 250 billion impressions per day. Campaigns run across desktop, mobile, apps, connected TV, search, and social—supported by advanced targeting, white-glove service, and a full-service in-house creative team—giving sellers the tools, scale, and support to win and grow digital business.

 

The Digital Sales Manager Opportunity:

Do you love helping businesses grow through modern, results-driven marketing? Are you a sales leader who thrives in digital and knows how to elevate teams through strategy, coaching, and execution? This is a rare opportunity to lead a local market as a Digital Sales Manager, owning digital revenue growth while also leading and supporting broadcast sales performance.

 

At Townsquare, we are redefining local media by combining the power of trusted radio brands with industry-leading digital marketing solutions. We’re looking for a hands-on leader with deep digital sales expertise to accelerate growth across Townsquare Ignite and Amped (digital on our owned and operated properties), while maintaining strong broadcast fundamentals.

 

The Digital Sales Manager serves as the senior revenue leader for the market, responsible for driving total market performance with a digital-first mindset. This role blends digital strategy, team leadership, and client-facing sales execution. You will act as the market’s digital authority—guiding sellers, partnering with clients, and leading complex, integrated deals—while also overseeing broadcast sales activity.

 

Responsibilities:

Digital & Revenue Leadership

  • Own and drive digital revenue growth for the market, with a strong emphasis on Townsquare Ignite and Amped solutions
  • Develop and execute a digital-forward sales strategy that aligns broadcast and digital into integrated, results-based programs
  • Set, track, and hold the team accountable to digital and total revenue goals, pipeline activity, and KPIs
  • Lead by example in selling complex digital and integrated campaigns, assisting Account Executives with high-impact opportunities
  • Drive new business development while expanding and retaining key accounts

Digital Strategy & Expertise

  • Serve as the digital subject matter expert for the market
  • Lead adoption and mastery of full-funnel digital solutions including Programmatic, Search, Social, Video, OTT/CTV, and Owned & Operated digital
  • Analyze campaign performance and reporting to guide optimization, renewals, and incremental revenue growth
  • Translate performance data into clear, compelling insights for clients and sellers

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, retain, and develop top-performing sales talent
  • Coach and train new and existing Account Executives on consultative selling, digital strategy, and solution-based presentations
  • Maintain a strong in-field presence, participating in client and prospect meetings alongside sellers
  • Set and enforce daily, weekly, and monthly activity, pipeline, and performance standards

Market & Community Leadership

  • Represent Townsquare as a trusted marketing partner to key clients, agencies, and community stakeholders
  • Monitor competitive activity and evolving market trends to identify growth opportunities
  • Act as a key member of the local leadership team

 

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of sales management experience in digital and/or broadcast media
  • Extensive experience selling digital marketing solutions including Programmatic, Search, Social, Video, and OTT/CTV
  • Proven track record of driving digital revenue growth and exceeding sales targets
  • Strong understanding of full-funnel digital marketing strategies and performance metrics
  • Experience setting, tracking, and enforcing sales KPIs and revenue goals
  • Demonstrated success in consultative selling and complex deal execution
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and proposal development skills
  • Radio or broadcast experience is a plus, but not required
  • Website and owned-and-operated digital sales experience a plus
  • Valid Driver’s License and insurance

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive base plus performance-based bonus 
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Company discounts, pet insurance, and volunteer time off
  • Strong career growth opportunities within Townsquare Media

job.title: Director of Digital & Radio Content - Fort Collins
job.description:
Director of Digital & Radio Content – Fort Collins

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Where Creative Leadership Meets Local Impact:

Are you a strategic, people-first content leader with a passion for building winning brands and developing top-tier talent? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re looking for a Director of Digital & Radio Content to lead our MARKET market—overseeing strong local brands and driving audience growth across on-air, digital, social, and live platforms.

This is a full-time, in-office leadership role working closely and collaboratively with a talented local team. You’ll set the vision for local content, coach and develop market-leading talent, and play a hands-on role in creating compelling, clickable, and shareable content that resonates with the local community—while partnering closely with sales and leadership to drive revenue and impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Fort Collins stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital & Radio Content for Fort Collins, you’ll provide leadership, strategy, and creative direction for our local brands—ensuring excellence across on-air, online, and on-site experiences. This role blends high-level strategy with hands-on leadership and content creation. You will:

  • Establish and execute a clear, competitive vision for local content while maintaining ownership of the overall sound, content strategy, and brand execution across all stations to drive audience growth, market leadership, and business results.
  • Lead from the front as an active influencer, content creator, and brand ambassador, setting the standard for audience engagement while coaching team members to build meaningful connections across on-air, digital, social, and live platforms.
  • Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing on-air, digital, and production talent, fostering a positive, collaborative, high-performance culture that drives market-leading results across all brands.
  • Partner closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to develop compelling, revenue-generating content, sponsorships, promotions, features, and events, creating innovative marketing solutions for clients while ensuring alignment across programming, sales, production, and market leadership.
  • Develop innovative, multi-platform content strategies that build highly engaged audience communities, drive ratings and digital growth, cultivate strong relationships throughout the market, and create revenue-generating partnerships across all channels.
  • Host a live, engaging on-air show on a regular, ongoing basis, preparing daily content that entertains, informs, and connects with the target audience
  • Create and publish a minimum of two original local articles per day for the station website and mobile app
  • Create and oversee compelling local content and digital storytelling across websites, mobile platforms, and social channels
  • Design and execute programming clocks, music strategy, and tactical plans to grow time spent listening, audience occasions, and digital reach
  • Oversee sound design, station imaging, and audio architecture—keeping content fresh, creative, and impactful
  • Creating and publishing original video content regularly, including social-first short-form video (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer-form segments that grow your personal on-screen brand
  • Prospecting and developing endorsement and influencer partnerships with local businesses, pitching yourself as a trusted community voice who can authentically promote products and services across on-air, video, and social platforms
  • Participating in person in high-visibility community events, client meetings, and business functions as a station ambassador who builds relationships that translate into revenue

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Demonstrated success as a content leader with strong people management skills
  • 3+ years of management experience
  • Strategic mindset with a strong understanding of industry trends and audience behavior
  • On-air programming experience with deep knowledge of content creation and curation
  • Strong writing, communication, and storytelling skills across platforms
  • Familiarity with a wide range of digital assets, tools, and publishing workflows
  • Proven ability to lead in competitive markets and drive measurable results
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect content strategy to revenue outcomes
  • Sound judgment, creativity, and a strong desire to win
  • High School Diploma (required)
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know leadership roles come with high expectations—and we back that up with meaningful rewards:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance

job.title: Director of Digital News & Audience – New Jersey 101.5
job.description:
Director of Digital News & Audience – New Jersey 101.5

* This is a full-time, in-office position in Trenton that involves working closely and collaboratively with our New Jersey content teams. * 

 

Lead the Next Evolution of Digital News & Audience Growth

Are you a sharp editor, strategic digital thinker, and hands-on content creator who understands how great stories find audiences today? At Townsquare Media – New Jersey, we’re looking for a Director of Digital News & Audience to help lead the digital evolution of New Jersey 101.5, while serving as a digital content resource for our other brands across New Jersey.

This is a digital-first, hands-on content leadership role at the intersection of journalism, content, audience, and growth. You’ll work alongside our journalists, personalities, producers, and content teams to create compelling original content, strengthen the stories we’re already telling, and expand their reach across web, social, video, apps, newsletters, and emerging platforms.

You don’t need to come from radio. Your experience may be in a digital newsroom, social or video team, local media company, creator-led organization, or another digital-first environment. What matters most is that you understand great storytelling, strong journalism, and how audiences discover, consume, and share content across platforms.

And this isn’t a role that manages from the sidelines. You’ll write, edit, publish, produce, package, analyze, and create content yourself, while helping talented people around you make their work even stronger.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted New Jersey stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital News & Audience, you’ll help shape our digital content strategy while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution. You’ll serve as both a leader and a hands-on editor, helping shape the digital voice of our local brands. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading digital news and content strategy for New Jersey 101.5, helping identify, develop, and execute compelling original and breaking-news coverage across platforms
  • Creating, editing, publishing, and packaging content across websites, apps, social media, video, newsletters, and other digital channels
  • Partnering with journalists, on-air personalities, producers, and creators to turn strong ideas and existing content into platform-specific digital experiences
  • Elevating our social and video storytelling, including platform-native hooks, headlines, captions, thumbnails, pacing, formats, and creative approaches for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms
  • Coaching and collaborating with content teams on digital storytelling, SEO, audience development, social strategy, and evolving best practices
  • Using audience and content analytics to understand performance, identify opportunities, test new ideas, and make data-informed editorial decisions
  • Expanding content distribution through SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and other audience-growth channels
  • Supporting day-to-day news priorities and coordination while balancing breaking news, daily content production, and longer-term audience-growth initiatives
  • Serving as a digital content resource across our New Jersey brands, helping teams capitalize on strong stories and audience opportunities
  • Exploring new platforms, technologies, and AI-assisted content and workflow tools to improve efficiency and creativity while maintaining strong editorial standards and human judgment

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital journalism, digital media, audience development, social/video content, online publishing, or a related content environment
  • A proven track record of creating digital content that earns and grows an audience
  • Exceptional writing, editing, story-framing, and headline-writing skills
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to make smart, responsible decisions quickly, particularly during breaking or developing news
  • Deep familiarity with Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, including platform-specific formats, audience behavior, discovery, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of social and short-form video storytelling, including hooks, pacing, captions, thumbnails, titles, and vertical video
  • Hands-on experience creating, editing, publishing, and packaging digital content—not simply directing others
  • Experience using analytics and performance data to identify opportunities and turn insights into actionable content decisions
  • Strong understanding of SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and digital audience development
  • Experience collaborating with and coaching reporters, writers, personalities, producers, or other content creators
  • Strong organizational, communication, and project-management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms, social publishing tools, analytics platforms, and digital/video production workflows
  • Curiosity about emerging platforms, creator trends, changing audience behaviors, and new technologies
  • Knowledge of New Jersey—its communities, culture, issues, and personalities—is a major plus
  • High School Diploma (required); college coursework or BA/BS degree (preferred)

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with great instincts, curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward action. You should be excited to experiment, pay close attention to what audiences are telling us through performance and engagement, and turn those insights into action. Just as importantly, you’ll be a collaborative, positive teammate who makes the people around you better.

 

What’s In It for You?

We offer a supportive environment where creativity and growth are encouraged:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunities for upward mobility within a growing media organization
  • Company discounts
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • And much more…

job.title: Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting
job.description:
Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting

*This is a remote position that requires you to work closely and collaboratively with internal teams.*

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital and broadcast media and digital marketing solutions company principally focused on markets outside the top 50 in the U.S. Our assets include 340 radio stations across 74 local markets, more than 400 local news and entertainment websites and mobile apps, a subscription digital marketing services business (Townsquare Interactive) and a digital advertising division (Townsquare Ignite).

 

About the Opportunity:

The Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting owns Townsquare’s external reporting and technical accounting and is a key member of the accounting leadership team.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and own SEC filings, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K (including earnings releases), and the related financial statements, footnotes and MD&A.
  • Coordinate with Investor Relations on all financial aspects of the earnings release, conference call script and materials posted to the Company’s website, including non-GAAP measures and reconciliations in compliance with Regulation G and Item 10(e) of Regulation S-K.
  • Support Legal Counsel in preparing the proxy statement (including executive compensation disclosures) and Section 16 filings (Forms 3, 4 and 5), as needed.
  • Stay current on new and proposed SEC rules, FASB standards and SEC comment letter trends; assess their impact and ensure the Company is prepared for new reporting requirements.
  • Own the SEC reporting process, including the Financial Reporting SOX narrative and the design and timely, effective operation of key controls; partner with the Director of Internal Audit on SOX walk-throughs and testing.
  • Own inline XBRL tagging and compliance.
  • Prepare and review disclosure checklists.
  • Complete quarterly and annual lender reporting under the credit agreement, including covenant compliance calculations and delivery of financial results.
  • Lead the application of accounting standards for the Company, including documentation, resolution of issues and implementation of process changes, particularly revenue recognition (ASC 606), goodwill and FCC license impairment testing (ASC 350), business combinations and dispositions (ASC 805), leases (ASC 842) and segment reporting (ASC 280).
  • Prepare technical accounting memos on complex and non-routine transactions, and review position papers prepared by others.
  • Coordinate with Finance, HR and Legal to maintain equity award records and calculate stock-based compensation expense.
  • Drive continuous process improvement and automation of reporting and close tasks, including appropriate use of analytics and AI tools.
  • Serve as the day-to-day contact with the external auditors for quarterly reviews and the annual integrated audit.
  • Prepare Audit Committee materials on accounting, reporting and control matters, and present to the Audit Committee as needed.
  • Coordinate with Tax on income tax provision (ASC 740) disclosures.
  • Review the quarterly consolidation, segment results and statement of cash flows.
  • Build, supervise and develop a team of reporting and technical accounting professionals.

 

Qualifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

Education & Experience:

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting (Big 4 or national firm preferred) and either at least three years of SEC reporting at a public registrant or equivalent experience auditing public companies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; active CPA license required.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and SEC rules (Regulation S-X and S-K).
  • Experience supervising and developing staff; month-end close experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong written communication skills and the judgment to present to senior management and the Audit Committee.

 

Computer Skills:

  • Advanced Excel required (Power Query, pivot tables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, building and auditing complex models).
  • Hands-on experience with Workiva or similar reporting software, including inline XBRL tagging, strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics GP and IBM Planning Analytics (TM1/Cognos), or comparable ERP and planning systems, preferred. Working knowledge of SQL a plus.
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) for research, drafting and automation, consistent with Company policy, a plus.
  • Proficiency in Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive base salary
  • 3 weeks PTO
  • 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal/floating holidays)
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Pet Insurance
  • 401(K) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Comprehensive training and growth opportunities
  • Unlimited growth potential in a dynamic work environment
