job.title: Sr. Program Manager
job.description:
Senior Program Manager 

Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business—not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to join Translation. This is a hybrid role based out of our Brooklyn office (4 days in office).

What You'll Do

As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll own internal program coordination across assigned work and be a key driver of both operational excellence and program delivery. You will lead integrated campaigns and ensure we deliver groundbreaking work that meets our clients’ objectives and propels agency growth. You’ll blend strategic thinking with sharp project management and a strong sense of ownership, overseeing teams and guiding work from scope through execution while managing the health (budget, scope, team design) of your projects. The Sr. Program Manager reports to the Program Director (or Group Program Director) and will manage Associates and/or Managers. The Sr. PM partners with the Business Supervisor or Business Director to run most Tier 1 or 2 projects. 

Responsibilities

  • Oversee day-to-day program coordination and delivery of assigned projects, ensuring internal teams are aligned and work meets client expectations.
  • Drive the end-to-end process for integrated campaigns (film, experiential, digital/social, OOH), ensuring seamless delivery on time and on budget by developing and tracking tactical plans to develop each with a keen understanding of client parameters and objectives. Work with junior team members to create and manage all tactical schedules
  • Partner with Business Leadership counterpart to develop all scope proposals for assigned projects, developing a compelling proposal as well as profitable approach for the agency
  • Provide strong financial management of assigned accounts including managing all budget allocations, reviewing burn, proactively creating scope change orders (internal and external), proactively suggesting areas for optimization and macro view of out-of-pocket budget tracking
  • Lead all reporting and reconciliation processes in partnership with finance team 
  • Help digest all client feedback and lead the team on how we address and action the feedback. Understand and mentor teams on where/when to escalate creative feedback or work reviews to senior leadership 
  • Build and nurture strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor who understands how to get things done effectively and efficiently leveraging our teams and resources to create innovative and breakthrough creative solutions that solve clients business objectives 
  • Manage and mentor junior program managers, strategically deploying them across projects and fostering their professional growth.
  • Collaborate with department leads (account, production, creative, strategy) to assemble the right teams for each initiative, confirm the right allocations and manage overall workforce planning with Resource Management lead
  • Work closely with production to ensure timelines accommodate production requirements and projects continue to move seamlessly in execution 
  • Support the Business Lead and Production teams during executional and production phases of creative work to ensure absolute clarity client & media requirements, provide tactical support during production and oversee the successful delivery/traffic assets when required 
  • Partner with Creative, Production, and Business teams to turn campaign ideas into actionable plans, ensuring timelines, budgets, and deliverables stay on track without compromising creative ambition.
  • Manage and monitor production and creative workflows, proactively identifying risks and driving solutions to keep projects moving smoothly.
  • Foster clear, integrated ways of working by aligning teams on roles, processes, and communication throughout the creative and production lifecycle.
  • Proactively identify potential issues or opportunities, keeping teams and clients informed and driving swift, effective solutions.
  • Oversee the creation of presentation materials that uphold agency standards and resonate with clients’ business objectives.
  • Participate in new business efforts, contributing to proposals, pitches, and strategic planning to showcase our operational strengths and capabilities
  • Champion a positive, collaborative environment that values diverse perspectives, accountability, and a shared passion for producing culturally powerful work.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and “off-script” navigation skills, with the confidence to lead and adapt in dynamic situations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex ideas clearly, accurately, and persuasively.
  • Deeply proactive, hands-on mentality—takes pride in their work, holds themselves accountable, and drives momentum across teams.
  • Diplomatic yet persistent; able to guide teams through peak moments with empathy, clarity, and a focus on solutions.
  • Highly organized with exceptional time management and prioritization abilities, balancing multiple workstreams with quality and care.
  • Passionate about people and culture, with a results-driven approach balanced by genuine curiosity and sensitivity to team dynamics.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of experience managing large-scale brands or programs within a creative agency or related communications environment.
  • Proven ability to build strong client partnerships that drive long-term growth and mutual success.
  • Demonstrated expertise managing multi-disciplinary teams across creative, production, and strategy disciplines.
  • Solid understanding of financial principles as they relate to agency scopes, budgets, and P&L impact.
  • Experience leading strategic and day-to-day client communications, as well as mentoring junior team members.
  • Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns, including digital, social, print, and broadcast production.
  • Comfortable with Google Suite (Sheets and Slides); experience with Monday.com or SmartSheets is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telco or retail categories, or in performance marketing environments.
  • Background in managing cross-functional agency partners and leading collaborative workstreams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $95,000 - $115,000

job.title: Temporary Copywriter
job.description:
UnitedMasters

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters' music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a versatile, culture-obsessed part-time Copywriter to join our team on a part-time basis. 

The Role

This role will sit at the intersection of music, tech, and media, supporting both the UnitedMasters brand and the 16Bars platform.

The ideal candidate has a sharp ear for voice, a deep understanding of music culture, and the ability to pivot between high-level brand storytelling and punchy social communications. You will collaborate closely with the Integrated Marketing, Social and Creative teams to drive engagement across our digital ecosystem.

What You’ll Do 

  • Digital & Web: Draft compelling website copy for landing pages and product launches, ensuring a seamless user experience.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM): Develop clear, impactful messaging for brand initiatives and new feature rollouts.
  • CRM & Editorial: Write engaging weekly newsletters and email marketing campaigns that drive conversion and community loyalty.
  • Social Media: Craft platform-specific copy (Instagram, TikTok, X) that resonates with independent artists and music fans.
  • Creative Development: Assist in writing creative treatments and "big idea" pitches for brand partnerships.
  • Content Scripts: Script short-form video content (Reels/TikToks) that feels authentic, trendy, and on-brand.

Who You Are 

  • 4-7 years of experience: working on internal and external facing brand copy across digital and social platforms
  • Culture-First Mindset: You’re plugged into music and culture, specifically the independent artist landscape.
  • Versatile Portfolio: Proven experience writing for tech, music, or lifestyle brands across web, email, and social.
  • Adaptability: Ability to switch voices between the professional/empowering tone of UnitedMasters and the editorial/sharp tone of 16Bars.
  • Efficiency: Capable of managing multiple projects under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Collaboration: A team player who can take feedback from integrated marketing leads and turn it into polished prose.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane — Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect — We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience — We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked — We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness — We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don't Know — We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don't.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $45 - $55/ hr 

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

job.title: Analyst, Strategic Analytics
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Universal Music Group is looking for an Analyst to join the Strategic Analytics team. This role is located on-site in UMG’s Santa Monica office.


How we LEAD:

The Analyst will consult on projects for Senior Executives, as well as individuals within Business Development, Finance, Communications, Marketing, and UMG’s various label groups. The ideal candidate should be an expert at analyzing large data sets in SQL and highly skilled at understanding new or messy data. Additional expertise in financial modeling, Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualization is a strong plus. Candidates should also demonstrate a solid understanding (or an eagerness to learn) the business models that are currently revolutionizing digital and subscription-based media.


How you’ll CREATE:

  • Write complex SQL scripts to extract necessary data for projects
  • Explain the benefits and pitfalls of various data sets based on deep understanding of data quality
  • Comfortable dealing with many disparate data sources and reconciling against the source of truth
  • Form a narrative through the distillation and interpretation of large amounts of data
  • Able to learn quickly and become a deep subject matter expert on all of UMG’s various data sources
  • Demonstrated ability to manage requests in a professional manner and communicate data-driven recommendations to a variety of different audience types (from senior executives to fellow analysts)
  • Work in project teams to answer interesting questions in a consultative fashion
  • Sample analysis may include:
    • Using data to identify user trends and platform trends, including user engagement, listening habits, conversion, retention, monetization, genre insights, among many others
    • Developing dynamic models to support licensing negotiations (e.g., with Spotify, Apple, YouTube), executive presentations, and high-level decision-making

Bring your VIBE:

  • 2–5 years of experience in consulting, finance, or a related analytical field preferred
  • Proficiency with Excel, data visualization tools, and the ability to create compelling presentations in PowerPoint
  • Experience working with large datasets and SQL for data extraction and analysis
  • Experience engaging with stakeholders in a consultative, client-facing, and analytical capacity
  • Strong intellectual curiosity and an eagerness to dive deep into new data sets, business models, and industry trends
  • Proactive mindset, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs, take initiative, and drive work forward independently
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts and tools, and the ability to apply them effectively
  • Excellent communication skills: comfortable walking through analyses, translating complexity, and presenting to executives
  • Comfort navigating ambiguous problems and structuring them into clear, actionable analytical steps
  • Ability to build strong relationships across business units and thrive within a collaborative team environment
  • Passion for music, analytics, and the role data plays in shaping creative and commercial outcomes

Bonus points if you have:

  • Previous experience in the music or entertainment industry
  • A track record of self-started projects that show initiative, experimentation, or personal passion (side data projects, GitHub repos, music/tech passion projects, etc.)
  • A natural tendency to ask, “Why?” and explore solutions beyond the obvious

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

  • 401(k) with 100% immediate vesting on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day)

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day)

  • Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent

Check out our full overview of benefits on the Perks Playlist page of the career site.

job.title: Business Partner Account Manager
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We are seeking a Business Partner Account Manager in our Digital Operations group that globally supports UMG’s owned and associated labels to set up new releases, manages the ongoing delivery of new releases and catalogue to business partners, and drives the introduction of new processes, product types and services with a continuous improvement focus.

In this position, the successful candidate will be responsible for and oversee designated aspects of Business Partner operations. The candidate will act as the key operational UMG contact for assigned partners and be a key internal point of contact for the Digital Strategy, Commercial, Business & Legal Affairs, and Rights teams for new partner developments, onboarding activities, and emerging digital initiatives.

How You’ll CREATE

Business Partner Onboarding & Approval Process Implementation

  • Ensure the agreed partner setup process required between Business & Legal Affairs and the global digital supply chain is implemented in response to partner account setup requests.

Business Partner Account Management & Internal UMG Account Support

  • Manage the ongoing operational and technical relationship management of UMG digital business partners and raise issues with effective communication. Provide partner-specific operational guidance and best practices to internal stakeholders to support successful content delivery and issue resolution.

Data Stewardship

  • Run, analyze, and reconcile repertoire data using comparison techniques as needed for specialized business partner activities.

  • Maintain and update digital records, including version control and replacements. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to ensure data accuracy and process adherence.

Business Partner Fulfillment Support

  • Manage individual partner content fulfillment as appropriate and in line with partner and UMG business expectations. Act as point of contact for Label Production & Release

  • Support Management teams to troubleshoot content and technical issues with designated partners.

Business Partner Catalog Backfill

  • Manage catalog backfill initiatives as assigned across the global digital supply chain. Remedy catalog gaps due to ingestion incidents and support catalog expansion efforts as necessary.

  • Act as a liaison within UMG for operational and technical integration activities related to catalog availability, distribution capabilities, and repertoire management enhancements.

job.description:

CD Baby is the world’s largest digital distribution platform for independent artists. For more than 20 years, we’ve empowered creators to release their music to Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music, Instagram, TikTok, and 150+ other platforms worldwide—paying out nearly $1 billion in earnings directly to independent artists.


Built by artists, for artists, we’re a mission-driven, artist-first company, and we’re expanding our Support team with experienced, detail-oriented problem-solvers who care deeply about helping creators succeed.


How we LEAD:

As a Customer Support Specialist, you’ll handle our most complex support inquiries, serving as an escalation point for high-impact issues involving royalties, metadata, distribution workflows, rights management, account configuration, and platform compliance.


You’ll be an expert in the independent music ecosystem and CD Baby’s product suite, capable of diagnosing nuanced, multi-layered problems and communicating solutions clearly and empathetically.


You’ll report to our Customer Support Manager, and work closely with the rest of the Customer Support team and cross-functional partners to improve workflows, provide insights, and elevate the overall quality and consistency of the CD Baby artist experience.

  • Manage complex customer cases, including advanced revenue issues, delivery failures, content policy blocks, and technical issues.

  • Communicate with professionalism, clarity, and empathy in every interaction.

  • Identify recurring issues, workflow gaps, and opportunities for automation or simplification.
  • Surface actionable insights to the Customer Support Manager, CX Operations Manager, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Contribute to improving policies, SOPs, and troubleshooting frameworks.

  • Maintain expert-level knowledge of CD Baby’s distribution pipelines, monetization, and digital service provider (DSP) requirements.
  • Collaborate on updates to macros, internal SOPs, and customer-facing documentation to ensure clarity and accuracy.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Digital Operations, and Marketing to resolve escalations that involve system bugs, content policy questions, or distribution exceptions.
  • Participate in case reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions to strengthen Support team expertise.

Customer Experience Leadership

  • Help uphold a culture of continuous learning, artist advocacy, and operational excellence.

job.description:

We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

The Strategic Initiatives & Investing team is a highly visible corporate development and investing team within UMG. The group partners with Virgin Music Group's executive leadership, business units, labels, and internal stakeholders to evaluate and execute opportunities across M&A, artist and business deals, catalog acquisitions, joint ventures, new business ventures, and select strategic initiatives. The team is lean and committed to a culture that is rigorous, collaborative, supportive, and fun.


How we LEAD:

The Strategic Initiatives & Investing team is looking for a full-time Senior Manager based in Los Angeles, CA. This is a hands-on corporate development role whose primary focus is financial analysis, valuation, diligence, and transaction execution across M&A, catalog acquisitions in coordination with Chord Music Partners, artist and business deals, joint ventures, and growth investments. The Senior Manager will own discrete transaction and analytical workstreams, develop clear recommendations for senior leaders, and partner with stakeholders across recorded music, publishing, merchandise, D2C, artist services, digital, technology, and marketing. The role will report to the VP, M&A and Strategic Investments, and work closely with other team members. The successful candidate is analytical, proactive, intellectually curious, and able to turn complex information into practical recommendations.


How you'll CREATE:

  • Build and own financial models, valuation analyses, and scenario assessments for potential M&A targets, artist and business deals, catalog acquisitions, joint venture partners, and other growth investments.
  • Manage discrete transaction workstreams, including data requests, financial and commercial diligence, sensitivity analyses, and synthesis of key findings.
  • Analyze deal economics and key terms, pressure-test operating assumptions, and identify value drivers, risks, and potential mitigants.
  • Coordinate with business units and cross-functional partners, including Finance, Legal, Business Affairs, Tax, Accounting, and commercial teams, to gather inputs and advance evaluations.
  • Conduct industry, market, and competitive research to inform valuation assumptions, strategic fit, and investment theses.
  • Prepare concise, executive-ready presentations and recommendations for senior management and other VMG leaders; communicate complex analyses clearly and accurately.
  • Support select strategic initiatives by structuring analyses around growth opportunities, revenue drivers, investment requirements, and business model implications.
  • Maintain transaction materials and improve models, templates, trackers, and processes to support consistent and efficient decision-making.
  • Support post-transaction reviews and performance tracking against the original investment case, where relevant.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 2+ years of relevant work experience in investment banking, corporate development, music IP or catalog investing, private equity, transaction advisory, consulting or strategy with a strong financial focus, or a similar field.
  • Direct experience with music IP, catalog investing, recorded music, publishing, or artist deal economics strongly preferred.
  • Strong financial modeling and valuation experience, including operating models, DCF, IRR, scenario and sensitivity analyses, and new venture economics.
  • Demonstrated ability to own analytical and diligence workstreams independently, with strong attention to detail and sound judgment.
  • Proven ability to synthesize complex findings into concise executive recommendations and presentations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; proficiency in Word required. Experience with HFM, SAP, or similar financial systems is a plus.

We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

The Senior Engineer, ServiceNow Custom App Lead is accountable for stakeholder engagement and outcomes for ServiceNow custom workflows and applications (including HRSD and other business workflows built on the platform).

This role owns the domain backlog and KPIs, defines end-to-end journeys and approval models, and ensures solutions are designed for supportability, compliance, and upgrade safety.

Working as part of a globally distributed ServiceNow team, the role partners closely with platform leadership and delivery resources to drive predictable delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement across multiple time zones.

How you'll CREATE:

  • Own stakeholder relationships and outcomes, backlog, and KPIs for HRSD and ServiceNow custom applications/workflows

  • Define end-to-end journeys, approvals, fulfilment steps, and reporting requirements for each service

  • Drive intake, prioritization, and delivery readiness (stories, acceptance criteria, UAT coordination, sign-off)

  • Partner with Platform team to ensure designs follow standards, are secure, and are upgrade-safe and supportable

  • Drive adoption and change enablement (communications, training needs, and post-release continuous improvement)

  • Collaborate effectively with a global ServiceNow team across time zones; align delivery with release cadence and handoffs 

Bring your VIBE:

  • Strong stakeholder management; able to translate business needs into clear services and measurable outcomes

  • Service design capability: map journeys, approval models, exceptions, and operational support requirements

  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow configuration and design patterns; preference for configuration over customization

  • Ability to manage intake/prioritization and drive UAT/sign-off to achieve predictable delivery

  • Ability to operate effectively in a global, multi-timezone team with structured coordination and handoffs

  • 5+ years of experience delivering business workflows on enterprise platforms or service management environments

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience delivering ServiceNow capabilities (workflows, catalog/approvals, reporting; HRSD preferred)

  • Experience owning backlog, KPIs, and stakeholder outcomes for a domain or product area

  • Experience defining requirements, acceptance criteria, and leading UAT coordination and business sign-off

  • Experience partnering with platform teams to ensure secure, supportable, and upgrade-safe solutions

  • Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Title: Service Reliability Engineer (SRE)  

Business Unit: UMG Corporate IT

Work Location: Nashville, TN

Department: Global Technical Operations

Reports To: Technical Operations Director AMER

FLSA*:

*Exempt or non-exempt determination will be made by Corporate Legal based on job functions and responsibilities

Job Summary:

We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.

As a key member of our Global Technical Operations team, you will be responsible for the reliability, scalability, and performance of the critical systems that power a global enterprise. By blending a software engineering mindset with operational expertise, you will engineer solutions that improve system reliability, automate complex processes, and reduce manual toil. You will be an essential partner to our development, infrastructure, and security teams, driving a culture of resilience and continuous improvement across the organization. 

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you won't just be supporting systems; you'll be ensuring the services that connect artists and fans around the globe are always on.

Job Functions:

Key Responsibilities

System Reliability & Performance

  • Design, build, and maintain the availability, scalability, and performance of critical services.
  • Develop and maintain robust monitoring, alerting, and observability systems (e.g., using AWS CloudWatch, Dynatrace) to ensure rapid issue detection and resolution.
  • Monitor infrastructure capacity and performance, providing analysis and suggestions for service delivery improvement.

Automation & Efficiency

  • Drive the automation of repetitive operational tasks, including infrastructure provisioning, deployments, and scaling.
  • Create and maintain scripts and custom code to support and enhance our operational toolset.
  • Support and optimize CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment speed and reliability.

Incident Management & Collaboration

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to troubleshoot and mitigate production incidents.
  • Lead post-incident reviews and root cause analyses to implement lasting solutions.
  • Partner with engineering and IT stakeholders to embed SRE best practices (SLOs, error budgets) into the design and development lifecycle.

Job Requirements:

Required Experience & Skills:

  • A strong background in systems administration (Linux/Windows) in a large-scale environment.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Java).
  • Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with a high preference for AWS.
  • Solid understanding of networking, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
  • Experience with modern monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace).
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities with experience in a high-pressure environment.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to foster a collaborative team environment.

Preferred Experience & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field.
  • Experience managing large-scale, distributed systems for a global organization.
  • Familiarity with IT governance standards like ITIL.
  • Direct experience with ServiceNow for IT service management.
  • Knowledge of chaos engineering, resilience testing, and advanced capacity planning.

job.title: Vice President, Enterprise Data Governance and Strategy
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How You’ll Lead:


The Vice President, Data Governance & Strategy is a senior executive leader responsible for defining and operationalizing a comprehensive enterprise data governance and data strategy across UMG. This role ensures that critical data assets—spanning music rights, royalties, digital consumption, fan engagement, e-commerce and merchandise (online and on-tour), physical products, and artist development—are accurate, trusted, compliant, and strategically leveraged.


Operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology, privacy, and partnerships, the VP champions a data-driven culture and enables scalable, compliant data usage that fuels monetization, fan growth, and innovation in a rapidly evolving global music ecosystem.


How You’ll Create:


Strategic Leadership


  • Define and drive the enterprise data strategy to support business growth, monetization of music assets, and fan engagement.
  • Identify and assess new fan data sources and partnership opportunities aligned with the enterprise data strategy, accounting for label and regional differences.
  • Align data initiatives with music industry trends, business priorities, and evolving digital platforms, including streaming, social platforms, AI-enabled services, and emerging distribution models.
  • Partner with C-level executives and senior leaders across Legal, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, HR, and Technology to integrate data insights into strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Serve as a trusted executive advisor on data value, risk, and opportunity across the organization.

Data Governance


  • Develop and implement a robust, scalable data governance framework covering:
    • Fan, CRM, and e-commerce data
    • Digital consumption and DSP reporting
    • Artist, repertoire, and product metadata
    • Financial, royalty, and rights data
  • Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, and accountability models across business units and regions.
  • Standardize data definitions and identifiers (e.g., ISRC, ISWC, IPI) to ensure consistency, transparency, and auditability across systems and partners.
  • Ensure compliance with global music rights regulations, licensing requirements, and data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), in close partnership with Legal, Privacy, and Security teams.

Collaboration & Enablement


  • Work cross-functionally with legal, operations, analytics, product, and technology teams to operationalize governance standards through platforms, processes, and workflows.
  • Promote data literacy, stewardship, and accountability across departments and business units.
  • Lead organizational change to position data as a managed enterprise asset, enabling trusted insights and scalable innovation.

Technology, Innovation & Future-Readiness


  • Evaluate, select, and deploy enterprise data governance and cataloging technologies supporting discovery, classification, lineage, quality monitoring, and access controls.
  • Drive automation and scalability in data ingestion, normalization, and reconciliation from digital platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, TikTok, and emerging channels.

AI Readiness, Responsible AI & Privacy by Design


  • Facilitate in establishing AI-ready data foundations, ensuring data used for advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI is accurate, well-governed, traceable, and ethically sourced.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Technology teams to define and operationalize AI governance frameworks, including controls for data usage, consent, provenance, bias mitigation, explainability, and auditability.
  • Embed privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default principles into AI-enabled initiatives involving fan, artist, and partner data, ensuring compliance with global privacy regulations and contractual obligations.
  • Play an active role in defining policies and guardrails for the responsible use of generative AI across the music lifecycle, including metadata enrichment, rights identification, royalty processing, fan engagement, marketing optimization, and internal productivity tools.
  • Assess and mitigate risks related to AI-driven data sharing, automated decision-making, synthetic data, and data leakage, while enabling innovation that supports monetization, efficiency, and trust.
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies such as AI/ML, blockchain, smart contracts, NFTs, and next-generation rights management, and evaluate their implications for music data governance, licensing, and revenue models.

Bring your VIBE:


Experience & Expertise


  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Science, Music Business, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data governance, data strategy, information management, or digital rights management—preferably within music, media, or entertainment.
  • Deep understanding of music rights, publishing, royalties, and global distribution models.
  • Strong familiarity with industry standards and ecosystems, including DDEX, ISRC, ISWC, IPI, and global licensing organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with data governance, catalog, and rights/royalty platforms (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, SynchTank, Vistex, Revelator or similar).

Leadership & Influence

  • Proven ability to operate at the executive level, influencing across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Track record of driving enterprise-wide data transformation and cultural change.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills.

Key Competencies

  • Visionary leadership at the intersection of data, music, and innovation
  • Strong grasp of digital music consumption, fan data, and data monetization models
  • Compliance-minded, detail-oriented, with a pragmatic business lens
  • Ability to align diverse teams and priorities in a complex, global organization

Perks Playlist:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

  • 401(k) with 100% immediate vesting on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day)

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day)

job.title: R1 Promotions Assistant
job.description:
Job Position:    Promotions Assistant

Department:    Promotions

Reports to:       Promotions/Marketing Director  

FLSA:                Non-Exempt

Status:              Part-time  

Work Location:     

 

OVERVIEW:

The Radio One story began simply with a dream and one radio station. Forty years, 13 markets, and 70+ stations later, we are an urban media empire, spanning multiple media platforms. We are in your ears with Reach Media/Radio One, on your televisions with TV One, and may even be the name behind your favorite website, with our digital platform Interactive One. Information is power, and our mission here at Radio One, Inc. is simple – to be the most trusted media source in the African American community. At Radio One, we pride ourselves on hiring people who are dedicated and continue to challenge the norm, while embracing a corporate culture built on creativity and passion. We are our employees’ biggest fans, and it is our daily mission to attract, develop, and retain the brightest stars in the business.

 

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Set up and represent various radio stations at on-site appearances, and at various locations and events
  • Assist with set-up and/or execution of assigned station events, remotes and station appearances; maintain station promotion and remote equipment within department
  • Develop, plan and carry out creative ways of increasing public awareness of the station
  • Present a positive attitude, and act as the contact between Radio One listeners and the stations during on-site events and promotions
  • Upkeep and maintenance of all station vehicles & equipment
  • Set up and maintain proper equipment for live broadcasts and remotes
  • Liaison for the promotions department and stations assigned during events, remotes and station appearances
  • Assist and coordinate with the Marketing & Promotions Director, Promotions Specialist, Administrative Assistant and other department members

 

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • At least 18 years of age with a High School Diploma or GED
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Must have at least 2 years of driving experience
  • Flexible schedule, with the ability and willingness to work varied hours on the weekdays, and weekends
  • Excellent organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize and effectively manage time
  • Self-starter, with the ability to take and follow direction
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to interact effectively with the station’s clients and listeners
  • Can work well independently and as an integral part of the team
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time, and lift/move up to 50 lbs   

 

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

A High School Diploma or GED is required. Valid driver's license and state-mandated automobile insurance.

job.title: R1 Traffic Manager
job.description:
Job Position:  Traffic Manager 

Department: Traffic 

Reports to Regional Traffic Director

FLSA: Exempt(ADM) 

Status: Full-time  

Location:   Indianapolis, IN

 

OVERVIEW: 

The Radio One story began simply with a dream and one radio station. Over Forty-five years, 13 markets, and 70+ stations later, we are an urban media empire, spanning multiple media platforms. We are in your ears with Reach Media/Radio One, on your televisions with TV One, and may even be the name behind your favorite website, with our digital platform Interactive One. Information is power, and our mission here at Radio One, Inc. is simple – to be the most trusted media source in the African American community. At Radio One, we pride ourselves on hiring people who are dedicated and continue to challenge the norm, while embracing a corporate culture built on creativity and passion. We are our employees’ biggest fans, and it is our daily mission to attract, develop, and retain the brightest stars in the business.

The Traffic Manager will be responsible for managing station logs for commercial, programming and promotional content.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepare logs using Wide-Orbit System, including creation, scheduling, processing , contract generation, and submission to the Programming 
  • Monitor competitive codes, rates, spot rotations, and available inventory and schedule commercials accordingly. Reconcile post-logs for approval and posting to boardfile; research and report discrepancies for follow-up 
  • Merge music logs
  • Produce, edit and advise on “time-sold” and pre-emption reports to maximize inventory; post inventory to other systems as required 
  • Analyze daily bump commercial reports and distribute relevant information to affected departments for follow-up
  • Review on-air time sales, promotion and programming, and news orders and/or public service announcements to verify accuracy and completeness 
  • Review sponsor requests for specific dates, and times of announcements; recommend alternate dates, and times and input information to update the log
  • Liaison with other departments, i.e. Accounting, Sales, Programming, Production, Promotions etc. as required
  • Demonstrate the ability to lead and direct a team to include but not limited to:
  • Provide regular constructive feedback in accordance with HR department expectations
  • Resolve issues/conflicts with diplomacy in a timely manner
  • Provide ongoing guidance and support for growth and development
  • Deploy effective coaching skills
  • Ability to effectively administer performance reviews, and corrective action plans as appropriate in a timely fashion
  • The ability to foster an inclusive work environment free of workplace harassment and bullying
  • Complies with Urban One’s mandatory trainings, and adheres to related course deadlines
  • Develop and distribute reports to requesting departments
  • Facilitate distribution of broadcast confirmations to Sales and clients 
  • Prepare and circulate network affidavits
  • Build hourly clocks as required
  • Maintain logs and records retention
  • Assist with scheduling of Emergency Alert System (EAS) tests for compliance with FCC regulations
  • Ensure satisfactory audits and SOX 404 compliance for areas of responsibility
  • Back up Traffic Manager and Continuity Director as required 
  • Perform other duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  •  Effectively interact well with management, staff and clients 
  • Demonstrate attention to accuracy and detail 
  • Knowledge of traffic, digital media, CRM (client relationship manager, e.g. Efficio)
  • Efficient in Microsoft Offices and SharePoint systems

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE: 

Associate degree or equivalent. Minimum 3 years relevant experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of experience and training.

job.title: Account Executive - Lethbridge, AB
job.description:
Your next big break is here!  Vista Radio is looking for an Account Executive to help grow our business in Lethbridge, AB. The role supports the Lethbridge market, working with our local brands including 94.1 CJOC and 98.1 The Ranch in Lethbridge.

The right candidate will be outgoing and ready to really dig into the community and be the face of the station around town.  In addition, you'll be joining the Vista team which prides itself on creating opportunity for advancement.  So, if you're ready to jump start your career, this is the place for you!

We are looking for a lifer, someone who gets us and wants to grow with us long-term 😉 We’re competitive, driven, and we support each other to win. This is not an easy role — it’s a high-energy, high-reward environment where resilience, consistency, and attitude matter. We have some pretty awesome ready-made sales for you, and lots of opportunity to build on that list with active and inactive clientele that are just waiting for you to come through their doors!

If you’re looking for a highly active sales position and someone who thrives on challenge, isn’t afraid of hearing “no,” and knows that success in sales is built through dedication to training, and pure old-fashioned hard work — we’re ready to talk to you.

About the Job:

Vista Radio has an immediate opening for an Account Executive, based in Lethbridge, AB.

What you'll do

Creating and managing multi-platform marketing campaigns that integrate radio, digital, and social media to help clients achieve their goals

Supporting an existing client base by developing new campaigns, optimizing ongoing strategies, and uncovering new growth opportunities

Prospecting and cold calling to develop new business from unassigned accounts and fresh leads

Designing creative sales strategies and proposals tailored to client needs and business goals

Meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly revenue targets

Managing your own account receivables to ensure timely billing and follow-up

What you Bring

Education in sales, marketing, business, or communications preferred and entrepreneurial backgrounds are welcomed

Sales experience is an asset; media sales experience is a bonus (we’ll train the right person!)

Comfortable working on a commission-based compensation structure

Self-starter with the ability to manage time, priorities, and deadlines independently

Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills

Computer-savvy, especially with Microsoft Office or Google Suite tools

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Customer service-oriented with exceptional networking skills

Creative thinker with a knack for problem-solving and solution development

Ability to work well in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment

Must have a valid driver’s license and a reliable, fully insured vehicle

This is not a passive sales role. It’s for people who want to build something, push themselves, and grow quickly.

Have questions? Apply and start the conversation — we’d love to connect with you. Taking that first step is exactly the kind of drive we’re looking for.

Vista Radio’s Vault of Benefits

At Vista Radio, we’re more than just a workplace — we’re a community of passionate people making a difference through local storytelling, music, and meaningful connections. We invest in our people with a benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and future — all in a fun, collaborative environment.

Previous experience in digital advertising, marketing coordination, campaign trafficking, project coordination, operations support, or media sales support.

Exceptional attention to detail when reviewing campaign requirements, Insertion Orders, creative assets, approvals, and fulfillment information.

job.title: Assistant Video Editor
job.description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Vox Media is looking for an Assistant Video Editor to join a growing post-production team within the branded content division for Vox and New York Magazine. This role is built for an editor early in their career who is sharp with turnkey and templated formats, comfortable owning quick-turn social cuts independently, and eager to grow into larger, more complex projects under supervision. You'll also work closely with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external editors, making you a key connective piece between in-house editing and the freelance bench.

 

Editing and Craft

  • Edit turnkey and templated content such as cutdowns, recaps, and repeatable social formats for various platforms
  • Cut quick-turn social edits independently, following established templates and house style
  • Take on larger or more complex edits with guidance from the Post-Production Supervisor and Creative Directors, building toward independent ownership of bigger projects over time
  • Add basic music and sound design to elevate templated pieces
  • Apply light color and LUTs following house presets

Project Setup and Coordination

  • Partner with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external/freelance editors such as bins, sequences, and file structure, following in-house SOPs
  • Create stringouts for Editors and Creative Directors per project
  • Prep and organize incoming footage, dailies, and assets ahead of handoff to external editors
  • Support project wrap-out and archiving, keeping files clean and organized across both in-house and external-editor projects

 

Workflow and Technical

  • Work in Adobe Premiere, including Team Projects and Productions, following house SOPs for project, bin, sequence, and track structure
  • Support turnovers to color and sound mix during finishing on larger projects
  • Work flexibly across a remote and hybrid workflow, including shipping/receiving drives and cloud sync as needed

 

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Share cuts via Frame.io and address internal notes accurately, flagging concerns proactively
  • Maintain clear communication with producers, the Post-Production Supervisor, and external editors
  • Learn from and support senior editors on shared projects, with room to grow into more senior editing responsibility over time

WHO YOU ARE

  • 2-3 years of experience editing in a digital, social, or branded content environment
  • Comfortable and fast with templated, repeatable edit formats, with a desire to grow into more complex, independent work
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere; familiarity with team projects/Productions is a plus
  • Comprehensive knowledge of technical specifications for distribution across all digital platforms
  • Organized and detail-oriented - comfortable managing file structure and project setup, not just cutting
  • Familiarity with Frame.io or similar review/delivery tools

 

WHERE YOU'LL WORK

This role is based in our New York City office. You’ll work a hybrid schedule: in-office three days a week & remote two days a week.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range$70,000—$80,000 USD

OUR DEI COMMITMENT

Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. job.title: Commerce Analyst
job.description:
Commerce Analyst

You'll be the primary point of contact for ecommerce data questions and analysis, translating numbers into clear stories and recommendations for editors, business development, and social teams. This is a role with a lot of autonomy — you'll help own the analysis of specific brands and verticals, structure your own day-to-day, and bring a level-headed approach to a fast-moving media environment.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible position with an initial five month term, with the possibility of extension based on performance and business need.

What you'll do

  • Present in-depth analyses of ecommerce performance that go beyond reporting what happened, to explain the bigger trends behind it
  • Translate data into plain language for non-data stakeholders, and make clear recommendations to editorial, business development, and social teams
  • Identify growth opportunities and design tests to act on them
  • Own solving problems as they come up — looking for ways to automate or use tools and data rather than patch things manually
  • Support the business with regular reporting, dashboards, and insights, and keep them well-maintained over the course of the engagement
  • Lead ad-hoc analysis for major commerce moments during the contract window (Black Friday, Cyber Monday, holiday season, and into Q1)
  • Help set up reporting and processes that can hand off cleanly at the end of the term

What we're looking for

Skills

  • Strong analytical ability, with a track record of synthesizing data into concepts non-data people can act on
  • Strong understanding of affiliate ecommerce 
  • Hands-on experience with Google Analytics and Big Query
  • Proficiency in Excel; experience with Google Sheets a plus
  • Experience with a data visualization tool — Looker, Google Data Studio (Looker Studio), or Tableau
  • Understanding of statistical concepts
  • Understanding of LLM’s and how they relate to retail/affiliate marketing

Experience

  • 4+ year working in an analytical role
  • Background at an ecommerce company, media company, or tech company preferred — we're open to other paths that show the same analytical muscle
  • Titles like Analyst are typical, but we care more about the work than the title
  • Comfortable hitting the ground running — this is a short-term engagement over our highest-volume season

Nice to haves

  • Experience with BigQuery or another SQL-based analytics tool
  • Search experience — SEO, SEMRush or a competitor tool, Search Console
  • Paid social experience
  • Experience with an affiliate or retail brand business
  • Experience with LLM analytics 

Education

  • No formal degree required. We've worked successfully with people who didn't go to college — what matters is that you're analytical and get results.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

job.title: Head of Social, Vulture
job.description:
THE ROLE

Social media is a linchpin of Vulture’s editorial operation — it’s an essential component of everything we produce and the businesses that support those efforts. We’re looking for a Head of Social to oversee that department. This person and their team will collaborate on all the work that Vulture produces and promotes, including articles, video, podcasts, games, and live events. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and lover of culture who is as comfortable in a creative brainstorming session as they are poring over editorial analytics. The job is fast-paced and often involves juggling multiple projects, so strong prioritization and communication skills are vital. 

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Determine the most effective ways to reflect Vulture’s sensibility, tone, and perspective across key platforms. 
  • Create and publish engaging content. 
  • Establish the necessary social strategies and tactics to help Vulture meet goals relating to audience reach and engagement, subscription conversion, sponsorship fulfillment, and brand-building. 
  • Monitor social performance and use data-driven insights to refine tactics and influence editorial decisions.
  • Manage the social team: create a clear agenda, set priorities, provide coaching. 
  • Introduce clear, efficient processes for working with the rest of the editorial teams. 
  • Pitch new social franchises: videos, columns, rubrics, or just one-off delights. 
  • Work with the Vulture features team and New York culture editors on plans for capturing behind-the-scenes content and subsequent story and package rollouts. 
  • Work with the news team on live-event coverage including red carpets, parties, premieres, award shows, and Vulture-led experiences. This occasionally involves night and weekend work.
  • Pay attention to emerging or underutilized platforms and determine if/when/how Vulture should launch a presence on them.
  • Build a roster of freelance social producers, especially outside of New York.
  • Manage a budget across talent, travel, and freelancer support.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Extensive social media experience, preferably at a digital media company. 
  • Excellent communication and time-management skills.
  • Comfort managing direct reports and working closely with members of adjacent departments.
  • A track record of growing an audience and producing distinct creative work.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Suite (especially Premiere), Figma, Meta Suite, and social scheduling platforms such as Dash Social.
  • The ability to parse performance data and use insights to influence editorial decision-making, track KPIs, and report on goals to leadership.
  • A high degree of entertainment enthusiasm and cultural fluency. Be prepared to discuss your favorite shows and movies, albums and creators, podcasts and video games.
  • Positivity, a level head, an insuppressible sense of humor, and a spirit of collaboration. 

PAY TRANSPARENCY

job.title: Manager, Workplace (Facilities)
job.description:
THE ROLE

Vox Media is seeking an experienced Manager, Workplace (Facilities) to lead the day-to-day operations of our New York City office. This role is responsible for creating a well-run, responsive, and thoughtfully maintained workplace that supports how our teams work and collaborate.

This is a hands-on operational role for someone who takes pride in making an office work well. You’ll oversee day-to-day workplace operations, manage a small team of employees and contractors, and partner closely with the Head of People to ensure our spaces are welcoming, functional, and responsive to employee needs.

While the primary focus is our New York headquarters, you'll also support the day-to-day operations of our Washington, DC office through remote coordination with local partners and vendors.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This job is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Oversee daily workplace operations, ensuring the office is well-maintained, functional, and supports a productive employee experience.
  • Manage a team of full-time, temporary, and contract staff, including scheduling, approving timesheets, and day-to-day direction of work.
  • Serve as the operational owner of the New York workplace, bringing together employees, vendors, building management, and internal partners to ensure the office runs smoothly every day.
  • Establish and maintain clear workplace processes, documentation, and operating standards that enable consistent service and operational excellence.
  • Own the operational management of workplace budgets, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor payments, ensuring accurate financial tracking and strong partnership with Finance.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for building management, overseeing logistics such as access, maintenance coordination, and adherence to building policies.
  • Ensure workplace safety and compliance by conducting regular on-the-ground checks, maintaining protocols, and responding to issues as they arise.
  • Act as a point of coordination during workplace-related incidents or crises, supporting clear and timely on-the-ground communication.
  • Support space planning and workplace requests from stakeholders, balancing competing needs while maintaining operational efficiency.
  • Manage relationships with workplace vendors and service providers, ensuring high-quality service, timely issue resolution, and continuous improvement across workplace operations.
  • Lead workplace projects such as office moves, space reconfigurations, vendor implementations, and operational improvements from planning through execution.
  • Partner with business leaders to plan workspace needs, balancing employee experience, operational requirements, and efficient use of office space

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Experience managing people, including direct reports and/or contract staff, with a focus on clear communication and accountability.
  • Experience managing workplace operations in a headquarters or multi-site office environment preferred.
  • Strong operational and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and workflows at once.
  • Experience managing budgets, invoices, and vendor relationships in a professional setting.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and resolve issues quickly.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally and managing requests from a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment and discretion, particularly in situations involving safety, compliance, or sensitive workplace issues.
  • Experience working in office operations, workplace management, facilities, or a related field.
  • Comfort learning and adopting new technologies, including AI tools, to improve operational efficiency and team workflows.

job.title: Motion Design Lead
job.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

Vox Media is looking for a Motion Design Lead, who is both a highly-skilled motion designer and an experienced leader, responsible for conceptualizing and executing motion designs across platforms to create industry-leading branded content for New York Magazine and Vox. The Motion Design Lead is a “player/coach” and has extensive experience creating story-driven content for digital platforms, as well as providing motion design leadership. This role is accountable to the art director and creative director on a project level, and the Head of Branded Content at a high level.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible position with an initial six-month term, with the possibility of extension based on performance and business need. Applications without a portfolio or reel link will not be considered.

 

Creative and Design Leadership

  • Partner with our in-house Art and Creative directors to evolve the vision for motion design in branded content across Vox’s Explainer Studio, as well as New York Magazine and its brands, including The Cut and Vulture
  • On the pulse of where motion design is going, the Associate Motion Director is immersed in emerging trends, tools, and techniques, folding them proactively into their practice
  • Push the level of design our team is known for, partnering with Art Directors and Creative Directors to raise quality expectations and sharpen Vox Media’s visual voice and aesthetic
  • Design and execute motion for a range of advertising clients and internal projects ranging from custom long- and short-form video, to social content — from concept through delivery
  • Bring deep expertise in visual storytelling across motion graphics, VFX, and 3D
  • Provide leadership and creative direction to freelance motion designers, cultivating and growing Vox Media’s network of creative collaborators: designers, animators, and 3D artists
  • Craft and initiate new visual products in partnership with other creative leads, translating what’s next in motion into what’s next for Vox Media
  • Own the team’s motion design and animation best practices, establishing and evolving our standards, workflows, and techniques that keep the team aligned and working at its highest level
  • Develop and maintain brand guidelines for motion and animation, ensuring Vox Media’s visual voice and aesthetic stay consistent and elevated across every deliverable

 

Team and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as an advocate for motion designers across every project, ensuring design has been vetted and considered well before delivery
  • Contribute hands-on where needed, and route the right work to the right people based on individual expertise within our bench of freelance artists
  • Collaborate closely with internal partners, as well as external stakeholders such as clients, vendors, and outside resources



On a Project Level

  • Show up as a key creative stakeholder — active in brainstorms, kick-offs, and status meetings
  • Own motion timelines across projects: set internal milestones, track progress, flag risks early, and to ensure deadlines are met
  • Produce work end-to-end on select campaigns, while simultaneously overseeing other projects, collaborating closely with freelance artists on execution by giving clear, timely, actionable feedback at every review stage 
  • Review the work of freelancers and provide clear, actionable notes, ensuring creative integrity is maintained through every state of development
  • Partner with writers, producers, and video editors to keep story and visual direction aligned
  • Attend video shoots when VFX are involved, when appropriate
  • Act as the link between outside motion designers, video editors, creative directors and art to coordinate asset handoffs, file sharing and delivering feedback 



WHO YOU ARE

  • 8+ years of relevant industry experience in motion design, with leadership experience guiding teams or freelancers
  • Fluent in Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma
  • A student of the craft, you follow motion design culture closely and have strong opinions on where the industry is headed and how it can be applied to the Branded Content business at Vox Media
  • A strong storyteller who can move between hands-on execution and creative leadership
  • A visual thinker with a deeply developed aesthetic and high visual taste
  • A collaborative approach to leadership — you build bridges across client services, art, production, and post teams
  • A background in graphic design is a plus, alongside an understanding of typography, composition, color, and visual hierarchy

 

WHERE YOU’LL WORK

  • This role is based in our New York City office. You’ll work a hybrid schedule: in-office most days, with some flex days from home.

job.title: Network & Systems Engineer
job.description:
THE ROLE

Vox Media is looking for a Network & Systems Engineer to own the design, operation, and evolution of our enterprise office network, studios, and production facilities. This is a hands-on engineering role on a small, high-trust infrastructure team — you will be the person who owns the network end to end.

You will be a primary technical owner of our enterprise network environment, with particular responsibility for our current Juniper infrastructure with Cato Networks providing SASE/SD-WAN and secure remote access. Because we operate as a lean infrastructure team, we're looking for someone who is comfortable working beyond traditional networking boundaries. 

The right person will be equally comfortable troubleshooting a complex routing or switching issue, planning a network migration, supporting server or cloud infrastructure, and partnering with Media & Production Technology, Service Desk, and other technical teams to solve cross-functional problems.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As our Network & Systems Engineer on a lean infrastructure team, you'll own networking end to end while contributing across systems, cloud, and identity infrastructure when needed. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Vox Media's enterprise network across offices, data centers, cloud environments, and remote connectivity
  • Serve as the senior technical resource for our Juniper networking environment, including configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle management
  • Administer our Cato Networks SASE platform, including SD-WAN connectivity, secure remote access, and associated security policy
  • Help define the future direction of Vox Media's network architecture, including evaluating and potentially migrating infrastructure to platforms such as Cisco and Meraki
  • Design and support LAN, WAN, wireless, and internet connectivity across multiple locations
  • Configure and manage VLANs, routing, switching, STP, ACLs, NAT, DHCP, DNS, and related network services, supporting routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF where applicable
  • Troubleshoot complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues, including packet-level analysis and root-cause investigation of difficult network and application connectivity problems
  • Monitor network availability, performance, capacity, and reliability, and proactively address emerging issues
  • Plan and execute network hardware upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and office infrastructure projects — including studio, conference room, and event connectivity — while minimizing business disruption
  • Manage ISP, circuit, and network hardware vendor relationships, including escalations, renewals, and capacity planning
  • Support and troubleshoot server, virtualization, cloud, identity, and enterprise infrastructure, assisting with systems administration across environments such as AWS, VMware, and Windows and/or Linux
  • Support enterprise identity and authentication technologies such as SSO and identity providers, and partner with IT operations on endpoint management (Mac and Windows MDM) and SaaS platform administration
  • Help administer monitoring, logging, configuration management, backup, and infrastructure management platforms
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for infrastructure incidents and perform root-cause analysis across networking, systems, and cloud environments
  • Develop repeatable processes and automation — using scripting, APIs, or infrastructure-as-code tools — that reduce manual administration and improve reliability
  • Assist with hands-on service desk support as needed, particularly for onsite requirements, including hardware and software troubleshooting, employee onboarding/offboarding, and resolution of support tickets to maintain operational continuity.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Must-haves:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in network engineering and infrastructure engineering
  • Strong hands-on production experience with Juniper networking technologies and Junos
  • Relevant networking certifications such as JNCIA/JNCIS/JNCIP, CCNA, or CCNP
  • Hands-on production experience with Cisco and/or Meraki, and the judgment to evaluate platforms on technical merit rather than familiarity
  • Deep understanding of enterprise TCP/IP networking, including designing, configuring, and troubleshooting Layer 2/Layer 3 switching, routing, wireless, and network connectivity
  • Systematic troubleshooting skills, including diagnosing complex network and application connectivity problems using monitoring, logging, packet capture, and performance-analysis tools
  • Experience planning and executing network upgrades or migrations with minimal business disruption
  • AWS networking experience, including VPCs, routing, VPNs, and cloud connectivity
  • Systems administration or broader infrastructure engineering experience alongside networking
  • Ability to independently own technical projects from design through implementation and ongoing operations, with the documentation and communication skills to bring others along
  • Ability to work onsite up to 5 days per week in Lower Manhattan(Financial District) and to be onsite for after-hours escalations and scheduled maintenance windows

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with SASE/SSE platforms such as Cato Networks, Zscaler, or Palo Alto Prisma Access
  • Experience migrating between networking vendors or architectures
  • Experience with Juniper Mist
  • Enterprise wireless design and troubleshooting experience
  • Experience with firewall and network-security platforms
  • Experience with VMware or other virtualization platforms
  • Infrastructure automation with Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar
  • Familiarity with identity platforms such as Okta and enterprise SaaS infrastructure
  • Media, broadcast, or production environment experience

PAY TRANSPARENCY
