job.title: Podcast Video Editor
job.description:
THE ROLE

The Vox Media Podcast Network is looking for a Video Editor to support its slate of sports and culture shows, working across full-length episodes and shoulder content (including quote cards, clips, and behind-the-scenes videos).

The ideal candidate is meticulous and fast as a technical editor, understands how podcasts move through the modern media ecosystem, and has a strong sense of visual style along with a portfolio of conceptually bold work.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life. This role is a part of the Vox Media Union, represented by the Writers Guild of America, East.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Execute the editing and visual post-production for full-length podcast episodes distributed on YouTube and video platforms.
  • Translate the personality and pacing of digital creators' shortform videos into a distinct and elevated podcast aesthetic.
  • Design and integrate dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and visual cues that enhance narrative and tone.
  • Ensure consistent visual branding through smart use of color, typography, and layout across both longform and shortform edits.
  • Implement split-screen layouts, on-screen text, varied pacing and punch-ins, and other techniques that keep conversations visually engaging and viewer-friendly.
  • Address mixed-location interviews (e.g., Zoom + studio) with creativity — ensuring cohesion and polish across footage types.
  • Collaborate with hosts, producers, and showrunners to iterate quickly and deliver high-quality video content on a regular schedule.
  • Source and incorporate archival video or social content where relevant to deepen storytelling.
  • Stay ahead of podcast video trends and contribute ideas that push visual strategy forward.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 5+ years of experience in podcast or social video production for a media brand or individual talent. 
  • Fluency with Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or other video editing programs. Experience with motion design a plus.
  • A keen eye for identifying the planned editing flow during a recording, a well-honed sense of pacing out a show/story arc, and ability to apply these skills on tight deadlines.
  • A portfolio that showcases your ability to shape voice, tone, and rhythm.
  • Comfort integrating motion graphics, typography and on-screen text to enhance clarity, emphasis, or humor.
  • Experience with multi-camera editing and visual storytelling techniques like split-screens, overlays, and animated inserts.
  • Ability to maintain brand consistency while experimenting with new formats and storytelling angles.
  • Passion for building a visual language that lives across platforms in collaboration with varied groups of creative stakeholders.
  • Deep knowledge of the social media landscape and excitement about evolving podcasts as dynamic, multiplatform media products.. 

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range$76,000—$80,000 USD

job.title: Post Production Supervisor
job.description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Vox Media is seeking a Post-Production Supervisor to serve as the core driver of post-production operations for the branded content division of Vox and New York Magazine. Reporting to the Director, Creative Production, you will lead end-to-end post operations in managing project schedules, engaging freelance editors and post-production vendors, and guaranteeing that all deliverables, from social content to still photography and long-form video, meet our high-quality standards and deadlines. Collaborating closely with Creative Directors and Producers, you will optimize post workflows and implement efficient operational practices. Serving as the ultimate steward of the production pipeline, you will work hand-in-hand with creative teams through final delivery, taking pride in delivering polished, high-caliber final assets.

Crew and Vendor Support

  • Resource and assign editors, colorists, retouchers, and sound mixers per campaign based on availability, budget, edit style, and Creative Director input
  • Onboard external support and manage timely payment and budget tracking
  • Build and maintain a vetted roster of post-production resources, staying current on new talent and tools in the field

Schedule and Workflow Management

  • Manage post-production tracker and calendar, finding automation efficiencies to improve workflow
  • Approve and oversee post-production timelines for all active campaigns
  • Confirm schedule feasibility with editors, vendors, and internal stakeholders
  • Establish and maintain technical workflows for media, dailies, and archival/stock footage
  • Track licensed assets across campaign deliverables such as royalty-free stock and music 
  • Track physical hard drives sent to and from editors or other post support
  • Set up and manage campaign-specific post-production Slack channels with all associated resources
  • Work alongside management to track and distribute post resources, including Frame.io, stock and library logins, and subscriptions

Delivery and Quality Control

  • Archive and back up all raw media files, edit versions and project files from campaigns into Lucid link
  • Enforce file-naming conventions and delivery specs across video and photo outputs
  • Work in tandem with the Design team to ensure graphics and animations are incorporated efficiently and on time
  • Review every cut and photo asset alongside Creative and Production for color, retouching quality, and spec compliance before client review

Leadership and Process

  • Guide the overall team in adopting efficient workflows and media-management practices
  • Develop and maintain SOPs for post-production to keep output consistent as the team scales
  • Own budget tracking and vendor invoicing across active post-production work alongside Production
  • Stay current on post-production tools and platforms, leading adoption of new tools that improve speed or quality

WHO YOU ARE

  • 4-6 years of experience managing post-production in branded content, media, or an agency environment
  • Deep understanding of digital production workflows across both video and photo post
  • Experience managing production budgets, timecard approvals, vendor invoicing, and payment tracking
  • Fluency with Frame.io and asset/production-tracking platforms (Airtable or similar)
  • Experience building and maintaining SOPs or process documentation for a scaling team
  • Solid grasp of the legal side of post-production, including copyright, licensing, and clearance procedures for third-party content
  • Strong people-management instincts, with the ability to anticipate roadblocks and conflicts before they arise
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical post-production concepts for non-technical stakeholders

WHERE YOU'LL WORK

  • This role is based in our New York City office. You’ll work a hybrid schedule: in-office three days a week & remote two days a week.

job.title: Real Estate Reporter
job.description:
THE ROLE

Curbed, New York Magazine’s pioneering site covering real estate, architecture, design, and urbanism, is looking for an experienced and ambitious real estate reporter to join our team and cover the people, deals, developments and trends shaping the city’s real estate market and neighborhoods. 

The ideal candidate is a strong reporter and writer with a network of industry sources and an insider’s perspective on the deals and developments shaping the city, and the ability to write compelling stories about complex real estate topics and developments. The reporter should have a deep knowledge of New York City’s residential and commercial real estate markets, housing, neighborhoods, and the business of real estate. 

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Cover breaking news and report on tips related to real estate
  • Report exclusives based on sourcing and original reporting
  • Track real estate transactions, property listings, development proposals, sales records, rental reports, financing, and other market activity
  • Analyze public records, real estate databases, government data, company filings, market reports, and other datasets to uncover news and trends.
  • Pitch news and feature story ideas that make sense of the real estate headlines and uncovers the real estate angle in national and major stories 
  • Write a mix of short and longer-lead stories every week
  • Collaborate with editors, photo and art teams, and other newsroom colleagues to publish and circulate stories.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • At least 2-5 years of reporting experience, covering real estate, housing, business, and related beats 
  • A strong track record of original published journalism 
  • Excellent reporting skills, including outreach, interviewing, research, and fact-checking
  • Comfort working with public records, interpreting market data, databases, and other research tools.
  • Has extensive sources within the real estate industry and New York City business community and knows how to cultivate new sources and follow-up with contacts 
  • Understands New York City neighborhoods and their characteristics in terms of housing and building types and neighborhood characteristics
  • Is interested in the narrative possibilities of buying/selling real estate, controversies and conflicts
  • Has a proven ability to research and analyze real estate databases and records 
  • Can turn stories around quickly 
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines 
  • Ability to work well with an editor and a team

job.title: Senior Editor, Vox
job.description:
Vox is seeking an experienced editor to help oversee its distinctive coverage of policy in a changing America. This editor will lead a team of multiplatform journalists who explore and explain the world of policy and ideas for Vox’s wide-ranging and curious audience, in a variety of formats including text, podcasts, and video. 

Vox’s coverage is dedicated to original reporting and analysis on issues, personalities, and movements that help people truly understand what’s at stake. We cover policy with a strong grounding in the news, but an eye toward the future and delivering smart solutions.

We’re looking for a dynamic, creative team member who can help Vox grow and adapt in a fast-changing political news landscape – and a pivotal moment in the national conversation. The editor should be eager to manage Vox’s coverage with urgency and ambition. They should also be highly collaborative and excited to work across Vox’s multimedia newsroom, finding creative ways for journalists to contribute to Vox’s signature podcast and video franchises, as well as its growing portfolio of newsletters. 

We’re looking for a leader who closely tracks the news, staying on top of major storylines and nimbly finding ways for Vox to offer distinctive coverage in a busy space. This editor should be able to find smart, original ways into major storylines — and guide reporters to uncovering fresh issues to bring to public attention. They should have a gift for finding points of intersection between American political currents and big-picture areas like technology, religion, and social policy. 

The ideal candidate should have a clear track record of managing journalists to deliver sharp, original angles that cut through the conversation, publishing original pieces on crisp deadlines, while also creating space for longer, more ambitious articles that help shape the public conversation. This position will be based in Washington, D.C. or New York, and report to the executive editor. 

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This is a hybrid position based in the Washington, D.C. or New York office, and reports to the executive editor. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage and lead a team of 4-5 reporters to conceive, assign, and edit pieces rooted in reporting and research. These include both fast analysis off the news and longer-horizon features — all driven by Vox’s commitment to explanation, solutions, new ideas, and improving people’s’ lives.
  • Guide Vox’s coverage of big policy topics with a clear hand and vision, staying on top of the news to find fresh angles
  • Collaborate closely with Vox’s editorial director for politics, as well as other Vox editors across multiple platforms, to deliver a rich and compelling political report.
  • Shape stories and broader coverage plans to ensure they are rigorous, compelling, and aligned with Vox’s editorial strategy and audience goals. You should be able to spot when a piece needs a sharper argument, a stronger evidence base, or a fundamentally different frame. You should also be able to see how each beat fits into Vox’s overall coverage, and identify ways to collaborate, prevent overlap, and build on our strengths.
  • Collaborate with other teams across the newsroom to help develop and sharpen your reporters’ stories in other platforms, including audio, video, and social video.
  • Work closely with colleagues in policy and politics, the executive editor, and the managing editor for audience and membership to ensure our editorial approach connects to Vox’s broader strategy in the membership era.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 5 years’ experience editing
  • While experience with audio and video production is not necessary, the candidate should have an understanding of the politics and policy podcast and video landscape
  • Strong leadership, management, communication, and editing skills
  • Excellent news judgment and a demonstrated ability to bring analysis and sharp angles to news stories
  • Analytical rigor. We want an editor with the ability to pressure-test arguments and take opposing ones seriously. We want an editor who can confidently edit pieces that explain ideas and/or stake out intellectual claims, and who is eager to assign and edit pieces that embrace nuance and complicate narratives without sacrificing clarity. 
  • Passion for Vox’s mission of serving the audience and making complex concepts accessible through explanatory journalism 

PAY TRANSPARENCY

job.title: Senior Experiential Strategist
job.description:
We’re seeking a creative, collaborative thinker to shape the experiential strategy for editorial events and custom brand activations across the New York Magazine portfolio. This is a creative-led role for someone who has their finger on the pulse of live experiences, culture, and emerging trends, and can translate those insights into smart, distinctive ideas. The role also requires strong practical expertise — from scoping event budgets and understanding production considerations to managing multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines with organization and ease.

Sitting within the Brand Marketing Strategy and Experiential teams, this is an ideal role for someone who’s passionate about events and creative storytelling, and excited to bring their experience to a fast-paced media company.

What You’ll Do:

  • Drive the creative positioning and go-to-market strategy for experiential offerings across New York Magazine, The Cut, Vulture, and The Strategist
  • Develop creative concepts for marquee multi-sponsor tentpole events, editorial activations, and custom branded experiences
  • Lead experiential thinking for RFPs and proactive pitches, using research, cultural trends, and visual storytelling to develop compelling concepts and proposals
  • Write pitch concepts with clarity, originality, and strategic intent, delivering standout creative copy that brings ideas to life and ladders back to client objectives
  • Lead deck development for proactive pitches to advertisers tied to priority experiential IP
  • Develop detailed event budgets and timelines, and assess production considerations to ensure concepts are both creatively compelling and feasible
  • Present experiential offerings and ideas to the Advertising organization and in client meetings, bringing concepts to life with clarity and confidence
  • Build strong relationships with the Sales and Editorial teams, ensuring what's pitched matches what's scoped, and flagging incremental work in pre-sale before it reaches post-sale production
  • Assist in  the pre-sale to post-sale handoff, translating the sold event vision and approved budget into a clear, actionable production scope while ensuring every element carries seamlessly from the original concept through execution
  • Attend key events and production walk-throughs as needed to gain firsthand insight into what works in practice — using those learnings to strengthen future concepts and inform strategic direction
  • Conduct competitive and cultural research to identify emerging opportunities, building a central point of view and a working archive of event moodboards, references, and industry innovation
  • Collaborate across Marketing, Editorial, Sales, and Experiential to shape strategy, provide informed recommendations, and develop ideas that are aligned with business objectives and brought effectively to life
  • Contribute to day-to-day team operations, organization, meeting preparation, and other needs as they arise

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3-5  years of experience in experiential marketing, event production, or creative strategy (agency, media, or brand side)
  • Outstanding writing and visual communication skills, with expertise in building pitch decks in Google Slides
  • Solid understanding of event pricing, preliminary budgeting, and vendor quote management
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to bring creative experiential ideas to life in meetings
  • Deep curiosity about live experiences, pop culture, and emerging trends
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at once, stay organized, and communicate effectively
  • Avid fan and reader of New York Magazine brands 

This is a permanent, full-time position based in our New York City office. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

job.title: Senior Recruiter
job.description:
THE ROLE

Vox Media is looking for a Senior Recruiter to own full-cycle hiring for editorial (New York Magazine & Vox), podcast (Vox Media Podcast Network), revenue, and operations roles across the company. 

This is a role for someone who has run full-cycle recruiting before, is comfortable being a trusted advisor to hiring managers (including senior ones), and genuinely enjoys the craft of matching talented people to the right opportunity, especially in a media environment where roles and needs can shift quickly.

Candidates should be fans of New York Magazine, Vox, and our podcast network.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This job is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting — intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer, and close — for a portfolio of roles spanning editorial, podcast/audio, revenue, and operations functions.
  • Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to scope open roles, build hiring plans, and act as a strategic advisor throughout the search.
  • Build and maintain proactive, representative talent pipelines through sourcing, referrals, and passive-candidate outreach, rather than relying solely on inbound applications.
  • Deliver a high-touch candidate experience that reflects well on Vox Media — timely communication, clear expectations, and thoughtful follow-through.
  • Structure and run consistent, bias-aware interview processes, including writing job scorecards and coaching interviewers on effective, legally sound interviewing.
  • Manage multiple concurrent searches with competing timelines, keeping hiring managers and candidates aligned without dropping the details.
  • Own offer strategy and negotiation in partnership with People leadership, balancing candidate expectations with internal equity and approved compensation bands.
  • Track and report on pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other recruiting metrics, and use that data to flag risks and recommend adjustments.
  • Stay current on the media, journalism, and podcasting talent landscape, and bring market insight back to hiring teams.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • A passion for the art of talent acquisition — aka you love what you do.
  • You're a genuine fan of our brands and shows — and you actually consume them.
  • 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience (strong preference for in-house) — you have a strong track record for closing candidates.
    • Specifically, experience recruiting editorial, creative, and audio/podcast talent.
  • You strive for a positive candidate experience — each open role builds on your ability to grow the talent network.
  • Strong sourcing skills — you don't wait for the perfect candidate to apply; you go find them.
  • Stakeholder management is second nature for you — you feel confident advising and pushing back constructively on hiring managers, including senior leaders.
  • You know that diverse slates alone don't move the needle — you build hiring processes that are equitable by design, from first outreach to final offer.
  • Excellent organizational skills — you can run a busy, varied req load without letting candidates or hiring managers fall through the cracks.
  • Systems expertise — you feel comfortable managing an ATS and partnering with the Head of People to build recruiting process.
  • Clear, warm, and timely communication — you represent Vox Media to every candidate you talk to, whether they're hired or not.

job.title: Video & Social Media Producer, Criminal
job.description:
Criminal Productions is looking for a temporary full-time Podcast Video & Social Media Producer to join our team. 

As a Podcast Video & Social Producer you will be responsible for creating video and social content for our digital platforms. This will range from producing long-form video interviews to short-form social media video clips. You will also create additional social content including image assets, stories/reels, and caption copy. You will work closely with the podcast producers and the podcast marketing team to reflect Criminal Productions’ voice, spirit, and brand.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Produce longform video content for Criminal’s YouTube channel from start to finish (coordinating recording, making initial editorial cuts and decisions, working with a video editor on drafts, and publishing a final version)
  • Produce shortform video content for Criminal’s YouTube shorts channel, as well as social media platforms - translating podcast moments into compelling visual stories
  • Upload archival Criminal podcast episodes to YouTube
  • Create compelling thumbnails, titles and copy for YouTube videos (including shorts) 
  • Coordinate and collaborate with show producers to create a social media plan around promoting new episodes across all of our podcasts, as well as upcoming events, important initiatives, and more
  • Develop and produce engaging social content for each Criminal Productions show— including image assets, GIFs, stories/reels, motion graphics, video cut-downs of episodes, and platform-specific variants
  • Optimize content for platform performance (length, format, captioning, hashtags, thumbnails, CTAs) and stay current with algorithm changes and emerging formats
  • Track performance metrics (views, reach, engagement, follower growth, click-throughs to episode/subscribe) and feed insights back into creative strategy
  • Maintain an archive of assets and templates, and iterate efficiency in production workflows

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Demonstrated ability to produce both longform and shortform video content, especially for talk-based or interview-driven formats
  • Excellent storytelling instincts; knowing which moments to spotlight that hook viewers, evoke emotion or insight, and prompt engagement or action
  • Strong understanding of social platforms and their nuances: Instagram (feed, stories, reels), TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook - including what drives performance, how users engage, and what makes shows grow
  • A collaborative, consultative working style and the ability to plug into existing teams to help elevate their visual presence.
  • Solid skills in editing short-form video tools (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects) and comfort with static image design (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva) and motion graphic templates
  • Ability to manage multiple projects/shows simultaneously, prioritize under tight deadlines, and collaborate closely with teammates
  • Attentiveness to performance metrics and a willingness to adjust accordingly
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience working in podcast media or editorial-driven media brands
  • Familiarity with audio editing or podcast production workflows a plus  

WHO WE ARE

Criminal Productions is the home of the podcast Criminal - as well as the podcasts This is Love, Phoebe Reads a Mystery, and their newest podcast: Please Continue with Phoebe and Lauren. 

Criminal is one of the most-listened to podcasts in the United States, and has been called “the thinking person’s true crime podcast.” Founded in 2014, Criminal has been praised by the ACLU of New York, The New York Times, Entertainment Weekly, and by the former Prime Minister of New Zealand, Jacinda Ardern. 

In 2018, the Criminal team launched This is Love. Time Magazine says, “The podcast tries to decode the mystery of how our romances, obsessions, and relationships drive us. Listening to it can feel like a contact high.” Phoebe Reads a Mystery features Criminal and This is Love host Phoebe Judge reading some of her favorite books in the public domain - from Sherlock Holmes to Little Women. 

Please Continue is our newest venture - an “unserious” chat show featuring Phoebe Judge and Criminal co-creator Lauren Spohrer in conversation about everything from offbeat crime stories to Costco shopping tips. One listener called their dynamic “comedy gold.” 

Criminal Productions is part of Vox Media. As a community of journalists and storytellers, business professionals, creators, and technologists, we believe it is a moral and business imperative to amplify voices: to cultivate diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our organization and media. This applies to our candidates, our teams, our storytelling, our creative work, and our platforms, products, and partnerships.

This is a temporary, 6-month, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life. This role is a part of the Vox Media Union, represented by the Writers Guild of America, East.

This job is remote. We are flexible on your work location, but we expect the candidate to work East Coast business hours (9 am - 5 pm Eastern Time). 

 

PAY TRANSPARENCY

job.title: Video Producer, On With Kara Swisher
job.description:
THE ROLE

The Vox Media Podcast Network is hiring a Video Producer for its award‑winning show On with Kara Swisher. The show reaches a large, influential audience and regularly welcomes headline‑makers across politics (Kamala Harris, Bernie Sanders, Pete Buttegieg), tech (Sam Altman, Geoffrey Hinton, Bill Gates), and culture (Margaret Atwood, Laverne Cox, Ronny Chieng). 

The Video Producer manages the technical workflows for full episodes and social video, creates thumbnails and other assets, and oversees publishing. They will deliver polished, high-performing content tailored to YouTube and other social platforms, and consult on strategy. This is a hands-on role for an experienced visual storyteller with a background in news. 

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life. This role is a part of the Vox Media Union, represented by the Writers Guild of America, East.

This is a remote, US East Coast-only position

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Edit and produce longform video episodes for platforms like YouTube, ensuring strong pacing, dynamic visuals, and high production value across remote, in-studio, and hybrid formats.
  • Create platform-native shortform video content optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts—translating strong podcast moments into compelling visual stories.
  • Design and implement scalable visual elements (motion graphics, captions, lower-thirds, etc.) that align with each show’s tone and target platform.
  • Manage and mentor freelance editors and designers, assigning work, giving creative feedback, and ensuring brand consistency and quality across deliverables.
  • Write and edit scripts as needed in collaboration with hosts/show teams, contributing to the editorial shape and clarity of visual content.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with editorial, social, and audience development teams to ensure content meets performance goals and platform best practices.
  • Stay current on visual and social trends across the podcast and digital media landscape, offering insights and ideas that help teams evolve and stand out.
  • Assembling, refining, and packaging the video version of each episode in Descript, while also producing polished audio using Descript and Pro Tools for advanced cleanup.
  • Shape the pacing, clarity, and visual presentation of each episode and ensure both formats deliver a compelling, high-quality viewer and listener experience.
  • Lead the complete video editing workflow for each episode in Descript, shaping visual pacing, structure, and clarity.
  • Handle multi-track/multi-camera assembly, visual layout adjustments, framing continuity, and sync across tracks.
  • Record and remotely direct host video intros, ensuring consistency in framing, lighting, and delivery.
  • Prepare and refine video assets such as thumbnails, captions, on-screen text, and other YouTube-optimized elements.
  • Maintain efficient ingest-to-publish workflows for all video materials.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 6-8+ years of experience in digital video production, with a track record of success creating editorial content for podcasts and social platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce both longform and shortform video content, especially for talk-based or interview-driven formats.
  • Strong editing expertise in Adobe Premiere
  • Motion design and graphics capabilities in After Effects or similar tools  
  • Experience managing freelancers or vendors, and clear creative direction that ensures timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Excellent editorial instincts and news judgement.
  • A collaborative, consultative working style and the ability to plug into existing teams to help elevate their visual presence.
  • A deep understanding of video platform ecosystems (YouTube, TikTok, Reels), including what drives performance, how users engage, and what makes shows grow.

Job Title: Director, FP&A 


A little bit about our team:  

The WMG FP&A team is responsible for ensuring compliance with WMG’s internal management reporting standards. The team collaborates across divisions, conducting a wide range of analyses including operating performance, market/competitive analysis, and ad-hoc projects. They provide comprehensive reporting and analysis for all actual, forecast, and budget cycles within WMG. 


Your role:  

This role requires a strong background in variance analysis and a deep understanding of accounting and finance. We are seeking an individual who is proactive in analyzing financial variances and can effectively communicate financial results and forecasts. You will collaborate closely with financial leadership across all divisions and the corporate executive team.  You will be responsible for the preparation and delivery of key management financial reports, focusing on areas such as affiliate-specific P&L performance, consolidated WMG performance against the annual budget, prior forecasts, and prior year results. This position will report directly to the VP, Financial Reporting & Analysis.  

 

As a proactive leader, you will manage financial analysis and drive performance across departments, acting as a key strategic partner to executive leadership on critical cross-functional projects. This role requires moving beyond standard metric reporting to actively shape high-level business decisions. We are looking for someone who demonstrates strong leadership by effectively managing resources, mentoring team members, and collaborating across all levels of the organization. You will be expected to inspire, motivate, and hold others accountable for achieving both individual and team goals, fostering a culture of transparency, accountability, and collaboration. 


Here you’ll get to:  

  •  Lead Financial Reporting & Analysis: Oversee monthly and quarterly reporting cycles, ensuring accurate and timely communication of results and forecasts to senior management.  
  • Mentor & Develop Team Members: Manage two direct reports, providing coaching and guidance to help them grow professionally while fostering a high-performance culture.  
  • Strategic Collaboration: Work with various stakeholders, including senior leadership, to integrate financial insights into company strategy and influence decisions.  
  •  Promote Accountability: Ensure team members and stakeholders are held accountable for deliverables, consistently meeting performance targets and financial goals.  
  •  Lead Cross-Functional Projects: Take charge of ad-hoc projects that require collaboration across departments, demonstrating your ability to unite teams and drive outcomes.

 

Key Responsibilities Include:  

 

  • Oversee the Corporate Reporting and Analysis process, ensuring timely monthly reporting of actual and forecast results. Coordinate with segment finance leads at Recorded Music, Music Publishing, and Corporate operating segments for accurate reporting and analysis of WMG’s performance.  
  • Manage and review financial review packages summarizing WMG’s performance, including key metrics, for the Board of Directors, CEO, CFO, and Controller.  
  • Prepare concise summaries of monthly actual and forecast results, comparing them to prior year, prior forecast, and budget, highlighting significant variances. Calculate and track critical compliance metrics, including comparative leverage calculations (e.g., Moody's vs. S&P methodologies), and model Adjusted EBITDA across various projections and business scenarios.  
  • Oversee the preparation and maintenance of recurring source files, primarily in Excel with HFM Smart View functionality, which form the foundation of senior management reporting.  
  • Collaborate with Investor Relations and External Reporting to assist in the development of quarterly and annual press releases, earnings script documents, and other financial communications, including directly supporting IR in answering investor and analyst questions.  
  • Manage KPI reporting across the organization and conduct detailed cost analysis. Perform deep-dive strategic analysis to evaluate key business drivers, model the financial impacts of internal structural changes, assess margin performance, and develop actionable scenarios to optimize financial outcomes. 
  • Work closely with External Reporting to review quarterly MD&A, income statement analysis, and other ad-hoc reporting during the earnings process. 

 

This role offers the opportunity to significantly contribute to WMG’s financial performance and provide strategic insights to senior leadership. 


About you:  

  • 10+ years professional experience in accounting and financial analysis  
  • CPA preferred  
  • Large multi-national experience a plus  
  • Strong computer skills with knowledge of financial systems and software  
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting/ Finance / Economics  

We’d love it if you also had:  

  • Deep understanding of financial analysis and reporting, key business metrics, forecasting, and annual budgeting;  
  • Problem solving, decision making, and continuous process improvement skills  
  • Superior organizational skills with attention to detail  
  • Partnering, influencing, and communication skills up and down the organizational structure to convey key elements in a concise and positive manner  
  • The ability to work proactively, independently and as a strategic partner in a team environment  
  • Knowledge of music/media industry strong plus

●       Collaborate proactively with the International teams on global stock volume needs for upcoming music and merchandise releases.

●       Provide data-driven insights to label partners, factoring cross-border demand and international market nuances directly into production planning to optimize global inventory and prevent stockouts.


Visual Merchandising & Sign-Off

●       Lead direct review sessions with Artist Managers and Label Leads, presenting dynamic thematic updates across digital storefronts to ensure visual merchandising perfectly aligns with the artist’s specific brand era and campaign aesthetics.

●       Shepherd storefront designs and product layouts through executive approval loops, actively managing feedback and securing explicit green lights from external stakeholders before pushing changes live.

The Finance Transformation team is a group of professionals across the WMG organization brought together to re-imagine our processes and systems to establish more standardized and efficient ways of working that will drive WMG’s growth and business aspirations. 


Your role:

The OTC Manager holds a global remit and is responsible for defining the future state Order to Cash (OTC) processes and measures that are aligned with organizational strategies, country-specific knowledge, and operational requirements. This process lead will strive to assemble opportunities, reviewing existing and best-practice workflows, tools, and data. The role moves through design, architecture, implementation, release, and steady state with an ongoing focus on continuous improvement and the integration of OTC finance processes into the overall WMG landscape. Specific accountability from revenue to the sales order and billing documents (plus ebilling where required) for digital, physical, D2C, 3rd party licensing and merchandise revenue streams.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Support the transformation team by leading cross-functional and virtual teams in the review, design, development, and implementation of global processes and procedures, including customer master data, credit management, order management/billing, accounts receivable (AR), collections, cash application, and revenue recognition. 
  • Lead process design meetings with internal Subject Matter Resources (SMRs) and third-party vendors through design, implementation, and release. 
  • Lead technical and operational teams to conduct testing, defect resolution, and ongoing configuration of SAP SD/FI-AR modules and associated sub-systems. 
  • Be responsible for OTC testing across credit limit setting, billing, cash application, dispute management, credit/debit memo processing, customer statement generation, and collaborate with sales, distribution, and licensing platforms. 
  • Work closely with the SAP Master Data Management team to ensure customer master data configuration and governance are consistent with global processes. 
  • Work closely with WMG Tax to solve complex scenarios involving worldwide tax.
  • Act as representative for intercompany billing between service centers and transformation.
  • Leverage OTC and industry process and systems knowledge/experience to implement standardization of global, regional, and/or local processes, challenging the status quo while taking input from SMRs and program partners to understand required localizations. 
  • Lead the design, documentation, and ongoing socialization of end-to-end OTC processes. 
  • Obtain consensus for Finance Transformation from key WMG partners across the globe by credibly communicating deep operating process and systems knowledge and an appreciation of the impact at a local level. 
  • Attend and/or present in update meetings as required for key decision, issue, and risk points. 
  • Work with collaborators to ensure Product / Policy / Process / Procedure / System decisions account for territory variances, commercial needs, and local legal/regulatory requirements. 
  • Partner with IT to identify integration points between commercial/sales operations systems, billing platforms, and core finance systems. 
  • Partner with people and change management resources to develop job aids, communications, and training approaches to embed new ways of working and systems training for the OTC area. 
  • Act as a spokesperson across the WMG organization for the benefits delivered by the Finance Transformation in the OTC space. 
  • Represent the OTC Business Process at individual Fit/Gap sessions in markets to ensure all business requirements are considered (and documented via User Requirements Specification). Ensure that any business needs driving a requirement for customization are strongly challenged and options for process redesign are considered. Where customizations are needed, ensure justification is documented and changes progress via the governance model. 
  • Update relevant OTC documentation based on changes to the global template (including SOPs, User Guides, and training materials). 
  • Participate in the preparation of OTC training materials. 
  • Be responsible for the resolution and review of OTC issues, risks, and business impacts for the owned process. 
  • Proactively and on an ongoing basis identify internal and external OTC guidelines (e.g., automation in cash application, AI-driven credit scoring, streamlined collections) that will enable improvement of the standard end-to-end process. 

About you:

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Business, Finance, Accounting, Business Information Systems, Management Science, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Proven experience focusing on OTC processes (Credit, Collections, Cash Application, Billing, AR) or related finance transformation experience. 
  • Strong Order to Cash process and systems knowledge, preferably within a music, media, digital licensing, or entertainment industry context. 
  • Facilitative style, with prior experience leading workshops and engaging collaborators through a series of approaches that require a targeted level of consensus. 
  • Relevant operational OTC experience supervising credit management, order fulfillment/billing workflows, cash management, dispute resolution, AR ledger management, and internal controls. 
  • Technically savvy with a robust organizational change skillset. 
  • Experience with a previous SAP implementation (specifically SAP SD, FI-AR, or FSCM) is crucial. 
  • Exemplary collaborator engagement and management skills internationally and within complex, multi-faceted organizations. 
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to perform complex dispute, credit risk, and receivables analysis. 
  • Ability to develop, articulate, and build support around a long-term OTC vision and implement incremental turning points in support of that vision. 
  • Team player who can participate and collaborate with varied business units (sales, licensing, supply chain, legal, finance) to effectively implement transformation initiatives. 


We’d love it if you also had:

  • Transformational leadership experience. 
  • Media, entertainment, digital distribution, or music industry experience preferred. 
  • Familiarity with SAP FSCM (Credit Management, Dispute Management, Collections Management) and modern automated cash application tools.

A Little Bit About Our Team:

The Record to Report (RTR) Accounting Team serves as the central operational backbone for financial integrity, revenue recognition, cash management, and financial reporting across Warner Music Group.

Operating within our Shared Services / Global Business Services framework, the Recorded Music RTR team provides specialized accounting expertise, revenue assurance, and critical month-end closing support across WMG’s renowned domestic and international record labels. We work with the GBS Revenue Team translating complex data into accurate financial reporting under US GAAP.


Your Role:

As the lead Revenue Accountant for Recorded Music, you will serve as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for our recorded music revenue accounting life cycle. This role bridges technical accounting, data analytics, and financial systems design. You will take ownership of the end-to-end accounting for high-volume, multi-source revenue streams, drive compliance with ASC 606, spearhead systems automation, and unlock actionable financial insights through advanced data mining. In addition to technical execution, you will provide training and education to other members of the Recorded Music RTR team.


Here you'll get to:

  • Lead the technical accounting, accrual modeling, and reconciliation for all Recorded Music revenue streams, including Digital Streaming Partners (Spotify, Apple, YouTube, Amazon), Digital Downloads, DMCA statutory royalties, Physical manufacturing and distribution (vinyl, CD, merch), Synchronization (film, TV, gaming, advertising), Master Licensing, and foreign affiliate distributions.
  • Architect and maintain robust ASC 606 recognition schedules, monthly flash revenue accruals, deferred revenue tracking, and automated reversals based on consumption ingestion files vs. actual cash settlements.
  • Query, clean, and analyze Revenue Operational Reporting datasets across disparate DSPs using Analysis for Office and Gemini AI Tools.    Reconcile Multi-System Reporting from Source to Financial Ledger.
  • Bridge consumption metadata (streams, downloads, play counts, tier rates) with transactional general ledger activity to detect anomalies, underreported royalties, missing catalog codes, and system mismatches.
  • Conduct granular month-over-month (MoM) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) variance analyses; present variance drivers to label finance leaders.
  • Serve as the RTR business lead for financial systems optimization across SAP (ECC / S/4HANA), BlackLine, and proprietary music revenue sub-ledgers.
  • Design, test, and implement automated reporting simplify manual journal entries and compress the monthly close cycle.
  • Direct the monthly and quarterly close deliverables for recorded music revenue, reviewing high-volume journal entries, complex accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Review work products prepared by staff accountants and offshore shared service partners (e.g., Shopify D2C sales tie-outs, DSP settlement matching, clearing account reconciliations), providing structured guidance and establishing standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Actively investigate and resolve persistent balances in revenue clearing, suspense, and partner withholding accounts.
  • Maintain and enhance internal control matrices under Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX 404), ensuring proper segregation of duties, automated validation checks, and data lineage documentation.
  • Serve as primary revenue audit liaison for internal and external auditors (e.g., Big 4), providing PBC audit schedules, roll-forwards, sample testing support, and technical accounting memos.
  • Partner proactively with Label Finance VPs/Directors, Commercial Revenue Operations, Business & Legal Affairs, IT/Data Engineering, and Corporate Royalty teams to align accounting treatments with evolving contract structures and deal terms.

About you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related analytical field required.
  • Active CPA license (or international equivalent) strongly preferred.
  • Master’s Degree (MAcc, MBA) or coursework in Financial Data Analytics / Information Systems is a significant plus.
  • 10 to 15+ years of progressive, hands-on accounting experience in Corporate Accounting, Shared Services, or Big 4 Public Accounting.
  • Extensive specialization (7+ years) in high-volume revenue accounting, billing assurance, or royalty accounting within the music, digital entertainment, streaming media, or intellectual property/licensing sectors.
  • Proven track record leading technical ASC 606 revenue recognition implementations or oversight for complex multi-element arrangements.
  • Demonstrable experience directing and reviewing work performed by distributed, hybrid, or offshore delivery centers.
  • Deep experience working with enterprise ERPs (specifically SAP FI/CO, S/4HANA) and automated balance sheet reconciliation tools (such as BlackLine or Cadency).
  • Expert-level Microsoft Excel proficiency (SAP Analysis for Office, Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/macros, advanced nested logic).
  • Experience with eCommerce and digital billing platforms (e.g., Shopify, DSP vendor reporting portals) is highly desirable.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Ability to untangle intricate data anomalies and synthesize findings into clear executive summaries.
  • Proactive drive to evaluate status-quo manual workflows and design scalable, automated alternatives.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to collaborate across label executives, data engineers, and external auditors.
  • Proven capacity to manage high-pressure close deadlines and competing stakeholder requests with composure and precision.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Job Title: SVP, Business & Legal Affairs


A little bit about our team: 

We are a dynamic, diverse, and dedicated group of professionals with a passion for music who provide general counseling to Warner Records on a wide range of business and legal issues. We value hard work, fine-tuned listening, and a forward-thinking approach. We work closely with every department at the label and focus on structuring the label’s business and legal relationship with each of our artists.


Your role: 

You will have the chance to make a significant and tangible contribution to the creation and release of our artists’ music. You will lead and oversee all business and legal aspects of the process, from recording to marketing to other activities surrounding artist projects. In a rapidly ever-changing industry, you will be challenged to make the most of your existing skills while driving strategic leadership and policy. The Warner Records culture will challenge you to make the most of your skills while providing ample opportunity to grow as an executive leader!


Here you’ll get to: 

  • Negotiate and draft a variety of music and entertainment-related agreements, including recording, label, license, producer, mixer, soundtrack, termination/release, and merchandise, along with related memos and summaries 
  • Advise and support A&R, marketing, video, commerce, promotion, royalties, international, and other departments regarding contractual and legal obligations 
  • Partner with A&R administration regarding clearances, budgets, approvals, and general counseling 
  • Collaborate with Finance to develop deal analyses 
  • Review and vet artwork, label copy, videos, and other assets and materials 
  • Provide counseling and policy guidance regarding the label’s content distribution and other business activities 
  • Investigate, analyze, and respond to claims and disputes, including copyright, audit, breach of contract, publicity, and trademark, and coordinate with the corporate legal department regarding dispute resolution strategies
  • Lead, mentor, and manage junior attorneys, paralegals, and department staff

About you:

  • You are incredibly passionate and knowledgeable about music. 
  • You have a J.D. from top law school plus membership in good standing in one state bar (preferably California). 
  • You have at least 12+ years of post-bar experience, including extensive experience in a major record label business and legal affairs department, in-house legal department, law firm, or similar senior executive experience. 
  • You have outstanding negotiating, drafting, organizational, and oral and written communication skills. 
  • You have a proven track record working independently within a team-oriented environment. 
  • You consistently and effectively meet deadlines while working under pressure, managing multiple assignments at any given time, and prioritizing them effectively and appropriately. 

We’d love it if you also had: 

  • Strong business and financial knowledge.
  • In-depth understanding of the areas of the law applicable to the music business, including copyright, trademark, contract, rights of publicity, etc.

job.title: B2B Engagement Marketing Lead
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is one of the most influential newsrooms in the world, and our subscriber base is growing to match. This role sits at the center of that growth responsible for how enterprise clients and professional product subscribers experience The Post after they sign up. WP Intelligence is our professional intelligence product line, delivering curated reporting, data, and analysis for decision-makers across industries. As the Engagement Marketing Lead for Enterprise and WP Intelligence, you will own the subscriber journey from activation through renewal designing omnichannel programs that help organizations and professionals get lasting value from their subscriptions.

Reporting to the Director of Engagement and Retention, you will partner closely with Enterprise Sales and Account Management, WP Intelligence Editorial, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, and Brand Marketing to build and execute strategies that drive measurable engagement and long-term retention.

Why This Role Matters

  • You support The Post’s mission to deliver world-class journalism while expanding reach and influence

  • You drive data-informed marketing strategies that improve activation, usage, and long-term retention

  • You thrive in collaborative environments that value initiative, clarity, and continuous improvement

  • You enjoy leading fast-paced, cross-platform programs that enhance subscriber experience and fuel business growth

How You'll Support the Mission

Lifecycle Strategy

  • Develop and execute full-funnel lifecycle programs that increase usage and deepen engagement across app, site, newsletters, and subscription benefits for enterprise and professional product subscribers.

  • Build subscriber journeys spanning lead progression, account activation, onboarding, education, loyalty, and renewal maintaining playbooks that support scalable, repeatable execution.

  • Design approaches that serve multiple audiences within a single account, including corporate and higher education end users, students, and key decision-makers.

The Manager, FP&A – Revenue & Growth is a key finance business partner supporting The Washington Post’s B2C digital subscription, B2B revenue, and emerging growth initiatives. This role translates business performance, market dynamics, and operating decisions into clear financial insight that helps leaders invest wisely, manage risk, and build sustainable revenue.

Reporting within the FP&A organization, the Manager leads planning, forecasting, and performance analysis for assigned revenue businesses while developing financial talent and strengthening the tools, processes, and partnerships that support informed decision-making across the company.

  • You are energized by helping mission-driven media organizations build durable, diversified revenue models.

  • Lead strategic analyses and ambiguous growth-related projects, structuring complex questions and communicating conclusions that advance executive decision-making.

 

The Skills and Experience You Bring

job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.

Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking an experienced Mobile Software Engineer to drive the technical evolution of our flagship mobile applications. In this role, you will focus on core mobile architecture, application performance, modularity, and cross-cutting platform systems. Our native apps drive the majority of our digital reach and serve millions of daily readers, making app reliability, fluid responsiveness, and maintainable software design central to our engineering mission. You will be responsible for defining structural patterns, eliminating technical debt, optimizing foundation-level workflows (networking, caching, state orchestration), and safely integrating high-impact domain modules - ranging from reader experiences and personalization to native monetization frameworks.


What Motivates You

  • You are passionate about clean system design, modular codebases, and establishing design standards that make multi-team feature development faster and safer.
  • You care deeply about fundamental app metrics—cold start times, smooth 60/120 fps rendering, battery efficiency, and low memory footprints.
  • You enjoy solving systemic, cross-cutting engineering problems that impact the entire application stack, not just isolated user interfaces.
  • You appreciate that third-party systems and revenue mechanisms are integral to running a premier media operation, and you relish the challenge of isolating external dependencies behind strict, testable abstractions.
  • You are eager to work with modern native patterns (Swift, Kotlin, declarative UI) and explore shared architecture paradigms to streamline cross-platform capabilities.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Design, implement, and maintain core mobile architecture patterns, shared foundational frameworks, and modular dependency graphs across the application.
  • Drive app-wide technical initiatives: optimize cold/warm startup times, reduce memory and binary footprint, and eliminate main-thread bottlenecks using profiling tools.
  • Establish robust abstraction layers, adapter patterns, and dependency injection strategies to isolate high-risk third-party SDKs, revenue systems, and analytics vendors.
  • Partner with product, backend, and feature teams to establish standardized API contracts, networking patterns, data persistence schemes, and caching strategies.
  • Lead architectural design discussions, author RFCs, define code quality benchmarks, and conduct thorough peer code reviews.
  • Support high-impact vertical integrations (such as native monetization, audio/video playback, and content feeds) by designing clean hook points and lifecycle management pipelines.
  • Ensure app compliance with platform privacy policies, sandbox requirements, and operating system updates across Apple and Google ecosystems.
  • Champion automated testing standards, CI/CD pipeline reliability, and contract testing across client-server boundaries.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Design, implement, and maintain core mobile architecture patterns, shared foundational frameworks, and modular dependency graphs across the application.
  • Establish robust abstraction layers, adapter patterns, and dependency injection strategies to isolate high-risk third-party SDKs, revenue systems, and analytics vendors.
  • Lead architectural design discussions, author RFCs, define code quality benchmarks, and conduct thorough peer code reviews.
  • Champion automated testing standards, CI/CD pipeline reliability, and contract testing across client-server boundaries.

Qualifications

  • Bachelorʼs degree in Computer Science, engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of professional mobile engineering experience shipping large-scale, production-grade applications.
  • Strong proficiency in modern native mobile development (Swift/iOS; familiarity with Android or Kotlin Multiplatform is a strong asset).
  • Deep understanding of architectural paradigms (MVVM, Clean Architecture, Unidirectional Data Flow / MVI, modularization) and design patterns.
  • Proven track record diagnosing and resolving system-level performance issues (concurrency, memory leaks, frame drops, network overhead).
  • Experience architecting SDK integration layers, wrapper libraries, or plugin systems that protect host app stability and crash-free rates.
  • Solid grasp of client-server API design, schema definition (REST, Protocol Buffers/gRPC, or GraphQL), and offline-first data synchronization.
  • Demonstrated commitment to code hygiene, automated testing (unit, integration, snapshot/UI), and continuous integration workflows.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join the Subscriptions team at The Washington Post. This role spans the full application stack with a strong emphasis on frontend applications and customer-facing experiences. You will design and build modern web applications primarily using React and TypeScript, while also contributing to backend services built with Java and Node.js and the AWS infrastructure and deployment systems that support them.


As a senior engineer, you will take ownership of complex technical work from design through production, contribute to architectural decisions, and help improve the quality, performance, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability of the applications our subscription products depend on.


The ideal candidate brings strong frontend engineering experience, particularly with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript, along with practical experience working with backend services and APIs. You should be able to contribute to Java and Node.js applications and be comfortable with AWS, CI/CD, observability, and production operations. This is a frontend-focused role, but you should be capable of delivering effectively across the full stack.


We value autonomy, initiative, strong technical judgment, clear communication, and meaningful day-to-day use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including continually finding new ways to apply AI to software development, automation, operations, and team effectiveness.


What Motivates You

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for the software you build and the customer experiences it supports.
  • Passionate about designing accessible, performant, reliable, and maintainable frontend applications.
  • Enjoys solving complex frontend and full-stack problems and driving work from design through production.
  • Comfortable working across React applications, backend services and APIs, AWS infrastructure, and production operations.
  • Proactive and comfortable driving complex work with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Interested in understanding how applications operate in production rather than treating deployment and infrastructure as separate concerns.
  • Actively uses AI in day-to-day engineering and continually looks for ways to expand its impact on development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, and productivity.
  • Enjoys collaborating across engineering, product, and design while mentoring other engineers and communicating technical decisions clearly.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate customer-facing applications and services supporting our subscription products.
  • Develop modern frontend applications primarily using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Build and improve subscription experiences such as checkout, offers, paywalls, product pages, subscriber lifecycle flows, and mobile web and native app integrations.
  • Own technical solutions throughout their lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through deployment, observability, production support, and continuous improvement.
  • Make thoughtful frontend architectural decisions around component design, application structure, state management, API integration, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Build reusable components, shared libraries, and frontend patterns that improve consistency and development efficiency.
  • Contribute to backend services, APIs, integrations, automation, and tooling built with Java and Node.js.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to define reliable API contracts and integration patterns that support customer-facing experiences.
  • Work with AWS services and infrastructure supporting our applications and contribute to CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Establish strong observability and diagnose issues spanning frontend applications, backend services, integrations, infrastructure, and deployment systems.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, taking ownership of incident diagnosis, mitigation, communication, and follow-up.
  • Identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, architectural limitations, and opportunities for improvement and proactively drive solutions.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical standards, architecture discussions, documentation, code quality, and engineering best practices.
  • Use AI throughout the engineering lifecycle to improve development, testing, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and operational workflows.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Broad expertise building responsive, high-performance web applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Solid background developing backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Node.js.
  • Experience working within AWS ecosystems, including containerized workloads (Docker/ECS) and foundational Infrastructure as Code concepts.
  • Strong knowledge of core web technologies, responsive layouts, web accessibility standards, and browser performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience establishing CI/CD automation and deployment pipeline configurations.
  • Familiarity with production monitoring and observability tools, including logging, metrics, alerting, and incident response.
  • Background building conversion-critical customer experiences, such as checkout flows, subscription systems, paywalls, or payment integrations.
  • Experience integrating web applications and micro-frontends with native mobile app environments.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to support day-to-day software development, testing, and troubleshooting.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of frontend development with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • 3+ years of backend development with Java, Node.js, or both.
  • 2+ years of experience deploying and operating applications in AWS.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive design, accessibility, browser behavior, and frontend performance.
  • Experience with frontend architecture, reusable components, state management, API integration, and automated testing.
  • Experience building and integrating with RESTful APIs and distributed backend services.
  • Experience with AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, and CloudWatch.
  • Experience with CI/CD and deployment automation using Jenkins or comparable tooling.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience building and operating containerized applications using Docker and ECS.
  • Experience with production observability, including logs, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting production applications through on-call rotations and incident response.
  • Ability to independently scope and drive complex technical work from design through production.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Significant hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools in day-to-day development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, or automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of frontend development with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • 4+ years of backend development with Java, Node.js, or both.
  • 3+ years of experience designing, deploying, and operating applications in AWS.
  • Experience with frontend monorepos, shared component libraries, design systems, or reusable application frameworks.
  • Experience building high-volume or conversion-sensitive experiences such as checkout, payments, subscriptions, ecommerce, registration, or account management.
  • Experience integrating web applications with native mobile applications.
  • Strong experience with Jenkins, AWS CDK, Terraform, containerized deployments, and automated delivery pipelines.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Catchpoint, and AWS-native monitoring services.
  • Experience improving frontend performance, accessibility, application reliability, and developer productivity.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing frontend architecture and engineering practices across team boundaries.
  • Advanced use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including helping other engineers apply AI effectively across development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, and operations.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

$119,700 - $199,300 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

job.title: Social Video Editor
job.description:
Application Instructions

Please list all professional experience and explain any gaps in employment history. All of your application materials, which may include PDF files of work samples and/or links to audio, video, photography or graphics, must be uploaded to the field labeled Resume/Cover Letter/Work Samples to be considered for the position.


Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a creative and versatile social video editor to help drive visual storytelling across our social platforms.


We’re looking for an editor who understands how journalism travels on social media — and how to shape it for audiences who expect immediacy, personality and clarity. This role will identify and create high-impact news video as well as work with Post journalists to create social-first video that resonates across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat, X and emerging platforms.


The ideal candidate is fluent in shooting and editing vertical video, deeply familiar with platform best practices and energized by the challenge of translating rigorous reporting into compelling short-form storytelling. This editor will be part of a team focused on producing high-impact video for both The Post’s owned-and-operated platforms and social ecosystems, helping grow reach, engagement and brand loyalty.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom.


What Motivates You:

  • You are excited about meeting audiences where they are and experimenting with new storytelling formats.
  • You enjoy collaborating with reporters and helping them sharpen their on-camera voice.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment where speed and accuracy both matter.
  • You are energized by tracking performance and iterating to improve results.
  • You care deeply about journalistic standards, even in short-form and highly visual formats.

How You’ll Support the Mission:

  • Shoot and edit vertical video optimized for social viewing, ensuring strong hooks, pacing and clarity.
  • Partner with Post journalists to create personality-driven, social-first videos tailored for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat and other platforms, grounded in Post standards and social media policies.
  • Collaborate with editors, producers and designers across the newsroom to refine the look, voice and tone of social video.
  • Evaluate engagement metrics regularly, track performance and adapt production strategies to maximize audience growth and interaction.
  • Coach journalists on best practices for creating effective social-first video, including scripting, framing and delivery.
  • Write accurate scripts, headlines, captions and metadata that enhance discoverability and engagement.

The Skills and Experiences You Bring:

  • At least two years of experience in a professional newsroom.
  • At least three years of video editing experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere and comfort managing the full social publishing pipeline.
  • Demonstrated speed and precision in video editing for deadline-driven environments.
  • Experience publishing to major social platforms and a deep understanding of vertical video best practices.
  • Strong news judgment, attention to detail and commitment to fact-checking and accuracy.
  • Ability to write clear, compelling scripts and social copy quickly.
  • Experience in audience engagement and working across multiple social platforms.
  • A demonstrated ability to use analytics to inform editorial and production decisions.
  • Experience producing video in the field, including operating camera equipment, lighting and audio setups.
  • A track record of creative and distinctive work on social media platforms.

Interested candidates should upload a résumé and a cover letter to our jobs portal. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, but those received by Oct. 27 will be prioritized. The cover letter should be addressed to Managing Editor for Content Strategy Bryan Flaherty and Head of Off-Platform Strategy Keely Diven.

The salary range for this position is $82,600 - $123,800. The actual starting salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements.
