job.title: Accounts Payable Assistant
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Position Overview
The Accounts Payable Travel Assistant is a hands-on operational role responsible for keeping TKO's travel-related payables running smoothly and accurately. This position owns the day-to-day processing of invoices and vendor payments, partners closely with the Travel and Finance teams to maintain tight controls and plays an active role in driving process improvements through automation.


Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end processing of travel-related invoices — including hotel commissions, airline invoices, and travel agency billing — from receipt through payment.
  • Code and route invoices accurately, ensuring proper allocation and timely approvals.
  • Verify invoices against purchase orders, receipts, and approvals; resolve discrepancies before they impact payment cycles.
  • Reconcile vendor accounts on a regular cadence and escalate aged or unresolved items promptly.
  • Monitor vendor payment schedules to ensure all invoices are settled on time and in accordance with agreed terms.
  • Maintain audit-ready financial records and documentation in line with compliance standards.
  • Act as the operational point of contact for travel vendors, handling payment inquiries and billing disputes efficiently.
  • Execute month-end close tasks, including reconciliations, accruals, and reporting, to meet finance deadlines.
  • Partner with the WWE Travel Department to support audits and spend analysis on travel-related costs.
  • Operate and help optimize AI-powered invoice automation tools, identifying manual bottlenecks and recommending process improvements.

Required Skills

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in accounts payable, travel administration, or a related accounting operations role.
  • Strong attention to detail with a process-oriented, organized approach to high-volume work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; comfort working with financial systems and automation tools.
  • Proven ability to manage competing deadlines and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Position Title: Manager, Membership Growth

Location: Los Angeles, CA (onsite)

I. Position Summary:

Manager of Membership Growth to help launch and scale a new digital membership product. This role will focus on converting a broad fan audience and large and growing waitlist into a paid membership base. The ideal candidate can build lifecycle campaigns, segment audiences, test messaging and offers, analyze performance, and coordinate cross-functionally to drive membership growth. This is primarily an owned-channel growth role, rather than a paid media role. Previous experience in subscription, membership, ecommerce, loyalty, ticketing, sports, media, entertainment, or consumer products is a plus. 2–5 years of relevant experience preferred, but open based on fit.

II. Core Responsibilities:

  • Own paid member growth for the digital membership product, with responsibility for converting waitlist users and owned fan audiences into new paid members

  • Build and manage lifecycle campaigns across email, SMS, web, app, landing pages, and other owned channels to support launch and ongoing membership growth

  • Partner with CRM and Data teams to segment audiences based on fan behavior, engagement, purchase history, geography, event interest, and stated preferences

  • Support launch planning and execution, including campaign calendars, audience sequencing, and testing plans

  • A/B test and optimize campaign messaging, subject lines, CTAs, offers, timing, landing pages, and conversion flows

  • Work closely with Product to identify and improve key funnel moments from waitlist sign-up to paid membership conversion

  • Collaborate with Creative and Marketing teams to develop campaign assets that clearly communicate membership benefits and drive action

  • Coordinate with Ticketing, Ecommerce, Social, Content, and CRM teams to maximize owned-channel promotion and conversion opportunities across digital touchpoints

  • Track funnel performance and prepare weekly readouts covering waitlist growth, email engagement, click-through rate, landing page conversion, checkout completion, paid member conversion, revenue, retention, key learnings, and next steps

  • Help establish repeatable growth processes for future membership campaigns, renewals, benefit drops, event pushes, and seasonal moments

$93,750 annually (minimum will not fall below the applicable State/local minimum salary thresholds)

Hiring Rate Maximum:

job.title: Part – Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle — Wake Up Missouri - Columbia, MO
job.description: Part – Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle — Wake Up Missouri - Columbia, MO - Zimmer Communications Jobs Jobs | Login Location: Columbia, MO, USA Pay Rate: Pay Type: Employment Type: Part Time Email Me This Job Part - Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle - Wake Up Missouri 93.9 The Eagle is looking for a dynamic Co-Host to join our top-rated morning News/Talk show, Wake Up Missouri . This is an opportunity to co-host a fast-paced, three-hour morning show heard across Missouri. ARE YOU THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR? Do you have an opinion about almost anything at the drop of a hat? Do you love sharing observations about your life, your experiences and the events everyone is talking about? Are you a storyteller who can turn an everyday experience into entertaining radio? Are you a team player who understands that great radio comes from chemistry, preparation and collaboration? Can you comfortably talk about news, politics, sports, movies, music and pop culture ? Are you willing to tease your fellow hosts-and be teased right back? If so, we want to hear from you. ABOUT WAKE UP MISSOURI Wake Up Missouri focuses on the biggest stories and conversations of the day. There are occasional newsmaker interviews, but the heart of the show is personality, opinions, observations, storytelling and debate . The show moves quickly. When breaking news happens, we change direction and go with it. You need to be prepared, curious, conversational and nimble enough to contribute wherever the show goes. Our target audience is clearly defined, and the show is built to give its personalities the opportunity to connect with listeners and succeed. WHAT YOU'LL GET You'll join a terrific on-air team in a supportive, creative environment. You'll also receive top-notch coaching and ongoing feedback designed to help you develop your personality, sharpen your skills and win in this role. We're looking for someone who doesn't just want to be on the radio. We're looking for someone who has something to say.
